011_the_infinitude_of_primes
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Infinitude of Primes" from Hundred Theorems item 011.
% This file contains no proof.

the_infinitude_of_primes: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(n: nat): bool =
    n >= 2 AND
      FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, n) IMPLIES
          divisor = 1 OR divisor = n

  the_infinitude_of_primes: bool =
    FORALL (bound: nat):
      EXISTS (p: nat):
        bound < p AND prime_nat(p)

END the_infinitude_of_primes

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate" from Hundred
-- Theorems item 012. This file contains no proof.

/-!
# The Independence of the Parallel Postulate

This statement-only file presents the two-dimensional Klein-disc model over an abstract
Dedekind-complete ordered field. Such a field is a presentation of the real numbers. Points are
pairs of scalars in the open unit disc, betweenness is ordinary affine betweenness, and segment
congruence is equality for the Klein semimetric.
-/

namespace Theorems100
namespace ParallelPostulateIndependence

/-- The scalar structure used below: a Dedekind-complete linearly ordered field with square root. -/
structure RealScalar where
  Carrier : Type
  zero : Carrier
  one : Carrier
  add : Carrier → Carrier → Carrier
  mul : Carrier → Carrier → Carrier
  neg : Carrier → Carrier
  inv : Carrier → Carrier
  sqrt : Carrier → Carrier
  le : Carrier → Carrier → Prop
  lt : Carrier → Carrier → Prop
  decLt : (a b : Carrier) → Decidable (lt a b)
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_comm : ∀ a b, add a b = add b a
  zero_add : ∀ a, add zero a = a
  add_neg : ∀ a, add (neg a) a = zero
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c, mul (mul a b) c = mul a (mul b c)
  mul_comm : ∀ a b, mul a b = mul b a
  one_mul : ∀ a, mul one a = a
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c, mul a (add b c) = add (mul a b) (mul a c)
  zero_ne_one : zero ≠ one
  inv_zero : inv zero = zero
  mul_inv : ∀ a, a ≠ zero → mul (inv a) a = one
  le_refl : ∀ a, le a a
  le_trans : ∀ a b c, le a b → le b c → le a c
  le_antisymm : ∀ a b, le a b → le b a → a = b
  le_total : ∀ a b, le a b ∨ le b a
  lt_iff_le_not_le : ∀ a b, lt a b ↔ le a b ∧ ¬le b a
  add_le_add_right : ∀ a b c, le a b → le (add a c) (add b c)
  mul_pos : ∀ a b, lt zero a → lt zero b → lt zero (mul a b)
  sqrt_nonneg : ∀ a, le zero (sqrt a)
  sqrt_sq : ∀ a, le zero a → mul (sqrt a) (sqrt a) = a
  complete :
    ∀ S : Carrier → Prop,
      (∃ x, S x) →
      (∃ u, ∀ x, S x → le x u) →
      ∃ s, (∀ x, S x → le x s) ∧ ∀ u, (∀ x, S x → le x u) → le s u

abbrev Real (R : RealScalar) := R.Carrier
abbrev EuclideanPoint (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat) := Fin n → Real R
abbrev Complex (R : RealScalar) := EuclideanPoint R 2
abbrev Set (α : Type) := α → Prop

def sub (R : RealScalar) (a b : Real R) : Real R :=
  R.add a (R.neg b)

def div (R : RealScalar) (a b : Real R) : Real R :=
  R.mul a (R.inv b)

def sq (R : RealScalar) (a : Real R) : Real R :=
  R.mul a a

def two (R : RealScalar) : Real R :=
  R.add R.one R.one

def four (R : RealScalar) : Real R :=
  R.mul (two R) (two R)

def half (R : RealScalar) : Real R :=
  div R R.one (two R)

def pointZero (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat} : EuclideanPoint R n :=
  fun _ => R.zero

def pointOne (R : RealScalar) : Complex R :=
  fun i => if i = 0 then R.one else R.zero

def pointAdd (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (a b : EuclideanPoint R n) : EuclideanPoint R n :=
  fun i => R.add (a i) (b i)

def pointSub (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (a b : EuclideanPoint R n) : EuclideanPoint R n :=
  fun i => sub R (a i) (b i)

def smul (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (a : Real R) (x : EuclideanPoint R n) : EuclideanPoint R n :=
  fun i => R.mul a (x i)

def dot (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) : Real R :=
  (Vector.ofFn (fun i => R.mul (x i) (y i))).toArray.foldl R.add R.zero

def normSq (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat} (x : EuclideanPoint R n) : Real R :=
  dot R x x

def norm (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat} (x : EuclideanPoint R n) : Real R :=
  R.sqrt (normSq R x)

def dist (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) : Real R :=
  norm R (pointSub R x y)

def abs (R : RealScalar) (x : Real R) : Real R :=
  match R.decLt x R.zero with
  | isTrue _ => R.neg x
  | isFalse _ => x

/-- Affine betweenness, with the middle point given first. -/
def between (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (x a b : EuclideanPoint R n) : Prop :=
  ∃ t : Real R,
    R.le R.zero t ∧
      R.le t R.one ∧
      x = pointAdd R (smul R (sub R R.one t) a) (smul R t b)

def collinear (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (a b c : EuclideanPoint R n) : Prop :=
  ∃ p v : EuclideanPoint R n, ∃ sa sb sc : Real R,
    a = pointAdd R p (smul R sa v) ∧
      b = pointAdd R p (smul R sb v) ∧
      c = pointAdd R p (smul R sc v)

def continuousAt (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (f : EuclideanPoint R n → Real R) (x : EuclideanPoint R n) : Prop :=
  ∀ epsilon,
    R.lt R.zero epsilon →
      ∃ delta,
        R.lt R.zero delta ∧
          ∀ y,
            R.lt (dist R y x) delta →
              R.lt (abs R (sub R (f y) (f x))) epsilon

/-- The semimetric used by the Klein model, with Euclidean distance outside the unit ball. -/
def ddist (R : RealScalar) {n : Nat}
    (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) : Real R :=
  match R.decLt (norm R x) R.one with
  | isTrue _ =>
      match R.decLt (norm R y) R.one with
      | isTrue _ =>
          sub R
            (div R
              (sq R (sub R R.one (dot R x y)))
              (R.mul
                (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R x)))
                (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R y)))))
            R.one
      | isFalse _ => dist R x y
  | isFalse _ => dist R x y

theorem ddist_increases_online (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (a b x : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (ha : R.lt (norm R a) R.one)
    (hb : R.lt (norm R b) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one)
    (hbetween : between R x a b)
    (hxb : x ≠ b) :
    R.lt (ddist R a x) (ddist R a b) := sorry

theorem ddist_refl (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat) (x : EuclideanPoint R n) :
    ddist R x x = R.zero := sorry

theorem ddist_symm (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat) (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) :
    ddist R x y = ddist R y x := sorry

theorem ddist_pos (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    R.lt R.zero (ddist R x y) := sorry

theorem ddist_nonneg (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat) (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) :
    R.le R.zero (ddist R x y) := sorry

theorem ddist_eq_zero (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat) (x y : EuclideanPoint R n) :
    ddist R x y = R.zero ↔ x = y := sorry

theorem between_iff_collinear_ddist (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (a b x : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (ha : R.lt (norm R a) R.one)
    (hb : R.lt (norm R b) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    between R x a b ↔
      collinear R a x b ∧
        R.le (ddist R x a) (ddist R a b) ∧
        R.le (ddist R x b) (ddist R a b) := sorry

theorem continuousAt_ddist (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (a x : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (ha : R.lt (norm R a) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    continuousAt R (fun y => ddist R a y) x := sorry

theorem hyperbolic_midpoint (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (a b : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (ha : R.lt (norm R a) R.one)
    (hb : R.lt (norm R b) R.one) :
    ∃ x, between R x a b ∧ ddist R x a = ddist R x b := sorry

theorem ddist_eq_origin (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (x y : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one)
    (hy : R.lt (norm R y) R.one) :
    ddist R (pointZero R) x = ddist R (pointZero R) y ↔
      norm R x = norm R y := sorry

theorem ddist_congruent_triples_zero (R : RealScalar) (n : Nat)
    (a b a' b' : EuclideanPoint R n)
    (ha : R.lt (norm R a) R.one)
    (hb : R.lt (norm R b) R.one)
    (ha' : R.lt (norm R a') R.one)
    (hb' : R.lt (norm R b') R.one) :
    (ddist R (pointZero R) a = ddist R (pointZero R) a' ∧
        ddist R a b = ddist R a' b' ∧
        ddist R b (pointZero R) = ddist R b' (pointZero R)) ↔
      (dist R (pointZero R) a = dist R (pointZero R) a' ∧
        dist R a b = dist R a' b' ∧
        dist R b (pointZero R) = dist R b' (pointZero R)) := sorry

def complexMk (R : RealScalar) (re im : Real R) : Complex R :=
  fun i => if i = 0 then re else im

def complexRe (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) : Real R :=
  z 0

def complexIm (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) : Real R :=
  z 1

def complexConj (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  complexMk R (complexRe R z) (R.neg (complexIm R z))

def complexMul (R : RealScalar) (z w : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  complexMk R
    (sub R
      (R.mul (complexRe R z) (complexRe R w))
      (R.mul (complexIm R z) (complexIm R w)))
    (R.add
      (R.mul (complexRe R z) (complexIm R w))
      (R.mul (complexIm R z) (complexRe R w)))

def complexDiv (R : RealScalar) (z w : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  let denominator := normSq R w
  complexMk R
    (div R
      (R.add
        (R.mul (complexRe R z) (complexRe R w))
        (R.mul (complexIm R z) (complexIm R w)))
      denominator)
    (div R
      (sub R
        (R.mul (complexIm R z) (complexRe R w))
        (R.mul (complexRe R z) (complexIm R w)))
      denominator)

/-- Orthogonal projection from the Poincare disc to the Klein disc. -/
def kleinify (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  smul R (div R (two R) (R.add R.one (sq R (norm R z)))) z

/-- The inverse radial map from the Klein disc to the Poincare disc. -/
def poincarify (R : RealScalar) (x : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  smul R
    (div R
      (sub R R.one (R.sqrt (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R x)))))
      (sq R (norm R x)))
    x

/-- The disc automorphism taking `w` to the origin. -/
def mobius (R : RealScalar) (w x : Complex R) : Complex R :=
  complexDiv R
    (pointSub R x w)
    (pointSub R (pointOne R) (complexMul R (complexConj R w) x))

theorem kleinify_zero_and_poincarify_zero (R : RealScalar) :
    kleinify R (pointZero R) = pointZero R ∧
      poincarify R (pointZero R) = pointZero R := sorry

theorem norm_kleinify (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) :
    norm R (kleinify R z) =
      div R (R.mul (two R) (norm R z)) (R.add R.one (sq R (norm R z))) := sorry

theorem norm_kleinify_lt_one_iff (R : RealScalar) (z : Complex R) :
    R.lt (norm R (kleinify R z)) R.one ↔ norm R z ≠ R.one := sorry

theorem norm_poincarify_lt_one (R : RealScalar) (x : Complex R)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    R.lt (norm R (poincarify R x)) R.one := sorry

theorem kleinify_poincarify (R : RealScalar) (x : Complex R)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    kleinify R (poincarify R x) = x := sorry

theorem poincarify_kleinify (R : RealScalar) (x : Complex R)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    poincarify R (kleinify R x) = x := sorry

theorem ddist_kleinify (R : RealScalar) (w z : Complex R)
    (hw : norm R w ≠ R.one) (hz : norm R z ≠ R.one) :
    ddist R (kleinify R w) (kleinify R z) =
      sub R
        (R.mul (four R)
          (sq R
            (R.add (half R)
              (div R
                (sq R (norm R (pointSub R w z)))
                (R.mul
                  (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R w)))
                  (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R z))))))))
        R.one := sorry

theorem ddist_kleinify_eq (R : RealScalar) (w z w' z' : Complex R)
    (hw : norm R w ≠ R.one)
    (hz : norm R z ≠ R.one)
    (hw' : norm R w' ≠ R.one)
    (hz' : norm R z' ≠ R.one)
    (hcross :
      R.mul
          (R.mul
            (sq R (norm R (pointSub R w z)))
            (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R w'))))
          (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R z'))) =
        R.mul
          (R.mul
            (sq R (norm R (pointSub R w' z')))
            (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R w))))
          (sub R R.one (sq R (norm R z)))) :
    ddist R (kleinify R w) (kleinify R z) =
      ddist R (kleinify R w') (kleinify R z') := sorry

theorem norm_kleinify_mobius_lt_one (R : RealScalar) (w x : Complex R)
    (hw : R.lt (norm R w) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one) :
    R.lt (norm R (kleinify R (mobius R w x))) R.one := sorry

theorem ddist_kleinify_mobius (R : RealScalar) (w x y : Complex R)
    (hw : R.lt (norm R w) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one)
    (hy : R.lt (norm R y) R.one) :
    ddist R (kleinify R (mobius R w x)) (kleinify R (mobius R w y)) =
      ddist R (kleinify R x) (kleinify R y) := sorry

theorem collinear_kleinify_mobius (R : RealScalar) (w x y z : Complex R)
    (hw : R.lt (norm R w) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one)
    (hy : R.lt (norm R y) R.one)
    (hz : R.lt (norm R z) R.one) :
    collinear R
        (kleinify R (mobius R w x))
        (kleinify R (mobius R w y))
        (kleinify R (mobius R w z)) ↔
      collinear R (kleinify R x) (kleinify R y) (kleinify R z) := sorry

theorem between_kleinify_mobius (R : RealScalar) (w x y z : Complex R)
    (hw : R.lt (norm R w) R.one)
    (hx : R.lt (norm R x) R.one)
    (hy : R.lt (norm R y) R.one)
    (hz : R.lt (norm R z) R.one) :
    between R
        (kleinify R (mobius R w x))
        (kleinify R (mobius R w y))
        (kleinify R (mobius R w z)) ↔
      between R (kleinify R x) (kleinify R y) (kleinify R z) := sorry

def HyperbolicIsometry (R : RealScalar) (f : Complex R → Complex R) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, R.lt (norm R x) R.one → R.lt (norm R (f x)) R.one) ∧
    (∀ x y,
      R.lt (norm R x) R.one →
      R.lt (norm R y) R.one →
      ddist R (f x) (f y) = ddist R x y) ∧
    (∀ x y z,
      R.lt (norm R x) R.one →
      R.lt (norm R y) R.one →
      R.lt (norm R z) R.one →
      (between R (f x) (f y) (f z) ↔ between R x y z))

theorem hyperbolic_translation (R : RealScalar) (w : Complex R)
    (hw : R.lt (norm R w) R.one) :
    ∃ f g : Complex R → Complex R,
      HyperbolicIsometry R f ∧
        HyperbolicIsometry R g ∧
        f w = pointZero R ∧
        g (pointZero R) = w ∧
        (∀ x, R.lt (norm R x) R.one → f (g x) = x) ∧
        (∀ x, R.lt (norm R x) R.one → g (f x) = x) := sorry

/-- The Klein model: the open unit disc in the real plane. -/
def Plane (R : RealScalar) :=
  {z : Complex R // R.lt (norm R z) R.one}

/-- Hyperbolic betweenness inherited from affine betweenness in the Klein disc. -/
def pbetween (R : RealScalar) (y x z : Plane R) : Prop :=
  between R y.val x.val z.val

/-- Hyperbolic segment length in the Klein model. -/
def pdist (R : RealScalar) (x y : Plane R) : Real R :=
  ddist R x.val y.val

theorem plane_norm_lt (R : RealScalar) (x : Plane R) :
    R.lt (norm R x.val) R.one := sorry

theorem plane_coe_eq (R : RealScalar) (x y : Plane R) :
    (x.val = y.val ↔ x = y) := sorry

theorem forall_plane_coe (R : RealScalar) (P : Complex R → Prop) :
    (∀ x : Plane R, P x.val) ↔
      ∀ x : Complex R, R.lt (norm R x) R.one → P x := sorry

theorem exists_plane_coe (R : RealScalar) (P : Complex R → Prop) :
    (∃ x : Plane R, P x.val) ↔
      ∃ x : Complex R, R.lt (norm R x) R.one ∧ P x := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 1: symmetry of segment congruence. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_1_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a b : Plane R) :
    pdist R a b = pdist R b a := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 2: transitivity of segment congruence. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_2_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a b p q r s : Plane R)
    (hpq : pdist R a b = pdist R p q)
    (hrs : pdist R a b = pdist R r s) :
    pdist R p q = pdist R r s := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 3: identity for segment congruence. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_3_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a b c : Plane R)
    (h : pdist R a b = pdist R c c) :
    a = b := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 4: segment construction. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_4_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a q b c : Plane R) :
    ∃ x, pbetween R a q x ∧ pdist R a x = pdist R b c := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 5: the five-segments axiom. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_5_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar)
    (a b c x a' b' c' x' : Plane R)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hab' : pdist R a b = pdist R a' b')
    (hac' : pdist R a c = pdist R a' c')
    (hbc' : pdist R b c = pdist R b' c')
    (hbetween : pbetween R b a x)
    (hbetween' : pbetween R b' a' x')
    (hbx' : pdist R b x = pdist R b' x') :
    pdist R c x = pdist R c' x' := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 6: identity for betweenness. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_6_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a b : Plane R)
    (h : pbetween R b a a) :
    a = b := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 7: Pasch's axiom. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_7_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (a b c p q : Plane R)
    (hp : pbetween R p a c)
    (hq : pbetween R q b c) :
    ∃ x, pbetween R x p b ∧ pbetween R x q a := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 8: the lower two-dimensional axiom. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_8_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) :
    ∃ a b c : Plane R,
      ¬pbetween R b a c ∧
        ¬pbetween R c b a ∧
        ¬pbetween R a c b := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 9: the upper two-dimensional axiom. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_9_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (p q a b c : Plane R)
    (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (ha : pdist R a p = pdist R a q)
    (hb : pdist R b p = pdist R b q)
    (hc : pdist R c p = pdist R c q) :
    pbetween R b a c ∨ pbetween R c b a ∨ pbetween R a c b := sorry

/-- The Klein model satisfies the negation of Tarski's Euclidean axiom 10. -/
theorem not_tarski_axiom_10_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) :
    ¬(∀ a b c d t : Plane R,
      pbetween R d a t ∧ pbetween R d b c ∧ a ≠ d →
        ∃ x y,
          pbetween R b a x ∧
            pbetween R c a y ∧
            pbetween R t x y) := sorry

/-- Tarski axiom 11: continuity. -/
theorem tarski_axiom_11_noneuclidean (R : RealScalar) (X Y : Set (Plane R)) :
    (∃ a, ∀ x y, X x ∧ Y y → pbetween R x a y) →
      ∃ b, ∀ x y, X x ∧ Y y → pbetween R b x y := sorry

/-- The complete statement supplied by the Klein model: axioms 1-9 and 11 hold, while 10 fails. -/
def KleinModelIndependence (R : RealScalar) : Prop :=
  (∀ a b : Plane R, pdist R a b = pdist R b a) ∧
  (∀ a b p q r s : Plane R,
    pdist R a b = pdist R p q →
    pdist R a b = pdist R r s →
    pdist R p q = pdist R r s) ∧
  (∀ a b c : Plane R, pdist R a b = pdist R c c → a = b) ∧
  (∀ a q b c : Plane R,
    ∃ x, pbetween R a q x ∧ pdist R a x = pdist R b c) ∧
  (∀ a b c x a' b' c' x' : Plane R,
    a ≠ b →
    pdist R a b = pdist R a' b' →
    pdist R a c = pdist R a' c' →
    pdist R b c = pdist R b' c' →
    pbetween R b a x →
    pbetween R b' a' x' →
    pdist R b x = pdist R b' x' →
    pdist R c x = pdist R c' x') ∧
  (∀ a b : Plane R, pbetween R b a a → a = b) ∧
  (∀ a b c p q : Plane R,
    pbetween R p a c →
    pbetween R q b c →
    ∃ x, pbetween R x p b ∧ pbetween R x q a) ∧
  (∃ a b c : Plane R,
    ¬pbetween R b a c ∧
      ¬pbetween R c b a ∧
      ¬pbetween R a c b) ∧
  (∀ p q a b c : Plane R,
    p ≠ q →
    pdist R a p = pdist R a q →
    pdist R b p = pdist R b q →
    pdist R c p = pdist R c q →
    pbetween R b a c ∨ pbetween R c b a ∨ pbetween R a c b) ∧
  ¬(∀ a b c d t : Plane R,
    pbetween R d a t ∧ pbetween R d b c ∧ a ≠ d →
      ∃ x y,
        pbetween R b a x ∧
          pbetween R c a y ∧
          pbetween R t x y) ∧
  (∀ X Y : Set (Plane R),
    (∃ a, ∀ x y, X x ∧ Y y → pbetween R x a y) →
      ∃ b, ∀ x y, X x ∧ Y y → pbetween R b x y)

/-- Existence of the two-dimensional Klein model witnessing failure of the parallel postulate. -/
theorem independence_of_parallel_postulate :
    ∃ R : RealScalar, KleinModelIndependence R := sorry

end ParallelPostulateIndependence
end Theorems100

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 012,
  "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate". The Klein disk model
  satisfies Tarski's axioms 1-9 and 11 while refuting the Euclidean axiom 10.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition R2 : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition dot (u v : R2) : R :=
  fst u * fst v + snd u * snd v.

Definition norm_sq (u : R2) : R := dot u u.

(* The points of the Klein model are the points of the open unit disk. *)
Definition KleinPoint : Type := { u : R2 | norm_sq u < 1 }.

Definition coordinates (p : KleinPoint) : R2 := proj1_sig p.

Definition affine_combination (t : R) (u v : R2) : R2 :=
  ((1 - t) * fst u + t * fst v,
   (1 - t) * snd u + t * snd v).

Definition between (y x z : R2) : Prop :=
  exists t : R,
    0 <= t <= 1 /\ y = affine_combination t x z.

Definition pbetween (y x z : KleinPoint) : Prop :=
  between (coordinates y) (coordinates x) (coordinates z).

Definition ddist (u v : R2) : R :=
  ((1 - dot u v) * (1 - dot u v)) /
    ((1 - norm_sq u) * (1 - norm_sq v)) - 1.

Definition pdist (p q : KleinPoint) : R :=
  ddist (coordinates p) (coordinates q).

Definition pcongruent
    (a b c d : KleinPoint) : Prop :=
  pdist a b = pdist c d.

Definition tarski_axiom_1 : Prop :=
  forall a b : KleinPoint, pcongruent a b b a.

Definition tarski_axiom_2 : Prop :=
  forall a b p q r s : KleinPoint,
    pcongruent a b p q /\ pcongruent a b r s ->
    pcongruent p q r s.

Definition tarski_axiom_3 : Prop :=
  forall a b c : KleinPoint,
    pcongruent a b c c -> a = b.

Definition tarski_axiom_4 : Prop :=
  forall q a b c : KleinPoint,
    exists x : KleinPoint,
      pbetween a q x /\ pcongruent a x b c.

Definition tarski_axiom_5 : Prop :=
  forall a b c x a' b' c' x' : KleinPoint,
    a <> b /\
    pcongruent a b a' b' /\
    pcongruent a c a' c' /\
    pcongruent b c b' c' /\
    pbetween b a x /\
    pbetween b' a' x' /\
    pcongruent b x b' x' ->
    pcongruent c x c' x'.

Definition tarski_axiom_6 : Prop :=
  forall a b : KleinPoint,
    pbetween b a a -> a = b.

Definition tarski_axiom_7 : Prop :=
  forall a b c p q : KleinPoint,
    pbetween p a c /\ pbetween q b c ->
    exists x : KleinPoint,
      pbetween x p b /\ pbetween x q a.

Definition tarski_axiom_8 : Prop :=
  exists a b c : KleinPoint,
    ~ pbetween b a c /\
    ~ pbetween c b a /\
    ~ pbetween a c b.

Definition tarski_axiom_9 : Prop :=
  forall p q a b c : KleinPoint,
    p <> q /\
    pcongruent a p a q /\
    pcongruent b p b q /\
    pcongruent c p c q ->
    pbetween b a c \/ pbetween c b a \/ pbetween a c b.

Definition tarski_axiom_10 : Prop :=
  forall a b c d t : KleinPoint,
    pbetween d a t /\ pbetween d b c /\ a <> d ->
    exists x y : KleinPoint,
      pbetween b a x /\
      pbetween c a y /\
      pbetween t x y.

Definition tarski_axiom_11 : Prop :=
  forall X Y : KleinPoint -> Prop,
    (exists a : KleinPoint,
       forall x y : KleinPoint,
         X x /\ Y y -> pbetween x a y) ->
    exists b : KleinPoint,
      forall x y : KleinPoint,
        X x /\ Y y -> pbetween b x y.

Theorem klein_disc_independence_of_parallel_postulate :
  tarski_axiom_1 /\
  tarski_axiom_2 /\
  tarski_axiom_3 /\
  tarski_axiom_4 /\
  tarski_axiom_5 /\
  tarski_axiom_6 /\
  tarski_axiom_7 /\
  tarski_axiom_8 /\
  tarski_axiom_9 /\
  ~ tarski_axiom_10 /\
  tarski_axiom_11.
Proof.
Admitted.

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the independence of the parallel postulate
  from Hundred Theorems item 012. The Klein disc satisfies Tarski's axioms
  1-9 and 11 while refuting the Euclidean axiom 10. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Independence_Of_The_Parallel_Postulate
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym point2 = "real \<times> real"

definition dot2 :: "point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "dot2 u v = fst u * fst v + snd u * snd v"

definition norm_sq2 :: "point2 \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "norm_sq2 u = dot2 u u"

definition klein_disc :: "point2 set"
  where
    "klein_disc = {u. norm_sq2 u < 1}"

definition affine_combination ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> point2"
  where
    "affine_combination t u v =
      ((1 - t) * fst u + t * fst v,
       (1 - t) * snd u + t * snd v)"

definition klein_between ::
    "point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "klein_between y x z \<longleftrightarrow>
      y \<in> klein_disc \<and> x \<in> klein_disc \<and> z \<in> klein_disc \<and>
      (\<exists>t. 0 \<le> t \<and> t \<le> 1 \<and> y = affine_combination t x z)"

definition klein_ddist :: "point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "klein_ddist u v =
      (1 - dot2 u v) ^ 2
        / ((1 - norm_sq2 u) * (1 - norm_sq2 v)) - 1"

definition klein_congruent ::
    "point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> point2 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "klein_congruent a b c d \<longleftrightarrow>
      klein_ddist a b = klein_ddist c d"

definition tarski_axiom_1 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_1 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_congruent a b b a)"

definition tarski_axiom_2 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_2 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>p\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>q\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>r\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>s\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_congruent a b p q \<and> klein_congruent a b r s
          \<longrightarrow> klein_congruent p q r s)"

definition tarski_axiom_3 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_3 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_congruent a b c c \<longrightarrow> a = b)"

definition tarski_axiom_4 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_4 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>q\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>a\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc.
        \<exists>x\<in>klein_disc.
          klein_between a q x \<and> klein_congruent a x b c)"

definition tarski_axiom_5 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_5 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>x\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>a'\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b'\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>c'\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>x'\<in>klein_disc.
        a \<noteq> b \<and>
        klein_congruent a b a' b' \<and>
        klein_congruent a c a' c' \<and>
        klein_congruent b c b' c' \<and>
        klein_between b a x \<and>
        klein_between b' a' x' \<and>
        klein_congruent b x b' x'
          \<longrightarrow> klein_congruent c x c' x')"

definition tarski_axiom_6 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_6 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_between b a a \<longrightarrow> a = b)"

definition tarski_axiom_7 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_7 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>p\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>q\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_between p a c \<and> klein_between q b c
          \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>x\<in>klein_disc.
            klein_between x p b \<and> klein_between x q a))"

definition tarski_axiom_8 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_8 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>a\<in>klein_disc. \<exists>b\<in>klein_disc. \<exists>c\<in>klein_disc.
        \<not> klein_between b a c \<and>
        \<not> klein_between c b a \<and>
        \<not> klein_between a c b)"

definition tarski_axiom_9 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_9 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>p\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>q\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc.
        p \<noteq> q \<and>
        klein_congruent a p a q \<and>
        klein_congruent b p b q \<and>
        klein_congruent c p c q
          \<longrightarrow>
            klein_between b a c \<or>
            klein_between c b a \<or>
            klein_between a c b)"

definition tarski_axiom_10 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_10 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>b\<in>klein_disc.
       \<forall>c\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>d\<in>klein_disc. \<forall>t\<in>klein_disc.
        klein_between d a t \<and> klein_between d b c \<and> a \<noteq> d
          \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>x\<in>klein_disc. \<exists>y\<in>klein_disc.
            klein_between b a x \<and>
            klein_between c a y \<and>
            klein_between t x y))"

definition tarski_axiom_11 :: bool
  where
    "tarski_axiom_11 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>X Y :: point2 set.
        X \<subseteq> klein_disc \<and> Y \<subseteq> klein_disc \<and>
        (\<exists>a\<in>klein_disc.
          \<forall>x\<in>X. \<forall>y\<in>Y. klein_between x a y)
          \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>b\<in>klein_disc.
            \<forall>x\<in>X. \<forall>y\<in>Y. klein_between b x y))"

theorem klein_disc_independence_of_parallel_postulate:
  "tarski_axiom_1 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_2 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_3 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_4 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_5 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_6 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_7 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_8 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_9 \<and>
   \<not> tarski_axiom_10 \<and>
   tarski_axiom_11"
  sorry

end

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Independence of the parallel postulate. The statement and some ideas are  *)
(* taken from Tim Makarios's MSc thesis "A mechanical verification of the    *)
(* independence of Tarski's Euclidean axiom".                                *)
(*                                                                           *)
(* In the file Multivariate/tarski.ml it is shown that all 11 of Tarski's    *)
(* axioms for geometry hold for the Euclidean plane `:real^2`, with          *)
(* betweenness and congruence of segments as:                                *)
(*                                                                           *)
(*      B x y z  <=> between y (x,z)                                         *)
(*      ab == pq <=> dist(a,b) = dist(p,q)                                   *)
(*                                                                           *)
(* The present file shows that the Klein model of the hyperbolic plane (type *)
(* `:plane`) satisfies all Tarski's axioms except that it satisfies the      *)
(* negation of the Euclidean axiom (10), with betweenness and congruence of  *)
(* segments as:                                                              *)
(*                                                                           *)
(*      B x y z  <=> pbetween y (x,z)                                        *)
(*      ab == pq <=> pdist(a,b) = pdist(p,q)                                 *)
(*                                                                           *)
(* Collectively, these two results show that the Euclidean axiom is          *)
(* independent of the others. For more references regarding Tarski's axioms  *)
(* for geometry see "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarski's_axioms".          *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

needs "Multivariate/cauchy.ml";;
needs "Multivariate/tarski.ml";;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The semimetric we will use, directly on real^N first. Choose a sensible   *)
(* default outside unit ball so some handy theorems become unconditional.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ddist = new_definition
 `ddist(x:real^N,y:real^N) =
    if norm(x) < &1 /\ norm(y) < &1 then
     (&1 - x dot y) pow 2 / ((&1 - norm(x) pow 2) * (&1 - norm(y) pow 2)) - &1
    else dist(x,y)`;;

let DDIST_INCREASES_ONLINE = `!a b x:real^N.
      norm a < &1 /\ norm b < &1 /\ norm x < &1 /\ between x (a,b) /\ ~(x = b)
      ==> ddist(a,x) < ddist(a,b)`;;

let DDIST_REFL = `!x:real^N. ddist(x,x) = &0`;;

let DDIST_SYM = `!x y:real^N. ddist(x,y) = ddist(y,x)`;;

let DDIST_POS_LT = `!x y:real^N. ~(x = y) ==> &0 < ddist(x,y)`;;

let DDIST_POS_LE = `!x y:real^N. &0 <= ddist(x,y)`;;

let DDIST_EQ_0 = `!x y:real^N. ddist(x,y) = &0 <=> x = y`;;

let BETWEEN_COLLINEAR_DDIST_EQ = `!a b x:real^N.
        norm(a) < &1 /\ norm(b) < &1 /\ norm(x) < &1
        ==> (between x (a,b) <=>
             collinear {a, x, b} /\
             ddist(x,a) <= ddist (a,b) /\ ddist(x,b) <= ddist(a,b))`;;

let CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_DDIST = `!a x:real^N.
      norm(a) < &1 /\ norm(x) < &1 ==> (\x. lift(ddist(a,x))) continuous at x`;;

let HYPERBOLIC_MIDPOINT = `!a b:real^N.
        norm a < &1 /\ norm b < &1
        ==> ?x. between x (a,b) /\ ddist(x,a) = ddist(x,b)`;;

let DDIST_EQ_ORIGIN = `!x:real^N y:real^N.
        norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1
        ==> (ddist(vec 0,x) = ddist(vec 0,y) <=> norm x = norm y)`;;

let DDIST_CONGRUENT_TRIPLES_0 = `!a b:real^N a' b':real^N.
        norm a < &1 /\ norm b < &1 /\ norm a' < &1 /\ norm b' < &1
        ==> (ddist(vec 0,a) = ddist(vec 0,a') /\ ddist(a,b) = ddist(a',b') /\
             ddist(b,vec 0) = ddist(b',vec 0) <=>
             dist(vec 0,a) = dist(vec 0,a') /\ dist(a,b) = dist(a',b') /\
             dist(b,vec 0) = dist(b',vec 0))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Deduce existence of hyperbolic translations via the Poincare disc model.  *)
(* Use orthogonal projection onto a hemisphere touching the unit disc,       *)
(* then stereographic projection back from the other pole of the sphere plus *)
(* scaling. See Greenberg's "Euclidean & Non-Euclidean Geometries" fig 7.13. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let kleinify = new_definition
 `kleinify z = Cx(&2 / (&1 + norm(z) pow 2)) * z`;;

let poincarify = new_definition
 `poincarify x = Cx((&1 - sqrt(&1 - norm(x) pow 2)) / norm(x) pow 2) * x`;;

let KLEINIFY_0,POINCARIFY_0 = (CONJ_PAIR o prove)
 (`kleinify (Cx(&0)) = Cx(&0) /\ poincarify (Cx(&0)) = Cx(&0)`,
  REWRITE_TAC[kleinify; poincarify; COMPLEX_MUL_RZERO]);;

let NORM_KLEINIFY = `!z. norm(kleinify z) = (&2 * norm(z)) / (&1 + norm(z) pow 2)`;;

let NORM_KLEINIFY_LT = `!z. norm(kleinify z) < &1 <=> ~(norm z = &1)`;;

let NORM_POINCARIFY_LT = `!x. norm(x) < &1 ==> norm(poincarify x) < &1`;;

let KLEINIFY_POINCARIFY = `!x. norm(x) < &1 ==> kleinify(poincarify x) = x`;;

let POINCARIFY_KLEINIFY = `!x. norm(x) < &1 ==> poincarify(kleinify x) = x`;;

let DDIST_KLEINIFY = `!w z. ~(norm w = &1) /\ ~(norm z = &1)
         ==> ddist(kleinify w,kleinify z) =
             &4 * (&1 / &2 + norm(w - z) pow 2 /
                             ((&1 - norm w pow 2) * (&1 - norm z pow 2))) pow 2
             - &1`;;

let DDIST_KLEINIFY_EQ = `!w z w' z'.
      ~(norm w = &1) /\ ~(norm z = &1) /\ ~(norm w' = &1) /\ ~(norm z' = &1) /\
      norm(w - z) pow 2 * (&1 - norm w' pow 2) * (&1 - norm z' pow 2) =
      norm(w' - z') pow 2 * (&1 - norm w pow 2) * (&1 - norm z pow 2)
      ==> ddist(kleinify w,kleinify z) = ddist(kleinify w',kleinify z')`;;

let NORM_KLEINIFY_MOEBIUS_LT = `!w x. norm w < &1 /\ norm x < &1
         ==> norm(kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w x)) < &1`;;

let DDIST_KLEINIFY_MOEBIUS = `!w x y. norm w < &1 /\ norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1
           ==> ddist(kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w x),
                     kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w y)) =
               ddist(kleinify x,kleinify y)`;;

let COLLINEAR_KLEINIFY_MOEBIUS = `!w x y z. norm w < &1 /\ norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1 /\ norm z < &1
             ==> (collinear {kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w x),
                             kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w y),
                             kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w z)} <=>
                  collinear {kleinify x,kleinify y,kleinify z})`;;

let BETWEEN_KLEINIFY_MOEBIUS = `!w x y z. norm w < &1 /\ norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1 /\ norm z < &1
             ==> (between (kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w x))
                          (kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w y),
                           kleinify(moebius_function (&0) w z)) <=>
                  between (kleinify x) (kleinify y,kleinify z))`;;

let hyperbolic_isometry = new_definition
 `hyperbolic_isometry (f:real^2->real^2) <=>
    (!x. norm x < &1 ==> norm(f x) < &1) /\
    (!x y. norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1 ==> ddist(f x,f y) = ddist(x,y)) /\
    (!x y z. norm x < &1 /\ norm y < &1 /\ norm z < &1
             ==> (between (f x) (f y,f z) <=> between x (y,z)))`;;

let HYPERBOLIC_TRANSLATION = `!w. norm w < &1
       ==> ?f:real^2->real^2 g:real^2->real^2.
                hyperbolic_isometry f /\ hyperbolic_isometry g /\
                f(w) = vec 0 /\ g(vec 0) = w /\
                (!x. norm x < &1 ==> f(g x) = x) /\
                (!x. norm x < &1 ==> g(f x) = x)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Our model.                                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let plane_tybij =
  let th = prove
   (`?x:real^2. norm x < &1`,
    EXISTS_TAC `vec 0:real^2` THEN NORM_ARITH_TAC) in
  new_type_definition "plane" ("mk_plane","dest_plane") th;;

let pbetween = new_definition
 `pbetween y (x,z) <=> between (dest_plane y) (dest_plane x,dest_plane z)`;;

let pdist = new_definition
 `pdist(x,y) = ddist(dest_plane x,dest_plane y)`;;

let DEST_PLANE_EQ = `!x y. dest_plane x = dest_plane y <=> x = y`;;

let FORALL_DEST_PLANE = `!P. (!x. P(dest_plane x)) <=> (!x. norm x < &1 ==> P x)`;;

let EXISTS_DEST_PLANE = `!P. (?x. P(dest_plane x)) <=> (?x. norm x < &1 /\ P x)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 1 (reflexivity for equidistance).                                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_1_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b. pdist(a,b) = pdist(b,a)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 2 (transitivity for equidistance).                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_2_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b p q r s.
        pdist(a,b) = pdist(p,q) /\ pdist(a,b) = pdist(r,s)
        ==> pdist(p,q) = pdist(r,s)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 3 (identity for equidistance).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_3_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b c. pdist(a,b) = pdist(c,c) ==> a = b`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 4 (segment construction).                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_4_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a q b c. ?x. pbetween a (q,x) /\ pdist(a,x) = pdist(b,c)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 5 (five-segments axiom).                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_5_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b c x a' b' c' x'.
        ~(a = b) /\
        pdist(a,b) = pdist(a',b') /\
        pdist(a,c) = pdist(a',c') /\
        pdist(b,c) = pdist(b',c') /\
        pbetween b (a,x) /\ pbetween b' (a',x') /\ pdist(b,x) = pdist(b',x')
        ==> pdist(c,x) = pdist(c',x')`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 6 (identity for between-ness).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_6_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b. pbetween b (a,a) ==> a = b`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 7 (Pasch's axiom).                                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_7_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!a b c p q.
    pbetween p (a,c) /\ pbetween q (b,c)
    ==> ?x. pbetween x (p,b) /\ pbetween x (q,a)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 8 (lower 2-dimensional axiom).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_8_NONEUCLIDEAN = `?a b c. ~pbetween b (a,c) /\ ~pbetween c (b,a) /\ ~pbetween a (c,b)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 9 (upper 2-dimensional axiom).                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_9_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!p q a b c.
        ~(p = q) /\
        pdist(a,p) = pdist(a,q) /\ pdist(b,p) = pdist(b,q) /\
        pdist(c,p) = pdist(c,q)
        ==> pbetween b (a,c) \/ pbetween c (b,a) \/ pbetween a (c,b)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 10 (Euclidean axiom).                                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let NOT_TARSKI_AXIOM_10_NONEUCLIDEAN = `~(!a b c d t.
      pbetween d (a,t) /\ pbetween d (b,c) /\ ~(a = d)
      ==> ?x y. pbetween b (a,x) /\ pbetween c (a,y) /\ pbetween t (x,y))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Axiom 11 (Continuity).                                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TARSKI_AXIOM_11_NONEUCLIDEAN = `!X Y. (?a. !x y. x IN X /\ y IN Y ==> pbetween x (a,y))
         ==> (?b. !x y. x IN X /\ y IN Y ==> pbetween b (x,y))`;;

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 012,
;; "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate": an exact rational-coordinate
;; form of the Klein-disk counterexample refuting Tarski's Euclidean axiom
;; (axiom 10), the non-Euclidean half of the independence result. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun ht-012-klein-pointp (x y)
  (and (rationalp x)
       (rationalp y)
       (< (+ (* x x) (* y y)) 1)))

(defun ht-012-point-equalp (x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (and (equal x1 x2)
       (equal y1 y2)))

(defun ht-012-euclidean-betweenp (px py ax ay bx by)
  (and (rationalp px)
       (rationalp py)
       (rationalp ax)
       (rationalp ay)
       (rationalp bx)
       (rationalp by)
       (equal (* (- px ax) (- by ay))
              (* (- py ay) (- bx ax)))
       (<= (+ (* (- px ax) (- px bx))
              (* (- py ay) (- py by)))
           0)))

(defun ht-012-pbetweenp (px py ax ay bx by)
  (and (ht-012-klein-pointp px py)
       (ht-012-klein-pointp ax ay)
       (ht-012-klein-pointp bx by)
       (ht-012-euclidean-betweenp px py ax ay bx by)))

(defun hundred-theorems-012-statement (x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (implies
   (and (ht-012-klein-pointp x1 y1)
        (ht-012-klein-pointp x2 y2))
   (and
    (ht-012-pbetweenp (/ 1 4) (/ 1 4)
                      0 0
                      (/ 3 5) (/ 3 5))
    (ht-012-pbetweenp (/ 1 4) (/ 1 4)
                      (/ 1 2) 0
                      0 (/ 1 2))
    (not (ht-012-point-equalp 0 0 (/ 1 4) (/ 1 4)))
    (not
     (and
      (ht-012-pbetweenp (/ 1 2) 0
                        0 0
                        x1 y1)
      (ht-012-pbetweenp 0 (/ 1 2)
                        0 0
                        x2 y2)
      (ht-012-pbetweenp (/ 3 5) (/ 3 5)
                        x1 y1
                        x2 y2))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate" from Hundred
-- Theorems item 012: the Klein disk over the real field satisfies Tarski's axioms other than
-- the Euclidean parallel axiom, whose negation holds. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not A = A -> Bottom

NotEqual : {a : Level} {A : Set a} -> A -> A -> Set a
NotEqual x y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists {a p : Level} (A : Set a) (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zero one : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set

    one-not-zero :
      NotEqual one zero

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zero == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zero

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x one == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zero == zero
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      NotEqual x zero ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == one

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero x ->
      lessOrEqual zero y ->
      lessOrEqual zero (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zero one and NotEqual zero one

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum) and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y and NotEqual x y

record Vector2 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor vector
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Vector2

vectorAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R
vectorAdd reals u v =
  vector
    (add reals (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
    (add reals (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v))

vectorScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R
vectorScale reals scalar v =
  vector
    (multiply reals scalar (x-coordinate v))
    (multiply reals scalar (y-coordinate v))

dot :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  R
dot reals u v =
  add reals
    (multiply reals (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
    (multiply reals (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v))

squaredNorm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  R
squaredNorm reals v =
  dot reals v v

InsideUnitDisk :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Set
InsideUnitDisk reals v =
  StrictLess reals
    (squaredNorm reals v)
    (one reals)

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Set
Between reals y x z =
  Exists _
    (\ t ->
      lessOrEqual reals (zero reals) t and
      (lessOrEqual reals t (one reals) and
       y ==
       vectorAdd reals
         (vectorScale reals
           (subtract reals (one reals) t)
           x)
         (vectorScale reals t z)))

kleinDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  Vector2 R ->
  R
kleinDistance reals x y =
  subtract reals
    (divide reals
      (square reals
        (subtract reals
          (one reals)
          (dot reals x y)))
      (multiply reals
        (subtract reals
          (one reals)
          (squaredNorm reals x))
        (subtract reals
          (one reals)
          (squaredNorm reals y))))
    (one reals)

record KleinPlane
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set₁ where

  field
    Point : Set
    dest : Point -> Vector2 R

    dest-inside :
      (p : Point) ->
      InsideUnitDisk reals (dest p)

    dest-injective :
      (p q : Point) ->
      dest p == dest q ->
      p == q

    dest-surjective :
      (v : Vector2 R) ->
      InsideUnitDisk reals v ->
      Exists Point (\ p -> dest p == v)

open KleinPlane

Betweenness :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  Set
Betweenness reals plane a b c =
  Between reals
    (dest plane b)
    (dest plane a)
    (dest plane c)

PlaneDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  R
PlaneDistance reals plane a b =
  kleinDistance reals
    (dest plane a)
    (dest plane b)

SegmentCongruent :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  Point plane ->
  Set
SegmentCongruent reals plane a b c d =
  PlaneDistance reals plane a b ==
  PlaneDistance reals plane c d

TarskiAxiom1 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom1 reals plane =
  (a b : Point plane) ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a b b a

TarskiAxiom2 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom2 reals plane =
  (a b p q r s : Point plane) ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a b p q ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a b r s ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane p q r s

TarskiAxiom3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom3 reals plane =
  (a b c : Point plane) ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a b c c ->
  a == b

TarskiAxiom4 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom4 reals plane =
  (a q b c : Point plane) ->
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ x ->
      Betweenness reals plane q a x and
      SegmentCongruent reals plane a x b c)

TarskiAxiom5 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom5 reals plane =
  (a b c x a' b' c' x' : Point plane) ->
  NotEqual a b ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a b a' b' ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a c a' c' ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane b c b' c' ->
  Betweenness reals plane a b x ->
  Betweenness reals plane a' b' x' ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane b x b' x' ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane c x c' x'

TarskiAxiom6 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom6 reals plane =
  (a b : Point plane) ->
  Betweenness reals plane a b a ->
  a == b

TarskiAxiom7 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom7 reals plane =
  (a b c p q : Point plane) ->
  Betweenness reals plane a p c ->
  Betweenness reals plane b q c ->
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ x ->
      Betweenness reals plane p x b and
      Betweenness reals plane q x a)

TarskiAxiom8 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom8 reals plane =
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ a ->
      Exists (Point plane)
        (\ b ->
          Exists (Point plane)
            (\ c ->
              Not (Betweenness reals plane a b c) and
              (Not (Betweenness reals plane b c a) and
               Not (Betweenness reals plane c a b)))))

TarskiAxiom9 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom9 reals plane =
  (p q a b c : Point plane) ->
  NotEqual p q ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane a p a q ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane b p b q ->
  SegmentCongruent reals plane c p c q ->
  Betweenness reals plane a b c or
  (Betweenness reals plane b c a or
   Betweenness reals plane c a b)

TarskiAxiom10 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set
TarskiAxiom10 reals plane =
  (a b c d t : Point plane) ->
  Betweenness reals plane a d t ->
  Betweenness reals plane b d c ->
  NotEqual a d ->
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ x ->
      Exists (Point plane)
        (\ y ->
          Betweenness reals plane a b x and
          (Betweenness reals plane a c y and
           Betweenness reals plane x t y)))

TarskiAxiom11 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) ->
  Set₁
TarskiAxiom11 reals plane =
  (X Y : Point plane -> Set) ->
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ a ->
      (x y : Point plane) ->
      X x and Y y ->
      Betweenness reals plane a x y) ->
  Exists (Point plane)
    (\ b ->
      (x y : Point plane) ->
      X x and Y y ->
      Betweenness reals plane x b y)

record TarskiAxiomsExceptEuclid
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (plane : KleinPlane reals) :
  Set₁ where

  field
    axiom1  : TarskiAxiom1 reals plane
    axiom2  : TarskiAxiom2 reals plane
    axiom3  : TarskiAxiom3 reals plane
    axiom4  : TarskiAxiom4 reals plane
    axiom5  : TarskiAxiom5 reals plane
    axiom6  : TarskiAxiom6 reals plane
    axiom7  : TarskiAxiom7 reals plane
    axiom8  : TarskiAxiom8 reals plane
    axiom9  : TarskiAxiom9 reals plane
    axiom11 : TarskiAxiom11 reals plane

record KleinRealCountermodel : Set₂ where
  field
    Real : Set
    real-field : CompleteOrderedField Real
    klein-plane : KleinPlane real-field
    absolute-geometry :
      TarskiAxiomsExceptEuclid real-field klein-plane
    parallel-postulate-fails :
      Not (TarskiAxiom10 real-field klein-plane)

the-independence-of-the-parallel-postulate : Set₂
the-independence-of-the-parallel-postulate =
  KleinRealCountermodel

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate" from Hundred
  Theorems item 012. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory;

val independence_of_parallel_postulate =
  ``?betw : real # real -> real # real -> real # real -> bool.
    ?cong :
      real # real -> real # real -> real # real -> real # real -> bool.
      (!a b. cong a b b a) /\
      (!a b p q r s.
         cong a b p q /\ cong a b r s ==> cong p q r s) /\
      (!a b c. cong a b c c ==> a = b) /\
      (!q a b c. ?x. betw q a x /\ cong a x b c) /\
      (!a b c d a' b' c' d'.
         ~(a = b) /\
         betw a b c /\ betw a' b' c' /\
         cong a b a' b' /\ cong b c b' c' /\
         cong a d a' d' /\ cong b d b' d'
         ==> cong c d c' d') /\
      (!a b. betw a b a ==> a = b) /\
      (!a b c p q.
         betw a p c /\ betw b q c
         ==> ?x. betw p x b /\ betw q x a) /\
      (?a b c. ~betw a b c /\ ~betw b c a /\ ~betw c a b) /\
      (!p q a b c.
         ~(p = q) /\
         cong a p a q /\ cong b p b q /\ cong c p c q
         ==> betw a b c \/ betw b c a \/ betw c a b) /\
      ~(!a b c d t.
          betw a d t /\ betw b d c /\ ~(a = d)
          ==> ?x y. betw a b x /\ betw a c y /\ betw x t y) /\
      (!X Y : real # real -> bool.
         (?a. !x y. X x /\ Y y ==> betw a x y)
         ==> ?b. !x y. X x /\ Y y ==> betw x b y)``;

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel
  Postulate" from Hundred Theorems item 012: the real Klein disc is a model
  of Tarski's axioms 1 through 9 and 11 in which the Euclidean parallel
  axiom 10 is false. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  HT012KDisk is the open unit disc in RR X. RR. Its elements are the concrete
  representatives of the HOL Light subtype, so equality is ordinary ordered-
  pair equality. HT012Bet is Euclidean closed-segment betweenness in that
  disc. HT012Cong compares the Klein semimetric

             (1 - x dot y)^2
    -------------------------------------- - 1.
    (1 - ||x||^2) x. (1 - ||y||^2)

  The definitions below are equalities or biconditionals in set.mm, rather
  than informal typings. All point quantifiers in the final assertion are
  restricted to HT012KDisk, while X and Y in axiom 11 range over arbitrary
  sets. The last declaration is an unproved $a statement.
$)

$c HT012KDisk HT012Dist HT012Bet HT012Cong $.

ht012-kdisk-syntax $a class HT012KDisk $.
ht012-dist-syntax $a class ( A HT012Dist B ) $.
ht012-bet-syntax $a wff HT012Bet A B C $.
ht012-cong-syntax $a wff HT012Cong A B C D $.

ht012-kdisk-definition $a |- HT012KDisk =
  { z e. ( RR X. RR ) |
    (
      (
        ( ( 1st ` z ) ^ 2 )
        +
        ( ( 2nd ` z ) ^ 2 )
      )
      <
      1
    )
  } $.

ht012-distance-definition $a |- ( A HT012Dist B ) =
  (
    (
      (
        (
          1
          -
          (
            ( ( 1st ` A ) x. ( 1st ` B ) )
            +
            ( ( 2nd ` A ) x. ( 2nd ` B ) )
          )
        )
        ^ 2
      )
      /
      (
        (
          1
          -
          (
            ( ( 1st ` A ) ^ 2 )
            +
            ( ( 2nd ` A ) ^ 2 )
          )
        )
        x.
        (
          1
          -
          (
            ( ( 1st ` B ) ^ 2 )
            +
            ( ( 2nd ` B ) ^ 2 )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    -
    1
  )
  $.

${
  $d l A B C $.

  ht012-betweenness-definition $a |- (
    HT012Bet A B C
    <->
    E. l e. RR
      (
        (
          ( 0 <_ l )
          /\
          ( l <_ 1 )
        )
        /\
        B
        =
        <.
          (
            ( ( 1 - l ) x. ( 1st ` A ) )
            +
            ( l x. ( 1st ` C ) )
          )
          ,
          (
            ( ( 1 - l ) x. ( 2nd ` A ) )
            +
            ( l x. ( 2nd ` C ) )
          )
        >.
      )
  ) $.
$}

ht012-congruence-definition $a |- (
  HT012Cong A B C D
  <->
  ( A HT012Dist B ) = ( C HT012Dist D )
) $.

${
  $d a b c d e f g h p q r s t u v x y $.

hundred-independence-parallel-postulate $a |- (
  (
    A. a e. HT012KDisk
    A. b e. HT012KDisk
      HT012Cong a b b a
  )
  /\
  (
    (
      A. a e. HT012KDisk
      A. b e. HT012KDisk
      A. p e. HT012KDisk
      A. q e. HT012KDisk
      A. r e. HT012KDisk
      A. s e. HT012KDisk
        (
          (
            HT012Cong a b p q
            /\
            HT012Cong a b r s
          )
          ->
          HT012Cong p q r s
        )
    )
    /\
    (
      (
        A. a e. HT012KDisk
        A. b e. HT012KDisk
        A. c e. HT012KDisk
          (
            HT012Cong a b c c
            ->
            a = b
          )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          A. q e. HT012KDisk
          A. a e. HT012KDisk
          A. b e. HT012KDisk
          A. c e. HT012KDisk
          E. x e. HT012KDisk
            (
              HT012Bet q a x
              /\
              HT012Cong a x b c
            )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            A. a e. HT012KDisk
            A. b e. HT012KDisk
            A. c e. HT012KDisk
            A. d e. HT012KDisk
            A. e e. HT012KDisk
            A. f e. HT012KDisk
            A. g e. HT012KDisk
            A. h e. HT012KDisk
              (
                (
                  -. a = b
                  /\
                  (
                    HT012Bet a b c
                    /\
                    (
                      HT012Bet e f g
                      /\
                      (
                        HT012Cong a b e f
                        /\
                        (
                          HT012Cong b c f g
                          /\
                          (
                            HT012Cong a d e h
                            /\
                            HT012Cong b d f h
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
                ->
                HT012Cong c d g h
              )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              A. a e. HT012KDisk
              A. b e. HT012KDisk
                (
                  HT012Bet a b a
                  ->
                  a = b
                )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                A. a e. HT012KDisk
                A. b e. HT012KDisk
                A. c e. HT012KDisk
                A. p e. HT012KDisk
                A. q e. HT012KDisk
                  (
                    (
                      HT012Bet a p c
                      /\
                      HT012Bet b q c
                    )
                    ->
                    E. x e. HT012KDisk
                      (
                        HT012Bet p x b
                        /\
                        HT012Bet q x a
                      )
                  )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  E. a e. HT012KDisk
                  E. b e. HT012KDisk
                  E. c e. HT012KDisk
                    (
                      -. HT012Bet a b c
                      /\
                      (
                        -. HT012Bet b c a
                        /\
                        -. HT012Bet c a b
                      )
                    )
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    A. p e. HT012KDisk
                    A. q e. HT012KDisk
                    A. a e. HT012KDisk
                    A. b e. HT012KDisk
                    A. c e. HT012KDisk
                      (
                        (
                          -. p = q
                          /\
                          (
                            HT012Cong a p a q
                            /\
                            (
                              HT012Cong b p b q
                              /\
                              HT012Cong c p c q
                            )
                          )
                        )
                        ->
                        (
                          HT012Bet a b c
                          \/
                          (
                            HT012Bet b c a
                            \/
                            HT012Bet c a b
                          )
                        )
                      )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    (
                      -.
                      A. a e. HT012KDisk
                      A. b e. HT012KDisk
                      A. c e. HT012KDisk
                      A. d e. HT012KDisk
                      A. t e. HT012KDisk
                        (
                          (
                            HT012Bet a d t
                            /\
                            (
                              HT012Bet b d c
                              /\
                              -. a = d
                            )
                          )
                          ->
                          E. x e. HT012KDisk
                          E. y e. HT012KDisk
                            (
                              HT012Bet a b x
                              /\
                              (
                                HT012Bet a c y
                                /\
                                HT012Bet x t y
                              )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      A. u
                      A. v
                        (
                          (
                            u C_ HT012KDisk
                            /\
                            v C_ HT012KDisk
                          )
                          ->
                          (
                            (
                              E. a e. HT012KDisk
                              A. x e. u
                              A. y e. v
                                HT012Bet a x y
                            )
                            ->
                            E. b e. HT012KDisk
                            A. x e. u
                            A. y e. v
                              HT012Bet x b y
                          )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.
$}
