content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate" from Hundred
:: Theorems item 012. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, SUBSET_1, REAL_1, RELAT_1, TARSKI, CARD_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, XXREAL_0, XBOOLE_0, RLTOPSP1, PRE_TOPC, EUCLID, METRIC_1,
      STRUCT_0, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ZFMISC_1, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, BINOP_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, XCMPLX_0, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
      REAL_1, ORDINAL1, METRIC_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, RLTOPSP1,
      EUCLID, TOPREAL6, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ZFMISC_1, SQUARE_1;
 constructors REAL_1, RLTOPSP1, EUCLID, TOPREAL6, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, SQUARE_1,
      RELSET_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, STRUCT_0,
      EUCLID, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
 equalities BINOP_1, EUCLID;

begin

:: The Klein-disc model satisfies Tarski's axioms other than the
:: Euclidean axiom, and refutes that axiom.
::$P-
theorem
  ex o being Point of TOP-REAL 2,
     D being non empty Subset of TOP-REAL 2,
     h being Function of [:REAL 2,REAL 2:],REAL st
    (for p being Point of TOP-REAL 2 holds
      p in D iff dist(p,o) < 1) &
    (for p,q being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st p in D & q in D holds
      h.(p,q) =
        (1 - ((dist(p,o) * dist(p,o) + dist(q,o) * dist(q,o) -
               dist(p,q) * dist(p,q)) / 2)) *
        (1 - ((dist(p,o) * dist(p,o) + dist(q,o) * dist(q,o) -
               dist(p,q) * dist(p,q)) / 2)) /
          ((1 - dist(p,o) * dist(p,o)) *
           (1 - dist(q,o) * dist(q,o))) - 1) &
    (for a,b being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st a in D & b in D holds
      h.(a,b) = h.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,p,q,r,s being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & p in D & q in D & r in D & s in D &
      h.(a,b) = h.(p,q) & h.(a,b) = h.(r,s)
    holds h.(p,q) = h.(r,s)) &
    (for a,b,c being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & c in D & h.(a,b) = h.(c,c)
    holds a = b) &
    (for q,a,b,c being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      q in D & a in D & b in D & c in D
    holds ex x being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      x in D & a in LSeg(q,x) & h.(a,x) = h.(b,c)) &
    (for a,b,c,x,a1,b1,c1,x1 being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & c in D & x in D &
      a1 in D & b1 in D & c1 in D & x1 in D &
      a <> b &
      h.(a,b) = h.(a1,b1) &
      h.(a,c) = h.(a1,c1) &
      h.(b,c) = h.(b1,c1) &
      b in LSeg(a,x) & b1 in LSeg(a1,x1) &
      h.(b,x) = h.(b1,x1)
    holds h.(c,x) = h.(c1,x1)) &
    (for a,b being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & b in LSeg(a,a)
    holds a = b) &
    (for a,b,c,p,q being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & c in D & p in D & q in D &
      p in LSeg(a,c) & q in LSeg(b,c)
    holds ex x being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      x in D & x in LSeg(p,b) & x in LSeg(q,a)) &
    (ex a,b,c being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & c in D &
      not b in LSeg(a,c) & not c in LSeg(b,a) & not a in LSeg(c,b)) &
    (for p,q,a,b,c being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      p in D & q in D & a in D & b in D & c in D &
      p <> q &
      h.(a,p) = h.(a,q) &
      h.(b,p) = h.(b,q) &
      h.(c,p) = h.(c,q)
    holds b in LSeg(a,c) or c in LSeg(b,a) or a in LSeg(c,b)) &
    not (for a,b,c,d,t being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      a in D & b in D & c in D & d in D & t in D &
      d in LSeg(a,t) & d in LSeg(b,c) & a <> d
    holds ex x,y being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      x in D & y in D &
      b in LSeg(a,x) & c in LSeg(a,y) & t in LSeg(x,y)) &
    (for X,Y being Subset of D st
      (ex a being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
        a in D &
        (for x,y being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st x in X & y in Y
         holds x in LSeg(a,y)))
    holds ex b being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st
      b in D &
      (for x,y being Point of TOP-REAL 2 st x in X & y in Y
       holds b in LSeg(x,y)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 012_the_independence_of_the_parallel_postulate
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Independence of the Parallel Postulate" from Hundred
% Theorems item 012. This file contains no proof.

hundred_theorems_012: THEORY
BEGIN
  euclidean_point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]

  dot(p, q: euclidean_point): real =
    x_coord(p) * x_coord(q) + y_coord(p) * y_coord(q)

  squared_norm(p: euclidean_point): real =
    dot(p, p)

  klein_point: TYPE =
    {p: euclidean_point | squared_norm(p) < 1}

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  ddist(p, q: klein_point): real =
    safe_div(
      (1 - dot(p, q)) ^ 2,
      (1 - squared_norm(p)) * (1 - squared_norm(q))) - 1

  pbetween(middle, left, right: klein_point): bool =
    EXISTS (u: real):
      0 <= u
        AND u <= 1
        AND x_coord(middle) =
          (1 - u) * x_coord(left) + u * x_coord(right)
        AND y_coord(middle) =
          (1 - u) * y_coord(left) + u * y_coord(right)

  congruent(a, b, p, q: klein_point): bool =
    ddist(a, b) = ddist(p, q)

  tarski_axiom_1: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: klein_point):
      congruent(a, b, b, a)

  tarski_axiom_2: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, p, q, r, s: klein_point):
      (congruent(a, b, p, q) AND congruent(a, b, r, s))
        IMPLIES congruent(p, q, r, s)

  tarski_axiom_3: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c: klein_point):
      congruent(a, b, c, c) IMPLIES a = b

  tarski_axiom_4: bool =
    FORALL (q, a, b, c: klein_point):
      EXISTS (x: klein_point):
        pbetween(a, q, x) AND congruent(a, x, b, c)

  tarski_axiom_5: bool =
    FORALL
      (a, b, c, x, a_prime, b_prime, c_prime, x_prime:
        klein_point):
      (a /= b
        AND congruent(a, b, a_prime, b_prime)
        AND congruent(a, c, a_prime, c_prime)
        AND congruent(b, c, b_prime, c_prime)
        AND pbetween(b, a, x)
        AND pbetween(b_prime, a_prime, x_prime)
        AND congruent(b, x, b_prime, x_prime))
      IMPLIES congruent(c, x, c_prime, x_prime)

  tarski_axiom_6: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: klein_point):
      pbetween(b, a, a) IMPLIES a = b

  tarski_axiom_7: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, p, q: klein_point):
      (pbetween(p, a, c) AND pbetween(q, b, c))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: klein_point):
            pbetween(x, p, b) AND pbetween(x, q, a)

  tarski_axiom_8: bool =
    EXISTS (a, b, c: klein_point):
      NOT pbetween(b, a, c)
        AND NOT pbetween(c, b, a)
        AND NOT pbetween(a, c, b)

  tarski_axiom_9: bool =
    FORALL (p, q, a, b, c: klein_point):
      (p /= q
        AND congruent(a, p, a, q)
        AND congruent(b, p, b, q)
        AND congruent(c, p, c, q))
      IMPLIES
        (pbetween(b, a, c)
          OR pbetween(c, b, a)
          OR pbetween(a, c, b))

  tarski_axiom_10: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, d, t: klein_point):
      (pbetween(d, a, t)
        AND pbetween(d, b, c)
        AND a /= d)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (x, y: klein_point):
          pbetween(b, a, x)
            AND pbetween(c, a, y)
            AND pbetween(t, x, y)

  tarski_axiom_11: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: [klein_point -> bool]):
      (EXISTS (a: klein_point):
        FORALL (x, y: klein_point):
          (X(x) AND Y(y)) IMPLIES pbetween(x, a, y))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (b: klein_point):
          FORALL (x, y: klein_point):
            (X(x) AND Y(y)) IMPLIES pbetween(b, x, y)

  not_tarski_axiom_10: bool =
    NOT tarski_axiom_10

  independence_of_the_parallel_postulate: bool =
    tarski_axiom_1
      AND tarski_axiom_2
      AND tarski_axiom_3
      AND tarski_axiom_4
      AND tarski_axiom_5
      AND tarski_axiom_6
      AND tarski_axiom_7
      AND tarski_axiom_8
      AND tarski_axiom_9
      AND not_tarski_axiom_10
      AND tarski_axiom_11
END hundred_theorems_012

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Polyhedron Formula" from Hundred Theorems item 013. This
-- file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Polyhedron Formula

Euler's relation for a full-dimensional polytope in real three-space.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Theorems100.PolyhedronFormula

noncomputable section

abbrev Point := Fin 3 → ℝ

/-- The affine combination of a finite family of points with the given coefficients. -/
def weightedPoint {n : ℕ} (coefficients : Fin n → ℝ) (points : Fin n → Point) : Point :=
  fun coordinate => ∑ i, coefficients i * points i coordinate

/-- The convex hull of a finite indexed family of points. -/
def finiteConvexHull {n : ℕ} (vertices : Fin n → Point) : Set Point :=
  {x |
    ∃ coefficients : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ coefficients i) ∧
        (∑ i, coefficients i) = 1 ∧
          x = weightedPoint coefficients vertices}

/-- A polytope is the convex hull of finitely many points. -/
def IsPolytope (p : Set Point) : Prop :=
  ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin n → Point, p = finiteConvexHull vertices

/-- The point at parameter `t` on the segment from `x` to `y`. -/
def segmentPoint (t : ℝ) (x y : Point) : Point :=
  fun coordinate => (1 - t) * x coordinate + t * y coordinate

/-- Convexity stated directly using line segments. -/
def IsConvexSet (s : Set Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ t : ℝ,
    0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → segmentPoint t x y ∈ s

/--
`f` is a face of `p` when it is a convex subset of `p` and any relative-interior
point of a segment in `p` lying in `f` forces both endpoints to lie in `f`.
-/
def IsFace (f p : Set Point) : Prop :=
  f ⊆ p ∧
    IsConvexSet f ∧
      ∀ x ∈ p, ∀ y ∈ p, ∀ t : ℝ,
        0 < t → t < 1 → segmentPoint t x y ∈ f → x ∈ f ∧ y ∈ f

/-- Affine independence via the only affine linear relation being the trivial one. -/
def AffineIndependent {n : ℕ} (points : Fin n → Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ coefficients : Fin n → ℝ,
    (∑ i, coefficients i) = 0 →
      (∀ coordinate : Fin 3, (∑ i, coefficients i * points i coordinate) = 0) →
        ∀ i, coefficients i = 0

/-- The set has affine dimension exactly `d`. -/
def AffineDimensionEq (s : Set Point) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∃ points : Fin (d + 1) → Point,
      (∀ i, points i ∈ s) ∧ AffineIndependent points) ∧
    ¬∃ points : Fin (d + 2) → Point,
      (∀ i, points i ∈ s) ∧ AffineIndependent points

/-- The set of `d`-dimensional faces of `p`. -/
def facesOfDimension (p : Set Point) (d : ℕ) : Set (Set Point) :=
  {f | IsFace f p ∧ AffineDimensionEq f d}

/--
Euler's polyhedron formula: for a full-dimensional polytope in `ℝ³`,
the number of vertices plus the number of two-dimensional faces minus
the number of edges is two.
-/
theorem euler_relation (p : Set Point)
    (hpolytope : IsPolytope p)
    (hfullDimensional : AffineDimensionEq p 3) :
    ((facesOfDimension p 0).ncard + (facesOfDimension p 2).ncard) -
        (facesOfDimension p 1).ncard =
      2 := sorry

end

end Theorems100.PolyhedronFormula

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
(*==========================================================
============================================================
            TOPOLOGICAL FMAPS, QHMAPS, HMAPS -

       PROOFS OF THE GENUS THEOREM AND THE EULER RELATION 

                        PART 3:

  EQUIVALENCES, CHARACTERISTICS, GENUS, EULER_POINCARE, 
         CONSTRUCTIVE CONDITION OF PLANARITY 

       (J.-F. Dufourd - June 2006 - FOR PUBLICATION
        completed in October 2007 / January 2008)

(* COMPLETE, APART FROM LEMMA expf_clos_symm, WHICH IS 
ADMITTED TO PROVE THE NECESSARY CONDITION OF PLANARITY *)
============================================================
==========================================================*)

(*==========================================================
           DART EQUIVALENCES IN QHMAPS
==========================================================*)

Require Export Euler2.

(* Face equivalence: *)

Definition eqf(m:fmap)(x y:dart):=
  expf m x y \/ expf m y x.

(* Reflexivity of eqf: *)

Lemma refl_eqf : forall (m:fmap)(x:dart),
  exd m x -> eqf m x x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Symmetry of eqf: *)

Lemma symm_eqf : forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  eqf m x y -> eqf m y x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Transitivity of eqf: *)

Lemma trans_eqf : forall (m:fmap),
  inv_qhmap m -> forall (x y z:dart),
  eqf m x y -> eqf m y z -> eqf m x z.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Decidability of eqf: *)

Lemma eqf_dec : forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  {eqf m x y} + {~eqf m x y}.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Connectivity : Definition in Prop "a la" Warshall *)

Fixpoint eqc(m:fmap)(x y:dart){struct m}:Prop:=
 match m with
     V => False
  |  I m0 x0 => x=x0 /\ y=x0 \/ eqc m0 x y
  |  L m0 _ x0 y0 =>
      eqc m0 x y
     \/ eqc m0 x x0 /\ eqc m0 y0 y
     \/ eqc m0 x y0 /\ eqc m0 x0 y
 end.

(* Decidability of eqc: *)

Lemma eqc_dec : forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
   {eqc m x y} + {~eqc m x y}.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Reflexivity of eqc: *)

Lemma refl_eqc: forall(m:fmap)(x:dart),
   exd m x -> eqc m x x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Symmetry of eqc: *)

Lemma symm_eqc: forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
   eqc m x y -> eqc m y x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Transitivity of eqc: *)

Lemma trans_eqc: forall(m:fmap)(x y z:dart),
   eqc m x y -> eqc m y z -> eqc m x z.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* LEMMAS, USED IN THE FOLLOWING: *)

Lemma succ_eqc_A_r : forall m:fmap,
 inv_qhmap m ->
  forall (k:dim)(x:dart),
      succ m k x -> eqc m x (A m k x).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Idem, for A_1: *)

Lemma pred_eqc_A_1_r : forall m:fmap, inv_qhmap m ->
 forall (k:dim)(x:dart),
     pred m k x -> eqc m x (A_1 m k x).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* OK: *)

Lemma eqc_eqc_A_1_l : forall m:fmap, inv_qhmap m ->
 forall (k:dim)(x y:dart),
   eqc m x y -> pred m k x -> eqc m (A_1 m k x) y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* INVERSES, Idem: *)

Lemma eqc_A_1_l_eqc : forall m:fmap, inv_qhmap m ->
 forall (k:dim)(x y:dart),
   pred m k x ->  eqc m (A_1 m k x) y -> eqc m x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* OK: *)

Lemma eqc_A_r_eqc : forall m:fmap, inv_qhmap m ->
 forall (k:dim)(x y:dart),
   succ m k y ->  eqc m x (A m k y) -> eqc m x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Face path implies equivalence: with the LEMMAS above: *)

Lemma expf_eqc : forall m:fmap,
 inv_qhmap m ->
   forall (x y:dart), expf m x y -> eqc m x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* OK: *)

Lemma expf_A_1_l_eqc : forall m:fmap,
 inv_qhmap m ->
   forall (x y:dart)(k:dim),
       expf m (A_1 m k x) y -> eqc m x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* IDEM : *)

Lemma expf_A_r_eqc : forall(m:fmap)(k:dim),
 inv_qhmap m ->
   forall (x y:dart), expf m x (A m k y) -> eqc m x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

(*========================================================
      	      NUMBERING AND CHARACTERISTICS:
=========================================================*)

Require Import ZArith.
Open Scope Z_scope.

(* Number of darts: *)

Fixpoint nd(m:fmap):Z :=
 match m with
    V => 0
  | I m0 x => nd m0 + 1
  | L m0 _ _ _ => nd m0
 end.

(* Number of vertices: *)

Fixpoint nv(m:fmap):Z :=
 match m with
    V => 0
  | I m0 x => nv m0 + 1
  | L m0 di0 x y => nv m0
  | L m0 di1 x y => nv m0 -
      if eq_dart_dec (A (clos m0) di1 x) y
      then 0 else 1
 end.

(* Number of edges: *)

Fixpoint ne(m:fmap):Z :=
 match m with
    V => 0
  | I m0 x => ne m0 + 1
  | L m0 di0 x y => ne m0 -
      if eq_dart_dec (A (clos m0) di0 x) y
      then 0 else 1
  | L m0 di1 x y => ne m0
 end.

(* Number of faces: *)

Fixpoint nf(m:fmap):Z :=
 match m with
    V => 0
  | I m0 x => nf m0 + 1
  | L m0 di0 x y =>
      let mc := clos m0 in
      let x0 := A mc di0 x in
      let x_1:= A_1 mc di1 x in
      nf m0 +
       if eq_dart_dec y x0 then 0
       else if expf_dec mc x_1 y then 1
	    else -1
  | L m0 di1 x y =>
      let mc := clos m0 in
      let x1 := A mc di1 x in
      let y0 := A mc di0 y in
      nf m0 +
       if eq_dart_dec y x1 then 0
       else if expf_dec mc x y0 then 1
	    else -1
 end.

(* Number of connected components: *)

Fixpoint nc(m:fmap):Z :=
 match m with
    V => 0
  | I m0 x => nc m0 + 1
  | L m0 _ x y => nc m0 -
       if eqc_dec (clos m0) x y then 0 else 1
 end.

(* Euler-Poincare characteristic: *)

Definition ec(m:fmap): Z:=
  nv m + ne m + nf m - nd m.

(* The Euler-Poincare characteristic is even: OK: *)

Theorem even_ec : forall m:fmap, Zeven (ec m).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* THEOREME OF THE GENUS: OK *)

Theorem genus_theorem : forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> 2 * (nc m) >= (ec m).
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition genus(m:fmap):= (nc m) - (ec m)/2.

(* COROLLARY, OK: *)

Theorem genus_corollary : forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> genus m >= 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition planar(m:fmap):= genus m = 0.

(* EULER-POINCARE FORMULA: *)

Lemma Euler_Poincare: forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m ->
    ec m / 2 = nc m.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* REMARK: SYMMETRY OF expf in the closure NOT USED *)

(* ==========================================================
         PLANARITY CRITERIA (SUFFICIENT CONDITIONS)  
=============================================================*)

(* Sewing at dimension 0: *)

Lemma expf_planar_0: forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m -> 
   prec_Lq m di0 x y -> let mc:= clos m in
    expf mc (A_1 mc di1 x) y -> 
      planar (L m di0 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Sewing at dimension 1: *) 

Lemma expf_planar_1: forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m ->
    prec_Lq m di1 x y -> let mc:= clos m in
      expf mc x (A mc di0 y) -> 
        planar (L m di1 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* V is planar: *)

Lemma planar_V: planar V.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Inserting a dart preserves planarity: *)

Lemma planar_I: forall (m:fmap)(x:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m -> prec_I m x -> 
       planar (I m x).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Sewing two disconnected darts preserves planarity:*)
 
Lemma not_eqc_planar: forall (m:fmap)(k:dim)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m ->  prec_Lq m k x y -> 
     let mc:= clos m in ~eqc mc x y -> 
         planar (L m k x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Sewing at dimension 0 and planarity preservation: *)

Lemma expf_planar_L0: forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m -> 
   prec_Lq m di0 x y -> let mc:= clos m in
     (~eqc mc x y \/ expf mc (A_1 mc di1 x) y) -> 
        planar (L m di0 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Sewing at dimension 1 and planarity preservation: *)

Lemma expf_planar_L1: forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> planar m -> 
   prec_Lq m di1 x y -> let mc:= clos m in
    (~eqc mc x y \/ expf mc x (A mc di0 y)) -> 
       planar (L m di1 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Definition of "Planar formation" of fmap: *)

Fixpoint plf(m:fmap):Prop:=
  match m with 
     V => True
   | I m0 x => plf m0
   | L m0 di0 x y => plf m0 /\ 
      (let mc := (clos m0) in
        ~eqc mc x y \/ expf mc (A_1 mc di1 x) y)
   | L m0 di1 x y => plf m0 /\ 
      (let mc := (clos m0) in
        ~eqc mc x y \/ expf mc x (A mc di0 y))
  end.

(* Constructive Sufficient Condition of planarity: *)

Theorem plf_planar:forall (m:fmap),
  inv_qhmap m -> plf m -> planar m.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* plf_EULER-POINCARE FORMULA: *)

Theorem plf_Euler_Poincare: forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> plf m ->
     ec m / 2 = nc m.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* ==========================================================
       
        PLANARITY CRITERIA (NECESSARY CONDITIONS)  

OK, modulo expf SYMMETRY!!
=============================================================*)

(* OK: *)

Lemma eq_genus_I : forall(m:fmap)(x:dart),
   inv_qhmap (I m x) -> genus (I m x) = genus m.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma incr_genus_L0:forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap (L m di0 x y) ->
     genus m <= genus (L m di0 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma incr_genus_L1:forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap (L m di1 x y) ->
     genus m <= genus (L m di1 x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma planar_I_rcp: forall(m:fmap)(x:dart),
  inv_qhmap (I m x) -> planar (I m x) -> planar m.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma planar_L0_rcp: forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap (L m di0 x y) -> 
     planar (L m di0 x y) -> planar m.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma planar_L1_rcp: forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap (L m di1 x y) -> 
    planar (L m di1 x y) -> planar m.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma succf_expf_F: forall(m:fmap)(x:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> succf m x -> expf m x (F m x).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* HYPOTHESIS: VERY IMPORTANT!!! *)

Lemma expf_clos_symm: forall(m:fmap)(x y:dart),
  inv_qhmap m -> expf (clos m) x y -> expf (clos m) y x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma expf_planar_L1_rcp: forall (m:fmap)(x y:dart),
   inv_qhmap (L m di1 x y) -> planar (L m di1 x y) -> 
      let mc:= clos m in
        (~eqc mc x y \/ expf mc x (A mc di0 y)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem plf_planar_rcp: forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> genus m = 0 -> plf m.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Corollary: *)

Theorem plf_Euler_Poincare_rcp: forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> ec m / 2 = nc m -> plf m.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Corollary: CHARACTERIZATION OF THE PLANAR POLYHEDRA: *)

Theorem Euler_Poincare_criterion: forall m:fmap,
  inv_qhmap m -> (plf m <-> ec m / 2 = nc m).
Proof.
Admitted.

(*==========================================================
============================================================

		      THE END

============================================================
===========================================================*)

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
section \<open>Euler's Polyhedron Formula\<close>

text \<open>One of the Famous 100 Theorems, ported from HOL Light\<close>
text\<open>Cited source:  
Lawrence, J. (1997). A Short Proof of Euler's Relation for Convex Polytopes. 
\emph{Canadian Mathematical Bulletin}, \textbf{40}(4), 471--474.\<close>

theory Euler_Formula
  imports 
    "HOL-Analysis.Analysis" 
begin


text\<open> Interpret which "side" of a hyperplane a point is on.                     \<close>

definition hyperplane_side
  where "hyperplane_side \<equiv> \<lambda>(a,b). \<lambda>x. sgn (a \<bullet> x - b)"

text\<open> Equivalence relation imposed by a hyperplane arrangement.                 \<close>

definition hyperplane_equiv
 where "hyperplane_equiv \<equiv> \<lambda>A x y. \<forall>h \<in> A. hyperplane_side h x = hyperplane_side h y"

lemma hyperplane_equiv_refl [iff]: "hyperplane_equiv A x x"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_equiv_sym:
   "hyperplane_equiv A x y \<longleftrightarrow> hyperplane_equiv A y x"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_equiv_trans:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_equiv A x y; hyperplane_equiv A y z\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_equiv A x z"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_equiv_Un:
   "hyperplane_equiv (A \<union> B) x y \<longleftrightarrow> hyperplane_equiv A x y \<and> hyperplane_equiv B x y"
  by sorry

subsection\<open> Cells of a hyperplane arrangement\<close>

definition hyperplane_cell :: "('a::real_inner \<times> real) set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "hyperplane_cell \<equiv> \<lambda>A C. \<exists>x. C = Collect (hyperplane_equiv A x)"

lemma hyperplane_cell: "hyperplane_cell A C \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>x. C = {y. hyperplane_equiv A x y})"
  by sorry

lemma not_hyperplane_cell_empty [simp]: "\<not> hyperplane_cell A {}"
  by sorry

lemma nonempty_hyperplane_cell: "hyperplane_cell A C \<Longrightarrow> (C \<noteq> {})"
  by sorry

lemma Union_hyperplane_cells: "\<Union> {C. hyperplane_cell A C} = UNIV"
  by sorry

lemma disjoint_hyperplane_cells:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cell A C1; hyperplane_cell A C2; C1 \<noteq> C2\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> disjnt C1 C2"
  by sorry

lemma disjoint_hyperplane_cells_eq:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cell A C1; hyperplane_cell A C2\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> (disjnt C1 C2 \<longleftrightarrow> (C1 \<noteq> C2))"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_empty [iff]: "hyperplane_cell {} C \<longleftrightarrow> C = UNIV"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_singleton_cases:
  assumes "hyperplane_cell {(a,b)} C"
  shows "C = {x. a \<bullet> x = b} \<or> C = {x. a \<bullet> x < b} \<or> C = {x. a \<bullet> x > b}"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_singleton:
   "hyperplane_cell {(a,b)} C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (if a = 0 then C = UNIV else C = {x. a \<bullet> x = b} \<or> C = {x. a \<bullet> x < b} \<or> C = {x. a \<bullet> x > b})"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_Un:
   "hyperplane_cell (A \<union> B) C \<longleftrightarrow>
        C \<noteq> {} \<and>
        (\<exists>C1 C2. hyperplane_cell A C1 \<and> hyperplane_cell B C2 \<and> C = C1 \<inter> C2)"
  by sorry

lemma finite_hyperplane_cells:
   "finite A \<Longrightarrow> finite {C. hyperplane_cell A C}"
  by sorry

lemma finite_restrict_hyperplane_cells:
   "finite A \<Longrightarrow> finite {C. hyperplane_cell A C \<and> P C}"
  by sorry

lemma finite_set_of_hyperplane_cells:
   "\<lbrakk>finite A; \<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cell A C\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> finite \<C>"
  by sorry

lemma pairwise_disjoint_hyperplane_cells:
   "(\<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cell A C) \<Longrightarrow> pairwise disjnt \<C>"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_Int_open_affine:
  assumes "finite A" "hyperplane_cell A C"
  obtains S T where "open S" "affine T" "C = S \<inter> T"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_relatively_open:
  assumes "finite A" "hyperplane_cell A C"
  shows "openin (subtopology euclidean (affine hull C)) C"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_relative_interior:
   "\<lbrakk>finite A; hyperplane_cell A C\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> rel_interior C = C"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_convex:
  assumes "hyperplane_cell A C"
  shows "convex C"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_Inter:
  assumes "\<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cell A C"
    and "\<C> \<noteq> {}" and INT: "\<Inter>\<C> \<noteq> {}"
  shows "hyperplane_cell A (\<Inter>\<C>)"
  by sorry


lemma hyperplane_cell_Int:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cell A S; hyperplane_cell A T; S \<inter> T \<noteq> {}\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cell A (S \<inter> T)"
  by sorry

subsection\<open> A cell complex is considered to be a union of such cells\<close>

definition hyperplane_cellcomplex 
  where "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S \<equiv>
        \<exists>\<T>. (\<forall>C \<in> \<T>. hyperplane_cell A C) \<and> S = \<Union>\<T>"

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_empty [simp]: "hyperplane_cellcomplex A {}"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cell_cellcomplex:
   "hyperplane_cell A C \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A C"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_Union:
  assumes "\<And>S. S \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A S"
  shows "hyperplane_cellcomplex A (\<Union> \<C>)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_Un:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cellcomplex A S; hyperplane_cellcomplex A T\<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A (S \<union> T)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_UNIV [simp]: "hyperplane_cellcomplex A UNIV"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_Inter:
  assumes "\<And>S. S \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A S"
  shows "hyperplane_cellcomplex A (\<Inter>\<C>)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_Int:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cellcomplex A S; hyperplane_cellcomplex A T\<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A (S \<inter> T)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_Compl:
  assumes "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S"
  shows "hyperplane_cellcomplex A (- S)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_diff:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cellcomplex A S; hyperplane_cellcomplex A T\<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A (S - T)"
  by sorry

lemma hyperplane_cellcomplex_mono:
  assumes "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S" "A \<subseteq> B"
  shows "hyperplane_cellcomplex B S"
  by sorry

lemma finite_hyperplane_cellcomplexes:
  assumes "finite A"
  shows "finite {C. hyperplane_cellcomplex A C}"
  by sorry

lemma finite_restrict_hyperplane_cellcomplexes:
   "finite A \<Longrightarrow> finite {C. hyperplane_cellcomplex A C \<and> P C}"
  by sorry

lemma finite_set_of_hyperplane_cellcomplex:
  assumes "finite A" "\<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A C"
  shows "finite \<C>"
  by sorry

lemma cell_subset_cellcomplex:
   "\<lbrakk>hyperplane_cell A C; hyperplane_cellcomplex A S\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> C \<subseteq> S \<longleftrightarrow> ~ disjnt C S"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>Euler characteristic\<close>


definition Euler_characteristic :: "('a::euclidean_space \<times> real) set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> int"
  where "Euler_characteristic A S \<equiv>
        (\<Sum>C | hyperplane_cell A C \<and> C \<subseteq> S. (-1) ^ nat (aff_dim C))"

lemma Euler_characteristic_empty [simp]: "Euler_characteristic A {} = 0"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic_cell_Union:
  assumes "\<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cell A C"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A (\<Union> \<C>) = (\<Sum>C\<in>\<C>. (- 1) ^ nat (aff_dim C))"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic_cell:
   "hyperplane_cell A C \<Longrightarrow> Euler_characteristic A C = (-1) ^ (nat(aff_dim C))"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic_cellcomplex_Un:
  assumes "finite A" "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S" 
    and AT: "hyperplane_cellcomplex A T" and "disjnt S T"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A (S \<union> T) =
         Euler_characteristic A S + Euler_characteristic A T"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic_cellcomplex_Union:
  assumes "finite A" 
    and \<C>: "\<And>C. C \<in> \<C> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A C" "pairwise disjnt \<C>"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A (\<Union> \<C>) = sum (Euler_characteristic A) \<C>"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic:
  fixes A :: "('n::euclidean_space * real) set"
  assumes "finite A"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A S =
        (\<Sum>d = 0..DIM('n). (-1) ^ d * int (card {C. hyperplane_cell A C \<and> C \<subseteq> S \<and> aff_dim C = int d}))"
        (is "_ = ?rhs")
  by sorry

subsection \<open>Show that the characteristic is invariant w.r.t. hyperplane arrangement.\<close>

lemma hyperplane_cells_distinct_lemma:
   "{x. a \<bullet> x = b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x < b} = {} \<and>
         {x. a \<bullet> x = b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x > b} = {} \<and>
         {x. a \<bullet> x < b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x = b} = {} \<and>
         {x. a \<bullet> x < b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x > b} = {} \<and>
         {x. a \<bullet> x > b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x = b} = {} \<and>
         {x. a \<bullet> x > b} \<inter> {x. a \<bullet> x < b} = {}"
  by sorry

proposition Euler_characterstic_lemma:
  assumes "finite A" and "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S"
  shows "Euler_characteristic (insert h A) S = Euler_characteristic A S"
  by sorry


lemma Euler_characterstic_invariant_aux:
  assumes "finite B" "finite A" "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S" 
  shows "Euler_characteristic (A \<union> B) S = Euler_characteristic A S"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characterstic_invariant:
  assumes "finite A" "finite B" "hyperplane_cellcomplex A S" "hyperplane_cellcomplex B S"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A S = Euler_characteristic B S"
  by sorry

lemma Euler_characteristic_inclusion_exclusion:
  assumes "finite A" "finite \<S>" "\<And>K. K \<in> \<S> \<Longrightarrow> hyperplane_cellcomplex A K"
  shows "Euler_characteristic A (\<Union> \<S>) = (\<Sum>\<T> | \<T> \<subseteq> \<S> \<and> \<T> \<noteq> {}. (- 1) ^ (card \<T> + 1) * Euler_characteristic A (\<Inter>\<T>))"
  by sorry



subsection \<open>Euler-type relation for full-dimensional proper polyhedral cones\<close>

lemma Euler_polyhedral_cone:
  fixes S :: "'n::euclidean_space set"
  assumes "polyhedron S" "conic S" and intS: "interior S \<noteq> {}" and "S \<noteq> UNIV"
  shows "(\<Sum>d = 0..DIM('n). (- 1) ^ d * int (card {f. f face_of S \<and> aff_dim f = int d})) = 0"  (is "?lhs = 0")
  by sorry



subsection \<open>Euler-Poincare relation for special $(n-1)$-dimensional polytope\<close>

lemma Euler_Poincare_lemma:
  fixes p :: "'n::euclidean_space set"
  assumes "DIM('n) \<ge> 2" "polytope p" "i \<in> Basis" and affp: "affine hull p = {x. x \<bullet> i = 1}"
  shows "(\<Sum>d = 0..DIM('n) - 1. (-1) ^ d * int (card {f. f face_of p \<and> aff_dim f = int d})) = 1"
  by sorry


corollary Euler_poincare_special:
  fixes p :: "'n::euclidean_space set"
  assumes "2 \<le> DIM('n)" "polytope p" "i \<in> Basis" and affp: "affine hull p = {x. x \<bullet> i = 0}"
  shows "(\<Sum>d = 0..DIM('n) - 1. (-1) ^ d * card {f. f face_of p \<and> aff_dim f = d}) = 1"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>Now Euler-Poincare for a general full-dimensional polytope\<close>

theorem Euler_Poincare_full:
  fixes p :: "'n::euclidean_space set"
  assumes "polytope p" "aff_dim p = DIM('n)"
  shows "(\<Sum>d = 0..DIM('n). (-1) ^ d * (card {f. f face_of p \<and> aff_dim f = d})) = 1"
  by sorry


text \<open>In particular, the Euler relation in 3 dimensions\<close>
corollary Euler_relation:
  fixes p :: "'n::euclidean_space set"
  assumes "polytope p" "aff_dim p = 3" "DIM('n) = 3"
  shows "(card {v. v face_of p \<and> aff_dim v = 0} + card {f. f face_of p \<and> aff_dim f = 2}) - card {e. e face_of p \<and> aff_dim e = 1} = 2"
  by sorry

end

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
013_polyhedron_formula
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 013,
;; "Polyhedron Formula." Every full-dimensional convex polytope in
;; three-dimensional real space has V + F = E + 2. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; ACL2's built-in numbers are not the real numbers, so the scalar structure
;; is an explicit real-closed ordered field. Real closedness is the
;; first-order algebraic theory of the reals needed by this statement.

(defstub ht013-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht013-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht013-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht013-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht013-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub ht013-less-op (x y) t)

(defun ht013-member-p (x)
  (if (ht013-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht013-add (x y)
  (ht013-add-op x y))

(defun ht013-multiply (x y)
  (ht013-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht013-negate (x)
  (ht013-negate-op x))

(defun ht013-inverse (x)
  (ht013-inverse-op x))

(defun ht013-subtract (x y)
  (ht013-add x (ht013-negate y)))

(defun ht013-less (x y)
  (if (ht013-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun ht013-less-or-equal (x y)
  (or (equal x y)
      (ht013-less x y)))

(defun ht013-square (x)
  (ht013-multiply x x))

(defun-sk ht013-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht013-member-p x)
      (ht013-member-p y)
      (ht013-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht013-member-p (ht013-add x y))
      (ht013-member-p (ht013-multiply x y))
      (ht013-member-p (ht013-negate x))
      (ht013-member-p (ht013-inverse x))
      (equal (ht013-add (ht013-add x y) z)
             (ht013-add x (ht013-add y z)))
      (equal (ht013-add x y)
             (ht013-add y x))
      (equal (ht013-add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht013-add x (ht013-negate x)) zero)
      (equal (ht013-multiply (ht013-multiply x y) z)
             (ht013-multiply x (ht013-multiply y z)))
      (equal (ht013-multiply x y)
             (ht013-multiply y x))
      (equal (ht013-multiply x one) x)
      (equal
       (ht013-multiply x (ht013-add y z))
       (ht013-add
        (ht013-multiply x y)
        (ht013-multiply x z)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (ht013-multiply x (ht013-inverse x))
        one))))))

(defun-sk ht013-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht013-member-p x)
      (ht013-member-p y)
      (ht013-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (ht013-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (ht013-less x y)
       (ht013-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht013-less x y)
        (ht013-less y z))
       (ht013-less x z))
      (implies
       (ht013-less x y)
       (ht013-less
        (ht013-add x z)
        (ht013-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht013-less zero x)
        (ht013-less zero y))
       (ht013-less zero (ht013-multiply x y)))))))

(defun ht013-field-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (ht013-member-p (car values))
       (ht013-field-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun ht013-polynomial-value (coefficients x zero)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht013-add
       (car coefficients)
       (ht013-multiply
        x
        (ht013-polynomial-value (cdr coefficients) x zero)))
    zero))

(defun ht013-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients zero)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (ht013-field-list-p coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero))))

(defun-sk ht013-has-square-root-p (x zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht013-member-p root)
     (equal (ht013-square root) x))))

(defun-sk ht013-has-polynomial-root-p (coefficients zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht013-member-p root)
     (equal
      (ht013-polynomial-value coefficients root zero)
      zero))))

(defun-sk ht013-real-closure-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x coefficients)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (ht013-member-p x)
       (not (ht013-less x zero)))
      (ht013-has-square-root-p x zero))
     (implies
      (ht013-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients zero)
      (ht013-has-polynomial-root-p coefficients zero)))))

(defun ht013-real-scalar-context-p (zero one)
  (and
   (ht013-member-p zero)
   (ht013-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht013-less zero one)
   (ht013-field-laws-p zero one)
   (ht013-order-laws-p zero)
   (ht013-real-closure-laws-p zero)))

;; A point is the proper list (x y z), and a plane is the proper list
;; (a b c d), denoting a*x + b*y + c*z = d. A polytope is represented by a
;; finite list of planes whose corresponding closed half-spaces are
;; intersected.

(defun ht013-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (ht013-member-p (nth 0 point))
   (ht013-member-p (nth 1 point))
   (ht013-member-p (nth 2 point))))

(defun ht013-point-x (point)
  (nth 0 point))

(defun ht013-point-y (point)
  (nth 1 point))

(defun ht013-point-z (point)
  (nth 2 point))

(defun ht013-plane-p (plane zero)
  (and
   (true-listp plane)
   (equal (len plane) 4)
   (ht013-member-p (nth 0 plane))
   (ht013-member-p (nth 1 plane))
   (ht013-member-p (nth 2 plane))
   (ht013-member-p (nth 3 plane))
   (not
    (and
     (equal (nth 0 plane) zero)
     (equal (nth 1 plane) zero)
     (equal (nth 2 plane) zero)))))

(defun ht013-plane-value (plane point)
  (ht013-add
   (ht013-add
    (ht013-multiply (nth 0 plane) (ht013-point-x point))
    (ht013-multiply (nth 1 plane) (ht013-point-y point)))
   (ht013-multiply (nth 2 plane) (ht013-point-z point))))

(defun ht013-plane-bound (plane)
  (nth 3 plane))

(defun ht013-halfspace-list-p (halfspaces zero)
  (if (consp halfspaces)
      (and
       (ht013-plane-p (car halfspaces) zero)
       (ht013-halfspace-list-p (cdr halfspaces) zero))
    (equal halfspaces nil)))

(defun ht013-point-in-polytope-p (point halfspaces)
  (and
   (ht013-point-p point)
   (if (consp halfspaces)
       (and
        (ht013-less-or-equal
         (ht013-plane-value (car halfspaces) point)
         (ht013-plane-bound (car halfspaces)))
        (ht013-point-in-polytope-p point (cdr halfspaces)))
     (equal halfspaces nil))))

(defun ht013-coordinate-bounded-p (coordinate bound)
  (and
   (ht013-less-or-equal (ht013-negate bound) coordinate)
   (ht013-less-or-equal coordinate bound)))

(defun-sk ht013-bound-works-p (halfspaces bound)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht013-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
     (and
      (ht013-coordinate-bounded-p (ht013-point-x point) bound)
      (ht013-coordinate-bounded-p (ht013-point-y point) bound)
      (ht013-coordinate-bounded-p (ht013-point-z point) bound)))))

(defun-sk ht013-bounded-p (halfspaces zero)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ht013-member-p bound)
     (ht013-less zero bound)
     (ht013-bound-works-p halfspaces bound))))

(defun ht013-distance-squared (first second)
  (let ((dx (ht013-subtract
             (ht013-point-x first)
             (ht013-point-x second)))
        (dy (ht013-subtract
             (ht013-point-y first)
             (ht013-point-y second)))
        (dz (ht013-subtract
             (ht013-point-z first)
             (ht013-point-z second))))
    (ht013-add
     (ht013-add (ht013-square dx) (ht013-square dy))
     (ht013-square dz))))

(defun-sk ht013-open-ball-contained-p (halfspaces center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht013-point-p point)
      (ht013-less
       (ht013-distance-squared point center)
       (ht013-square radius)))
     (ht013-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces))))

(defun-sk ht013-full-dimensional-p (halfspaces zero)
  (exists (center radius)
    (and
     (ht013-point-p center)
     (ht013-member-p radius)
     (ht013-less zero radius)
     (ht013-open-ball-contained-p halfspaces center radius))))

(defun ht013-polytope3-p (halfspaces zero)
  (and
   (true-listp halfspaces)
   (ht013-halfspace-list-p halfspaces zero)
   (ht013-bounded-p halfspaces zero)
   (ht013-full-dimensional-p halfspaces zero)))

;; Every face of a polytope is exposed. A plane descriptor represents the
;; nonempty face where a supporting inequality is tight.

(defun-sk ht013-supporting-plane-p (halfspaces plane)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht013-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
     (ht013-less-or-equal
      (ht013-plane-value plane point)
      (ht013-plane-bound plane)))))

(defun ht013-point-in-face-p (point halfspaces plane)
  (and
   (ht013-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
   (equal
    (ht013-plane-value plane point)
    (ht013-plane-bound plane))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-equivalent-p
    (halfspaces first-plane second-plane)
  (forall (point)
    (equal
     (ht013-point-in-face-p point halfspaces first-plane)
     (ht013-point-in-face-p point halfspaces second-plane))))

;; Affine dimensions zero, one, and two are expressed intrinsically. The
;; quantified scalars in on-line and on-plane range over the field carrier.

(defun-sk ht013-on-line-p (point first second)
  (exists (parameter)
    (and
     (ht013-member-p parameter)
     (equal
      (ht013-point-x point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-point-x first)
       (ht013-multiply
        parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-x second)
         (ht013-point-x first)))))
     (equal
      (ht013-point-y point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-point-y first)
       (ht013-multiply
        parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-y second)
         (ht013-point-y first)))))
     (equal
      (ht013-point-z point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-point-z first)
       (ht013-multiply
        parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-z second)
         (ht013-point-z first))))))))

(defun ht013-cross-x (first second third)
  (ht013-subtract
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-y second) (ht013-point-y first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-z third) (ht013-point-z first)))
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-z second) (ht013-point-z first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-y third) (ht013-point-y first)))))

(defun ht013-cross-y (first second third)
  (ht013-subtract
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-z second) (ht013-point-z first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-x third) (ht013-point-x first)))
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-x second) (ht013-point-x first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-z third) (ht013-point-z first)))))

(defun ht013-cross-z (first second third)
  (ht013-subtract
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-x second) (ht013-point-x first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-y third) (ht013-point-y first)))
   (ht013-multiply
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-y second) (ht013-point-y first))
    (ht013-subtract (ht013-point-x third) (ht013-point-x first)))))

(defun ht013-affinely-independent-three-p
    (first second third zero)
  (or
   (not (equal (ht013-cross-x first second third) zero))
   (not (equal (ht013-cross-y first second third) zero))
   (not (equal (ht013-cross-z first second third) zero))))

(defun-sk ht013-on-plane-p (point first second third)
  (exists (first-parameter second-parameter)
    (and
     (ht013-member-p first-parameter)
     (ht013-member-p second-parameter)
     (equal
      (ht013-point-x point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-add
        (ht013-point-x first)
        (ht013-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht013-subtract
          (ht013-point-x second)
          (ht013-point-x first))))
       (ht013-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-x third)
         (ht013-point-x first)))))
     (equal
      (ht013-point-y point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-add
        (ht013-point-y first)
        (ht013-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht013-subtract
          (ht013-point-y second)
          (ht013-point-y first))))
       (ht013-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-y third)
         (ht013-point-y first)))))
     (equal
      (ht013-point-z point)
      (ht013-add
       (ht013-add
        (ht013-point-z first)
        (ht013-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht013-subtract
          (ht013-point-z second)
          (ht013-point-z first))))
       (ht013-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht013-subtract
         (ht013-point-z third)
         (ht013-point-z first))))))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-is-singleton-p
    (halfspaces plane point)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (ht013-point-in-face-p other halfspaces plane)
     (equal other point))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-dimension-zero-p
    (halfspaces plane)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (ht013-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-face-is-singleton-p halfspaces plane point))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-contained-in-line-p
    (halfspaces plane first second)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht013-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-on-line-p point first second))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-dimension-one-p
    (halfspaces plane)
  (exists (first second)
    (and
     (ht013-point-in-face-p first halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-point-in-face-p second halfspaces plane)
     (not (equal first second))
     (ht013-face-contained-in-line-p
      halfspaces plane first second))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-contained-in-plane-p
    (halfspaces plane first second third)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht013-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-on-plane-p point first second third))))

(defun-sk ht013-face-dimension-two-p
    (halfspaces plane zero)
  (exists (first second third)
    (and
     (ht013-point-in-face-p first halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-point-in-face-p second halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-point-in-face-p third halfspaces plane)
     (ht013-affinely-independent-three-p
      first second third zero)
     (ht013-face-contained-in-plane-p
      halfspaces plane first second third))))

(defun ht013-face-of-dimension-p
    (halfspaces plane dimension zero)
  (and
   (ht013-plane-p plane zero)
   (ht013-supporting-plane-p halfspaces plane)
   (cond
    ((equal dimension 0)
     (ht013-face-dimension-zero-p halfspaces plane))
    ((equal dimension 1)
     (ht013-face-dimension-one-p halfspaces plane))
    ((equal dimension 2)
     (ht013-face-dimension-two-p halfspaces plane zero))
    (t nil))))

;; A finite list enumerates the faces of one dimension when every descriptor
;; is sound, no two descriptors denote the same face, and every supporting
;; plane for such a face is extensionally represented in the list.

(defun ht013-equivalent-face-in-list-p
    (halfspaces plane face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (or
       (ht013-face-equivalent-p
        halfspaces plane (car face-list))
       (ht013-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces plane (cdr face-list)))
    nil))

(defun ht013-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
    (halfspaces plane face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (and
       (not
        (ht013-face-equivalent-p
         halfspaces plane (car face-list)))
       (ht013-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces plane (cdr face-list)))
    t))

(defun ht013-face-list-sound-p
    (halfspaces face-list dimension zero)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (and
       (ht013-face-of-dimension-p
        halfspaces (car face-list) dimension zero)
       (ht013-face-list-sound-p
        halfspaces (cdr face-list) dimension zero))
    (equal face-list nil)))

(defun ht013-face-list-distinct-p (halfspaces face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (and
       (ht013-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces (car face-list) (cdr face-list))
       (ht013-face-list-distinct-p
        halfspaces (cdr face-list)))
    (equal face-list nil)))

(defun-sk ht013-face-list-complete-p
    (halfspaces face-list dimension zero)
  (forall (plane)
    (implies
     (ht013-face-of-dimension-p
      halfspaces plane dimension zero)
     (ht013-equivalent-face-in-list-p
      halfspaces plane face-list))))

(defun ht013-face-enumeration-p
    (halfspaces face-list dimension zero)
  (and
   (true-listp face-list)
   (ht013-face-list-sound-p
    halfspaces face-list dimension zero)
   (ht013-face-list-distinct-p halfspaces face-list)
   (ht013-face-list-complete-p
    halfspaces face-list dimension zero)))

(defun-sk ht013-euler-enumerations-exist-p
    (halfspaces zero)
  (exists (vertices edges facets)
    (and
     (ht013-face-enumeration-p
      halfspaces vertices 0 zero)
     (ht013-face-enumeration-p
      halfspaces edges 1 zero)
     (ht013-face-enumeration-p
      halfspaces facets 2 zero)
     (equal
      (+ (len vertices) (len facets))
      (+ (len edges) 2)))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-013-polyhedron-formula-statement
    (zero one)
  (forall (halfspaces)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht013-real-scalar-context-p zero one)
      (ht013-polytope3-p halfspaces zero))
     (ht013-euler-enumerations-exist-p
      halfspaces zero))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Polyhedron Formula" from Hundred Theorems item 013
-- (artifact hundred-theorems__agda__013): a full-dimensional convex polytope in real
-- three-space has V - E + F = 2. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _≠_ _≈_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 2 _∨_

data ⊥ : Set where

_≠_ : {a : Level} {A : Set a} → A → A → Set a
x ≠ y = x ≡ y → ⊥

record _∧_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Exists {a p : Level} (A : Set a) (P : A → Set p) :
    Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    evidence : P value

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R → R → R
    negate inverse : R → R
    lessOrEqual : R → R → Set
    fromNat : Nat → R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) → add x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) → add x (negate x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) → multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) → multiply x oneR ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) → multiply x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR ≡ zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) → lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y ∨ lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqual zeroR x →
      lessOrEqual zeroR y →
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR ∧ oneR ≠ zeroR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) → fromNat (suc n) ≡ add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Exists Nat (λ n → lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set) →
      Exists R P →
      Exists R
        (λ upper →
          (x : R) →
          P x →
          lessOrEqual x upper) →
      Exists R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqual x supremum) ∧
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqual x upper) →
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

record Point3 (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R
    z-coordinate : R

Region : Set → Set₁
Region A = A → Set

_≈_ : {A : Set} → Region A → Region A → Set
_≈_ {A = A} S T = (x : A) → S x ↔ T x

record HasCardinality
  {a e p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (equivalent : A → A → Set e)
  (P : A → Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) : Set (a ⊔ e ⊔ p) where

  field
    enumerate : Fin cardinality → A

    enumeration-sound :
      (i : Fin cardinality) →
      P (enumerate i)

    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) →
      P item →
      Exists (Fin cardinality) (λ i → equivalent item (enumerate i))

    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) →
      equivalent (enumerate i) (enumerate j) →
      i ≡ j

module PolyhedronFormulaStatement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals
  open Point3

  Point : Set
  Point = Point3 R

  Region3 : Set₁
  Region3 = Region Point

  zeroPoint : Point
  zeroPoint = point zeroR zeroR zeroR

  addPoint : Point → Point → Point
  addPoint u v =
    point
      (add (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
      (add (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v))
      (add (z-coordinate u) (z-coordinate v))

  negatePoint : Point → Point
  negatePoint u =
    point
      (negate (x-coordinate u))
      (negate (y-coordinate u))
      (negate (z-coordinate u))

  subtractPoint : Point → Point → Point
  subtractPoint u v = addPoint u (negatePoint v)

  scalePoint : R → Point → Point
  scalePoint scalar u =
    point
      (multiply scalar (x-coordinate u))
      (multiply scalar (y-coordinate u))
      (multiply scalar (z-coordinate u))

  dot : Point → Point → R
  dot u v =
    add
      (add
        (multiply (x-coordinate u) (x-coordinate v))
        (multiply (y-coordinate u) (y-coordinate v)))
      (multiply (z-coordinate u) (z-coordinate v))

  sumFin : {n : Nat} → (Fin n → R) → R
  sumFin {zero} values = zeroR
  sumFin {suc n} values =
    add (values fzero) (sumFin (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

  weightedSum :
    {n : Nat} →
    (Fin n → Point) →
    (Fin n → R) →
    Point
  weightedSum {zero} vertices weights = zeroPoint
  weightedSum {suc n} vertices weights =
    addPoint
      (scalePoint (weights fzero) (vertices fzero))
      (weightedSum
        (λ i → vertices (fsuc i))
        (λ i → weights (fsuc i)))

  convexHull :
    {n : Nat} →
    (Fin n → Point) →
    Region3
  convexHull {n} vertices p =
    Exists (Fin n → R)
      (λ weights →
        ((i : Fin n) → lessOrEqual zeroR (weights i)) ∧
        (sumFin weights ≡ oneR) ∧
        (weightedSum vertices weights ≡ p))

  Polytope : Region3 → Set
  Polytope polyhedron =
    Exists Nat
      (λ n →
        Exists (Fin n → Point)
          (λ vertices → polyhedron ≈ convexHull vertices))

  faceOf : Region3 → Region3 → Set
  faceOf face polyhedron =
    Exists Point
      (λ normal →
        Exists R
          (λ bound →
            ((p : Point) →
              polyhedron p →
              lessOrEqual (dot normal p) bound) ∧
            (face ≈
              (λ p →
                polyhedron p ∧ dot normal p ≡ bound))))

  linearlyIndependent2 : Point → Point → Set
  linearlyIndependent2 u v =
    (a b : R) →
    addPoint (scalePoint a u) (scalePoint b v) ≡ zeroPoint →
    a ≡ zeroR ∧ b ≡ zeroR

  linearlyIndependent3 : Point → Point → Point → Set
  linearlyIndependent3 u v w =
    (a b c : R) →
    addPoint
      (addPoint (scalePoint a u) (scalePoint b v))
      (scalePoint c w) ≡ zeroPoint →
    a ≡ zeroR ∧ b ≡ zeroR ∧ c ≡ zeroR

  affineDimensionZero : Region3 → Set
  affineDimensionZero S =
    Exists Point
      (λ p →
        S p ∧
        ((q : Point) → S q → q ≡ p))

  affineDimensionOne : Region3 → Set
  affineDimensionOne S =
    Exists Point
      (λ p →
        Exists Point
          (λ q →
            S p ∧
            S q ∧
            p ≠ q ∧
            ((r : Point) →
              S r →
              Exists R
                (λ t →
                  r ≡
                  addPoint p
                    (scalePoint t (subtractPoint q p))))))

  affineDimensionTwo : Region3 → Set
  affineDimensionTwo S =
    Exists Point
      (λ p →
        Exists Point
          (λ q →
            Exists Point
              (λ r →
                S p ∧
                S q ∧
                S r ∧
                linearlyIndependent2
                  (subtractPoint q p)
                  (subtractPoint r p) ∧
                ((s : Point) →
                  S s →
                  Exists R
                    (λ a →
                      Exists R
                        (λ b →
                          s ≡
                          addPoint
                            (addPoint p
                              (scalePoint a (subtractPoint q p)))
                            (scalePoint b (subtractPoint r p))))))))

  affineDimensionThree : Region3 → Set
  affineDimensionThree S =
    Exists Point
      (λ p →
        Exists Point
          (λ q →
            Exists Point
              (λ r →
                Exists Point
                  (λ s →
                    S p ∧
                    S q ∧
                    S r ∧
                    S s ∧
                    linearlyIndependent3
                      (subtractPoint q p)
                      (subtractPoint r p)
                      (subtractPoint s p)))))

  vertexFace : Region3 → Region3 → Set
  vertexFace polyhedron face =
    faceOf face polyhedron ∧ affineDimensionZero face

  edgeFace : Region3 → Region3 → Set
  edgeFace polyhedron face =
    faceOf face polyhedron ∧ affineDimensionOne face

  twoDimensionalFace : Region3 → Region3 → Set
  twoDimensionalFace polyhedron face =
    faceOf face polyhedron ∧ affineDimensionTwo face

  record EulerFaceCounts (polyhedron : Region3) : Set₁ where
    field
      vertexCount edgeCount twoDimensionalFaceCount : Nat

      vertex-cardinality :
        HasCardinality
          (λ S T → S ≈ T)
          (vertexFace polyhedron)
          vertexCount

      edge-cardinality :
        HasCardinality
          (λ S T → S ≈ T)
          (edgeFace polyhedron)
          edgeCount

      two-dimensional-face-cardinality :
        HasCardinality
          (λ S T → S ≈ T)
          (twoDimensionalFace polyhedron)
          twoDimensionalFaceCount

      Euler-relation :
        vertexCount + twoDimensionalFaceCount - edgeCount ≡ suc (suc zero)

  proposition : Set₁
  proposition =
    (polyhedron : Region3) →
    Polytope polyhedron →
    affineDimensionThree polyhedron →
    EulerFaceCounts polyhedron

polyhedron-formula : Set₁
polyhedron-formula =
  (R : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  PolyhedronFormulaStatement.proposition reals

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Polyhedron Formula" from Hundred Theorems item 013. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory cardinalTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val polyhedron_formula =
  ``let xcoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. FST (FST p)
    in
    let ycoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. SND (FST p)
    in
    let zcoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. SND p
    in
    let plane_value =
      \(h : (real # real) # (real # real))
       (p : (real # real) # real).
        FST (FST h) * xcoord p +
        SND (FST h) * ycoord p +
        FST (SND h) * zcoord p
    in
    let plane_rhs =
      \h : (real # real) # (real # real). SND (SND h)
    in
    let nonzero_normal =
      \h : (real # real) # (real # real).
        ~(FST (FST h) = 0 /\
          SND (FST h) = 0 /\
          FST (SND h) = 0)
    in
    let bounded3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?B : real.
          0 < B /\
          !p.
            p IN P ==>
            abs (xcoord p) <= B /\
            abs (ycoord p) <= B /\
            abs (zcoord p) <= B
    in
    let full_dimensional3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?c r.
          0 < r /\
          !p.
            (xcoord p - xcoord c) * (xcoord p - xcoord c) +
            (ycoord p - ycoord c) * (ycoord p - ycoord c) +
            (zcoord p - zcoord c) * (zcoord p - zcoord c) < r * r
            ==> p IN P
    in
    let polytope3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?H : (((real # real) # (real # real)) set).
          FINITE H /\
          (!h. h IN H ==> nonzero_normal h) /\
          (!p.
             p IN P <=>
             !h. h IN H ==> plane_value h p <= plane_rhs h) /\
          bounded3 P /\
          full_dimensional3 P
    in
    let face_of =
      \(f : (((real # real) # real) set))
       (P : (((real # real) # real) set)).
        ~(f = EMPTY) /\
        f SUBSET P /\
        ?h : (real # real) # (real # real).
          nonzero_normal h /\
          (!p. p IN P ==> plane_value h p <= plane_rhs h) /\
          f = {p | p IN P /\ plane_value h p = plane_rhs h}
    in
    let on_line =
      \(p : (real # real) # real)
       (q : (real # real) # real)
       (s : (real # real) # real).
        ?t : real.
          xcoord s = xcoord p + t * (xcoord q - xcoord p) /\
          ycoord s = ycoord p + t * (ycoord q - ycoord p) /\
          zcoord s = zcoord p + t * (zcoord q - zcoord p)
    in
    let on_plane =
      \(p : (real # real) # real)
       (q : (real # real) # real)
       (r : (real # real) # real)
       (s : (real # real) # real).
        ?u v : real.
          xcoord s =
            xcoord p +
            u * (xcoord q - xcoord p) +
            v * (xcoord r - xcoord p) /\
          ycoord s =
            ycoord p +
            u * (ycoord q - ycoord p) +
            v * (ycoord r - ycoord p) /\
          zcoord s =
            zcoord p +
            u * (zcoord q - zcoord p) +
            v * (zcoord r - zcoord p)
    in
    let dimension0 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p. f = {p}
    in
    let dimension1 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p q.
          p IN f /\
          q IN f /\
          ~(p = q) /\
          !s. s IN f ==> on_line p q s
    in
    let dimension2 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p q r.
          p IN f /\
          q IN f /\
          r IN f /\
          ~(p = q) /\
          ~on_line p q r /\
          !s. s IN f ==> on_plane p q r s
    in
      !P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        polytope3 P ==>
        (CARD {v | face_of v P /\ dimension0 v} +
         CARD {f | face_of f P /\ dimension2 f}) -
        CARD {e | face_of e P /\ dimension1 e} = 2``;

title: 013_polyhedron_formula
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Polyhedron Formula" from Hundred
  Theorems item 013: every full-dimensional convex polytope in real
  three-space satisfies Euler's vertex-edge-face equation V + F - E = 2.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Real three-space is represented by RR X. ( RR X. RR ).  The following
  symbols are definitional abbreviations only.  They expand convex
  polytopes as convex hulls of internally existentially quantified finite
  sets of real points, faces by the open-segment characterization, and
  affine dimensions by affine independence of two, three, or four points.
$)

$c
  HT013R3 HT013X HT013Y HT013Z HT013Mix HT013Hull HT013Convex
  HT013AI3 HT013Det HT013AI4 HT013Dim0 HT013Dim1 HT013Dim2
  HT013Full3 HT013Polytope HT013Face HT013Faces0 HT013Faces1
  HT013Faces2
$.

ht013-r3-syntax $a class HT013R3 $.
ht013-x-syntax $a class ( HT013X A ) $.
ht013-y-syntax $a class ( HT013Y A ) $.
ht013-z-syntax $a class ( HT013Z A ) $.
ht013-mix-syntax $a class ( A HT013Mix B C ) $.
ht013-hull-syntax $a class ( HT013Hull A ) $.
ht013-convex-syntax $a wff ( HT013Convex A ) $.
ht013-ai3-syntax $a wff ( HT013AI3 A B C ) $.
ht013-det-syntax $a class ( HT013Det A B C D ) $.
ht013-ai4-syntax $a wff ( HT013AI4 A B C D ) $.
ht013-dim0-syntax $a wff ( HT013Dim0 A ) $.
ht013-dim1-syntax $a wff ( HT013Dim1 A ) $.
ht013-dim2-syntax $a wff ( HT013Dim2 A ) $.
ht013-full3-syntax $a wff ( HT013Full3 A ) $.
ht013-polytope-syntax $a wff ( HT013Polytope A ) $.
ht013-face-syntax $a wff ( A HT013Face B ) $.
ht013-faces0-syntax $a class ( HT013Faces0 A ) $.
ht013-faces1-syntax $a class ( HT013Faces1 A ) $.
ht013-faces2-syntax $a class ( HT013Faces2 A ) $.

ht013-r3-def $a
  |- HT013R3 = ( RR X. ( RR X. RR ) )
$.

ht013-x-def $a
  |- ( HT013X A ) = ( 1st ` A )
$.

ht013-y-def $a
  |- ( HT013Y A ) = ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
$.

ht013-z-def $a
  |- ( HT013Z A ) = ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
$.

ht013-mix-def $a
  |- ( A HT013Mix B C ) =
      <. ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT013X B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT013X C ) ) ,
        <. ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT013Y B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT013Y C ) ) ,
           ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT013Z B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT013Z C ) ) >. >.
$.

${
  $d w x z A $.
  ht013-hull-def $a
    |- ( HT013Hull A ) =
       { z e. HT013R3 |
         E. w
           ( ( w : A --> RR /\
               A. x e. A ( 0 <_ ( w ` x ) ) ) /\
             ( ( sum_ x e. A ( w ` x ) ) = 1 /\
               z =
               <. sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT013X x ) ) ,
                  <. sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT013Y x ) ) ,
                     sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT013Z x ) ) >. >. ) ) }
  $.
$}

${
  $d t x y A $.
  ht013-convex-def $a
    |- ( HT013Convex A ) <->
       A. x e. A A. y e. A A. t e. RR
         ( ( 0 <_ t /\ t <_ 1 ) -> ( ( t HT013Mix x y ) e. A ) )
  $.
$}

ht013-ai3-def $a
  |- ( HT013AI3 A B C ) <->
     ( ( ( ( HT013X B ) - ( HT013X A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013Y C ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT013Y B ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013X C ) - ( HT013X A ) ) ) \/
       ( ( ( HT013X B ) - ( HT013X A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013Z C ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT013Z B ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013X C ) - ( HT013X A ) ) ) \/
       ( ( ( HT013Y B ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013Z C ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT013Z B ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT013Y C ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) ) )
$.

ht013-det-def $a
  |- ( HT013Det A B C D ) =
     ( ( ( ( HT013X B ) - ( HT013X A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT013Y C ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013Z D ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT013Z C ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013Y D ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) ) ) ) -
       ( ( ( HT013Y B ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT013X C ) - ( HT013X A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013Z D ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT013Z C ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013X D ) - ( HT013X A ) ) ) ) ) ) +
       ( ( ( HT013Z B ) - ( HT013Z A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT013X C ) - ( HT013X A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013Y D ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT013Y C ) - ( HT013Y A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT013X D ) - ( HT013X A ) ) ) ) ) )
$.

ht013-ai4-def $a
  |- ( HT013AI4 A B C D ) <-> ( ( HT013Det A B C D ) =/= 0 )
$.

${
  $d x y A $.
  ht013-dim0-def $a
    |- ( HT013Dim0 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT013R3 /\ A =/= (/) ) /\
         A. x e. A A. y e. A x = y )
  $.
$}

${
  $d x y z A $.
  ht013-dim1-def $a
    |- ( HT013Dim1 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT013R3 /\
           E. x e. A E. y e. A x =/= y ) /\
         A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
           -. ( HT013AI3 x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d w x y z A $.
  ht013-dim2-def $a
    |- ( HT013Dim2 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT013R3 /\
           E. x e. A E. y e. A E. z e. A
             ( HT013AI3 x y z ) ) /\
         A. w e. A A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
           -. ( HT013AI4 w x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d w x y z A $.
  ht013-full3-def $a
    |- ( HT013Full3 A ) <->
       ( A C_ HT013R3 /\
         E. w e. A E. x e. A E. y e. A E. z e. A
           ( HT013AI4 w x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d v A $.
  ht013-polytope-def $a
    |- ( HT013Polytope A ) <->
       E. v
         ( ( v e. Fin /\ v C_ HT013R3 ) /\
           A = ( HT013Hull v ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d t x y A B $.
  ht013-face-def $a
    |- ( A HT013Face B ) <->
       ( ( A C_ B /\ ( HT013Convex A ) ) /\
         A. x e. B A. y e. B A. t e. RR
           ( ( ( 0 < t /\ t < 1 ) /\
               ( ( t HT013Mix x y ) e. A ) ) ->
             ( x e. A /\ y e. A ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d f A $.
  ht013-faces0-def $a
    |- ( HT013Faces0 A ) =
       { f e. ~P A | ( ( f HT013Face A ) /\ ( HT013Dim0 f ) ) }
  $.

  ht013-faces1-def $a
    |- ( HT013Faces1 A ) =
       { f e. ~P A | ( ( f HT013Face A ) /\ ( HT013Dim1 f ) ) }
  $.

  ht013-faces2-def $a
    |- ( HT013Faces2 A ) =
       { f e. ~P A | ( ( f HT013Face A ) /\ ( HT013Dim2 f ) ) }
  $.
$}

$(
  This unproved assertion is the translated statement.  The cardinalities
  count the zero-, one-, and two-dimensional faces, respectively; subtraction
  is natural-number subtraction, matching the HOL Light and Isabelle sources.
$)
ht013-polyhedron-formula $a
  |- A. p
       ( ( ( HT013Polytope p ) /\ ( HT013Full3 p ) ) ->
         ( ( ( # ` ( HT013Faces0 p ) ) +
             ( # ` ( HT013Faces2 p ) ) ) -
           ( # ` ( HT013Faces1 p ) ) ) = 2 )
$.
