    u continuous_on (:complex) /\ bounded(support (+) u (:complex)) /\
    g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1]
    ==> (\x. norm(vector_derivative g (at x)) %
             integral (:complex) (\y. lift(norm(u y / (y - g x)))))
        measurable_on interval[vec 0, vec 1]`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Fubini exchange: swap path integral and area integral.                    *)
(* Uses FUBINI_INTEGRAL_SWAP on the product space real^1 x complex.          *)
(* LMUL integrability handled via INTEGRAL_SPIKE + NEGLIGIBLE_AC_PATH.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* AC path image is negligible (measure zero in R^2)                         *)
let NEGLIGIBLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_PATH_IMAGE = `!g:real^1->complex.
    g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1]
    ==> negligible(path_image g)`;;

let PATH_INTEGRABLE_CONTINUOUS_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS = `!f:complex->complex g:real^1->complex.
    f continuous_on path_image g /\
    g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1]
    ==> f path_integrable_on g`;;

let FUBINI_PATH_AREA = `!u:complex->complex g.
        u continuous_on (:complex) /\
        bounded (support (+) u (:complex)) /\
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> path_integral g (\w. integral (:complex)
               (\z. u(z) / (z - w))) =
            integral (:complex)
               (\z. u(z) * path_integral g (\w. Cx(&1) / (z - w)))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Absolute integrability of the translated dbar kernel.                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_DBAR_KERNEL = `!f:complex->complex w.
        (\z. wirtinger_dbar f z) continuous_on (:complex) /\
        bounded (support (+) (wirtinger_dbar f) (:complex))
        ==> (\z. wirtinger_dbar f (w + z) / z) absolutely_integrable_on
            (:complex)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Angular / polar path lemmas for polar coordinates proof.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Derivative chain: t -> Cx(drop t)                                         *)
let HAS_DERIVATIVE_CX_DROP = `!t:real^1. ((\t. Cx(drop t)) has_derivative (\h. Cx(drop h))) (at t)`;;

(* Derivative chain: t -> ii * Cx(drop t)                                    *)
let HAS_DERIVATIVE_II_CX_DROP = `!t:real^1. ((\t. ii * Cx(drop t)) has_derivative (\h. ii * Cx(drop h)))
              (at t)`;;

(* Derivative chain: t -> cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))                              *)
let HAS_DERIVATIVE_CEXP_POLAR = `!t:real^1. ((\t. cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) has_derivative
      (\h. cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) * (ii * Cx(drop h)))) (at t)`;;

(* Affine map z -> w + c*z has derivative h -> c*h                           *)
let HAS_DERIVATIVE_AFFINE_MUL = `!c:complex w:complex a:complex.
     ((\z. w + c * z) has_derivative (\h. c * h)) (at a)`;;

(* Derivative of full polar path t -> w + Cx(r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))      *)
let HAS_DERIVATIVE_POLAR_PATH = `!w:complex r t:real^1.
     ((\t. w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) has_derivative
      (\h. Cx r * (cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) * (ii * Cx(drop h))))) (at t)`;;


(* Continuity helper: (\z. c * z) continuous on (:complex)                   *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPLEX_LMUL_FN = `!c:complex. (\z:complex. c * z) continuous_on (:complex)`;;

(* Continuity: t -> ii * Cx(drop t) on (:real^1)                             *)
let CONT_II_CX_DROP = `(\t:real^1. ii * Cx(drop t)) continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

(* Continuity: t -> cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) on (:real^1)                       *)
let CONT_CEXP_POLAR = `(\t:real^1. cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

(* Continuity: full polar path on (:real^1)                                  *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_POLAR_PATH = `!w:complex r.
     (\t. w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

(* Continuity on the interval [0, 2*pi]                                      *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_POLAR_PATH_INTERVAL = `!w:complex r.
     (\t. w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) continuous_on
     interval[vec 0:real^1, lift(&2 * pi)]`;;

(* f composed with polar path continuous                                     *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_F_POLAR = `!f:complex->complex w r.
     f continuous_on (:complex)
     ==> (\t. f(w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)))) continuous_on
         interval[vec 0:real^1, lift(&2 * pi)]`;;

(* Vector derivative of f composed with polar path                           *)
let HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_F_POLAR = `!f:complex->complex w r t.
     f differentiable at (w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)))
     ==> ((\t. f(w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
          has_vector_derivative
          (frechet_derivative f (at (w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
            (Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) * ii)))
         (at t)`;;

(* Angular FTC: integral of derivative along polar path                      *)
let ANGULAR_FTC = `!f:complex->complex w r.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex)
     ==> ((\t. frechet_derivative f (at (w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                (Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) * ii))
          has_integral
          (f(w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop(lift(&2 * pi))))) -
           f(w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop(vec 0))))))
         (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])`;;

(* The angular integral is zero by 2*pi-periodicity of exp                   *)
let ANGULAR_INTEGRAL_ZERO = `!f:complex->complex w r.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex)
     ==> integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
           (\t. frechet_derivative f (at (w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                  (Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)) * ii)) = vec 0`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Frechet derivative commutes with real scalar multiplication               *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_CX_LMUL = `!f:complex->complex z c x.
     f differentiable at z
     ==> frechet_derivative f (at z) (Cx c * x) =
         Cx c * frechet_derivative f (at z) x`;;

(* For r != 0, the angular integral of f'(z)(ii * exp(it)) is zero           *)
let ANGULAR_INTEGRAL_II_ZERO = `!f:complex->complex w r.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     ~(r = &0)
     ==> integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
           (\t. frechet_derivative f
                  (at (w + Cx r * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                  (ii * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)))) = vec 0`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Radial path lemmas for polar coordinates proof                            *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

(* Radial path: r -> w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)  for fixed t0         *)

let HAS_DERIVATIVE_RADIAL_PATH = `!w:complex t0:real r:real^1.
     ((\r. w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)) has_derivative
      (\h. Cx(drop h) * cexp(ii * Cx t0))) (at r)`;;


let HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_F_RADIAL = `!f:complex->complex w t0 r.
     f differentiable at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0))
     ==> ((\r. f(w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)))
          has_vector_derivative
          (frechet_derivative f (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)))
            (cexp(ii * Cx t0))))
         (at r)`;;

(* The radial path is continuous                                             *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_RADIAL_PATH = `!w:complex t0. (\r:real^1. w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0))
                  continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

(* Continuity of f composed with radial path                                 *)
let CONTINUOUS_ON_F_RADIAL = `!f:complex->complex w t0.
     f continuous_on (:complex)
     ==> (\r. f(w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0))) continuous_on
         {r:real^1 | &0 <= drop r}`;;

(* Radial FTC for f on [0, R]                                                *)
let RADIAL_FTC = `!f:complex->complex w t0 R.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     &0 < R
     ==> ((\r. frechet_derivative f
                (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)))
                (cexp(ii * Cx t0)))
          has_integral
          (f(w + Cx R * cexp(ii * Cx t0)) - f(w)))
         (interval[vec 0, lift R])`;;


(* For r > 0, the inner polar integral simplifies:                           *)
(* drop r % (dbar f z / (Cx(drop r) * cexp)) =                               *)
(*   inv(Cx 2) * integral [0,2pi] f'(z)(cexp)                                *)
(* Uses: POLAR_CEXP_SIMPLIFY + WIRTINGER_DBAR_FRECHET_POLAR +                *)
(*       ANGULAR_INTEGRAL_II_ZERO                                            *)

let INNER_INTEGRAL_SIMPLIFY = `!f:complex->complex w r.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     (!h. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on (:complex)) /\
     &0 < drop r
     ==> integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
           (\t. drop r %
                (wirtinger_dbar f (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))) /
                 (Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))) =
         inv(Cx(&2)) *
         integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
           (\t. frechet_derivative f
                  (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                  (cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))`;;

(* For each fixed angle t, the radial integral from 0 to infinity            *)
(* of the radial derivative equals -f(w) (by FTC + compact support).         *)

let RADIAL_INTEGRAL_NEG_FW = `!f:complex->complex w t0.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     bounded (support (+) f (:complex))
     ==> integral {r:real^1 | &0 <= drop r}
           (\r. frechet_derivative f
                  (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx t0)))
                  (cexp(ii * Cx t0))) = --(f w)`;;

(* Helper: in real^1, nonneg and nonzero means positive                      *)
let DROP_POS_OF_NONNEG_NZ = `!r:real^1. &0 <= drop r /\ ~(r = vec 0) ==> &0 < drop r`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Helpers for Fubini swap of polar integrals.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let WIRTINGER_DZ_FRECHET = `!f:complex->complex z.
        wirtinger_dz f z =
        (frechet_derivative f (at z) (Cx(&1)) -
         ii * frechet_derivative f (at z) ii) / Cx(&2)`;;

let WIRTINGER_DZ_CONTINUOUS = `!f:complex->complex s.
        (!h. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on s)
        ==> (\z. wirtinger_dz f z) continuous_on s`;;

let FRECHET_CONTINUOUS_ON_JOINT = `!f:complex->complex (g:real^P->complex) (h:real^P->complex) s.
        f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
        (!e. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) e) continuous_on (:complex)) /\
        g continuous_on s /\
        h continuous_on s
        ==> (\x. frechet_derivative f (at (g x)) (h x)) continuous_on s`;;

let CONTINUOUS_ON_CEXP_SNDCART = `!s. (\z:real^(1,1)finite_sum.
          cexp(ii * Cx(drop(sndcart z)))) continuous_on s`;;

let CONTINUOUS_ON_POLAR_PASTECART = `!w:complex s.
     (\z:real^(1,1)finite_sum.
        w + Cx(drop(fstcart z)) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop(sndcart z))))
     continuous_on s`;;

let FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_OUTSIDE = `!f:real^M->real^N z h R.
    f differentiable_on (:real^M) /\
    (!y. R < norm y ==> f y = vec 0) /\
    R < norm z
    ==> frechet_derivative f (at z) h = vec 0`;;

let ZERO_OUTSIDE_SUPPORT_BALL = `!f:real^M->real^N R.
    (!x. x IN support (+) f (:real^M) ==> norm x <= R)
    ==> (!y. R < norm y ==> f y = vec 0)`;;

let POLAR_POINT_NORM_BOUND = `!w:complex r:real^1 t:real^1 R.
    R + norm w + &1 <= drop r
    ==> R < norm(w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)))`;;

let POLAR_FUBINI_SWAP = `!f:complex->complex w.
     f continuous_on (:complex) /\
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     (!h. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on (:complex)) /\
     bounded (support (+) f (:complex))
     ==>
     integral {r:real^1 | &0 <= drop r}
       (\r. integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
              (\t. frechet_derivative f
                     (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                     (cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))) =
     integral (interval[vec 0, lift(&2 * pi)])
       (\t. integral {r:real^1 | &0 <= drop r}
              (\r. frechet_derivative f
                     (at (w + Cx(drop r) * cexp(ii * Cx(drop t))))
                     (cexp(ii * Cx(drop t)))))`;;

(* Full polar decomposition: converts 2D dbar integral to constant           *)
(* angular integral. Combines FUBINI_POLAR + INNER_INTEGRAL_SIMPLIFY +       *)
(* Fubini swap + RADIAL_INTEGRAL_NEG_FW.                                     *)

let POLAR_INTEGRAL_DECOMPOSITION = `!f:complex->complex w.
     f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
     (!h. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on (:complex)) /\
     bounded (support (+) f (:complex))
     ==> integral (:complex) (\z. wirtinger_dbar f (w + z) / z) =
         inv(Cx(&2)) *
         integral (interval[vec 0:real^1, lift(&2 * pi)]) (\t:real^1. --(f w))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Helper lemmas for the Pompeiu formula.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let INTEGRAL_CONST_2PI = `!c:complex.
     integral (interval[vec 0:real^1, lift(&2 * pi)]) (\t. c) =
     Cx(&2 * pi) * c`;;

let INV_TWO_TIMES_TWO_PI = `inv(Cx(&2)) * Cx(&2 * pi) = Cx(pi)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The Pompeiu formula: Cauchy transform inverts dbar.                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let CAUCHY_TRANSFORM_INVERTS_DBAR = `!f:complex->complex w.
        f differentiable_on (:complex) /\
        (!h. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on (:complex)) /\
        bounded (support (+) f (:complex))
        ==> integral (:complex)
              (\z. wirtinger_dbar f z / (z - w)) = --(Cx pi * f w)`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Hermite cutoff infrastructure for smooth extension.                       *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let PIECEWISE_HAS_DERIVATIVE_LOCAL = `!(f:real^M->real^N) g ef f' z d0.
    &0 < d0 /\
    (f has_derivative f') (at z) /\
    (g has_derivative f') (at z) /\
    f z = g z /\
    (!y:real^M. norm(y - z) < d0 ==> ef y = f y \/ ef y = g y) /\
    ef z = f z
    ==> (ef has_derivative f') (at z)`;;

let PIECEWISE_HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_LOCAL = `!f g ef f' x d0.
    &0 < d0 /\
    (f has_real_derivative f') (atreal x) /\
    (g has_real_derivative f') (atreal x) /\
    f x = g x /\
    (!y. abs(y - x) < d0 ==> ef y = f y \/ ef y = g y) /\
    ef x = f x
    ==> (ef has_real_derivative f') (atreal x)`;;

let hermite_cutoff = new_definition
 `hermite_cutoff (t:real) =
    if t <= &0 then &1
    else if &1 <= t then &0
    else &2 * t pow 3 - &3 * t pow 2 + &1`;;

let hermite_cutoff_deriv = new_definition
 `hermite_cutoff_deriv (t:real) =
    if t <= &0 then &0
    else if &1 <= t then &0
    else &6 * t pow 2 - &6 * t`;;


let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_INTERIOR = `!t. &0 < t /\ t < &1
       ==> (hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative (&6 * t pow 2 - &6 * t))
           (atreal t)`;;

let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_LEFT = `!t. t < &0
       ==> (hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative (&0)) (atreal t)`;;

let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_RIGHT = `!t. &1 < t
       ==> (hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative (&0)) (atreal t)`;;

let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_AT_0 = `(hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative (&0)) (atreal (&0))`;;

let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_AT_1 = `(hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative (&0)) (atreal (&1))`;;

let HAS_REAL_DERIVATIVE_HERMITE_EXPLICIT = `!t. (hermite_cutoff has_real_derivative hermite_cutoff_deriv t) (atreal t)`;;

let POLY_CONTINUOUS_REAL1 = `(\x:real^1. lift(&6 * drop x pow 2 - &6 * drop x)) continuous_on s`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_DERIV_CONTINUOUS = `(lift o hermite_cutoff_deriv o drop) continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_DIFFERENTIABLE = `!x:real^1. (lift o hermite_cutoff o drop) differentiable (at x)`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_DIFFERENTIABLE_ON = `!s. (lift o hermite_cutoff o drop) differentiable_on s`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_CONTINUOUS = `(lift o hermite_cutoff o drop) continuous_on (:real^1)`;;

(* Chain rule for hermite_cutoff composed with phi(z) = (norm z^2 - R^2)/c   *)
let HERMITE_CUTOFF_CHI_HAS_DERIVATIVE = `!R c (z:complex).
     &0 < c
     ==> ((\z'. lift(hermite_cutoff((norm z' pow 2 - R pow 2) / c)))
          has_derivative
          (\h:complex. lift(hermite_cutoff_deriv((norm z pow 2 - R pow 2) / c) *
                            (&2 * (z dot h)) / c))) (at z)`;;

(* Helper lemmas for continuity of composed functions                        *)
let HERMITE_CUTOFF_LE_0 = `!t. t <= &0 ==> hermite_cutoff t = &1`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_GE_1 = `!t. &1 <= t ==> hermite_cutoff t = &0`;;

let HERMITE_CUTOFF_NONNEG = `!t. &0 <= hermite_cutoff t`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* C^1 extension from open sets: weaken f differentiable_on (:complex) to    *)
(* f differentiable_on u for an open set u containing the compact set K.     *)
(* Approach: cover K by finitely many balls inside u, build C^1 ball bumps,  *)
(* sum them, compose with hermite_cutoff to get a C^1 cutoff chi = 1 on K    *)
(* with support inside u, then ef = chi * f extends to all of C.             *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

(* Shifted version: derivative of hermite_cutoff((|w-a|^2 - R^2)/c)          *)
let HERMITE_CUTOFF_SHIFTED_HAS_DERIVATIVE = `!a:complex R c (z:complex).
     &0 < c
     ==> ((\w. lift(hermite_cutoff((norm(w - a) pow 2 - R pow 2) / c)))
          has_derivative
          (\h:complex. lift(hermite_cutoff_deriv
               ((norm(z - a) pow 2 - R pow 2) / c) *
               (&2 * ((z - a) dot h)) / c))) (at z)`;;

(* Continuity of shifted phi                                                 *)
let PHI_SHIFTED_CONTINUOUS_ON = `!a:complex c R s. &0 < c ==>
    (\z. lift((norm(z - a) pow 2 - R pow 2) / c)) continuous_on s`;;

(* Continuity of hcd(shifted phi) and hc(shifted phi)                        *)
let HCD_SHIFTED_CONTINUOUS_ON = `!a:complex c R s. &0 < c ==>
    (\z. lift(hermite_cutoff_deriv((norm(z - a) pow 2 - R pow 2) / c)))
    continuous_on s`;;

let HC_SHIFTED_CONTINUOUS_ON = `!a:complex c R s. &0 < c ==>
    (\z. lift(hermite_cutoff((norm(z - a) pow 2 - R pow 2) / c)))
    continuous_on s`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* C^1 extension from open sets.                                             *)
(* Given compact K in open u, extend C^1 function on u to C^1 on all of C    *)
(* with compact support inside u. Uses finite ball cover + hermite cutoff.   *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let SMOOTH_EXTENSION_FROM_OPEN = `!f:complex->complex u (K:complex->bool).
    compact K /\ open u /\ K SUBSET u /\
    f differentiable_on u /\
    (!h:complex. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on u)
    ==> ?ef:complex->complex.
        ef differentiable_on (:complex) /\
        (!h:complex. (\z. frechet_derivative ef (at z) h)
          continuous_on (:complex)) /\
        bounded(support (+) ef (:complex)) /\
        (!z. z IN K ==> ef z = f z)`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Product-space absolute integrability for the Cauchy kernel integrand.     *)
(* Factored out from FUBINI_PATH_AREA to expose integrability separately.    *)
(* Does NOT need simple_path or pathfinish = pathstart.                      *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CAUCHY_PATH_PRODUCT = `!u:complex->complex g:real^1->complex.
        u continuous_on (:complex) /\
        bounded (support (+) u (:complex)) /\
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1]
        ==> (\p:real^(1,2)finite_sum.
                if fstcart p IN interval[vec 0,vec 1]
                then u(sndcart p) / (sndcart p - g(fstcart p)) *
                     vector_derivative g (at (fstcart p))
                else vec 0)
            absolutely_integrable_on (:real^(1,2)finite_sum)`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Integrability of winding_number * dbar f without simple_path.             *)
(* Derived from the Fubini product-space integrability via:                  *)
(*   Fubini abs integ -> has_integral -> integrable ->                       *)
(*   INTEGRABLE_SPIKE -> INTEGRABLE_COMPLEX_LMUL_EQ                          *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let INTEGRABLE_WINDING_DBAR_PRODUCT = `!f:complex->complex g:real^1->complex.
        (\z. wirtinger_dbar f z) continuous_on (:complex) /\
        bounded (support (+) (wirtinger_dbar f) (:complex)) /\
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> (\z. Cx(Re(winding_number(g,z))) *
              wirtinger_dbar f z) integrable_on (:complex)`;;

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Most general Gauss-Green formula: no simple_path, local C^1.              *)
(* Uses smooth extension + Cauchy transform + Fubini.                        *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

let COMPLEX_GREEN_ALT = `!f:complex->complex g u.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        open u /\
        inside(path_image g) UNION path_image g SUBSET u /\
        f differentiable_on u /\
        (!h:complex. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on u)
        ==> (\z. Cx(Re(winding_number(g,z))) *
                 wirtinger_dbar f z) integrable_on (:complex) /\
            f path_integrable_on g /\
            Cx(inv(&2)) / ii * path_integral g f =
            integral (:complex)
              (\z. Cx(Re(winding_number(g,z))) *
                   wirtinger_dbar f z)`;;

(* Relational form: replaces Cx(Re(winding_number)) with winding_number      *)
(* (they agree a.e. since winding_number is integer off path_image g).       *)
let COMPLEX_GREEN = `!f:complex->complex g u.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        open u /\
        inside(path_image g) UNION path_image g SUBSET u /\
        f differentiable_on u /\
        (!h:complex. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on u)
        ==> (\z. winding_number(g,z) * wirtinger_dbar f z)
            integrable_on (:complex) /\
            f path_integrable_on g /\
            path_integral g f =
            Cx(&2) * ii *
            integral (:complex)
                     (\z. winding_number(g,z) * wirtinger_dbar f z)`;;

(* Path integral of cnj for absolutely continuous closed curves.              *)
(* General form: path_integral = Cx(&2)*ii * integral_inside(wn).            *)
let HAS_PATH_INTEGRAL_CNJ = `!g:real^1->complex.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> cnj path_integrable_on g /\
            path_integral g cnj =
            Cx(&2) * ii *
            integral (inside(path_image g))
                     (\z. winding_number(g,z))`;;

(* Gauss-Green for cnj: integral of wirtinger_dbar cnj = 1 gives area.       *)
let COMPLEX_GREEN_CNJ = `!g. g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
       pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
       (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1))
       ==> (cnj has_path_integral
            Cx(&2) * ii * Cx(measure(inside(path_image g)))) g`;;

(* Cauchy's theorem for identity (no wn hypothesis, closed path only).       *)
let HAS_PATH_INTEGRAL_I_CLOSED = `!g:real^1->complex.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> (I has_path_integral Cx(&0)) g`;;

(* Cauchy's theorem for the identity: wirtinger_dbar I = 0.                  *)
(* Trivial corollary of HAS_PATH_INTEGRAL_I_CLOSED (extra wn hyp unused).   *)
let COMPLEX_GREEN_I = `!g. g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
       pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
       (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1))
       ==> (I has_path_integral Cx(&0)) g`;;

(* Complex area formula: measure of inside from path integral of cnj.        *)
let COMPLEX_GREEN_AREA = `!g. g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
       pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
       (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1))
       ==> cnj path_integrable_on g /\
           Cx(measure(inside(path_image g))) =
           --ii / Cx(&2) * path_integral g cnj`;;

(* Orientation-free complex area formula for simple closed curves.           *)
(* Uses COMPLEX_GREEN_INSIDE and case split on wn=+1/-1.                     *)
let COMPLEX_GREEN_AREA_ABS = `!g:real^1->complex.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> cnj path_integrable_on g /\
            measure(inside(path_image g)) =
            norm(path_integral g cnj) / &2`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Real Green's theorem (curl form) and real area formulas.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Green's theorem in classical curl form:                                   *)
(*   integral(f2 dx + f1 dy) = integral(df1/dx - df2/dy) dA                  *)
(* Expands wirtinger_dbar integral into explicit partial derivatives.        *)
(* Statement uses real^2, basis 1, basis 2 to avoid complex paraphernalia.   *)
(* Helper lemmas (green_theorem_real, wirtinger_dbar_2i_im, linearity)       *)
(* are localized inside the proof.                                           *)
let GREEN_THEOREM_CURL = `!f:real^2->real^2 g u.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1)) /\
        open u /\
        inside(path_image g) UNION path_image g SUBSET u /\
        f differentiable_on u /\
        (!h:real^2. (\z. frechet_derivative f (at z) h) continuous_on u)
        ==> (\z. lift(frechet_derivative f (at z) (basis 1) $1 -
                      frechet_derivative f (at z) (basis 2) $2))
            integrable_on inside(path_image g) /\
            (\t. lift(f(g t)$2 * vector_derivative g (at t) $1 +
                      f(g t)$1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2))
            integrable_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
            integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
              (\t. lift(f(g t)$2 * vector_derivative g (at t) $1 +
                        f(g t)$1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2)) =
            integral (inside(path_image g))
              (\z. lift(frechet_derivative f (at z) (basis 1) $1 -
                        frechet_derivative f (at z) (basis 2) $2))`;;

(* De-complexified area formula: integral of x*dy = area (x*y' form).        *)
let GREEN_AREA = `!g. g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
       pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
       (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1))
       ==> (\t. lift(g t $1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2))
           integrable_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
           integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
             (\t. lift(g t $1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2)) =
           lift(measure(inside(path_image g)))`;;

(* De-complexified area formula: integral of y*dx = -area (x'*y form).       *)
let GREEN_AREA_ALT = `!g. g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
       pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
       (!z. z IN inside(path_image g) ==> winding_number(g,z) = Cx(&1))
       ==> (\t. lift(vector_derivative g (at t) $1 * g t $2))
           integrable_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
           integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
             (\t. lift(vector_derivative g (at t) $1 * g t $2)) =
           --lift(measure(inside(path_image g)))`;;

(* Orientation-free real area formula: x*dy form.                            *)
(* For wn=+1 uses GREEN_AREA; for wn=-1 derives from componentwise           *)
(* extraction of cnj and I path integrals.                                   *)
let GREEN_AREA_ABS = `!g:real^1->complex.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> (\t. lift(g t $1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2))
            integrable_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
            norm(integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
              (\t. lift(g t $1 * vector_derivative g (at t) $2))) =
            measure(inside(path_image g))`;;

(* Orientation-free real area formula: y*dx form.                            *)
let GREEN_AREA_ABS_ALT = `!g:real^1->complex.
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> (\t. lift(vector_derivative g (at t) $1 * g t $2))
            integrable_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
            norm(integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
              (\t. lift(vector_derivative g (at t) $1 * g t $2))) =
            measure(inside(path_image g))`;;

title: 021_green_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__021, "Green's Theorem": a C1 planar vector field
;; has circulation around a closed absolutely continuous path equal to the
;; integral of its scalar curl over the winding-number-one interior. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the real numbers as a Dedekind-complete
;; ordered field. Paths, fields, sets, and gauges are arbitrary tame APPLY$
;; functions, not finite tables.

(defun ht021-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun ht021-unary (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun ht021-binary (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk ht021-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
          (ht021-member-p carrier y)
          (ht021-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-binary add x y))
      (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-binary multiply x y))
      (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-unary negate x))
      (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-unary inverse x))
      (equal (ht021-binary add (ht021-binary add x y) z)
             (ht021-binary add x (ht021-binary add y z)))
      (equal (ht021-binary add x y) (ht021-binary add y x))
      (equal (ht021-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht021-binary add x (ht021-unary negate x)) zero)
      (equal
       (ht021-binary multiply (ht021-binary multiply x y) z)
       (ht021-binary multiply x (ht021-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (ht021-binary multiply x y)
             (ht021-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (ht021-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies (equal x zero)
               (equal (ht021-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (ht021-binary multiply x (ht021-unary inverse x)) one))
      (equal
       (ht021-binary multiply x (ht021-binary add y z))
       (ht021-binary
        add
        (ht021-binary multiply x y)
        (ht021-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk ht021-order-laws-p (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
          (ht021-member-p carrier y)
          (ht021-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (ht021-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (ht021-binary less x y)
          (ht021-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (ht021-binary less x y)
            (ht021-binary less y z))
       (ht021-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (ht021-binary less x y)
       (ht021-binary
        less (ht021-binary add x z) (ht021-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (ht021-binary less zero x)
            (ht021-binary less zero y))
       (ht021-binary less zero (ht021-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk ht021-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk ht021-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (ht021-binary less bound x)))))

(defun-sk ht021-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (ht021-member-p carrier bound)
         (ht021-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk ht021-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (ht021-member-p carrier supremum)
     (ht021-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (ht021-member-p carrier bound)
           (ht021-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (not (ht021-binary less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk ht021-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (ht021-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht021-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (ht021-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (ht021-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (ht021-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun ht021-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (ht021-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht021-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht021-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (ht021-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (ht021-binary less zero one)
   (ht021-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun ht021-add (add x y)
  (ht021-binary add x y))

(defun ht021-neg (negate x)
  (ht021-unary negate x))

(defun ht021-sub (add negate x y)
  (ht021-add add x (ht021-neg negate y)))

(defun ht021-mul (multiply x y)
  (ht021-binary multiply x y))

(defun ht021-inv (inverse x)
  (ht021-unary inverse x))

(defun ht021-less-p (less x y)
  (if (ht021-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun ht021-leq-p (less x y)
  (not (ht021-less-p less y x)))

(defun ht021-abs (less negate zero x)
  (if (ht021-less-p less x zero)
      (ht021-neg negate x)
    x))

(defun ht021-max (less x y)
  (if (ht021-less-p less x y) y x))

(defun ht021-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
       (ht021-less-p less zero x)))

(defun ht021-two (add one)
  (ht021-add add one one))

(defun ht021-four (add one)
  (ht021-two add (ht021-two add one)))

(defun ht021-square (multiply x)
  (ht021-mul multiply x x))

(defun ht021-plane-distance
    (add negate less zero x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (ht021-max
   less
   (ht021-abs less negate zero (ht021-sub add negate x1 x2))
   (ht021-abs less negate zero (ht021-sub add negate y1 y2))))

(defun-sk ht021-unary-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ht021-member-p carrier x)
     (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-unary function x)))))

(defun-sk ht021-binary-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
          (ht021-member-p carrier y))
     (ht021-member-p carrier (ht021-binary function x y)))))

(defun ht021-valid-unary-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (ht021-unary-real-function-p carrier function)))

(defun ht021-valid-binary-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (ht021-binary-real-function-p carrier function)))

(defun ht021-in-interval-p (less a b x)
  (and (ht021-leq-p less a x)
       (ht021-leq-p less x b)))

;; Absolute continuity is the standard finite disjoint-interval definition.

(defun ht021-interval-family-p (carrier less zero one intervals previous)
  (if (consp intervals)
      (let* ((entry (car intervals))
             (left (car entry))
             (right (cadr entry)))
        (and
         (true-listp entry)
         (equal (len entry) 2)
         (ht021-member-p carrier left)
         (ht021-member-p carrier right)
         (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one left)
         (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one right)
         (ht021-leq-p less previous left)
         (ht021-less-p less left right)
         (ht021-interval-family-p
          carrier less zero one (cdr intervals) right)))
    (equal intervals nil)))

(defun ht021-interval-length-sum (add negate zero intervals)
  (if (consp intervals)
      (ht021-add
       add
       (ht021-sub add negate (cadar intervals) (caar intervals))
       (ht021-interval-length-sum add negate zero (cdr intervals)))
    zero))

(defun ht021-path-variation-sum
    (add negate less zero gx gy intervals)
  (if (consp intervals)
      (let* ((left (caar intervals))
             (right (cadar intervals))
             (dx (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gx right)
                  (ht021-unary gx left)))
             (dy (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gy right)
                  (ht021-unary gy left))))
        (ht021-add
         add
         (ht021-max less
                    (ht021-abs less negate zero dx)
                    (ht021-abs less negate zero dy))
         (ht021-path-variation-sum
          add negate less zero gx gy (cdr intervals))))
    zero))

(defun-sk ht021-ac-delta-p
    (carrier gx gy add negate zero one less epsilon delta)
  (forall (intervals)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-interval-family-p
       carrier less zero one intervals zero)
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-interval-length-sum add negate zero intervals)
       delta))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-path-variation-sum
       add negate less zero gx gy intervals)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-ac-radius-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy add negate zero one less epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (ht021-ac-delta-p
      carrier gx gy add negate zero one less epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk ht021-absolutely-continuous-path-p
    (carrier gx gy add negate zero one less)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-ac-radius-exists-p
      carrier gx gy add negate zero one less epsilon))))

(defun ht021-closed-path-p (gx gy zero one)
  (and (equal (ht021-unary gx zero) (ht021-unary gx one))
       (equal (ht021-unary gy zero) (ht021-unary gy one))))

(defun-sk ht021-path-hits-point-p (gx gy zero one less x y)
  (exists (t0)
    (and
     (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one t0)
     (equal (ht021-unary gx t0) x)
     (equal (ht021-unary gy t0) y))))

;; Tagged divisions and gauge Riemann--Stieltjes sums.

(defun ht021-tagged-division-from-p
    (carrier less current finish entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let* ((entry (car entries))
             (left (car entry))
             (right (cadr entry))
             (tag (caddr entry)))
        (and
         (true-listp entry)
         (equal (len entry) 3)
         (equal left current)
         (ht021-member-p carrier right)
         (ht021-member-p carrier tag)
         (ht021-less-p less left right)
         (ht021-in-interval-p less left right tag)
         (ht021-tagged-division-from-p
          carrier less right finish (cdr entries))))
    (and (equal entries nil)
         (equal current finish))))

(defun ht021-tagged-division-p
    (carrier less start finish entries)
  (and
   (ht021-member-p carrier start)
   (ht021-member-p carrier finish)
   (ht021-tagged-division-from-p
    carrier less start finish entries)))

(defun-sk ht021-gauge-positive-on-p
    (carrier gauge less zero start finish)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (ht021-member-p carrier x)
          (ht021-in-interval-p less start finish x))
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero (ht021-unary gauge x)))))

(defun ht021-positive-gauge-on-p
    (carrier gauge less zero start finish)
  (and
   (ht021-valid-unary-function-p carrier gauge)
   (ht021-gauge-positive-on-p
    carrier gauge less zero start finish)))

(defun ht021-fine-tagged-division-p
    (add negate less gauge entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (ht021-less-p
        less
        (ht021-sub add negate (cadar entries) (caar entries))
        (ht021-unary gauge (caddar entries)))
       (ht021-fine-tagged-division-p
        add negate less gauge (cdr entries)))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun ht021-circulation-sum
    (add multiply negate zero p q gx gy entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let* ((entry (car entries))
             (left (car entry))
             (right (cadr entry))
             (tag (caddr entry))
             (x (ht021-unary gx tag))
             (y (ht021-unary gy tag))
             (dx (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gx right)
                  (ht021-unary gx left)))
             (dy (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gy right)
                  (ht021-unary gy left))))
        (ht021-add
         add
         (ht021-add
          add
          (ht021-mul multiply (ht021-binary p x y) dx)
          (ht021-mul multiply (ht021-binary q x y) dy))
         (ht021-circulation-sum
          add multiply negate zero p q gx gy (cdr entries))))
    zero))

(defun-sk ht021-circulation-close-for-gauge-p
    (carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less
             value epsilon gauge)
  (forall (entries)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-tagged-division-p carrier less zero one entries)
      (ht021-fine-tagged-division-p add negate less gauge entries))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht021-sub
        add negate
        (ht021-circulation-sum
         add multiply negate zero p q gx gy entries)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-circulation-gauge-exists-p
    (carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less value epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp gauge)
     (ht021-positive-gauge-on-p
      carrier gauge less zero zero one)
     (ht021-circulation-close-for-gauge-p
      carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less
      value epsilon gauge))))

(defun-sk ht021-has-circulation-integral-p
    (carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-circulation-gauge-exists-p
      carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less
      value epsilon))))

;; Pi is the gauge integral of 4/(1+x^2) on [0,1].

(defun ht021-pi-riemann-sum
    (add multiply negate inverse zero one entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let* ((left (caar entries))
             (right (cadar entries))
             (tag (caddar entries))
             (four (ht021-four add one))
             (denominator
              (ht021-add add one (ht021-square multiply tag)))
             (value
              (ht021-mul multiply four (ht021-inv inverse denominator)))
             (width (ht021-sub add negate right left)))
        (ht021-add
         add
         (ht021-mul multiply value width)
         (ht021-pi-riemann-sum
          add multiply negate inverse zero one (cdr entries))))
    zero))

(defun-sk ht021-pi-close-for-gauge-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             pi-value epsilon gauge)
  (forall (entries)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-tagged-division-p carrier less zero one entries)
      (ht021-fine-tagged-division-p add negate less gauge entries))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht021-sub
        add negate
        (ht021-pi-riemann-sum
         add multiply negate inverse zero one entries)
        pi-value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-pi-gauge-exists-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp gauge)
     (ht021-positive-gauge-on-p
      carrier gauge less zero zero one)
     (ht021-pi-close-for-gauge-p
      carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      pi-value epsilon gauge))))

(defun-sk ht021-pi-limit-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-pi-gauge-exists-p
      carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value epsilon))))

(defun ht021-pi-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
  (and
   (ht021-member-p carrier pi-value)
   (ht021-pi-limit-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)))

;; Winding number one is the exact Riemann--Stieltjes identity
;; integral (-(g_y-y)/r^2) d g_x + ((g_x-x)/r^2) d g_y = 2*pi-value.

(defun ht021-winding-sum
    (add multiply negate inverse zero gx gy x y entries)
  (if (consp entries)
      (let* ((left (caar entries))
             (right (cadar entries))
             (tag (caddar entries))
             (rx (ht021-sub add negate (ht021-unary gx tag) x))
             (ry (ht021-sub add negate (ht021-unary gy tag) y))
             (radius-square
              (ht021-add
               add
               (ht021-square multiply rx)
               (ht021-square multiply ry)))
             (reciprocal (ht021-inv inverse radius-square))
             (dx (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gx right)
                  (ht021-unary gx left)))
             (dy (ht021-sub
                  add negate
                  (ht021-unary gy right)
                  (ht021-unary gy left))))
        (ht021-add
         add
         (ht021-add
          add
          (ht021-mul
           multiply
           (ht021-neg
            negate (ht021-mul multiply ry reciprocal))
           dx)
          (ht021-mul
           multiply
           (ht021-mul multiply rx reciprocal)
           dy))
         (ht021-winding-sum
          add multiply negate inverse zero gx gy x y (cdr entries))))
    zero))

(defun-sk ht021-winding-close-for-gauge-p
    (carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             value epsilon gauge)
  (forall (entries)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-tagged-division-p carrier less zero one entries)
      (ht021-fine-tagged-division-p add negate less gauge entries))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht021-sub
        add negate
        (ht021-winding-sum
         add multiply negate inverse zero gx gy x y entries)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-winding-gauge-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             value epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp gauge)
     (ht021-positive-gauge-on-p
      carrier gauge less zero zero one)
     (ht021-winding-close-for-gauge-p
      carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      value epsilon gauge))))

(defun-sk ht021-has-winding-integral-p
    (carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-winding-gauge-exists-p
      carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      value epsilon))))

(defun ht021-winding-one-p
    (carrier gx gy x y pi-value add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (let ((two-pi (ht021-mul multiply (ht021-two add one) pi-value)))
    (and
     (ht021-member-p carrier x)
     (ht021-member-p carrier y)
     (not (ht021-path-hits-point-p gx gy zero one less x y))
     (ht021-has-winding-integral-p
      carrier gx gy x y add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      two-pi))))

;; The HOL source's INSIDE(path_image g) is the union of the bounded
;; components of the complement. For a compact planar path image, a
;; complementary point is in the unbounded component exactly when it can be
;; joined through the complement to a point outside a square containing the
;; image. The following definitions therefore express, without an opaque
;; region parameter, the source assumption that winding number is one at
;; every point of INSIDE(path_image g).

(defun-sk ht021-path-image-in-square-p
    (carrier gx gy zero one less negate bound)
  (forall (parameter)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one parameter))
     (and
      (ht021-leq-p
       less
       (ht021-abs
        less negate zero (ht021-unary gx parameter))
       bound)
      (ht021-leq-p
       less
       (ht021-abs
        less negate zero (ht021-unary gy parameter))
       bound)))))

(defun-sk ht021-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier hx hy add negate zero one less
             parameter epsilon delta)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier other)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one other)
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-abs
        less negate zero
        (ht021-sub add negate other parameter))
       delta))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-plane-distance
       add negate less zero
       (ht021-unary hx other)
       (ht021-unary hy other)
       (ht021-unary hx parameter)
       (ht021-unary hy parameter))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier hx hy add negate zero one less parameter epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (ht021-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier hx hy add negate zero one less
      parameter epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk ht021-continuous-planar-path-p
    (carrier hx hy add negate zero one less)
  (forall (parameter epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one parameter)
      (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (ht021-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier hx hy add negate zero one less parameter epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-connector-avoids-image-p
    (carrier gx gy hx hy zero one less)
  (forall (parameter)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less zero one parameter))
     (not
      (ht021-path-hits-point-p
       gx gy zero one less
       (ht021-unary hx parameter)
       (ht021-unary hy parameter))))))

(defun ht021-outside-connector-p
    (carrier gx gy hx hy x y bound
             add negate zero one less)
  (and
   (ht021-valid-unary-function-p carrier hx)
   (ht021-valid-unary-function-p carrier hy)
   (ht021-continuous-planar-path-p
    carrier hx hy add negate zero one less)
   (equal (ht021-unary hx zero) x)
   (equal (ht021-unary hy zero) y)
   (or
    (ht021-less-p
     less bound
     (ht021-abs less negate zero (ht021-unary hx one)))
    (ht021-less-p
     less bound
     (ht021-abs less negate zero (ht021-unary hy one))))
   (ht021-connector-avoids-image-p
    carrier gx gy hx hy zero one less)))

(defun-sk ht021-outside-connector-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy x y bound add negate zero one less)
  (exists (hx hy)
    (ht021-outside-connector-p
     carrier gx gy hx hy x y bound
     add negate zero one less)))

(defun-sk ht021-complement-classified-at-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value bound
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (not (ht021-path-hits-point-p gx gy zero one less x y)))
     (or
      (ht021-winding-one-p
       carrier gx gy x y pi-value
       add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
      (ht021-outside-connector-exists-p
       carrier gx gy x y bound add negate zero one less)))))

(defun-sk ht021-positive-interior-orientation-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero bound)
     (ht021-path-image-in-square-p
      carrier gx gy zero one less negate bound)
     (ht021-complement-classified-at-bound-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value bound
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less))))

;; Open neighborhood and local C1 hypotheses.

(defun-sk ht021-open-ball-contained-p
    (carrier neighborhood add negate zero less x y radius)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier u)
      (ht021-member-p carrier v)
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-plane-distance add negate less zero x y u v)
       radius))
     (apply$ neighborhood (list u v)))))

(defun-sk ht021-open-radius-exists-p
    (carrier neighborhood add negate zero less x y)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero radius)
     (ht021-open-ball-contained-p
      carrier neighborhood add negate zero less x y radius))))

(defun-sk ht021-open-set-p
    (carrier neighborhood add negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$ neighborhood (list x y)))
     (ht021-open-radius-exists-p
      carrier neighborhood add negate zero less x y))))

(defun-sk ht021-neighborhood-contains-relevant-p
    (carrier neighborhood gx gy pi-value
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (or
       (ht021-path-hits-point-p gx gy zero one less x y)
       (ht021-winding-one-p
        carrier gx gy x y pi-value
        add multiply negate inverse zero one less)))
     (apply$ neighborhood (list x y)))))

(defun ht021-derivative-residual
    (function x-derivative y-derivative
              add multiply negate x y dx dy)
  (ht021-sub
   add negate
   (ht021-sub
    add negate
    (ht021-binary
     function (ht021-add add x dx) (ht021-add add y dy))
    (ht021-binary function x y))
   (ht021-add
    add
    (ht021-mul multiply (ht021-binary x-derivative x y) dx)
    (ht021-mul multiply (ht021-binary y-derivative x y) dy))))

(defun-sk ht021-frechet-neighborhood-p
    (carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
             add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (dx dy)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier dx)
      (ht021-member-p carrier dy)
      (apply$ neighborhood
              (list (ht021-add add x dx) (ht021-add add y dy)))
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-plane-distance add negate less zero zero zero dx dy)
       delta))
     (ht021-leq-p
      less
      (ht021-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht021-derivative-residual
        function x-derivative y-derivative
        add multiply negate x y dx dy))
      (ht021-mul
       multiply epsilon
       (ht021-plane-distance
        add negate less zero zero zero dx dy))))))

(defun-sk ht021-frechet-radius-exists-p
    (carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
             add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (ht021-frechet-neighborhood-p
      carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk ht021-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
    (carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
             add multiply negate zero less x y)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-frechet-radius-exists-p
      carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-differentiable-on-p
    (carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
             add multiply negate zero less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$ neighborhood (list x y)))
     (ht021-has-frechet-derivative-at-p
      carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
      add multiply negate zero less x y))))

(defun-sk ht021-derivative-continuous-neighborhood-p
    (carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
             add negate zero less x y epsilon delta)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier u)
      (ht021-member-p carrier v)
      (apply$ neighborhood (list u v))
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-plane-distance add negate less zero x y u v)
       delta))
     (and
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-abs
        less negate zero
        (ht021-sub
         add negate
         (ht021-binary x-derivative u v)
         (ht021-binary x-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)
      (ht021-less-p
       less
       (ht021-abs
        less negate zero
        (ht021-sub
         add negate
         (ht021-binary y-derivative u v)
         (ht021-binary y-derivative x y)))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk ht021-derivative-continuity-radius-p
    (carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
             add negate zero less x y epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (ht021-derivative-continuous-neighborhood-p
      carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk ht021-derivative-pair-continuous-on-p
    (carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
             add negate zero less)
  (forall (x y epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (apply$ neighborhood (list x y))
      (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (ht021-derivative-continuity-radius-p
      carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
      add negate zero less x y epsilon))))

(defun ht021-c1-on-p
    (carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
             add multiply negate zero less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp x-derivative)
   (tamep-functionp y-derivative)
   (ht021-valid-binary-function-p carrier x-derivative)
   (ht021-valid-binary-function-p carrier y-derivative)
   (ht021-differentiable-on-p
    carrier neighborhood function x-derivative y-derivative
    add multiply negate zero less)
   (ht021-derivative-pair-continuous-on-p
    carrier neighborhood x-derivative y-derivative
    add negate zero less)))

(defun-sk ht021-field-c1-witness-p
    (carrier neighborhood p q add multiply negate zero less)
  (exists (p-x p-y q-x q-y)
    (and
     (ht021-c1-on-p
      carrier neighborhood p p-x p-y
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (ht021-c1-on-p
      carrier neighborhood q q-x q-y
      add multiply negate zero less))))

;; Two-dimensional gauge integration over a square containing the
;; winding-one region. Every rectangular cell has an arbitrary tag.

(defun ht021-division-from-p (carrier less current finish cells)
  (if (consp cells)
      (let* ((cell (car cells))
             (left (car cell))
             (right (cadr cell)))
        (and
         (true-listp cell)
         (equal (len cell) 2)
         (equal left current)
         (ht021-member-p carrier right)
         (ht021-less-p less left right)
         (ht021-division-from-p
          carrier less right finish (cdr cells))))
    (and (equal cells nil)
         (equal current finish))))

(defun ht021-division-p (carrier less start finish cells)
  (ht021-division-from-p carrier less start finish cells))

(defun ht021-tags-fit-row-p (carrier less xcell ycells tags)
  (if (consp ycells)
      (and
       (consp tags)
       (true-listp (car tags))
       (equal (len (car tags)) 2)
       (ht021-member-p carrier (caar tags))
       (ht021-member-p carrier (cadar tags))
       (ht021-in-interval-p
        less (car xcell) (cadr xcell) (caar tags))
       (ht021-in-interval-p
        less (caar ycells) (cadar ycells) (cadar tags))
       (ht021-tags-fit-row-p
        carrier less xcell (cdr ycells) (cdr tags)))
    (equal tags nil)))

(defun ht021-tags-fit-grid-p
    (carrier less xcells ycells tags)
  (if (consp xcells)
      (and
       (consp tags)
       (ht021-tags-fit-row-p
        carrier less (car xcells) ycells (car tags))
       (ht021-tags-fit-grid-p
        carrier less (cdr xcells) ycells (cdr tags)))
    (equal tags nil)))

(defun-sk ht021-bivariate-gauge-positive-on-square-p
    (carrier gauge negate less zero bound)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-member-p carrier x)
      (ht021-member-p carrier y)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less (ht021-neg negate bound) bound x)
      (ht021-in-interval-p less (ht021-neg negate bound) bound y))
     (ht021-positive-p
      carrier less zero (ht021-binary gauge x y)))))

(defun ht021-grid-fine-row-p
    (add negate less gauge xcell ycells tags)
  (if (consp ycells)
      (let* ((ycell (car ycells))
             (tag (car tags))
             (xwidth
              (ht021-sub add negate (cadr xcell) (car xcell)))
             (ywidth
              (ht021-sub add negate (cadr ycell) (car ycell)))
             (mesh (ht021-max less xwidth ywidth))
             (radius (ht021-binary gauge (car tag) (cadr tag))))
        (and
         (ht021-less-p less mesh radius)
         (ht021-grid-fine-row-p
          add negate less gauge xcell (cdr ycells) (cdr tags))))
    t))

(defun ht021-grid-fine-p
    (add negate less gauge xcells ycells tags)
  (if (consp xcells)
      (and
       (ht021-grid-fine-row-p
        add negate less gauge (car xcells) ycells (car tags))
       (ht021-grid-fine-p
        add negate less gauge (cdr xcells) ycells (cdr tags)))
    t))

(defun ht021-curl-at (add negate p-y q-x x y)
  (ht021-sub
   add negate
   (ht021-binary q-x x y)
   (ht021-binary p-y x y)))

(defun ht021-region-sum-row
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             xcell ycells tags)
  (if (consp ycells)
      (let* ((ycell (car ycells))
             (tag (car tags))
             (x (car tag))
             (y (cadr tag))
             (xwidth
              (ht021-sub add negate (cadr xcell) (car xcell)))
             (ywidth
              (ht021-sub add negate (cadr ycell) (car ycell)))
             (area (ht021-mul multiply xwidth ywidth))
             (value
              (if
                  (ht021-winding-one-p
                   carrier gx gy x y pi-value
                   add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
                  (ht021-curl-at add negate p-y q-x x y)
                zero)))
        (ht021-add
         add
         (ht021-mul multiply value area)
         (ht021-region-sum-row
          carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
          add multiply negate inverse zero one less
          xcell (cdr ycells) (cdr tags))))
    zero))

(defun ht021-region-sum
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             xcells ycells tags)
  (if (consp xcells)
      (ht021-add
       add
       (ht021-region-sum-row
        carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
        add multiply negate inverse zero one less
        (car xcells) ycells (car tags))
       (ht021-region-sum
        carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
        add multiply negate inverse zero one less
        (cdr xcells) ycells (cdr tags)))
    zero))

(defun-sk ht021-region-contained-in-square-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value add multiply negate inverse zero one less bound)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (ht021-winding-one-p
      carrier gx gy x y pi-value
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
     (and
      (ht021-leq-p less (ht021-abs less negate zero x) bound)
      (ht021-leq-p less (ht021-abs less negate zero y) bound)))))

(defun-sk ht021-region-close-for-gauge-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             bound value epsilon gauge)
  (forall (xcells ycells tags)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht021-division-p
       carrier less (ht021-neg negate bound) bound xcells)
      (ht021-division-p
       carrier less (ht021-neg negate bound) bound ycells)
      (ht021-tags-fit-grid-p
       carrier less xcells ycells tags)
      (ht021-grid-fine-p
       add negate less gauge xcells ycells tags))
     (ht021-less-p
      less
      (ht021-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht021-sub
        add negate
        (ht021-region-sum
         carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
         add multiply negate inverse zero one less
         xcells ycells tags)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-region-gauge-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             bound value epsilon)
  (exists (gauge)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp gauge)
     (ht021-valid-binary-function-p carrier gauge)
     (ht021-bivariate-gauge-positive-on-square-p
      carrier gauge negate less zero bound)
     (ht021-region-close-for-gauge-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      bound value epsilon gauge))))

(defun-sk ht021-region-integral-at-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less bound value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht021-region-gauge-exists-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      bound value epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht021-has-region-integral-p
    (carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less value)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ht021-positive-p carrier less zero bound)
     (ht021-region-contained-in-square-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less bound)
     (ht021-region-integral-at-bound-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less bound value))))

;; Derivative and integral values are internal witnesses constrained by the
;; definitions above; the desired equality is not an input assumption.

(defun-sk ht021-green-conclusion-p
    (carrier neighborhood p q gx gy pi-value
             add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (exists (p-x p-y q-x q-y circulation curl-integral)
    (and
     (ht021-member-p carrier circulation)
     (ht021-member-p carrier curl-integral)
     (ht021-c1-on-p
      carrier neighborhood p p-x p-y
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (ht021-c1-on-p
      carrier neighborhood q q-x q-y
      add multiply negate zero less)
     (ht021-has-circulation-integral-p
      carrier p q gx gy add multiply negate zero one less circulation)
     (ht021-has-region-integral-p
      carrier gx gy pi-value p-y q-x
      add multiply negate inverse zero one less curl-integral)
     (equal circulation curl-integral))))

(defun hundred-theorems-021-greens-theorem-statement
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             p q gx gy neighborhood pi-value)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht021-real-field-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (ht021-valid-binary-function-p carrier p)
    (ht021-valid-binary-function-p carrier q)
    (ht021-valid-unary-function-p carrier gx)
    (ht021-valid-unary-function-p carrier gy)
    (tamep-functionp neighborhood)
    (ht021-pi-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
    (ht021-absolutely-continuous-path-p
     carrier gx gy add negate zero one less)
    (ht021-closed-path-p gx gy zero one)
    (ht021-positive-interior-orientation-p
     carrier gx gy pi-value
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (ht021-open-set-p
     carrier neighborhood add negate zero less)
    (ht021-neighborhood-contains-relevant-p
     carrier neighborhood gx gy pi-value
     add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (ht021-field-c1-witness-p
     carrier neighborhood p q add multiply negate zero less))
   (ht021-green-conclusion-p
    carrier neighborhood p q gx gy pi-value
    add multiply negate inverse zero one less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 021_green_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Green's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 021:
-- over Cauchy-sequence real numbers, a closed absolutely continuous plane curve
-- having winding number one on its inside (the bounded complement components)
-- equates the
-- boundary line integral of a differentiable vector field with its curl integral.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Equivalent (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalent
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n = suc m <=N n

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos n) = negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

addInt : Int -> Int -> Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int -> Int -> Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

scaleInt : Int -> Nat -> Int
scaleInt z n = multiplyInt z (pos n)

absoluteInt : Int -> Nat
absoluteInt (pos n) = n
absoluteInt (negsuc n) = suc n

data IntLessOrEqual : Int -> Int -> Set where
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n)
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (pos n)
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational public

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q = suc (denominator-minus-one q)

ratZero : Rational
ratZero = fraction (pos zero) zero

ratOne : Rational
ratOne = fraction (pos (suc zero)) zero

ratFour : Rational
ratFour = fraction (pos (suc (suc (suc (suc zero))))) zero

unitFraction : Nat -> Rational
unitFraction n = fraction (pos (suc zero)) n

ratNegate : Rational -> Rational
ratNegate q =
  fraction (negateInt (numerator q)) (denominator-minus-one q)

ratAdd : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
ratAdd x y =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
      (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

ratSubtract : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
ratSubtract x y = ratAdd x (ratNegate y)

ratMultiply : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
ratMultiply x y =
  fraction
    (multiplyInt (numerator x) (numerator y))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

ratAbsolute : Rational -> Rational
ratAbsolute q =
  fraction
    (pos (absoluteInt (numerator q)))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

RationalEquivalent : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalEquivalent x y =
  scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y) ==
  scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)

RationalLessOrEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalLessOrEqual x y =
  IntLessOrEqual
    (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
    (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x))

RationalDistanceWithin : Rational -> Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalDistanceWithin x y epsilon =
  RationalLessOrEqual
    (ratAbsolute (ratSubtract x y))
    epsilon

Sequence : Set
Sequence = Nat -> Rational

Cauchy : Sequence -> Set
Cauchy sequence =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalDistanceWithin
        (sequence m)
        (sequence n)
        (unitFraction precision))

record Real : Set where
  constructor cauchyReal
  field
    approximation : Sequence
    cauchy         : Cauchy approximation

open Real public

SequenceEquivalent : Sequence -> Sequence -> Set
SequenceEquivalent leftSequence rightSequence =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalDistanceWithin
        (leftSequence n)
        (rightSequence n)
        (unitFraction precision))

SequenceLessOrEqual : Sequence -> Sequence -> Set
SequenceLessOrEqual leftSequence rightSequence =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalLessOrEqual
        (leftSequence n)
        (ratAdd (rightSequence n) (unitFraction precision)))

SequenceStrictLess : Sequence -> Sequence -> Set
SequenceStrictLess leftSequence rightSequence =
  Exists Nat
    (\ margin ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ cutoff ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          cutoff <=N n ->
          RationalLessOrEqual
            (ratAdd (leftSequence n) (unitFraction margin))
            (rightSequence n)))

RealEquivalent : Real -> Real -> Set
RealEquivalent x y =
  SequenceEquivalent (approximation x) (approximation y)

RealLessOrEqual : Real -> Real -> Set
RealLessOrEqual x y =
  SequenceLessOrEqual (approximation x) (approximation y)

RealStrictLess : Real -> Real -> Set
RealStrictLess x y =
  SequenceStrictLess (approximation x) (approximation y)

constantSequence : Rational -> Sequence
constantSequence q n = q

Nonnegative : Real -> Set
Nonnegative x =
  SequenceLessOrEqual
    (constantSequence ratZero)
    (approximation x)

Positive : Real -> Set
Positive x =
  SequenceStrictLess
    (constantSequence ratZero)
    (approximation x)

alternatingSign : Nat -> Int
alternatingSign zero = pos (suc zero)
alternatingSign (suc n) = negateInt (alternatingSign n)

oddNatural : Nat -> Nat
oddNatural n = suc (n + n)

leibnizTerm : Nat -> Rational
leibnizTerm n =
  fraction
    (alternatingSign n)
    (pred (oddNatural n))

leibnizPartialSum : Nat -> Rational
leibnizPartialSum zero = leibnizTerm zero
leibnizPartialSum (suc n) =
  ratAdd (leibnizPartialSum n) (leibnizTerm (suc n))

piSequence : Sequence
piSequence n =
  ratMultiply ratFour (leibnizPartialSum n)

record ConcreteRealOperations : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR piR : Real
    addR multiplyR : Real -> Real -> Real
    negateR inverseR squareRootR : Real -> Real

    zero-semantics :
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation zeroR)
        (constantSequence ratZero)
    one-semantics :
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation oneR)
        (constantSequence ratOne)
    pi-semantics :
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation piR)
        piSequence
    add-semantics :
      (x y : Real) ->
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation (addR x y))
        (\ n -> ratAdd (approximation x n) (approximation y n))
    multiply-semantics :
      (x y : Real) ->
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation (multiplyR x y))
        (\ n -> ratMultiply (approximation x n) (approximation y n))
    negate-semantics :
      (x : Real) ->
      SequenceEquivalent
        (approximation (negateR x))
        (\ n -> ratNegate (approximation x n))
    inverse-zero-semantics :
      RealEquivalent (inverseR zeroR) zeroR
    inverse-semantics :
      (x : Real) ->
      Not (RealEquivalent x zeroR) ->
      RealEquivalent (multiplyR x (inverseR x)) oneR
    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : Real) -> Nonnegative (squareRootR x)
    square-root-semantics :
      (x : Real) ->
      Nonnegative x ->
      RealEquivalent
        (multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x))
        x

    add-respects-equivalence :
      (a b c d : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent a b ->
      RealEquivalent c d ->
      RealEquivalent (addR a c) (addR b d)
    multiply-respects-equivalence :
      (a b c d : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent a b ->
      RealEquivalent c d ->
      RealEquivalent (multiplyR a c) (multiplyR b d)
    negate-respects-equivalence :
      (a b : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent a b ->
      RealEquivalent (negateR a) (negateR b)
    inverse-respects-equivalence :
      (a b : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent a b ->
      RealEquivalent (inverseR a) (inverseR b)
    square-root-respects-equivalence :
      (a b : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent a b ->
      RealEquivalent (squareRootR a) (squareRootR b)

open ConcreteRealOperations

subtractR : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Real -> Real
subtractR operations x y =
  addR operations x (negateR operations y)

divideR : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Real -> Real
divideR operations x y =
  multiplyR operations x (inverseR operations y)

twoPi : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real
twoPi operations =
  addR operations (piR operations) (piR operations)

realSquare : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Real
realSquare operations x =
  multiplyR operations x x

realDistance : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Real -> Real
realDistance operations x y =
  squareRootR operations
    (realSquare operations (subtractR operations x y))

record Point : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : Real
    y-coordinate : Real

open Point public

PointEquivalent : Point -> Point -> Set
PointEquivalent p q =
  Both
    (RealEquivalent (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (RealEquivalent (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

zeroPoint : ConcreteRealOperations -> Point
zeroPoint operations =
  point (zeroR operations) (zeroR operations)

addPoint : ConcreteRealOperations -> Point -> Point -> Point
addPoint operations p q =
  point
    (addR operations (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (addR operations (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

subtractPoint : ConcreteRealOperations -> Point -> Point -> Point
subtractPoint operations p q =
  point
    (subtractR operations (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (subtractR operations (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

scalePoint : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Point -> Point
scalePoint operations scalar p =
  point
    (multiplyR operations scalar (x-coordinate p))
    (multiplyR operations scalar (y-coordinate p))

pointDistanceSquared :
