  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Real
pointDistanceSquared operations p q =
  addR operations
    (realSquare operations
      (subtractR operations (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (realSquare operations
      (subtractR operations (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

pointDistance :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Real
pointDistance operations p q =
  squareRootR operations (pointDistanceSquared operations p q)

PointClose :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Real ->
  Set
PointClose operations p q epsilon =
  RealStrictLess (pointDistance operations p q) epsilon

Region : Set1
Region = Point -> Set

RegionExtensional : Region -> Set
RegionExtensional region =
  (p q : Point) ->
  PointEquivalent p q ->
  Equivalent (region p) (region q)

Subset : Region -> Region -> Set
Subset smaller larger =
  (p : Point) -> smaller p -> larger p

Union : Region -> Region -> Region
Union leftRegion rightRegion p =
  Either (leftRegion p) (rightRegion p)

Complement : Region -> Region
Complement region p =
  Not (region p)

ClosedInterval :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Set
ClosedInterval a b t =
  Both (RealLessOrEqual a t) (RealLessOrEqual t b)

UnitInterval : ConcreteRealOperations -> Real -> Set
UnitInterval operations =
  ClosedInterval (zeroR operations) (oneR operations)

record Curve : Set where
  constructor curve
  field
    curveValue : Real -> Point
    curve-extensional :
      (s t : Real) ->
      RealEquivalent s t ->
      PointEquivalent (curveValue s) (curveValue t)

open Curve public

record VectorField : Set where
  constructor vectorField
  field
    fieldValue : Point -> Point
    field-extensional :
      (p q : Point) ->
      PointEquivalent p q ->
      PointEquivalent (fieldValue p) (fieldValue q)

open VectorField public

pathImage :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Curve ->
  Region
pathImage operations g p =
  Exists Real
    (\ t ->
      Both
        (UnitInterval operations t)
        (PointEquivalent (curveValue g t) p))

OpenRegion :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Region ->
  Set
OpenRegion operations region =
  Both
    (RegionExtensional region)
    ((p : Point) ->
      region p ->
      Exists Real
        (\ radius ->
          Both
            (Positive radius)
            ((q : Point) ->
              PointClose operations p q radius ->
              region q)))

ContinuousCurveOnUnit :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Curve ->
  Set
ContinuousCurveOnUnit operations g =
  (t : Real) ->
  UnitInterval operations t ->
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Real
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive delta)
        ((s : Real) ->
          UnitInterval operations s ->
          RealStrictLess (realDistance operations s t) delta ->
          PointClose
            operations
            (curveValue g s)
            (curveValue g t)
            epsilon))

SameComplementComponent :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Region ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Set
SameComplementComponent operations boundary p q =
  Exists Curve
    (\ connector ->
      Both
        (PointEquivalent
          (curveValue connector (zeroR operations))
          p)
        (Both
          (PointEquivalent
            (curveValue connector (oneR operations))
            q)
          (Both
            (ContinuousCurveOnUnit operations connector)
            ((t : Real) ->
              UnitInterval operations t ->
              Not (boundary (curveValue connector t))))))

Inside :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Region ->
  Region
Inside operations boundary p =
  Both
    (Not (boundary p))
    (Exists Point
      (\ center ->
        Exists Real
          (\ radius ->
            Both
              (Positive radius)
              ((q : Point) ->
                SameComplementComponent operations boundary p q ->
                RealLessOrEqual
                  (pointDistance operations q center)
                  radius))))

record Matrix : Set where
  constructor matrix
  field
    entry11 : Real
    entry12 : Real
    entry21 : Real
    entry22 : Real

open Matrix public

applyMatrix :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Matrix ->
  Point ->
  Point
applyMatrix operations derivative h =
  point
    (addR operations
      (multiplyR operations (entry11 derivative) (x-coordinate h))
      (multiplyR operations (entry12 derivative) (y-coordinate h)))
    (addR operations
      (multiplyR operations (entry21 derivative) (x-coordinate h))
      (multiplyR operations (entry22 derivative) (y-coordinate h)))

HasFrechetDerivativeAt :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  VectorField ->
  Point ->
  Matrix ->
  Set
HasFrechetDerivativeAt operations f z derivative =
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Real
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive delta)
        ((w : Point) ->
          PointClose operations w z delta ->
          RealLessOrEqual
            (pointDistanceSquared operations
              (subtractPoint operations
                (subtractPoint operations
                  (fieldValue f w)
                  (fieldValue f z))
                (applyMatrix operations derivative
                  (subtractPoint operations w z)))
              (zeroPoint operations))
            (multiplyR operations
              (realSquare operations epsilon)
              (pointDistanceSquared operations w z))))

HasVectorDerivativeAt :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Curve ->
  Real ->
  Point ->
  Set
HasVectorDerivativeAt operations g t derivative =
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Real
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive delta)
        ((s : Real) ->
          RealStrictLess (realDistance operations s t) delta ->
          RealLessOrEqual
            (pointDistanceSquared operations
              (subtractPoint operations
                (subtractPoint operations
                  (curveValue g s)
                  (curveValue g t))
                (scalePoint operations
                  (subtractR operations s t)
                  derivative))
              (zeroPoint operations))
            (multiplyR operations
              (realSquare operations epsilon)
              (realSquare operations
                (subtractR operations s t)))))

DifferentiableOn :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  VectorField ->
  Region ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn operations f region =
  (z : Point) ->
  region z ->
  Exists Matrix (HasFrechetDerivativeAt operations f z)

ContinuousVectorOn :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Point -> Point) ->
  Region ->
  Set
ContinuousVectorOn operations function region =
  (z : Point) ->
  region z ->
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Real
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive delta)
        ((w : Point) ->
          region w ->
          PointClose operations w z delta ->
          PointClose operations (function w) (function z) epsilon))

record DerivativeSelections
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) : Set1 where
  field
    frechetDerivative :
      VectorField ->
      Point ->
      Matrix
    frechet-derivative-correct :
      (f : VectorField) ->
      (z : Point) ->
      Exists Matrix (HasFrechetDerivativeAt operations f z) ->
      HasFrechetDerivativeAt operations f z
        (frechetDerivative f z)

    vectorDerivative :
      Curve ->
      Real ->
      Point
    vector-derivative-correct :
      (g : Curve) ->
      (t : Real) ->
      Exists Point (HasVectorDerivativeAt operations g t) ->
      HasVectorDerivativeAt operations g t
        (vectorDerivative g t)
    vector-derivative-zero-otherwise :
      (g : Curve) ->
      (t : Real) ->
      Not (Exists Point (HasVectorDerivativeAt operations g t)) ->
      PointEquivalent
        (vectorDerivative g t)
        (zeroPoint operations)

open DerivativeSelections

record IntervalFamily : Set where
  constructor intervalFamily
  field
    interval-count : Nat
    interval-left  : Nat -> Real
    interval-right : Nat -> Real

open IntervalFamily public

FamilyInsideUnit :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  IntervalFamily ->
  Set
FamilyInsideUnit operations family =
  Both
    ((i : Nat) ->
      i <N interval-count family ->
      Both
        (UnitInterval operations (interval-left family i))
        (UnitInterval operations (interval-right family i)))
    (Both
      ((i : Nat) ->
        i <N interval-count family ->
        RealLessOrEqual
          (interval-left family i)
          (interval-right family i))
      ((i j : Nat) ->
        i <N interval-count family ->
        j <N interval-count family ->
        i != j ->
        Either
          (RealLessOrEqual
            (interval-right family i)
            (interval-left family j))
          (RealLessOrEqual
            (interval-right family j)
            (interval-left family i))))

sumReals :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Nat -> Real) ->
  Nat ->
  Real
sumReals operations term zero =
  zeroR operations
sumReals operations term (suc n) =
  addR operations
    (sumReals operations term n)
    (term n)

familyTotalLength :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  IntervalFamily ->
  Real
familyTotalLength operations family =
  sumReals operations
    (\ i ->
      subtractR operations
        (interval-right family i)
        (interval-left family i))
    (interval-count family)

familyTotalVariation :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Curve ->
  IntervalFamily ->
  Real
familyTotalVariation operations g family =
  sumReals operations
    (\ i ->
      pointDistance operations
        (curveValue g (interval-right family i))
        (curveValue g (interval-left family i)))
    (interval-count family)

AbsolutelyContinuousOnUnit :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Curve ->
  Set
AbsolutelyContinuousOnUnit operations g =
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Real
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive delta)
        ((family : IntervalFamily) ->
          FamilyInsideUnit operations family ->
          RealStrictLess
            (familyTotalLength operations family)
            delta ->
          RealStrictLess
            (familyTotalVariation operations g family)
            epsilon))

record TaggedDivision : Set where
  constructor taggedDivision
  field
    division-count : Nat
    division-point : Nat -> Real
    division-tag   : Nat -> Real

open TaggedDivision public

TaggedDivisionOf :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  TaggedDivision ->
  Set
TaggedDivisionOf a b division =
  Both
    (RealEquivalent (division-point division zero) a)
    (Both
      (RealEquivalent
        (division-point division (division-count division))
        b)
      (Both
        ((i : Nat) ->
          i <N division-count division ->
          RealLessOrEqual
            (division-point division i)
            (division-point division (suc i)))
        ((i : Nat) ->
          i <N division-count division ->
          ClosedInterval
            (division-point division i)
            (division-point division (suc i))
            (division-tag division i))))

Gauge1 : Set
Gauge1 = Real -> Real

PositiveGauge1 :
  Gauge1 ->
  Set
PositiveGauge1 gauge =
  (t : Real) -> Positive (gauge t)

GaugeFine1 :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Gauge1 ->
  TaggedDivision ->
  Set
GaugeFine1 operations gauge division =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i <N division-count division ->
  (x : Real) ->
  ClosedInterval
    (division-point division i)
    (division-point division (suc i))
    x ->
  RealStrictLess
    (realDistance operations x (division-tag division i))
    (gauge (division-tag division i))

riemannSum1 :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Real -> Real) ->
  TaggedDivision ->
  Real
riemannSum1 operations integrand division =
  sumReals operations
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR operations
        (integrand (division-tag division i))
        (subtractR operations
          (division-point division (suc i))
          (division-point division i)))
    (division-count division)

HasIntervalIntegral :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Real -> Real) ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Set
HasIntervalIntegral operations integrand a b integral =
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Gauge1
    (\ gauge ->
      Both
        (PositiveGauge1 gauge)
        ((division : TaggedDivision) ->
          TaggedDivisionOf a b division ->
          GaugeFine1 operations gauge division ->
          RealStrictLess
            (realDistance operations
              (riemannSum1 operations integrand division)
              integral)
            epsilon))

record Box : Set where
  constructor box
  field
    lower-left  : Point
    upper-right : Point

open Box public

ValidBox : Box -> Set
ValidBox rectangle =
  Both
    (RealLessOrEqual
      (x-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
      (x-coordinate (upper-right rectangle)))
    (RealLessOrEqual
      (y-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
      (y-coordinate (upper-right rectangle)))

PointInBox : Box -> Point -> Set
PointInBox rectangle p =
  Both
    (ClosedInterval
      (x-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
      (x-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))
      (x-coordinate p))
    (ClosedInterval
      (y-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
      (y-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))
      (y-coordinate p))

PointInBoxInterior : Box -> Point -> Set
PointInBoxInterior rectangle p =
  Both
    (Both
      (RealStrictLess
        (x-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
        (x-coordinate p))
      (RealStrictLess
        (x-coordinate p)
        (x-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))))
    (Both
      (RealStrictLess
        (y-coordinate (lower-left rectangle))
        (y-coordinate p))
      (RealStrictLess
        (y-coordinate p)
        (y-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))))

BoxArea :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Box ->
  Real
BoxArea operations rectangle =
  multiplyR operations
    (subtractR operations
      (x-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))
      (x-coordinate (lower-left rectangle)))
    (subtractR operations
      (y-coordinate (upper-right rectangle))
      (y-coordinate (lower-left rectangle)))

record TaggedBoxDivision : Set where
  constructor taggedBoxDivision
  field
    box-count     : Nat
    division-box  : Nat -> Box
    box-tag       : Nat -> Point

open TaggedBoxDivision public

BoxesInteriorDisjoint : Box -> Box -> Set
BoxesInteriorDisjoint firstBox secondBox =
  (p : Point) ->
  PointInBoxInterior firstBox p ->
  PointInBoxInterior secondBox p ->
  Bottom

TaggedBoxDivisionOf :
  Box ->
  TaggedBoxDivision ->
  Set
TaggedBoxDivisionOf outer division =
  Both
    ((i : Nat) ->
      i <N box-count division ->
      Both
        (ValidBox (division-box division i))
        (Both
          ((p : Point) ->
            PointInBox (division-box division i) p ->
            PointInBox outer p)
          (PointInBox
            (division-box division i)
            (box-tag division i))))
    (Both
      ((p : Point) ->
        PointInBox outer p ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ i ->
            Both
              (i <N box-count division)
              (PointInBox (division-box division i) p)))
      ((i j : Nat) ->
        i <N box-count division ->
        j <N box-count division ->
        i != j ->
        BoxesInteriorDisjoint
          (division-box division i)
          (division-box division j)))

Gauge2 : Set
Gauge2 = Point -> Real

PositiveGauge2 : Gauge2 -> Set
PositiveGauge2 gauge =
  (p : Point) -> Positive (gauge p)

GaugeFine2 :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  Gauge2 ->
  TaggedBoxDivision ->
  Set
GaugeFine2 operations gauge division =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i <N box-count division ->
  (p : Point) ->
  PointInBox (division-box division i) p ->
  PointClose
    operations
    p
    (box-tag division i)
    (gauge (box-tag division i))

riemannSum2 :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Point -> Real) ->
  TaggedBoxDivision ->
  Real
riemannSum2 operations integrand division =
  sumReals operations
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR operations
        (integrand (box-tag division i))
        (BoxArea operations (division-box division i)))
    (box-count division)

HasBoxIntegral :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Point -> Real) ->
  Box ->
  Real ->
  Set
HasBoxIntegral operations integrand outer integral =
  ValidBox outer ->
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  Positive epsilon ->
  Exists Gauge2
    (\ gauge ->
      Both
        (PositiveGauge2 gauge)
        ((division : TaggedBoxDivision) ->
          TaggedBoxDivisionOf outer division ->
          GaugeFine2 operations gauge division ->
          RealStrictLess
            (realDistance operations
              (riemannSum2 operations integrand division)
              integral)
            epsilon))

record RegionRestriction
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations)
  (integrand : Point -> Real)
  (region : Region) : Set where
  field
    restrictedValue : Point -> Real
    value-on-region :
      (p : Point) ->
      region p ->
      RealEquivalent (restrictedValue p) (integrand p)
    zero-off-region :
      (p : Point) ->
      Not (region p) ->
      RealEquivalent (restrictedValue p) (zeroR operations)

open RegionRestriction

HasRegionIntegral :
  ConcreteRealOperations ->
  (Point -> Real) ->
  Region ->
  Real ->
  Set
HasRegionIntegral operations integrand region integral =
  Exists Box
    (\ outer ->
      Both
        (ValidBox outer)
        (Both
          ((p : Point) ->
            region p ->
            PointInBox outer p)
          (Exists
            (RegionRestriction operations integrand region)
            (\ restriction ->
              HasBoxIntegral operations
                (restrictedValue restriction)
                outer
                integral))))

WindingDensity :
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  DerivativeSelections operations ->
  Curve ->
  Point ->
  Real ->
  Real
WindingDensity operations selections g z t =
  divideR operations
    (subtractR operations
      (multiplyR operations
        (subtractR operations
          (x-coordinate (curveValue g t))
          (x-coordinate z))
        (y-coordinate
          (vectorDerivative selections g t)))
      (multiplyR operations
        (subtractR operations
          (y-coordinate (curveValue g t))
          (y-coordinate z))
        (x-coordinate
          (vectorDerivative selections g t))))
    (pointDistanceSquared operations (curveValue g t) z)

WindingNumberOne :
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  DerivativeSelections operations ->
  Curve ->
  Point ->
  Set
WindingNumberOne operations selections g z =
  HasIntervalIntegral operations
    (WindingDensity operations selections g z)
    (zeroR operations)
    (oneR operations)
    (twoPi operations)

curlDensity :
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  DerivativeSelections operations ->
  VectorField ->
  Point ->
  Real
curlDensity operations selections f z =
  subtractR operations
    (entry11 (frechetDerivative selections f z))
    (entry22 (frechetDerivative selections f z))

boundaryDensity :
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  DerivativeSelections operations ->
  VectorField ->
  Curve ->
  Real ->
  Real
boundaryDensity operations selections f g t =
  addR operations
    (multiplyR operations
      (y-coordinate (fieldValue f (curveValue g t)))
      (x-coordinate (vectorDerivative selections g t)))
    (multiplyR operations
      (x-coordinate (fieldValue f (curveValue g t)))
      (y-coordinate (vectorDerivative selections g t)))

derivativeAction :
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  DerivativeSelections operations ->
  VectorField ->
  Point ->
  Point ->
  Point
derivativeAction operations selections f h z =
  applyMatrix operations
    (frechetDerivative selections f z)
    h

green-s-theorem : Set1
green-s-theorem =
  (operations : ConcreteRealOperations) ->
  (selections : DerivativeSelections operations) ->
  (f : VectorField) ->
  (g : Curve) ->
  (u : Region) ->
  AbsolutelyContinuousOnUnit operations g ->
  PointEquivalent
    (curveValue g (oneR operations))
    (curveValue g (zeroR operations)) ->
  ((z : Point) ->
    Inside operations (pathImage operations g) z ->
    WindingNumberOne operations selections g z) ->
  OpenRegion operations u ->
  Subset
    (Union
      (Inside operations (pathImage operations g))
      (pathImage operations g))
    u ->
  DifferentiableOn operations f u ->
  ((h : Point) ->
    ContinuousVectorOn operations
      (derivativeAction operations selections f h)
      u) ->
  Exists Real
    (\ regionIntegral ->
      Exists Real
        (\ boundaryIntegral ->
          Both
            (HasRegionIntegral operations
              (curlDensity operations selections f)
              (Inside operations (pathImage operations g))
              regionIntegral)
            (Both
              (HasIntervalIntegral operations
                (boundaryDensity operations selections f g)
                (zeroR operations)
                (oneR operations)
                boundaryIntegral)
              (RealEquivalent boundaryIntegral regionIntegral))))

title: 021_green_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Green's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 021. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

(* Hundred Theorems, Green's Theorem (021): boundary circulation of a C1
   planar field around a positively oriented absolutely continuous closed
   path equals the area integral of its scalar curl. This is a statement-only
   formalization and contains no proof. *)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open limTheory integrationTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;
open martingaleTheory;

val green_s_theorem =
  ``!(P Q : (real # real) -> real)
      (g : real -> (real # real))
      (dg : real -> (real # real))
      (u : (real # real) -> bool)
      (dPdx dPdy dQdx dQdy : (real # real) -> real).
      let sqdist =
        \x y : real # real.
          (FST y - FST x) pow 2 + (SND y - SND x) pow 2
      in
      let on_unit_interval =
        \t. 0 <= t /\ t <= 1
      in
      let open_plane =
        \s : (real # real) -> bool.
          !x. s x ==>
              ?d. 0 < d /\
                  !y. sqdist x y < d pow 2 ==> s y
      in
      let continuous_on_plane =
        \s h.
          !x. s x ==>
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?d. 0 < d /\
                      !y. s y /\ sqdist x y < d pow 2 ==>
                          abs (h y - h x) < e
      in
      let continuous_plane_path =
        \h.
          !t. on_unit_interval t ==>
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?d. 0 < d /\
                      !s. on_unit_interval s /\ abs (s - t) < d ==>
                          sqdist (h s) (h t) < e
      in
      let path_image =
        \z. ?t. on_unit_interval t /\ g t = z
      in
      let path_derivative = dg
      in
      let absolutely_continuous_path =
        ((\t. FST (path_derivative t))
           absolutely_integrable_on interval [0, 1] /\
         (\t. SND (path_derivative t))
           absolutely_integrable_on interval [0, 1] /\
         !t. 0 <= t /\ t <= 1 ==>
             FST (g t) =
               FST (g 0) +
               integration$integral (interval [0, t])
                 (\s. FST (path_derivative s)) /\
             SND (g t) =
               SND (g 0) +
               integration$integral (interval [0, t])
                 (\s. SND (path_derivative s)))
      in
      let winding_integrand =
        \z t.
          ((FST (g t) - FST z) * SND (path_derivative t) -
           (SND (g t) - SND z) * FST (path_derivative t)) /
          sqdist z (g t)
      in
      let winding_number =
        \z.
          integration$integral (interval [0, 1])
            (winding_integrand z) / (2 * pi)
      in
      let same_component =
        \x y.
          ?h.
            continuous_plane_path h /\
            h 0 = x /\
            h 1 = y /\
            !t. on_unit_interval t ==> ~path_image (h t)
      in
      let unbounded_component =
        \z.
          ~path_image z /\
          !R. ?w.
            same_component z w /\
            R < sqrt (sqdist (0, 0) w)
      in
      let inside =
        \z. ~path_image z /\ ~unbounded_component z
      in
      let circulation =
        \t.
          P (g t) * FST (path_derivative t) +
          Q (g t) * SND (path_derivative t)
      in
      let area_density =
        \z.
          if inside z then Normal (dQdx z - dPdy z)
          else (0 : extreal)
      in
        absolutely_continuous_path /\
        g 1 = g 0 /\
        (!z. ~path_image z ==>
             winding_integrand z integrable_on interval [0, 1]) /\
        (!z. inside z ==> winding_number z = 1) /\
        open_plane u /\
        (!z. (inside z \/ path_image z) ==> u z) /\
        (!z. u z ==>
             ((\x. P (x, SND z)) diffl dPdx z) (FST z) /\
             ((\y. P (FST z, y)) diffl dPdy z) (SND z) /\
             ((\x. Q (x, SND z)) diffl dQdx z) (FST z) /\
             ((\y. Q (FST z, y)) diffl dQdy z) (SND z)) /\
        continuous_on_plane u dPdx /\
        continuous_on_plane u dPdy /\
        continuous_on_plane u dQdx /\
        continuous_on_plane u dQdy
        ==>
        lebesgue$integrable
          (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue) area_density /\
        circulation integrable_on interval [0, 1] /\
        Normal
          (integration$integral (interval [0, 1]) circulation) =
        lebesgue$integral
          (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue) area_density``;

title: 021_green_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Green's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 021. It states
  the positively oriented planar curl theorem for an absolutely continuous closed curve and a
  continuously differentiable real vector field on an open neighborhood of the curve and its
  inside. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The Euclidean plane is identified isometrically with CC by (x,y) |-> x + i y. The source
  vector field f is represented by its real component functions P and Q, with

      P(z) = (f(z))_2,  Q(z) = (f(z))_1.

  Consequently the boundary integrand is P dx + Q dy and the interior integrand is
  partial_x Q - partial_y P, exactly the component ordering in GREEN_THEOREM_CURL.

  Every analytic notion introduced below is a conservative abbreviation over set.mm:

  * HT021AC uses the standard characterization of absolute continuity as an indefinite
    Lebesgue integral of an L^1 derivative.
  * HT021Inside is the union of the bounded connected components of the complement of the
    curve image in the standard complex topology.
  * HT021Dx and HT021Dy use set.mm's real derivative RR _D on coordinate slices. Their zero
    fallback is irrelevant on U, where HT021C1 explicitly requires all four derivatives.
  * HT021Wind1 is the defining contour-integral equation integral g'(t)/(g(t)-z) dt = 2*pi*i.
  * HT021PlaneIntegral is an iterated Lebesgue integral of the zero extension to RR x RR.
    Under the stated hypotheses the inside is bounded with negligible boundary and the curl
    is continuous, so this is the same planar integral as the source gauge integral.
  * HT021LineIntegral is the Lebesgue integral of the explicitly defined boundary integrand.
    Absolute continuity makes it equivalent to the source path integral.

  The final assertion is an unproved $a statement. The two integral predicates include the
  source integrability conclusions as well as the common integral value.
$)

$c HT021AC HT021Inside HT021D HT021Dx HT021Dy HT021C1 $.
$c HT021WindIntegrand HT021Wind1 HT021Line HT021Curl $.
$c HT021PlaneIntegrand HT021Row HT021PlaneIntegral HT021LineIntegral $.

ht021-ac-syntax $a wff ( HT021AC G ) $.
ht021-inside-syntax $a class ( HT021Inside G ) $.
ht021-d-syntax $a class ( HT021D G T ) $.
ht021-dx-syntax $a class ( HT021Dx P Z ) $.
ht021-dy-syntax $a class ( HT021Dy P Z ) $.
ht021-c1-syntax $a wff ( HT021C1 P Q U ) $.
ht021-wind-integrand-syntax $a class ( HT021WindIntegrand G Z T ) $.
ht021-wind1-syntax $a wff ( HT021Wind1 G Z ) $.
ht021-line-syntax $a class ( HT021Line P Q G T ) $.
ht021-curl-syntax $a class ( HT021Curl P Q Z ) $.
ht021-plane-integrand-syntax $a class ( HT021PlaneIntegrand H S X Y ) $.
ht021-row-syntax $a class ( HT021Row H S X ) $.
ht021-plane-integral-syntax $a wff ( HT021PlaneIntegral H S C ) $.
ht021-line-integral-syntax $a wff ( HT021LineIntegral P Q G C ) $.

${
  $d h t x G $.

  ht021-ac-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021AC G )
    <->
    (
      G : ( 0 [,] 1 ) --> CC
      /\
      E. h
        (
          ( h : RR --> CC /\ h e. L^1 )
          /\
          A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
            ( G ` t ) =
              ( ( G ` 0 ) + S. ( 0 [,] t ) ( h ` x ) _d x )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c r w z G $.

  ht021-inside-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Inside G )
    =
    { z e. ( CC \ ran G ) |
      E. r e. RR+
        A. w e.
          U. { c e. ~P ( CC \ ran G ) |
            (
              z e. c
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( ( TopOpen ` CCfld ) |`t ( CC \ ran G ) )
                  |`t c
                )
                e. Conn
              )
            )
          }
          ( ( abs ` w ) < r )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G T $.

  ht021-d-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021D G T )
    =
    if
      (
        T e. dom ( RR _D G ) ,
        ( ( RR _D G ) ` T ) ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r P Z $.

  ht021-dx-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Dx P Z )
    =
    if
      (
        ( Re ` Z ) e.
          dom
            (
              RR _D
                ( r e. RR |->
                  ( P ` ( r + ( _i x. ( Im ` Z ) ) ) )
                )
            ) ,
        (
          (
            RR _D
              ( r e. RR |->
                ( P ` ( r + ( _i x. ( Im ` Z ) ) ) )
              )
          )
          ` ( Re ` Z )
        ) ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r P Z $.

  ht021-dy-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Dy P Z )
    =
    if
      (
        ( Im ` Z ) e.
          dom
            (
              RR _D
                ( r e. RR |->
                  ( P ` ( ( Re ` Z ) + ( _i x. r ) ) )
                )
            ) ,
        (
          (
            RR _D
              ( r e. RR |->
                ( P ` ( ( Re ` Z ) + ( _i x. r ) ) )
              )
          )
          ` ( Im ` Z )
        ) ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d r z P Q U $.

  ht021-c1-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021C1 P Q U )
    <->
    (
      (
        U e. ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
        /\
        ( P : CC --> RR /\ Q : CC --> RR )
      )
      /\
      (
        A. z e. U
          (
            (
              ( Re ` z ) e.
                dom
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( r e. RR |->
                        ( P ` ( r + ( _i x. ( Im ` z ) ) ) )
                      )
                  )
              /\
              ( Im ` z ) e.
                dom
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( r e. RR |->
                        ( P ` ( ( Re ` z ) + ( _i x. r ) ) )
                      )
                  )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( Re ` z ) e.
                dom
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( r e. RR |->
                        ( Q ` ( r + ( _i x. ( Im ` z ) ) ) )
                      )
                  )
              /\
              ( Im ` z ) e.
                dom
                  (
                    RR _D
                      ( r e. RR |->
                        ( Q ` ( ( Re ` z ) + ( _i x. r ) ) )
                      )
                  )
            )
          )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( z e. U |-> ( HT021Dx P z ) ) e. ( U -cn-> CC )
            /\
            ( z e. U |-> ( HT021Dy P z ) ) e. ( U -cn-> CC )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( z e. U |-> ( HT021Dx Q z ) ) e. ( U -cn-> CC )
            /\
            ( z e. U |-> ( HT021Dy Q z ) ) e. ( U -cn-> CC )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G Z T $.

  ht021-wind-integrand-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021WindIntegrand G Z T )
    =
    ( ( HT021D G T ) / ( ( G ` T ) - Z ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d t G Z $.

  ht021-wind1-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Wind1 G Z )
    <->
    (
      (
        t e. RR |->
          if
            (
              t e. ( 0 [,] 1 ) ,
              ( HT021WindIntegrand G Z t ) ,
              0
            )
      )
      e. L^1
      /\
      S. ( 0 [,] 1 ) ( HT021WindIntegrand G Z t ) _d t
        = ( ( 2 x. _pi ) x. _i )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q G T $.

  ht021-line-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Line P Q G T )
    =
    (
      (
        ( P ` ( G ` T ) )
        x.
        ( Re ` ( HT021D G T ) )
      )
      +
      (
        ( Q ` ( G ` T ) )
        x.
        ( Im ` ( HT021D G T ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P Q Z $.

  ht021-curl-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Curl P Q Z )
    =
    ( ( HT021Dx Q Z ) - ( HT021Dy P Z ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H S X Y $.

  ht021-plane-integrand-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021PlaneIntegrand H S X Y )
    =
    if
      (
        ( X + ( _i x. Y ) ) e. S ,
        ( H ` ( X + ( _i x. Y ) ) ) ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y H S X $.

  ht021-row-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021Row H S X )
    =
    S. RR ( HT021PlaneIntegrand H S X y ) _d y
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d x y H S C $.

  ht021-plane-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021PlaneIntegral H S C )
    <->
    (
      H : CC --> CC
      /\
      (
        A. x e. RR
          ( y e. RR |-> ( HT021PlaneIntegrand H S x y ) ) e. L^1
        /\
        (
          ( x e. RR |-> ( HT021Row H S x ) ) e. L^1
          /\
          C = S. RR ( HT021Row H S x ) _d x
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d t P Q G C $.

  ht021-line-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( HT021LineIntegral P Q G C )
    <->
    (
      (
        t e. RR |->
          if
            (
              t e. ( 0 [,] 1 ) ,
              ( HT021Line P Q G t ) ,
              0
            )
      )
      e. L^1
      /\
      C = S. ( 0 [,] 1 ) ( HT021Line P Q G t ) _d t
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c z G P Q U $.

  hundred-theorems-021-green-theorem $a |- (
    (
      (
        ( HT021AC G )
        /\
        ( G ` 1 ) = ( G ` 0 )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          A. z e. ( HT021Inside G )
            ( HT021Wind1 G z )
          /\
          ( ( ( HT021Inside G ) u. ran G ) C_ U )
        )
        /\
        ( HT021C1 P Q U )
      )
    )
    ->
    E. c e. CC
      (
        (
          HT021PlaneIntegral
            ( z e. CC |-> ( HT021Curl P Q z ) )
            ( HT021Inside G )
            c
        )
        /\
        ( HT021LineIntegral P Q G c )
      )
  ) $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b being Real,
      I being Element of L-Field,
      x,y,dx,dy,boundary being PartFunc of REAL,REAL,
      CImg,R being Subset of TOP-REAL 2,
      Rxy being Subset of [:REAL,REAL:],
      U being Subset of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:],
      e1,e2 being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:],
      P0,Q0 being PartFunc of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:],RNS_Real,
      P,Q,K being PartFunc of [:REAL,REAL:],REAL st
    a = 0 & b = 1 & I = [.a,b.] & e1 = [1,0] & e2 = [0,1] &
    I c= dom x & I c= dom y &
    I c= dom dx & I c= dom dy &
    dx|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
    dy|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
    (for t being Real st t in I holds
      x.t = x.a + Integral(L-Meas,dx| [.a,t.]) &
      y.t = y.a + Integral(L-Meas,dy| [.a,t.])) &
    x.a = x.b & y.a = y.b &
    (for z being object holds
      z in CImg iff
      ex t being Real st t in I & z = |[x.t,y.t]|) &
    R = BDD CImg &
    (for p,q being Real st |[p,q]| in R holds
      ex w being PartFunc of REAL,REAL st
        I c= dom w &
        (for t being Real st t in I holds
          w.t = ((x.t-p)*dy.t - (y.t-q)*dx.t) /
            ((x.t-p)^2 + (y.t-q)^2)) &
        w|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
        Integral(L-Meas,w|I) = 2*PI) &
    (for p,q being Real holds
      [p,q] in Rxy iff |[p,q]| in R) &
    U is open &
    (for p,q being Real st |[p,q]| in R \/ CImg holds [p,q] in U) &
    P0 = P & Q0 = Q &
    U c= dom P & U c= dom Q & U c= dom K &
    P0 is_differentiable_on U &
    Q0 is_differentiable_on U &
    (for h,z being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:], r being Real
      st z in U & 0 < r holds
      ex s being Real st 0 < s &
        for w being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:]
          st w in U & ||.w-z.|| < s holds
          ||.diff(P0,w) . h - diff(P0,z) . h.|| < r) &
    (for h,z being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:], r being Real
      st z in U & 0 < r holds
      ex s being Real st 0 < s &
        for w being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:]
          st w in U & ||.w-z.|| < s holds
          ||.diff(Q0,w) . h - diff(Q0,z) . h.|| < r) &
    (for p,q being Real, z being Point of [:RNS_Real,RNS_Real:]
      st [p,q] in U & z = [p,q] holds
      K.([p,q]) =
        diff(Q0,z) . e1 - diff(P0,z) . e2) &
    I c= dom boundary &
    (for t being Real st t in I holds
      boundary.t =
        P.([x.t,y.t])*dx.t + Q.([x.t,y.t])*dy.t)
  holds
    (K|Rxy) is_integrable_on Prod_Measure(L-Meas,L-Meas) &
    boundary|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
    Integral(L-Meas,boundary|I) =
      Integral(Prod_Measure(L-Meas,L-Meas),K|Rxy)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 021_green_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Green's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 021:
% an absolutely continuous positively oriented closed plane curve has boundary
% integral equal to the area integral of the planar curl. This file contains no proof.

green_s_theorem_021: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  vector_field: TYPE = [point -> point]
  scalar_field: TYPE = [point -> real]
  parametrized_curve: TYPE = [real -> point]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  jacobian: TYPE =
    [# j11: real, j12: real, j21: real, j22: real #]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  squared_norm(p: point): real =
    x_coord(p) ^ 2 + y_coord(p) ^ 2

  euclidean_distance(p, q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (distance: real):
        0 <= distance
          AND distance ^ 2 = squared_distance(p, q))

  in_unit_interval(t: real): bool =
    0 <= t AND t <= 1

  point_close(p, q: point, radius: real): bool =
    squared_distance(p, q) < radius ^ 2

  continuous_on_unit_interval(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES
        FORALL (eps: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (s: real):
              (in_unit_interval(s)
                AND abs(s - t) < delta)
              IMPLIES point_close(g(s), g(t), eps)

  ordered_interval_family(
      starts, finishes: real_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        (0 <= starts(index)
          AND starts(index) <= finishes(index)
          AND finishes(index) <= 1))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index + 1 < count IMPLIES
          finishes(index) <= starts(index + 1))

  interval_length_sum(
      starts, finishes: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      interval_length_sum(starts, finishes, count - 1)
        + finishes(count - 1) - starts(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  curve_increment_sum(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      starts, finishes: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      curve_increment_sum(g, starts, finishes, count - 1)
        + euclidean_distance(
            g(finishes(count - 1)),
            g(starts(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  absolutely_continuous_on_unit_interval(
      g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL
            (starts, finishes: real_sequence),
            (count: nat):
          (ordered_interval_family(starts, finishes, count)
            AND interval_length_sum(starts, finishes, count)
              < delta)
          IMPLIES
            curve_increment_sum(g, starts, finishes, count)
              < eps

  path_start(g: parametrized_curve): point =
    g(0)

  path_finish(g: parametrized_curve): point =
    g(1)

  closed_path(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    path_finish(g) = path_start(g)

  path_image(g: parametrized_curve): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        in_unit_interval(t) AND p = g(t)

  complement_path(
      h: parametrized_curve,
      region: planar_region,
      start, finish: point): bool =
    continuous_on_unit_interval(h)
      AND path_start(h) = start
      AND path_finish(h) = finish
      AND FORALL (t: real):
        in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES NOT region(h(t))

  same_complement_component(
      region: planar_region,
      p, q: point): bool =
    EXISTS (h: parametrized_curve):
      complement_path(h, region, p, q)

  bounded_complement_component(
      region: planar_region,
      p: point): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (q: point):
        same_complement_component(region, p, q)
          IMPLIES squared_norm(q) <= bound ^ 2

  inside_region(region: planar_region): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      NOT region(p)
        AND bounded_complement_component(region, p)

  open_region(region: planar_region): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (q: point):
            point_close(q, p, radius) IMPLIES region(q)

  inside_and_path_subset(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      region: planar_region): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      (inside_region(path_image(g))(p)
        OR path_image(g)(p))
      IMPLIES region(p)

  derivative_error_squared(
      f: vector_field,
      derivative: jacobian,
      p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(f(q)) - x_coord(f(p))
      - j11(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
      - j12(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(f(q)) - y_coord(f(p))
        - j21(derivative) * (x_coord(q) - x_coord(p))
        - j22(derivative) * (y_coord(q) - y_coord(p))) ^ 2

  has_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: vector_field,
      derivative: jacobian,
      p: point): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (q: point):
          (NOT (q = p)
            AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            derivative_error_squared(f, derivative, p, q)
              < eps ^ 2 * squared_distance(q, p)

  jacobian_at(f: vector_field, p: point): jacobian =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (derivative: jacobian):
        has_frechet_derivative_at(f, derivative, p))

  differentiable_on(
      f: vector_field,
      region: planar_region): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (derivative: jacobian):
          has_frechet_derivative_at(f, derivative, p)

  jacobian_distance_squared(
      first, second: jacobian): real =
    (j11(first) - j11(second)) ^ 2
      + (j12(first) - j12(second)) ^ 2
      + (j21(first) - j21(second)) ^ 2
      + (j22(first) - j22(second)) ^ 2

  continuous_jacobian_on(
      f: vector_field,
      region: planar_region): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (eps: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (q: point):
              (region(q)
                AND squared_distance(q, p) < delta ^ 2)
              IMPLIES
                jacobian_distance_squared(
                  jacobian_at(f, q),
                  jacobian_at(f, p))
                  < eps ^ 2

  curve_derivative_error_squared(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      velocity: point,
      t, s: real): real =
    (x_coord(g(s)) - x_coord(g(t))
      - x_coord(velocity) * (s - t)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(g(s)) - y_coord(g(t))
        - y_coord(velocity) * (s - t)) ^ 2

  has_curve_derivative_at(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      velocity: point,
      t: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (s: real):
          (NOT (s = t) AND abs(s - t) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            curve_derivative_error_squared(g, velocity, t, s)
              < eps ^ 2 * (s - t) ^ 2

  curve_velocity(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      t: real): point =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (velocity: point):
        has_curve_derivative_at(g, velocity, t))

  positive_gauge(gauge: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real): 0 < gauge(x)

  tagged_partition(
      a, b: real,
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): bool =
    points(0) = a
      AND points(count) = b
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)))

  gauge_fine(
      gauge: real_function,
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        (tags(index) - gauge(tags(index)) < points(index)
          AND points(index + 1)
            < tags(index) + gauge(tags(index)))

  tagged_sum(
      f: real_function,
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      tagged_sum(f, count - 1, points, tags)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * (points(count) - points(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_unit_interval_integral(
      f: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (gauge: real_function):
        positive_gauge(gauge)
          AND (FORALL
              (count: nat),
              (points, tags: real_sequence):
            (tagged_partition(0, 1, count, points, tags)
              AND gauge_fine(gauge, count, points, tags))
            IMPLIES
              abs(tagged_sum(f, count, points, tags)
                - integral_value) < eps)

  unit_interval_integrable(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: real):
      has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value)

  unit_interval_integral(f: real_function): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
        has_unit_interval_integral(f, integral_value))

  valid_box(rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) < right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) < top(rectangle)

  in_closed_box(p: point, rectangle: box): bool =
    left(rectangle) <= x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) <= right(rectangle)
      AND bottom(rectangle) <= y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) <= top(rectangle)

  box_contained_in(
      inner, outer: box): bool =
    left(outer) <= left(inner)
      AND right(inner) <= right(outer)
      AND bottom(outer) <= bottom(inner)
      AND top(inner) <= top(outer)

  box_content(rectangle: box): real =
    (right(rectangle) - left(rectangle))
      * (top(rectangle) - bottom(rectangle))

  box_interiors_overlap(
      first, second: box): bool =
    left(first) < right(second)
      AND left(second) < right(first)
      AND bottom(first) < top(second)
      AND bottom(second) < top(first)

  tagged_box_division(
      parent: box,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): bool =
    valid_box(parent)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (valid_box(rectangles(index))
            AND box_contained_in(rectangles(index), parent)
            AND in_closed_box(tags(index), rectangles(index))))
      AND (FORALL (first, second: nat):
        first < second AND second < count IMPLIES
          NOT box_interiors_overlap(
            rectangles(first), rectangles(second)))
      AND (FORALL (p: point):
        in_closed_box(p, parent) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < count
              AND in_closed_box(p, rectangles(index)))

  positive_planar_gauge(gauge: scalar_field): bool =
    FORALL (p: point): 0 < gauge(p)

  box_gauge_fine(
      gauge: scalar_field,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        (x_coord(tags(index)) - gauge(tags(index))
            < left(rectangles(index))
          AND right(rectangles(index))
            < x_coord(tags(index)) + gauge(tags(index))
          AND y_coord(tags(index)) - gauge(tags(index))
            < bottom(rectangles(index))
          AND top(rectangles(index))
            < y_coord(tags(index)) + gauge(tags(index)))

  tagged_box_sum(
      f: scalar_field,
      count: nat,
      rectangles: box_sequence,
      tags: point_sequence): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      tagged_box_sum(f, count - 1, rectangles, tags)
        + f(tags(count - 1))
            * box_content(rectangles(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_box_integral(
      f: scalar_field,
      parent: box,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    valid_box(parent)
      AND FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS (gauge: scalar_field):
          positive_planar_gauge(gauge)
            AND (FORALL
                (count: nat),
                (rectangles: box_sequence),
                (tags: point_sequence):
              (tagged_box_division(
                  parent, count, rectangles, tags)
                AND box_gauge_fine(
                  gauge, count, rectangles, tags))
              IMPLIES
                abs(tagged_box_sum(
                  f, count, rectangles, tags)
                    - integral_value) < eps)

  region_subset_of_box(
      region: planar_region,
      rectangle: box): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES in_closed_box(p, rectangle)

  restrict_to_region(
      f: scalar_field,
      region: planar_region): scalar_field =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF region(p) THEN f(p) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  has_area_integral(
      f: scalar_field,
      region: planar_region,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (parent: box):
      region_subset_of_box(region, parent)
        AND has_box_integral(
          restrict_to_region(f, region),
          parent,
          integral_value)

  area_integrable_on(
      f: scalar_field,
      region: planar_region): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: real):
      has_area_integral(f, region, integral_value)

  area_integral(
      f: scalar_field,
      region: planar_region): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
        has_area_integral(f, region, integral_value))

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  winding_integrand(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      p: point): real_function =
    LAMBDA (t: real):
      safe_div(
        (x_coord(g(t)) - x_coord(p))
            * y_coord(curve_velocity(g, t))
          - (y_coord(g(t)) - y_coord(p))
            * x_coord(curve_velocity(g, t)),
        squared_distance(g(t), p))

  has_winding_number_one(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      p: point): bool =
    has_unit_interval_integral(
      winding_integrand(g, p),
      2 * pi)

  positively_oriented_on_inside(
      g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      inside_region(path_image(g))(p) IMPLIES
        has_winding_number_one(g, p)

  line_integrand(
      f: vector_field,
      g: parametrized_curve): real_function =
    LAMBDA (t: real):
      y_coord(f(g(t))) * x_coord(curve_velocity(g, t))
        + x_coord(f(g(t))) * y_coord(curve_velocity(g, t))

  curl_integrand(f: vector_field): scalar_field =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      j11(jacobian_at(f, p))
        - j22(jacobian_at(f, p))

  green_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (f: vector_field),
        (g: parametrized_curve),
        (u: planar_region):
      (absolutely_continuous_on_unit_interval(g)
        AND closed_path(g)
        AND positively_oriented_on_inside(g)
        AND open_region(u)
        AND inside_and_path_subset(g, u)
        AND differentiable_on(f, u)
        AND continuous_jacobian_on(f, u))
      IMPLIES
        (area_integrable_on(
            curl_integrand(f),
            inside_region(path_image(g)))
          AND unit_interval_integrable(line_integrand(f, g))
          AND unit_interval_integral(line_integrand(f, g))
            = area_integral(
                curl_integrand(f),
                inside_region(path_image(g))))
END green_s_theorem_021

content:

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Pointwise.Interval
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Rat.Cardinal
public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Continuum

/-!
# The cardinality of the reals

This file shows that the real numbers have cardinality continuum, i.e. `#ℝ = 𝔠`.

We show that `#ℝ ≤ 𝔠` by noting that every real number is determined by a Cauchy-sequence of the
form `ℕ → ℚ`, which has cardinality `𝔠`. To show that `#ℝ ≥ 𝔠` we define an injection from
`{0, 1} ^ ℕ` to `ℝ` with `f ↦ Σ n, f n * (1 / 3) ^ n`.

We conclude that all intervals with distinct endpoints have cardinality continuum.

## Main definitions

* `Cardinal.cantorFunction` is the function that sends `f` in `{0, 1} ^ ℕ` to `ℝ` by
  `f ↦ Σ' n, f n * (1 / 3) ^ n`

## Main statements

* `Cardinal.mk_real : #ℝ = 𝔠`: the reals have cardinality continuum.
* `Cardinal.not_countable_real`: the universal set of real numbers is not countable.
  We can use this same proof to show that all the other sets in this file are not countable.
* 8 lemmas of the form `mk_Ixy_real` for `x,y ∈ {i,o,c}` state that intervals on the reals
  have cardinality continuum.

## Notation

* `𝔠` : notation for `Cardinal.continuum` in scope `Cardinal`, defined in `SetTheory.Continuum`.

## Tags
continuum, cardinality, reals, cardinality of the reals
-/

@[expose] public section


open Nat Set

open Cardinal

noncomputable section

namespace Cardinal

variable {c : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → Bool} {n : ℕ}

/-- The body of the sum in `cantorFunction`.
`cantorFunctionAux c f n = c ^ n` if `f n = true`;
`cantorFunctionAux c f n = 0` if `f n = false`. -/
def cantorFunctionAux (c : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  cond (f n) (c ^ n) 0

@[simp]
theorem cantorFunctionAux_true (h : f n = true) : cantorFunctionAux c f n = c ^ n := by sorry
theorem cantorFunctionAux_false (h : f n = false) : cantorFunctionAux c f n = 0 := by sorry
theorem cantorFunctionAux_nonneg (h : 0 ≤ c) : 0 ≤ cantorFunctionAux c f n := by sorry
theorem cantorFunctionAux_eq (h : f n = g n) :
    cantorFunctionAux c f n = cantorFunctionAux c g n := by simp [cantorFunctionAux, h]

theorem cantorFunctionAux_zero (f : ℕ → Bool) : cantorFunctionAux c f 0 = cond (f 0) 1 0 := by sorry
theorem cantorFunctionAux_succ (f : ℕ → Bool) :
    (fun n => cantorFunctionAux c f (n + 1)) = fun n =>
      c * cantorFunctionAux c (fun n => f (n + 1)) n := by sorry
theorem summable_cantor_function (f : ℕ → Bool) (h1 : 0 ≤ c) (h2 : c < 1) :
    Summable (cantorFunctionAux c f) := by sorry
def cantorFunction (c : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n, cantorFunctionAux c f n

theorem cantorFunction_le (h1 : 0 ≤ c) (h2 : c < 1) (h3 : ∀ n, f n → g n) :
    cantorFunction c f ≤ cantorFunction c g := by sorry
theorem cantorFunction_succ (f : ℕ → Bool) (h1 : 0 ≤ c) (h2 : c < 1) :
    cantorFunction c f = cond (f 0) 1 0 + c * cantorFunction c fun n => f (n + 1) := by sorry
theorem increasing_cantorFunction (h1 : 0 < c) (h2 : c < 1 / 2) {n : ℕ} {f g : ℕ → Bool}
    (hn : ∀ k < n, f k = g k) (fn : f n = false) (gn : g n = true) :
    cantorFunction c f < cantorFunction c g := by sorry
theorem cantorFunction_injective (h1 : 0 < c) (h2 : c < 1 / 2) :
    Function.Injective (cantorFunction c) := by sorry
theorem mk_real : #ℝ = 𝔠 := by sorry
theorem mk_univ_real : #(Set.univ : Set ℝ) = 𝔠 := by rw [mk_univ, mk_real]

/-- **Non-Denumerability of the Continuum**: The reals are not countable. -/
instance : Uncountable ℝ := by sorry
theorem not_countable_real : ¬(Set.univ : Set ℝ).Countable :=
  not_countable_univ

/-- The cardinality of the interval $(a, ∞)$. -/
theorem mk_Ioi_real (a : ℝ) : #(Ioi a) = 𝔠 := by sorry
theorem mk_Ici_real (a : ℝ) : #(Ici a) = 𝔠 :=
  le_antisymm (mk_real ▸ mk_set_le _) (mk_Ioi_real a ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset Ioi_subset_Ici_self)

/-- The cardinality of the interval $(-∞, a)$. -/
theorem mk_Iio_real (a : ℝ) : #(Iio a) = 𝔠 := by sorry
theorem mk_Iic_real (a : ℝ) : #(Iic a) = 𝔠 :=
  le_antisymm (mk_real ▸ mk_set_le _) (mk_Iio_real a ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset Iio_subset_Iic_self)

/-- The cardinality of the interval $(a, b)$. -/
theorem mk_Ioo_real {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) : #(Ioo a b) = 𝔠 := by sorry
theorem mk_Ico_real {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) : #(Ico a b) = 𝔠 :=
  le_antisymm (mk_real ▸ mk_set_le _) (mk_Ioo_real h ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset Ioo_subset_Ico_self)

/-- The cardinality of the interval $[a, b]$. -/
theorem mk_Icc_real {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) : #(Icc a b) = 𝔠 :=
  le_antisymm (mk_real ▸ mk_set_le _) (mk_Ioo_real h ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset Ioo_subset_Icc_self)

/-- The cardinality of the interval $(a, b]$. -/
theorem mk_Ioc_real {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) : #(Ioc a b) = 𝔠 :=
  le_antisymm (mk_real ▸ mk_set_le _) (mk_Ioo_real h ▸ mk_le_mk_of_subset Ioo_subset_Ioc_self)

@[simp]
lemma Real.Ioo_countable_iff {x y : ℝ} :
    (Ioo x y).Countable ↔ y ≤ x := by sorry
lemma Real.Ico_countable_iff {x y : ℝ} :
    (Ico x y).Countable ↔ y ≤ x := by sorry
lemma Real.Ioc_countable_iff {x y : ℝ} :
    (Ioc x y).Countable ↔ y ≤ x := by sorry
lemma Real.Icc_countable_iff {x y : ℝ} :
    (Icc x y).Countable ↔ y ≤ x := by sorry
end Cardinal

You should have received a copy of the GNU Lesser General Public
License along with this library; if not, write to the Free Software
Foundation, Inc., 51 Franklin Street, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA  02110-1301,
USA.
*)

Require Import Reals.
Require Import Lra.

Open Scope R_scope.
(* begin hide *)

Lemma epsilon_2 : forall x, 0 < x -> x / 2 < x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rabs_include :
  forall x y u v, x <= u <= y -> x <= v <= y -> Rabs (u - v) <= Rabs (x - y).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rabs_max : forall x y d, Rabs (x - y) <= d -> x <= y + d.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rabs_min : forall x y d, Rabs (x - y) <= d -> x - d <= y.
Proof.
Admitted.

Section middle_facts.

Definition middle (x y : R) := (x + y) / 2.

Variables x y x' y': R.

Lemma Rlt_middle_r : x < y -> (middle x y) < y.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rlt_middle_l : x < y -> x < middle x y.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma middle_sym : middle x y = middle y x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma middle_minus : x - (middle x y) = (x - y) / 2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma middle_dist : R_dist x (middle x y) = (R_dist x y) / 2.
Proof.
Admitted.

End middle_facts.

Section succ_facts.

Definition succ x y k :=
  let m := middle x y in
  let loc := total_order_T m k in
  match loc with
  | inleft (left _) => (x, m)
  | inleft (right _) => (x, middle x m)
  | inright _ => (m, y)
  end
.

Variable x y k : R.
Hypothesis H : x < y.

Lemma succ_compat : fst (succ x y k) < snd (succ x y k).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma succ_not_in : ~ (fst (succ x y k) <= k <= snd (succ x y k)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma succ_included_l : x <= fst (succ x y k).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma succ_included_r : snd (succ x y k) <= y.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma succ_dist : R_dist (fst (succ x y k)) (snd (succ x y k)) <= (R_dist x y) / 2.
Proof.
Admitted.

End succ_facts.

Section CantorDiagonal.

Variable lb ub : R.
Hypothesis not_empty : lb < ub. 
Variable f : nat -> R.

Definition Rn n := f n.

Fixpoint Dn n {struct n} :=
  match n with
  | O => succ lb ub (Rn O)
  | S m =>
    succ (fst (Dn m)) (snd (Dn m)) (Rn n)
  end
.

Lemma non_zero_dist : R_dist lb ub > 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma diagonal_compat : forall n, fst (Dn n) < snd (Dn n).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma diagonal_included_l : forall n p, (n <= p)%nat -> fst (Dn n) <= fst (Dn p).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma diagonal_included_r : forall n p, (n <= p)%nat -> snd (Dn p) <= snd (Dn n).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma diagonal_dist : forall n, R_dist (fst (Dn n)) (snd (Dn n)) <= (R_dist lb ub) * ((/2) ^ (S n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma diagonal_not_in : forall n p, (n <= p)%nat -> ~ (fst (Dn p) <= Rn n <= snd (Dn p)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition Ln n := middle (fst (Dn n)) (snd (Dn n)).

Lemma sequence_bound : forall n p, (n <= p)%nat -> (fst (Dn n)) <= Ln p <= (snd (Dn n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma sequence_cauchy : forall n p q, (p >= n)%nat -> (q >= n)%nat -> R_dist (Ln p) (Ln q) < (R_dist lb ub) * (/2) ^ n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma sequence_cauchy_crit : Cauchy_crit Ln.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma sequence_cv : { l : R | Un_cv Ln l }.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition l := proj1_sig sequence_cv.
Definition l_is_limit := proj2_sig sequence_cv.

Lemma l_in_Dn : forall n, fst (Dn n) <= l <= snd (Dn n).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma l_not_in_Rn : forall n, ~(Rn n = l).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma l_in_segment : lb <= l <= ub.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma segment_uncountable : { l | forall n, l <> Rn n }.
Proof.
Admitted.

End CantorDiagonal.
(* end hide *)

(** * R is uncountable. *)

Theorem R_uncountable_strong :
  forall (f : nat -> R) (x y : R), x < y -> {l : R | forall n, l <> f n & x <= l <= y}.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem R_uncountable : forall (f : nat -> R), {l : R | forall n, l <> f n}.
Proof.
Admitted.

(*  Title:      HOL/Analysis/Continuum_Not_Denumerable.thy
    Author:     Benjamin Porter, Monash University, NICTA, 2005
    Author:     Johannes Hölzl, TU München
*)

section \<open>Non-Denumerability of the Continuum\<close>

theory Continuum_Not_Denumerable
imports
  Complex_Main 
  "HOL-Library.Countable_Set"
begin

subsection\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> \<open>Abstract\<close>

text \<open>
  The following document presents a proof that the Continuum is uncountable.
  It is formalised in the Isabelle/Isar theorem proving system.

  \<^bold>\<open>Theorem:\<close> The Continuum \<open>\<real>\<close> is not denumerable. In other words, there does
  not exist a function \<open>f: \<nat> \<Rightarrow> \<real>\<close> such that \<open>f\<close> is surjective.

  \<^bold>\<open>Outline:\<close> An elegant informal proof of this result uses Cantor's
  Diagonalisation argument. The proof presented here is not this one.

  First we formalise some properties of closed intervals, then we prove the
  Nested Interval Property. This property relies on the completeness of the
  Real numbers and is the foundation for our argument. Informally it states
  that an intersection of countable closed intervals (where each successive
  interval is a subset of the last) is non-empty. We then assume a surjective
  function \<open>f: \<nat> \<Rightarrow> \<real>\<close> exists and find a real \<open>x\<close> such that \<open>x\<close> is not in the
  range of \<open>f\<close> by generating a sequence of closed intervals then using the
  Nested Interval Property.
\<close>
text\<^marker>\<open>tag important\<close> \<open>%whitespace\<close>
theorem real_non_denum: "\<nexists>f :: nat \<Rightarrow> real. surj f"
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_UNIV_real: "uncountable (UNIV :: real set)"
  by sorry

corollary complex_non_denum: "\<nexists>f :: nat \<Rightarrow> complex. surj f"
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_UNIV_complex: "uncountable (UNIV :: complex set)"
  by sorry

lemma bij_betw_open_intervals:
  fixes a b c d :: real
  assumes "a < b" "c < d"
  shows "\<exists>f. bij_betw f {a<..<b} {c<..<d}"
  by sorry

lemma bij_betw_tan: "bij_betw tan {-pi/2<..<pi/2} UNIV"
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_open_interval: "uncountable {a<..<b} \<longleftrightarrow> a < b" for a b :: real
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_half_open_interval_1: "uncountable {a..<b} \<longleftrightarrow> a < b" for a b :: real
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_half_open_interval_2: "uncountable {a<..b} \<longleftrightarrow> a < b" for a b :: real
  by sorry

lemma real_interval_avoid_countable_set:
  fixes a b :: real and A :: "real set"
  assumes "a < b" and "countable A"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>{a<..<b}. x \<notin> A"
  by sorry

lemma uncountable_closed_interval: "uncountable {a..b} \<longleftrightarrow> a < b" for a b :: real
  by sorry

lemma open_minus_countable:
  fixes S A :: "real set"
  assumes "countable A" "S \<noteq> {}" "open S"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>S. x \<notin> A"
  by sorry

end

title: 022_the_non-denumerability_of_the_continuum
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Non-Denumerability of the Continuum" from Hundred
-- Theorems item 022: every function from the natural numbers to the real continuum omits
-- some real, so no such function is surjective. This file contains no proof.

module NonDenumerabilityContinuum where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field presents the real number system.
record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum) and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

non-denumerability-of-the-continuum : Set₁
non-denumerability-of-the-continuum =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (enumerate : Nat -> R) ->
  Exists R (\ x -> (n : Nat) -> x != enumerate n)
