title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
/-
Copyright (c) 2020 Paul van Wamelen. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Paul van Wamelen
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Data.Int.NatPrime
public import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Int.Basic
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Field

/-!
# Pythagorean Triples

The main result is the classification of Pythagorean triples. The final result is for general
Pythagorean triples. It follows from the more interesting relatively prime case. We use the
"rational parametrization of the circle" method for the proof. The parametrization maps the point
`(x / z, y / z)` to the slope of the line through `(-1, 0)` and `(x / z, y / z)`. This quickly
shows that `(x / z, y / z) = (2 * m * n / (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2), (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) / (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2))` where
`m / n` is the slope. In order to identify numerators and denominators we now need results showing
that these are coprime. This is easy except for the prime 2. In order to deal with that we have to
analyze the parity of `x`, `y`, `m` and `n` and eliminate all the impossible cases. This takes up
the bulk of the proof below.
-/

@[expose] public section

assert_not_exists TwoSidedIdeal

theorem sq_ne_two_fin_zmod_four (z : ZMod 4) : z * z ≠ 2 := by sorry
theorem Int.sq_ne_two_mod_four (z : ℤ) : z * z % 4 ≠ 2 := by sorry
def PythagoreanTriple (x y z : ℤ) : Prop :=
  x * x + y * y = z * z

/-- Pythagorean triples are interchangeable, i.e `x * x + y * y = y * y + x * x = z * z`.
This comes from additive commutativity. -/
theorem pythagoreanTriple_comm {x y z : ℤ} : PythagoreanTriple x y z ↔ PythagoreanTriple y x z := by sorry
theorem PythagoreanTriple.zero : PythagoreanTriple 0 0 0 := by sorry
namespace PythagoreanTriple

variable {x y z : ℤ}

theorem eq (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z) : x * x + y * y = z * z :=
  h

@[symm]
theorem symm (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z) : PythagoreanTriple y x z := by sorry
theorem mul (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z) (k : ℤ) : PythagoreanTriple (k * x) (k * y) (k * z) :=
  calc
    k * x * (k * x) + k * y * (k * y) = k ^ 2 * (x * x + y * y) := by ring
    _ = k ^ 2 * (z * z) := by rw [h.eq]
    _ = k * z * (k * z) := by ring

/-- `(k*x, k*y, k*z)` is a Pythagorean triple if and only if
`(x, y, z)` is also a triple. -/
theorem mul_iff (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    PythagoreanTriple (k * x) (k * y) (k * z) ↔ PythagoreanTriple x y z := by sorry
def IsClassified (_ : PythagoreanTriple x y z) :=
  ∃ k m n : ℤ,
    (x = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧ y = k * (2 * m * n) ∨
        x = k * (2 * m * n) ∧ y = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ∧
      Int.gcd m n = 1

/-- A primitive Pythagorean triple `x, y, z` is a Pythagorean triple with `x` and `y` coprime.
Such a triple is “primitively classified” if there exist coprime integers `m, n` such that either
* `x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2` and `y = 2 * m * n`, or
* `x = 2 * m * n` and `y = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2`.
-/
@[nolint unusedArguments]
def IsPrimitiveClassified (_ : PythagoreanTriple x y z) :=
  ∃ m n : ℤ,
    (x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ∧ y = 2 * m * n ∨ x = 2 * m * n ∧ y = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧
      Int.gcd m n = 1 ∧ (m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0)

variable (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z)
include h

theorem mul_isClassified (k : ℤ) (hc : h.IsClassified) : (h.mul k).IsClassified := by sorry
theorem even_odd_of_coprime (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) :
    x % 2 = 0 ∧ y % 2 = 1 ∨ x % 2 = 1 ∧ y % 2 = 0 := by sorry
theorem gcd_dvd : (Int.gcd x y : ℤ) ∣ z := by sorry
theorem normalize : PythagoreanTriple (x / Int.gcd x y) (y / Int.gcd x y) (z / Int.gcd x y) := by sorry
theorem isClassified_of_isPrimitiveClassified (hp : h.IsPrimitiveClassified) : h.IsClassified := by sorry
theorem isClassified_of_normalize_isPrimitiveClassified (hc : h.normalize.IsPrimitiveClassified) :
    h.IsClassified := by sorry
theorem ne_zero_of_coprime (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) : z ≠ 0 := by sorry
theorem isPrimitiveClassified_of_coprime_of_zero_left (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) (hx : x = 0) :
    h.IsPrimitiveClassified := by sorry
theorem coprime_of_coprime (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) : Int.gcd y z = 1 := by sorry
end PythagoreanTriple

section circleEquivGen

/-!
### A parametrization of the unit circle

For the classification of Pythagorean triples, we will use a parametrization of the unit circle.
-/


variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

-- Non-terminal simp, used to be field_simp
set_option linter.flexible false in
-- see https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/issues/29041
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false in
/-- A parameterization of the unit circle that is useful for classifying Pythagorean triples.
(To be applied in the case where `K = ℚ`.) -/
def circleEquivGen (hk : ∀ x : K, 1 + x ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    K ≃ { p : K × K // p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = 1 ∧ p.2 ≠ -1 } where
  toFun x :=
    ⟨⟨2 * x / (1 + x ^ 2), (1 - x ^ 2) / (1 + x ^ 2)⟩, by field [hk x], by
      simp only [Ne, div_eq_iff (hk x), neg_mul, one_mul, neg_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_left_inj]
      simpa only [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, one_pow] using hk 1⟩
  invFun p := (p : K × K).1 / ((p : K × K).2 + 1)
  left_inv x := by sorry
theorem circleEquivGen_apply (hk : ∀ x : K, 1 + x ^ 2 ≠ 0) (x : K) :
    (circleEquivGen hk x : K × K) = ⟨2 * x / (1 + x ^ 2), (1 - x ^ 2) / (1 + x ^ 2)⟩ :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem circleEquivGen_symm_apply (hk : ∀ x : K, 1 + x ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (v : { p : K × K // p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = 1 ∧ p.2 ≠ -1 }) :
    (circleEquivGen hk).symm v = (v : K × K).1 / ((v : K × K).2 + 1) :=
  rfl

end circleEquivGen

private theorem coprime_sq_sub_sq_add_of_even_odd {m n : ℤ} (h : Int.gcd m n = 1) (hm : m % 2 = 0)
    (hn : n % 2 = 1) : Int.gcd (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) = 1 := by sorry
namespace PythagoreanTriple

variable {x y z : ℤ} (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z)

theorem isPrimitiveClassified_aux (hc : x.gcd y = 1) (hzpos : 0 < z) {m n : ℤ}
    (hm2n2 : 0 < m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) (hv2 : (x : ℚ) / z = 2 * m * n / ((m : ℚ) ^ 2 + (n : ℚ) ^ 2))
    (hw2 : (y : ℚ) / z = ((m : ℚ) ^ 2 - (n : ℚ) ^ 2) / ((m : ℚ) ^ 2 + (n : ℚ) ^ 2))
    (H : Int.gcd (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) = 1) (co : Int.gcd m n = 1)
    (pp : m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0) : h.IsPrimitiveClassified := by sorry
theorem isPrimitiveClassified_of_coprime_of_odd_of_pos (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) (hyo : y % 2 = 1)
    (hzpos : 0 < z) : h.IsPrimitiveClassified := by sorry
theorem isPrimitiveClassified_of_coprime_of_pos (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) (hzpos : 0 < z) :
    h.IsPrimitiveClassified := by sorry
theorem isPrimitiveClassified_of_coprime (hc : Int.gcd x y = 1) : h.IsPrimitiveClassified := by sorry
theorem classified : h.IsClassified := by sorry
theorem coprime_classification :
    PythagoreanTriple x y z ∧ Int.gcd x y = 1 ↔
      ∃ m n,
        (x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ∧ y = 2 * m * n ∨ x = 2 * m * n ∧ y = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧
          (z = m ^ 2 + n ^ 2 ∨ z = -(m ^ 2 + n ^ 2)) ∧
            Int.gcd m n = 1 ∧ (m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0) := by sorry
theorem coprime_classification' {x y z : ℤ} (h : PythagoreanTriple x y z)
    (h_coprime : Int.gcd x y = 1) (h_parity : x % 2 = 1) (h_pos : 0 < z) :
    ∃ m n,
      x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ∧
        y = 2 * m * n ∧
          z = m ^ 2 + n ^ 2 ∧
            Int.gcd m n = 1 ∧ (m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ m := by sorry
theorem classification :
    PythagoreanTriple x y z ↔
      ∃ k m n,
        (x = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧ y = k * (2 * m * n) ∨
            x = k * (2 * m * n) ∧ y = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ∧
          (z = k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) ∨ z = -k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2)) := by sorry
end PythagoreanTriple

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
(* Pythagorean.v *)

(***********************)
(* Pythagorean triples *)
(***********************)

Require Export Tactics.

(* A non nul predicate *)
Definition nnl_triple (a b c : Z) := ~(a = 0) /\ ~(b = 0) /\ ~(c = 0).

(* A positive predicate *)
Definition pos_triple (a b c : Z) := (a >= 0) /\ (b >= 0) /\ (c >= 0).

(* A Pythagorean predicate *)
Definition is_pytha (a b c : Z) := (pos_triple a b c) /\ a * a + b * b = c * c.

(* Unit circle and D_r *)
Definition in_ucirc (x y : R) := (x * x + y * y = 1)%R.
Definition D_r (r x y : R) := (y = r * (x + 1))%R.

(******************************)
(* Set of Pythagorean triples *)
(******************************)

(* step1 *)

Lemma pytha_ucirc1 : forall a b c : Z,
  (c > 0) -> (is_pytha a b c) -> (in_ucirc (frac a c) (frac b c)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma pytha_ucirc2 : forall a b c : Z, (a >= 0) /\ (b >= 0) /\ (c > 0) ->
  (in_ucirc (frac a c) (frac b c)) -> (is_pytha a b c).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* step 2 *)

(* Intersection between the unit circle and D_r *)
Definition interCDr (r x y : R) := (in_ucirc x y) /\ (D_r r x y).

(* Points of the intersection *)
Definition p1 := (-1,0)%R.
Definition p2 (r : R) :=
  let den := (1 + r * r)%R in
  ((1 - r * r) / den, 2 * r / den)%R.

(* Equality over points *)
Definition eqp (p1 p2 : R * R) := (fst p1) = (fst p2) /\ (snd p1)= (snd p2).

(* Total order over points (using R) *)
Lemma ordp : forall p1 p2 : R * R, (eqp p1 p2) \/ ~(eqp p1 p2).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Characterization of the intersection *)
Lemma interCDr_sol : forall r x y : R,
  (interCDr r x y) -> (eqp (x,y) p1) \/ (eqp (x,y) (p2 r)).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* step 3 *)

Lemma rat_coo1 : forall x y : R, (in_ucirc x y) /\
  (exists r : R, (is_rat r) /\ (interCDr r x y)) -> (is_ratp (x,y)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma rat_coo2 : forall x y : R, (in_ucirc x y) /\ (is_ratp (x,y)) ->
  exists r : R, (is_rat r) /\ (interCDr r x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* step 4 *)

(* Positivity predicate over points *)
Definition is_posp (c : R * R) := (fst c >= 0)%R /\ (snd c >= 0)%R.

(* Predicate for the positive rational coordinates of the unit circle *)
Definition is_ucp (c : R * R) :=
  (in_ucirc (fst c) (snd c)) /\ (is_ratp c) /\ (is_posp c).

(* Positive rational coordinates of the unit circle *)
Definition ucp (p q : Z) :=
  let pr := (IZR p) in
  let qr := (IZR q) in
  let den := (pr * pr + qr * qr)%R in
  ((qr * qr - pr * pr) / den, (2 * pr * qr) / den)%R.

(* A basic condition over p and q *)
Definition cond_pqb (p q : Z) := p >= 0 /\ q > 0 /\ p <= q /\ (rel_prime p q).

(* Set of positive rational coordinates of the unit circle *)
Definition in_ucp_setb (x y : R) :=
  exists p : Z, exists q : Z,
  x = (fst (ucp p q)) /\ y = (snd (ucp p q)) /\ (cond_pqb p q).

Lemma rat_pos_coo1 : forall x y : R, (is_ucp (x,y)) ->
  exists r : R, (is_rat r) /\ (r >= 0)%R /\ (r <= 1)%R /\ x = (fst (p2 r)) /\
  y = (snd (p2 r)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma rat_pos_coo2 : forall x y : R, (is_ucp (x,y)) -> (in_ucp_setb x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Step 5 *)

(* The full condition over p and q *)
Definition cond_pq (p q : Z) := cond_pqb p q /\ (distinct_parity p q).

(* The (new) set of positive rational coordinates of the unit circle *)
Definition in_ucp_set (x y : R) :=
  exists p : Z, exists q : Z,
  (x = (fst (ucp p q)) /\ y = (snd (ucp p q)) \/
   x = (snd (ucp p q)) /\ y = (fst (ucp p q))) /\ (cond_pq p q).

(* Inclusion of in_ucp_set in in_ucp_setb *)
Lemma nrat_pos_coo1 : forall x y : R, (in_ucp_set x y) -> (in_ucp_setb x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Inclusion of in_ucp_setb in in_ucp_set *)
Lemma nrat_pos_coo2 : forall x y : R, (in_ucp_setb x y) -> (in_ucp_set x y).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* step 6 *)

(* The set of Pythagorean triples *)
Definition pytha_set (a b c : Z) :=
  exists p : Z, exists q : Z, exists m : Z,
    (a = m * (q * q - p * p) /\ b = 2 * m * (p * q) \/
     a = 2 * m * (p * q) /\ b = m * (q * q - p * p)) /\
    c = m * (p * p + q * q) /\ m >= 0 /\ (cond_pq p q).

(* Relative primality and fractions *)
Lemma relp_frac : forall a b c d : Z,
  (b <> 0) -> (d <> 0) -> (frac a b) = (frac c d) -> (rel_prime c d) ->
  exists m : Z, m <> 0 /\ b = m * d.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma pytha_thm1 : forall a b c : Z, (is_pytha a b c) -> (pytha_set a b c).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma pytha_thm2 : forall a b c : Z, (pytha_set a b c) -> (is_pytha a b c).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* A specific case *)

Definition pytha_set_even (a b c : Z) :=
  exists p : Z, exists q : Z, exists m : Z,
    a = m * (q * q - p * p) /\ b = 2 * m * (p * q) /\
    c = m * (p * p + q * q) /\ m >= 0 /\ (cond_pq p q).

Lemma pytha_thm3 : forall a b c : Z,
  is_pytha a b c -> Zodd a -> pytha_set_even a b c.
Proof.
Admitted.

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 023, "Formula for Pythagorean
  Triples": the integer solutions of x^2 + y^2 = z^2 are exactly the scaled Euclidean
  parametrizations, allowing either leg order and either sign for z. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Formula_for_Pythagorean_Triples
  imports Main
begin

theorem formula_for_pythagorean_triples:
  fixes x y z :: int
  shows "x * x + y * y = z * z \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>k m n :: int.
      ((x = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) \<and> y = k * (2 * m * n)) \<or>
       (x = k * (2 * m * n) \<and> y = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2))) \<and>
      (z = k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) \<or> z = -k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2)))"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems
  item 023, classifying integer solutions of x^2 + y^2 = z^2. This file contains no proof.
*)

let FORMULA_FOR_PYTHAGOREAN_TRIPLES =
  `!x y z:int.
      x pow 2 + y pow 2 = z pow 2 <=>
      ?k m n:int.
        ((x = k * (m pow 2 - n pow 2) /\
          y = k * (&2 * m * n)) \/
         (x = k * (&2 * m * n) /\
          y = k * (m pow 2 - n pow 2))) /\
        (z = k * (m pow 2 + n pow 2) \/
         z = --k * (m pow 2 + n pow 2))`;;

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__023, "Formula for Pythagorean Triples": integer
;; solutions of x^2 + y^2 = z^2 are exactly the scaled Euclidean
;; parametrizations, allowing the legs to be exchanged and either sign for z.
;; Bounded searches from -abs(z) through abs(z) encode the existential integer
;; parameters k, m, and n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun hundred-theorems-023-integer-abs (z)
  (if (integerp z)
      (if (< z 0)
          (- z)
        z)
    0))

(defun hundred-theorems-023-pythagorean-triple-p (x y z)
  (and (integerp x)
       (integerp y)
       (integerp z)
       (equal (+ (* x x) (* y y))
              (* z z))))

(defun hundred-theorems-023-parameterized-triple-p
    (x y z k m n)
  (and (integerp x)
       (integerp y)
       (integerp z)
       (integerp k)
       (integerp m)
       (integerp n)
       (or (and (equal x
                       (* k (- (* m m) (* n n))))
                (equal y
                       (* k (* 2 (* m n)))))
           (and (equal x
                       (* k (* 2 (* m n))))

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems item
-- 023. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixl 6 _+z_ _-z_
infixl 7 _*z_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 2 _∨_
infix 1 _↔_

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  or-left : A → A ∨ B
  or-right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A → Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

negateInt : Int → Int
negateInt (pos n) = negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

_+z_ : Int → Int → Int
pos m +z pos n = pos (m + n)
pos m +z negsuc n = difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +z pos n = difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +z negsuc n = negsuc (suc (m + n))

_-z_ : Int → Int → Int
x -z y = x +z negateInt y

_*z_ : Int → Int → Int
pos m *z pos n = pos (m * n)
pos m *z negsuc n = negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *z pos n = negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *z negsuc n = pos (suc m * suc n)

square : Int → Int
square x = x *z x

PythagoreanTriple : Int → Int → Int → Set
PythagoreanTriple x y z =
  square x +z square y ≡ square z

oddLeg : Int → Int → Int → Int
oddLeg k m n = k *z (square m -z square n)

evenLeg : Int → Int → Int → Int
evenLeg k m n = k *z ((pos 2 *z m) *z n)

hypotenuse : Int → Int → Int → Int
hypotenuse k m n = k *z (square m +z square n)

ParameterizedTriple : Int → Int → Int → Int → Int → Int → Set
ParameterizedTriple x y z k m n =
  (((x ≡ oddLeg k m n) ∧ (y ≡ evenLeg k m n)) ∨
   ((x ≡ evenLeg k m n) ∧ (y ≡ oddLeg k m n))) ∧
  ((z ≡ hypotenuse k m n) ∨
   (z ≡ hypotenuse (negateInt k) m n))

formula-for-pythagorean-triples : Set
formula-for-pythagorean-triples =
  (x y z : Int) →
  PythagoreanTriple x y z ↔
  Exists Int (λ k →
    Exists Int (λ m →
      Exists Int (λ n →
        ParameterizedTriple x y z k m n)))

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems item
  023. It classifies integer solutions to x^2 + y^2 = z^2 by square-difference and double-product
  parameters, allowing the legs to be exchanged and either sign for z. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory;

val formula_for_pythagorean_triples =
  ``!(x : int) (y : int) (z : int).
      x * x + y * y = z * z <=>
      ?k m n : int.
        ((x = k * (m * m - n * n) /\
          y = k * (2 * m * n)) \/
         (x = k * (2 * m * n) /\
          y = k * (m * m - n * n))) /\
        (z = k * (m * m + n * n) \/
         z = -k * (m * m + n * n))``;

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems item
  023: the general integer classification and its normalized nonnegative form. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The imported set.mm database supplies the standard integers ZZ, arithmetic,
  order, gcd, and the classes Even and Odd. The first assertion classifies all
  integer solutions, with either ordering of the legs and either sign of the
  hypotenuse. The second records the equivalent normalized classification for
  nonnegative triples, including ordered coprime opposite-parity parameters
  and a nonnegative scale. Both declarations are unproved $a statements.
$)

${
  $d x y z k m n $.

  hundred-theorems-023-pythagorean-triples-general $a
    |- A. x e. ZZ A. y e. ZZ A. z e. ZZ
         (
           ( ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) = ( z ^ 2 ) )
           <->
           E. k e. ZZ E. m e. ZZ E. n e. ZZ
             (
               (
                 (
                   x = ( k x. ( ( m ^ 2 ) - ( n ^ 2 ) ) )
                   /\
                   y = ( k x. ( ( 2 x. m ) x. n ) )
                 )
                 \/
                 (
                   x = ( k x. ( ( 2 x. m ) x. n ) )
                   /\
                   y = ( k x. ( ( m ^ 2 ) - ( n ^ 2 ) ) )
                 )
               )
               /\
               (
                 z = ( k x. ( ( m ^ 2 ) + ( n ^ 2 ) ) )
                 \/
                 z = ( -u k x. ( ( m ^ 2 ) + ( n ^ 2 ) ) )
               )
             )
         )
  $.
$}

${
  $d x y z p q r $.

  hundred-theorems-023-pythagorean-triples-nonnegative $a
    |- A. x e. ZZ A. y e. ZZ A. z e. ZZ
         (
           (
             0 <_ x
             /\
             (
               0 <_ y
               /\
               (
                 0 <_ z
                 /\
                 ( ( x ^ 2 ) + ( y ^ 2 ) ) = ( z ^ 2 )
               )
             )
           )
           <->
           E. p e. ZZ E. q e. ZZ E. r e. ZZ
             (
               (
                 (
                   x = ( r x. ( ( q ^ 2 ) - ( p ^ 2 ) ) )
                   /\
                   y = ( ( 2 x. r ) x. ( p x. q ) )
                 )
                 \/
                 (
                   x = ( ( 2 x. r ) x. ( p x. q ) )
                   /\
                   y = ( r x. ( ( q ^ 2 ) - ( p ^ 2 ) ) )
                 )
               )
               /\
               (
                 z = ( r x. ( ( p ^ 2 ) + ( q ^ 2 ) ) )
                 /\
                 (
                   0 <_ r
                   /\
                   (
                     0 <_ p
                     /\
                     (
                       0 < q
                       /\
                       (
                         p <_ q
                         /\
                         (
                           ( p gcd q ) = 1
                           /\
                           (
                             ( p e. Even /\ q e. Odd )
                             \/
                             ( p e. Odd /\ q e. Even )
                           )
                         )
                       )
                     )
                   )
                 )
               )
             )
         )
  $.
$}

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems
:: item 023. It classifies integer solutions of x^2 + y^2 = z^2 by the standard
:: scaled parametrization, allowing the two legs and the sign of z to vary. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, SUBSET_1, INT_1, RAT_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_1,
    NEWTON, ARYTM_3, CARD_1, PREPOWER, FUNCT_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1,
    REAL_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, ORDINAL2, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_2, SEQ_4,
    COMPLEX1, VALUED_0, POWER, ABIAN, ORDINAL1;
  notations SUBSET_1, NEWTON, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    COMPLEX1, INT_1, RAT_1, REAL_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
    COMSEQ_2, SEQM_3, SQUARE_1, SEQ_4, PREPOWER, ABIAN, XXREAL_2,
    POWER;
  constructors REAL_1, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQM_3, SEQ_4, NEWTON,
    PREPOWER, XXREAL_2, RELSET_1, ABIAN, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2, POWER;
  registrations XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, INT_1, RAT_1, MEMBERED,
    NEWTON, PREPOWER, SEQ_4, ABIAN, ORDINAL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for x, y, z being Integer holds
    (x * x + y * y = z * z iff
      ex k, m, n being Integer st
        ((x = k * (m * m - n * n) & y = k * (2 * m * n) or
          x = k * (2 * m * n) & y = k * (m * m - n * n)) &
         (z = k * (m * m + n * n) or
          z = -(k * (m * m + n * n)))))

end;
::$P+

title: 023_formula_for_pythagorean_triples
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Formula for Pythagorean Triples" from Hundred Theorems item
% 023. It classifies integer Pythagorean triples by the Euclidean parameter formula, allowing
% the legs to be swapped and the hypotenuse to have either sign. This file contains no proof.

formula_for_pythagorean_triples_023: THEORY
BEGIN
  pythagorean_triple(x, y, z: int): bool =
    x * x + y * y = z * z

  formula_for_pythagorean_triples: bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: int):
      pythagorean_triple(x, y, z)
        IFF
          EXISTS (k, m, n: int):
            (((x = k * (m * m - n * n)
                AND y = k * (2 * m * n))
              OR
              (x = k * (2 * m * n)
                AND y = k * (m * m - n * n)))
              AND
              (z = k * (m * m + n * n)
                OR z = -(k * (m * m + n * n))))
END formula_for_pythagorean_triples_023

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis" from Hundred
-- Theorems item 024. It asserts a proper countable transitive ZF extension with the same ordinals,
-- preserving Choice when present. This file contains no proof.

namespace ContinuumHypothesisUndecidability

universe u

/--
An Aczel-style universe of well-founded sets. A set may be formed from any small
indexing type, providing the ambient set formation needed for forcing constructions.
-/
inductive PSet : Type (u + 1) where
  | mk (Index : Type u) (element : Index → PSet)

/-- Extensional equality of well-founded set trees. -/
def PSet.Equiv : PSet.{u} → PSet.{u} → Prop
  | .mk _ left, .mk _ right =>
      (∀ i, ∃ j, Equiv (left i) (right j)) ∧
        (∀ j, ∃ i, Equiv (left i) (right j))

/-- Membership in a well-founded set, modulo extensional equality. -/
def PSet.Mem (x : PSet.{u}) : PSet.{u} → Prop
  | .mk _ element => ∃ i, Equiv x (element i)

/-- First-order formulas in the language of set theory, using de Bruijn variables. -/
inductive Formula where
  | equal (left right : Nat)
  | member (left right : Nat)
  | falsum
  | conjunction (left right : Formula)
  | disjunction (left right : Formula)
  | implication (left right : Formula)
  | negation (body : Formula)
  | universal (body : Formula)
  | existential (body : Formula)

/-- Add a new value for de Bruijn variable zero and shift the previous assignment. -/
def extendAssignment (value : PSet) (assignment : Nat → PSet) : Nat → PSet
  | 0 => value
  | Nat.succ index => assignment index

/-- Tarski satisfaction for membership formulas, with quantifiers restricted to a model. -/
def satisfies (model : PSet) (assignment : Nat → PSet) : Formula → Prop
  | .equal left right => PSet.Equiv (assignment left) (assignment right)
  | .member left right => PSet.Mem (assignment left) (assignment right)
  | .falsum => False
  | .conjunction left right =>
      satisfies model assignment left ∧ satisfies model assignment right
  | .disjunction left right =>
      satisfies model assignment left ∨ satisfies model assignment right
  | .implication left right =>
      satisfies model assignment left → satisfies model assignment right
  | .negation body => ¬satisfies model assignment body
  | .universal body =>
      ∀ value, PSet.Mem value model →
        satisfies model (extendAssignment value assignment) body
  | .existential body =>
      ∃ value, PSet.Mem value model ∧
        satisfies model (extendAssignment value assignment) body

/-- Every value in an assignment is an element of the model. -/
def AssignmentIn (model : PSet) (assignment : Nat → PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ index, PSet.Mem (assignment index) model

/-- Inclusion between two sets that serve as model domains. -/
def ModelSubset (M N : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem x N

/-- A set is transitive when it contains every member of each of its elements. -/
def TransitiveSet (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ {x y}, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem y x → PSet.Mem y M

/-- A von Neumann ordinal is a transitive set linearly ordered by membership. -/
def IsOrdinal (ordinal : PSet) : Prop :=
  TransitiveSet ordinal ∧
    ∀ {x y}, PSet.Mem x ordinal → PSet.Mem y ordinal →
      PSet.Mem x y ∨ PSet.Equiv x y ∨ PSet.Mem y x

/-- The elements of a set are in bijection with the natural numbers. -/
def EquinumerousWithNat (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∃ enumeration : Nat → PSet,
    (∀ n, PSet.Mem (enumeration n) M) ∧
      (∀ {m n}, PSet.Equiv (enumeration m) (enumeration n) → m = n) ∧
      (∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → ∃ n, PSet.Equiv (enumeration n) x)

/-- Extensionality as seen inside a model. -/
def ModelsExtensionality (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ {x y}, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem y M →
    (∀ z, PSet.Mem z M → (PSet.Mem z x ↔ PSet.Mem z y)) →
    PSet.Equiv x y

/-- The model contains an empty set. -/
def ModelsEmptySet (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∃ empty, PSet.Mem empty M ∧
    ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → ¬PSet.Mem x empty

/-- The model is closed under unordered pairs. -/
def ModelsPairing (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M →
    ∀ y, PSet.Mem y M →
      ∃ pair, PSet.Mem pair M ∧
        ∀ z, PSet.Mem z M →
          (PSet.Mem z pair ↔ PSet.Equiv z x ∨ PSet.Equiv z y)

/-- The model is closed under unions. -/
def ModelsUnion (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ family, PSet.Mem family M →
    ∃ union, PSet.Mem union M ∧
      ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M →
        (PSet.Mem x union ↔
          ∃ member, PSet.Mem member M ∧
            PSet.Mem member family ∧ PSet.Mem x member)

/-- Internal subsethood in a model. -/
def InternalSubset (M left right : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem x left → PSet.Mem x right

/-- The model is closed under power sets. -/
def ModelsPowerSet (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ base, PSet.Mem base M →
    ∃ power, PSet.Mem power M ∧
      ∀ candidate, PSet.Mem candidate M →
        (PSet.Mem candidate power ↔ InternalSubset M candidate base)

/-- A set is empty according to the model. -/
def IsEmptyIn (M empty : PSet) : Prop :=
  PSet.Mem empty M ∧
    ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → ¬PSet.Mem x empty

/-- `successor` is `x ∪ {x}` according to the model. -/
def IsSuccessorIn (M x successor : PSet) : Prop :=
  PSet.Mem successor M ∧
    ∀ z, PSet.Mem z M →
      (PSet.Mem z successor ↔ PSet.Mem z x ∨ PSet.Equiv z x)

/-- The model contains an inductive set. -/
def ModelsInfinity (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∃ infinity, PSet.Mem infinity M ∧
    ∃ empty, IsEmptyIn M empty ∧ PSet.Mem empty infinity ∧
      ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem x infinity →
        ∃ successor, IsSuccessorIn M x successor ∧ PSet.Mem successor infinity

/-- Every definable subclass of a set is represented by a set in the model. -/
def ModelsSeparation (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ formula assignment, AssignmentIn M assignment →
    ∀ base, PSet.Mem base M →
      ∃ subset, PSet.Mem subset M ∧
        ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M →
          (PSet.Mem x subset ↔
            PSet.Mem x base ∧
              satisfies M (extendAssignment x assignment) formula)

/-- Every definable functional image of a set is represented by a set in the model. -/
def ModelsReplacement (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ formula assignment, AssignmentIn M assignment →
    ∀ domain, PSet.Mem domain M →
      (∀ x, PSet.Mem x M → PSet.Mem x domain →
        ∃ y, PSet.Mem y M ∧
          satisfies M (extendAssignment y (extendAssignment x assignment)) formula ∧
          ∀ z, PSet.Mem z M →
            satisfies M
              (extendAssignment z (extendAssignment x assignment)) formula →
            PSet.Equiv z y) →
      ∃ range, PSet.Mem range M ∧
        ∀ y, PSet.Mem y M →
          (PSet.Mem y range ↔
            ∃ x, PSet.Mem x M ∧ PSet.Mem x domain ∧
              satisfies M
                (extendAssignment y (extendAssignment x assignment)) formula)

/-- Foundation as seen inside a model. -/
def ModelsFoundation (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ set, PSet.Mem set M →
    (∃ x, PSet.Mem x M ∧ PSet.Mem x set) →
      ∃ minimal, PSet.Mem minimal M ∧ PSet.Mem minimal set ∧
        ∀ y, PSet.Mem y M → PSet.Mem y minimal → ¬PSet.Mem y set

/-- Satisfaction of the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms, including both schemas. -/
structure ModelsZF (M : PSet) : Prop where
  extensionality : ModelsExtensionality M
  emptySet : ModelsEmptySet M
  pairing : ModelsPairing M
  union : ModelsUnion M
  powerSet : ModelsPowerSet M
  infinity : ModelsInfinity M
  separation : ModelsSeparation M
  replacement : ModelsReplacement M
  foundation : ModelsFoundation M

/--
Choice in the disjoint-family form: every set of nonempty pairwise disjoint sets
has a set meeting each member in exactly one element.
-/
def ModelsChoice (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ family, PSet.Mem family M →
    (∀ member, PSet.Mem member M → PSet.Mem member family →
      ∃ x, PSet.Mem x M ∧ PSet.Mem x member) →
    (∀ left, PSet.Mem left M → PSet.Mem left family →
      ∀ right, PSet.Mem right M → PSet.Mem right family →
        ¬PSet.Equiv left right →
          ∀ x, PSet.Mem x M →
            ¬(PSet.Mem x left ∧ PSet.Mem x right)) →
    ∃ choice, PSet.Mem choice M ∧
      ∀ member, PSet.Mem member M → PSet.Mem member family →
        ∃ selected, PSet.Mem selected M ∧
          PSet.Mem selected member ∧ PSet.Mem selected choice ∧
          ∀ other, PSet.Mem other M → PSet.Mem other member →
            PSet.Mem other choice → PSet.Equiv other selected

/-- Satisfaction of ZFC is satisfaction of ZF together with Choice. -/
def ModelsZFC (M : PSet) : Prop :=
  ModelsZF M ∧ ModelsChoice M

/--
Every countable transitive model of ZF has a proper countable transitive ZF extension
with exactly the same ordinals. If the original model satisfies Choice, the extension
satisfies ZFC.
-/
theorem extensions_of_ctms
    (M : PSet)
    (hcountable : EquinumerousWithNat M)
    (htransitive : TransitiveSet M)
    (hZF : ModelsZF M) :
    ∃ N : PSet,
      ModelSubset M N ∧
        EquinumerousWithNat N ∧
        TransitiveSet N ∧
        ModelsZF N ∧
        ¬PSet.Equiv M N ∧
        (∀ ordinal, IsOrdinal ordinal →
          (PSet.Mem ordinal M ↔ PSet.Mem ordinal N)) ∧
        (ModelsChoice M → ModelsZFC N) := sorry

end ContinuumHypothesisUndecidability

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Forcing extension theorem for countable transitive models of ZF.

  Unlike a bare signature with unconstrained predicates, this statement gives
  the ambient membership relation a Tarski semantics and spells out the ZF
  axioms, the axiom of choice, omega, and ordinals relative to a class.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Logic.Classical.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section ForcingExtension.

Variable V : Type.
Variable member : V -> V -> Prop.

Definition set_class : Type := V -> Prop.

Definition full_class : set_class :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition elements (a : V) : set_class :=
  fun x => member x a.

Definition class_included (A B : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall x, A x -> B x.

Definition same_class (A B : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall x, A x <-> B x.

Definition equinumerous (A B : set_class) : Prop :=
  exists f : V -> V,
    (forall x, A x -> B (f x)) /\
    (forall x y, A x -> A y -> f x = f y -> x = y) /\
    (forall y, B y -> exists x, A x /\ f x = y).

Definition transitive_class (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall x y, member x y -> M y -> M x.

Definition assignment_in (M : set_class) (rho : nat -> V) : Prop :=
  forall n, M (rho n).

Definition extend_assignment (rho : nat -> V) (x : V) : nat -> V :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | O => x
    | S k => rho k
    end.

Inductive formula : Type :=
| FEqual : nat -> nat -> formula
| FMember : nat -> nat -> formula
| FFalse : formula
| FAnd : formula -> formula -> formula
| FOr : formula -> formula -> formula
| FImplies : formula -> formula -> formula
| FNot : formula -> formula
| FForall : formula -> formula
| FExists : formula -> formula.

Fixpoint satisfies
    (M : set_class) (rho : nat -> V) (phi : formula) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | FEqual i j => rho i = rho j
  | FMember i j => member (rho i) (rho j)
  | FFalse => False
  | FAnd lhs rhs =>
      satisfies M rho lhs /\ satisfies M rho rhs
  | FOr lhs rhs =>
      satisfies M rho lhs \/ satisfies M rho rhs
  | FImplies lhs rhs =>
      satisfies M rho lhs -> satisfies M rho rhs
  | FNot body =>
      ~ satisfies M rho body
  | FForall body =>
      forall x, M x -> satisfies M (extend_assignment rho x) body
  | FExists body =>
      exists x, M x /\ satisfies M (extend_assignment rho x) body
  end.

Definition subset_in (M : set_class) (a b : V) : Prop :=
  forall x, M x -> member x a -> member x b.

Definition empty_in (M : set_class) (e : V) : Prop :=
  M e /\ forall x, M x -> ~ member x e.

Definition successor_in (M : set_class) (a successor : V) : Prop :=
  M successor /\
  forall x, M x ->
    (member x successor <-> member x a \/ x = a).

Definition inductive_set (M : set_class) (a : V) : Prop :=
  M a /\
  exists e,
    empty_in M e /\
    member e a /\
    forall x, M x -> member x a ->
      exists successor,
        successor_in M x successor /\
        member successor a.

Definition is_omega (M : set_class) (omega : V) : Prop :=
  inductive_set M omega /\
  forall a, inductive_set M a -> subset_in M omega a.

Definition transitive_set (M : set_class) (a : V) : Prop :=
  M a /\
  forall x y,
    M x -> M y ->
    member x y -> member y a ->
    member x a.

Definition membership_well_orders (M : set_class) (a : V) : Prop :=
  (forall x, M x -> member x a -> ~ member x x) /\
  (forall x y z,
      M x -> M y -> M z ->
      member x y -> member y z -> member z a ->
      member x z) /\
  (forall x y,
      M x -> M y ->
      member x a -> member y a ->
      x = y \/ member x y \/ member y x) /\
  (forall A : set_class,
      (exists x, A x) ->
      class_included A (elements a) ->
      exists least,
        A least /\
        forall x, A x -> x = least \/ member least x).

Definition is_ordinal (M : set_class) (a : V) : Prop :=
  transitive_set M a /\ membership_well_orders M a.

Definition models_extensionality (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall a b,
    M a -> M b ->
    (forall x, M x -> (member x a <-> member x b)) ->
    a = b.

Definition models_empty_set (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  exists e, empty_in M e.

Definition models_pairing (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall a b,
    M a -> M b ->
    exists pair,
      M pair /\
      forall x, M x ->
        (member x pair <-> x = a \/ x = b).

Definition models_union (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall a,
    M a ->
    exists union,
      M union /\
      forall x, M x ->
        (member x union <->
         exists y, M y /\ member x y /\ member y a).

Definition models_power_set (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall a,
    M a ->
    exists power,
      M power /\
      forall x, M x ->
        (member x power <-> subset_in M x a).

Definition models_infinity (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  exists infinity, inductive_set M infinity.

Definition models_separation (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall (phi : formula) (rho : nat -> V) (a : V),
    assignment_in M rho ->
    M a ->
    exists subset,
      M subset /\
      forall x, M x ->
        (member x subset <->
         member x a /\
         satisfies M (extend_assignment rho x) phi).

Definition replacement_holds
    (M : set_class) (rho : nat -> V) (phi : formula)
    (x y : V) : Prop :=
  satisfies M
    (extend_assignment (extend_assignment rho x) y)
    phi.

Definition models_replacement (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall (phi : formula) (rho : nat -> V) (a : V),
    assignment_in M rho ->
    M a ->
    (forall x,
        M x -> member x a ->
        exists! y, M y /\ replacement_holds M rho phi x y) ->
    exists image,
      M image /\
      forall y, M y ->
        (member y image <->
         exists x,
           M x /\
           member x a /\
           replacement_holds M rho phi x y).

Definition models_foundation (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall a,
    M a ->
    (exists x, M x /\ member x a) ->
    exists minimal,
      M minimal /\
      member minimal a /\
      forall x, M x ->
        member x minimal ->
        ~ member x a.

Record models_ZF (M : set_class) : Prop := {
  zf_extensionality : models_extensionality M;
  zf_empty_set : models_empty_set M;
  zf_pairing : models_pairing M;
  zf_union : models_union M;
  zf_power_set : models_power_set M;
  zf_infinity : models_infinity M;
  zf_separation : models_separation M;
  zf_replacement : models_replacement M;
  zf_foundation : models_foundation M
}.

Definition nonempty_in (M : set_class) (a : V) : Prop :=
  exists x, M x /\ member x a.

Definition singleton_in
    (M : set_class) (x singleton : V) : Prop :=
  M singleton /\
  forall z, M z ->
    (member z singleton <-> z = x).

Definition unordered_pair_in
    (M : set_class) (x y pair : V) : Prop :=
  M pair /\
  forall z, M z ->
    (member z pair <-> z = x \/ z = y).

Definition ordered_pair_in
    (M : set_class) (x y pair : V) : Prop :=
  exists singleton unordered,
    singleton_in M x singleton /\
    unordered_pair_in M x y unordered /\
    M pair /\
    forall z, M z ->
      (member z pair <-> z = singleton \/ z = unordered).

Definition choice_graph_for
    (M : set_class) (family graph : V) : Prop :=
  M graph /\
  forall a,
    M a -> member a family ->
    exists selected pair,
      M selected /\
      member selected a /\
      ordered_pair_in M a selected pair /\
      member pair graph /\
      forall other other_pair,
        M other ->
        ordered_pair_in M a other other_pair ->
        member other_pair graph ->
        other = selected.

Definition models_choice (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  forall family,
    M family ->
    (forall a, M a -> member a family -> nonempty_in M a) ->
    exists graph, choice_graph_for M family graph.

Definition models_ZFC (M : set_class) : Prop :=
  models_ZF M /\ models_choice M.

Theorem extensions_of_countable_transitive_models :
  forall omega,
    models_ZF full_class ->
    is_omega full_class omega ->
    forall M : set_class,
      equinumerous M (elements omega) ->
      transitive_class M ->
      models_ZF M ->
      exists N : set_class,
        class_included M N /\
        equinumerous N (elements omega) /\
        transitive_class N /\
        models_ZF N /\
        ~ same_class M N /\
        (forall alpha,
            is_ordinal full_class alpha ->
            (M alpha <-> N alpha)) /\
        (models_choice M -> models_ZFC N).
Proof.
Admitted.

End ForcingExtension.

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
section\<open>The main theorem\<close>
theory Forcing_Main
  imports 
  Internal_ZFC_Axioms
  Choice_Axiom
  Ordinals_In_MG
  Succession_Poset

begin

subsection\<open>The generic extension is countable\<close>
(*
\<comment> \<open>Useful missing lemma\<close>
lemma surj_imp_well_ord:
  assumes "well_ord(A,r)" "h \<in> surj(A,B)"
  shows "\<exists>s. well_ord(B,r)" 
*)

definition
  minimum :: "i \<Rightarrow> i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "minimum(r,B) \<equiv> THE b. b\<in>B \<and> (\<forall>y\<in>B. y \<noteq> b \<longrightarrow> \<langle>b, y\<rangle> \<in> r)"

lemma well_ord_imp_min:
  assumes 
    "well_ord(A,r)" "B \<subseteq> A" "B \<noteq> 0"
  shows 
    "minimum(r,B) \<in> B" 
  by sorry

lemma well_ord_surj_imp_lepoll:
  assumes "well_ord(A,r)" "h \<in> surj(A,B)"
  shows "B \<lesssim> A"
  by sorry

lemma (in forcing_data) surj_nat_MG :
  "\<exists>f. f \<in> surj(nat,M[G])"
  by sorry

lemma (in G_generic) MG_eqpoll_nat: "M[G] \<approx> nat"
  by sorry

subsection\<open>The main result\<close>

theorem extensions_of_ctms:
  assumes 
    "M \<approx> nat" "Transset(M)" "M \<Turnstile> ZF"
  shows 
    "\<exists>N. 
      M \<subseteq> N \<and> N \<approx> nat \<and> Transset(N) \<and> N \<Turnstile> ZF \<and> M\<noteq>N \<and>
      (\<forall>\<alpha>. Ord(\<alpha>) \<longrightarrow> (\<alpha> \<in> M \<longleftrightarrow> \<alpha> \<in> N)) \<and>
      (M, []\<Turnstile> AC \<longrightarrow> N \<Turnstile> ZFC)"
  by sorry

end

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 024,
  "The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis". It states the source's
  forcing result that every countable transitive model of ZF has a proper
  countable transitive ZF extension with the same ambient ordinals, where
  countability uses a set-coded bijection with ambient omega and internal
  choice is preserved as ZFC in the extension. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Logic/fol.ml";;

let EXTENSIONS_OF_CTMS =
  `!(member:A->A->bool).
     let interp =
       \D:A->bool.
         (D,
          (\(f:num) (args:A list). @x:A. T),
          (\(p:num) (args:A list).
             (p = 0 /\ ?x y:A. args = [x; y] /\ x = y) \/
             (p = 1 /\ ?x y:A. args = [x; y] /\ member x y))) in
     let set_formula =
       \p:form.
         functions_form p = {} /\
         predicates_form p SUBSET {(0,2),(1,2)} in
     let zf_model =
       \D:A->bool.
         (!x y:A.
            x IN D /\ y IN D /\
            (!z:A. z IN D ==> (member z x <=> member z y))
            ==> x = y) /\
         (?e:A. e IN D /\ !x:A. x IN D ==> ~(member x e)) /\
         (!x y:A.
            x IN D /\ y IN D
            ==> ?p:A.
                  p IN D /\
                  !z:A. z IN D
                        ==> (member z p <=> z = x \/ z = y)) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D
            ==> ?u:A.
                  u IN D /\
                  !z:A. z IN D
                        ==> (member z u <=>
                             ?y:A. y IN D /\ member y x /\ member z y)) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D
            ==> ?p:A.
                  p IN D /\
                  !z:A. z IN D
                        ==> (member z p <=>
                             !y:A.
                               y IN D /\ member y z ==> member y x)) /\
         (?i:A.
            i IN D /\
            (?e:A.
               e IN D /\
               (!z:A. z IN D ==> ~(member z e)) /\
               member e i) /\
            (!x:A.
               x IN D /\ member x i
               ==> ?s:A.
                     s IN D /\ member s i /\
                     !z:A.
                       z IN D
                       ==> (member z s <=> member z x \/ z = x))) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D /\ (?y:A. y IN D /\ member y x)
            ==> ?y:A.
                  y IN D /\ member y x /\
                  !z:A.
                    z IN D /\ member z x ==> ~(member z y)) /\
         (!p:form v:num->A a:A.
            set_formula p /\ valuation (interp D) v /\ a IN D
            ==> ?b:A.
                  b IN D /\
                  !x:A.
                    x IN D
                    ==> (member x b <=>
                         member x a /\
                         holds (interp D) (valmod (0,x) v) p)) /\
         (!p:form v:num->A a:A.
            set_formula p /\ valuation (interp D) v /\ a IN D /\
            (!x:A.
               x IN D /\ member x a
               ==> ?y:A.
                     y IN D /\
                     holds (interp D)
                       (valmod (1,y) (valmod (0,x) v)) p /\
                     !y':A.
                       y' IN D /\
                       holds (interp D)
                         (valmod (1,y') (valmod (0,x) v)) p
                       ==> y' = y)
            ==> ?b:A.
                  b IN D /\
                  !y:A.
                    y IN D
                    ==> (member y b <=>
                         ?x:A.
                           x IN D /\ member x a /\
                           holds (interp D)
                             (valmod (1,y) (valmod (0,x) v)) p)) in
     let transitive_set =
       \m:A.
         !x y:A. member x m /\ member y x ==> member y m in
     let empty_set =
       \D:A->bool e:A.
         e IN D /\
         !x:A. x IN D ==> ~(member x e) in
     let successor_set =
       \D:A->bool x:A s:A.
         s IN D /\
         !z:A.
           z IN D ==> (member z s <=> member z x \/ z = x) in
     let inductive_set =
       \D:A->bool i:A.
         i IN D /\
         (?e:A. empty_set D e /\ member e i) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D /\ member x i
            ==> ?s:A.
                  successor_set D x s /\ member s i) in
     let is_omega =
       \D:A->bool w:A.
         w IN D /\
         inductive_set D w /\
         !i:A.
           inductive_set D i
           ==> !x:A.
                 x IN D /\ member x w ==> member x i in
     let is_ordinal =
       \D:A->bool a:A.
         a IN D /\
         (!x y:A.
            x IN D /\ y IN D /\ member x a /\ member y x
            ==> member y a) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D /\ member x a ==> ~(member x x)) /\
         (!x y z:A.
            x IN D /\ y IN D /\ z IN D /\
            member x a /\ member y a /\ member z a /\
            member x y /\ member y z
            ==> member x z) /\
         (!x y:A.
            x IN D /\ y IN D /\ member x a /\ member y a
            ==> member x y \/ x = y \/ member y x) /\
         (!s:A.
            s IN D /\
            (!x:A.
               x IN D /\ member x s ==> member x a) /\
            (?x:A. x IN D /\ member x s)
            ==> ?x:A.
                  x IN D /\ member x s /\
                  !y:A.
                    y IN D /\ member y s
                    ==> y = x \/ member x y) in
     let upair =
       \D:A->bool x:A y:A u:A.
         u IN D /\
         !z:A. z IN D ==> (member z u <=> z = x \/ z = y) in
     let opair =
       \D:A->bool x:A y:A p:A.
         ?u v:A.
           upair D x x u /\
           upair D x y v /\
           upair D u v p in
     let relates =
       \D:A->bool r:A x:A y:A.
         ?p:A. p IN D /\ member p r /\ opair D x y p in
     let is_surjection =
       \D:A->bool f:A a:A b:A.
         f IN D /\ a IN D /\ b IN D /\
         (!p:A.
            p IN D /\ member p f
            ==> ?x y:A.
                  x IN D /\ y IN D /\
                  member x a /\ member y b /\
                  opair D x y p) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN D /\ member x a
            ==> ?y:A.
                  y IN D /\ member y b /\ relates D f x y /\
                  !y':A.
                    y' IN D /\ member y' b /\ relates D f x y'
                    ==> y' = y) /\
         (!y:A.
            y IN D /\ member y b
            ==> ?x:A.
                  x IN D /\ member x a /\ relates D f x y) in
     let is_bijection =
       \D:A->bool f:A a:A b:A.
         is_surjection D f a b /\
         !x x' y:A.
           x IN D /\ x' IN D /\ y IN D /\
           member x a /\ member x' a /\ member y b /\
           relates D f x y /\ relates D f x' y
           ==> x = x' in
     let choice_model =
       \D:A->bool.
         !x:A.
           x IN D
           ==> ?a f:A.
                 a IN D /\ f IN D /\
                 is_ordinal D a /\ is_surjection D f a x in
     let zfc_model =
       \D:A->bool.
         zf_model D /\ choice_model D in
     let countably_infinite =
       \m:A.
         ?omega enum:A.
           is_omega (UNIV:A->bool) omega /\
           is_bijection (UNIV:A->bool) enum omega m in
     zf_model (UNIV:A->bool)
     ==> !M:A.
           countably_infinite M /\
           transitive_set M /\
           zf_model (\x:A. member x M)
           ==> ?N:A.
                 (!x:A. member x M ==> member x N) /\
                 countably_infinite N /\
                 transitive_set N /\
                 zf_model (\x:A. member x N) /\
                 ~(M = N) /\
                 (!a:A.
                    is_ordinal (UNIV:A->bool) a
                    ==> (member a M <=> member a N)) /\
                 (choice_model (\x:A. member x M)
                  ==> zfc_model (\x:A. member x N))`;;

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__024, "The Undecidability of the Continuum
;; Hypothesis": every countable transitive set model of ZF has a proper
;; countable transitive ZF extension with exactly the same ambient ordinals;
;; if the original model satisfies choice, the extension satisfies ZFC.
;; Ambient membership is constrained by the ZF axioms, countability uses
;; membership-defined bijection graphs over the least inductive set, and the
;; extension model is internally existential. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; Conservative interfaces for ambient set membership and for internal and
;; ambient satisfaction of first-order formulas in the language of sets.
(defstub ht024-ambient-set-p (object) t)
(defstub ht024-member-p (set element) t)
(defstub ht024-sat (model environment formula) t)
(defstub ht024-ambient-sat (environment formula) t)

(defun ht024-sat-p (model environment formula)
  (if (ht024-sat model environment formula) t nil))

(defun ht024-ambient-sat-p (environment formula)
  (if (ht024-ambient-sat environment formula) t nil))

;; Formulas use natural-numbered variables and the constructors
;; (:equal i j), (:member i j), (:not p), (:and p q), and (:forall i p).
(defun ht024-formula-p (formula)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((atom formula) nil)
   ((equal (car formula) :equal)
    (and (true-listp formula)
         (equal (len formula) 3)
         (natp (cadr formula))
         (natp (caddr formula))))
   ((equal (car formula) :member)
    (and (true-listp formula)
         (equal (len formula) 3)
         (natp (cadr formula))
         (natp (caddr formula))))
   ((equal (car formula) :not)
    (and (true-listp formula)
         (equal (len formula) 2)
         (ht024-formula-p (cadr formula))))
   ((equal (car formula) :and)
    (and (true-listp formula)
         (equal (len formula) 3)
         (ht024-formula-p (cadr formula))
         (ht024-formula-p (caddr formula))))
   ((equal (car formula) :forall)
    (and (true-listp formula)
         (equal (len formula) 3)
         (natp (cadr formula))
         (ht024-formula-p (caddr formula))))
   (t nil)))

(defun ht024-env-lookup (variable environment)
  (cdr (assoc-equal variable environment)))

(defun ht024-env-update (variable value environment)
  (acons variable value environment))

(defun ht024-bound-variable-p (variable bound)
  (if (consp bound)
      (or (equal variable (car bound))
          (ht024-bound-variable-p variable (cdr bound)))
    nil))

;; Every free parameter of a schema formula is assigned an element of MODEL.
(defun ht024-parameters-in-model-p
    (model formula environment bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((atom formula) nil)
   ((or (equal (car formula) :equal)
        (equal (car formula) :member))
    (and
     (or (ht024-bound-variable-p (cadr formula) bound)
         (ht024-member-p
          model
          (ht024-env-lookup (cadr formula) environment)))
     (or (ht024-bound-variable-p (caddr formula) bound)
         (ht024-member-p
          model
          (ht024-env-lookup (caddr formula) environment)))))
   ((equal (car formula) :not)
    (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
     model (cadr formula) environment bound))
   ((equal (car formula) :and)
    (and
     (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
      model (cadr formula) environment bound)
     (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
      model (caddr formula) environment bound)))
   ((equal (car formula) :forall)
    (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
     model
     (caddr formula)
     environment
     (cons (cadr formula) bound)))
   (t nil)))

;; Basic unbounded set predicates.
(defun-sk ht024-set-nonempty-p (set)
  (exists (element)
    (ht024-member-p set element)))

(defun-sk ht024-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p left element)
     (ht024-member-p right element))))

(defun-sk ht024-set-equal-p (left right)
  (forall (element)
    (iff
     (ht024-member-p left element)
     (ht024-member-p right element))))

(defun-sk ht024-transitive-p (set)
  (forall (element member)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p set element)
      (ht024-member-p element member))
     (ht024-member-p set member))))

;; Ambient ordinals are exactly the transitive sets whose membership relation
;; is a strict total well-order.
(defun-sk ht024-membership-strict-order-p (set)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p set x)
      (not (ht024-member-p x x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht024-member-p set x)
       (ht024-member-p set y)
       (ht024-member-p set z)
       (ht024-member-p y x)
       (ht024-member-p z y))
      (ht024-member-p z x))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht024-member-p set x)
       (ht024-member-p set y)
       (not (equal x y)))
      (or
       (ht024-member-p y x)
       (ht024-member-p x y))))))

(defun-sk ht024-membership-least-p (subset least)
  (forall (other)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p subset least)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p subset other)
      (or
       (equal least other)
       (ht024-member-p other least))))))

(defun-sk ht024-membership-least-exists-p (subset)
  (exists (least)
    (ht024-membership-least-p subset least)))

(defun-sk ht024-membership-well-founded-p (set)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-subset-p subset set)
      (ht024-set-nonempty-p subset))
     (ht024-membership-least-exists-p subset))))

(defun ht024-ordinal-p (set)
  (and
   (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
   (ht024-transitive-p set)
   (ht024-membership-strict-order-p set)
   (ht024-membership-well-founded-p set)))

;; Tarskian recursion laws make HT024-SAT a genuine satisfaction relation.
(defun-sk ht024-all-members-satisfy-p
    (model environment variable body)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p model value)
     (ht024-sat-p
      model
      (ht024-env-update variable value environment)
      body))))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfaction-equality-law-p ()
  (forall (model environment i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j))
     (equal
      (ht024-sat-p model environment (list :equal i j))
      (equal
       (ht024-env-lookup i environment)
       (ht024-env-lookup j environment))))))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfaction-membership-law-p ()
  (forall (model environment i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j))
     (equal
      (ht024-sat-p model environment (list :member i j))
      (if
       (ht024-member-p
        (ht024-env-lookup j environment)
        (ht024-env-lookup i environment))
       t nil)))))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfaction-negation-law-p ()
  (forall (model environment body)
    (implies
     (ht024-formula-p body)
     (equal
      (ht024-sat-p model environment (list :not body))
      (if (ht024-sat-p model environment body) nil t)))))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfaction-conjunction-law-p ()
  (forall (model environment left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-formula-p left)
      (ht024-formula-p right))
     (equal
      (ht024-sat-p model environment (list :and left right))
      (if
       (and
        (ht024-sat-p model environment left)
        (ht024-sat-p model environment right))
       t nil)))))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfaction-universal-law-p ()
  (forall (model environment variable body)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp variable)
      (ht024-formula-p body))
     (equal
      (ht024-sat-p
       model environment (list :forall variable body))
      (if
       (ht024-all-members-satisfy-p
        model environment variable body)
       t nil)))))

(defun ht024-satisfaction-laws-p ()
  (and
   (ht024-satisfaction-equality-law-p)
   (ht024-satisfaction-membership-law-p)
   (ht024-satisfaction-negation-law-p)
   (ht024-satisfaction-conjunction-law-p)
   (ht024-satisfaction-universal-law-p)))

;; The ambient satisfaction relation has the same Tarskian recursion, with
;; quantifiers ranging over every ambient set represented in the ACL2 domain.
(defun-sk ht024-ambient-all-satisfy-p
    (environment variable body)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (ht024-ambient-set-p value)
     (ht024-ambient-sat-p
      (ht024-env-update variable value environment)
      body))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-satisfaction-equality-law-p ()
  (forall (environment i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j))
     (equal
      (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment (list :equal i j))
      (equal
       (ht024-env-lookup i environment)
       (ht024-env-lookup j environment))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-satisfaction-membership-law-p ()
  (forall (environment i j)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (natp j))
     (equal
      (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment (list :member i j))
      (if
       (ht024-member-p
        (ht024-env-lookup j environment)
        (ht024-env-lookup i environment))
       t nil)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-satisfaction-negation-law-p ()
  (forall (environment body)
    (implies
     (ht024-formula-p body)
     (equal
      (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment (list :not body))
      (if (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment body) nil t)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-satisfaction-conjunction-law-p ()
  (forall (environment left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-formula-p left)
      (ht024-formula-p right))
     (equal
      (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment (list :and left right))
      (if
       (and
        (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment left)
        (ht024-ambient-sat-p environment right))
       t nil)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-satisfaction-universal-law-p ()
  (forall (environment variable body)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp variable)
      (ht024-formula-p body))
     (equal
      (ht024-ambient-sat-p
       environment (list :forall variable body))
      (if
       (ht024-ambient-all-satisfy-p environment variable body)
       t nil)))))

(defun ht024-ambient-satisfaction-laws-p ()
  (and
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-equality-law-p)
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-membership-law-p)
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-negation-law-p)
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-conjunction-law-p)
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-universal-law-p)))

;; Extensionality.
(defun-sk ht024-same-internal-members-p (model left right)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p model element)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p left element)
      (ht024-member-p right element)))))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-extensionality-p (model)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model left)
      (ht024-member-p model right)
      (ht024-same-internal-members-p model left right))
     (equal left right))))

;; Empty set.
(defun-sk ht024-empty-set-p (model empty)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model empty)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (not (ht024-member-p empty element))))))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-empty-set-p (model)
  (exists (empty)
    (ht024-empty-set-p model empty)))

;; Pairing.
(defun-sk ht024-pair-set-p (model pair left right)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model pair)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p pair element)
       (or (equal element left)
           (equal element right)))))))

(defun-sk ht024-pair-set-exists-p (model left right)
  (exists (pair)
    (ht024-pair-set-p model pair left right)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-pairing-p (model)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model left)
      (ht024-member-p model right))
     (ht024-pair-set-exists-p model left right))))

;; Union.
(defun-sk ht024-in-member-of-p (element set)
  (exists (member)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set member)
     (ht024-member-p member element))))

(defun-sk ht024-union-set-p (model union set)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model union)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p union element)
       (ht024-in-member-of-p element set))))))

(defun-sk ht024-union-set-exists-p (model set)
  (exists (union)
    (ht024-union-set-p model union set)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-union-p (model)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p model set)
     (ht024-union-set-exists-p model set))))

;; Power set, with subset interpreted inside the model.
(defun-sk ht024-internal-subset-p (model left right)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (ht024-member-p left element))
     (ht024-member-p right element))))

(defun-sk ht024-power-set-p (model power set)
  (forall (candidate)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model power)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model candidate)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p power candidate)
       (ht024-internal-subset-p model candidate set))))))

(defun-sk ht024-power-set-exists-p (model set)
  (exists (power)
    (ht024-power-set-p model power set)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-power-set-p (model)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p model set)
     (ht024-power-set-exists-p model set))))

;; Infinity.
(defun-sk ht024-successor-set-p (model successor set)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model successor)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p successor element)
       (or
        (ht024-member-p set element)
        (equal element set)))))))

(defun-sk ht024-successor-in-set-exists-p (model inductive set)
  (exists (successor)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p inductive successor)
     (ht024-successor-set-p model successor set))))

(defun-sk ht024-inductive-set-p (model inductive)
  (forall (set)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model inductive)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p inductive set)
      (ht024-successor-in-set-exists-p model inductive set)))))

(defun-sk ht024-empty-member-exists-p (model set)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set empty)
     (ht024-empty-set-p model empty))))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-infinity-p (model)
  (exists (inductive)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model inductive)
     (ht024-empty-member-exists-p model inductive)
     (ht024-inductive-set-p model inductive))))

;; Foundation.
(defun-sk ht024-foundation-minimal-p (set minimal)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set minimal)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p set element)
      (not (ht024-member-p minimal element))))))

(defun-sk ht024-foundation-minimal-exists-p (set)
  (exists (minimal)
    (ht024-foundation-minimal-p set minimal)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-foundation-p (model)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model set)
      (ht024-set-nonempty-p set))
     (ht024-foundation-minimal-exists-p set))))

;; Separation schema. Variable 0 is the element selected from SET.
(defun-sk ht024-separated-set-p
    (model result set formula environment)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model result)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model element)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p result element)
       (and
        (ht024-member-p set element)
        (ht024-sat-p
         model
         (ht024-env-update 0 element environment)
         formula)))))))

(defun-sk ht024-separated-set-exists-p
    (model set formula environment)
  (exists (result)
    (ht024-separated-set-p
     model result set formula environment)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-separation-p (model)
  (forall (set formula environment)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model set)
      (ht024-formula-p formula)
      (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
       model formula environment (list 0)))
     (ht024-separated-set-exists-p
      model set formula environment))))

;; Replacement schema. Variables 0 and 1 are respectively the argument and
;; the uniquely specified value.
(defun ht024-replacement-instance-sat-p
    (model environment formula argument value)
  (ht024-sat-p
   model
   (ht024-env-update
    1 value
    (ht024-env-update 0 argument environment))
   formula))

(defun-sk ht024-replacement-value-exists-p
    (model environment formula argument)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model value)
     (ht024-replacement-instance-sat-p
      model environment formula argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-replacement-value-unique-p
    (model environment formula argument)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model left)
      (ht024-member-p model right)
      (ht024-replacement-instance-sat-p
       model environment formula argument left)
      (ht024-replacement-instance-sat-p
       model environment formula argument right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-formula-functional-on-p
    (model set formula environment)
  (forall (argument)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p set argument)
     (and
      (ht024-replacement-value-exists-p
       model environment formula argument)
      (ht024-replacement-value-unique-p
       model environment formula argument)))))

(defun-sk ht024-replacement-image-member-p
    (model set formula environment value)
  (exists (argument)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set argument)
     (ht024-replacement-instance-sat-p
      model environment formula argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-replacement-set-p
    (model result set formula environment)
  (forall (value)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p model result)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p model value)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p result value)
       (ht024-replacement-image-member-p
        model set formula environment value))))))

(defun-sk ht024-replacement-set-exists-p
    (model set formula environment)
  (exists (result)
    (ht024-replacement-set-p
     model result set formula environment)))

(defun-sk ht024-zf-replacement-p (model)
  (forall (set formula environment)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model set)
      (ht024-formula-p formula)
      (ht024-parameters-in-model-p
       model formula environment (list 0 1))
      (ht024-formula-functional-on-p
       model set formula environment))
     (ht024-replacement-set-exists-p
      model set formula environment))))

(defun ht024-satisfies-zf-p (model)
  (and
   (ht024-zf-extensionality-p model)
   (ht024-zf-empty-set-p model)
   (ht024-zf-pairing-p model)
   (ht024-zf-union-p model)
   (ht024-zf-power-set-p model)
   (ht024-zf-infinity-p model)
   (ht024-zf-foundation-p model)
   (ht024-zf-separation-p model)
   (ht024-zf-replacement-p model)))

;; AC is represented by its well-ordering form, equivalent over ZF.
;; Kuratowski ordered pairs and relations are decoded from membership.
(defun-sk ht024-singleton-p (singleton element)
  (forall (member)
    (iff
     (ht024-member-p singleton member)
     (equal member element))))

(defun-sk ht024-unordered-pair-p (pair left right)
  (forall (member)
    (iff
     (ht024-member-p pair member)
     (or
      (equal member left)
      (equal member right)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ordered-pair-p (pair left right)
  (exists (singleton unordered)
    (and
     (ht024-singleton-p singleton left)
     (ht024-unordered-pair-p unordered left right)
     (ht024-unordered-pair-p pair singleton unordered))))

(defun-sk ht024-relation-holds-p (relation left right)
  (exists (pair)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p relation pair)
     (ht024-ordered-pair-p pair left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-relation-entry-on-p (set entry)
  (exists (left right)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set left)
     (ht024-member-p set right)
     (ht024-ordered-pair-p entry left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-relation-on-p (relation set)
  (forall (entry)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p relation entry)
     (ht024-relation-entry-on-p set entry))))

(defun-sk ht024-strict-total-order-p (relation set)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p set x)
      (not (ht024-relation-holds-p relation x x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht024-member-p set x)
       (ht024-member-p set y)
       (ht024-member-p set z)
       (ht024-relation-holds-p relation x y)
       (ht024-relation-holds-p relation y z))
      (ht024-relation-holds-p relation x z))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht024-member-p set x)
       (ht024-member-p set y)
       (not (equal x y)))
      (or
       (ht024-relation-holds-p relation x y)
       (ht024-relation-holds-p relation y x))))))

(defun-sk ht024-relation-least-p (relation subset least)
  (forall (other)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p subset least)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p subset other)
      (or
       (equal least other)
       (ht024-relation-holds-p relation least other))))))

(defun-sk ht024-relation-least-exists-p (relation subset)
  (exists (least)
    (ht024-relation-least-p relation subset least)))

(defun-sk ht024-internal-well-founded-p (model relation set)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p model subset)
      (ht024-internal-subset-p model subset set)
      (ht024-set-nonempty-p subset))
     (ht024-relation-least-exists-p relation subset))))

(defun ht024-well-orders-p (model relation set)
  (and
   (ht024-member-p model relation)
   (ht024-relation-on-p relation set)
   (ht024-strict-total-order-p relation set)
   (ht024-internal-well-founded-p model relation set)))

(defun-sk ht024-well-order-exists-p (model set)
  (exists (relation)
    (ht024-well-orders-p model relation set)))

(defun-sk ht024-satisfies-ac-p (model)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p model set)
     (ht024-well-order-exists-p model set))))

(defun ht024-satisfies-zfc-p (model)
  (and
   (ht024-satisfies-zf-p model)
   (ht024-satisfies-ac-p model)))

;; Ambient Isabelle/ZF semantics. ACL2 values satisfying HT024-AMBIENT-SET-P
;; form the set universe; the membership relation is typed and satisfies ZF.
(defun-sk ht024-ambient-membership-typed-p ()
  (forall (set element)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p set element)
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
      (ht024-ambient-set-p element)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-extensionality-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p left)
      (ht024-ambient-set-p right)
      (ht024-set-equal-p left right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-empty-p (empty)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p empty)
     (not (ht024-member-p empty element)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-empty-exists-p ()
  (exists (empty)
    (ht024-ambient-empty-p empty)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-pair-p (pair left right)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p pair)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p pair element)
      (or
       (equal element left)
       (equal element right))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-pair-exists-p (left right)
  (exists (pair)
    (ht024-ambient-pair-p pair left right)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-pairing-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p left)
      (ht024-ambient-set-p right))
     (ht024-ambient-pair-exists-p left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-union-p (union set)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p union)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p union element)
      (ht024-in-member-of-p element set)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-union-exists-p (set)
  (exists (union)
    (ht024-ambient-union-p union set)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-union-axiom-p ()
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
     (ht024-ambient-union-exists-p set))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-power-p (power set)
  (forall (candidate)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p power)
     (implies
      (ht024-ambient-set-p candidate)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p power candidate)
       (ht024-subset-p candidate set))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-power-exists-p (set)
  (exists (power)
    (ht024-ambient-power-p power set)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-power-axiom-p ()
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
     (ht024-ambient-power-exists-p set))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-successor-p (successor set)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p successor)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p successor element)
      (or
       (ht024-member-p set element)
       (equal element set))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-successor-in-p (inductive set)
  (exists (successor)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p inductive successor)
     (ht024-ambient-successor-p successor set))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-empty-member-p (inductive)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-empty-p empty)
     (ht024-member-p inductive empty))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-inductive-p (inductive)
  (forall (set)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p inductive)
     (ht024-ambient-empty-member-p inductive)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p inductive set)
      (ht024-ambient-successor-in-p inductive set)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-infinity-p ()
  (exists (inductive)
    (ht024-ambient-inductive-p inductive)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-foundation-p ()
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
      (ht024-set-nonempty-p set))
     (ht024-foundation-minimal-exists-p set))))

;; Ambient Separation, with variable 0 bound to the selected element.
(defun-sk ht024-ambient-separated-set-p
    (result set formula environment)
  (forall (element)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p result)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p result element)
      (and
       (ht024-member-p set element)
       (ht024-ambient-sat-p
        (ht024-env-update 0 element environment)
        formula))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-separated-set-exists-p
    (set formula environment)
  (exists (result)
    (ht024-ambient-separated-set-p
     result set formula environment)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-separation-p ()
  (forall (set formula environment)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
      (ht024-formula-p formula))
     (ht024-ambient-separated-set-exists-p
      set formula environment))))

;; Ambient Replacement. Variables 0 and 1 denote argument and value.
(defun ht024-ambient-replacement-instance-p
    (environment formula argument value)
  (ht024-ambient-sat-p
   (ht024-env-update
    1 value
    (ht024-env-update 0 argument environment))
   formula))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-value-exists-p
    (environment formula argument)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p value)
     (ht024-ambient-replacement-instance-p
      environment formula argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-value-unique-p
    (environment formula argument)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p left)
      (ht024-ambient-set-p right)
      (ht024-ambient-replacement-instance-p
       environment formula argument left)
      (ht024-ambient-replacement-instance-p
       environment formula argument right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-formula-functional-on-p
    (set formula environment)
  (forall (argument)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p set argument)
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-replacement-value-exists-p
       environment formula argument)
      (ht024-ambient-replacement-value-unique-p
       environment formula argument)))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-image-member-p
    (set formula environment value)
  (exists (argument)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p set argument)
     (ht024-ambient-replacement-instance-p
      environment formula argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-set-p
    (result set formula environment)
  (forall (value)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p result)
     (implies
      (ht024-ambient-set-p value)
      (iff
       (ht024-member-p result value)
       (ht024-ambient-replacement-image-member-p
        set formula environment value))))))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-set-exists-p
    (set formula environment)
  (exists (result)
    (ht024-ambient-replacement-set-p
     result set formula environment)))

(defun-sk ht024-ambient-replacement-p ()
  (forall (set formula environment)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-ambient-set-p set)
      (ht024-formula-p formula)
      (ht024-ambient-formula-functional-on-p
       set formula environment))
     (ht024-ambient-replacement-set-exists-p
      set formula environment))))

(defun ht024-ambient-zf-p ()
  (and
   (ht024-ambient-membership-typed-p)
   (ht024-ambient-satisfaction-laws-p)
   (ht024-ambient-extensionality-p)
   (ht024-ambient-empty-exists-p)
   (ht024-ambient-pairing-p)
   (ht024-ambient-union-axiom-p)
   (ht024-ambient-power-axiom-p)
   (ht024-ambient-infinity-p)
   (ht024-ambient-foundation-p)
   (ht024-ambient-separation-p)
   (ht024-ambient-replacement-p)))

;; The natural numbers object is the least ambient inductive set.
(defun-sk ht024-least-inductive-p (omega)
  (forall (inductive)
    (implies
     (ht024-ambient-inductive-p inductive)
     (ht024-subset-p omega inductive))))

(defun ht024-omega-p (omega)
  (and
   (ht024-ambient-inductive-p omega)
   (ht024-least-inductive-p omega)))

;; A bijection is an ambient membership-defined graph of Kuratowski pairs.
(defun-sk ht024-graph-entry-on-p (entry domain codomain)
  (exists (argument value)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p domain argument)
     (ht024-member-p codomain value)
     (ht024-ordered-pair-p entry argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-on-p (graph domain codomain)
  (forall (entry)
    (and
     (ht024-ambient-set-p graph)
     (implies
      (ht024-member-p graph entry)
