      (ht024-graph-entry-on-p entry domain codomain)))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-value-exists-p
    (graph codomain argument)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p codomain value)
     (ht024-relation-holds-p graph argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-total-p (graph domain codomain)
  (forall (argument)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p domain argument)
     (ht024-graph-value-exists-p graph codomain argument))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-single-valued-p (graph domain codomain)
  (forall (argument left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p domain argument)
      (ht024-member-p codomain left)
      (ht024-member-p codomain right)
      (ht024-relation-holds-p graph argument left)
      (ht024-relation-holds-p graph argument right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-injective-p (graph domain codomain)
  (forall (left right value)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht024-member-p domain left)
      (ht024-member-p domain right)
      (ht024-member-p codomain value)
      (ht024-relation-holds-p graph left value)
      (ht024-relation-holds-p graph right value))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-preimage-exists-p
    (graph domain value)
  (exists (argument)
    (and
     (ht024-member-p domain argument)
     (ht024-relation-holds-p graph argument value))))

(defun-sk ht024-graph-surjective-p (graph domain codomain)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (ht024-member-p codomain value)
     (ht024-graph-preimage-exists-p graph domain value))))

(defun ht024-bijection-graph-p (graph domain codomain)
  (and
   (ht024-ambient-set-p domain)
   (ht024-ambient-set-p codomain)
   (ht024-graph-on-p graph domain codomain)
   (ht024-graph-total-p graph domain codomain)
   (ht024-graph-single-valued-p graph domain codomain)
   (ht024-graph-injective-p graph domain codomain)
   (ht024-graph-surjective-p graph domain codomain)))

(defun-sk ht024-equinumerous-with-nat-p (model)
  (exists (omega graph)
    (and
     (ht024-omega-p omega)
     (ht024-bijection-graph-p graph omega model))))

(defun-sk ht024-same-ordinals-p (left right)
  (forall (ordinal)
    (implies
     (ht024-ordinal-p ordinal)
     (iff
      (ht024-member-p left ordinal)
      (ht024-member-p right ordinal)))))

;; This DEFUN-SK restores the source's internal existential quantifier over N.
(defun-sk ht024-extension-exists-p (model)
  (exists (extension)
    (and
     (ht024-subset-p model extension)
     (not (ht024-set-equal-p model extension))
     (ht024-equinumerous-with-nat-p extension)
     (ht024-transitive-p extension)
     (ht024-satisfies-zf-p extension)
     (ht024-same-ordinals-p model extension)
     (implies
      (ht024-satisfies-ac-p model)
      (ht024-satisfies-zfc-p extension)))))

(defun hundred-theorems-024-extensions-of-ctms-statement (model)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht024-ambient-zf-p)
    (ht024-satisfaction-laws-p)
    (ht024-ambient-set-p model)
    (ht024-equinumerous-with-nat-p model)
    (ht024-transitive-p model)
    (ht024-satisfies-zf-p model))
   (ht024-extension-exists-p model)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 024, "The
-- Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis": every countable transitive set
-- model of ZF has a proper countable transitive ZF extension with the same
-- ordinals, and source-model AC yields ZFC in the extension. This file
-- contains no proof.

module Main where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_
infix 1 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not A = A -> Bottom

NotEqual : {a : Level} {A : Set a} -> A -> A -> Set a
NotEqual x y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record _and_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists {a p : Level} (A : Set a) (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

-- This structure becomes the ambient Isabelle/ZF universe only through the
-- ZFUniverse record below, which requires the complete ZF theory.
record MembershipStructure : Set₁ where
  field
    Carrier    : Set
    membership : Carrier -> Carrier -> Set

open MembershipStructure

UniversalDomain :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
UniversalDomain S x = Top

record InDomain
  (S : MembershipStructure)
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) :
  Set where

  constructor element
  field
    object    : Carrier S
    in-domain : D object

open InDomain

-- This is the full first-order language used by Isabelle/ZF: atomic equality
-- and membership, Sheffer NAND, and universal quantification. The index gives
-- the exact finite environment length. Thus the syntax ranges over every
-- formula with every arbitrary finite tuple of parameters; it is the
-- well-scoped de Bruijn presentation of Isabelle's formula/environment lists.
data Formula (free-variables : Nat) : Set where
  Equal  :
    Fin free-variables ->
    Fin free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  Member :
    Fin free-variables ->
    Fin free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  Nand   :
    Formula free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  Forall :
    Formula (suc free-variables) ->
    Formula free-variables

Assignment :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Assignment S D n =
  Fin n -> InDomain S D

extend :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> A) ->
  A ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  A
extend assignment new-value fzero =
  new-value
extend assignment new-value (fsuc index) =
  assignment index

-- Recursive Tarskian satisfaction for precisely that formula language.
-- In particular, no excluded-middle or decidability field is assumed.
Satisfies :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  {free-variables : Nat} ->
  Formula free-variables ->
  Assignment S D free-variables ->
  Set
Satisfies S D (Equal i j) assignment =
  object (assignment i) == object (assignment j)
Satisfies S D (Member i j) assignment =
  membership S (object (assignment i)) (object (assignment j))
Satisfies S D (Nand left-formula right-formula) assignment =
  Not
    (Satisfies S D left-formula assignment and
     Satisfies S D right-formula assignment)
Satisfies S D (Forall formula) assignment =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  Satisfies S D formula (extend assignment x)

record ExistsUniqueIn
  (S : MembershipStructure)
  (D : Carrier S -> Set)
  (P : InDomain S D -> Set) :
  Set where

  constructor unique-witness
  field
    unique-value    : InDomain S D
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness      :
      (other : InDomain S D) ->
      P other ->
      object other == object unique-value

SubsetObject :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
SubsetObject S a b =
  (x : Carrier S) ->
  membership S x a ->
  membership S x b

Transset :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
Transset S a =
  (x y : Carrier S) ->
  membership S x y ->
  membership S y a ->
  membership S x a

SameMembersIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
SameMembersIn S D a b =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  (membership S (object x) a iff
   membership S (object x) b)

IsEmptyIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsEmptyIn S D empty =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  Not (membership S (object x) empty)

IsInhabitedIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsInhabitedIn S D a =
  Exists (InDomain S D)
    (\ x -> membership S (object x) a)

SubsetIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
SubsetIn S D a b =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object x) a ->
  membership S (object x) b

IsPairIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsPairIn S D a b pair =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  (membership S (object x) pair iff
   (object x == a or object x == b))

IsUnionIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsUnionIn S D family union =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  (membership S (object x) union iff
   Exists (InDomain S D)
     (\ member ->
       membership S (object member) family and
       membership S (object x) (object member)))

IsPowerSetIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsPowerSetIn S D a power =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  (membership S (object x) power iff
   SubsetIn S D (object x) a)

IsSuccessorIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsSuccessorIn S D a successor =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  (membership S (object x) successor iff
   (membership S (object x) a or object x == a))

IsInductiveIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsInductiveIn S D inductive-set =
  Exists (InDomain S D)
    (\ empty ->
      IsEmptyIn S D (object empty) and
      membership S (object empty) inductive-set) and
  ((x : InDomain S D) ->
    membership S (object x) inductive-set ->
    Exists (InDomain S D)
      (\ successor ->
        IsSuccessorIn S D (object x) (object successor) and
        membership S (object successor) inductive-set))

IsOmega :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsOmega S omega =
  IsInductiveIn S (UniversalDomain S) omega and
  ((inductive-set : Carrier S) ->
    IsInductiveIn S (UniversalDomain S) inductive-set ->
    SubsetObject S omega inductive-set)

FunctionalFormulaOn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  {parameter-count : Nat} ->
  Formula (suc (suc parameter-count)) ->
  Assignment S D parameter-count ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
FunctionalFormulaOn S D formula parameters domain =
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object x) domain ->
  ExistsUniqueIn S D
    (\ y ->
      Satisfies S D formula
        (extend (extend parameters x) y))

-- A model satisfies ZF exactly when it satisfies all eight axioms, with
-- Separation and Replacement ranging over the complete syntax above and all
-- finite parameter environments.
record SatisfiesZF
  (S : MembershipStructure)
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) :
  Set where

  field
    extensionality :
      (a b : InDomain S D) ->
      SameMembersIn S D (object a) (object b) ->
      object a == object b

    empty-set :
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ empty -> IsEmptyIn S D (object empty))

    pairing :
      (a b : InDomain S D) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ pair ->
          IsPairIn S D (object a) (object b) (object pair))

    union :
      (a : InDomain S D) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ union-set ->
          IsUnionIn S D (object a) (object union-set))

    power-set :
      (a : InDomain S D) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ power ->
          IsPowerSetIn S D (object a) (object power))

    infinity :
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ inductive-set ->
          IsInductiveIn S D (object inductive-set))

    separation :
      (parameter-count : Nat) ->
      (formula : Formula (suc parameter-count)) ->
      (parameters : Assignment S D parameter-count) ->
      (a : InDomain S D) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ subset ->
          (x : InDomain S D) ->
          (membership S (object x) (object subset) iff
           (membership S (object x) (object a) and
            Satisfies S D formula (extend parameters x))))

    -- Variable zero is the value, variable one the argument, and the
    -- remaining variables are the arbitrary parameter tuple.
    replacement :
      (parameter-count : Nat) ->
      (formula : Formula (suc (suc parameter-count))) ->
      (parameters : Assignment S D parameter-count) ->
      (a : InDomain S D) ->
      FunctionalFormulaOn S D formula parameters (object a) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ image ->
          (y : InDomain S D) ->
          (membership S (object y) (object image) iff
           Exists (InDomain S D)
             (\ x ->
               membership S (object x) (object a) and
               Satisfies S D formula
                 (extend (extend parameters x) y))))

    foundation :
      (a : InDomain S D) ->
      IsInhabitedIn S D (object a) ->
      Exists (InDomain S D)
        (\ least ->
          membership S (object least) (object a) and
          ((x : InDomain S D) ->
            membership S (object x) (object least) ->
            Not (membership S (object x) (object a))))

-- A ZFUniverse represents the fixed ambient Isabelle/ZF set universe. Thus
-- every object quantified below, including N and every ordinal, is an ambient
-- set rather than an element of an unconstrained relational structure.
record ZFUniverse : Set₁ where
  field
    ambient                  : MembershipStructure
    ambient-satisfies-ZF     :
      SatisfiesZF ambient (UniversalDomain ambient)
    natural-numbers          : Carrier ambient
    natural-numbers-is-omega : IsOmega ambient natural-numbers

open ZFUniverse

SetObject : ZFUniverse -> Set
SetObject U =
  Carrier (ambient U)

Belongs :
  (U : ZFUniverse) ->
  SetObject U ->
  SetObject U ->
  Set
Belongs U =
  membership (ambient U)

ModelDomain :
  (U : ZFUniverse) ->
  SetObject U ->
  SetObject U ->
  Set
ModelDomain U M x =
  Belongs U x M

IsSingleton :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsSingleton S x singleton =
  (z : InDomain S (UniversalDomain S)) ->
  (membership S (object z) singleton iff object z == x)

-- Isabelle/ZF functions and bijections are ambient sets of Kuratowski ordered
-- pairs. This definition says that pair-code is {{x},{x,y}}.
IsOrderedPair :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsOrderedPair S x y pair-code =
  Exists (Carrier S)
    (\ singleton ->
      IsSingleton S x singleton and
      Exists (Carrier S)
        (\ unordered-pair ->
          IsPairIn S (UniversalDomain S) x y unordered-pair and
          IsPairIn S (UniversalDomain S)
            singleton unordered-pair pair-code))

GraphRelates :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
GraphRelates S graph x y =
  Exists (Carrier S)
    (\ pair-code ->
      membership S pair-code graph and
      IsOrderedPair S x y pair-code)

record IsSetCodedBijection
  (S : MembershipStructure)
  (graph domain codomain : Carrier S) :
  Set where

  field
    graph-between :
      (pair-code : Carrier S) ->
      membership S pair-code graph ->
      Exists (InDomain S (\ x -> membership S x domain))
        (\ x ->
          Exists (InDomain S (\ y -> membership S y codomain))
            (\ y ->
              IsOrderedPair S
                (object x) (object y) pair-code))

    total-and-functional :
      (x : InDomain S (\ z -> membership S z domain)) ->
      ExistsUniqueIn S (\ y -> membership S y codomain)
        (\ y -> GraphRelates S graph (object x) (object y))

    injective :
      (x-one x-two : InDomain S (\ z -> membership S z domain)) ->
      (y : InDomain S (\ z -> membership S z codomain)) ->
      GraphRelates S graph (object x-one) (object y) ->
      GraphRelates S graph (object x-two) (object y) ->
      object x-one == object x-two

    surjective :
      (y : InDomain S (\ z -> membership S z codomain)) ->
      Exists (InDomain S (\ x -> membership S x domain))
        (\ x -> GraphRelates S graph (object x) (object y))

Equinumerous :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
Equinumerous S a b =
  Exists (Carrier S)
    (\ graph -> IsSetCodedBijection S graph a b)

Countable :
  (U : ZFUniverse) ->
  SetObject U ->
  Set
Countable U M =
  Equinumerous (ambient U) M (natural-numbers U)

NonemptyMembersIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
NonemptyMembersIn S D family =
  (a : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object a) family ->
  Exists (InDomain S D)
    (\ x -> membership S (object x) (object a))

PairwiseDisjointIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjointIn S D family =
  (a b : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object a) family ->
  membership S (object b) family ->
  NotEqual (object a) (object b) ->
  (x : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object x) (object a) ->
  Not (membership S (object x) (object b))

IsChoiceSetIn :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsChoiceSetIn S D family choice =
  (a : InDomain S D) ->
  membership S (object a) family ->
  ExistsUniqueIn S D
    (\ selected ->
      membership S (object selected) (object a) and
      membership S (object selected) choice)

ChoiceAxiom :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Set
ChoiceAxiom S D =
  (family : InDomain S D) ->
  NonemptyMembersIn S D (object family) ->
  PairwiseDisjointIn S D (object family) ->
  Exists (InDomain S D)
    (\ choice ->
      IsChoiceSetIn S D (object family) (object choice))

SatisfiesZFC :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  (D : Carrier S -> Set) ->
  Set
SatisfiesZFC S D =
  SatisfiesZF S D and ChoiceAxiom S D

-- Isabelle/ZF defines an ordinal as a transitive set whose elements are
-- transitive sets. The surrounding ZF universe supplies Foundation.
IsOrdinal :
  (S : MembershipStructure) ->
  Carrier S ->
  Set
IsOrdinal S ordinal =
  Transset S ordinal and
  ((member : Carrier S) ->
    membership S member ordinal ->
    Transset S member)

SameOrdinals :
  (U : ZFUniverse) ->
  SetObject U ->
  SetObject U ->
  Set
SameOrdinals U M N =
  (ordinal : SetObject U) ->
  IsOrdinal (ambient U) ordinal ->
  (Belongs U ordinal M iff Belongs U ordinal N)

the-undecidability-of-the-continuum-hypothesis : Set₁
the-undecidability-of-the-continuum-hypothesis =
  (U : ZFUniverse) ->
  (M : SetObject U) ->
  Countable U M ->
  Transset (ambient U) M ->
  SatisfiesZF (ambient U) (ModelDomain U M) ->
  Exists (SetObject U)
    (\ N ->
      SubsetObject (ambient U) M N and
      Countable U N and
      Transset (ambient U) N and
      SatisfiesZF (ambient U) (ModelDomain U N) and
      NotEqual M N and
      SameOrdinals U M N and
      (ChoiceAxiom (ambient U) (ModelDomain U M) ->
       SatisfiesZFC (ambient U) (ModelDomain U N)))

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis" from Hundred
  Theorems item 024. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory cardinalTheory combinTheory pred_setTheory;

val extensions_of_ctms =
  ``let pair_num =
      \i j : num. ((i + j) * (i + j + 1)) DIV 2 + j
    in
    let valuation =
      \(M : (num set) set) (v : num -> num set).
        !i. v i IN M
    in
    let denumerable =
      \(M : (num set) set).
        ?enumerate : num -> num set.
          BIJ enumerate (UNIV : num set) M
    in
    let transitive_model =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool) (M : (num set) set).
        (!x y. y IN M /\ mem x y ==> x IN M) /\
        (!S : (num set) set.
           S SUBSET M /\ ~(S = EMPTY) ==>
           ?x. x IN S /\ !y. y IN S ==> ~mem y x)
    in
    let tarski =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set)
       (sat : (num -> num set) -> num -> bool).
        (!v i j.
           valuation M v ==>
           (sat v (5 * pair_num i j) <=> v i = v j)) /\
        (!v i j.
           valuation M v ==>
           (sat v (5 * pair_num i j + 1) <=> mem (v i) (v j))) /\
        (!v p.
           valuation M v ==>
           (sat v (5 * p + 2) <=> ~sat v p)) /\
        (!v p q.
           valuation M v ==>
           (sat v (5 * pair_num p q + 3) <=>
              sat v p /\ sat v q)) /\
        (!v i p.
           valuation M v ==>
           (sat v (5 * pair_num i p + 4) <=>
              ?x. x IN M /\ sat ((i =+ x) v) p))
    in
    let zf_model =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set)
       (sat : (num -> num set) -> num -> bool).
        tarski mem M sat /\
        (!x y.
           x IN M /\ y IN M /\
           (!z. z IN M ==> (mem z x <=> mem z y))
           ==> x = y) /\
        (?e. e IN M /\ !z. z IN M ==> ~mem z e) /\
        (!x y.
           x IN M /\ y IN M ==>
           ?p. p IN M /\
               !z. z IN M ==> (mem z p <=> z = x \/ z = y)) /\
        (!a.
           a IN M ==>
           ?u. u IN M /\
               !z. z IN M ==>
                 (mem z u <=>
                    ?y. y IN M /\ mem y a /\ mem z y)) /\
        (!a.
           a IN M ==>
           ?p. p IN M /\
               !z. z IN M ==>
                 (mem z p <=>
                    !w. w IN M /\ mem w z ==> mem w a)) /\
        (?i.
           i IN M /\
           (?e.
              e IN M /\
              (!z. z IN M ==> ~mem z e) /\
              mem e i) /\
           (!x.
              x IN M /\ mem x i ==>
              ?s. s IN M /\
                  (!z.
                     z IN M ==>
                     (mem z s <=> mem z x \/ z = x)) /\
                  mem s i)) /\
        (!a.
           a IN M /\ (?x. x IN M /\ mem x a) ==>
           ?x. x IN M /\ mem x a /\
               !y. y IN M /\ mem y a ==> ~mem y x) /\
        (!phi v a.
           valuation M v /\ a IN M ==>
           ?b. b IN M /\
               !x. x IN M ==>
                 (mem x b <=>
                    mem x a /\ sat ((0 =+ x) v) phi)) /\
        (!phi v a.
           valuation M v /\ a IN M /\
           (!x.
              x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
              ?y. y IN M /\
                  sat ((1 =+ y) ((0 =+ x) v)) phi /\
                  (!y'.
                     y' IN M /\
                     sat ((1 =+ y') ((0 =+ x) v)) phi
                     ==> y' = y))
           ==>
           ?b. b IN M /\
               !y. y IN M ==>
                 (mem y b <=>
                    ?x. x IN M /\ mem x a /\
                        sat ((1 =+ y) ((0 =+ x) v)) phi))
    in
    let singleton =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set) x s.
        x IN M /\ s IN M /\
        !z. z IN M ==> (mem z s <=> z = x)
    in
    let unordered_pair =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set) x y p.
        x IN M /\ y IN M /\ p IN M /\
        !z. z IN M ==> (mem z p <=> z = x \/ z = y)
    in
    let ordered_pair =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set) x y p.
        ?sx xy.
          singleton mem M x sx /\
          unordered_pair mem M x y xy /\
          unordered_pair mem M sx xy p
    in
    let relates =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set) f x y.
        ?p. p IN M /\ ordered_pair mem M x y p /\ mem p f
    in
    let choice_function =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set) a f.
        a IN M /\ f IN M /\
        (!p.
           p IN M /\ mem p f ==>
           ?x y.
             x IN M /\ y IN M /\ mem x a /\ mem y x /\
             ordered_pair mem M x y p) /\
        (!x.
           x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
           ?y. y IN M /\ mem y x /\ relates mem M f x y) /\
        (!x y z.
           x IN M /\ y IN M /\ z IN M /\
           relates mem M f x y /\ relates mem M f x z
           ==> y = z)
    in
    let ac_model =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool) (M : (num set) set).
        !a.
          a IN M /\
          (!x.
             x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
             ?y. y IN M /\ mem y x)
          ==>
          ?f. f IN M /\ choice_function mem M a f
    in
    let transitive_object =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool) (a : num set).
        !x y. mem x y /\ mem y a ==> mem x a
    in
    let ordinal =
      \(mem : num set -> num set -> bool) (a : num set).
        transitive_object mem a /\
        (!x. mem x a ==> transitive_object mem x) /\
        (!x y.
           mem x a /\ mem y a ==>
           x = y \/ mem x y \/ mem y x) /\
        (!S : (num set) set.
           S SUBSET {x | mem x a} /\ ~(S = EMPTY) ==>
           ?m. m IN S /\ !x. x IN S ==> ~mem x m)
    in
    let end_extends =
      \(old_mem : num set -> num set -> bool)
       (M : (num set) set)
       (new_mem : num set -> num set -> bool).
        !x y. y IN M ==> (new_mem x y <=> old_mem x y)
    in
    !(mem : num set -> num set -> bool) (M : (num set) set).
      denumerable M /\
      transitive_model mem M /\
      (?satM : (num -> num set) -> num -> bool.
         zf_model mem M satM)
      ==>
      ?memN N satN.
        M SUBSET N /\
        ~(M = N) /\
        end_extends mem M memN /\
        denumerable N /\
        transitive_model memN N /\
        zf_model memN N satN /\
        (!alpha : num set.
           (alpha IN M /\ ordinal mem alpha) <=>
           (alpha IN N /\ ordinal memN alpha)) /\
        (ac_model mem M ==> ac_model memN N)``;

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Undecidability of the Continuum
  Hypothesis" from Hundred Theorems item 024: every countable transitive set
  model of ZF has a proper countable transitive ZF extension with the same
  ordinals, and Choice in the source model implies ZFC in the extension.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The predicates below are grounded in set.mm. HT024ZFModels is the class of
  sets satisfying the six displayed Godel-coded ZF axioms and every instance
  of the Godel-coded Replacement scheme. Transitivity remains a separate
  condition, exactly as in the Isabelle source.

  HT024AxChoice is the closed pure-membership sentence saying that every
  pairwise-disjoint family of nonempty sets has a choice set meeting each
  family member in exactly one element. Over ZF this is equivalent to the
  source's axiom of choice. Since the code is closed, set.mm validity
  M |= HT024AxChoice is equivalent to satisfaction under the empty assignment.

  HT024ZFCModels is defined as ZF satisfaction together with satisfaction of
  this Choice sentence. The final declaration is an unproved $a statement;
  the artifact adds no proof.
$)

$c HT024AxChoice HT024ZFModels HT024ZFCModels $.

ht024-choice-syntax $a class HT024AxChoice $.
ht024-zf-models-syntax $a class HT024ZFModels $.
ht024-zfc-models-syntax $a class HT024ZFCModels $.

$(
  Variable indices in HT024AxChoice are:
    0 family, 1 and 2 family members, 3 selected element, and 4 choice set.
  Index 2 is reused as the comparison element after its earlier scope ends.
$)
ht024-choice-definition $a |- HT024AxChoice =
  A.g (/) (
    (
      (
        A.g 1o (
          ( 1o e.g (/) )
          ->g
          E.g 2o ( 2o e.g 1o )
        )
        /\g
        A.g 1o A.g 2o (
          (
            (
              ( 1o e.g (/) )
              /\g
              ( 2o e.g (/) )
            )
            /\g
            -.g ( 1o =g 2o )
          )
          ->g
          -.g E.g 3o (
            ( 3o e.g 1o )
            /\g
            ( 3o e.g 2o )
          )
        )
      )
      ->g
      E.g 4o A.g 1o (
        ( 1o e.g (/) )
        ->g
        E.g 3o (
          (
            ( 3o e.g 1o )
            /\g
            ( 3o e.g 4o )
          )
          /\g
          A.g 2o (
            (
              ( 2o e.g 1o )
              /\g
              ( 2o e.g 4o )
            )
            ->g
            ( 2o =g 3o )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.

${
  $d m u $.
  ht024-zf-models-definition $a |- HT024ZFModels = { m |
    (
      ( m |= AxExt /\ m |= AxPow )
      /\
      ( m |= AxUn /\ m |= AxReg )
      /\
      (
        m |= AxInf
        /\
        A. u e. ( Fmla ` _om ) m |= ( AxRep ` u )
      )
    )
  } $.
$}

ht024-zfc-models-definition $a |- HT024ZFCModels = { m |
  (
    m e. HT024ZFModels
    /\
    m |= HT024AxChoice
  )
} $.

${
  $d M n a $.
  ht024-source-model-countable $e |- M ~~ _om $.
  ht024-source-model-transitive $e |- Tr M $.
  ht024-source-model-zf $e |- M e. HT024ZFModels $.

  extensions-of-ctms $a |- (
    E. n (
      M C_ n
      /\
      (
        n ~~ _om
        /\
        (
          Tr n
          /\
          (
            n e. HT024ZFModels
            /\
            (
              M =/= n
              /\
              (
                (
                  A. a (
                    Ord a
                    ->
                    (
                      a e. M
                      <->
                      a e. n
                    )
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  M |= HT024AxChoice
                  ->
                  n e. HT024ZFCModels
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 024,
:: "The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis." It states the supplied
:: countable-transitive-model extension theorem: a countable transitive ZF
:: model has a proper countable transitive ZF extension with the same ordinals,
:: and choice in the ground model yields choice in the extension. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ZF_LANG, ZF_MODEL;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, ZF_LANG, ZF_MODEL;
  constructors TARSKI, NUMBERS, ZF_MODEL;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ZF_LANG;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for M being non empty set st
    M,NAT are_equipotent &
    M is epsilon-transitive &
    M is being_a_model_of_ZF
  holds ex N being non empty set st
    M c= N &
    M <> N &
    N,NAT are_equipotent &
    N is epsilon-transitive &
    N is being_a_model_of_ZF &
    (for A being Ordinal holds (A in M iff A in N)) &
    ((for X being Element of M st
        (for Y being Element of M st Y in X holds Y <> {})
      holds ex f being Function st
        f in M & dom f = X &
        (for Y being Element of M st Y in X holds f.Y in Y))
     implies
     (for X being Element of N st
        (for Y being Element of N st Y in X holds Y <> {})
      holds ex f being Function st
        f in N & dom f = X &
        (for Y being Element of N st Y in X holds f.Y in Y)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 024_the_undecidability_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis" from
% Hundred Theorems item 024: every set-theoretically countable transitive ZF model has a
% proper such extension with the same ordinals, preserving choice when it is present.
% This file contains no proof.

zf_formula_024: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  zf_equal_024(left_variable, right_variable: nat): zf_equal_024?
  zf_member_024(left_variable, right_variable: nat): zf_member_024?
  zf_not_024(not_body: zf_formula_024): zf_not_024?
  zf_and_024(and_left, and_right: zf_formula_024): zf_and_024?
  zf_forall_024(bound_variable: nat, forall_body: zf_formula_024): zf_forall_024?
END zf_formula_024

hundred_theorems_024: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING zf_formula_024

  set_object: TYPE+
  set_collection: TYPE = [set_object -> bool]
  nat_environment: TYPE = [nat -> set_object]

  member: [set_object, set_object -> bool]

  carrier(M: set_object): set_collection =
    LAMBDA (value: set_object): member(value, M)

  assign(rho: nat_environment, variable: nat, value: set_object): nat_environment =
    rho WITH [(variable) := value]

  holds_in(
      M: set_collection,
      rho: nat_environment,
      phi: zf_formula_024): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES phi OF
      zf_equal_024(left_variable, right_variable):
        rho(left_variable) = rho(right_variable),
      zf_member_024(left_variable, right_variable):
        member(rho(left_variable), rho(right_variable)),
      zf_not_024(body):
        NOT holds_in(M, rho, body),
      zf_and_024(left, right):
        holds_in(M, rho, left) AND holds_in(M, rho, right),
      zf_forall_024(variable, body):
        FORALL (value: set_object):
          M(value) IMPLIES holds_in(M, assign(rho, variable, value), body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE phi BY <<

  in_model_assignment(M: set_collection, rho: nat_environment): bool =
    FORALL (variable: nat): M(rho(variable))

  object_subset(left, right: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (value: set_object):
      member(value, left) IMPLIES member(value, right)

  model_subset(
      M: set_collection,
      left, right: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (value: set_object):
      M(value) IMPLIES
        (member(value, left) IMPLIES member(value, right))

  transitive_object(value: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (element: set_object):
      member(element, value) IMPLIES object_subset(element, value)

  is_ordinal(value: set_object): bool =
    transitive_object(value)
      AND
      (FORALL (element: set_object):
        member(element, value) IMPLIES transitive_object(element))

  empty_object(empty_set: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (value: set_object):
      NOT member(value, empty_set)

  successor_object(value, successor: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (element: set_object):
      member(element, successor)
        IFF (member(element, value) OR element = value)

  inductive_object(value: set_object): bool =
    (EXISTS (empty_set: set_object):
      empty_object(empty_set) AND member(empty_set, value))
      AND
      (FORALL (element: set_object):
        member(element, value)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (successor: set_object):
            successor_object(element, successor)
              AND member(successor, value))

  is_omega(value: set_object): bool =
    inductive_object(value)
      AND
      (FORALL (inductive_set: set_object):
        inductive_object(inductive_set)
          IMPLIES object_subset(value, inductive_set))

  subset(M, N: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (value: set_object):
      M(value) IMPLIES N(value)

  transitive(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (element, container: set_object):
      (M(container) AND member(element, container)) IMPLIES M(element)

  extensionality_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: set_object):
      (M(left) AND M(right)
        AND
        (FORALL (value: set_object):
          M(value) IMPLIES
            (member(value, left) IFF member(value, right))))
      IMPLIES left = right

  foundation_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (container: set_object):
      (M(container)
        AND
        (EXISTS (element: set_object):
          M(element) AND member(element, container)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (minimal: set_object):
          M(minimal)
            AND member(minimal, container)
            AND
            (FORALL (value: set_object):
              M(value) IMPLIES
                NOT (member(value, minimal) AND member(value, container)))

  pairing_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: set_object):
      (M(left) AND M(right))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (pair: set_object):
          M(pair)
            AND
            (FORALL (value: set_object):
              M(value) IMPLIES
                (member(value, pair) IFF (value = left OR value = right)))

  union_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (family: set_object):
      M(family)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (union_set: set_object):
          M(union_set)
            AND
            (FORALL (value: set_object):
              M(value) IMPLIES
                (member(value, union_set)
                  IFF
                  EXISTS (container: set_object):
                    M(container)
                      AND member(container, family)
                      AND member(value, container)))

  power_set_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (base: set_object):
      M(base)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (power_set: set_object):
          M(power_set)
            AND
            (FORALL (value: set_object):
              M(value) IMPLIES
                (member(value, power_set) IFF model_subset(M, value, base)))

  empty_in_model(M: set_collection, empty_set: set_object): bool =
    M(empty_set)
      AND
      (FORALL (value: set_object):
        M(value) IMPLIES NOT member(value, empty_set))

  successor_in_model(
      M: set_collection,
      value, successor: set_object): bool =
    M(successor)
      AND
      (FORALL (element: set_object):
        M(element) IMPLIES
          (member(element, successor)
            IFF (member(element, value) OR element = value)))

  infinity_axiom(M: set_collection): bool =
    EXISTS (inductive_set, empty_set: set_object):
      M(inductive_set)
        AND empty_in_model(M, empty_set)
        AND member(empty_set, inductive_set)
        AND
        (FORALL (value: set_object):
          (M(value) AND member(value, inductive_set))
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (successor: set_object):
              successor_in_model(M, value, successor)
                AND member(successor, inductive_set))

  separation_schema(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL
        (phi: zf_formula_024),
        (rho: nat_environment),
        (base: set_object):
      (in_model_assignment(M, rho) AND M(base))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (separated: set_object):
          M(separated)
            AND
            (FORALL (value: set_object):
              M(value) IMPLIES
                (member(value, separated)
                  IFF
                  (member(value, base)
                    AND holds_in(
                      M, assign(rho, 0, value), phi))))

  functional_on(
      M: set_collection,
      rho: nat_environment,
      base: set_object,
      phi: zf_formula_024): bool =
    FORALL (argument: set_object):
      (M(argument) AND member(argument, base))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (image: set_object):
          M(image)
            AND holds_in(
              M,
              assign(assign(rho, 0, argument), 1, image),
              phi)
            AND
            (FORALL (other_image: set_object):
              (M(other_image)
                AND holds_in(
                  M,
                  assign(assign(rho, 0, argument), 1, other_image),
                  phi))
              IMPLIES other_image = image)

  replacement_schema(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL
        (phi: zf_formula_024),
        (rho: nat_environment),
        (base: set_object):
      (in_model_assignment(M, rho)
        AND M(base)
        AND functional_on(M, rho, base, phi))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (range_set: set_object):
          M(range_set)
            AND
            (FORALL (image: set_object):
              M(image) IMPLIES
                (member(image, range_set)
                  IFF
                  EXISTS (argument: set_object):
                    M(argument)
                      AND member(argument, base)
                      AND holds_in(
                        M,
                        assign(assign(rho, 0, argument), 1, image),
                        phi)))

  models_zf(M: set_collection): bool =
    extensionality_axiom(M)
      AND foundation_axiom(M)
      AND pairing_axiom(M)
      AND union_axiom(M)
      AND power_set_axiom(M)
      AND infinity_axiom(M)
      AND separation_schema(M)
      AND replacement_schema(M)

  pairwise_disjoint_family(
      M: set_collection,
      family: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (left, right, value: set_object):
      (M(left)
        AND M(right)
        AND M(value)
        AND member(left, family)
        AND member(right, family)
        AND left /= right)
      IMPLIES NOT (member(value, left) AND member(value, right))

  nonempty_family(M: set_collection, family: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (container: set_object):
      (M(container) AND member(container, family))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (value: set_object):
          M(value) AND member(value, container)

  is_choice_set(
      M: set_collection,
      family, choice_set: set_object): bool =
    M(choice_set)
      AND
      (FORALL (container: set_object):
        (M(container) AND member(container, family))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (chosen: set_object):
            M(chosen)
              AND member(chosen, container)
              AND member(chosen, choice_set)
              AND
              (FORALL (other: set_object):
                (M(other)
                  AND member(other, container)
                  AND member(other, choice_set))
                IMPLIES other = chosen))

  models_choice(M: set_collection): bool =
    FORALL (family: set_object):
      (M(family)
        AND pairwise_disjoint_family(M, family)
        AND nonempty_family(M, family))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (choice_set: set_object):
          is_choice_set(M, family, choice_set)

  models_zfc(M: set_collection): bool =
    models_zf(M) AND models_choice(M)

  models_zf_set(M: set_object): bool =
    models_zf(carrier(M))

  models_choice_set(M: set_object): bool =
    models_choice(carrier(M))

  models_zfc_set(M: set_object): bool =
    models_zfc(carrier(M))

  universe: set_collection =
    LAMBDA (value: set_object): TRUE

  ambient_zf: bool =
    models_zf(universe)

  is_singleton(singleton, value: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (element: set_object):
      member(element, singleton) IFF element = value

  is_unordered_pair(
      pair, left, right: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (element: set_object):
      member(element, pair)
        IFF (element = left OR element = right)

  is_ordered_pair(
      pair, left, right: set_object): bool =
    EXISTS (singleton_left, unordered_pair: set_object):
      is_singleton(singleton_left, left)
        AND is_unordered_pair(unordered_pair, left, right)
        AND is_unordered_pair(pair, singleton_left, unordered_pair)

  graph_value(
      graph, argument, image: set_object): bool =
    EXISTS (pair: set_object):
      member(pair, graph)
        AND is_ordered_pair(pair, argument, image)

  graph_between(
      graph, domain, codomain: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (pair: set_object):
      member(pair, graph)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (argument, image: set_object):
          member(argument, domain)
            AND member(image, codomain)
            AND is_ordered_pair(pair, argument, image)

  total_function_graph(
      graph, domain, codomain: set_object): bool =
    graph_between(graph, domain, codomain)
      AND
      (FORALL (argument: set_object):
        member(argument, domain)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (image: set_object):
            member(image, codomain)
              AND graph_value(graph, argument, image))
      AND
      (FORALL (argument, left_image, right_image: set_object):
        (member(argument, domain)
          AND member(left_image, codomain)
          AND member(right_image, codomain)
          AND graph_value(graph, argument, left_image)
          AND graph_value(graph, argument, right_image))
        IMPLIES left_image = right_image)

  injective_graph(
      graph, domain, codomain: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (left, right, image: set_object):
      (member(left, domain)
        AND member(right, domain)
        AND member(image, codomain)
        AND graph_value(graph, left, image)
        AND graph_value(graph, right, image))
      IMPLIES left = right

  surjective_graph(
      graph, domain, codomain: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (image: set_object):
      member(image, codomain)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (argument: set_object):
          member(argument, domain)
            AND graph_value(graph, argument, image)

  is_bijection_graph(
      graph, domain, codomain: set_object): bool =
    total_function_graph(graph, domain, codomain)
      AND injective_graph(graph, domain, codomain)
      AND surjective_graph(graph, domain, codomain)

  equinumerous(left, right: set_object): bool =
    EXISTS (graph: set_object):
      is_bijection_graph(graph, left, right)

  set_subset(M, N: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (value: set_object):
      member(value, M) IMPLIES member(value, N)

  transitive_set(M: set_object): bool =
    transitive(carrier(M))

  same_ordinals(M, N: set_object): bool =
    FORALL (ordinal: set_object):
      is_ordinal(ordinal)
        IMPLIES (member(ordinal, M) IFF member(ordinal, N))

  extensions_of_ctms: bool =
    ambient_zf
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (omega: set_object):
        is_omega(omega)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (M: set_object):
            (equinumerous(M, omega)
              AND transitive_set(M)
              AND models_zf_set(M))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (N: set_object):
                set_subset(M, N)
                  AND equinumerous(N, omega)
                  AND transitive_set(N)
                  AND models_zf_set(N)
                  AND M /= N
                  AND same_ordinals(M, N)
                  AND
                  (models_choice_set(M)
                    IMPLIES models_zfc_set(N))
END hundred_theorems_024

content:
/-
Copyright (c) 2017 Johannes Hölzl. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Johannes Hölzl, Mario Carneiro
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Piecewise
public import Mathlib.Order.FixedPoints
public import Mathlib.Order.Zorn

/-!
# Schröder-Bernstein theorem, well-ordering of cardinals

This file proves the Schröder-Bernstein theorem (see `schroeder_bernstein`), the well-ordering of
cardinals (see `min_injective`) and the totality of their order (see `total`).

## Notes

Cardinals are naturally ordered by `α ≤ β ↔ ∃ f : a → β, Injective f`:
* `schroeder_bernstein` states that, given injections `α → β` and `β → α`, one can get a
  bijection `α → β`. This corresponds to the antisymmetry of the order.
* The order is also well-founded: any nonempty set of cardinals has a minimal element.
  `min_injective` states that by saying that there exists an element of the set that injects into
  all others.

Cardinals are defined and further developed in the folder `SetTheory.Cardinal`.
-/

public section


open Set Function

universe u v

namespace Function

namespace Embedding

section antisymm

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v}

/-- **The Schröder-Bernstein Theorem**:
Given injections `α → β` and `β → α` that satisfy a pointwise property `R`, we can get a bijection
`α → β` that satisfies that same pointwise property. -/
theorem schroeder_bernstein_of_rel {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) (R : α → β → Prop) (hp₁ : ∀ a : α, R a (f a))
    (hp₂ : ∀ b : β, R (g b) b) :
    ∃ h : α → β, Bijective h ∧ ∀ a : α, R a (h a) := by sorry
theorem schroeder_bernstein {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) : ∃ h : α → β, Bijective h := by sorry
theorem antisymm : (α ↪ β) → (β ↪ α) → Nonempty (α ≃ β) := by sorry
end antisymm

section Wo

variable {ι : Type u} (β : ι → Type v)

/-- `sets β` -/
private abbrev sets :=
  { s : Set (∀ i, β i) | ∀ i : ι, s.InjOn fun x => x i }

/-- The cardinals are well-ordered. We express it here by the fact that in any set of cardinals
there is an element that injects into the others.
See `Cardinal.conditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot` for (one of) the lattice instances. -/
theorem min_injective [I : Nonempty ι] : ∃ i, Nonempty (∀ j, β i ↪ β j) :=
  let ⟨s, hs⟩ := show ∃ s, Maximal (· ∈ sets β) s by
    refine zorn_subset _ fun c hc hcc ↦
      ⟨⋃₀ c, fun i x ⟨p, hpc, hxp⟩ y ⟨q, hqc, hyq⟩ hi ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ subset_sUnion_of_mem⟩
    exact (hcc.total hpc hqc).elim (fun h ↦ hc hqc i (h hxp) hyq hi)
      fun h ↦ hc hpc i hxp (h hyq) hi
  let ⟨i, e⟩ :=
    show ∃ i, Surjective fun x : s => x.val i from
      Classical.by_contradiction fun h =>
        have h : ∀ i, ∃ y, ∀ x ∈ s, (x : ∀ i, β i) i ≠ y := by sorry
end Wo

/-- The cardinals are totally ordered. See
`Cardinal.conditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot` for (one of) the lattice
instance. -/
theorem total (α : Type u) (β : Type v) : Nonempty (α ↪ β) ∨ Nonempty (β ↪ α) :=
  match @min_injective Bool (fun b => cond b (ULift α) (ULift.{max u v, v} β)) ⟨true⟩
    with := by sorry
end Embedding

end Function

(* Contribution to the Coq Library   V6.3 (July 1999)                       *)
(****************************************************************************)
(*                 The Calculus of Inductive Constructions                  *)
(*                                                                          *)
(*                                Projet Coq                                *)
(*                                                                          *)
(*                     INRIA                        ENS-CNRS                *)
(*              Rocquencourt                        Lyon                    *)
(*                                                                          *)
(*                                Coq V5.11                                 *)
(*                              Feb 2nd 1996                                *)
(*                                                                          *)
(*                (notations and layout updated March 2009)                 *)
(****************************************************************************)
(*                               Schroeder.v                                *)
(****************************************************************************)
(* This file is distributed under the terms of the                          *) 
(* GNU Lesser General Public License Version 2.1                            *)
(****************************************************************************)


(**  If A is of cardinal less than B and conversely, then A and B           *)
(**  are equipollent                                                        *)
(**  In other words, if there is an injective map from A to B and           *)
(**  an injective map from B to A then there exists a map from A onto B.    *)

(**                  (based on a proof by Fraenkel)                         *)

Require Import Ensembles.      (* Ensemble, In, Included, Setminus *)
Require Import Relations_1.    (* Relation, Transitive *)
Require Import Powerset.       (* Inclusion_is_transitive *)
Require Import Classical_Prop. (* classic *)

Require Import Setminus_fact.
Require Import Sums.
Require Import Functions.
Require Import Equipollence.

Section Schroeder_Bernstein.


(****************************************************************************)
(** We need the decidability of the belonging relation on sets              *)
(** This is equivalent to classical logic                                   *)

Definition in_or_not_in (U : Type) (x : U) (A : Ensemble U) :=
  classic (In U A x).


(****************************************************************************)
(**  A and B are sets of elements in the univers U                          *)


Variable U : Type.

Let SU := Ensemble U.

Variable A B : SU.  (* A and B are sets of elements in the univers U *)


  Section Bijection.

  (**************************************************************************)
  (** We now show that if f and g are injections resp from A to B and from  *)
  (** B to A, then there is a subset J of A s.t. h, defined to be f on A    *)
  (** and the converse of g on A\J is a bijection from A to B               *)

  Variable f g : Relation U.  (* f and g are relations *)

  Hypothesis f_inj : injection U A B f. (* f and g are injections *)
  Hypothesis g_inj : injection U B A g.

  Let Imf : Ensemble U -> Ensemble U := Im U f.
  Let Img : Ensemble U -> Ensemble U := Im U g.

  (** Constructing J s.t. g(B\f(J))=A\J *)

    (** (Setminus U A C) denotes the difference A\C         *)
    (** (Included U A C) means that A is included in C  *)

    Let F (C : SU) := Setminus U A (Img (Setminus U B (Imf C))).

    Let D (C : SU) := Included U C (F C).

    Let J := Set_Sum U D.


  (**  We show that so-built J is the subset we are looking for *)

    (** J is Tarski's fix-point of F, a function which is growing *)
    (** w.r.t. inclusion                                          *)

    (** Lemma: F is growing *)

      Lemma F_growing :
       forall C C' : SU, Included U C C' -> Included U (F C) (F C').
Proof.
Admitted.

  End Bijection.


(**    Schroeder-Bernstein-Cantor Theorem     *)

Theorem Schroeder : A <=_card B -> B <=_card A -> A =_card B.
Proof.
Admitted.


End Schroeder_Bernstein.


                           (* The end *)


(* $Id$ *)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 025,
  "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem": injections between two arbitrary sets in
  both directions imply that the sets are in bijection. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let SCHROEDER_BERNSTEIN =
  `!s:A->bool t:B->bool f:A->B g:B->A.
      ((!x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
       (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
       (!x. x IN t ==> g x IN s) /\
       (!x y. x IN t /\ y IN t /\ g x = g y ==> x = y))
      ==> ?h:A->B.
            (!x. x IN s ==> h x IN t) /\
            (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ h x = h y ==> x = y) /\
            (!y. y IN t ==> ?x. x IN s /\ h x = y)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__025, "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem": injections in
;; both directions between two arbitrary carriers imply the existence of a
;; bijection between them. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Unary tame function objects represent arbitrary carriers. Tame function
;; objects also represent maps, and DEFUN-SK keeps every element and map
;; witness quantified inside the statement.

(defun ht025-member-p (carrier element)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list element)) t nil))

(defun ht025-map-value (map element)
  (apply$ map (list element)))

(defun-sk ht025-map-total-p (domain codomain map)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (ht025-member-p domain element)
     (ht025-member-p
      codomain
      (ht025-map-value map element)))))

(defun-sk ht025-map-injective-p (domain map)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht025-member-p domain left)
      (ht025-member-p domain right)
      (equal
       (ht025-map-value map left)
       (ht025-map-value map right)))
     (equal left right))))

(defun ht025-injection-p (domain codomain map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp domain)
   (tamep-functionp codomain)
   (tamep-functionp map)
   (ht025-map-total-p domain codomain map)
   (ht025-map-injective-p domain map)))

(defun-sk ht025-preimage-exists-p (target domain map)
  (exists (source)
    (and
     (ht025-member-p domain source)
     (equal (ht025-map-value map source) target))))

(defun-sk ht025-map-surjective-p (domain codomain map)
  (forall (target)
    (implies
     (ht025-member-p codomain target)
     (ht025-preimage-exists-p target domain map))))

(defun ht025-bijection-p (domain codomain map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp domain)
   (tamep-functionp codomain)
   (tamep-functionp map)
   (ht025-map-total-p domain codomain map)
   (ht025-map-injective-p domain map)
   (ht025-map-surjective-p domain codomain map)))

(defun-sk ht025-bijection-exists-p (domain codomain)
  (exists (map)
    (ht025-bijection-p domain codomain map)))

(defun hundred-theorems-025-schroeder-bernstein-statement
    (domain codomain forward backward)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht025-injection-p domain codomain forward)
    (ht025-injection-p codomain domain backward))
   (ht025-bijection-exists-p domain codomain)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 025_schroeder-bernstein_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 025.
-- This file contains no proof.

-- Hundred Theorems item 025, "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem": under excluded middle,
-- injections between two sets in both directions imply a bijection. This is a
-- statement-only formalization and contains no proof.

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

data Empty : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not proposition = proposition -> Empty

IsProposition : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
IsProposition proposition =
  (left right : proposition) -> left == right

IsSet : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
IsSet A =
  (x y : A) -> IsProposition (x == y)

data Dec {a : Level} (proposition : Set a) : Set a where
  yes : proposition -> Dec proposition
  no  : Not proposition -> Dec proposition

ExcludedMiddleAt : (a : Level) -> Set (lsuc a)
ExcludedMiddleAt a =
  (proposition : Set a) ->
  IsProposition proposition ->
  Dec proposition

record Injection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  field
    map : A -> B
    map-injective :
      (x y : A) ->
      map x == map y ->
      x == y

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

schroeder-bernstein-theorem :
  {a b : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a lmax b))
schroeder-bernstein-theorem {a} {b} =
  ExcludedMiddleAt (a lmax b) ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (B : Set b) ->
  IsSet A ->
  IsSet B ->
  Injection A B ->
  Injection B A ->
  Bijection A B

% Statement-only formalization of "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 025.
% This file contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 025, "Schroeder-Bernstein Theorem": mutual injections between two
% types imply the existence of a bijection. This is a statement-only formalization and
% contains no proof.

schroeder_bernstein_025[
  A: TYPE,
  B: TYPE
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  injective_ab(f: [A -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      f(x) = f(y) IMPLIES x = y

  injective_ba(g: [B -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: B):
      g(x) = g(y) IMPLIES x = y

  surjective_ab(h: [A -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (y: B):
      EXISTS (x: A): h(x) = y

  schroeder_bernstein: bool =
    FORALL (f: [A -> B]), (g: [B -> A]):
      (injective_ab(f) AND injective_ba(g))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (h: [A -> B]):
          injective_ab(h) AND surjective_ab(h)
END schroeder_bernstein_025

public section

namespace Real

/-- **Leibniz's series for `π`**. The alternating sum of odd number reciprocals is `π / 4`,
proved by using Abel's limit theorem to extend the Maclaurin series of `arctan` to 1. -/

content:
(************************************************************************)

From Stdlib Require Import Lra.
From Stdlib Require Import Rbase.

From Stdlib Require Import Rtrigo_facts.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Znat.

#[local] Open Scope R_scope.
#[local] Ltac Tauto.intuition_solver ::= auto with rorders real arith.

(*********************************************************)
(** * Preliminaries                                      *)
(*********************************************************)

(** ** Various generic lemmas which probably should go somewhere else *)

Lemma Boule_half_to_interval : forall x,
  Boule (/2) posreal_half x -> 0 <= x <= 1.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ub_opp : forall x, x < PI/2 -> -PI/2 < -x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition atan x := let (v, _) := pre_atan x in v.

Lemma atan_bound : forall x,
  -PI/2 < atan x < PI/2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Ratan_seq_opp : forall x n,
  Ratan_seq (-x) n = -Ratan_seq x n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition in_int (x : R) : {-1 <= x <= 1}+{~ -1 <= x <= 1}.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition ps_atan (x : R) : R :=
 match in_int x with
   left h => let (v, _) := ps_atan_exists_1 x h in v
 | right h => atan x
 end.

(** ** Proof of the equivalence of the two definitions between -1 and 1 *)

Lemma ps_atan0_0 : ps_atan 0 = 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ps_atan_exists_1_opp : forall x h h',
  proj1_sig (ps_atan_exists_1 (-x) h) = -(proj1_sig (ps_atan_exists_1 x h')).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ps_atan_opp : forall x,
  ps_atan (-x) = -ps_atan x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** atan = ps_atan *)

Lemma ps_atanSeq_continuity_pt_1 : forall (N : nat) (x : R),
  0 <= x -> x <= 1 ->
  continuity_pt (fun x => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Ratan_seq x)) N) x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** Definition of ps_atan's derivative *)

Definition Datan_seq := fun (x : R) (n : nat) => x ^ (2*n).

Lemma pow_lt_1_compat : forall x n,
  0 <= x < 1 -> (0 < n)%nat ->
  0 <= x ^ n < 1.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_seq_Rabs : forall x n,
  Datan_seq (Rabs x) n = Datan_seq x n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_seq_pos : forall x n, 0 < x ->
  0 < Datan_seq x n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_sum_eq :forall x n,
  sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Datan_seq x)) n = (1 - (- x ^ 2) ^ S n)/(1 + x ^ 2).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_seq_increasing : forall x y n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> 0 <= x < y ->
  Datan_seq x n < Datan_seq y n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_seq_decreasing : forall x, -1 < x -> x < 1 ->
  Un_decreasing (Datan_seq x).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_seq_CV_0 : forall x, -1 < x -> x < 1 ->
  Un_cv (Datan_seq x) 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_lim : forall x, -1 < x -> x < 1 ->
  Un_cv (fun N : nat => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Datan_seq x)) N) (/ (1 + x ^ 2)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_CVU_prelim : forall c (r : posreal), Rabs c + r < 1 ->
  CVU (fun N x => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Datan_seq x)) N)
      (fun y : R => / (1 + y ^ 2)) c r.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_is_datan : forall (N : nat) (x : R),
  -1 <= x -> x < 1 ->
  derivable_pt_lim (fun x => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Ratan_seq x)) N) x (sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Datan_seq x)) N).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Ratan_CVU' :
  CVU (fun N x => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Ratan_seq x)) N)
      ps_atan (/2) posreal_half.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Ratan_CVU :
  CVU (fun N x => sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Ratan_seq x)) N)
      ps_atan 0 (mkposreal 1 Rlt_0_1).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Alt_PI_tg : forall n, PI_tg n = Ratan_seq 1 n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Ratan_is_ps_atan : forall eps, eps > 0 ->
  exists N, forall n, (n >= N)%nat -> forall x, -1 < x -> x < 1 ->
  Rabs (sum_f_R0 (tg_alt (Ratan_seq x)) n - ps_atan x) < eps.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_continuity : continuity (fun x => /(1 + x^2)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma derivable_pt_lim_ps_atan : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  derivable_pt_lim ps_atan x ((fun y => /(1 + y ^ 2)) x).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma derivable_pt_ps_atan : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  derivable_pt ps_atan x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ps_atan_continuity_pt_1 : forall eps : R,
  eps > 0 ->
  exists alp : R, alp > 0 /\ (forall x, x < 1 -> 0 < x -> Rdist x 1 < alp ->
  dist R_met (ps_atan x) (Alt_PI/4) < eps).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Datan_eq_DatanSeq_interv : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  forall (Pratan:derivable_pt ps_atan x) (Prmymeta:derivable_pt atan x),
    derive_pt ps_atan x Pratan = derive_pt atan x Prmymeta.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma atan_eq_ps_atan : forall x, 0 < x < 1 ->
  atan x = ps_atan x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Alt_PI_eq : Alt_PI = PI.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma PI_ineq : forall N : nat,
  sum_f_R0 (tg_alt PI_tg) (S (2 * N)) <= PI/4 <= sum_f_R0 (tg_alt PI_tg) (2 * N).
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Relation between arctangent and sine and cosine *)

Lemma sin_atan: forall x,
  sin (atan x) = x / sqrt (1 + x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma cos_atan: forall x,
  cos (atan x) = 1 / sqrt(1 + x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

(*********************************************************)
(** * Definition of arcsine based on arctangent          *)
(*********************************************************)

(** asin is defined by cases so that it is defined in the full range from -1 .. 1 *)

Definition asin x :=
  if Rle_dec x (-1) then - (PI / 2) else
  if Rle_dec 1 x then PI / 2 else
  atan (x / sqrt (1 - x²)).

(** ** Relation between arcsin and arctangent *)

Lemma asin_atan : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  asin x = atan (x / sqrt (1 - x²)).
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** arcsine of specific values *)

Lemma asin_0 : asin 0 = 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_1 : asin 1 = PI / 2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_inv_sqrt2 : asin (/sqrt 2) = PI/4.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_opp : forall x,
  asin (- x) = - asin x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Bounds of arcsine *)

Lemma asin_bound : forall x,
  - (PI/2) <= asin x <= PI/2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_bound_lt : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  - (PI/2) < asin x < PI/2.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** arcsine is the left and right inverse of sine *)

Lemma sin_asin : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  sin (asin x) = x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_sin : forall x, -(PI/2) <= x <= PI/2 ->
  asin (sin x) = x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Relation between arcsin, cosine and tangent *)

Lemma cos_asin : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  cos (asin x) = sqrt (1 - x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma tan_asin : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  tan (asin x) = x / sqrt (1 - x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Derivative of arcsine *)

Lemma derivable_pt_asin : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  derivable_pt asin x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma derive_pt_asin : forall (x : R) (Hxrange : -1 < x < 1),
   derive_pt asin x (derivable_pt_asin x Hxrange) = 1 / sqrt (1 - x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

(*********************************************************)
(** * Definition of arccosine based on arctangent        *)
(*********************************************************)

(** acos is defined by cases so that it is defined in the full range from -1 .. 1 *)

Definition acos x :=
  if Rle_dec x (-1) then PI else
  if Rle_dec 1 x then 0 else
  PI/2 - atan (x/sqrt(1 - x²)).

(** ** Relation between arccosine, arcsine and arctangent *)

Lemma acos_atan : forall x, 0 < x ->
  acos x = atan (sqrt (1 - x²) / x).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_asin : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  acos x = PI/2 - asin x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma asin_acos : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  asin x = PI/2 - acos x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** arccosine of specific values *)

Lemma acos_0 : acos 0 = PI/2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_1 : acos 1 = 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_opp : forall x,
  acos (- x) = PI - acos x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_inv_sqrt2 : acos (/sqrt 2) = PI/4.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Bounds of arccosine *)

Lemma acos_bound : forall x,
  0 <= acos x <= PI.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_bound_lt : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  0 < acos x < PI.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** arccosine is the left and right inverse of cosine *)

Lemma cos_acos : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  cos (acos x) = x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma acos_cos : forall x, 0 <= x <= PI ->
  acos (cos x) = x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Relation between arccosine, sine and tangent *)

Lemma sin_acos : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  sin (acos x) = sqrt (1 - x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma tan_acos : forall x, -1 <= x <= 1 ->
  tan (acos x) = sqrt (1 - x²) / x.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** ** Derivative of arccosine *)

Lemma derivable_pt_acos : forall x, -1 < x < 1 ->
  derivable_pt acos x.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma derive_pt_acos : forall (x : R) (Hxrange : -1 < x < 1),
   derive_pt acos x (derivable_pt_acos x Hxrange) = -1 / sqrt (1 - x²).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma sin_gt_x x : x < 0 -> x < sin x.
Proof.
Admitted.
