content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Ballot Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 030.
-- It counts fixed A/B vote sequences and those in which A stays strictly ahead at every prefix.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<_
infixr 5 _++_
infixr 6 _and_

data _<_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero-less-successor :
    {n : Nat} →
    zero < suc n
  successor-less-successor :
    {m n : Nat} →
    m < n →
    suc m < suc n

data Vote : Set where
  A B : Vote

_and_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true and condition = condition
false and condition = false

natEqual : Nat → Nat → Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc n) = false
natEqual (suc m) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

lessThan : Nat → Nat → Bool
lessThan zero zero = false
lessThan zero (suc n) = true
lessThan (suc m) zero = false
lessThan (suc m) (suc n) = lessThan m n

_++_ : {X : Set} → List X → List X → List X
[] ++ ys = ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

mapList :
  {X Y : Set} →
  (X → Y) →
  List X →
  List Y
mapList function [] = []
mapList function (x ∷ xs) =
  function x ∷ mapList function xs

prependA : List Vote → List Vote
prependA votes = A ∷ votes

prependB : List Vote → List Vote
prependB votes = B ∷ votes

allVoteSequences : Nat → List (List Vote)
allVoteSequences zero = [] ∷ []
allVoteSequences (suc n) =
  mapList prependA (allVoteSequences n) ++
  mapList prependB (allVoteSequences n)

countA : List Vote → Nat
countA [] = zero
countA (A ∷ votes) = suc (countA votes)
countA (B ∷ votes) = countA votes

countB : List Vote → Nat
countB [] = zero
countB (A ∷ votes) = countB votes
countB (B ∷ votes) = suc (countB votes)

hasVoteCounts : Nat → Nat → List Vote → Bool
hasVoteCounts p q votes =
  natEqual (countA votes) p and
  natEqual (countB votes) q

staysAheadFrom : Nat → Nat → List Vote → Bool
staysAheadFrom a b [] = true
staysAheadFrom a b (A ∷ votes) =
  lessThan b (suc a) and
  staysAheadFrom (suc a) b votes
staysAheadFrom a b (B ∷ votes) =
  lessThan (suc b) a and
  staysAheadFrom a (suc b) votes

staysAhead : List Vote → Bool
staysAhead = staysAheadFrom zero zero

validSequence : Nat → Nat → List Vote → Bool
validSequence p q votes =
  hasVoteCounts p q votes and staysAhead votes

filterList :
  {X : Set} →
  (X → Bool) →
  List X →
  List X
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) with predicate x
... | true = x ∷ filterList predicate xs
... | false = filterList predicate xs

length : {X : Set} → List X → Nat
length [] = zero
length (x ∷ xs) = suc (length xs)

allCountings : Nat → Nat → Nat
allCountings p q =
  length
    (filterList
      (hasVoteCounts p q)
      (allVoteSequences (p + q)))

validCountings : Nat → Nat → Nat
validCountings p q =
  length
    (filterList
      (validSequence p q)
      (allVoteSequences (p + q)))

the-ballot-problem : Set
the-ballot-problem =
  (p q : Nat) →
  q < p →
  (p + q) * validCountings p q ≡
  (p - q) * allCountings p q

title: 030_the_ballot_problem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Ballot Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 030. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

(*
  Hundred Theorems item 030, "The Ballot Problem": among vote sequences with a votes for A
  and b votes for B, the number in which A is strictly ahead after every nonempty prefix
  satisfies the classical ballot counting identity. This is a statement-only formalization
  and contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val ballot_problem =
  ``let count_a =
      \votes : bool list. LENGTH (FILTER (\vote. vote) votes)
    in
    let count_b =
      \votes : bool list. LENGTH (FILTER (\vote. ~vote) votes)
    in
    let all_countings =
      \a b : num.
        CARD
          {votes : bool list |
             LENGTH votes = a + b /\
             count_a votes = a /\
             count_b votes = b}
    in
    let valid_countings =
      \a b : num.
        CARD
          {votes : bool list |
             LENGTH votes = a + b /\
             count_a votes = a /\
             count_b votes = b /\
             !m.
               0 < m /\ m <= LENGTH votes ==>
               count_b (TAKE m votes) < count_a (TAKE m votes)}
    in
      !a b : num.
        (a + b) * valid_countings a b =
        (a - b) * all_countings a b``;

title: 030_the_ballot_problem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Ballot Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 030. This file
% contains no proof.

the_ballot_problem_030: THEORY
BEGIN
  % A bounded binary natural encodes a vote sequence, with its
  % least-significant bit representing the first vote counted.
  a_votes(code, prefix_length: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF prefix_length = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      (IF mod(code, 2) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
        + a_votes(ndiv(code, 2), prefix_length - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE prefix_length

  b_votes(code, prefix_length: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF prefix_length = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      (IF mod(code, 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
        + b_votes(ndiv(code, 2), prefix_length - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE prefix_length

  all_sequence(code, p, q: nat): bool =
    code < 2 ^ (p + q)
      AND a_votes(code, p + q) = p
      AND b_votes(code, p + q) = q

  strictly_ahead(code, length: nat): bool =
    FORALL (prefix_length: nat):
      (0 < prefix_length AND prefix_length <= length)
        IMPLIES
          a_votes(code, prefix_length)
            > b_votes(code, prefix_length)

  valid_sequence(code, p, q: nat): bool =
    all_sequence(code, p, q)
      AND strictly_ahead(code, p + q)

  count_below(limit: nat, property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  all_countings(p, q: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      2 ^ (p + q),
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): all_sequence(code, p, q)))

  valid_countings(p, q: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      2 ^ (p + q),
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): valid_sequence(code, p, q)))

  the_ballot_problem: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: nat):
      q < p IMPLIES
        (p + q) * valid_countings(p, q)
          = (p - q) * all_countings(p, q)
END the_ballot_problem_030

title: 031_ramsey_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Ramsey's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 031. It
-- states that every finite coloring of fixed-size subsets of an infinite set has an infinite
-- homogeneous subset. This file contains no proof.

namespace Theorems100

universe u

abbrev Subset (α : Type u) := α → Prop

def IncludedIn {α : Type u} (s t : Subset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, s x → t x

def HasCardinality {α : Type u} (n : Nat) (s : Subset α) : Prop :=
  ∃ enumerate : Fin n → α,
    (∀ i, s (enumerate i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, enumerate i = enumerate j → i = j) ∧
        ∀ x, s x → ∃ i, enumerate i = x

def InfiniteSubset {α : Type u} (s : Subset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : Nat, ∃ choose : Fin n → α,
    (∀ i, s (choose i)) ∧
      ∀ i j, choose i = choose j → i = j

/--
Infinite Ramsey's theorem: if the `n`-element subsets of an infinite set receive only finitely
many colors, there is an infinite subset on which the coloring is constant.
-/
theorem ramsey_theorem {α : Type u} (n colors : Nat) (s : Subset α)
    (hs : InfiniteSubset s) (color : Subset α → Nat)
    (color_extensional :
      ∀ u v : Subset α, (∀ x, u x ↔ v x) → color u = color v)
    (color_bounded :
      ∀ u : Subset α, IncludedIn u s → HasCardinality n u → color u < colors) :
    ∃ t : Subset α, IncludedIn t s ∧ InfiniteSubset t ∧
      ∃ c : Nat, c < colors ∧
        ∀ u : Subset α, IncludedIn u t → HasCardinality n u → color u = c := sorry

end Theorems100

title: 031_ramsey_s_theorem
content:
(**
CoLoR, a Coq library on rewriting and termination.
See the COPYRIGHTS and LICENSE files.

- Frederic Blanqui, 2014-12-11

* Infinite Ramsey theorem

After "On a Problem of Formal Logic", F. P. Ramsey, London
Math. Soc. s2-30(1):264-286, 1930, doi:10.1112/plms/s2-30.1.264. *)

Set Implicit Arguments.

From Stdlib Require Import Morphisms Basics Setoid.
From CoLoR Require Import ClassicUtil IotaUtil EpsilonUtil DepChoice
     LogicUtil SetUtil FinSet InfSet NatUtil.

Section S.

  Variables (A : Type) (W : set A).

(****************************************************************************)
(** Infinite pigeon-hole principle with two holes. *)

  Lemma IPHP_with_2_holes (P : Pinf W) (f : elts P -> bool) :
    exists b (Q : Pinf P), forall x (i : mem x Q), f (elt (Pinf_sub Q _ i)) = b.
Proof.
Admitted.

  (* Let [i] be the function which maps [X] in [Pcard V n] to [add a X]
  in [Pcard P (S n)] provided that [a] is in [P] but not in [V]. *)
  Definition i n P (Q : Pinf P) (U : Pinf Q) V (a : A)
    (aU : mem a U) (VU_a : V [<=] rem a U) : Pcard V n -> Pcard P (S n).

  Proof.
Admitted.

  Arguments i [n P Q U V a] _ _ _.

  Lemma i_eq n P (Q : Pinf P) (U : Pinf Q) V (a : A)
        (VU_a : V [<=] rem a U) (aU : mem a U) (X : Pcard V n) :
    i aU VU_a X [=] add a X.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Arguments j n [P a T'] _ _ _ _.

  Lemma j_eq n (P : Pinf W) a (T' : Pinf W) (aP : mem a P) (naT : ~mem a T')
        (TP : T' [<=] P) X : j n aP naT TP X [=] add a X.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Theorem ramsey_with_2_colors : forall n (P : Pinf W)
    (f : Pcard P (S n) -> bool), Proper (Pcard_equiv ==> eq) f ->
    exists b (Q : Pinf P), forall X : Pcard Q (S n), f (Pcard_subset Q X) = b.
Proof.
Admitted.

End S.

Arguments ramsey_with_2_colors [A W n P f] _.

(****************************************************************************)
(** Ramsey theorem with a finite set of colors. *)

Theorem ramsey A (W : set A) n (P : Pinf W) B : forall (C : Pf B)
  (f : Pcard P (S n) -> elts C), Proper (Pcard_equiv ==> elts_eq) f ->
  exists c (Q : Pinf P), forall X : Pcard Q (S n), f (Pcard_subset Q X) = c.
Proof.
Admitted.

section "Ramsey's Theorem"

theory Ramsey
  imports Main "HOL-Library.Infinite_Set" "HOL-Library.Ramsey" 

begin

text \<open>Please note: this entire development has been updated and incorporated into 
@{theory "HOL-Library.Ramsey"}  above. Below, some of the results of the original development are 
linked to their current versions elsewhere in the Isabelle libraries. \<close>

subsection "Library lemmas"

lemma infinite_inj_infinite_image: "infinite Z \<Longrightarrow> inj_on f Z \<Longrightarrow> infinite (f ` Z)"
  by sorry

lemma infinite_dom_finite_rng: "[| infinite A; finite (f ` A) |] ==> \<exists>b \<in> f ` A. infinite {a : A. f a = b}"
  by sorry

lemma infinite_mem: "infinite X \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>x. x \<in> X"
  by sorry

lemma not_empty_least: "(Y::nat set) \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>m. m \<in> Y \<and> (\<forall>m'. m' \<in> Y \<longrightarrow> m \<le> m')"
  by sorry


subsection "Dependent Choice Variant"
  
lemma dc:
  assumes trans: "trans r"
    and P0: "P x0"
    and Pstep: "\<And>x. P x \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. P y \<and> (x, y) \<in> r"
  obtains f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where "\<And>n. P (f n)" and "\<And>n m. n < m \<Longrightarrow> (f n, f m) \<in> r"
  by sorry

subsection "Ramsey's theorem"

lemma ramsey: "\<forall>(s::nat) (r::nat) (YY::'a set) (f::'a set \<Rightarrow> nat).
  infinite YY 
  \<and> (\<forall>X. X \<subseteq> YY \<and> finite X \<and> card X = r \<longrightarrow> f X < s)
  \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>Y' t'.
  Y' \<subseteq> YY 
  \<and> infinite Y' 
  \<and> t' < s 
  \<and> (\<forall>X. X \<subseteq> Y' \<and> finite X \<and> card X = r \<longrightarrow> f X = t'))"
  by sorry

end

title: 031_ramsey_s_theorem
031_ramsey_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__031, "Ramsey's Theorem": every finite coloring of
;; the fixed-cardinality subsets of an arbitrary infinite set has an infinite
;; subset on which the coloring is constant. This file contains no proof.
;; Manual semantic audit (2026-09-06): retained as a historical candidate,
;; but not counted as a faithful standard-ACL2 translation. See
;; corpus-extension/semantic_canonical_resolutions.json for the blocker.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A tame unary function object is a characteristic function for an arbitrary
;; set. A second tame unary function object maps duplicate-free finite lists
;; to colors. Extensionality below makes the latter depend only on the finite
;; set represented by a list, not on the order of its elements.

(defun ht031-member-p (set element)
  (if (apply$ set (list element))
      t
    nil))

(defun ht031-color (coloring finite-subset)
  (apply$ coloring (list finite-subset)))

(defun ht031-elements-in-set-p (set elements)
  (if (consp elements)
      (and
       (ht031-member-p set (car elements))
       (ht031-elements-in-set-p set (cdr elements)))
    (equal elements nil)))

(defun ht031-finite-subset-p (set rank elements)
  (and
   (true-listp elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal elements)
   (equal (len elements) rank)
   (ht031-elements-in-set-p set elements)))

(defun ht031-same-finite-set-p (left right)
  (and
   (subsetp-equal left right)
   (subsetp-equal right left)))

(defun-sk ht031-coloring-extensional-p (coloring)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp left)
      (true-listp right)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal left)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal right)
      (ht031-same-finite-set-p left right))
     (equal
      (ht031-color coloring left)
      (ht031-color coloring right)))))

(defun-sk ht031-coloring-bounded-p
    (source-set coloring rank color-count)
  (forall (finite-subset)
    (implies
     (ht031-finite-subset-p
      source-set rank finite-subset)
     (and
      (natp (ht031-color coloring finite-subset))
      (< (ht031-color coloring finite-subset)
         color-count)))))

;; An injective sequence N -> S has infinite range contained in S. Conversely,
;; in the classical setting of the source formalizations, every infinite set
;; admits such a sequence. Thus these predicates define infinitude without a
;; finite carrier, a bounded approximation, or an externally supplied witness.

(defun ht031-sequence-value (sequence index)
  (apply$ sequence (list index)))

(defun-sk ht031-sequence-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (ht031-member-p
      set
      (ht031-sequence-value sequence index)))))

(defun-sk ht031-sequence-injective-p (sequence)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-index)
      (natp right-index)
      (equal
       (ht031-sequence-value sequence left-index)
       (ht031-sequence-value sequence right-index)))
     (equal left-index right-index))))

(defun ht031-injective-sequence-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (ht031-sequence-in-set-p set sequence)
   (ht031-sequence-injective-p sequence)))

(defun-sk ht031-infinite-set-p (set)
  (exists (enumeration)
    (ht031-injective-sequence-in-set-p set enumeration)))

(defun ht031-natural-index-list-p (indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (natp (car indices))
       (ht031-natural-index-list-p (cdr indices)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun ht031-index-subset-p (rank indices)
  (and
   (true-listp indices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
   (equal (len indices) rank)
   (ht031-natural-index-list-p indices)))

(defun ht031-sequence-image (sequence indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (cons
       (ht031-sequence-value sequence (car indices))
       (ht031-sequence-image sequence (cdr indices)))
    nil))

(defun-sk ht031-sequence-homogeneous-p
    (sequence coloring rank homogeneous-color)
  (forall (indices)
    (implies
     (ht031-index-subset-p rank indices)
     (equal
      (ht031-color
       coloring
       (ht031-sequence-image sequence indices))
      homogeneous-color))))

;; The range of HOMOGENEOUS-SEQUENCE is the existential set Y' in the source
;; statements. Injectivity makes that range infinite, and quantification over
;; all finite index sets is equivalent to quantification over all rank-element
;; subsets of the range.

(defun-sk ht031-homogeneous-witness-exists-p
    (source-set coloring rank color-count)
  (exists (homogeneous-sequence homogeneous-color)
    (and
     (natp homogeneous-color)
     (< homogeneous-color color-count)
     (ht031-injective-sequence-in-set-p
      source-set homogeneous-sequence)
     (ht031-sequence-homogeneous-p
      homogeneous-sequence coloring rank homogeneous-color))))

(defun hundred-theorems-031-ramsey-statement
    (rank color-count source-set coloring)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp rank)
    (natp color-count)
    (tamep-functionp source-set)
    (tamep-functionp coloring)
    (ht031-infinite-set-p source-set)
    (ht031-coloring-extensional-p coloring)
    (ht031-coloring-bounded-p
     source-set coloring rank color-count))
   (ht031-homogeneous-witness-exists-p
    source-set coloring rank color-count)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 031_ramsey_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 031, "Ramsey's Theorem":
-- every finite coloring of the fixed-cardinality finite subsets of an infinite
-- set has an infinite monochromatic subset. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _<_ _is-subset-of_
infixr 5 _::_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {level : Level} -> Set level -> Set level
Not proposition = proposition -> Bottom

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-successor :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero < suc n
  successor-less-successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m < n ->
    suc m < suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  [] : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

lookup :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Fin n ->
  A
lookup [] ()
lookup (x :: xs) fzero = x
lookup (x :: xs) (fsuc i) = lookup xs i

Subset : Set -> Set1
Subset A = A -> Set

_is-subset-of_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set
_is-subset-of_ {A} X Y =
  (x : A) ->
  X x ->
  Y x

record SameSubset
  {A : Set}
  (X Y : Subset A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forward : X is-subset-of Y
    backward : Y is-subset-of X

record OccursAt
  {A : Set}
  {n : Nat}
  (elements : Vec A n)
  (x : A) :
  Set where

  field
    index : Fin n
    equality : lookup elements index == x

record HasCardinality
  {A : Set}
  (X : Subset A)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    elements : Vec A n
    listed-elements-belong :
      (i : Fin n) ->
      X (lookup elements i)
    every-element-is-listed :
      (x : A) ->
      X x ->
      OccursAt elements x
    no-repetitions :
      (i j : Fin n) ->
      lookup elements i == lookup elements j ->
      i == j

record Finite
  {A : Set}
  (X : Subset A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    cardinality : Nat
    has-cardinality : HasCardinality X cardinality

Infinite :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Set1
Infinite X =
  Not (Finite X)

ExtensionalColoring :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Subset A -> Nat) ->
  Set1
ExtensionalColoring coloring =
  (X Y : Subset _) ->
  SameSubset X Y ->
  coloring X == coloring Y

BoundedColoringOn :
  {A : Set} ->
  Subset A ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  (Subset A -> Nat) ->
  Set1
BoundedColoringOn {A} S subset-size color-count coloring =
  (X : Subset A) ->
  X is-subset-of S ->
  HasCardinality X subset-size ->
  coloring X < color-count

record RamseyConclusion
  {A : Set}
  (S : Subset A)
  (subset-size color-count : Nat)
  (coloring : Subset A -> Nat) :
  Set1 where

  field
    homogeneous-set : Subset A
    contained : homogeneous-set is-subset-of S
    infinite : Infinite homogeneous-set
    homogeneous-color : Nat
    color-in-range : homogeneous-color < color-count
    monochromatic :
      (X : Subset A) ->
      X is-subset-of homogeneous-set ->
      HasCardinality X subset-size ->
      coloring X == homogeneous-color

ramsey-s-theorem : Set1
ramsey-s-theorem =
  (A : Set) ->
  (color-count subset-size : Nat) ->
  (S : Subset A) ->
  (coloring : Subset A -> Nat) ->
  ExtensionalColoring coloring ->
  Infinite S ->
  BoundedColoringOn S subset-size color-count coloring ->
  RamseyConclusion S subset-size color-count coloring

(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Ramsey's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 031. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

(*
  Hundred Theorems item 031, "Ramsey's Theorem": every finite coloring of the
  fixed-cardinality finite subsets of an infinite set has an infinite
  homogeneous subset. This is a statement-only formalization and contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val ramsey_s_theorem =
  ``!M N (C : 'a set -> num) (s : 'a set).
      INFINITE s /\
      (!X : 'a set.
         X SUBSET s /\ FINITE X /\ CARD X = N ==>
         C X <= M)
      ==>
      ?t c.
        INFINITE t /\
        t SUBSET s /\
        c <= M /\
        (!X : 'a set.
           X SUBSET t /\ FINITE X /\ CARD X = N ==>
           C X = c)``;

title: 031_ramsey_s_theorem
031_ramsey_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Ramsey's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 031. This file
% contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 031, "Ramsey's Theorem": every finite coloring of fixed-size
% subsets of an infinite set has an infinite homogeneous subset. This is a statement-only
% formalization and contains no proof.

ramsey_s_theorem_031[A: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  set_predicate: TYPE = [A -> bool]

  subset(X, Y: set_predicate): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      X(x) IMPLIES Y(x)

  injective_below(
      enumeration: [nat -> A],
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_exactly(
      enumeration: [nat -> A],
      X: set_predicate,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      X(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = x

  has_cardinality(X: set_predicate, cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [nat -> A]):
      injective_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_exactly(enumeration, X, cardinality)

  finite_subset(X: set_predicate): bool =
    EXISTS (cardinality: nat):
      has_cardinality(X, cardinality)

  infinite_subset(X: set_predicate): bool =
    NOT finite_subset(X)

  bounded_coloring(
      ambient: set_predicate,
      subset_size, color_count: nat,
      coloring: [set_predicate -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (X: set_predicate):
      subset(X, ambient)
        AND has_cardinality(X, subset_size)
      IMPLIES coloring(X) < color_count

  homogeneous_for(
      H: set_predicate,
      subset_size: nat,
      coloring: [set_predicate -> nat],
      color: nat): bool =
    FORALL (X: set_predicate):
      subset(X, H)
        AND has_cardinality(X, subset_size)
      IMPLIES coloring(X) = color

  ramsey_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (color_count, subset_size: nat),
           (ambient: set_predicate),
           (coloring: [set_predicate -> nat]):
      infinite_subset(ambient)
        AND bounded_coloring(
          ambient,
          subset_size,
          color_count,
          coloring)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (H: set_predicate), (color: nat):
          subset(H, ambient)
            AND infinite_subset(H)
            AND color < color_count
            AND homogeneous_for(H, subset_size, coloring, color)
END ramsey_s_theorem_031

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Four Color Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 032. This
-- file contains no proof.

/-!
# The Four Color Problem

This is the high-level real-plane formulation used by the Rocq Four Color Theorem.
Maps are partial equivalence relations on points. Their classes are open connected
regions, and adjacent regions must receive different colors.
-/

namespace Theorems100.FourColorProblem

universe u

/-- The operations carried by the source formalization's axiomatized real line. -/
structure RealStructure where
  Val : Type u
  le : Val → Val → Prop
  sup : (Val → Prop) → Val
  add : Val → Val → Val
  zero : Val
  neg : Val → Val
  mul : Val → Val → Val
  one : Val
  inv : Val → Val

def RealEq (R : RealStructure) (x y : R.Val) : Prop :=
  R.le x y ∧ R.le y x

def UpperBounds (R : RealStructure) (s : R.Val → Prop) : R.Val → Prop :=
  fun z => ∀ y, s y → R.le y z

def DownwardClosure (R : RealStructure) (s : R.Val → Prop) : R.Val → Prop :=
  fun x => ∃ y, s y ∧ R.le x y

def NonemptySet {α : Type u} (s : α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, s x

def HasUpperBound (R : RealStructure) (s : R.Val → Prop) : Prop :=
  NonemptySet (UpperBounds R s)

def HasSupremum (R : RealStructure) (s : R.Val → Prop) : Prop :=
  NonemptySet s ∧ HasUpperBound R s

/-- The complete ordered-field axioms used by the source theorem. -/
structure RealAxioms (R : RealStructure) : Prop where
  le_refl : ∀ x, R.le x x
  le_trans : ∀ x y z, R.le x y → R.le y z → R.le x z
  sup_upper_bound : ∀ s, HasSupremum R s → UpperBounds R s (R.sup s)
  sup_total : ∀ s x, HasSupremum R s → DownwardClosure R s x ∨ R.le (R.sup s) x
  add_mono : ∀ x y z, R.le y z → R.le (R.add x y) (R.add x z)
  add_comm : ∀ x y, RealEq R (R.add x y) (R.add y x)
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, RealEq R (R.add x (R.add y z)) (R.add (R.add x y) z)
  zero_add : ∀ x, RealEq R (R.add R.zero x) x
  add_neg : ∀ x, RealEq R (R.add x (R.neg x)) R.zero
  mul_mono : ∀ x y z, R.le R.zero x → R.le y z → R.le (R.mul x y) (R.mul x z)
  mul_comm : ∀ x y, RealEq R (R.mul x y) (R.mul y x)
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, RealEq R (R.mul x (R.mul y z)) (R.mul (R.mul x y) z)
  mul_add : ∀ x y z, RealEq R (R.mul x (R.add y z)) (R.add (R.mul x y) (R.mul x z))
  one_mul : ∀ x, RealEq R (R.mul R.one x) x
  mul_inv : ∀ x, ¬RealEq R x R.zero → RealEq R (R.mul x (R.inv x)) R.one
  one_ne_zero : ¬RealEq R R.one R.zero

structure RealModel where
  toStructure : RealStructure
  axioms : RealAxioms toStructure

structure Point (R : RealStructure) where
  x : R.Val
  y : R.Val

abbrev Region (R : RealStructure) := Point R → Prop

/-- A map is a relation on points; its equivalence classes are its regions. -/
abbrev PlaneMap (R : RealStructure) := Point R → Point R → Prop

structure Interval (R : RealStructure) where
  left : R.Val
  right : R.Val

structure Rectangle (R : RealStructure) where
  horizontal : Interval R
  vertical : Interval R

def InInterval {R : RealStructure} (s : Interval R) (t : R.Val) : Prop :=
  ¬R.le t s.left ∧ ¬R.le s.right t

def InRectangle {R : RealStructure} (rect : Rectangle R) : Region R :=
  fun p => InInterval rect.horizontal p.x ∧ InInterval rect.vertical p.y

def RegionUnion {R : RealStructure} (r1 r2 : Region R) : Region R :=
  fun p => r1 p ∨ r2 p

def RegionInter {R : RealStructure} (r1 r2 : Region R) : Region R :=
  fun p => r1 p ∧ r2 p

def RegionNonempty {R : RealStructure} (r : Region R) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, r p

def Subregion {R : RealStructure} (r1 r2 : Region R) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, r1 p → r2 p

def Meet {R : RealStructure} (r1 r2 : Region R) : Prop :=
  RegionNonempty (RegionInter r1 r2)

/-- A plain map is a partial equivalence relation on points. -/
structure PlainMap {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) : Prop where
  symm : ∀ p q, m p q → m q p
  trans : ∀ p q, m p q → Subregion (m q) (m p)

def Cover {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) : Region R :=
  fun p => m p p

def Submap {R : RealStructure} (m1 m2 : PlaneMap R) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, Subregion (m1 p) (m2 p)

def AtMostRegions {R : RealStructure} (n : Nat) (m : PlaneMap R) : Prop :=
  ∃ representatives : Nat → Point R,
    ∀ p, Cover m p → ∃ i, i < n ∧ m (representatives i) p

/-- Openness in the rectangle-basis topology of the modeled real plane. -/
def OpenRegion {R : RealStructure} (r : Region R) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, r p → ∃ rect, InRectangle rect p ∧ Subregion (InRectangle rect) r

def Closure {R : RealStructure} (r : Region R) : Region R :=
  fun p => ∀ u, OpenRegion u → u p → Meet r u

/-- Connectedness expressed through separation by two open regions. -/
def Connected {R : RealStructure} (r : Region R) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v,
    OpenRegion u →
      OpenRegion v →
        Subregion r (RegionUnion u v) →
          Meet u r → Meet v r → Meet u v

structure SimpleMap {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) : Prop where
  plain : PlainMap m
  open_region : ∀ p, OpenRegion (m p)
  connected_region : ∀ p, Connected (m p)

structure FiniteSimpleMap {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) : Prop where
  simple : SimpleMap m
  finite : ∃ n, AtMostRegions n m

def Border {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) (p q : Point R) : Region R :=
  RegionInter (Closure (m p)) (Closure (m q))

def CornerMap {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) (p : Point R) : PlaneMap R :=
  fun q r => m q r ∧ Closure (m q) p

def NotCorner {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) : Region R :=
  fun p => AtMostRegions 2 (CornerMap m p)

/-- Two distinct regions are adjacent when their border contains a non-corner point. -/
def Adjacent {R : RealStructure} (m : PlaneMap R) (p q : Point R) : Prop :=
  ¬m p q ∧ Meet (NotCorner m) (Border m p q)

/-- A coloring is a coarser partial equivalence relation separating adjacent regions. -/
structure Coloring {R : RealStructure} (m k : PlaneMap R) : Prop where
  plain : PlainMap k
  cover : Subregion (Cover k) (Cover m)
  consistent : Submap m k
  separates_adjacent : ∀ p q, Adjacent m p q → ¬k p q

def ColorableWith {R : RealStructure} (n : Nat) (m : PlaneMap R) : Prop :=
  ∃ k, Coloring m k ∧ AtMostRegions n k

/-- Every finite simple map over an arbitrary model of the real line is four-colorable. -/
theorem four_color_finite (Rmodel : RealModel)
    (m : PlaneMap Rmodel.toStructure) :
    FiniteSimpleMap m → ColorableWith 4 m := sorry

/-- Every simple map over an arbitrary model of the real line is four-colorable. -/
theorem four_color (Rmodel : RealModel)
    (m : PlaneMap Rmodel.toStructure) :
    SimpleMap m → ColorableWith 4 m := sorry

end Theorems100.FourColorProblem

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
(* (c) Copyright 2006-2018 Microsoft Corporation and Inria.                  *)
(* Distributed under the terms of CeCILL-B.                                  *)
From fourcolor Require Import real realplane.
From fourcolor Require combinatorial4ct discretize finitize.

(******************************************************************************)
(*   This files contains the proof of the high-level statement of the Four    *)
(* Color Theorem, whose statement uses only the elementary real topology      *)
(* defined in libraries real and realplane.                                   *)
(*   The real-line model is explicit, so the theorem does not silently assume *)
(* a particular construction of the real numbers.                             *)
(******************************************************************************)

Section FourColorTheorem.

Variable Rmodel : Real.model.
Let R := Real.model_structure Rmodel.
Implicit Type m : map R.

Theorem four_color_finite m : finite_simple_map m -> colorable_with 4 m.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem four_color m : simple_map m -> colorable_with 4 m.
Proof.
Admitted.

End FourColorTheorem.

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 032, "The Four Color
  Problem". It states that finite and arbitrary simple maps over every modeled
  real plane admit a coloring with at most four colors. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Four_Color_Problem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'a fc_point = "'a \<times> 'a"
type_synonym 'a fc_region = "'a fc_point \<Rightarrow> bool"
type_synonym 'a fc_plane_map = "'a fc_point \<Rightarrow> 'a fc_region"
type_synonym 'a fc_interval = "'a \<times> 'a"
type_synonym 'a fc_rectangle = "'a fc_interval \<times> 'a fc_interval"

definition fc_real_eq ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_real_eq rle x y \<longleftrightarrow> rle x y \<and> rle y x"

definition fc_upper_bounds ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_upper_bounds rle E z \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>y. E y \<longrightarrow> rle y z)"

definition fc_downward_closure ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_downward_closure rle E x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>y. E y \<and> rle x y)"

definition fc_has_supremum ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_has_supremum rle E \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>x. E x) \<and> (\<exists>z. fc_upper_bounds rle E z)"

locale fc_real_model =
  fixes rle :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and rsup :: "('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and radd :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and rzero :: "'r"
    and ropp :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and rmul :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and rone :: "'r"
    and rinv :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  assumes rle_reflexive: "\<And>x. rle x x"
    and rle_transitive: "\<And>x y z. rle x y \<Longrightarrow> rle y z \<Longrightarrow> rle x z"
    and rsup_upper_bound:
      "\<And>E. fc_has_supremum rle E \<Longrightarrow> fc_upper_bounds rle E (rsup E)"
    and rsup_total:
      "\<And>E x. fc_has_supremum rle E \<Longrightarrow>
        fc_downward_closure rle E x \<or> rle (rsup E) x"
    and radd_monotone:
      "\<And>x y z. rle y z \<Longrightarrow> rle (radd x y) (radd x z)"
    and radd_commutative:
      "\<And>x y. fc_real_eq rle (radd x y) (radd y x)"
    and radd_associative:
      "\<And>x y z. fc_real_eq rle (radd x (radd y z)) (radd (radd x y) z)"
    and radd_zero_left:
      "\<And>x. fc_real_eq rle (radd rzero x) x"
    and radd_opposite_right:
      "\<And>x. fc_real_eq rle (radd x (ropp x)) rzero"
    and rmul_monotone:
      "\<And>x y z. rle rzero x \<Longrightarrow> rle y z \<Longrightarrow>
        rle (rmul x y) (rmul x z)"
    and rmul_commutative:
      "\<And>x y. fc_real_eq rle (rmul x y) (rmul y x)"
    and rmul_associative:
      "\<And>x y z. fc_real_eq rle (rmul x (rmul y z)) (rmul (rmul x y) z)"
    and rmul_distributive_right:
      "\<And>x y z. fc_real_eq rle (rmul x (radd y z))
        (radd (rmul x y) (rmul x z))"
    and rmul_one_left:
      "\<And>x. fc_real_eq rle (rmul rone x) x"
    and rmul_inverse_right:
      "\<And>x. \<not> fc_real_eq rle x rzero \<Longrightarrow>
        fc_real_eq rle (rmul x (rinv x)) rone"
    and rone_nonzero:
      "\<not> fc_real_eq rle rone rzero"
begin

definition fc_in_interval :: "'r fc_interval \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_in_interval s t \<longleftrightarrow>
    \<not> rle t (fst s) \<and> \<not> rle (snd s) t"

definition fc_in_rectangle :: "'r fc_rectangle \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_in_rectangle rect p \<longleftrightarrow>
    fc_in_interval (fst rect) (fst p) \<and>
    fc_in_interval (snd rect) (snd p)"

definition fc_region_union :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_region_union r1 r2 p \<longleftrightarrow> r1 p \<or> r2 p"

definition fc_region_intersection ::
    "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_region_intersection r1 r2 p \<longleftrightarrow> r1 p \<and> r2 p"

definition fc_nonempty_region :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_nonempty_region r \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>p. r p)"

definition fc_subregion :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_subregion r1 r2 \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>p. r1 p \<longrightarrow> r2 p)"

definition fc_regions_meet :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_regions_meet r1 r2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    fc_nonempty_region (fc_region_intersection r1 r2)"

definition fc_plain_map :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_plain_map m \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p q. m p q \<longrightarrow> m q p) \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. m p q \<longrightarrow> fc_subregion (m q) (m p))"

definition fc_cover :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_cover m p \<longleftrightarrow> m p p"

definition fc_submap :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_submap m1 m2 \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>p. fc_subregion (m1 p) (m2 p))"

definition fc_at_most_regions :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_at_most_regions n m \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>representatives :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point.
      \<forall>p. fc_cover m p \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>i. i < n \<and> m (representatives i) p))"

definition fc_open_region :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_open_region r \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p. r p \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>rect. fc_in_rectangle rect p \<and>
        fc_subregion (fc_in_rectangle rect) r))"

definition fc_closure :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_closure r p \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u. fc_open_region u \<longrightarrow> u p \<longrightarrow> fc_regions_meet r u)"

definition fc_connected_region :: "'r fc_region \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_connected_region r \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u v. fc_open_region u \<longrightarrow> fc_open_region v \<longrightarrow>
      fc_subregion r (fc_region_union u v) \<longrightarrow>
      fc_regions_meet u r \<longrightarrow> fc_regions_meet v r \<longrightarrow>
      fc_regions_meet u v)"

definition fc_simple_map :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_simple_map m \<longleftrightarrow>
    fc_plain_map m \<and>
    (\<forall>p. fc_open_region (m p)) \<and>
    (\<forall>p. fc_connected_region (m p))"

definition fc_finite_simple_map :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_finite_simple_map m \<longleftrightarrow>
    fc_simple_map m \<and> (\<exists>n. fc_at_most_regions n m)"

definition fc_border ::
    "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point \<Rightarrow>
      'r fc_region" where
  "fc_border m p q =
    fc_region_intersection (fc_closure (m p)) (fc_closure (m q))"

definition fc_corner_map ::
    "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_plane_map" where
  "fc_corner_map m p q r \<longleftrightarrow> m q r \<and> fc_closure (m q) p"

definition fc_not_corner :: "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_region" where
  "fc_not_corner m p \<longleftrightarrow> fc_at_most_regions 2 (fc_corner_map m p)"

definition fc_adjacent ::
    "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_point \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_adjacent m p q \<longleftrightarrow>
    \<not> m p q \<and> fc_regions_meet (fc_not_corner m) (fc_border m p q)"

definition fc_coloring ::
    "'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_coloring m k \<longleftrightarrow>
    fc_plain_map k \<and>
    fc_subregion (fc_cover k) (fc_cover m) \<and>
    fc_submap m k \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. fc_adjacent m p q \<longrightarrow> \<not> k p q)"

definition fc_colorable_with :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r fc_plane_map \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fc_colorable_with n m \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>k. fc_coloring m k \<and> fc_at_most_regions n k)"

theorem four_color_finite:
  fixes m :: "'r fc_plane_map"
  assumes "fc_finite_simple_map m"
  shows "fc_colorable_with 4 m"
  sorry

theorem four_color:
  fixes m :: "'r fc_plane_map"
  assumes "fc_simple_map m"
  shows "fc_colorable_with 4 m"
  sorry

end

end

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Four Color Problem" from Hundred
  Theorems item 032. It states the finite and general four-color claims for
  simple topological maps over every complete ordered-field real model.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let FOUR_COLOR_PROBLEM =
 `!rle:A->A->bool
    rsup:(A->bool)->A
    radd:A->A->A
    rzero:A
    ropp:A->A
    rmul:A->A->A
    rone:A
    rinv:A->A.
  let real_eq = \x y:A. rle x y /\ rle y x in
  let rhas_sup =
    \e:A->bool.
      (?x. e x) /\ (?z. !y. e y ==> rle y z) in
  let real_model_axioms =
   ((!x. rle x x) /\
    (!x y z. rle x y /\ rle y z ==> rle x z) /\
    (!e:A->bool.
       rhas_sup e ==> !y. e y ==> rle y (rsup e)) /\
    (!e:A->bool x.
       rhas_sup e
       ==> ((?y. e y /\ rle x y) \/ rle (rsup e) x)) /\
    (!x y z. rle y z ==> rle (radd x y) (radd x z)) /\
    (!x y. real_eq (radd x y) (radd y x)) /\
    (!x y z.
       real_eq (radd x (radd y z)) (radd (radd x y) z)) /\
    (!x. real_eq (radd rzero x) x) /\
    (!x. real_eq (radd x (ropp x)) rzero) /\
    (!x y z.
       rle rzero x /\ rle y z ==> rle (rmul x y) (rmul x z)) /\
    (!x y. real_eq (rmul x y) (rmul y x)) /\
    (!x y z.
       real_eq (rmul x (rmul y z)) (rmul (rmul x y) z)) /\
    (!x y z.
       real_eq (rmul x (radd y z))
               (radd (rmul x y) (rmul x z))) /\
    (!x. real_eq (rmul rone x) x) /\
    (!x. ~(real_eq x rzero)
         ==> real_eq (rmul x (rinv x)) rone) /\
    ~(real_eq rone rzero)) in
  let strict = \x y:A. ~(rle y x) in
  let open_region =
    \s:(A#A)->bool.
      !p. s p
          ==> ?xl xu yl yu:A.
                strict xl (FST p) /\ strict (FST p) xu /\
                strict yl (SND p) /\ strict (SND p) yu /\
                (!q. strict xl (FST q) /\ strict (FST q) xu /\
                     strict yl (SND q) /\ strict (SND q) yu
                     ==> s q) in
  let closure_region =
    \s:(A#A)->bool. \p:A#A.
      !u:(A#A)->bool.
        open_region u /\ u p ==> ?q. s q /\ u q in
  let connected_region =
    \s:(A#A)->bool.
      !u v:(A#A)->bool.
        open_region u /\
        open_region v /\
        (!x. s x ==> u x \/ v x) /\
        (?x. u x /\ s x) /\
        (?x. v x /\ s x)
        ==> ?x. u x /\ v x in
  let plain_map =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      (!p q. m p q ==> m q p) /\
      (!p q r. m p q /\ m q r ==> m p r) in
  let at_most_regions =
    \n:num. \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      ?representative:num->(A#A).
        !p. m p p ==> ?i. i < n /\ m (representative i) p in
  let simple_map =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      plain_map m /\
      (!p. open_region (m p)) /\
      (!p. connected_region (m p)) in
  let finite_simple_map =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      simple_map m /\ ?n. at_most_regions n m in
  let border =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
    \p q:A#A. \x:A#A.
      closure_region (m p) x /\ closure_region (m q) x in
  let corner_map =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
    \p:A#A. \q r:A#A.
      m q r /\ closure_region (m q) p in
  let not_corner =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool. \p:A#A.
      at_most_regions 2 (corner_map m p) in
  let adjacent =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool. \p q:A#A.
      ~(m p q) /\ ?x. not_corner m x /\ border m p q x in
  let coloring =
    \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
    \k:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      plain_map k /\
      (!p. k p p ==> m p p) /\
      (!p q. m p q ==> k p q) /\
      (!p q. adjacent m p q ==> ~(k p q)) in
  let colorable_with =
    \n:num. \m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
      ?k:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
        coloring m k /\ at_most_regions n k in
  real_model_axioms
  ==>
  ((!m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
       finite_simple_map m ==> colorable_with 4 m) /\
   (!m:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool.
       simple_map m ==> colorable_with 4 m))`;;

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__032, "The Four Color Problem": every finite simple
;; plane map, represented by a rational straight-line planar adjacency graph
;; of its regions, admits a proper coloring of adjacent regions with at most
;; four colors. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A region record is (:region identifier x-coordinate y-coordinate), and a
;; border record is (:border first-region-id second-region-id).

(defun ht032-region-recordp (region)
  (and (true-listp region)
       (equal (len region) 4)
       (equal (nth 0 region) :region)
       (rationalp (nth 2 region))
       (rationalp (nth 3 region))))

(defun ht032-region-listp (regions)
  (if (consp regions)
      (and (ht032-region-recordp (car regions))
           (ht032-region-listp (cdr regions)))
    (equal regions nil)))

(defun ht032-region-id (region)
  (nth 1 region))

(defun ht032-region-x (region)
  (nth 2 region))

(defun ht032-region-y (region)
  (nth 3 region))

(defun ht032-region-identifiers (regions)
  (if (consp regions)
      (cons (ht032-region-id (car regions))
            (ht032-region-identifiers (cdr regions)))
    nil))

(defun ht032-region-coordinates (regions)
  (if (consp regions)
      (cons (cons (ht032-region-x (car regions))
                  (ht032-region-y (car regions)))
            (ht032-region-coordinates (cdr regions)))
    nil))

(defun ht032-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (ht032-region-x b) (ht032-region-x a))
        (- (ht032-region-y c) (ht032-region-y a)))
     (* (- (ht032-region-y b) (ht032-region-y a))
        (- (ht032-region-x c) (ht032-region-x a)))))

(defun ht032-noncollinear-with-third-p (a b remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (not (equal (ht032-orientation a b (car remaining)) 0))
           (ht032-noncollinear-with-third-p a b (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun ht032-noncollinear-with-pairs-p (a remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (ht032-noncollinear-with-third-p
            a (car remaining) (cdr remaining))
           (ht032-noncollinear-with-pairs-p a (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun ht032-general-position-p (regions)
  (if (consp regions)
      (and (ht032-noncollinear-with-pairs-p
            (car regions) (cdr regions))
           (ht032-general-position-p (cdr regions)))
    t))

(defun ht032-border-recordp (border region-identifiers)
  (and (true-listp border)
       (equal (len border) 3)
       (equal (nth 0 border) :border)
       (member-equal (nth 1 border) region-identifiers)
       (member-equal (nth 2 border) region-identifiers)
       (not (equal (nth 1 border) (nth 2 border)))))

(defun ht032-border-listp (borders region-identifiers)
  (if (consp borders)
      (and (ht032-border-recordp (car borders) region-identifiers)
           (ht032-border-listp (cdr borders) region-identifiers))
    (equal borders nil)))

(defun ht032-border-first (border)
  (nth 1 border))

(defun ht032-border-second (border)
  (nth 2 border))

(defun ht032-same-undirected-border-p (left right)
  (or (and (equal (ht032-border-first left)
                  (ht032-border-first right))
           (equal (ht032-border-second left)
                  (ht032-border-second right)))
      (and (equal (ht032-border-first left)
                  (ht032-border-second right))
           (equal (ht032-border-second left)
                  (ht032-border-first right)))))

(defun ht032-border-distinct-from-list-p (border remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (not (ht032-same-undirected-border-p border (car remaining)))
           (ht032-border-distinct-from-list-p border (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun ht032-no-duplicate-borders-p (borders)
  (if (consp borders)
      (and (ht032-border-distinct-from-list-p
            (car borders) (cdr borders))
           (ht032-no-duplicate-borders-p (cdr borders)))
    t))

(defun ht032-find-region (identifier regions)
  (if (consp regions)
      (if (equal identifier (ht032-region-id (car regions)))
          (car regions)
        (ht032-find-region identifier (cdr regions)))
    nil))

(defun ht032-strict-opposite-signs-p (left right)
  (or (and (< left 0) (< 0 right))
      (and (< right 0) (< 0 left))))

(defun ht032-proper-segment-crossing-p (left right regions)
  (let* ((a (ht032-find-region (ht032-border-first left) regions))
         (b (ht032-find-region (ht032-border-second left) regions))
         (c (ht032-find-region (ht032-border-first right) regions))
         (d (ht032-find-region (ht032-border-second right) regions)))
    (and
     (ht032-strict-opposite-signs-p
      (ht032-orientation a b c)
      (ht032-orientation a b d))
     (ht032-strict-opposite-signs-p
      (ht032-orientation c d a)
      (ht032-orientation c d b)))))

(defun ht032-border-noncrossing-with-list-p
    (border remaining regions)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (not (ht032-proper-segment-crossing-p
                 border (car remaining) regions))
           (ht032-border-noncrossing-with-list-p
            border (cdr remaining) regions))
    t))

(defun ht032-noncrossing-borders-p (borders regions)
  (if (consp borders)
      (and (ht032-border-noncrossing-with-list-p
            (car borders) (cdr borders) regions)
           (ht032-noncrossing-borders-p (cdr borders) regions))
    t))

(defun ht032-simple-plane-map-p (regions borders)
  (and
   (true-listp regions)
   (true-listp borders)
   (ht032-region-listp regions)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (ht032-region-identifiers regions))
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (ht032-region-coordinates regions))
   (ht032-general-position-p regions)
   (ht032-border-listp borders (ht032-region-identifiers regions))
   (ht032-no-duplicate-borders-p borders)
   (ht032-noncrossing-borders-p borders regions)))

(defun ht032-color-differs-from-assigned-p
    (other-region color coloring)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal other-region coloring)))
    (or (not (consp entry))
        (not (equal color (cdr entry))))))

(defun ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
    (region color borders coloring)
  (if (consp borders)
      (and
       (cond
        ((equal region (ht032-border-first (car borders)))
         (ht032-color-differs-from-assigned-p
          (ht032-border-second (car borders)) color coloring))
        ((equal region (ht032-border-second (car borders)))
         (ht032-color-differs-from-assigned-p
          (ht032-border-first (car borders)) color coloring))
        (t t))
       (ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
        region color (cdr borders) coloring))
    t))

(defun ht032-four-colorable-from-p
    (remaining-regions borders coloring)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining-regions)))
  (if (consp remaining-regions)
      (let ((region (ht032-region-id (car remaining-regions))))
        (or
         (and
          (ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
           region 0 borders coloring)
          (ht032-four-colorable-from-p
           (cdr remaining-regions)
           borders
           (cons (cons region 0) coloring)))
         (and
          (ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
           region 1 borders coloring)
          (ht032-four-colorable-from-p
           (cdr remaining-regions)
           borders
           (cons (cons region 1) coloring)))
         (and
          (ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
           region 2 borders coloring)
          (ht032-four-colorable-from-p
           (cdr remaining-regions)
           borders
           (cons (cons region 2) coloring)))
         (and
          (ht032-color-choice-compatible-with-borders-p
           region 3 borders coloring)
          (ht032-four-colorable-from-p
           (cdr remaining-regions)
           borders
           (cons (cons region 3) coloring)))))
    t))

(defun ht032-colorable-with-four-p (regions borders)
  (ht032-four-colorable-from-p regions borders nil))

(defun hundred-theorems-032-the-four-color-problem-statement
    (regions borders)

   (ht032-simple-plane-map-p regions borders)

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Four Color Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 032:
-- every simple map of open connected regions over an arbitrary modeled real plane is
-- colorable with at most four colors. This file contains no proof.

module FourColorProblem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

data NatLessOrEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual zero n
  successors-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual m n ->
    NatLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  NatLessOrEqual (suc m) n

record RealStructure : Set1 where
  field
    Val : Set
    lessOrEqual : Val -> Val -> Set
    supremum : (Val -> Set) -> Val
    add : Val -> Val -> Val
    zeroR : Val
    negate : Val -> Val
    multiply : Val -> Val -> Val
    oneR : Val
    inverse : Val -> Val

open RealStructure

RealEqual :
  (R : RealStructure) ->
  Val R ->
  Val R ->
  Set
RealEqual R x y =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual R x y)
    (lessOrEqual R y x)

UpperBounds :
  (R : RealStructure) ->
  (Val R -> Set) ->
  Val R ->
  Set
UpperBounds R body upper =
  (y : Val R) ->
  body y ->
  lessOrEqual R y upper

DownwardClosure :
  (R : RealStructure) ->
  (Val R -> Set) ->
  Val R ->
  Set
DownwardClosure R body x =
  Exists (Val R)
    (\ y ->
      Both
        (body y)
        (lessOrEqual R x y))

NonemptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Set) ->
  Set
NonemptySet {A} body =
  Exists A body

HasUpperBound :
  (R : RealStructure) ->
  (Val R -> Set) ->
  Set
HasUpperBound R body =
  NonemptySet (UpperBounds R body)

HasSupremum :
  (R : RealStructure) ->
  (Val R -> Set) ->
  Set
HasSupremum R body =
  Both
    (NonemptySet body)
    (HasUpperBound R body)

record RealAxioms (R : RealStructure) : Set1 where
  field
    order-reflexive :
      (x : Val R) ->
      lessOrEqual R x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      lessOrEqual R x y ->
      lessOrEqual R y z ->
      lessOrEqual R x z
    supremum-upper-bound :
      (body : Val R -> Set) ->
      HasSupremum R body ->
      UpperBounds R body (supremum R body)
    supremum-total :
      (body : Val R -> Set) ->
      (x : Val R) ->
      HasSupremum R body ->
      Either
        (DownwardClosure R body x)
        (lessOrEqual R (supremum R body) x)
    add-monotone :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      lessOrEqual R y z ->
      lessOrEqual R (add R x y) (add R x z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R (add R x y) (add R y x)
    add-associative :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R
        (add R x (add R y z))
        (add R (add R x y) z)
    zero-add :
      (x : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R (add R (zeroR R) x) x
    add-negate :
      (x : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R (add R x (negate R x)) (zeroR R)
    multiply-monotone :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      lessOrEqual R (zeroR R) x ->
      lessOrEqual R y z ->
      lessOrEqual R
        (multiply R x y)
        (multiply R x z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R
        (multiply R x y)
        (multiply R y x)
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R
        (multiply R x (multiply R y z))
        (multiply R (multiply R x y) z)
    multiply-add :
      (x y z : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R
        (multiply R x (add R y z))
        (add R
          (multiply R x y)
          (multiply R x z))
    one-multiply :
      (x : Val R) ->
      RealEqual R (multiply R (oneR R) x) x
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : Val R) ->
      Not (RealEqual R x (zeroR R)) ->
      RealEqual R
        (multiply R x (inverse R x))
        (oneR R)
    one-not-zero :
      Not (RealEqual R (oneR R) (zeroR R))

record RealModel : Set1 where
  field
    structure : RealStructure
    axioms : RealAxioms structure

open RealModel

record Point (R : RealStructure) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : Val R
    y-coordinate : Val R

open Point

Region : RealStructure -> Set1
Region R =
  Point R -> Set

PlaneMap : RealStructure -> Set1
PlaneMap R =
  Point R -> Point R -> Set

record Interval (R : RealStructure) : Set where
  constructor interval
  field
    left-endpoint : Val R
    right-endpoint : Val R

open Interval

record Rectangle (R : RealStructure) : Set where
  constructor rectangle
  field
    horizontal : Interval R
    vertical : Interval R

open Rectangle

InInterval :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Interval R ->
  Val R ->
  Set
InInterval {R} bounds t =
  Both
    (Not (lessOrEqual R t (left-endpoint bounds)))
    (Not (lessOrEqual R (right-endpoint bounds) t))

InRectangle :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Rectangle R ->
  Region R
InRectangle bounds p =
  Both
    (InInterval (horizontal bounds) (x-coordinate p))
    (InInterval (vertical bounds) (y-coordinate p))

RegionUnion :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
RegionUnion leftRegion rightRegion p =
  Either
    (leftRegion p)
    (rightRegion p)

RegionIntersection :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
RegionIntersection leftRegion rightRegion p =
  Both
    (leftRegion p)
    (rightRegion p)

RegionNonempty :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Set
RegionNonempty {R} body =
  Exists (Point R) body

Subregion :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Subregion {R} leftRegion rightRegion =
  (p : Point R) ->
  leftRegion p ->
  rightRegion p

Meet :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Meet leftRegion rightRegion =
  RegionNonempty
    (RegionIntersection leftRegion rightRegion)

record PlainMap
  {R : RealStructure}
  (m : PlaneMap R) :
  Set where

  field
    symmetric :
      (p q : Point R) ->
      m p q ->
      m q p
    transitive :
      (p q : Point R) ->
      m p q ->
      Subregion (m q) (m p)

Cover :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Region R
Cover m p =
  m p p

Submap :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Set
Submap {R} smaller larger =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Subregion (smaller p) (larger p)

AtMostRegions :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Nat ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Set
AtMostRegions {R} n m =
  Exists (Nat -> Point R)
    (\ representatives ->
      (p : Point R) ->
      Cover m p ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          Both
            (NatStrictLess i n)
            (m (representatives i) p)))

OpenRegion :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Set
OpenRegion {R} body =
  (p : Point R) ->
  body p ->
  Exists (Rectangle R)
    (\ bounds ->
      Both
        (InRectangle bounds p)
        (Subregion (InRectangle bounds) body))

Closure :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Closure {R} body p =
  (bounds : Rectangle R) ->
  InRectangle bounds p ->
  Meet body (InRectangle bounds)

Connected :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Region R ->
  Set1
Connected body =
  (leftOpen rightOpen : Region _) ->
  OpenRegion leftOpen ->
  OpenRegion rightOpen ->
  Subregion body (RegionUnion leftOpen rightOpen) ->
  Meet leftOpen body ->
  Meet rightOpen body ->
  Meet leftOpen rightOpen

record SimpleMap
  {R : RealStructure}
  (m : PlaneMap R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    plain :
      PlainMap m
    open-region :
      (p : Point R) ->
      OpenRegion (m p)
    connected-region :
      (p : Point R) ->
      Connected (m p)

record FiniteSimpleMap
  {R : RealStructure}
  (m : PlaneMap R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    simple :
      SimpleMap m
    finite :
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          AtMostRegions n m)

Border :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Region R
Border m p q =
  RegionIntersection
    (Closure (m p))
    (Closure (m q))

CornerMap :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Point R ->
  PlaneMap R
CornerMap m p q r =
  Both
    (m q r)
    (Closure (m q) p)

NotCorner :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Region R
NotCorner m p =
  AtMostRegions 2 (CornerMap m p)

Adjacent :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Adjacent m p q =
  Both
    (Not (m p q))
    (Meet
      (NotCorner m)
      (Border m p q))

record Coloring
  {R : RealStructure}
  (m k : PlaneMap R) :
  Set where

  field
    plain :
      PlainMap k
    cover :
      Subregion (Cover k) (Cover m)
    consistent :
      Submap m k
    separates-adjacent :
      (p q : Point R) ->
      Adjacent m p q ->
      Not (k p q)

ColorableWith :
  {R : RealStructure} ->
  Nat ->
  PlaneMap R ->
  Set1
ColorableWith {R} n m =
  Exists (PlaneMap R)
    (\ coloring ->
      Both
        (Coloring m coloring)
        (AtMostRegions n coloring))

four-color-finite : Set1
four-color-finite =
  (Rmodel : RealModel) ->
  (m : PlaneMap (structure Rmodel)) ->
  FiniteSimpleMap m ->
  ColorableWith 4 m

four-color : Set1
four-color =
  (Rmodel : RealModel) ->
  (m : PlaneMap (structure Rmodel)) ->
  SimpleMap m ->
  ColorableWith 4 m

record BothFourColorClaims : Set1 where
  field
    finite-case : four-color-finite
    general-case : four-color

the-four-color-problem : Set1
the-four-color-problem =
  BothFourColorClaims

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Four Color Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 032. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

(*
  Hundred Theorems item 032, "The Four Color Problem": every simple map of
  open connected regions over an arbitrary modeled real plane is colorable
  with at most four colors, with adjacent regions separated. This is a
  statement-only formalization and contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory;

val the_four_color_problem =
  ``!(le : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (supremum : ('r -> bool) -> 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zero : 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (one : 'r)
      (inv : 'r -> 'r).
      let real_eq =
        \x y. le x y /\ le y x
      in
      let upper_bounds =
        \(s : 'r -> bool) z. !y. s y ==> le y z
      in
      let downward_closure =
        \(s : 'r -> bool) x. ?y. s y /\ le x y
      in
      let nonempty =
        \(s : 'r -> bool). ?x. s x
      in
      let has_upper_bound =
        \(s : 'r -> bool). ?z. upper_bounds s z
      in
      let has_supremum =
        \(s : 'r -> bool). nonempty s /\ has_upper_bound s
      in
      let real_model =
        ((!x. le x x) /\
         (!x y z. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
         (!s. has_supremum s ==> upper_bounds s (supremum s)) /\
         (!s x.
            has_supremum s ==>
            downward_closure s x \/ le (supremum s) x) /\
         (!x y z. le y z ==> le (add x y) (add x z)) /\
         (!x y. real_eq (add x y) (add y x)) /\
         (!x y z. real_eq (add x (add y z)) (add (add x y) z)) /\
         (!x. real_eq (add zero x) x) /\
         (!x. real_eq (add x (neg x)) zero) /\
         (!x y z.
            le zero x /\ le y z ==>
            le (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
         (!x y. real_eq (mul x y) (mul y x)) /\
         (!x y z. real_eq (mul x (mul y z)) (mul (mul x y) z)) /\
         (!x y z.
            real_eq (mul x (add y z))
                    (add (mul x y) (mul x z))) /\
         (!x. real_eq (mul one x) x) /\
         (!x. ~real_eq x zero ==> real_eq (mul x (inv x)) one) /\
         ~real_eq one zero)
      in
      let subregion =
        \(r1 : ('r # 'r) -> bool) r2.
          !p. r1 p ==> r2 p
      in
      let meet =
        \(r1 : ('r # 'r) -> bool) r2.
          ?p. r1 p /\ r2 p
      in
      let in_interval =
        \left right t. ~(le t left) /\ ~(le right t)
      in
      let open_region =
        \(r : ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          !p.
            r p ==>
            ?left right bottom top.
              in_interval left right (FST p) /\
              in_interval bottom top (SND p) /\
              (!q.
                 in_interval left right (FST q) /\
                 in_interval bottom top (SND q) ==>
                 r q)
      in
      let connected =
        \(r : ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          !u v.
            open_region u /\
            open_region v /\
            subregion r (\p. u p \/ v p) /\
            meet u r /\
            meet v r ==>
            meet u v
      in
      let plain_map =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          (!p q. m p q ==> m q p) /\
          (!p q r. m p q /\ m q r ==> m p r)
      in
      let cover =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) p.
          m p p
      in
      let submap =
        \(m1 : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) m2.
          !p. subregion (m1 p) (m2 p)
      in
      let at_most_regions =
        \(n : num) (m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          ?representatives : num -> ('r # 'r).
            !p.
              cover m p ==>
              ?i. i < n /\ m (representatives i) p
      in
      let simple_map =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          plain_map m /\
          (!p. open_region (m p)) /\
          (!p. connected (m p))
      in
      let finite_simple_map =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          simple_map m /\ ?n. at_most_regions n m
      in
      let closure =
        \(r : ('r # 'r) -> bool) p.
          !u. open_region u /\ u p ==> meet r u
      in
      let border =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) p q x.
          closure (m p) x /\ closure (m q) x
      in
      let corner_map =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) p q r.
          m q r /\ closure (m q) p
      in
      let not_corner =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) p.
          at_most_regions 2 (corner_map m p)
      in
      let adjacent =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) p q.
          ~(m p q) /\ meet (not_corner m) (border m p q)
      in
      let coloring =
        \(m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool) k.
          plain_map k /\
          subregion (cover k) (cover m) /\
          submap m k /\
          (!p q. adjacent m p q ==> ~(k p q))
      in
      let colorable_with =
        \(n : num) (m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool).
          ?k. coloring m k /\ at_most_regions n k
      in
        real_model ==>
        !m : ('r # 'r) -> ('r # 'r) -> bool.
          (finite_simple_map m ==> colorable_with 4 m) /\
          (simple_map m ==> colorable_with 4 m)``;

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Four Color Problem" from Hundred
  Theorems item 032: every simple planar map over an arbitrary model of the
  real line is colorable with at most four colors. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  This encoding preserves the definitions used by the Rocq source rather than
  replacing them with uninterpreted predicates.

  HT032RealModel codes Real.model as a nine-component function whose entries
  are the carrier, order, supremum, addition, zero, opposite, multiplication,
  one, and inverse. Its definition includes exactly the source typing
  conditions and sixteen real-model axioms. Points are ordered pairs in the
  carrier square, regions are subsets of that plane, and maps are functions
  from points to regions.

  HT032PlainMap, HT032AtMost, HT032Open, HT032Connected, HT032SimpleMap,
  HT032FiniteSimpleMap, HT032Closure, HT032CornerMap, HT032NotCorner,
  HT032Adjacent, HT032Coloring, and HT032ColorableWith are direct
  set-theoretic renderings of the correspondingly named definitions in
  realplane.v. In particular, colors remain equivalence-relation regions, and
  adjacency uses a non-corner point in the common closures of two regions.

  The two final assertions preserve the finite intermediate theorem and the
  full compactness theorem. They are unproved $a assertions; this statement
  file adds no $p proof statement.
$)

$c HT032Val HT032Le HT032Sup HT032Add HT032Zero HT032Opp $.
$c HT032Mul HT032One HT032Inv HT032Eq HT032HasSup HT032RealModel $.
$c HT032Plane HT032Map HT032PlainMap HT032AtMost HT032Open $.
$c HT032Connected HT032SimpleMap HT032FiniteSimpleMap HT032Closure $.
$c HT032CornerMap HT032NotCorner HT032Adjacent HT032Coloring $.
$c HT032ColorableWith $.

ht032-val-syntax $a class ( HT032Val R ) $.
ht032-le-syntax $a class ( HT032Le R ) $.
ht032-sup-syntax $a class ( HT032Sup R ) $.
ht032-add-syntax $a class ( HT032Add R ) $.
ht032-zero-syntax $a class ( HT032Zero R ) $.
ht032-opp-syntax $a class ( HT032Opp R ) $.
ht032-mul-syntax $a class ( HT032Mul R ) $.
ht032-one-syntax $a class ( HT032One R ) $.
ht032-inv-syntax $a class ( HT032Inv R ) $.
ht032-eq-syntax $a wff ( HT032Eq R X Y ) $.
ht032-has-sup-syntax $a wff ( HT032HasSup R A ) $.
ht032-real-model-syntax $a wff ( HT032RealModel R ) $.
ht032-plane-syntax $a class ( HT032Plane R ) $.
ht032-map-syntax $a wff ( HT032Map R M ) $.
ht032-plain-map-syntax $a wff ( HT032PlainMap R M ) $.
ht032-at-most-syntax $a wff ( HT032AtMost R N M ) $.
ht032-open-syntax $a wff ( HT032Open R A ) $.
ht032-connected-syntax $a wff ( HT032Connected R A ) $.
ht032-simple-map-syntax $a wff ( HT032SimpleMap R M ) $.
ht032-finite-simple-map-syntax $a wff ( HT032FiniteSimpleMap R M ) $.
ht032-closure-syntax $a class ( HT032Closure R A ) $.
ht032-corner-map-syntax $a class ( HT032CornerMap R M Z ) $.
ht032-not-corner-syntax $a class ( HT032NotCorner R M ) $.
ht032-adjacent-syntax $a wff ( HT032Adjacent R M X Y ) $.
ht032-coloring-syntax $a wff ( HT032Coloring R M K ) $.
ht032-colorable-with-syntax $a wff ( HT032ColorableWith R N M ) $.

 ${
  ht032-val-definition $a |- ( HT032Val R ) = ( R ` 0 ) $.
  ht032-le-definition $a |- ( HT032Le R ) = ( R ` 1 ) $.
  ht032-sup-definition $a |- ( HT032Sup R ) = ( R ` 2 ) $.
  ht032-add-definition $a |- ( HT032Add R ) = ( R ` 3 ) $.
  ht032-zero-definition $a |- ( HT032Zero R ) = ( R ` 4 ) $.
  ht032-opp-definition $a |- ( HT032Opp R ) = ( R ` 5 ) $.
  ht032-mul-definition $a |- ( HT032Mul R ) = ( R ` 6 ) $.
  ht032-one-definition $a |- ( HT032One R ) = ( R ` 7 ) $.
  ht032-inv-definition $a |- ( HT032Inv R ) = ( R ` 8 ) $.
$}

${
  $d R X Y $.
  ht032-eq-definition $a |- (
    ( HT032Eq R X Y )
    <->
    (
      <. X , Y >. e. ( HT032Le R )
      /\
      <. Y , X >. e. ( HT032Le R )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R x y $.
  ht032-has-sup-definition $a |- (
    ( HT032HasSup R A )
    <->
    (
      A =/= (/)
      /\
      E. x e. ( HT032Val R )
        A. y e. A <. y , x >. e. ( HT032Le R )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a R x y z $.

  ht032-real-model-definition $a |- (
    ( HT032RealModel R )
    <->
    (
      (
        R : ( 0 ..^ 9 ) --> _V
        /\
        (
          ( HT032Le R )
          C_
          ( ( HT032Val R ) X. ( HT032Val R ) )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          ( HT032Sup R ) : ~P ( HT032Val R ) --> ( HT032Val R )
          /\
          (
            ( HT032Add R )
            :
            ( ( HT032Val R ) X. ( HT032Val R ) )
            -->
            ( HT032Val R )
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( HT032Zero R ) e. ( HT032Val R )
            /\
            ( HT032Opp R ) : ( HT032Val R ) --> ( HT032Val R )
          )
          /\
          (
            (
              ( HT032Mul R )
              :
              ( ( HT032Val R ) X. ( HT032Val R ) )
              -->
              ( HT032Val R )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( HT032One R ) e. ( HT032Val R )
                /\
                ( HT032Inv R ) : ( HT032Val R ) --> ( HT032Val R )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  A. x e. ( HT032Val R )
                    <. x , x >. e. ( HT032Le R )
                  /\

  st p is one-to-one &
    (for e being Element of the_Edges_of G st
      e in the_Edges_of G holds
      ex v,w being Vertex of G, A being Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st
        e Joins v,w,G & A = a.e & A is_an_arc_of p.v,p.w) &
    (for e being Element of the_Edges_of G, v being Vertex of G,
        A being Subset of TOP-REAL 2 st
      e in the_Edges_of G & A = a.e & p.v in A holds
      ex w being Vertex of G st e Joins v,w,G) &
    (for e1,e2 being Element of the_Edges_of G,
        A1,A2 being Subset of TOP-REAL 2, x being object st
      e1 in the_Edges_of G & e2 in the_Edges_of G & e1 <> e2 &
      A1 = a.e1 & A2 = a.e2 & x in A1 & x in A2 holds
      ex v,w1,w2 being Vertex of G st
        x = p.v & e1 Joins v,w1,G & e2 Joins v,w2,G)
  holds G is 4-vcolorable
proof
end;

title: 032_the_four_color_problem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 032, "The Four Color Problem":
% finite and arbitrary simple maps of the plane over any model of the real line are
% colorable with at most four colors. This file contains no proof.

four_color_problem_032[
  real_value: TYPE+,
  real_le: [real_value, real_value -> bool],
  real_sup: [[real_value -> bool] -> real_value],
  real_add: [real_value, real_value -> real_value],
  real_zero: real_value,
  real_opp: [real_value -> real_value],
  real_mul: [real_value, real_value -> real_value],
  real_one: real_value,
  real_inv: [real_value -> real_value]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real_value -> bool]

  real_equal(x, y: real_value): bool =
    real_le(x, y) AND real_le(y, x)

  upper_bounds(E: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (z: real_value):
      FORALL (y: real_value):
        E(y) IMPLIES real_le(y, z)

  real_nonempty(E: real_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: real_value): E(x)

  has_upper_bound(E: real_set): bool =
    real_nonempty(upper_bounds(E))

  has_supremum(E: real_set): bool =
    real_nonempty(E) AND has_upper_bound(E)

  downward_closure(E: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real_value):
      EXISTS (y: real_value):
        E(y) AND real_le(x, y)

  real_model_axioms: bool =
    (FORALL (x: real_value):
      real_le(x, x))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_le(x, y) AND real_le(y, z)
        IMPLIES real_le(x, z))
    AND
    (FORALL (E: real_set):
      has_supremum(E)
        IMPLIES upper_bounds(E)(real_sup(E)))
    AND
    (FORALL (E: real_set), (x: real_value):
      has_supremum(E)
        IMPLIES
          (downward_closure(E)(x)
            OR real_le(real_sup(E), x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_le(y, z)
        IMPLIES
          real_le(real_add(x, y), real_add(x, z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: real_value):
      real_equal(real_add(x, y), real_add(y, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_equal(
        real_add(x, real_add(y, z)),
        real_add(real_add(x, y), z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: real_value):
      real_equal(real_add(real_zero, x), x))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: real_value):
      real_equal(real_add(x, real_opp(x)), real_zero))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_le(real_zero, x) AND real_le(y, z)
        IMPLIES
          real_le(real_mul(x, y), real_mul(x, z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: real_value):
      real_equal(real_mul(x, y), real_mul(y, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_equal(
        real_mul(x, real_mul(y, z)),
        real_mul(real_mul(x, y), z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: real_value):
      real_equal(
        real_mul(x, real_add(y, z)),
        real_add(real_mul(x, y), real_mul(x, z))))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: real_value):
      real_equal(real_mul(real_one, x), x))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: real_value):
      NOT real_equal(x, real_zero)
        IMPLIES
          real_equal(real_mul(x, real_inv(x)), real_one))
    AND NOT real_equal(real_one, real_zero)

  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coordinate: real_value,
       y_coordinate: real_value #]

  region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  plane_map: TYPE = [point -> region]

  interval: TYPE =
    [# lower_endpoint: real_value,
       upper_endpoint: real_value #]

  rectangle: TYPE =
    [# horizontal_span: interval,
       vertical_span: interval #]

  real_lt(x, y: real_value): bool =
    NOT real_le(y, x)

  in_interval(s: interval, t: real_value): bool =
    real_lt(lower_endpoint(s), t)
      AND real_lt(t, upper_endpoint(s))

  in_rectangle(box: rectangle, z: point): bool =
    in_interval(horizontal_span(box), x_coordinate(z))
      AND in_interval(vertical_span(box), y_coordinate(z))

  region_union(r1, r2: region): region =
    LAMBDA (z: point):
      r1(z) OR r2(z)

  region_intersection(r1, r2: region): region =
    LAMBDA (z: point):
      r1(z) AND r2(z)

  nonempty_region(r: region): bool =
    EXISTS (z: point): r(z)

  subregion(r1, r2: region): bool =
    FORALL (z: point):
      r1(z) IMPLIES r2(z)

  regions_meet(r1, r2: region): bool =
    nonempty_region(region_intersection(r1, r2))

  plain_map(m: plane_map): bool =
    (FORALL (z1, z2: point):
      m(z1)(z2) IMPLIES m(z2)(z1))
      AND
    (FORALL (z1, z2: point):
      m(z1)(z2)
        IMPLIES subregion(m(z2), m(z1)))

  map_cover(m: plane_map): region =
    LAMBDA (z: point):
      m(z)(z)

  submap(m1, m2: plane_map): bool =
    FORALL (z: point):
      subregion(m1(z), m2(z))

  at_most_regions(n: nat, m: plane_map): bool =
    EXISTS (representative: [nat -> point]):
      FORALL (z: point):
        map_cover(m)(z)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (i: nat):
              i < n AND m(representative(i))(z)

  open_region(r: region): bool =
    FORALL (z: point):
      r(z)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (box: rectangle):
            in_rectangle(box, z)
              AND subregion(
                    LAMBDA (w: point): in_rectangle(box, w),
                    r)

  region_closure(r: region): region =
    LAMBDA (z: point):
      FORALL (u: region):
        open_region(u) AND u(z)
          IMPLIES regions_meet(r, u)

  connected_region(r: region): bool =
    FORALL (u, v: region):
      (open_region(u)
        AND open_region(v)
        AND subregion(r, region_union(u, v))
        AND regions_meet(u, r)
        AND regions_meet(v, r))
      IMPLIES regions_meet(u, v)

  simple_map(m: plane_map): bool =
    plain_map(m)
      AND (FORALL (z: point): open_region(m(z)))
      AND (FORALL (z: point): connected_region(m(z)))

  finite_simple_map(m: plane_map): bool =
    simple_map(m)
      AND EXISTS (n: nat):
        at_most_regions(n, m)

  map_border(m: plane_map, z1, z2: point): region =
    region_intersection(region_closure(m(z1)), region_closure(m(z2)))

  corner_map(m: plane_map, z: point): plane_map =
    LAMBDA (z1: point):
      LAMBDA (z2: point):
        m(z1)(z2) AND region_closure(m(z1))(z)

  not_corner(m: plane_map): region =
    LAMBDA (z: point):
      at_most_regions(2, corner_map(m, z))

  adjacent(m: plane_map, z1, z2: point): bool =
    NOT m(z1)(z2)
      AND regions_meet(not_corner(m), map_border(m, z1, z2))

  coloring(m, k: plane_map): bool =
    plain_map(k)
      AND subregion(map_cover(k), map_cover(m))
      AND submap(m, k)
      AND
        (FORALL (z1, z2: point):
          adjacent(m, z1, z2)
            IMPLIES NOT k(z1)(z2))

  colorable_with(n: nat, m: plane_map): bool =
    EXISTS (k: plane_map):
      coloring(m, k) AND at_most_regions(n, k)

  four_color_finite: bool =
    real_model_axioms
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (m: plane_map):
          finite_simple_map(m) IMPLIES colorable_with(4, m)

  four_color: bool =
    real_model_axioms
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (m: plane_map):
          simple_map(m) IMPLIES colorable_with(4, m)
END four_color_problem_032
