-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact hundred-theorems__agda__033,
-- "Fermat's Last Theorem": no positive natural bases satisfy a^n + b^n = c^n for a
-- natural exponent n > 2. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _≤_ _<_
infixr 8 _^_

data ⊥ : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → ⊥

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

_^_ : Nat → Nat → Nat
base ^ zero = 1
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

fermat-s-last-theorem : Set
fermat-s-last-theorem =
  (n a b c : Nat) →
  2 < n →
  zero < a →
  zero < b →
  zero < c →
  Not (a ^ n + b ^ n ≡ c ^ n)

title: 034_divergence_of_the_harmonic_series
content:
/-

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NNReal
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Continuity
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SumOverResidueClass

/-!
# Convergence of `p`-series

In this file we prove that the series `∑' k in ℕ, 1 / k ^ p` converges if and only if `p > 1`.
The proof is based on the
[Cauchy condensation test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cauchy_condensation_test): `∑ k, f k`
converges if and only if so does `∑ k, 2 ^ k f (2 ^ k)`. We prove this test in
`NNReal.summable_condensed_iff` and `summable_condensed_iff_of_nonneg`, then use it to prove
`summable_one_div_rpow`. After this transformation, a `p`-series turns into a geometric series.

## Tags

p-series, Cauchy condensation test
-/

@[expose] public section

/-!
### Schlömilch's generalization of the Cauchy condensation test

In this section we prove the Schlömilch's generalization of the Cauchy condensation test:
for a strictly increasing `u : ℕ → ℕ` with ratio of successive differences bounded and an
antitone `f : ℕ → ℝ≥0` or `f : ℕ → ℝ`, `∑ k, f k` converges if and only if
so does `∑ k, (u (k + 1) - u k) * f (u k)`. Instead of giving a monolithic proof, we split it
into a series of lemmas with explicit estimates of partial sums of each series in terms of the
partial sums of the other series.
-/

/--
A sequence `u` has the property that its ratio of successive differences is bounded
when there is a positive real number `C` such that, for all n ∈ ℕ,
(u (n + 2) - u (n + 1)) ≤ C * (u (n + 1) - u n)
-/
def SuccDiffBounded (C : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 2) - u (n + 1) ≤ C • (u (n + 1) - u n)

namespace Finset

variable {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ}

theorem le_sum_schlomilch' (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (hu : Monotone u) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico (u 0) (u n), f k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k) := by sorry
theorem le_sum_condensed' (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico 1 (2 ^ n), f k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, 2 ^ k • f (2 ^ k) := by sorry
theorem le_sum_schlomilch (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (hu : Monotone u) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (u n), f k) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range (u 0), f k + ∑ k ∈ range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k) := by sorry
theorem le_sum_condensed (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (2 ^ n), f k) ≤ f 0 + ∑ k ∈ range n, 2 ^ k • f (2 ^ k) := by sorry
theorem sum_schlomilch_le' (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (hu : Monotone u) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u (k + 1))) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Ico (u 0 + 1) (u n + 1), f k := by sorry
theorem sum_condensed_le' (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n, 2 ^ k • f (2 ^ (k + 1))) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Ico 2 (2 ^ n + 1), f k := by sorry
theorem sum_schlomilch_le {C : ℕ} (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hu : Monotone u) (h_succ_diff : SuccDiffBounded C u) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k) ≤
    (u 1 - u 0) • f (u 0) + C • ∑ k ∈ Ico (u 0 + 1) (u n + 1), f k := by sorry
theorem sum_condensed_le (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), 2 ^ k • f (2 ^ k)) ≤ f 1 + 2 • ∑ k ∈ Ico 2 (2 ^ n + 1), f k := by sorry
end Finset

namespace ENNReal

open Filter Finset

variable {u : ℕ → ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞}

open NNReal in
theorem le_tsum_schlomilch (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (hu : StrictMono u) :
    ∑' k, f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ range (u 0), f k + ∑' k : ℕ, (u (k + 1) - u k) * f (u k) := by sorry
theorem le_tsum_condensed (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) :
    ∑' k, f k ≤ f 0 + ∑' k : ℕ, 2 ^ k * f (2 ^ k) := by sorry
theorem tsum_schlomilch_le {C : ℕ} (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hu : Monotone u) (h_succ_diff : SuccDiffBounded C u) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (u (k + 1) - u k) * f (u k) ≤ (u 1 - u 0) * f (u 0) + C * ∑' k, f k := by sorry
theorem tsum_condensed_le (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, 2 ^ k * f (2 ^ k)) ≤ f 1 + 2 * ∑' k, f k := by sorry
end ENNReal

namespace NNReal

open Finset

open ENNReal in
/-- for a series of `NNReal` version. -/
theorem summable_schlomilch_iff {C : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ≥0}
    (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m)
    (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n) (hu_strict : StrictMono u)
    (hC_nonzero : C ≠ 0) (h_succ_diff : SuccDiffBounded C u) :
    (Summable fun k : ℕ => (u (k + 1) - (u k : ℝ≥0)) * f (u k)) ↔ Summable f := by sorry
open ENNReal in
theorem summable_condensed_iff {f : ℕ → ℝ≥0} (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) :
    (Summable fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ k * f (2 ^ k)) ↔ Summable f := by sorry
end NNReal

open NNReal in
/-- for series of nonnegative real numbers. -/
theorem summable_schlomilch_iff_of_nonneg {C : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} (h_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n)
    (hf : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) (h_pos : ∀ n, 0 < u n)
    (hu_strict : StrictMono u) (hC_nonzero : C ≠ 0) (h_succ_diff : SuccDiffBounded C u) :
    (Summable fun k : ℕ => (u (k + 1) - (u k : ℝ)) * f (u k)) ↔ Summable f := by sorry
theorem summable_condensed_iff_of_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} (h_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n)
    (h_mono : ∀ ⦃m n⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) :
    (Summable fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ k * f (2 ^ k)) ↔ Summable f := by sorry
theorem summable_condensed_iff_of_eventually_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} (h_nonneg : 0 ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] f)
    (h_mono : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, f (k + 1) ≤ f k) :
    (Summable fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ k * f (2 ^ k)) ↔ Summable f := by sorry
section p_series

/-!
### Convergence of the `p`-series

In this section we prove that for a real number `p`, the series `∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (n ^ p)` converges if
and only if `1 < p`. There are many different proofs of this fact. The proof in this file uses the
Cauchy condensation test we formalized above. This test implies that `∑ n, 1 / (n ^ p)` converges if
and only if `∑ n, 2 ^ n / ((2 ^ n) ^ p)` converges, and the latter series is a geometric series with
common ratio `2 ^ {1 - p}`. -/

namespace Real

open Filter

/-- Test for convergence of the `p`-series: the real-valued series `∑' n : ℕ, (n ^ p)⁻¹` converges
if and only if `1 < p`. -/
@[simp]
theorem summable_nat_rpow_inv {p : ℝ} :
    Summable (fun n => ((n : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹ : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_nat_rpow {p : ℝ} : Summable (fun n => (n : ℝ) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ p < -1 := by sorry
theorem summable_one_div_nat_rpow {p : ℝ} :
    Summable (fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_nat_pow_inv {p : ℕ} :
    Summable (fun n => ((n : ℝ) ^ p)⁻¹ : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_one_div_nat_pow {p : ℕ} :
    Summable (fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_one_div_int_pow {p : ℕ} :
    (Summable fun n : ℤ ↦ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_abs_int_rpow {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => |(n : ℝ)| ^ (-b) := by sorry
theorem not_summable_natCast_inv : ¬Summable (fun n => n⁻¹ : ℕ → ℝ) := by sorry
theorem not_summable_one_div_natCast : ¬Summable (fun n => 1 / n : ℕ → ℝ) := by sorry
theorem tendsto_sum_range_one_div_nat_succ_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / (i + 1) : ℝ)) atTop atTop := by sorry
end Real

namespace NNReal

@[simp]
theorem summable_rpow_inv {p : ℝ} :
    Summable (fun n => ((n : ℝ≥0) ^ p)⁻¹ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
theorem summable_rpow {p : ℝ} : Summable (fun n => (n : ℝ≥0) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ≥0) ↔ p < -1 := by sorry
theorem summable_one_div_rpow {p : ℝ} :
    Summable (fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ≥0) ^ p : ℕ → ℝ≥0) ↔ 1 < p := by sorry
end NNReal

end p_series

section

open Finset

variable {α : Type*} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]

theorem sum_Ioc_inv_sq_le_sub {k n : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : k ≤ n) :
    (∑ i ∈ Ioc k n, ((i : α) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ (k : α)⁻¹ - (n : α)⁻¹ := by sorry
theorem sum_Ioo_inv_sq_le (k n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Ioo k n, (i ^ 2 : α)⁻¹) ≤ 2 / (k + 1) :=
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Ioo k n, ((i : α) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Ioc k (max (k + 1) n), ((i : α) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by sorry
end

open Set Nat in

(** Properties involving series and integrals *)
Require Import Reals.
Require Import Rseries_def.
Require Import Rseries_facts.
Require Import RiemannInt.
Require Import Lra.
Require Import Rsequence_facts.
Require Import Rsequence_subsequence.
Require Import Riemann_integrable.
Require Import Rintegral.

Local Open Scope R_scope.
(** printing ~	~ *)
Section Rseries_RiemannInt.

Local Coercion INR : nat >-> R.

(* begin hide *)
Lemma Rle_minus' : forall a b, b <= a -> 0 <= a - b.
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma Rminus_le_compat_r: forall r r1 r2 : R, r2 <= r1 -> r - r1 <= r - r2.
Proof.
Admitted.
(* end hide *)

Lemma Telescoping_series : forall a n, sum_f_R0 (fun i => a (S i) - a i) n = a (S n) - a O.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Telescoping_series_opp : forall a n, sum_f_R0 (fun i => a i - a (S i)) n = a O - a (S n).
Proof.
Admitted.


(** * Generalized Chasles relation *)
Lemma Rint_generalized_Chasles : forall f An, 
  (forall n : nat, Rint f n (S n) (An n)) -> 
    forall n : nat, Rint f 0 (S n) (sum_f_R0 An n).
Proof.
Admitted.

Section Rser_RiemannInt_link.

Variable f : R -> R.
Hypothesis Hcont : forall x, 0 <= x -> continuity_pt f x.
Hypothesis Hpos : forall x, 0 <= x -> 0 <= f x.
Hypothesis Hdec : forall x y : R, 0 <= x <= y -> f y <= f x.

Lemma Riemann_integrable_f_n_Sn : forall (n : nat), Riemann_integrable f (INR n) (INR (S n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rser_RiemannInt_link_general_term_integrable : forall (n : nat), 
  Riemann_integrable (fun x => fct_cte (f (INR n)) x - f x) (INR n) (INR (S n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rser_RiemannInt_link_general_term_bound (n : nat) : 
  RiemannInt (Rser_RiemannInt_link_general_term_integrable n) <= f (INR n) - f (INR (S n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

(**  * Link between series and integral *)
Lemma Rser_RiemannInt_link : { l | Rser_cv (fun n => f (INR n) - RiemannInt (Riemann_integrable_f_n_Sn n) ) l}.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rser_RiemannInt_cv_pos_infty : 
    exists pr : forall (n : nat), Riemann_integrable f 0 (INR n), 
    Rseq_cv_pos_infty (fun n => RiemannInt (pr (S n))) ->
        (sum_f_R0 (fun n => f (INR n))) ~ (fun n => RiemannInt (pr (S n))).
Proof.
Admitted.

Section Applications.

Definition ln1 := comp ln (fun x => x+1).

Lemma Rint_inv1 : forall a b, 
  -1 < a <= b -> Rint (/(id + fct_cte 1))%F a b (ln (b + 1) - ln (a + 1)).
Proof.
Admitted.   
      
(** Equivalent of the harmonic series *)
Lemma harmonic_series_equiv : (sum_f_R0 (fun n => / (S n))) ~ (fun n => ln (S (S n))).
Proof.
Admitted.


End Applications.

(*  Title:    HOL/Analysis/Harmonic_Numbers.thy
    Author:   Manuel Eberl, TU München
*)

section \<open>Harmonic Numbers\<close>

theory Harmonic_Numbers
imports
  Complex_Transcendental
  Summation_Tests
begin

text \<open>
  The definition of the Harmonic Numbers and the Euler-Mascheroni constant.
  Also provides a reasonably accurate approximation of \<^term>\<open>ln 2 :: real\<close>
  and the Euler-Mascheroni constant.
\<close>

subsection \<open>The Harmonic numbers\<close>

definition\<^marker>\<open>tag important\<close> harm :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a :: real_normed_field" where
  "harm n = (\<Sum>k=1..n. inverse (of_nat k))"

lemma harm_altdef: "harm n = (\<Sum>k<n. inverse (of_nat (Suc k)))"
  by sorry

lemma harm_Suc: "harm (Suc n) = harm n + inverse (of_nat (Suc n))"
  by sorry

lemma harm_nonneg: "harm n \<ge> (0 :: 'a :: {real_normed_field,linordered_field})"
  by sorry

lemma harm_pos: "n > 0 \<Longrightarrow> harm n > (0 :: 'a :: {real_normed_field,linordered_field})"
  by sorry

lemma harm_mono: "m \<le> n \<Longrightarrow> harm m \<le> (harm n :: 'a :: {real_normed_field,linordered_field})"
  by sorry

lemma of_real_harm: "of_real (harm n) = harm n"
  by sorry

lemma abs_harm [simp]: "(abs (harm n) :: real) = harm n"
  by sorry

lemma norm_harm: "norm (harm n) = harm n"
  by sorry

lemma harm_expand:
  "harm 0 = 0"
  "harm (Suc 0) = 1"
  "harm (numeral n) = harm (pred_numeral n) + inverse (numeral n)"
  by sorry

theorem not_convergent_harm: "\<not>convergent (harm :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a :: real_normed_field)"
  by sorry

lemma harm_pos_iff [simp]: "harm n > (0 :: 'a :: {real_normed_field,linordered_field}) \<longleftrightarrow> n > 0"
  by sorry

lemma ln_diff_le_inverse:
  assumes "x \<ge> (1::real)"
  shows   "ln (x + 1) - ln x < 1 / x"
  by sorry

lemma ln_le_harm: "ln (real n + 1) \<le> (harm n :: real)"
  by sorry

lemma harm_at_top: "filterlim (harm :: nat \<Rightarrow> real) at_top sequentially"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>The Euler-Mascheroni constant\<close>

text \<open>
  The limit of the difference between the partial harmonic sum and the natural logarithm
  (approximately 0.577216). This value occurs e.g. in the definition of the Gamma function.
 \<close>
definition euler_mascheroni :: "'a :: real_normed_algebra_1" where
  "euler_mascheroni = of_real (lim (\<lambda>n. harm n - ln (of_nat n)))"

lemma of_real_euler_mascheroni [simp]: "of_real euler_mascheroni = euler_mascheroni"
  by sorry

lemma harm_ge_ln: "harm n \<ge> ln (real n + 1)"
  by sorry

lemma decseq_harm_diff_ln: "decseq (\<lambda>n. harm (Suc n) - ln (Suc n))"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_sequence_nonneg:
  assumes "n > 0"
  shows   "harm n - ln (real n) \<ge> (0 :: real)"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_convergent: "convergent (\<lambda>n. harm n - ln n)"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_sequence_decreasing:
  "m > 0 \<Longrightarrow> m \<le> n \<Longrightarrow> harm n - ln (of_nat n) \<le> harm m - ln (of_nat m :: real)"
  by sorry
  
lemma\<^marker>\<open>tag important\<close> euler_mascheroni_LIMSEQ:
  "(\<lambda>n. harm n - ln (of_nat n) :: real) \<longlonglongrightarrow> euler_mascheroni"
  by sorry

lemma harm_le: "n \<ge> 1 \<Longrightarrow> harm n \<le> ln n + 1"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_LIMSEQ_of_real:
  "(\<lambda>n. of_real (harm n - ln (of_nat n))) \<longlonglongrightarrow>
      (euler_mascheroni :: 'a :: {real_normed_algebra_1, topological_space})"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_sum_real:
  "(\<lambda>n. inverse (of_nat (n+1)) + ln (of_nat (n+1)) - ln (of_nat (n+2)) :: real)
       sums euler_mascheroni"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_sum:
  "(\<lambda>n. inverse (of_nat (n+1)) + of_real (ln (of_nat (n+1))) - of_real (ln (of_nat (n+2))))
       sums (euler_mascheroni :: 'a :: {banach, real_normed_field})"
  by sorry

theorem alternating_harmonic_series_sums: "(\<lambda>k. (-1)^k / real_of_nat (Suc k)) sums ln 2"
  by sorry

lemma alternating_harmonic_series_sums':
  "(\<lambda>k. inverse (real_of_nat (2*k+1)) - inverse (real_of_nat (2*k+2))) sums ln 2"
  by sorry


subsection\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> \<open>Bounds on the Euler-Mascheroni constant\<close>
(* TODO: perhaps move this section away to remove unnecessary dependency on integration *)

(* TODO: Move? *)
lemma ln_inverse_approx_le:
  assumes "(x::real) > 0" "a > 0"
  shows   "ln (x + a) - ln x \<le> a * (inverse x + inverse (x + a))/2" (is "_ \<le> ?A")
  by sorry

lemma ln_inverse_approx_ge:
  assumes "(x::real) > 0" "x < y"
  shows   "ln y - ln x \<ge> 2 * (y - x) / (x + y)" (is "_ \<ge> ?A")
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_lower:
          "euler_mascheroni \<ge> harm (Suc n) - ln (real_of_nat (n + 2)) + 1/real_of_nat (2 * (n + 2))"
    and euler_mascheroni_upper:
          "euler_mascheroni \<le> harm (Suc n) - ln (real_of_nat (n + 2)) + 1/real_of_nat (2 * (n + 1))"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_pos: "euler_mascheroni > (0::real)"
  by sorry

context
begin

private lemma ln_approx_aux:
  fixes n :: nat and x :: real
  defines "y \<equiv> (x-1)/(x+1)"
  assumes x: "x > 0" "x \<noteq> 1"
  shows "inverse (2*y^(2*n+1)) * (ln x - (\<Sum>k<n. 2*y^(2*k+1) / of_nat (2*k+1))) \<in>
            {0..(1 / (1 - y^2) / of_nat (2*n+1))}"
proof -
  from x have norm_y: "norm y < 1" unfolding y_def by simp
  from power_strict_mono[OF this, of 2] have norm_y': "norm y^2 < 1" by simp

  let ?f = "\<lambda>k. 2 * y ^ (2*k+1) / of_nat (2*k+1)"
  note sums = ln_series_quadratic[OF x(1)]
  define c where "c = inverse (2*y^(2*n+1))"
  let ?d = "c * (ln x - (\<Sum>k<n. ?f k))"
  have "\<And>k. y\<^sup>2^k / of_nat (2*(k+n)+1) \<le> y\<^sup>2 ^ k / of_nat (2*n+1)"
    by (intro divide_left_mono mult_right_mono mult_pos_pos zero_le_power[of "y^2"]) simp_all
  moreover {
    have "(\<lambda>k. ?f (k + n)) sums (ln x - (\<Sum>k<n. ?f k))"
      using sums_split_initial_segment[OF sums] by (simp add: y_def)
    hence "(\<lambda>k. c * ?f (k + n)) sums ?d" by (rule sums_mult)
    also have "(\<lambda>k. c * (2*y^(2*(k+n)+1) / of_nat (2*(k+n)+1))) =
                   (\<lambda>k. (c * (2*y^(2*n+1))) * ((y^2)^k / of_nat (2*(k+n)+1)))"
      by (simp only: ring_distribs power_add power_mult) (simp add: mult_ac)
    also from x have "c * (2*y^(2*n+1)) = 1" by (simp add: c_def y_def)
    finally have "(\<lambda>k. (y^2)^k / of_nat (2*(k+n)+1)) sums ?d" by simp
  } note sums' = this
  moreover from norm_y' have "(\<lambda>k. (y^2)^k / of_nat (2*n+1)) sums (1 / (1 - y^2) / of_nat (2*n+1))"
    by (intro sums_divide geometric_sums) (simp_all add: norm_power)
  ultimately have "?d \<le> (1 / (1 - y^2) / of_nat (2*n+1))" by (rule sums_le)
  moreover have "c * (ln x - (\<Sum>k<n. 2 * y ^ (2 * k + 1) / real_of_nat (2 * k + 1))) \<ge> 0"
    by (intro sums_le[OF _ sums_zero sums']) simp_all
  ultimately show ?thesis unfolding c_def by simp
qed

lemma
  fixes n :: nat and x :: real
  defines "y \<equiv> (x-1)/(x+1)"
  defines "approx \<equiv> (\<Sum>k<n. 2*y^(2*k+1) / of_nat (2*k+1))"
  defines "d \<equiv> y^(2*n+1) / (1 - y^2) / of_nat (2*n+1)"
  assumes x: "x > 1"
  shows   ln_approx_bounds: "ln x \<in> {approx..approx + 2*d}"
  and     ln_approx_abs:    "abs (ln x - (approx + d)) \<le> d"
  by sorry

end

lemma euler_mascheroni_bounds:
  fixes n :: nat assumes "n \<ge> 1" defines "t \<equiv> harm n - ln (of_nat (Suc n)) :: real"
  shows "euler_mascheroni \<in> {t + inverse (of_nat (2*(n+1)))..t + inverse (of_nat (2*n))}"
  by sorry

lemma euler_mascheroni_bounds':
  fixes n :: nat assumes "n \<ge> 1" "ln (real_of_nat (Suc n)) \<in> {l<..<u}"
  shows "euler_mascheroni \<in>
           {harm n - u + inverse (of_nat (2*(n+1)))<..<harm n - l + inverse (of_nat (2*n))}"
  by sorry


text \<open>
  Approximation of \<^term>\<open>ln 2\<close>. The lower bound is accurate to about 0.03; the upper
  bound is accurate to about 0.0015.
\<close>
lemma ln2_ge_two_thirds: "2/3 \<le> ln (2::real)"
  and ln2_le_25_over_36: "ln (2::real) \<le> 25/36"
  by sorry


text \<open>
  Approximation of the Euler-Mascheroni constant. The lower bound is accurate to about 0.0015;
  the upper bound is accurate to about 0.015.
\<close>
lemma euler_mascheroni_gt_19_over_33: "(euler_mascheroni :: real) > 19/33" (is ?th1)
  and euler_mascheroni_less_13_over_22: "(euler_mascheroni :: real) < 13/22" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__034, "Divergence of the Harmonic Series": the
;; positive-integer reciprocal partial sums 1 + 1/2 + ... + 1/n grow without
;; bound. Exact rational partial sums encode the real claim. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-prefix (terms)
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (+ (hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-prefix (- terms 1))
       (/ 1 terms))))

;; Quantifier order for the final predicate:
;;   for every rational bound, there exists a natural cutoff; every natural
;;   term count at least that cutoff has a harmonic prefix at least the bound.
(defun-sk hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-tail-above-bound-p
    (bound cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (<= bound
         (hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-prefix terms)))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-cutoff-exists-p (bound)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-tail-above-bound-p
      bound cutoff))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-034-divergence-of-the-harmonic-series-statement ()
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (rationalp bound)
     (hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-cutoff-exists-p bound))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 034_divergence_of_the_harmonic_series
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Divergence of the Harmonic Series" from Hundred Theorems
-- item 034. This file contains no proof.

-- Hundred Theorems item 034, "Divergence of the Harmonic Series": the harmonic
-- partial sums sum_{k=1}^n 1/k eventually exceed every bound. This is a
-- statement-only formalization and contains no proof.

module DivergenceOfHarmonicSeries where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record ArchimedeanOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

open ArchimedeanOrderedField

harmonicPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  ArchimedeanOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
harmonicPartialSum reals zero =
  zeroR reals
harmonicPartialSum reals (suc n) =
  add reals
    (harmonicPartialSum reals n)
    (inverse reals (fromNat reals (suc n)))

GrowsWithoutBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  ArchimedeanOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
GrowsWithoutBound {R} reals sequence =
  (bound : R) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessOrEqual reals bound (sequence n))

divergence-of-the-harmonic-series : Set1
divergence-of-the-harmonic-series =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : ArchimedeanOrderedField R) ->
  GrowsWithoutBound reals (harmonicPartialSum reals)

$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Divergence of the Harmonic Series" from Hundred Theorems
  item 034: the real harmonic partial sums tend to positive infinity. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  Every mathematical symbol below is grounded in the imported set.mm database.
  RR and NN0 are the standard real and nonnegative-integer classes; <_ is
  non-strict order, / is real division on these arguments, and sum_ is
  set.mm's finite-sum binder.

  For n in NN0,

    sum_ k e. ( 1 ... n ) ( 1 / k )

  is the sum from k = 1 through n. It is identical, by successor reindexing,
  to the n-term partial sum over i = 0, ..., n - 1 of 1 / (i + 1) used by the
  Lean and Agda sources. The assertion says that for every real bound b there
  is a natural threshold m after which every harmonic partial sum is at least
  b. This is the restricted-quantifier expansion of convergence to positive
  infinity and is equivalent here to divergence of the harmonic series.

  The final declaration is an unproved $a statement.
$)

hundred-theorems-034-harmonic-series-diverges $a
  |- A. b e. RR
       E. m e. NN0
         A. n e. NN0
           ( m <_ n ->
             b <_ ( sum_ k e. ( 1 ... n ) ( 1 / k ) ) )
$.

title: 034_divergence_of_the_harmonic_series
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Divergence of the Harmonic Series" from Hundred Theorems item
% 034. This file contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 034, "Divergence of the Harmonic Series": the real harmonic
% partial sums eventually lie above every real bound. This statement-only formalization
% contains no proof.

divergence_of_the_harmonic_series_034: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  harmonic_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      harmonic_partial_sum(count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, count :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  divergence_of_the_harmonic_series: bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            bound <= harmonic_partial_sum(count)
END divergence_of_the_harmonic_series_034

title: 035_taylor_s_theorem
content:
/-
Copyright (c) 2022 Moritz Doll. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Moritz Doll
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Module.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Operations
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Pow
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.IteratedDeriv.Defs
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.AbsolutelyContinuousFun
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.IntegrationByParts

/-!
# Taylor's theorem

This file defines the Taylor polynomial of a real function `f : ℝ → E`,
where `E` is a normed vector space over `ℝ` and proves Taylor's theorem,
which states that if `f` is sufficiently smooth, then
`f` can be approximated by the Taylor polynomial up to an explicit error term.

## Main definitions

* `taylorCoeffWithin`: the Taylor coefficient using `iteratedDerivWithin`
* `taylorWithin`: the Taylor polynomial using `iteratedDerivWithin`

## Main statements

* `taylor_tendsto`: Taylor's theorem as a limit
* `taylor_isLittleO`: Taylor's theorem using little-o notation
* `taylor_mean_remainder`: Taylor's theorem with the general form of the remainder term
* `taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange`: Taylor's theorem with the Lagrange remainder
* `taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy`: Taylor's theorem with the Cauchy remainder
* `exists_taylor_mean_remainder_bound`: Taylor's theorem for vector-valued functions with a
  polynomial bound on the remainder
* `taylor_integral_remainder_of_absolutelyContinuous`,
  `taylor_integral_remainder`: Taylor's theorem with the integral form of the
  remainder

## TODO

* Generalization to higher dimensions

## Tags

Taylor polynomial, Taylor's theorem
-/

@[expose] public section


open scoped Interval Topology Nat

open Set

variable {𝕜 E F : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- The `k`th coefficient of the Taylor polynomial. -/
noncomputable def taylorCoeffWithin (f : ℝ → E) (k : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : E :=
  (k ! : ℝ)⁻¹ • iteratedDerivWithin k f s x₀

/-- The Taylor polynomial with derivatives inside of a set `s`.

The Taylor polynomial is given by
$$∑_{k=0}^n \frac{(x - x₀)^k}{k!} f^{(k)}(x₀),$$
where $f^{(k)}(x₀)$ denotes the iterated derivative in the set `s`. -/
noncomputable def taylorWithin (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : PolynomialModule ℝ E :=
  (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum fun k =>
    PolynomialModule.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x₀)
      (PolynomialModule.single ℝ k (taylorCoeffWithin f k s x₀))

/-- The Taylor polynomial with derivatives inside of a set `s` considered as a function `ℝ → E` -/
noncomputable def taylorWithinEval (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ x : ℝ) : E :=
  PolynomialModule.eval x (taylorWithin f n s x₀)

theorem taylorWithin_succ (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    taylorWithin f (n + 1) s x₀ = taylorWithin f n s x₀ +
      PolynomialModule.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x₀)
      (PolynomialModule.single ℝ (n + 1) (taylorCoeffWithin f (n + 1) s x₀)) := by sorry
theorem taylorWithinEval_succ (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ x : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval f (n + 1) s x₀ x = taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x +
      (((n + 1 : ℝ) * n !)⁻¹ * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1)) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f s x₀ := by sorry
theorem taylor_within_zero_eval (f : ℝ → E) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ x : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval f 0 s x₀ x = f x₀ := by sorry
theorem taylorWithinEval_self (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x₀ = f x₀ := by sorry
theorem taylor_within_apply (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ x : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - x₀) ^ k) • iteratedDerivWithin k f s x₀ := by sorry
theorem continuousOn_taylorWithinEval {f : ℝ → E} {x : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : UniqueDiffOn ℝ s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f s) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => taylorWithinEval f n s t x) s := by sorry
theorem monomial_has_deriv_aux (t x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => (x - y) ^ (n + 1)) (-(n + 1) * (x - t) ^ n) t := by sorry
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_taylor_coeff_within {f : ℝ → E} {x y : ℝ} {k : ℕ} {s t : Set ℝ}
    (ht : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ t y) (hs : s ∈ 𝓝[t] y)
    (hf : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin (k + 1) f s) s y) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun z => (((k + 1 : ℝ) * k !)⁻¹ * (x - z) ^ (k + 1)) • iteratedDerivWithin (k + 1) f s z)
      ((((k + 1 : ℝ) * k !)⁻¹ * (x - y) ^ (k + 1)) • iteratedDerivWithin (k + 2) f s y -
        ((k ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - y) ^ k) • iteratedDerivWithin (k + 1) f s y) t y := by sorry
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_taylorWithinEval {f : ℝ → E} {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {s s' : Set ℝ}
    (hs_unique : UniqueDiffOn ℝ s) (hs' : s' ∈ 𝓝[s] y)
    (hy : y ∈ s') (h : s' ⊆ s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f s)
    (hf' : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f s) s y) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun t => taylorWithinEval f n s t x)
      (((n ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - y) ^ n) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f s y) s' y := by sorry
theorem taylorWithinEval_hasDerivAt_Ioo {f : ℝ → E} {a b t : ℝ} (x : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hx : a < b)
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Icc a b)) (Ioo a b)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => taylorWithinEval f n (Icc a b) y x)
      (((n ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - t) ^ n) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Icc a b) t) t :=
  have h_nhds : Ioo a b ∈ 𝓝 t := isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht
  have h_nhds' : Ioo a b ∈ 𝓝[Icc a b] t := nhdsWithin_le_nhds h_nhds
  (hasDerivWithinAt_taylorWithinEval (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hx) h_nhds' ht
    Ioo_subset_Icc_self hf <| (hf' t ht).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin h_nhds').hasDerivAt h_nhds

/-- Calculate the derivative of the Taylor polynomial with respect to `x₀`.

Version for closed intervals -/
theorem hasDerivWithinAt_taylorWithinEval_at_Icc {f : ℝ → E} {a b t : ℝ} (x : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hx : a < b) (ht : t ∈ Icc a b) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Icc a b))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Icc a b)) (Icc a b)) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => taylorWithinEval f n (Icc a b) y x)
      (((n ! : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - t) ^ n) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Icc a b) t) (Icc a b) t :=
  hasDerivWithinAt_taylorWithinEval (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hx)
    self_mem_nhdsWithin ht rfl.subset hf (hf' t ht)

/-- Calculate the derivative of the Taylor polynomial with respect to `x`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_taylorWithinEval_succ {x₀ x : ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (taylorWithinEval f (n + 1) s x₀)
      (taylorWithinEval (derivWithin f s) n s x₀ x) x := by sorry
theorem taylor_isLittleO {f : ℝ → E} {x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hx₀s : x₀ ∈ s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f s) :
    (fun x ↦ f x - taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x) =o[𝓝[s] x₀] fun x ↦ (x - x₀) ^ n := by sorry
theorem taylor_isLittleO_univ {f : ℝ → E} {x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f) :
    (fun x ↦ f x - taylorWithinEval f n univ x₀ x) =o[𝓝 x₀] fun x ↦ (x - x₀) ^ n := by sorry
theorem taylor_tendsto {f : ℝ → E} {x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hx₀s : x₀ ∈ s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x ↦ ((x - x₀) ^ n)⁻¹ • (f x - taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x))
      (𝓝[s] x₀) (𝓝 0) := by sorry
theorem Real.taylor_tendsto {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hx₀s : x₀ ∈ s) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x ↦ (f x - taylorWithinEval f n s x₀ x) / (x - x₀) ^ n)
      (𝓝[s] x₀) (𝓝 0) := by sorry
theorem taylor_mean_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (uIcc x₀ x)) (uIoo x₀ x))
    (gcont : ContinuousOn g (uIcc x₀ x))
    (gdiff : ∀ x_1 : ℝ, x_1 ∈ uIoo x₀ x → HasDerivAt g (g' x_1) x_1)
    (g'_ne : ∀ x_1 : ℝ, x_1 ∈ uIoo x₀ x → g' x_1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x' ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x = ((x - x') ^ n / n ! *
      (g x - g x₀) / g' x') • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) x' := by sorry
theorem taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (uIcc x₀ x)) (uIoo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)! := by sorry
lemma taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)! := by sorry
theorem taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (uIcc x₀ x)) (uIoo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) x' * (x - x') ^ n / n ! * (x - x₀) := by sorry
theorem taylor_mean_remainder_bound {f : ℝ → E} {a b C x : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (Icc a b)) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b)
    (hC : ∀ y ∈ Icc a b, ‖iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Icc a b) y‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Icc a b) a x‖ ≤ C * (x - a) ^ (n + 1) / n ! := by sorry
theorem exists_taylor_mean_remainder_bound {f : ℝ → E} {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (Icc a b)) :
    ∃ C, ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ‖f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Icc a b) a x‖ ≤ C * (x - a) ^ (n + 1) := by sorry
theorem taylor_integral_remainder_aux [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {f : ℝ → F} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ k ≤ n, let u := fun t ↦ (x - t) ^ k / k !;
      let v := fun t ↦ iteratedDerivWithin k f [[x₀, x]] t;
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in x₀..x, u t • deriv v t = u x • v x - u x₀ • v x₀ -
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in x₀..x, deriv u t • v t) :
    f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      ∫ t in x₀..x, ((x - t) ^ n / n !) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) t  := by sorry
theorem taylor_integral_remainder_of_absolutelyContinuous {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hf₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf₂ : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (iteratedDerivWithin n f (uIcc x₀ x)) x₀ x) :
    f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      ∫ t in x₀..x, ((x - t) ^ n / n !) * iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) t := by sorry
theorem taylor_integral_remainder [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [CompleteSpace F] {f : ℝ → F} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1 : ℕ) f (uIcc x₀ x)) :
    f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      ∫ t in x₀..x, ((x - t) ^ n / n !) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x) t := by sorry

content:

Require Export CoRN.ftc.TaylorLemma.

Opaque Min Max N_Deriv.

Section More_Taylor_Defs.

(**
** General case

The generalization to arbitrary intervals just needs a few more definitions.

%\begin{convention}% Let [I] be a proper interval, [F:PartIR] and
[a,b:IR] be points of [I].
%\end{convention}%
*)

Variable I : interval.
Hypothesis pI : proper I.

Variable F : PartIR.

(* begin show *)
Let deriv_Sn b n Hf :=
 N_Deriv _ pI (S n) F Hf{*} [-C-] ([1][/] _[//]nring_fac_ap_zero _ n) {*} ( [-C-]b{-}FId) {^}n.
(* end show *)

Variables a b : IR.
Hypothesis Ha : I a.
Hypothesis Hb : I b.

(* begin show *)
Let fi n Hf i Hi :=
  N_Deriv _ pI _ _ (le_imp_Diffble_n _ _ _ _ (proj1 (Nat.lt_succ_r i n) Hi) F Hf).

Let funct_i n Hf i Hi :=
  [-C-] (fi n Hf i Hi a Ha[/] _[//]nring_fac_ap_zero _ i) {*} (FId{-} [-C-]a) {^}i.
(* end show *)

Definition Taylor_Seq' n Hf := FSumx _ (funct_i n Hf).

(* begin hide *)
Lemma TaylorB : forall n Hf, Dom (Taylor_Seq' n Hf) b.
Proof.
Admitted.
(* end hide *)

Definition Taylor_Rem n Hf := F b (Diffble_n_imp_inc _ _ _ _ Hf b Hb) [-]
 Taylor_Seq' n Hf b (TaylorB n Hf).

(* begin hide *)
Lemma Taylor_Sumx_lemma : forall n x z y y', (forall H, y 0 H [=] z) ->
  (forall i H H', y' i H' [=] y (S i) H) ->
  x[-]Sumx (G:=IR) (n:=S n) y [=] x[-]z[-]Sumx (G:=IR) (n:=n) y'.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Taylor_lemma_ap : forall n Hf Hf' Ha',
 Taylor_Rem n Hf'[-]deriv_Sn b n Hf a Ha'[*] (b[-]a) [#] [0] -> a [#] b.
Proof.
Admitted.
(* end hide *)

Theorem Taylor' : forall n Hf Hf' e, [0] [<] e -> {c : IR | Compact (Min_leEq_Max a b) c |
 forall Hc, AbsIR (Taylor_Rem n Hf'[-]deriv_Sn b n Hf c Hc[*] (b[-]a)) [<=] e}.
Proof.
Admitted.

End More_Taylor_Defs.

Section Taylor_Theorem.

(**
And finally the ``nice'' version, when we know the expression of the
derivatives of [F].

%\begin{convention}% Let [f] be the sequence of derivatives of [F] of
order up to [n] and [F'] be the nth-derivative of [F].
%\end{convention}%
*)

Variable I : interval.
Hypothesis pI : proper I.

Variable F : PartIR.

Variable n : nat.
Variable f : forall i : nat, i < S n -> PartIR.

Hypothesis goodF : ext_fun_seq f.
Hypothesis goodF' : ext_fun_seq' f.

Hypothesis derF : forall i Hi, Derivative_n i I pI F (f i Hi).

Variable F' : PartIR.
Hypothesis derF' : Derivative_n (S n) I pI F F'.

Variables a b : IR.
Hypothesis Ha : I a.
Hypothesis Hb : I b.


(* begin show *)
Let funct_i i Hi := let HX := (Derivative_n_imp_inc' _ _ _ _ _ (derF i Hi) a Ha) in
[-C-] (f i Hi a HX [/] _[//] nring_fac_ap_zero _ i) {*} (FId{-} [-C-]a) {^}i.

Definition Taylor_Seq := FSumx _ funct_i.

Let deriv_Sn := F'{*} [-C-] ([1][/] _[//]nring_fac_ap_zero _ n) {*} ( [-C-]b{-}FId) {^}n.
(* end show *)

Lemma Taylor_aux : Dom Taylor_Seq b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Taylor : forall e, [0] [<] e -> forall Hb', {c : IR | Compact (Min_leEq_Max a b) c |
 forall Hc, AbsIR (F b Hb'[-]Part _ _ Taylor_aux[-]deriv_Sn c Hc[*] (b[-]a)) [<=] e}.
Proof.
Admitted.

End Taylor_Theorem.

title: 035_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Taylor's theorem from Hundred Theorems
  item 035. The remainder is in Lagrange form at a point strictly between the
  expansion point and the evaluation point. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Taylor_Theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem hundred_theorems_taylor:
  fixes c x :: real and n :: nat
  assumes init: "n > 0" "diff 0 = f"
    and derivatives:
      "\<forall>m t. m < n \<and> min c x \<le> t \<and> t \<le> max c x
        \<longrightarrow> DERIV (diff m) t :> diff (Suc m) t"
    and distinct: "x \<noteq> c"
  shows "\<exists>t.
    (if x < c then x < t \<and> t < c else c < t \<and> t < x) \<and>
    f x = (\<Sum>m<n. (diff m c / fact m) * (x - c)^m)
      + (diff n t / fact n) * (x - c)^n"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 035,
;; "Taylor's Theorem": the Lagrange-remainder formula for a real-valued
;; function continuously differentiable through order n on the unordered
;; closed interval between two distinct points and differentiable once more
;; on its interior.
;; This file contains no proof.
;;
;; Semantic status: the direct DEFUN-SK formulation below repairs the former
;; vacuous APPLY$ quantifiers, but standard ACL2 still ranges only over tame
;; coded functions and subsets. It therefore does not preserve the source's
;; unrestricted real-function quantification and is not counted as a faithful
;; translation.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ objects represent the real carrier, its operations, every
;; subset used by completeness, the arbitrary source function, and its
;; derivative family. All quantifiers remain direct DEFUN-SK quantifiers, so
;; no finite table or opaque set/function tag replaces an extensional object.

(defun ht035-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht035-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun ht035-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; A scalar context consists of a carrier predicate, zero, one, addition,
;; multiplication, negation, inversion, and strict order.

(defun ht035-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun ht035-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun ht035-real-p (ctx value)
  (ht035-member-p (ht035-r-carrier ctx) value))

(defun ht035-zero (ctx)
  (ht035-r-zero ctx))

(defun ht035-one (ctx)
  (ht035-r-one ctx))

(defun ht035-add (ctx left right)
  (ht035-binary-value
   (ht035-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun ht035-multiply (ctx left right)
  (ht035-binary-value
   (ht035-r-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun ht035-negate (ctx value)
  (ht035-unary-value
   (ht035-r-negate ctx) value))

(defun ht035-inverse (ctx value)
  (ht035-unary-value
   (ht035-r-inverse ctx) value))

(defun ht035-less (ctx left right)
  (if
      (ht035-binary-value
       (ht035-r-less ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun ht035-set-member-p (ctx set value)
  (declare (ignore ctx))
  (ht035-member-p set value))

(defun ht035-function-value (function point)
  (ht035-unary-value function point))

(defun ht035-derivative-value
    (derivatives derivative-order point)
  (ht035-binary-value
   derivatives derivative-order point))

(defun ht035-subtract (ctx left right)
  (ht035-add ctx left (ht035-negate ctx right)))

(defun ht035-divide (ctx numerator denominator)
  (ht035-multiply
   ctx numerator (ht035-inverse ctx denominator)))

(defun ht035-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (ht035-less ctx right left)))

(defun ht035-absolute-value (ctx value)
  (if (ht035-less ctx value (ht035-zero ctx))
      (ht035-negate ctx value)
    value))

(defun ht035-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (ht035-real-p ctx value)
   (ht035-less ctx (ht035-zero ctx) value)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk ht035-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-real-p ctx a)
      (ht035-real-p ctx b)
      (ht035-real-p ctx c))
     (let* ((ab-add (ht035-add ctx a b))
            (bc-add (ht035-add ctx b c))
            (ab-mul (ht035-multiply ctx a b))
            (bc-mul (ht035-multiply ctx b c))
            (neg-a (ht035-negate ctx a))
            (inv-a (ht035-inverse ctx a))
            (zero (ht035-zero ctx))
            (one (ht035-one ctx)))
       (and
        (ht035-real-p ctx ab-add)
        (ht035-real-p ctx ab-mul)
        (ht035-real-p ctx neg-a)
        (ht035-real-p ctx inv-a)
        (equal
         (ht035-add ctx ab-add c)
         (ht035-add ctx a bc-add))
        (equal ab-add (ht035-add ctx b a))
        (equal (ht035-add ctx a zero) a)
        (equal (ht035-add ctx a neg-a) zero)
        (equal
         (ht035-multiply ctx ab-mul c)
         (ht035-multiply ctx a bc-mul))
        (equal ab-mul (ht035-multiply ctx b a))
        (equal (ht035-multiply ctx a one) a)
        (implies
         (equal a zero)
         (equal inv-a zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal a zero))
         (equal (ht035-multiply ctx a inv-a) one))
        (equal
         (ht035-multiply ctx a bc-add)
         (ht035-add
          ctx
          (ht035-multiply ctx a b)
          (ht035-multiply ctx a c))))))))

(defun-sk ht035-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-real-p ctx a)
      (ht035-real-p ctx b)
      (ht035-real-p ctx c))
     (and
      (not (ht035-less ctx a a))
      (or
       (ht035-less ctx a b)
       (equal a b)
       (ht035-less ctx b a))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht035-less ctx a b)
        (ht035-less ctx b c))
       (ht035-less ctx a c))
      (implies
       (ht035-less ctx a b)
       (ht035-less
        ctx
        (ht035-add ctx a c)
        (ht035-add ctx b c)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht035-less ctx (ht035-zero ctx) a)
        (ht035-less ctx (ht035-zero ctx) b))
       (ht035-less
        ctx
        (ht035-zero ctx)
        (ht035-multiply ctx a b)))))))

(defun-sk ht035-valid-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (ht035-set-member-p ctx set value)
     (ht035-real-p ctx value))))

(defun ht035-extensional-set-p (ctx set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht035-valid-set-p ctx set)))

(defun-sk ht035-set-nonempty-p (ctx set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (ht035-real-p ctx value)
     (ht035-set-member-p ctx set value))))

(defun-sk ht035-upper-bound-p (ctx set upper)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-real-p ctx value)
      (ht035-set-member-p ctx set value))
     (not (ht035-less ctx upper value)))))

(defun-sk ht035-bounded-above-p (ctx set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (ht035-real-p ctx upper)
     (ht035-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))))

(defun-sk ht035-least-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-real-p ctx upper)
      (ht035-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))
     (not (ht035-less ctx upper supremum)))))

(defun ht035-is-supremum-p (ctx set supremum)
  (and
   (ht035-real-p ctx supremum)
   (ht035-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)
   (ht035-least-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht035-has-supremum-p (ctx set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (ht035-is-supremum-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht035-completeness-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-extensional-set-p ctx set)
      (ht035-set-nonempty-p ctx set)
      (ht035-bounded-above-p ctx set))
     (ht035-has-supremum-p ctx set))))

(defun ht035-real-field-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-multiply ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-negate ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-inverse ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht035-r-less ctx))
   (ht035-real-p ctx (ht035-zero ctx))
   (ht035-real-p ctx (ht035-one ctx))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht035-zero ctx)
     (ht035-one ctx)))
   (ht035-field-laws-p ctx)
   (ht035-order-laws-p ctx)
   (ht035-completeness-p ctx)
   (ht035-less
    ctx (ht035-zero ctx) (ht035-one ctx))))

;; Natural numbers embedded in the abstract real field.

(defun ht035-real-natural (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (ht035-zero ctx)
    (ht035-add
     ctx
     (ht035-one ctx)
     (ht035-real-natural ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun ht035-power (ctx base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (ht035-one ctx)
    (ht035-multiply
     ctx
     base
     (ht035-power ctx base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun ht035-factorial (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (ht035-one ctx)
    (ht035-multiply
     ctx
     (ht035-real-natural ctx n)
     (ht035-factorial ctx (- n 1)))))

;; The unordered intervals uIcc x0 x and uIoo x0 x.

(defun ht035-in-closed-interval-p
    (ctx x0 x point)
  (and
   (ht035-real-p ctx point)
   (or
    (and
     (not (ht035-less ctx point x0))
     (not (ht035-less ctx x point)))
    (and
     (not (ht035-less ctx point x))
     (not (ht035-less ctx x0 point))))))

(defun ht035-in-open-interval-p
    (ctx x0 x point)
  (and
   (ht035-real-p ctx point)
   (or
    (and
     (ht035-less ctx x0 point)
     (ht035-less ctx point x))
    (and
     (ht035-less ctx x point)
     (ht035-less ctx point x0)))))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and explicitly tied iterated derivatives.

(defun-sk ht035-real-function-p (ctx function)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-real-p ctx point)
     (ht035-real-p
      ctx (ht035-function-value function point)))))

(defun ht035-extensional-real-function-p
    (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht035-real-function-p ctx function)))

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-order-real-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-real-p ctx point)
     (ht035-real-p
      ctx
      (ht035-derivative-value
       derivatives derivative-order point)))))

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-family-p
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (<= derivative-order maximum-order))
     (ht035-derivative-order-real-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order))))

(defun ht035-extensional-derivative-family-p
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivatives)
   (ht035-derivative-family-p
    ctx derivatives maximum-order)))

(defun-sk ht035-order-zero-is-function-p
    (ctx function derivatives)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-real-p ctx point)
     (equal
      (ht035-derivative-value derivatives 0 point)
      (ht035-function-value function point)))))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity of a derivative row on the closed interval.

(defun-sk ht035-continuity-radius-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point epsilon radius)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-in-closed-interval-p
       ctx x0 x nearby)
      (ht035-less
       ctx
       (ht035-absolute-value
        ctx (ht035-subtract ctx nearby point))
       radius))
     (ht035-less
      ctx
      (ht035-absolute-value
       ctx
       (ht035-subtract
        ctx
        (ht035-derivative-value
         derivatives derivative-order nearby)
        (ht035-derivative-value
         derivatives derivative-order point)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht035-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (ht035-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (ht035-continuity-radius-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order
      x0 x point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk ht035-continuous-within-at-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht035-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (ht035-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order
      x0 x point epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht035-continuous-on-closed-interval-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-in-closed-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (ht035-continuous-within-at-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point))))

;; HasDerivWithinAt in epsilon-delta form, restricted to Icc x0 x.

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-radius-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point epsilon radius)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-in-closed-interval-p
       ctx x0 x nearby)
      (ht035-less
       ctx
       (ht035-absolute-value
        ctx (ht035-subtract ctx nearby point))
       radius))
     (ht035-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (ht035-absolute-value
       ctx
       (ht035-subtract
        ctx
        (ht035-subtract
         ctx
         (ht035-derivative-value
          derivatives derivative-order nearby)
         (ht035-derivative-value
          derivatives derivative-order point))
        (ht035-multiply
         ctx
         derivative
         (ht035-subtract ctx nearby point))))
      (ht035-multiply
       ctx
       epsilon
       (ht035-absolute-value
        ctx (ht035-subtract ctx nearby point)))))))

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (ht035-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (ht035-derivative-radius-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
      x0 x point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk ht035-has-derivative-within-at-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht035-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (ht035-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
      x0 x point epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht035-contdiff-orders-continuous-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (<= derivative-order order))
     (ht035-continuous-on-closed-interval-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x))))

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-chain-at-index-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-in-closed-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (ht035-has-derivative-within-at-p
      ctx
      derivatives
      derivative-order
      (ht035-derivative-value
       derivatives (+ 1 derivative-order) point)
      x0 x point))))

(defun-sk ht035-derivative-chain-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (< derivative-order order))
     (ht035-derivative-chain-at-index-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x))))

(defun ht035-contdiff-through-p
    (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
  (and
   (ht035-order-zero-is-function-p
    ctx function derivatives)
   (ht035-contdiff-orders-continuous-p
    ctx derivatives order x0 x)
   (ht035-derivative-chain-p
    ctx derivatives order x0 x)))

(defun-sk ht035-next-derivative-on-interior-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht035-in-open-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (ht035-has-derivative-within-at-p
      ctx
      derivatives
      order
      (ht035-derivative-value
       derivatives (+ 1 order) point)
      x0 x point))))

;; The finite Taylor polynomial sum from k = 0 through k = ORDER.

(defun ht035-taylor-sum
    (ctx derivatives terms x0 x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (ht035-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (delta (ht035-subtract ctx x x0))
           (coefficient
            (ht035-divide
             ctx
             (ht035-derivative-value
              derivatives index x0)
             (ht035-factorial ctx index)))
           (term
            (ht035-multiply
             ctx
             coefficient
             (ht035-power ctx delta index))))
      (ht035-add
       ctx
       (ht035-taylor-sum
        ctx derivatives index x0 x)
       term))))

;; Internal existential witness for the source's Lagrange remainder.

(defun-sk ht035-lagrange-remainder-p
    (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
  (exists (witness)
    (let* ((next-order (+ 1 order))
           (delta (ht035-subtract ctx x x0))
           (left-side
            (ht035-subtract
             ctx
             (ht035-function-value function x)
             (ht035-taylor-sum
              ctx derivatives next-order x0 x)))
           (right-side
            (ht035-divide
             ctx
             (ht035-multiply
              ctx
              (ht035-derivative-value
               derivatives next-order witness)
              (ht035-power ctx delta next-order))
             (ht035-factorial ctx next-order))))
      (and
       (ht035-in-open-interval-p
        ctx x0 x witness)
       (equal left-side right-side)))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-035-taylors-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht035-real-field-p ctx)
      (natp order)
      (ht035-real-p ctx x0)
      (ht035-real-p ctx x)
      (not (equal x0 x))
      (ht035-extensional-real-function-p
       ctx function)
      (ht035-extensional-derivative-family-p
       ctx derivatives (+ 1 order))
      (ht035-contdiff-through-p
       ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
      (ht035-next-derivative-on-interior-p
       ctx derivatives order x0 x))
     (ht035-lagrange-remainder-p
      ctx function derivatives order x0 x))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 035_taylor_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of corpus artifact hundred-theorems__agda__035,
-- "Taylor's Theorem": a real function with a continuous derivative hierarchy is
-- its Taylor polynomial plus a Lagrange remainder at an intermediate point.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x)
    (StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius))

ContinuousWithin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithin {R} reals f domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          CloseTo reals (f point) epsilon (f y)))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals f x y =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (f y) (f x))
    (subtract reals y x)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals f x derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          CloseTo reals x delta y ->
          y != x ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals f x y)))

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals a b x =
  Either
    (Both
      (lessOrEqual reals a x)
      (lessOrEqual reals x b))
    (Both
      (lessOrEqual reals b x)
      (lessOrEqual reals x a))

StrictlyBetween :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictlyBetween reals a b x =
  Either
    (Both
      (StrictLess reals a x)
      (StrictLess reals x b))
    (Both
      (StrictLess reals b x)
      (StrictLess reals x a))

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (power reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

taylorTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
taylorTerm reals derivatives center x n =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals
      (derivatives n center)
      (fromNat reals (factorial n)))
    (power reals (subtract reals x center) n)

taylorPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
taylorPolynomial reals derivatives center x n =
  sumFirst reals
    (taylorTerm reals derivatives center x)
    n

taylorRemainder :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
taylorRemainder reals derivatives center x n intermediate =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals
      (derivatives n intermediate)
      (fromNat reals (factorial n)))
    (power reals (subtract reals x center) n)

taylor-theorem : Set1
taylor-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  (derivatives : Nat -> R -> R) ->
  (center x : R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  zero <N n ->
  center != x ->
  ((point : R) ->
    derivatives zero point == f point) ->
  ((m : Nat) ->
    m <N n ->
    (point : R) ->
    InClosedInterval reals center x point ->
    ContinuousWithin reals
      (derivatives m)
      (InClosedInterval reals center x)
      point) ->
  ((m : Nat) ->
    m <N n ->
    (point : R) ->
    StrictlyBetween reals center x point ->
    DerivativeAt reals
      (derivatives m)
      point
      (derivatives (suc m) point)) ->
  Exists R
    (\ intermediate ->
      Both
        (StrictlyBetween reals center x intermediate)
        (f x ==
          add reals
            (taylorPolynomial reals derivatives center x n)
            (taylorRemainder reals derivatives center x n intermediate)))

title: 035_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Taylor's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 035.
  A sufficiently differentiable real function equals its finite Taylor sum at a base point
  plus a Lagrange remainder evaluated at an intermediate point. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory limTheory transcTheory;

val taylors_theorem =
  ``!f diff a x n.
      0 < n /\
      a <> x /\
      diff 0 = f /\
      (!m t.
         m < n /\
         min a x <= t /\ t <= max a x
         ==>
         (diff m diffl (diff (SUC m) t)) t)
      ==>
      ?t.
        min a x < t /\ t < max a x /\
        f x =
          SIGMA
            (\m. diff m a / &(FACT m) * (x - a) pow m)
            (count n) +
          diff n t / &(FACT n) * (x - a) pow n``;

title: 035_taylor_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Taylor's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems
  item 035. It states the real Taylor formula with Lagrange remainder for a
  function on the unordered closed interval between two distinct real
  points, using relative iterated derivatives. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The repeated class

    { t e. RR |
      ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/ ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }

  is the unordered closed interval with endpoints A and X. Replacing both
  non-strict inequalities by strict inequalities gives its open interior.

  The first smoothness premise says that the restriction of F to the closed
  interval is C^N there. The second says that its N-th relative derivative,
  restricted to the open interval, is differentiable at every point of that
  interval. The conclusion gives an internal witness c and expands the
  degree-N Taylor polynomial as the native finite sum from 0 through N.
$)

${
  $d c A $.
  $d c F $.
  $d c N $.
  $d c X $.
  $d c k $.
  $d c t $.
  $d k A $.
  $d k F $.
  $d k N $.
  $d k X $.
  $d k t $.
  $d t A $.
  $d t F $.
  $d t N $.
  $d t X $.

  taylor-theorem-with-lagrange-remainder $a |- (
    (
      (
        (
          ( A e. RR /\ X e. RR )
          /\
          ( N e. NN0 /\ A =/= X )
        )
        /\
        F : RR --> RR
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          F |`
            { t e. RR |
              ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/ ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
        )
        e.
        (
          (
            C^n `
              { t e. RR |
                ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/ ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
          )
          ` N
        )
        /\
        (
          { t e. RR |
            ( ( A < t /\ t < X ) \/ ( X < t /\ t < A ) ) }
          C_
          dom
            (
              { t e. RR |
                ( ( A < t /\ t < X ) \/ ( X < t /\ t < A ) ) }
              _D
              (
                (
                  (
                    { t e. RR |
                      ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                        ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                    Dn
                    (
                      F |`
                        { t e. RR |
                          ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                            ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                    )
                  )
                  ` N
                )
                |`
                { t e. RR |
                  ( ( A < t /\ t < X ) \/ ( X < t /\ t < A ) ) }
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    E. c e.
      { t e. RR |
        ( ( A < t /\ t < X ) \/ ( X < t /\ t < A ) ) }
      (
        (
          ( F ` X )
          -
          sum_ k e. ( 0 ... N )
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    (
                      { t e. RR |
                        ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                          ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                      Dn
                      (
                        F |`
                          { t e. RR |
                            ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                              ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                      )
                    )
                    ` k
                  )
                  ` A
                )
                /
                ( ! ` k )
              )
              x.
              ( ( X - A ) ^ k )
            )
        )
        =
        (
          (
            (
              (
                (
                  { t e. RR |
                    ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                      ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                  Dn
                  (
                    F |`
                      { t e. RR |
                        ( ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) \/
                          ( X <_ t /\ t <_ A ) ) }
                  )
                )
                ` ( N + 1 )
              )
              ` c
            )
            x.
            ( ( X - A ) ^ ( N + 1 ) )
          )
          /
          ( ! ` ( N + 1 ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}
