(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* More homotopy extension results and relations to components.              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let HOMOTOPIC_ON_COMPONENTS = `!s t f g:real^M->real^N.
        locally connected s /\
        (!c. c IN components s
             ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
                   (subtopology euclidean c,subtopology euclidean t) f g)
        ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
             (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t) f g`;;

let INESSENTIAL_ON_COMPONENTS = `!f:real^M->real^N s t.
        locally connected s /\ path_connected t /\
        (!c. c IN components s
             ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                       (subtopology euclidean c,subtopology euclidean t)
                       f (\x. a))
        ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                  (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t)
                  f (\x. a)`;;

let HOMOTOPIC_NEIGHBOURHOOD_EXTENSION = `!f g:real^M->real^N s t u.
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET u /\
        g continuous_on s /\ IMAGE g s SUBSET u /\
        closed_in (subtopology euclidean s) t /\ ANR u /\
        homotopic_with (\x. T)
         (subtopology euclidean t,subtopology euclidean u) f g
        ==> ?v. t SUBSET v /\
                open_in (subtopology euclidean s) v /\
                homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean v,subtopology euclidean u) f g`;;

let HOMOTOPIC_ON_COMPONENTS_EQ = `!s t f g:real^M->real^N.
        (locally connected s \/ compact s /\ ANR t)
        ==> (homotopic_with (\x. T)
               (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t) f g <=>
             f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
             g continuous_on s /\ IMAGE g s SUBSET t /\
             !c. c IN components s
                 ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
                      (subtopology euclidean c,subtopology euclidean t) f g)`;;

let INESSENTIAL_ON_COMPONENTS_EQ = `!s t f:real^M->real^N.
        (locally connected s \/ compact s /\ ANR t) /\
        path_connected t
        ==> ((?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                   (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t)
                   f (\x. a)) <=>
             f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
             !c. c IN components s
                 ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                          (subtopology euclidean c,subtopology euclidean t)
                          f (\x. a))`;;

let COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_ON_COMPONENTS = `!s:real^M->bool t:real^N->bool.
        (locally connected s \/ compact s /\ ANR t)
         ==> ((!f g. f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
                     g continuous_on s /\ IMAGE g s SUBSET t
                     ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
                          (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t)
                          f g) <=>
              (!c. c IN components s
                   ==> (!f g. f continuous_on c /\ IMAGE f c SUBSET t /\
                              g continuous_on c /\ IMAGE g c SUBSET t
                              ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
                                   (subtopology euclidean c,
                                    subtopology euclidean t) f g)))`;;

let COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_ON_COMPONENTS_NULL = `!s:real^M->bool t:real^N->bool.
        (locally connected s \/ compact s /\ ANR t) /\ path_connected t
         ==> ((!f. f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
                   ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                            (subtopology euclidean s,
                             subtopology euclidean t) f (\x. a)) <=>
              (!c. c IN components s
                   ==> (!f. f continuous_on c /\ IMAGE f c SUBSET t
                            ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                                     (subtopology euclidean c,
                                      subtopology euclidean t) f (\x. a))))`;;

let COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_1D = `!f:real^M->real^N s t.
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
        ANR t /\ connected t /\
        (dimindex(:M) = 1 \/ ?r:real^1->bool. s homeomorphic r)
        ==> ?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean t) f (\x. a)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A few simple lemmas about deformation retracts.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let DEFORMATION_RETRACTION_COMPOSE = `!s t u r1 r2:real^N->real^N.
        homotopic_with (\x. T)
          (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r1 /\
        retraction (s,t) r1 /\
        homotopic_with (\x. T)
          (subtopology euclidean t,subtopology euclidean t) (\x. x) r2 /\
        retraction (t,u) r2
        ==> homotopic_with (\x. T)
             (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s)
             (\x. x) (r2 o r1) /\
            retraction (s,u) (r2 o r1)`;;

let DEFORMATION_RETRACT_TRANS = `!s t u:real^N->bool.
        (?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
             retraction (s,t) r) /\
        (?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean t,subtopology euclidean t) (\x. x) r /\
             retraction (t,u) r)
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction (s,u) r`;;

let DEFORMATION_RETRACT_IMP_HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        (?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
             retraction(s,t) r)
        ==> s homotopy_equivalent t`;;

let DEFORMATION_RETRACT = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        (?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
             retraction(s,t) r) <=>
        t retract_of s /\
        ?f. homotopic_with (\x. T)
             (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) f /\
            IMAGE f s SUBSET t`;;

let ANR_STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACTION = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        ANR s /\
        (?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
             retraction(s,t) r)
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\h. !x. x IN t ==> h x = x)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,t) r`;;

let DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_CONTRACTIBLE = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        contractible s /\ t retract_of s
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,t) r`;;

let AR_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_CONTRACTIBLE = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        contractible s /\ AR t /\ closed_in (subtopology euclidean s) t
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,t) r`;;

let DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_CONTRACTIBLE_SING = `!s a:real^N.
        contractible s /\ a IN s
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\x. T)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,{a}) r`;;

let STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        AR s /\ t retract_of s
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\h. !x. x IN t ==> h x = x)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,t) r`;;

let AR_STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        AR s /\ AR t /\ closed_in (subtopology euclidean s) t
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\h. !x. x IN t ==> h x = x)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,t) r`;;

let SING_STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR = `!s a:real^N.
        AR s /\ a IN s
        ==> ?r. homotopic_with (\h. h a = a)
                 (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) (\x. x) r /\
                retraction(s,{a}) r`;;

let HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_PUNCTURED_CONVEX = `!s t a:real^N.
      convex s /\ bounded s /\ a IN relative_interior s /\
      convex t /\ relative_frontier s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET affine hull s
      ==> (relative_frontier s) homotopy_equivalent (t DELETE a)`;;

let HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_PUNCTURED_AFFINE_HULL = `!s a:real^N.
      convex s /\ bounded s /\ a IN relative_interior s
      ==> (relative_frontier s) homotopy_equivalent (affine hull s DELETE a)`;;

let HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_PUNCTURED_UNIV_SPHERE = `!c a:real^N r.
        &0 < r ==> ((:real^N) DELETE c) homotopy_equivalent sphere(a,r)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Preservation of fixpoints under (more general notion of) retraction.      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let INVERTIBLE_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY = `!s:real^M->bool t:real^N->bool i r.
     i continuous_on t /\ IMAGE i t SUBSET s /\
     r continuous_on s /\ IMAGE r s SUBSET t /\
     (!y. y IN t ==> (r(i(y)) = y))
     ==> (!f. f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
              ==> ?x. x IN s /\ (f x = x))
         ==> !g. g continuous_on t /\ IMAGE g t SUBSET t
                 ==> ?y. y IN t /\ (g y = y)`;;

let HOMEOMORPHIC_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY = `!s t. s homeomorphic t
         ==> ((!f. f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
                   ==> ?x. x IN s /\ (f x = x)) <=>
              (!g. g continuous_on t /\ IMAGE g t SUBSET t
                   ==> ?y. y IN t /\ (g y = y)))`;;

let RETRACT_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY = `!s t:real^N->bool.
        t retract_of s /\
        (!f. f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
             ==> ?x. x IN s /\ (f x = x))
        ==> !g. g continuous_on t /\ IMAGE g t SUBSET t
                ==> ?y. y IN t /\ (g y = y)`;;

let FRONTIER_SUBSET_RETRACTION = `!s:real^N->bool t r.
        bounded s /\
        frontier s SUBSET t /\
        r continuous_on (closure s) /\
        IMAGE r s SUBSET t /\
        (!x. x IN t ==> r x = x)
        ==> s SUBSET t`;;

let NO_RETRACTION_FRONTIER_BOUNDED = `!s:real^N->bool.
        bounded s /\ ~(interior s = {}) ==> ~((frontier s) retract_of s)`;;

let COMPACT_SUBSET_FRONTIER_RETRACTION = `!f:real^N->real^N s.
        compact s /\ f continuous_on s /\ (!x. x IN frontier s ==> f x = x)
        ==> s SUBSET IMAGE f s`;;

let NOT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_COBOUNDED = `!s. bounded s /\ ((:real^N) DIFF s) retract_of (:real^N) ==> s = {}`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Bohl-type fixed point theorems.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let BOHL = `!f s a:real^N.
        f continuous_on s /\ convex s /\ compact s /\ a IN interior s
        ==> (?x. x IN s /\ f x = x) \/
            (?x. x IN frontier s /\ x IN segment(a,f x))`;;

let BOHL_ALT = `!f s a.
        f continuous_on s /\ convex s /\ compact s /\ a IN interior s /\
        IMAGE f s SUBSET (:real^N) DELETE a
        ==> ?x. x IN frontier s /\ a IN segment(x,f x)`;;

let BOHL_SIMPLE = `!f:real^N->real^N s a.
       compact s /\ a IN s /\
       f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET (:real^N) DELETE a
       ==> ?x. x IN frontier s /\ ~(f x = x)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some more theorems about connectivity of retract complements.             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let BOUNDED_COMPONENT_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_MEETS = `!s t c. closed s /\ s retract_of t /\
           c IN components((:real^N) DIFF s) /\ bounded c
           ==> ~(c SUBSET t)`;;

let COMPONENT_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_MEETS = `!s t c. closed s /\ s retract_of t /\ bounded t /\
           c IN components((:real^N) DIFF s)
           ==> ~(c SUBSET t)`;;

let FINITE_COMPLEMENT_ENR_COMPONENTS = `!s. compact s /\ ENR s ==> FINITE(components((:real^N) DIFF s))`;;

let FINITE_COMPLEMENT_ANR_COMPONENTS = `!s. compact s /\ ANR s ==> FINITE(components((:real^N) DIFF s))`;;

let CARD_LE_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS = `!s t. compact s /\ s retract_of t /\ bounded t
         ==> components((:real^N) DIFF s) <=_c components((:real^N) DIFF t)`;;

let CONNECTED_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT = `!s t. compact s /\ s retract_of t /\ bounded t /\
         connected((:real^N) DIFF t)
         ==> connected((:real^N) DIFF s)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* We also get fixpoint properties for suitable ANRs.                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let BROUWER_INESSENTIAL_ANR = `!f:real^N->real^N s.
        compact s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ ANR s /\
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s /\
        (?a. homotopic_with (\x. T)
              (subtopology euclidean s,subtopology euclidean s) f (\x. a))
        ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

let BROUWER_CONTRACTIBLE_ANR = `!f:real^N->real^N s.
        compact s /\ contractible s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ ANR s /\
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
        ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

let FIXED_POINT_INESSENTIAL_SPHERE_MAP = `!f a:real^N r c.
     &0 < r /\
     homotopic_with (\x. T)
      (subtopology euclidean (sphere(a,r)),
       subtopology euclidean (sphere(a,r))) f (\x. c)
     ==> ?x. x IN sphere(a,r) /\ f x = x`;;

let BROUWER_AR = `!f s:real^N->bool.
        compact s /\ AR s /\ f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
         ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

let BROUWER_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT = `!f s. compact s /\ s retract_of (:real^N) /\
         f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
         ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* This interesting lemma is no longer used for Schauder but we keep it.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let SCHAUDER_PROJECTION = `!s:real^N->bool e.
        compact s /\ &0 < e
        ==> ?t f. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET s /\
                  f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET (convex hull t) /\
                  (!x. x IN s ==> norm(f x - x) < e)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some other related fixed-point theorems.                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let BROUWER_FACTOR_THROUGH_AR = `!f:real^M->real^N g:real^N->real^M s t.
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
        g continuous_on t /\ IMAGE g t SUBSET s /\
        compact s /\ AR t
        ==> ?x. x IN s /\ g(f x) = x`;;

let BROUWER_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_GEN = `!f s:real^N->bool.
           s retract_of (:real^N) /\
           f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s /\ bounded(IMAGE f s)
           ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

let SCHAUDER_GEN = `!f s t:real^N->bool.
     AR s /\ f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET s /\ compact t
     ==> ?x. x IN t /\ f x = x`;;

let SCHAUDER = `!f s t:real^N->bool.
        convex s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ t SUBSET s /\ compact t /\
        f continuous_on s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
        ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

let SCHAUDER_UNIV = `!f:real^N->real^N.
        f continuous_on (:real^N) /\ bounded (IMAGE f (:real^N))
        ==> ?x. f x = x`;;

let ROTHE = `!f s:real^N->bool.
        closed s /\ convex s /\ ~(s = {}) /\
        f continuous_on s /\ bounded(IMAGE f s) /\
        IMAGE f (frontier s) SUBSET s
        ==> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Perron-Frobenius theorem.                                                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PERRON_FROBENIUS = `!A:real^N^N.
        (!i j. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) /\ 1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex(:N)
               ==> &0 <= A$i$j)
        ==> ?v c. norm v = &1 /\ &0 <= c /\ A ** v = c % v`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Bijections between intervals.                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let interval_bij = new_definition
 `interval_bij (a:real^N,b:real^N) (u:real^N,v:real^N) (x:real^N) =
    (lambda i. u$i + (x$i - a$i) / (b$i - a$i) * (v$i - u$i)):real^N`;;

let INTERVAL_BIJ_AFFINE = `interval_bij (a,b) (u,v) =
        \x. (lambda i. (v$i - u$i) / (b$i - a$i) * x$i) +
            (lambda i. u$i - (v$i - u$i) / (b$i - a$i) * a$i)`;;

let CONTINUOUS_INTERVAL_BIJ = `!a b u v x. (interval_bij (a:real^N,b:real^N) (u:real^N,v:real^N))
                  continuous at x`;;

let CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERVAL_BIJ = `!a b u v s. interval_bij (a,b) (u,v) continuous_on s`;;

let IN_INTERVAL_INTERVAL_BIJ = `!a b u v x:real^N.
        x IN interval[a,b] /\ ~(interval[u,v] = {})
        ==> (interval_bij (a,b) (u,v) x) IN interval[u,v]`;;

let INTERVAL_BIJ_BIJ = `!a b u v x:real^N.
        (!i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) ==> a$i < b$i /\ u$i < v$i)
        ==> interval_bij (a,b) (u,v) (interval_bij (u,v) (a,b) x) = x`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Fashoda meet theorem.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let INFNORM_2 = `infnorm (x:real^2) = max (abs(x$1)) (abs(x$2))`;;

let INFNORM_EQ_1_2 = `infnorm (x:real^2) = &1 <=>
        abs(x$1) <= &1 /\ abs(x$2) <= &1 /\
        (x$1 = -- &1 \/ x$1 = &1 \/ x$2 = -- &1 \/ x$2 = &1)`;;

let INFNORM_EQ_1_IMP = `infnorm (x:real^2) = &1 ==> abs(x$1) <= &1 /\ abs(x$2) <= &1`;;

let FASHODA_UNIT = `!f:real^1->real^2 g:real^1->real^2.
        IMAGE f (interval[--vec 1,vec 1]) SUBSET interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        IMAGE g (interval[--vec 1,vec 1]) SUBSET interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        f continuous_on interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        g continuous_on interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        f(--vec 1)$1 = -- &1 /\ f(vec 1)$1 = &1 /\
        g(--vec 1)$2 = -- &1 /\ g(vec 1)$2 = &1
        ==> ?s t. s IN interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
                  t IN interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
                  f(s) = g(t)`;;

let FASHODA_UNIT_PATH = `!f:real^1->real^2 g:real^1->real^2.
        path f /\ path g /\
        path_image f SUBSET interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        path_image g SUBSET interval[--vec 1,vec 1] /\
        (pathstart f)$1 = -- &1 /\ (pathfinish f)$1 = &1 /\
        (pathstart g)$2 = -- &1 /\ (pathfinish g)$2 = &1
        ==> ?z. z IN path_image f /\ z IN path_image g`;;

let FASHODA = `!f g a b:real^2.
        path f /\ path g /\
        path_image f SUBSET interval[a,b] /\
        path_image g SUBSET interval[a,b] /\
        (pathstart f)$1 = a$1 /\ (pathfinish f)$1 = b$1 /\
        (pathstart g)$2 = a$2 /\ (pathfinish g)$2 = b$2
        ==> ?z. z IN path_image f /\ z IN path_image g`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some slightly ad hoc lemmas I use below                                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let SEGMENT_VERTICAL = `!a:real^2 b:real^2 x:real^2.
      a$1 = b$1
      ==> (x IN segment[a,b] <=>
           x$1 = a$1 /\ x$1 = b$1 /\
           (a$2 <= x$2 /\ x$2 <= b$2 \/ b$2 <= x$2 /\ x$2 <= a$2))`;;

let SEGMENT_HORIZONTAL = `!a:real^2 b:real^2 x:real^2.
      a$2 = b$2
      ==> (x IN segment[a,b] <=>
           x$2 = a$2 /\ x$2 = b$2 /\
           (a$1 <= x$1 /\ x$1 <= b$1 \/ b$1 <= x$1 /\ x$1 <= a$1))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Useful Fashoda corollary pointed out to me by Tom Hales.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let FASHODA_INTERLACE = `!f g a b:real^2.
        path f /\ path g /\
        path_image f SUBSET interval[a,b] /\
        path_image g SUBSET interval[a,b] /\
        (pathstart f)$2 = a$2 /\ (pathfinish f)$2 = a$2 /\
        (pathstart g)$2 = a$2 /\ (pathfinish g)$2 = a$2 /\
        (pathstart f)$1 < (pathstart g)$1 /\
        (pathstart g)$1 < (pathfinish f)$1 /\
        (pathfinish f)$1 < (pathfinish g)$1
        ==> ?z. z IN path_image f /\ z IN path_image g`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Complement in dimension N >= 2 of set homeomorphic to any interval in     *)
(* any dimension is (path-)connected. This naively generalizes the argument  *)
(* in Ryuji Maehara's paper "The Jordan curve theorem via the Brouwer        *)
(* fixed point theorem", American Mathematical Monthly 1984.                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT = `!s c. compact s /\ AR s /\ c IN components((:real^N) DIFF s)
         ==> ~bounded c`;;

let CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT = `!s. 2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ compact s /\ AR s
       ==> connected((:real^N) DIFF s)`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT = `!s:real^N->bool.
        2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ compact s /\ AR s
        ==> path_connected((:real^N) DIFF s)`;;

let CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT = `!s:real^N->bool t:real^M->bool.
        2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ s homeomorphic t /\ convex t /\ compact t
        ==> connected((:real^N) DIFF s)`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT = `!s:real^N->bool t:real^M->bool.
        2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ s homeomorphic t /\ convex t /\ compact t
        ==> path_connected((:real^N) DIFF s)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* In particular, apply all these to the special case of an arc.             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let RETRACTION_ARC = `!p. arc p
       ==> ?f. f continuous_on (:real^N) /\
               IMAGE f (:real^N) SUBSET path_image p /\
               (!x. x IN path_image p ==> f x = x)`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_ARC_COMPLEMENT = `!p. 2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ arc p
       ==> path_connected((:real^N) DIFF path_image p)`;;

let CONNECTED_ARC_COMPLEMENT = `!p. 2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ arc p
       ==> connected((:real^N) DIFF path_image p)`;;

let INSIDE_ARC_EMPTY = `!p:real^1->real^N. arc p ==> inside(path_image p) = {}`;;

let INSIDE_SIMPLE_CURVE_IMP_CLOSED = `!g x:real^N.
        simple_path g /\ x IN inside(path_image g)
        ==> pathfinish g = pathstart g`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some nice theorems giving accessibility for ANR complement components     *)
(* (from Hu's "Theory of Retracts", apparently originally from Borsuk).      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let FINITE_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS_CONCENTRIC = `!s p:real^N a b.
        compact s /\ ANR s /\ a < b
        ==> FINITE {c | c IN components(cball(p,b) DIFF s) /\
                        ~(closure c INTER cball(p,a) = {})}`;;

let ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_ANR_INTER_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT = `!s c p:real^N b.
        compact s /\ ANR s /\
        c IN components(b DIFF s) /\ p IN frontier c /\ p IN interior b
        ==> ?g. arc g /\ pathfinish g = p /\
                !t. t IN interval[vec 0,vec 1] DELETE (vec 1) ==> g(t) IN c`;;

let ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT = `!s c x y.
        compact s /\ ANR s /\
        c IN components((:real^N) DIFF s) /\ x IN c /\ y IN frontier c
        ==> ?g. arc g /\ pathstart g = x /\ pathfinish g = y /\
                !t. t IN interval[vec 0,vec 1] DELETE (vec 1) ==> g(t) IN c`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some simple consequences for complement connectivity.                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let LPC_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT = `!s c t.
        compact s /\
        ANR s /\
        c IN components ((:real^N) DIFF s) /\
        c SUBSET t /\
        t SUBSET closure c
        ==> locally path_connected t`;;

let LPC_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT = `!s t. compact s /\ ANR s /\
         (:real^N) DIFF s SUBSET t /\ DISJOINT t (interior s)
         ==> locally path_connected t`;;

let LPC_SUPERSET_COMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE = `!g s:real^N->bool.
        2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ simple_path g /\
        (:real^N) DIFF path_image g SUBSET s
        ==> locally path_connected s`;;

let LPC_OPEN_SIMPLE_PATH_COMPLEMENT = `!g. simple_path g
       ==> locally path_connected
            ((:real^N) DIFF (path_image g DIFF {pathstart g,pathfinish g}))`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT = `!s c t.
        compact s /\ ANR s /\ c IN components((:real^N) DIFF s) /\
        c SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET closure c
        ==> path_connected t`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_SUPERSET_COMPLEMENT_ARC_IMAGE = `!g s:real^N->bool.
        2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ arc g /\ (:real^N) DIFF path_image g SUBSET s
        ==> path_connected s`;;

let PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_ARC_COMPLEMENT = `!g. 2 <= dimindex(:N) /\ arc g
       ==> path_connected
            ((:real^N) DIFF (path_image g DIFF {pathstart g,pathfinish g}))`;;

title: 036_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 036,
;; "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem": every continuous self-map of a nonempty
;; compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real normed space has a
;; fixed point. This file contains no proof.
;;
;; Semantic status: the direct DEFUN-SK formulation below repairs the former
;; vacuous APPLY$ quantifiers, but standard ACL2 still ranges only over tame
;; coded scalar sets, vector sets, sequences, and maps. It therefore does not
;; preserve the source's unrestricted real-space quantification and is not
;; counted as a faithful translation.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Function-valued objects are represented by tame APPLY$ objects. Every
;; mathematical quantifier below is a direct DEFUN-SK quantifier; no generated
;; lambda calls a user-defined ACL2 function.

(defun ht036-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht036-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun ht036-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; A scalar context contains a carrier predicate, zero, one, addition,
;; multiplication, negation, inversion, and strict order.

(defun ht036-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun ht036-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun ht036-real-p (ctx value)
  (ht036-member-p (ht036-r-carrier ctx) value))

(defun ht036-zero (ctx)
  (ht036-r-zero ctx))

(defun ht036-one (ctx)
  (ht036-r-one ctx))

(defun ht036-add (ctx left right)
  (ht036-binary-value
   (ht036-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun ht036-multiply (ctx left right)
  (ht036-binary-value
   (ht036-r-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun ht036-negate (ctx value)
  (ht036-unary-value
   (ht036-r-negate ctx) value))

(defun ht036-inverse (ctx value)
  (ht036-unary-value
   (ht036-r-inverse ctx) value))

(defun ht036-less (ctx left right)
  (if
      (ht036-binary-value
       (ht036-r-less ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun ht036-subtract (ctx left right)
  (ht036-add ctx left (ht036-negate ctx right)))

(defun ht036-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (ht036-less ctx right left)))

(defun ht036-absolute-value (ctx value)
  (if (ht036-less ctx value (ht036-zero ctx))
      (ht036-negate ctx value)
    value))

(defun ht036-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (ht036-real-p ctx value)
   (ht036-less ctx (ht036-zero ctx) value)))

(defun-sk ht036-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p ctx a)
      (ht036-real-p ctx b)
      (ht036-real-p ctx c))
     (let* ((ab-add (ht036-add ctx a b))
            (bc-add (ht036-add ctx b c))
            (ab-mul (ht036-multiply ctx a b))
            (bc-mul (ht036-multiply ctx b c))
            (neg-a (ht036-negate ctx a))
            (inv-a (ht036-inverse ctx a))
            (zero (ht036-zero ctx))
            (one (ht036-one ctx)))
       (and
        (ht036-real-p ctx ab-add)
        (ht036-real-p ctx ab-mul)
        (ht036-real-p ctx neg-a)
        (ht036-real-p ctx inv-a)
        (equal
         (ht036-add ctx ab-add c)
         (ht036-add ctx a bc-add))
        (equal ab-add (ht036-add ctx b a))
        (equal (ht036-add ctx a zero) a)
        (equal (ht036-add ctx a neg-a) zero)
        (equal
         (ht036-multiply ctx ab-mul c)
         (ht036-multiply ctx a bc-mul))
        (equal ab-mul (ht036-multiply ctx b a))
        (equal (ht036-multiply ctx a one) a)
        (implies
         (equal a zero)
         (equal inv-a zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal a zero))
         (equal (ht036-multiply ctx a inv-a) one))
        (equal
         (ht036-multiply ctx a bc-add)
         (ht036-add
          ctx
          (ht036-multiply ctx a b)
          (ht036-multiply ctx a c))))))))

(defun-sk ht036-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p ctx a)
      (ht036-real-p ctx b)
      (ht036-real-p ctx c))
     (and
      (not (ht036-less ctx a a))
      (or
       (ht036-less ctx a b)
       (equal a b)
       (ht036-less ctx b a))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht036-less ctx a b)
        (ht036-less ctx b c))
       (ht036-less ctx a c))
      (implies
       (ht036-less ctx a b)
       (ht036-less
        ctx
        (ht036-add ctx a c)
        (ht036-add ctx b c)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht036-less ctx (ht036-zero ctx) a)
        (ht036-less ctx (ht036-zero ctx) b))
       (ht036-less
        ctx
        (ht036-zero ctx)
        (ht036-multiply ctx a b)))))))

;; Dedekind completeness pins the scalar field down to a presentation of the
;; real numbers under the corpus's tame-function convention.

(defun ht036-scalar-set-member-p (ctx set value)
  (declare (ignore ctx))
  (ht036-member-p set value))

(defun-sk ht036-valid-scalar-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (ht036-scalar-set-member-p ctx set value)
     (ht036-real-p ctx value))))

(defun ht036-extensional-scalar-set-p (ctx set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht036-valid-scalar-set-p ctx set)))

(defun-sk ht036-scalar-set-nonempty-p (ctx set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (ht036-real-p ctx value)
     (ht036-scalar-set-member-p ctx set value))))

(defun-sk ht036-upper-bound-p (ctx set upper)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p ctx value)
      (ht036-scalar-set-member-p ctx set value))
     (not (ht036-less ctx upper value)))))

(defun-sk ht036-bounded-above-p (ctx set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (ht036-real-p ctx upper)
     (ht036-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))))

(defun-sk ht036-least-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p ctx upper)
      (ht036-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))
     (not (ht036-less ctx upper supremum)))))

(defun ht036-is-supremum-p (ctx set supremum)
  (and
   (ht036-real-p ctx supremum)
   (ht036-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)
   (ht036-least-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht036-has-supremum-p (ctx set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (ht036-is-supremum-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht036-completeness-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-extensional-scalar-set-p ctx set)
      (ht036-scalar-set-nonempty-p ctx set)
      (ht036-bounded-above-p ctx set))
     (ht036-has-supremum-p ctx set))))

(defun ht036-real-field-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-multiply ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-negate ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-inverse ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-r-less ctx))
   (ht036-real-p ctx (ht036-zero ctx))
   (ht036-real-p ctx (ht036-one ctx))
   (not (equal (ht036-zero ctx) (ht036-one ctx)))
   (ht036-field-laws-p ctx)
   (ht036-order-laws-p ctx)
   (ht036-completeness-p ctx)
   (ht036-less ctx (ht036-zero ctx) (ht036-one ctx))))

;; A vector-space context contains a carrier predicate, zero, addition,
;; negation, scalar multiplication, and norm.

(defun ht036-v-carrier (space) (nth 0 space))
(defun ht036-v-zero (space) (nth 1 space))
(defun ht036-v-add (space) (nth 2 space))
(defun ht036-v-negate (space) (nth 3 space))
(defun ht036-v-smul (space) (nth 4 space))
(defun ht036-v-norm (space) (nth 5 space))

(defun ht036-vector-p (space value)
  (ht036-member-p (ht036-v-carrier space) value))

(defun ht036-vector-zero (space)
  (ht036-v-zero space))

(defun ht036-vector-add (space left right)
  (ht036-binary-value
   (ht036-v-add space) left right))

(defun ht036-vector-negate (space value)
  (ht036-unary-value
   (ht036-v-negate space) value))

(defun ht036-scalar-multiply (space scalar vector)
  (ht036-binary-value
   (ht036-v-smul space) scalar vector))

(defun ht036-norm (space vector)
  (ht036-unary-value
   (ht036-v-norm space) vector))

(defun ht036-distance (real space left right)
  (declare (ignore real))
  (ht036-norm
   space
   (ht036-vector-add
    space left (ht036-vector-negate space right))))

(defun-sk ht036-vector-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p real a)
      (ht036-real-p real b)
      (ht036-vector-p space x)
      (ht036-vector-p space y)
      (ht036-vector-p space z))
     (let* ((xy (ht036-vector-add space x y))
            (yz (ht036-vector-add space y z))
            (neg-x (ht036-vector-negate space x))
            (ax (ht036-scalar-multiply space a x))
            (bx (ht036-scalar-multiply space b x))
            (ay (ht036-scalar-multiply space a y))
            (zero (ht036-vector-zero space)))
       (and
        (ht036-vector-p space xy)
        (ht036-vector-p space neg-x)
        (ht036-vector-p space ax)
        (equal
         (ht036-vector-add space xy z)
         (ht036-vector-add space x yz))
        (equal xy (ht036-vector-add space y x))
        (equal (ht036-vector-add space x zero) x)
        (equal (ht036-vector-add space x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (ht036-scalar-multiply space (ht036-one real) x)
         x)
        (equal
         (ht036-scalar-multiply
          space (ht036-add real a b) x)
         (ht036-vector-add space ax bx))
        (equal
         (ht036-scalar-multiply space a xy)
         (ht036-vector-add space ax ay))
        (equal
         (ht036-scalar-multiply
          space (ht036-multiply real a b) x)
         (ht036-scalar-multiply space a bx)))))))

(defun-sk ht036-norm-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-real-p real a)
      (ht036-vector-p space x)
      (ht036-vector-p space y))
     (let* ((norm-x (ht036-norm space x))
            (norm-y (ht036-norm space y))
            (norm-sum
             (ht036-norm
              space (ht036-vector-add space x y)))
            (norm-scale
             (ht036-norm
              space
              (ht036-scalar-multiply space a x))))
       (and
        (ht036-real-p real norm-x)
        (ht036-real-p real norm-y)
        (ht036-real-p real norm-sum)
        (ht036-real-p real norm-scale)
        (ht036-less-equal-p
         real (ht036-zero real) norm-x)
        (iff
         (equal norm-x (ht036-zero real))
         (equal x (ht036-vector-zero space)))
        (ht036-less-equal-p
         real
         norm-sum
         (ht036-add real norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         norm-scale
         (ht036-multiply
          real
          (ht036-absolute-value real a)
          norm-x)))))))

(defun ht036-normed-vector-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (true-listp space)
   (equal (len space) 6)
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-v-carrier space))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-v-add space))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-v-negate space))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-v-smul space))
   (tamep-functionp (ht036-v-norm space))
   (ht036-vector-p space (ht036-vector-zero space))
   (ht036-vector-laws-p real space)
   (ht036-norm-laws-p real space)))

;; A finite basis and its coordinate map witness finite dimensionality.

(defun ht036-basis-value (basis index)
  (ht036-unary-value basis index))

(defun ht036-coordinate-value
    (coordinates vector index)
  (ht036-binary-value coordinates vector index))

(defun ht036-linear-combination
    (space basis coordinates vector count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (ht036-vector-zero space)
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (coefficient
            (ht036-coordinate-value
             coordinates vector index))
           (term
            (ht036-scalar-multiply
             space coefficient
             (ht036-basis-value basis index))))
      (ht036-vector-add
       space
       (ht036-linear-combination
        space basis coordinates vector index)
       term))))

(defun-sk ht036-basis-values-p
    (space basis dimension)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (< index dimension))
     (ht036-vector-p
      space (ht036-basis-value basis index)))))

(defun-sk ht036-coordinate-values-p
    (real space coordinates dimension)
  (forall (vector index)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-vector-p space vector)
      (natp index)
      (< index dimension))
     (ht036-real-p
      real
      (ht036-coordinate-value
       coordinates vector index)))))

(defun-sk ht036-coordinate-basis-law-p
    (real space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (row column)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp row)
      (< row dimension)
      (natp column)
      (< column dimension))
     (equal
      (ht036-coordinate-value
       coordinates
       (ht036-basis-value basis row)
       column)
      (if (equal row column)
          (ht036-one real)
        (ht036-zero real))))))

(defun-sk ht036-coordinate-reconstruction-p
    (real space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (vector)
    (implies
     (ht036-vector-p space vector)
     (equal
      (ht036-linear-combination
       space basis coordinates vector dimension)
      vector))))

(defun ht036-finite-coordinate-system-p
    (real space dimension basis coordinates)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (< 0 dimension)
   (tamep-functionp basis)
   (tamep-functionp coordinates)
   (ht036-basis-values-p space basis dimension)
   (ht036-coordinate-values-p
    real space coordinates dimension)
   (ht036-coordinate-basis-law-p
    real space basis coordinates dimension)
   (ht036-coordinate-reconstruction-p
    real space basis coordinates dimension)))

;; Extensional subsets and maps of the vector space.

(defun ht036-set-member-p (set vector)
  (ht036-member-p set vector))

(defun ht036-function-value (function vector)
  (ht036-unary-value function vector))

(defun-sk ht036-valid-vector-set-p (space set)
  (forall (vector)
    (implies
     (ht036-set-member-p set vector)
     (ht036-vector-p space vector))))

(defun ht036-extensional-vector-set-p (space set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht036-valid-vector-set-p space set)))

(defun-sk ht036-set-nonempty-p (space set)
  (exists (vector)
    (and
     (ht036-vector-p space vector)
     (ht036-set-member-p set vector))))

(defun-sk ht036-endomap-p (space function)
  (forall (vector)
    (implies
     (ht036-vector-p space vector)
     (ht036-vector-p
      space (ht036-function-value function vector)))))

(defun ht036-extensional-endomap-p (space function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht036-endomap-p space function)))

;; Sequential compactness in the norm metric. In finite-dimensional real
;; normed spaces this is equivalent to the source provers' compactness.

(defun ht036-sequence-value (sequence index)
  (ht036-unary-value sequence index))

(defun ht036-subsequence-index
    (subsequence index)
  (ht036-unary-value subsequence index))

(defun-sk ht036-sequence-in-set-p
    (space set sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (let ((value
            (ht036-sequence-value sequence index)))
       (and
        (ht036-vector-p space value)
        (ht036-set-member-p set value))))))

(defun-sk ht036-subsequence-natural-p (subsequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (natp
      (ht036-subsequence-index
       subsequence index)))))

(defun-sk ht036-subsequence-increasing-p (subsequence)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right)
      (< left right))
     (<
      (ht036-subsequence-index subsequence left)
      (ht036-subsequence-index subsequence right)))))

(defun ht036-strict-subsequence-p (subsequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp subsequence)
   (ht036-subsequence-natural-p subsequence)
   (ht036-subsequence-increasing-p subsequence)))

(defun-sk ht036-convergence-tail-p
    (real space sequence subsequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (<= start index))
     (ht036-less
      real
      (ht036-distance
       real
       space
       (ht036-sequence-value
        sequence
        (ht036-subsequence-index
         subsequence index))
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht036-convergence-start-exists-p
    (real space sequence subsequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (ht036-convergence-tail-p
      real space sequence subsequence
      limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk ht036-converges-to-p
    (real space sequence subsequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht036-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (ht036-convergence-start-exists-p
      real space sequence subsequence
      limit epsilon))))

(defun ht036-compact-witness-p
    (real space set sequence subsequence limit)
  (and
   (ht036-strict-subsequence-p subsequence)
   (ht036-vector-p space limit)
   (ht036-set-member-p set limit)
   (ht036-converges-to-p
    real space sequence subsequence limit)))

(defun-sk ht036-compact-witness-exists-p
    (real space set sequence)
  (exists (subsequence limit)
    (ht036-compact-witness-p
     real space set sequence subsequence limit)))

(defun-sk ht036-compact-set-quantifier-p
    (real space set)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp sequence)
      (ht036-sequence-in-set-p
       space set sequence))
     (ht036-compact-witness-exists-p
      real space set sequence))))

(defun ht036-compact-set-p (real space set)
  (and
   (ht036-extensional-vector-set-p space set)
   (ht036-compact-set-quantifier-p
    real space set)))

;; Convexity uses the standard affine combination (1-t)x + ty.

(defun ht036-convex-combination
    (real space parameter left right)
  (ht036-vector-add
   space
   (ht036-scalar-multiply
    space
    (ht036-subtract
     real (ht036-one real) parameter)
    left)
   (ht036-scalar-multiply
    space parameter right)))

(defun-sk ht036-convex-set-quantifier-p
    (real space set)
  (forall (left right parameter)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-vector-p space left)
      (ht036-vector-p space right)
      (ht036-set-member-p set left)
      (ht036-set-member-p set right)
      (ht036-real-p real parameter)
      (ht036-less-equal-p
       real (ht036-zero real) parameter)
      (ht036-less-equal-p
       real parameter (ht036-one real)))
     (ht036-set-member-p
      set
      (ht036-convex-combination
       real space parameter left right)))))

(defun ht036-convex-set-p (real space set)
  (and
   (ht036-extensional-vector-set-p space set)
   (ht036-convex-set-quantifier-p
    real space set)))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity relative to the subset.

(defun-sk ht036-continuity-nearby-p
    (real space set function point epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht036-vector-p space nearby)
      (ht036-set-member-p set nearby)
      (ht036-less
       real
       (ht036-distance
        real space nearby point)
       delta))
     (ht036-less
      real
      (ht036-distance
       real
       space
       (ht036-function-value function nearby)

title: 036_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 036.
-- This file contains no proof.

-- Hundred Theorems item 036, "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem": every continuous
-- self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real
-- Euclidean space has a fixed point. This is a statement-only formalization
-- and contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data NatLessOrEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual zero n
  successors-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    NatLessOrEqual m n ->
    NatLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

NatStrictLess : Nat -> Nat -> Set
NatStrictLess m n =
  NatLessOrEqual (suc m) n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x)
    (StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius))

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

Region : Set -> Nat -> Set1
Region R n =
  Vector R n -> Set

addVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
addVector reals x y i =
  add reals (x i) (y i)

scaleVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
scaleVector reals scalar x i =
  multiply reals scalar (x i)

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
linearCombination reals t x y =
  addVector reals
    (scaleVector reals t x)
    (scaleVector reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
      y)

VectorClose :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorClose {n = n} reals center radius x =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  CloseTo reals (center i) radius (x i)

VectorConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Vector R n) ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (k : Nat) ->
      NatLessOrEqual cutoff k ->
      VectorClose reals limit epsilon (sequence k))

StrictlyIncreasing : (Nat -> Nat) -> Set
StrictlyIncreasing subsequence =
  (k : Nat) ->
  NatStrictLess (subsequence k) (subsequence (suc k))

Compact :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
Compact {R} {n} reals body =
  (sequence : Nat -> Vector R n) ->
  ((k : Nat) -> body (sequence k)) ->
  Exists (Nat -> Nat)
    (\ subsequence ->
      Both
        (StrictlyIncreasing subsequence)
        (Exists (Vector R n)
          (\ limit ->
            Both
              (body limit)
              (VectorConvergesTo reals
                (\ k -> sequence (subsequence k))
                limit))))

Convex :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
Convex {R} {n} reals body =
  (x y : Vector R n) ->
  body x ->
  body y ->
  (t : R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals) ->
  body (linearCombination reals t x y)

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R n ->
  (Vector R n -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} {n} reals body f =
  (x : Vector R n) ->
  body x ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : Vector R n) ->
          body y ->
          VectorClose reals x delta y ->
          VectorClose reals (f x) epsilon (f y)))

Nonempty :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
Nonempty {R} {n} body =
  Exists (Vector R n) body

MapsInto :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Region R n ->
  (Vector R n -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
MapsInto {R} {n} body f =
  (x : Vector R n) ->
  body x ->
  body (f x)

brouwer-fixed-point-theorem : Set1
brouwer-fixed-point-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (body : Region R n) ->
  (f : Vector R n -> Vector R n) ->
  Compact reals body ->
  Convex reals body ->
  Nonempty body ->
  ContinuousOn reals body f ->
  MapsInto body f ->
  Exists (Vector R n)
    (\ x ->
      Both
        (body x)
        (VectorEqual (f x) x))

title: 036_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 036.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

(*
  Hundred Theorems item 036, "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem": every continuous
  self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional
  Euclidean real space has a fixed point in that subset. This is a
  statement-only formalization and contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val brouwer_fixed_point_theorem =
  ``!(s : ('i -> real) -> bool)
      (f : ('i -> real) -> ('i -> real)).
      let sqdist =
        \x y : 'i -> real.
          SIGMA (\k. (x k - y k) pow 2) (UNIV : 'i -> bool)
      in
      let compact_euclidean =
        \t.
          !(a : num -> 'i -> real).
            (!n. a n IN t) ==>
            ?r x.
              x IN t /\
              (!m n. m < n ==> r m < r n) /\
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?N. !n. N <= n ==> sqdist (a (r n)) x < e
      in
      let convex_euclidean =
        \t.
          !x y u.
            x IN t /\ y IN t /\ 0 <= u /\ u <= 1 ==>
            (\k. (1 - u) * x k + u * y k) IN t
      in
      let continuous_on_euclidean =
        \t g.
          !x. x IN t ==>
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?d. 0 < d /\
                      !y. y IN t /\ sqdist x y < d ==>
                          sqdist (g x) (g y) < e
      in
        FINITE (UNIV : 'i -> bool) /\
        compact_euclidean s /\
        convex_euclidean s /\
        (?x. x IN s) /\
        continuous_on_euclidean s f /\
        (!x. x IN s ==> f x IN s)
        ==>
        ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x``;

title: 036_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem" from Hundred
  Theorems item 036. It states the fixed-point theorem for continuous
  self-maps of nonempty compact convex subsets of finite-dimensional real
  Euclidean space. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  For each positive finite dimension n, RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) is the set of
  real coordinate vectors. The finite product topology below is the standard
  Euclidean topology used by SetMM's Poincare-Miranda and cube Brouwer
  development.

  Convexity is expanded directly: for x,y in s and t in [0,1], the coordinate
  map (1-t)x + ty belongs to s. The other assumptions say that s is nonempty
  and compact, f is an ambient Euclidean self-map, its restriction to s is
  continuous as a map from s to s, and its image of s is contained in s.
  The final $a assertion is the unproved corpus statement.
$)

brouwer-fixed-point-theorem $a |- A. n e. NN A. s A. f
  (
    (
      (
        s C_ ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
        /\
        s =/= (/)
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          (
            Xt_ `
              ( ( 1 ... n ) X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
          )
          |`t s
        )
        e. Comp
        /\
        A. x e. s A. y e. s A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
          (
            k e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
              (
                ( ( 1 - t ) x. ( x ` k ) )
                +
                ( t x. ( y ` k ) )
              )
          )
          e. s
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          f : ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) ) --> ( RR ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
          /\
          ( f " s ) C_ s
        )
        /\
        ( f |` s ) e.
          (
            (
              (
                Xt_ `
                  ( ( 1 ... n ) X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
              )
              |`t s
            )
            Cn
            (
              (
                Xt_ `
                  ( ( 1 ... n ) X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
              )
              |`t s
            )
          )
      )
    )
    ->
    E. x e. s ( f ` x ) = x
  )
$.

title: 036_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 036.
% This file contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 036, "Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem": every continuous
% self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real
% vector space has a fixed point. This statement-only encoding contains no proof.

brouwer_fixed_point_theorem_036[N: posnat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(N)
  vector: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  region: TYPE = [vector -> bool]
  vector_map: TYPE = [vector -> vector]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> vector]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  coordinate_close(x, y: vector, epsilon: real): bool =
    FORALL (i: coordinate):
      abs(x(i) - y(i)) < epsilon

  converges(sequence: vector_sequence, limit: vector): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      epsilon > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (k: nat):
            cutoff <= k
              IMPLIES coordinate_close(sequence(k), limit, epsilon)

  strictly_increasing(indices: index_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (k: nat):
      indices(k) < indices(k + 1)

  compact_region(S: region): bool =
    FORALL (sequence: vector_sequence):
      (FORALL (k: nat): S(sequence(k)))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (limit: vector), (indices: index_sequence):
            S(limit)
              AND strictly_increasing(indices)
              AND converges(
                    LAMBDA (k: nat): sequence(indices(k)),
                    limit)

  affine_combination(t: real, x, y: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
      t * x(i) + (1 - t) * y(i)

  convex_region(S: region): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: vector), (t: real):
      (S(x)
        AND S(y)
        AND 0 <= t
        AND t <= 1)
      IMPLIES S(affine_combination(t, x, y))

  continuous_on(f: vector_map, S: region): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      S(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon: real):
          epsilon > 0 IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              delta > 0
                AND FORALL (y: vector):
                  (S(y) AND coordinate_close(x, y, delta))
                    IMPLIES coordinate_close(f(x), f(y), epsilon)

  maps_into(f: vector_map, S: region): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      S(x) IMPLIES S(f(x))

  nonempty_region(S: region): bool =
    EXISTS (x: vector): S(x)

  brouwer_fixed_point_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (S: region), (f: vector_map):
      (compact_region(S)
        AND convex_region(S)
        AND nonempty_region(S)
        AND continuous_on(f, S)
        AND maps_into(f, S))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (x: vector):
          S(x) AND f(x) = x
END brouwer_fixed_point_theorem_036

import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Cyclotomic.Roots

/-!
# The roots of cubic and quartic polynomials

This file proves Theorem 37 and 46 from the [100 Theorems List](https://www.cs.ru.nl/~freek/100/).

We give the solutions to the cubic equation `a * x^3 + b * x^2 + c * x + d = 0` over a field `K`
that has characteristic neither 2 nor 3, that has a third primitive root of
unity, and in which certain other quantities admit square and cube roots. This is based on the
[Cardano's Formula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_equation#Cardano's_formula).

We also give solutions to the quartic equation `a * x^4 + b * x^3 + c * x^2 + d * x + e = 0` over
a field `K` that is not characteristic 2, and in which certain quantities admit square roots, in
terms of a quantity that is a root of a particular cubic equation.

## Main statements

- `cubic_eq_zero_iff`: gives the roots of the cubic equation
  where the discriminant `p = 3 * a * c - b^2` is nonzero.
- `cubic_eq_zero_iff_of_p_eq_zero`: gives the roots of the cubic equation
  where the discriminant equals zero.
- `quartic_eq_zero_iff`: gives the roots of the quartic equation
  where the quantity `b^3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a^2 * d` is nonzero, in terms of a root `u`
  to a cubic resolvent.
- `quartic_eq_zero_iff_of_q_eq_zero`: gives the roots of the quartic equation
  where the quantity `b^3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a^2 * d` equals zero.

## Proof outline

Proofs of the cubic and quartic formulas are similar in outline.

For a cubic:
1.  Given cubic $ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d = 0$, we show it is equivalent to some "depressed cubic"
    $y^3 + 3py - 2q = 0$ where $y = x + b / (3a)$, $p = (3ac - b^2) / (9a^2)$, and
    $q = (9abc - 2b^3 - 27a^2d) / (54a^3)$ (`h₁` in `cubic_eq_zero_iff`).
2.  When $p$ is zero, this is easily solved (`cubic_eq_zero_iff_of_p_eq_zero`).
3.  Otherwise one can directly derive a factorization of the depressed cubic, in terms of some
    primitive cube root of unity $\omega^3 = 1$ (`cubic_depressed_eq_zero_iff`).

Similarly, for a quartic:
1.  Given quartic $ax^4 + bx^3 + cx^2 + dx + e = 0$, it is equivalent to some "depressed quartic"
    $y^4 + py^2 + qy + r = 0$ where $y = x + b / (4a)$, $p = (8ac - 3b^2) / (8a^2))$,
    $q = b^3 - 4abc + 8a^2d) / (8a^3))$, and $r = (16ab^2c + 256a^3e - 3b^4 - 64a^2bd) / (256a^4)$
    (`h₁` in `quartic_eq_zero_iff`).
2.  When $q$ is zero, this is easily solved as a quadratic in $y^2$
    (`quartic_eq_zero_iff_of_q_eq_zero`).
3.  Otherwise one can directly derive a factorization of the depressed quartic into two quadratics,
    in terms of some root of the *cubic resolvent* $u^3 - pu^2 - 4ru + 4pr - q^2 = 0$
    (`quartic_depressed_eq_zero_iff`).

## References

The cubic formula was originally ported from Isabelle/HOL. The
[original file](https://isabelle.in.tum.de/dist/library/HOL/HOL-ex/Cubic_Quartic.html) was written by Amine Chaieb.

The proof of the quartic formula is similar in structure to the cubic, and uses the formulation in
[Zwillinger, *CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulae*](zwillinger2003).

## Tags

polynomial, cubic, quartic, root
-/


namespace Theorems100

section Field

open Polynomial

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] (a b c d e : K) {ω p q r s t u v w x y : K}

section Cubic

theorem cube_root_of_unity_sum (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω 3) : 1 + ω + ω ^ 2 = 0 := by sorry
theorem cubic_depressed_eq_zero_iff (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω 3) (hp_nonzero : p ≠ 0)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = q ^ 2 + p ^ 3) (hs3 : s ^ 3 = q + r) (ht : t * s = p) (x : K) :
    x ^ 3 + 3 * p * x - 2 * q = 0 ↔ x = s - t ∨ x = s * ω - t * ω ^ 2 ∨ x = s * ω ^ 2 - t * ω := by sorry
variable [Invertible (2 : K)] [Invertible (3 : K)]

/-- **The Solution of Cubic**.
  The roots of a cubic polynomial whose discriminant is nonzero. -/
theorem cubic_eq_zero_iff (ha : a ≠ 0) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω 3)
    (hp : p = (3 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (9 * a ^ 2)) (hp_nonzero : p ≠ 0)
    (hq : q = (9 * a * b * c - 2 * b ^ 3 - 27 * a ^ 2 * d) / (54 * a ^ 3))
    (hr : r ^ 2 = q ^ 2 + p ^ 3) (hs3 : s ^ 3 = q + r) (ht : t * s = p) (x : K) :
    a * x ^ 3 + b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d = 0 ↔
      x = s - t - b / (3 * a) ∨
        x = s * ω - t * ω ^ 2 - b / (3 * a) ∨ x = s * ω ^ 2 - t * ω - b / (3 * a) := by sorry
theorem cubic_eq_zero_iff_of_p_eq_zero (ha : a ≠ 0) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω 3)
    (hpz : 3 * a * c - b ^ 2 = 0)
    (hq : q = (9 * a * b * c - 2 * b ^ 3 - 27 * a ^ 2 * d) / (54 * a ^ 3)) (hs3 : s ^ 3 = 2 * q)
    (x : K) :
    a * x ^ 3 + b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d = 0 ↔
      x = s - b / (3 * a) ∨ x = s * ω - b / (3 * a) ∨ x = s * ω ^ 2 - b / (3 * a) := by sorry
end Cubic

section Quartic

variable [Invertible (2 : K)]

/-- Roots of a quartic whose cubic term is zero and linear term is nonzero,
  In terms of some `u` that satisfies a particular cubic resolvent. -/
theorem quartic_depressed_eq_zero_iff
    (hq_nonzero : q ≠ 0)
    (hu : u ^ 3 - p * u ^ 2 - 4 * r * u + 4 * p * r - q ^ 2 = 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = u - p)
    (hv : v ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u - q / s))
    (hw : w ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u + q / s))
    (x : K) :
    x ^ 4 + p * x ^ 2 + q * x + r = 0 ↔
      x = (-2 * s - v) / 4 ∨ x = (-2 * s + v) / 4 ∨ x = (2 * s - w) / 4 ∨ x = (2 * s + w) / 4 := by sorry
theorem quartic_eq_zero_iff (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hp : p = (8 * a * c - 3 * b ^ 2) / (8 * a ^ 2))
    (hq : q = (b ^ 3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a ^ 2 * d) / (8 * a ^ 3)) (hq_nonzero : q ≠ 0)
    (hr : r =
      (16 * a * b ^ 2 * c + 256 * a ^ 3 * e - 3 * b ^ 4 - 64 * a ^ 2 * b * d) / (256 * a ^ 4))
    (hu : u ^ 3 - p * u ^ 2 - 4 * r * u + 4 * p * r - q ^ 2 = 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = u - p)
    (hv : v ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u - q / s))
    (hw : w ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u + q / s)) (x : K) :
    a * x ^ 4 + b * x ^ 3 + c * x ^ 2 + d * x + e = 0 ↔
      x = (-2 * s - v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨ x = (-2 * s + v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨
        x = (2 * s - w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨ x = (2 * s + w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) := by sorry
theorem quartic_eq_zero_iff_of_q_eq_zero (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hp : p = (8 * a * c - 3 * b ^ 2) / (8 * a ^ 2))
    (hqz : b ^ 3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a ^ 2 * d = 0)
    (hr : r =
      (16 * a * b ^ 2 * c + 256 * a ^ 3 * e - 3 * b ^ 4 - 64 * a ^ 2 * b * d) / (256 * a ^ 4))
    (ht : t ^ 2 = p ^ 2 - 4 * r)
    (hv : v ^ 2 = (-p + t) / 2)
    (hw : w ^ 2 = (-p - t) / 2) (x : K) :
    a * x ^ 4 + b * x ^ 3 + c * x ^ 2 + d * x + e = 0 ↔
      x = v - b / (4 * a) ∨ x = -v - b / (4 * a) ∨ x = w - b / (4 * a) ∨ x = -w - b / (4 * a) := by sorry
end Quartic

end Field

end Theorems100

Require Import Reals Coq.Reals.Rtrigo_def Coquelicot.Coquelicot Coquelicot.ElemFct Lra.



Open Scope R_scope.

Ltac Rsimpl:=
repeat (
try rewrite Ropp_involutive;
try rewrite Ropp_0;
try rewrite Rplus_opp_l;
try rewrite Rplus_opp_r;
try rewrite Rplus_0_l;
try rewrite Rplus_0_r;
try rewrite Rmult_1_l;
try rewrite Rmult_1_r;
try rewrite Rmult_0_l;
try rewrite Rmult_0_r
).


Ltac Csimpl:=
  repeat (
      try rewrite Copp_0;
      try rewrite Cplus_opp_r;
      try rewrite Cplus_0_l;
      try rewrite Cplus_0_r;
      try rewrite Cmult_0_r;
      try rewrite Cmult_1_r;
      try rewrite Cmult_0_l;
      try rewrite Cmult_1_l).


Lemma contraposition_neg : forall P Q:Prop, ( P -> Q ) -> ( (~Q) -> (~P)).
Proof.
Admitted.


Definition Rneg_or_not : forall z:C,
 {0<Re z} + {Im z<>0} + {Im z=0 /\ Re z<=0}.
Proof.
intros.
destruct z as (u,v).
unfold Im, Re, fst, snd.
unfold Rle.
destruct (total_order_T u 0) as [uneg|uspos];
  try destruct uneg as [usneg|u0];
  destruct (Reqdec v) as [veq0|vneq0];
  auto.
Qed.


Definition Csqrt:=fun (z:C) =>
let (u,v):=z in
let a:=(sqrt(((Cmod z)+u)/2))%R in
let b:=(if (Rneg_or_not z) 
   then v/2/a
   else  sqrt(-u))%R in
(a,b)%C : C.


Lemma Csqrt_Cpow2 : forall z: C, (Csqrt z)*(Csqrt z)=z.
Proof.
Admitted.



Definition cargument (z: C) : R := 
if (Rneg_or_not z) then (INR 2)*atan((Im (Csqrt z))/(Re (Csqrt z))) 
else PI.

Lemma trigoform: forall z : C,
                   z=(cos(cargument z),sin(cargument z))*(Cmod z,0).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma factorisationdeg3 : forall z1 z2 z3:C, forall z:C, 
(z-z1)*(z-z2)*(z-z3)=Cpow z 3+(-(z1+z2+z3))*Cpow z 2+(z1*z2+z2*z3+z3*z1)*z+(-(z1*z2*z3)).
Proof.
Admitted.





Theorem Cpowexp : forall n:nat, forall x:R, ((exp(x))^n=exp((INR n)*x)) % R.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem comCpow: forall n : nat, forall z:C, forall u:C, (Cpow (z*u)%C n)=((Cpow z n)*(Cpow u n))%C.
Proof.
Admitted.


Lemma RCpow : forall n:nat,forall x:R, Cpow (x,0)%C n = ((x^n)%R,0)%C.
Proof.
Admitted.



Definition nroot (n:nat) (z:C) : C:= 
if Ceq_dec z 0 then  0 
else let argn:=((cargument z)/(INR n))%R in
  (cos(argn),sin(argn))*(exp((ln (Cmod z))/(INR n)),0).


Theorem nroot_Cpown : forall n:nat,forall z:C,n<>O-> Cpow (nroot n z) n=z.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma nrootpositive : forall x:R, forall n:nat, 0<=x -> Im( nroot n x ) =0%R.
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition cubicroot (z:C) := if(Rcase_abs (Re z)) then -nroot 3 (-z) else nroot 3 z.

Lemma cubicroot3 : forall z:C, Cpow (cubicroot z) 3=z.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma cubicrootreal : forall (x:R), 0%R=Im (cubicroot x).
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition CJ := ((-/2)%R,(sqrt (3/4))%R)%C.

Lemma CJ2: CJ*CJ=-CJ-1.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma CJ3 : CJ*CJ*CJ=1%C.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Cval2 : RtoC 2=RtoC 1+RtoC 1.
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma Cval3 : RtoC 3=RtoC 1+RtoC 1+RtoC 1.
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma Cval4: (RtoC 4=(RtoC 1+RtoC 1)*(RtoC 1+RtoC 1)).
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma Cval6 : RtoC 6=(RtoC 1+RtoC 1+RtoC 1)*(RtoC 1+RtoC 1).
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma Cval8 : RtoC 8=(RtoC 1+RtoC 1)*(RtoC 1+RtoC 1)*(RtoC 1+RtoC 1).
Proof.
Admitted.


Lemma shiftdeg3 : forall u:C, forall a b c:C, forall z:C, 
Cpow (z+u) 3+a*Cpow (z+u) 2+b*(z+u)+c
=Cpow z 3+(a+3*u)*Cpow z 2+(b+2*u*a+3*Cpow u 2)*z+(c+b*u+a*Cpow u 2+Cpow u 3).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma permprod: forall e f g:C,  g*f*e=e*g*f.
Proof.
Admitted.

Ltac nneq0:=unfold RtoC;
injection;
intro;
lra.

Ltac developall:=
  unfold Cpow;
  repeat (try Csimpl;
          try rewrite Cmult_plus_distr_r;
          try rewrite Cmult_plus_distr_l);
  repeat (
          repeat rewrite (permprod CJ);
          repeat rewrite Cmult_assoc).




Definition Cardan_Tartaglia_formula:=fun (a1:C) (a2:C) (a3:C) (n:nat) =>
let s:=-a1/3 in 
let p:=a2+2*s*a1+3*Cpow s 2 in
let q:=a3+a2*s+a1*Cpow s 2+Cpow s 3 in
let Delta:=(Cpow (q/2) 2)+(Cpow (p/3) 3) in
let alpha : C :=if(Ceq_dec p 0) then (RtoC 0) else (cubicroot (-(q/2)+Csqrt Delta)) in
let beta:=if(Ceq_dec p 0) then -cubicroot q else -(p/3)/alpha in
s+(alpha*Cpow CJ n+beta*Cpow CJ (n+n)).


Theorem Cardan_Tartaglia : forall a1 a2 a3 :C,
let u1:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 0) in
let u2:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 1) in
let u3:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 2) in
forall u:C, (u-u1)*(u-u2)*(u-u3)=Cpow u 3+a1*Cpow u 2+a2*u+a3.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma shiftdeg4 : forall u:C, forall a b c d:C, forall z:C, 
Cpow (z+u) 4+a*Cpow (z+u) 3+b*Cpow (z+u) 2+c*(z+u)+d
=Cpow z 4+(a+4*u)*Cpow z 3+(b+3*u*a+6*Cpow u 2)*Cpow z 2
 +(c+2*b*u+3*a*Cpow u 2+4*Cpow u 3)*z+(d+c*u+b*Cpow u 2+a*Cpow u 3+Cpow u 4).
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition binom_solution:= fun (b:C) (c:C) (n:nat) =>
-b/2+(Csqrt (Cpow (b/2) 2-c))*Cpow (-1) n.

Lemma Binom_solution_proof : forall (b:C) (c:C), forall z:C,
Cpow z 2+b*z+c=(z-binom_solution b c 0)*(z-binom_solution b c 1).
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Ferrari_formula: forall (a:C) (b:C) (c:C) (d:C), 
let s:=-a/4 in 
let p:= b+3*s*a+6*Cpow s 2 in
let q:= c+2*b*s+3*a*Cpow s 2+4*Cpow s 3 in
let r:= d+c*s+b*Cpow s 2+a*Cpow s 3+Cpow s 4 in
let lambda:=Cardan_Tartaglia_formula (-p/2) (-r) (r*p/2-/8*Cpow q 2) 0 in
let A:=Csqrt(2*lambda-p) in
let cond:=(Ceq_dec (2*lambda) p) in
let B:=if cond then (RtoC 0) else (-q/(2*A)) in
let z1:=if cond then Csqrt (binom_solution p r 0) 
                else binom_solution A (B+lambda) 0 in
let z2:=if cond then -Csqrt (binom_solution p r 0) 
                else binom_solution A (B+lambda) 1 in
let z3:=if cond then Csqrt (binom_solution p r 1) 
                else binom_solution (-A) (-B+lambda) 0 in
let z4:=if cond then -Csqrt (binom_solution p r 1) 
                else binom_solution (-A) (-B+lambda) 1 in
let u1:=z1+s in
let u2:=z2+s in
let u3:=z3+s in
let u4:=z4+s in
forall u:C, (u-u1)*(u-u2)*(u-u3)*(u-u4)=Cpow u 4+a*Cpow u 3+b*Cpow u 2+c*u+d.
Proof.
Admitted.
