section \<open>Algorithms to compute all complex and real roots of a cubic polynomial\<close>

theory Cubic_Polynomials
  imports 
    Cardanos_Formula
    Complex_Roots
begin

text \<open>The real case where a result is only delivered if the discriminant is negative\<close>

definition solve_depressed_cubic_Cardano_real :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real option" where
  "solve_depressed_cubic_Cardano_real e f = (
    if e = 0 then Some (root 3 (-f)) else
     let v = - (e ^ 3 / 27) in
     case rroots2 [:v,f,1:] of 
       [u,_] \<Rightarrow> let rt = root 3 u in Some (rt - e / (3 * rt))
     | _ \<Rightarrow> None)" 

lemma solve_depressed_cubic_Cardano_real: 
  assumes "solve_depressed_cubic_Cardano_real e f = Some y" 
  shows "{y. y^3 + e * y + f = 0} = {y}"
  by sorry

text \<open>The complex case\<close>

definition solve_depressed_cubic_complex :: "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex list" where
  "solve_depressed_cubic_complex e f = (let
          ys = (if e = 0 then all_croots 3 (- f) else (let
       u = hd (croots2 [: - (e ^ 3 / 27) ,f,1:]); 
       zs = all_croots 3 u 
       in map (\<lambda> z. z - e / (3 * z)) zs))
      in remdups ys)" 

lemma solve_depressed_cubic_complex_code[code]: 
  "solve_depressed_cubic_complex e f = (let
          ys = (if e = 0 then all_croots 3 (- f) else (let
            f2 = f / 2;
            u = - f2 + csqrt (f2^2 + e ^ 3 / 27);
            zs = all_croots 3 u 
            in map (\<lambda> z. z - e / (3 * z)) zs))
      in remdups ys)" 
  by sorry


lemma solve_depressed_cubic_complex: "y \<in> set (solve_depressed_cubic_complex e f) 
  \<longleftrightarrow> (y^3 + e * y + f = 0)"
  by sorry

text \<open>For the general real case, we first try Cardano with negative discrimiant and only if it is not applicable,
   then we go for the calculation using complex numbers. Note that for for non-negative delta 
   no filter is required to identify the real roots from the list of complex roots, since in that case we 
   already know that all roots are real.\<close>
definition solve_depressed_cubic_real :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "solve_depressed_cubic_real e f = (case solve_depressed_cubic_Cardano_real e f 
      of Some y \<Rightarrow> [y] 
       | None \<Rightarrow> map Re (solve_depressed_cubic_complex (of_real e) (of_real f)))"

lemma solve_depressed_cubic_real_code[code]: "solve_depressed_cubic_real e f =
  (if e = 0 then [root 3 (-f)] else 
   let v = e ^ 3 / 27; 
       f2 = f / 2;
       f2v = f2^2 + v in
   if f2v > 0 then 
     let u = -f2 + sqrt f2v;
         rt = root 3 u
      in [rt - e / (3 * rt)]
  else 
  let ce3 = of_real e / 3; 
      u = - of_real f2 + csqrt (of_real f2v) in
   map Re (remdups (map (\<lambda>rt. rt - ce3 / rt) (all_croots 3 u))))" 
  by sorry

lemma solve_depressed_cubic_real: "y \<in> set (solve_depressed_cubic_real e f) 
  \<longleftrightarrow> (y^3 + e * y + f = 0)" 
  by sorry

text \<open>Combining the various algorithms\<close>

lemma degree3_coeffs: "degree p = 3 \<Longrightarrow>
  \<exists> a b c d. p = [: d, c, b, a :] \<and> a \<noteq> 0"
  by sorry

definition roots3_generic :: "('a :: field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list) \<Rightarrow> 'a poly \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "roots3_generic depressed_solver p = (let 
     cs = coeffs p; 
     a = cs ! 3; b = cs ! 2; c = cs ! 1; d = cs ! 0;
     a3 = 3 * a;
     ba3 = b / a3;
     b2 = b * b;
     b3 = b2 * b;
     e = (c - b2 / a3) / a;
     f = (d + 2 * b3 / (27 * a^2) - b * c / a3) / a;
     roots = depressed_solver e f
     in map (\<lambda> y. y - ba3) roots)" 

lemma roots3_generic: assumes deg: "degree p = 3" 
  and solver: "\<And> e f y. y \<in> set (depressed_solver e f) \<longleftrightarrow> y^3 + e * y + f = 0" 
  shows "set (roots3_generic depressed_solver p) = {x. poly p x = 0}" 
  by sorry

definition croots3 :: "complex poly \<Rightarrow> complex list" where
  "croots3 = roots3_generic solve_depressed_cubic_complex"

lemma croots3: assumes deg: "degree p = 3" 
  shows "set (croots3 p) = { x. poly p x = 0}" 
  by sorry

definition rroots3 :: "real poly \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "rroots3 = roots3_generic solve_depressed_cubic_real"

lemma rroots3: assumes deg: "degree p = 3" 
  shows "set (rroots3 p) = { x. poly p x = 0}" 
  by sorry

end

title: 037_the_solution_of_a_cubic
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__037, "The Solution of a Cubic": Cardano data over
;; an arbitrary field with nonzero 2 and 3 and a primitive cube root of unity
;; characterize all three roots of a nondegenerate cubic, in the zero and
;; nonzero cases of its normalized depressed linear coefficient. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ function objects present the carrier and field operations.
;; FN-EQUAL with a constant-true function gives unbounded universal
;; quantification over the ACL2 universe, with the carrier predicate restricting
;; the field laws to the represented field. Thus the carrier may be infinite
;; and the operations are genuine functions rather than finite tables.

(defun ht037-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun ht037-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (ht037-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (ht037-quoted nil)))

(defun ht037-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (ht037-quoted function)
        (ht037-term-list arguments)))

(defun ht037-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht037-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (ht037-quoted nil))
    (ht037-quoted t)))

(defun ht037-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (ht037-quoted nil)
        (ht037-quoted t)))

(defun ht037-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (ht037-quoted t)))

(defun ht037-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht037-quoted t)))

(defun ht037-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (ht037-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun ht037-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht037-value1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun ht037-value2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

;; An arbitrary nontrivial commutative field.

(defun ht037-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (ht037-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (ht037-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (ht037-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (ht037-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (ht037-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (ht037-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht037-implies-term
      (ht037-and-terms
       (list (ht037-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
             (ht037-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
             (ht037-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht037-and-terms
       (list
        (ht037-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (ht037-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (ht037-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (ht037-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (ht037-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (ht037-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (ht037-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (ht037-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (ht037-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (ht037-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (ht037-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht037-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (ht037-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (ht037-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (ht037-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))
        (ht037-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (ht037-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (ht037-quoted zero)))
        (ht037-implies-term
         (ht037-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (ht037-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (ht037-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (ht037-quoted one)))))))))

(defun ht037-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let ((laws
         (ht037-field-laws-function
          carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp multiply)
     (tamep-functionp negate)
     (tamep-functionp inverse)
     (ht037-member-p carrier zero)
     (ht037-member-p carrier one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (ht037-universal-p laws '(x y z)))))

(defun ht037-all-members-p (carrier objects)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and (ht037-member-p carrier (car objects))
           (ht037-all-members-p carrier (cdr objects)))
    t))

;; Field arithmetic used by the statement.

(defun ht037-add (add x y)
  (ht037-value2 add x y))

(defun ht037-mul (multiply x y)
  (ht037-value2 multiply x y))

(defun ht037-neg (negate x)
  (ht037-value1 negate x))

(defun ht037-inv (inverse x)
  (ht037-value1 inverse x))

(defun ht037-sub (add negate x y)
  (ht037-add add x (ht037-neg negate y)))

(defun ht037-div (multiply inverse x y)
  (ht037-mul multiply x (ht037-inv inverse y)))

(defun ht037-square (multiply x)
  (ht037-mul multiply x x))

(defun ht037-cube (multiply x)
  (ht037-mul multiply x (ht037-square multiply x)))

(defun ht037-two (add one)
  (ht037-add add one one))

(defun ht037-three (add one)
  (ht037-add add (ht037-two add one) one))

(defun ht037-nine (add multiply one)
  (ht037-square multiply (ht037-three add one)))

(defun ht037-twenty-seven (add multiply one)
  (ht037-mul
   multiply
   (ht037-nine add multiply one)
   (ht037-three add one)))

(defun ht037-fifty-four (add multiply one)
  (ht037-mul
   multiply
   (ht037-two add one)
   (ht037-twenty-seven add multiply one)))

(defun ht037-cardano-p
    (add multiply negate inverse a b c one)
  (let* ((three (ht037-three add one))
         (nine (ht037-nine add multiply one))
         (numerator
          (ht037-sub
           add negate
           (ht037-mul
            multiply
            (ht037-mul multiply three a)
            c)
           (ht037-square multiply b)))
         (denominator
          (ht037-mul
           multiply nine (ht037-square multiply a))))
    (ht037-div multiply inverse numerator denominator)))

(defun ht037-cardano-q
    (add multiply negate inverse a b c d one)
  (let* ((two (ht037-two add one))
         (nine (ht037-nine add multiply one))
         (twenty-seven
          (ht037-twenty-seven add multiply one))
         (fifty-four
          (ht037-fifty-four add multiply one))
         (a-squared (ht037-square multiply a))
         (a-cubed (ht037-cube multiply a))
         (b-cubed (ht037-cube multiply b))
         (nine-a-b-c
          (ht037-mul
           multiply
           (ht037-mul
            multiply
            (ht037-mul multiply nine a)
            b)
           c))
         (two-b-cubed
          (ht037-mul multiply two b-cubed))
         (twenty-seven-a-squared-d
          (ht037-mul
           multiply
           (ht037-mul multiply twenty-seven a-squared)
           d))
         (numerator
          (ht037-sub
           add negate
           (ht037-sub add negate nine-a-b-c two-b-cubed)
           twenty-seven-a-squared-d))
         (denominator
          (ht037-mul multiply fifty-four a-cubed)))
    (ht037-div multiply inverse numerator denominator)))

(defun ht037-cubic-value (add multiply a b c d x)
  (ht037-add
   add
   (ht037-add
    add
    (ht037-add
     add
     (ht037-mul multiply a (ht037-cube multiply x))
     (ht037-mul multiply b (ht037-square multiply x)))
    (ht037-mul multiply c x))
   d))

(defun ht037-primitive-cube-root-p (multiply omega one)
  (and (equal (ht037-cube multiply omega) one)
       (not (equal omega one))))

(defun ht037-base-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
             a b c d omega p q s x)
  (let ((two (ht037-two add one))
        (three (ht037-three add one)))
    (and
     (ht037-field-p
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
     (ht037-all-members-p
      carrier (list a b c d omega p q s x))
     (not (equal a zero))
     (not (equal two zero))
     (not (equal three zero))
     (ht037-primitive-cube-root-p multiply omega one)
     (equal
      p
      (ht037-cardano-p
       add multiply negate inverse a b c one))
     (equal
      q
      (ht037-cardano-q
       add multiply negate inverse a b c d one)))))

(defun ht037-root-characterization-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse
          a b c d omega p s tau x)
  (let* ((three (ht037-three add one))
         (shift
          (ht037-div
           multiply inverse b (ht037-mul multiply three a)))
         (omega-squared (ht037-square multiply omega))
         (root-one
          (if (equal p zero)
              (ht037-sub add negate s shift)
            (ht037-sub
             add negate
             (ht037-sub add negate s tau)
             shift)))
         (root-two
          (if (equal p zero)
              (ht037-sub
               add negate
               (ht037-mul multiply s omega)
               shift)
            (ht037-sub
             add negate
             (ht037-sub
              add negate
              (ht037-mul multiply s omega)
              (ht037-mul multiply tau omega-squared))
             shift)))
         (root-three
          (if (equal p zero)
              (ht037-sub
               add negate
               (ht037-mul multiply s omega-squared)
               shift)
            (ht037-sub
             add negate
             (ht037-sub
              add negate
              (ht037-mul multiply s omega-squared)
              (ht037-mul multiply tau omega))
             shift))))
    (equal
     (equal
      (ht037-cubic-value add multiply a b c d x)
      zero)
     (or (equal x root-one)
         (equal x root-two)
         (equal x root-three)))))

(defun hundred-theorems-037-solution-of-a-cubic-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
             a b c d omega p q r s tau x)
  (implies
   (ht037-base-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
    a b c d omega p q s x)
   (if (equal p zero)
       (implies
        (equal
         (ht037-cube multiply s)
         (ht037-mul multiply (ht037-two add one) q))
        (ht037-root-characterization-p
         zero one add multiply negate inverse
         a b c d omega p s tau x))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht037-member-p carrier r)
       (ht037-member-p carrier tau)
       (equal
        (ht037-square multiply r)
        (ht037-add
         add
         (ht037-square multiply q)
         (ht037-cube multiply p)))
       (equal
        (ht037-cube multiply s)
        (ht037-add add q r))
       (equal (ht037-mul multiply tau s) p))
      (ht037-root-characterization-p
       zero one add multiply negate inverse
       a b c d omega p s tau x)))))

;; Admission-time audit for the reified universal field-law function.

(defun ht037-reified-field-function-tame-p ()
  (let ((unary '(lambda (x) (quote t)))
        (binary '(lambda (x y) x)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp (ht037-true-function '(x)))
     (tamep-functionp
      (ht037-field-laws-function
       unary 0 1 binary binary unary unary)))))

(value-triple
 (if (ht037-reified-field-function-tame-p)
     :itpeval-tame-reified-functions-checked
   (er hard 'ht037-tameness
       "A reified statement function is not tame.")))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 037_the_solution_of_a_cubic
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of a Cubic" from Hundred Theorems item 037.
-- It states Cardano's three-root characterization in both coefficient cases and contains no proof.

module HundredTheorems037 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 2 _∨_
infix 1 _↔_

data ⊥ : Set where

¬_ : Set → Set
¬ A = A → ⊥

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = ¬ (x ≡ y)

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Field (F : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F → F → F
    negate inverse : F → F
    fromNat : Nat → F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF ≠ zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) → add x zeroF ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) → add x (negate x) ≡ zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) → multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) → multiply x oneF ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) → multiply x zeroF ≡ zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF ≡ zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) →
      x ≠ zeroF →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ oneF

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero ≡ zeroF
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) → fromNat (suc n) ≡ add (fromNat n) oneF
    two-not-zero :
      fromNat (suc (suc zero)) ≠ zeroF
    three-not-zero :
      fromNat (suc (suc (suc zero))) ≠ zeroF

power :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  Nat →
  F
power algebra x zero =
  Field.oneF algebra
power algebra x (suc n) =
  Field.multiply algebra x (power algebra x n)

subtract :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
subtract algebra x y =
  Field.add algebra x (Field.negate algebra y)

divide :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
divide algebra x y =
  Field.multiply algebra x (Field.inverse algebra y)

scale :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  Nat →
  F →
  F
scale algebra n x =
  Field.multiply algebra (Field.fromNat algebra n) x

product3 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
product3 algebra x y z =
  Field.multiply algebra (Field.multiply algebra x y) z

cubicValue :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
cubicValue algebra a b c d x =
  Field.add algebra
    (Field.add algebra
      (Field.add algebra
        (Field.multiply algebra a (power algebra x 3))
        (Field.multiply algebra b (power algebra x 2)))
      (Field.multiply algebra c x))
    d

depressedP :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedP algebra a b c =
  divide algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (scale algebra 3 (Field.multiply algebra a c))
      (power algebra b 2))
    (scale algebra 9 (power algebra a 2))

depressedQNumerator :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedQNumerator algebra a b c d =
  subtract algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (scale algebra 9 (product3 algebra a b c))
      (scale algebra 2 (power algebra b 3)))
    (scale algebra 27
      (Field.multiply algebra (power algebra a 2) d))

depressedQ :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedQ algebra a b c d =
  divide algebra
    (depressedQNumerator algebra a b c d)
    (scale algebra 54 (power algebra a 3))

cubicOffset :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
cubicOffset algebra a b =
  divide algebra b (scale algebra 3 a)

PrimitiveCubeRoot :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  Set
PrimitiveCubeRoot algebra omega =
  power algebra omega 3 ≡ Field.oneF algebra ∧
  omega ≠ Field.oneF algebra

nonzeroRoot1 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot1 algebra a b s t =
  subtract algebra
    (subtract algebra s t)
    (cubicOffset algebra a b)

nonzeroRoot2 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot2 algebra a b omega s t =
  subtract algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (Field.multiply algebra s omega)
      (Field.multiply algebra t (power algebra omega 2)))
    (cubicOffset algebra a b)

nonzeroRoot3 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot3 algebra a b omega s t =
  subtract algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (Field.multiply algebra s (power algebra omega 2))
      (Field.multiply algebra t omega))
    (cubicOffset algebra a b)

zeroRoot1 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
zeroRoot1 algebra a b s =
  subtract algebra s (cubicOffset algebra a b)

zeroRoot2 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
zeroRoot2 algebra a b omega s =
  subtract algebra
    (Field.multiply algebra s omega)
    (cubicOffset algebra a b)

zeroRoot3 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
zeroRoot3 algebra a b omega s =
  subtract algebra
    (Field.multiply algebra s (power algebra omega 2))
    (cubicOffset algebra a b)

ThreeRootCases :
  {F : Set} →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  Set
ThreeRootCases x root1 root2 root3 =
  x ≡ root1 ∨
  x ≡ root2 ∨
  x ≡ root3

cubic-nonzero-case : Set₁
cubic-nonzero-case =
  (F : Set) →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (a b c d omega p q r s t x : F) →
  a ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  PrimitiveCubeRoot algebra omega →
  p ≡ depressedP algebra a b c →
  p ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  q ≡ depressedQ algebra a b c d →
  power algebra r 2 ≡
    Field.add algebra
      (power algebra q 2)
      (power algebra p 3) →
  power algebra s 3 ≡ Field.add algebra q r →
  Field.multiply algebra t s ≡ p →
  cubicValue algebra a b c d x ≡ Field.zeroF algebra ↔
  ThreeRootCases x
    (nonzeroRoot1 algebra a b s t)
    (nonzeroRoot2 algebra a b omega s t)
    (nonzeroRoot3 algebra a b omega s t)

cubic-zero-case : Set₁
cubic-zero-case =
  (F : Set) →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (a b c d omega q s x : F) →
  a ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  PrimitiveCubeRoot algebra omega →
  subtract algebra
    (scale algebra 3 (Field.multiply algebra a c))
    (power algebra b 2)
    ≡ Field.zeroF algebra →
  q ≡ depressedQ algebra a b c d →
  power algebra s 3 ≡ scale algebra 2 q →
  cubicValue algebra a b c d x ≡ Field.zeroF algebra ↔
  ThreeRootCases x
    (zeroRoot1 algebra a b s)
    (zeroRoot2 algebra a b omega s)
    (zeroRoot3 algebra a b omega s)

record CubicFormula : Set₁ where
  field
    cardano-nonzero-case :
      cubic-nonzero-case
    cardano-zero-case :
      cubic-zero-case

hundred-theorems-037 : Set₁
hundred-theorems-037 =
  CubicFormula

(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of a Cubic" from Hundred Theorems item 037. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open complexTheory;

val solution_of_a_cubic =
  ``!a b c d p q r s t omega x : complex.
      a <> 0 /\
      p = (3 * a * c - b pow 2) / (9 * a pow 2) /\
      q =
        (9 * a * b * c - 2 * b pow 3 - 27 * a pow 2 * d) /
        (54 * a pow 3) /\
      omega pow 3 = 1 /\
      omega <> 1 /\
      (if p = 0 then
         s pow 3 = 2 * q
       else
         r pow 2 = q pow 2 + p pow 3 /\
         s pow 3 = q + r /\
         t * s = p)
      ==>
      (if p = 0 then
         (a * x pow 3 + b * x pow 2 + c * x + d = 0 <=>
          x = s - b / (3 * a) \/
          x = s * omega - b / (3 * a) \/
          x = s * omega pow 2 - b / (3 * a))
       else
         s <> 0 /\
         (a * x pow 3 + b * x pow 2 + c * x + d = 0 <=>
          x = s - t - b / (3 * a) \/
          x = s * omega - t * omega pow 2 - b / (3 * a) \/
          x = s * omega pow 2 - t * omega - b / (3 * a)))``;

title: 037_the_solution_of_a_cubic
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of a Cubic" from Hundred
  Theorems item 037: Cardano's two-case characterization of all complex roots
  of a general cubic equation. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The imported set.mm database supplies the standard complex numbers CC,
  complex arithmetic, natural-number powers, equality, logical connectives,
  and restricted universal quantifiers.

  The condition w ^ 3 = 1 and w =/= 1 says that w is a primitive cube root of
  unity over CC. In the first assertion, p and q are the depressed-cubic
  coefficients, p is nonzero, r is a square root of q^2 + p^3, s is a cube
  root of q + r, and t*s = p. The conclusion characterizes exactly the three
  roots of the original cubic.

  The second assertion is the complementary case p = 0, written as
  3*a*c - b^2 = 0. A cube root s of 2*q gives the three roots after the same
  translation. Both declarations are unproved $a statements and add no proof
  to set.mm.
$)

hundred-theorems-037-cardano-nonzero-p $a

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of a Cubic" from Hundred Theorems item 037.
:: It states Cardano's formulas for all complex roots in the nonzero and zero cases and contains
:: no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, SQUARE_1, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_1, NEWTON;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
    COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, COMPLEX1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

:: Cardano's formula when the depressed cubic coefficient is nonzero.
::$P-
theorem
  for a, b, c, d, p, q, r, s, t, w, x being Complex st
    a <> 0 &
    w |^ 3 = 1 &
    w <> 1 &
    p = (3 * a * c - b |^ 2) / (9 * (a |^ 2)) &
    p <> 0 &
    q = (9 * a * b * c - 2 * (b |^ 3) - 27 * (a |^ 2) * d) /
      (54 * (a |^ 3)) &
    r |^ 2 = q |^ 2 + p |^ 3 &
    s |^ 3 = q + r &
    t * s = p
  holds
    (a * (x |^ 3) + b * (x |^ 2) + c * x + d = 0 iff
      x = s - t - b / (3 * a) or
      x = s * w - t * (w |^ 2) - b / (3 * a) or
      x = s * (w |^ 2) - t * w - b / (3 * a))
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Cardano's formula when the depressed cubic coefficient is zero.
::$P-
theorem
  for a, b, c, d, q, s, w, x being Complex st
    a <> 0 &
    w |^ 3 = 1 &
    w <> 1 &
    3 * a * c - b |^ 2 = 0 &
    q = (9 * a * b * c - 2 * (b |^ 3) - 27 * (a |^ 2) * d) /
      (54 * (a |^ 3)) &
    s |^ 3 = 2 * q
  holds
    (a * (x |^ 3) + b * (x |^ 2) + c * x + d = 0 iff
      x = s - b / (3 * a) or
      x = s * w - b / (3 * a) or
      x = s * (w |^ 2) - b / (3 * a))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 037_the_solution_of_a_cubic
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of a Cubic" from Hundred Theorems item 037. This
% file contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 037, "The Solution of a Cubic": Cardano's formulas characterize all
% complex roots of every cubic with nonzero leading coefficient, separating the cases where the
% depressed cubic's linear parameter is zero or nonzero. This statement-only encoding contains
% no proof.

hundred_theorems_037: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  complex_inv(x: complex): complex =
    LET denominator: real =
      real_part(x) * real_part(x)
        + imag_part(x) * imag_part(x)
    IN
      (# real_part := safe_div(real_part(x), denominator),
         imag_part := safe_div(-imag_part(x), denominator) #)

  complex_div(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(x, complex_inv(y))

  complex_power(x: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  cubic_value(a, b, c, d, x: complex): complex =
    complex_add(
      complex_add(
        complex_add(
          complex_mul(a, complex_power(x, 3)),
          complex_mul(b, complex_power(x, 2))),
        complex_mul(c, x)),
      d)

  cardano_p(a, b, c: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      complex_sub(
        complex_mul(complex_mul(complex_of_real(3), a), c),
        complex_power(b, 2)),
      complex_mul(complex_of_real(9), complex_power(a, 2)))

  cardano_q(a, b, c, d: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      complex_sub(
        complex_sub(
          complex_mul(
            complex_mul(
              complex_mul(complex_of_real(9), a),
              b),
            c),
          complex_mul(complex_of_real(2), complex_power(b, 3))),
        complex_mul(
          complex_mul(complex_of_real(27), complex_power(a, 2)),
          d)),
      complex_mul(complex_of_real(54), complex_power(a, 3)))

  depression_shift(a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      b,
      complex_mul(complex_of_real(3), a))

  shifted_root(y, a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_sub(y, depression_shift(a, b))

  primitive_cube_root(omega: complex): bool =
    complex_power(omega, 3) = complex_one
      AND NOT (omega = complex_one)

  p_zero_cardano_solution(
      a, b, c, d, q: complex): bool =
    FORALL (s, omega: complex):
      primitive_cube_root(omega)
        AND complex_power(s, 3)
          = complex_mul(complex_of_real(2), q)
        IMPLIES (FORALL (x: complex):
          cubic_value(a, b, c, d, x) = complex_zero
            IFF
          x = shifted_root(s, a, b)
            OR x = shifted_root(complex_mul(s, omega), a, b)
            OR x = shifted_root(
              complex_mul(s, complex_power(omega, 2)),
              a,
              b))

  p_nonzero_cardano_solution(
      a, b, c, d, p, q: complex): bool =
    FORALL (r, s, t, omega: complex):
      primitive_cube_root(omega)
        AND complex_power(r, 2)
          = complex_add(
              complex_power(q, 2),
              complex_power(p, 3))
        AND complex_power(s, 3) = complex_add(q, r)
        AND complex_mul(t, s) = p
        IMPLIES (FORALL (x: complex):
          cubic_value(a, b, c, d, x) = complex_zero
            IFF
          x = shifted_root(complex_sub(s, t), a, b)
            OR x = shifted_root(
              complex_sub(
                complex_mul(s, omega),
                complex_mul(t, complex_power(omega, 2))),
              a,
              b)
            OR x = shifted_root(
              complex_sub(
                complex_mul(s, complex_power(omega, 2)),
                complex_mul(t, omega)),
              a,
              b))

  the_solution_of_a_cubic: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, d: complex):
      NOT (a = complex_zero)
        IMPLIES
      ((cardano_p(a, b, c) = complex_zero
          AND p_zero_cardano_solution(
            a,
            b,
            c,
            d,
            cardano_q(a, b, c, d)))
        OR
       (NOT (cardano_p(a, b, c) = complex_zero)
          AND p_nonzero_cardano_solution(
            a,
            b,
            c,
            d,
            cardano_p(a, b, c),
            cardano_q(a, b, c, d))))
END hundred_theorems_037

title: 038_arithmetic_mean___geometric_mean
content:
/-

Authors: Yury Kudryashov, Sébastien Gouëzel, Rémy Degenne, Jireh Loreaux

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Expect
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Jensen
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.SpecificFunctions.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NNReal
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.ConjExponents

/-!
# Mean value inequalities

In this file we prove several inequalities for finite sums, including AM-GM inequality,
HM-GM inequality, Young's inequality, Hölder inequality, and Minkowski inequality. Versions for
integrals of some of these inequalities are available in
`Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/MeanInequalities.lean`.

## Main theorems

### AM-GM inequality:

The inequality says that the geometric mean of a tuple of non-negative numbers is less than or equal
to their arithmetic mean. We prove the weighted version of this inequality: if $w$ and $z$
are two non-negative vectors and $\sum_{i\in s} w_i=1$, then
$$
\prod_{i\in s} z_i^{w_i} ≤ \sum_{i\in s} w_iz_i.
$$
The classical version is a special case of this inequality for $w_i=\frac{1}{n}$.

We prove a few versions of this inequality. Each of the following lemmas comes in two versions:
a version for real-valued non-negative functions is in the `Real` namespace, and a version for
`NNReal`-valued functions is in the `NNReal` namespace.

- `geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted` : weighted version for functions on `Finset`s;
- `geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted` : weighted version for two numbers;
- `geom_mean_le_arith_mean3_weighted` : weighted version for three numbers;
- `geom_mean_le_arith_mean4_weighted` : weighted version for four numbers.


### HM-GM inequality:

The inequality says that the harmonic mean of a tuple of positive numbers is less than or equal
to their geometric mean. We prove the weighted version of this inequality: if $w$ and $z$
are two positive vectors and $\sum_{i\in s} w_i=1$, then
$$
1/(\sum_{i\in s} w_i/z_i) ≤ \prod_{i\in s} z_i^{w_i}
$$
The classical version is proven as a special case of this inequality for $w_i=\frac{1}{n}$.

The inequalities are proven only for real-valued positive functions on `Finset`s, and namespaced in
`Real`. The weighted version follows as a corollary of the weighted AM-GM inequality.

### Young's inequality

Young's inequality says that for non-negative numbers `a`, `b`, `p`, `q` such that
$\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=1$ we have
$$
ab ≤ \frac{a^p}{p} + \frac{b^q}{q}.
$$

This inequality is a special case of the AM-GM inequality. It is then used to prove Hölder's
inequality (see below).

### Hölder's inequality

The inequality says that for two conjugate exponents `p` and `q` (i.e., for two positive numbers
such that $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=1$) and any two non-negative vectors their inner product is
less than or equal to the product of the $L_p$ norm of the first vector and the $L_q$ norm of the
second vector:
$$
\sum_{i\in s} a_ib_i ≤ \sqrt[p]{\sum_{i\in s} a_i^p}\sqrt[q]{\sum_{i\in s} b_i^q}.
$$

We give versions of this result in `ℝ`, `ℝ≥0` and `ℝ≥0∞`.

There are at least two short proofs of this inequality. In our proof we prenormalize both vectors,
then apply Young's inequality to each $a_ib_i$. Another possible proof would be to deduce this
inequality from the generalized mean inequality for well-chosen vectors and weights.

### Minkowski's inequality

The inequality says that for `p ≥ 1` the function
$$
\|a\|_p=\sqrt[p]{\sum_{i\in s} a_i^p}
$$
satisfies the triangle inequality $\|a+b\|_p\le \|a\|_p+\|b\|_p$.

We give versions of this result in `Real`, `ℝ≥0` and `ℝ≥0∞`.

We deduce this inequality from Hölder's inequality. Namely, Hölder inequality implies that $\|a\|_p$
is the maximum of the inner product $\sum_{i\in s}a_ib_i$ over `b` such that $\|b\|_q\le 1$. Now
Minkowski's inequality follows from the fact that the maximum value of the sum of two functions is
less than or equal to the sum of the maximum values of the summands.

## TODO

- each inequality `A ≤ B` should come with a theorem `A = B ↔ _`; one of the ways to prove them
  is to define `StrictConvexOn` functions.
- generalized mean inequality with any `p ≤ q`, including negative numbers;
- prove that the power mean tends to the geometric mean as the exponent tends to zero.

-/

public section


universe u v

open Finset NNReal ENNReal
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι)

section GeomMeanLEArithMean

/-! ### AM-GM inequality -/


namespace Real

/-- **AM-GM inequality**: The geometric mean is less than or equal to the arithmetic mean, weighted
version for real-valued nonnegative functions. -/
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted (w z : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (hw' : 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, w i) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, w i)⁻¹ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i) / (∑ i ∈ s, w i) := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_weighted_of_constant (w z : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → z i = x) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = x :=
  calc
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = ∏ i ∈ s, x ^ w i := by sorry
theorem arith_mean_weighted_of_constant (w z : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1)
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → z i = x) : ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i = x :=
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * x := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_eq_arith_mean_weighted_of_constant (w z : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → z i = x) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_eq_arith_mean_weighted_iff' (w z : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ↔ ∀ j ∈ s, z j = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_eq_arith_mean_weighted_iff (w z : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ↔ ∀ j ∈ s, w j ≠ 0 → z j = ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_lt_arith_mean_weighted_iff_of_pos (w z : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i)
    (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i < ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ↔ ∃ j ∈ s, ∃ k ∈ s, z j ≠ z k := by sorry
end Real

namespace NNReal

/-- **AM-GM inequality**: The geometric mean is less than or equal to the arithmetic mean, weighted
version for `NNReal`-valued functions. -/
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted (w z : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ (w i : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i :=
  mod_cast
    Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted _ _ _ (fun i _ => (w i).coe_nonneg)
      (by assumption_mod_cast) fun i _ => (z i).coe_nonneg

/-- **AM-GM inequality**: The geometric mean is less than or equal to the arithmetic mean, weighted
version for two `NNReal` numbers. -/
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted (w₁ w₂ p₁ p₂ : ℝ≥0) :
    w₁ + w₂ = 1 → p₁ ^ (w₁ : ℝ) * p₂ ^ (w₂ : ℝ) ≤ w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean3_weighted (w₁ w₂ w₃ p₁ p₂ p₃ : ℝ≥0) :
    w₁ + w₂ + w₃ = 1 →
      p₁ ^ (w₁ : ℝ) * p₂ ^ (w₂ : ℝ) * p₃ ^ (w₃ : ℝ) ≤ w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ + w₃ * p₃ := by sorry
theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean4_weighted (w₁ w₂ w₃ w₄ p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : ℝ≥0) :
    w₁ + w₂ + w₃ + w₄ = 1 →
      p₁ ^ (w₁ : ℝ) * p₂ ^ (w₂ : ℝ) * p₃ ^ (w₃ : ℝ) * p₄ ^ (w₄ : ℝ) ≤
        w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ + w₃ * p₃ + w₄ * p₄ := by sorry
end NNReal

namespace Real

theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted {w₁ w₂ p₁ p₂ : ℝ} (hw₁ : 0 ≤ w₁) (hw₂ : 0 ≤ w₂)
    (hp₁ : 0 ≤ p₁) (hp₂ : 0 ≤ p₂) (hw : w₁ + w₂ = 1) : p₁ ^ w₁ * p₂ ^ w₂ ≤ w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ :=
  NNReal.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ ⟨w₂, hw₂⟩ ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩ <|
    NNReal.coe_inj.1 <| by assumption

theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean3_weighted {w₁ w₂ w₃ p₁ p₂ p₃ : ℝ} (hw₁ : 0 ≤ w₁) (hw₂ : 0 ≤ w₂)
    (hw₃ : 0 ≤ w₃) (hp₁ : 0 ≤ p₁) (hp₂ : 0 ≤ p₂) (hp₃ : 0 ≤ p₃) (hw : w₁ + w₂ + w₃ = 1) :
    p₁ ^ w₁ * p₂ ^ w₂ * p₃ ^ w₃ ≤ w₁ * p₁ + w₂ * p₂ + w₃ * p₃ :=
  NNReal.geom_mean_le_arith_mean3_weighted ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩ ⟨w₂, hw₂⟩ ⟨w₃, hw₃⟩ ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩
      ⟨p₃, hp₃⟩ <|
    NNReal.coe_inj.1 hw

theorem geom_mean_le_arith_mean4_weighted {w₁ w₂ w₃ w₄ p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : ℝ} (hw₁ : 0 ≤ w₁)

version for real-valued nonnegative functions. -/

section Young

/-! ### Young's inequality -/


namespace Real

/-- **Young's inequality**, a version for nonnegative real numbers. -/
theorem young_inequality_of_nonneg {a b p q : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) : a * b ≤ a ^ p / p + b ^ q / q := by sorry
theorem young_inequality (a b : ℝ) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ |a| ^ p / p + |b| ^ q / q :=
  calc
    a * b ≤ |a * b| := le_abs_self (a * b)
    _ = |a| * |b| := abs_mul a b
    _ ≤ |a| ^ p / p + |b| ^ q / q :=
      Real.young_inequality_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) (abs_nonneg b) hpq

end Real

namespace NNReal

/-- **Young's inequality**, `ℝ≥0` version. We use `{p q : ℝ≥0}` in order to avoid constructing
witnesses of `0 ≤ p` and `0 ≤ q` for the denominators. -/
theorem young_inequality (a b : ℝ≥0) {p q : ℝ≥0} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ a ^ (p : ℝ) / p + b ^ (q : ℝ) / q :=
  Real.young_inequality_of_nonneg a.coe_nonneg b.coe_nonneg hpq.coe

/-- **Young's inequality**, `ℝ≥0` version with real conjugate exponents. -/
theorem young_inequality_real (a b : ℝ≥0) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ a ^ p / Real.toNNReal p + b ^ q / Real.toNNReal q := by sorry
end NNReal

namespace ENNReal

/-- **Young's inequality**, `ℝ≥0∞` version with real conjugate exponents. -/
theorem young_inequality (a b : ℝ≥0∞) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ a ^ p / ENNReal.ofReal p + b ^ q / ENNReal.ofReal q := by sorry
end ENNReal

end Young

lemma inner_le_weight_mul_Lp_of_nonneg (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (w f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) * (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ := by sorry
theorem rpow_sum_le_const_mul_sum_rpow (hp : 1 ≤ p) :

      (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) + (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by sorry

content:
section \<open>The Weighted Arithmetic--Geometric Mean Inequality\<close>
theory Weighted_Arithmetic_Geometric_Mean
  imports Complex_Main
begin

subsection \<open>Auxiliary Facts\<close>

lemma root_powr_inverse': "0 < n \<Longrightarrow> 0 \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> root n x = x powr (1/n)"
  by sorry

lemma powr_sum_distrib_real_right:
  assumes "a \<noteq> 0"
  shows   "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a powr e x :: real) = a powr (\<Sum>x\<in>X. e x)"
  by sorry

lemma powr_sum_distrib_real_left:
  assumes "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x \<ge> 0"
  shows   "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x powr e :: real) = (\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x) powr e"
  by sorry

lemma prod_ge_pointwise_le_imp_pointwise_eq:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  assumes ge: "prod f X \<ge> prod g X"
  assumes nonneg: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> f x \<ge> 0"
  assumes pos: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> g x > 0"
  assumes le: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> f x \<le> g x" and x: "x \<in> X"
  shows   "f x = g x"
  by sorry

lemma powr_right_real_eq_iff:
  assumes "a \<ge> (0 :: real)"
  shows   "a powr x = a powr y \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0 \<or> a = 1 \<or> x = y"
  by sorry

lemma powr_left_real_eq_iff:
  assumes "a \<ge> (0 :: real)" "b \<ge> 0" "x \<noteq> 0"
  shows   "a powr x = b powr x \<longleftrightarrow> a = b"
  by sorry

lemma exp_real_eq_one_plus_iff:
  fixes x :: real
  shows "exp x = 1 + x \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>The Inequality\<close>

text \<open>
  We first prove the equality under the assumption that all the $a_i$ and $w_i$ are positive.
\<close>
lemma weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean_pos:
  fixes a w :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  assumes pos1: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x > 0"
  assumes pos2: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> w x > 0"
  assumes sum_weights: "(\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x) = 1"
  shows   "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x powr w x) \<le> (\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x * a x)"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  We can now relax the positivity assumptions to non-negativity: if one of the $a_i$ is
  zero, the theorem becomes trivial (note that $0^0 = 0$ by convention for the real-valued
  power operator \<^term>\<open>(powr) :: real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real\<close>).

  Otherwise, we can simply remove all the indices that have weight 0 and apply the
  above auxiliary version of the theorem.
\<close>
theorem weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean:
  fixes a w :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  assumes nonneg1: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x \<ge> 0"
  assumes nonneg2: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> w x \<ge> 0"
  assumes sum_weights: "(\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x) = 1"
  shows   "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x powr w x) \<le> (\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x * a x)"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  We can derive the regular arithmetic/geometric mean inequality from this by simply
  setting all the weights to $\frac{1}{n}$:
\<close>
corollary arithmetic_geometric_mean:
  fixes a :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  defines "n \<equiv> card X"
  assumes nonneg: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x \<ge> 0"
  shows   "root n (\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x) \<le> (\<Sum>x\<in>X. a x) / n"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>The Equality Case\<close>

text \<open>
  Next, we show that weighted arithmetic and geometric mean are equal if and only if all the 
  $a_i$ are equal.

  We first prove the more difficult direction as a lemmas and again first assume positivity
  of all $a_i$ and $w_i$ and will relax this somewhat later.
\<close>
lemma weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean_eq_iff_pos:
  fixes a w :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  assumes pos1: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x > 0"
  assumes pos2: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> w x > 0"
  assumes sum_weights: "(\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x) = 1"
  assumes eq: "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x powr w x) = (\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x * a x)"
  shows   "\<forall>x\<in>X. \<forall>y\<in>X. a x = a y"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  We can now show the full theorem and relax the positivity condition on the $a_i$ to
  non-negativity. This is possible because if some $a_i$ is zero and the two means
  coincide, then the product is obviously 0, but the sum can only be 0 if \<^term>\<open>all\<close>
  the $a_i$ are 0.
\<close>
theorem weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean_eq_iff:
  fixes a w :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  assumes nonneg1: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x \<ge> 0"
  assumes pos2:    "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> w x > 0"
  assumes sum_weights: "(\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x) = 1"
  shows   "(\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x powr w x) = (\<Sum>x\<in>X. w x * a x) \<longleftrightarrow> X \<noteq> {} \<and> (\<forall>x\<in>X. \<forall>y\<in>X. a x = a y)"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  Again, we derive a version for the unweighted arithmetic/geometric mean.
\<close>
corollary arithmetic_geometric_mean_eq_iff:
  fixes a :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "finite X"
  defines "n \<equiv> card X"
  assumes nonneg: "\<And>x. x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> a x \<ge> 0"
  shows   "root n (\<Prod>x\<in>X. a x) = (\<Sum>x\<in>X. a x) / n \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>X. \<forall>y\<in>X. a x = a y)"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>The Binary Version\<close>

text \<open>
  For convenience, we also derive versions for only two numbers:
\<close>
corollary weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean_binary:
  fixes w1 w2 x1 x2 :: real
  assumes "x1 \<ge> 0" "x2 \<ge> 0" "w1 \<ge> 0" "w2 \<ge> 0" "w1 + w2 = 1"
  shows   "x1 powr w1 * x2 powr w2 \<le> w1 * x1 + w2 * x2"
  by sorry

corollary weighted_arithmetic_geometric_mean_eq_iff_binary:
  fixes w1 w2 x1 x2 :: real
  assumes "x1 \<ge> 0" "x2 \<ge> 0" "w1 > 0" "w2 > 0" "w1 + w2 = 1"
  shows   "x1 powr w1 * x2 powr w2 = w1 * x1 + w2 * x2 \<longleftrightarrow> x1 = x2"
  by sorry

corollary arithmetic_geometric_mean_binary:
  fixes x1 x2 :: real
  assumes "x1 \<ge> 0" "x2 \<ge> 0"
  shows   "sqrt (x1 * x2) \<le> (x1 + x2) / 2"
  by sorry

corollary arithmetic_geometric_mean_eq_iff_binary:
  fixes x1 x2 :: real
  assumes "x1 \<ge> 0" "x2 \<ge> 0"
  shows   "sqrt (x1 * x2) = (x1 + x2) / 2 \<longleftrightarrow> x1 = x2"
  by sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 038,
;; "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean." For every nonempty finite family of
;; nonnegative elements of a linearly ordered field, the product is at most
;; the nth power of the arithmetic mean, with equality exactly when all terms
;; are equal. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defstub ht038-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht038-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht038-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht038-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht038-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub ht038-less-op (x y) t)

(defun ht038-member-p (x)
  (if (ht038-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht038-add (x y)
  (ht038-add-op x y))

(defun ht038-multiply (x y)
  (ht038-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht038-negate (x)
  (ht038-negate-op x))

(defun ht038-inverse (x)
  (ht038-inverse-op x))

(defun ht038-less (x y)
  (if (ht038-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun-sk ht038-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht038-member-p x)
      (ht038-member-p y)
      (ht038-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht038-member-p (ht038-add x y))
      (ht038-member-p (ht038-multiply x y))
      (ht038-member-p (ht038-negate x))
      (ht038-member-p (ht038-inverse x))
      (equal (ht038-add (ht038-add x y) z)
             (ht038-add x (ht038-add y z)))
      (equal (ht038-add x y)
             (ht038-add y x))
      (equal (ht038-add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht038-add x (ht038-negate x)) zero)
      (equal (ht038-multiply (ht038-multiply x y) z)
             (ht038-multiply x (ht038-multiply y z)))
      (equal (ht038-multiply x y)
             (ht038-multiply y x))
      (equal (ht038-multiply x one) x)
      (equal
       (ht038-multiply x (ht038-add y z))
       (ht038-add
        (ht038-multiply x y)
        (ht038-multiply x z)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (ht038-multiply x (ht038-inverse x))
        one))))))

(defun-sk ht038-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht038-member-p x)
      (ht038-member-p y)
      (ht038-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (ht038-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (ht038-less x y)
       (ht038-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht038-less x y)
        (ht038-less y z))
       (ht038-less x z))
      (implies
       (ht038-less x y)
       (ht038-less
        (ht038-add x z)
        (ht038-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht038-less zero x)
        (ht038-less zero y))
       (ht038-less zero (ht038-multiply x y)))))))

(defun ht038-ordered-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (ht038-member-p zero)
   (ht038-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht038-less zero one)
   (ht038-field-laws-p zero one)
   (ht038-order-laws-p zero)))

(defun ht038-nonnegative-p (zero value)
  (and
   (ht038-member-p value)
   (not (ht038-less value zero))))

(defun ht038-nonnegative-list-p (zero values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (ht038-nonnegative-p zero (car values))
       (ht038-nonnegative-list-p zero (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun ht038-sum (values zero)
  (if (consp values)
      (ht038-add
       (car values)
       (ht038-sum (cdr values) zero))
    zero))

(defun ht038-product (values one)
  (if (consp values)
      (ht038-multiply
       (car values)
       (ht038-product (cdr values) one))
    one))

(defun ht038-natural-value (n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (ht038-add
     one
     (ht038-natural-value (- n 1) zero one))))

(defun ht038-power (value n one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      one
    (ht038-multiply
     value
     (ht038-power value (- n 1) one))))

(defun ht038-all-equal-to-p (values common-value)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (equal (car values) common-value)
       (ht038-all-equal-to-p (cdr values) common-value))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun ht038-am-gm-conclusion-p (values n zero one)
  (let* ((n-value
          (ht038-natural-value n zero one))
         (mean
          (ht038-multiply
           (ht038-sum values zero)
           (ht038-inverse n-value)))
         (product
          (ht038-product values one))
         (mean-to-n
          (ht038-power mean n one))
         (all-equal
          (ht038-all-equal-to-p values (car values))))
    (and
     (not (ht038-less mean-to-n product))
     (iff (equal product mean-to-n)
          all-equal))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-038-arithmetic-mean-geometric-mean-statement
    (zero one)
  (forall (values n)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht038-ordered-field-p zero one)
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n)
      (true-listp values)
      (equal (len values) n)
      (ht038-nonnegative-list-p zero values))
     (ht038-am-gm-conclusion-p values n zero one))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean" from Hundred Theorems item
-- 038. This file contains no proof.

-- Statement-only formalization for hundred-theorems__agda__038:
-- "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean" (Hundred Theorems item 038). Every nonempty
-- finite family of nonnegative real numbers has product at most its arithmetic
-- mean raised to the size of the family. This file contains no proof.

module ArithmeticMeanGeometricMean where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero = oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals x (power reals x n)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} values =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} values =
  add reals
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> values (fsuc i)))

productFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
productFin reals {zero} values =
  oneR reals
productFin reals {suc n} values =
  multiply reals
    (values fzero)
    (productFin reals (\ i -> values (fsuc i)))

arithmetic-mean-geometric-mean : Set1
arithmetic-mean-geometric-mean =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (values : Fin (suc n) -> R) ->
  ((i : Fin (suc n)) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (values i)) ->
  lessOrEqual reals
    (productFin reals values)
    (power reals
      (divide reals
        (sumFin reals values)
        (fromNat reals (suc n)))
      (suc n))

(*
  Hundred Theorems item 038, "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean": for a nonempty finite sequence
  of nonnegative real numbers, the product is at most the nth power of its arithmetic mean.
  This is a statement-only formalization and contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val arithmetic_mean_geometric_mean =
  ``!n : num. !a : num -> real.
      1 <= n /\
      (!i. 1 <= i /\ i <= n ==> 0 <= a i)
      ==>

  nonnegative real sequence, the product is at most the corresponding power

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  All mathematical notation in the assertion is defined by set.mm. The
  function F is an arbitrary real sequence indexed by the positive natural
  numbers. Restricting it to 1 ... N therefore represents an arbitrary
  N-tuple, without replacing the sequence by a finite table.

  This is the power form of AM-GM used directly by the HOL Light and Rocq
  sources. The zero-based source formulation is obtained by successor
  reindexing. For positive N and nonnegative entries, this form is
  equivalent to the usual N-th-root comparison because raising
  nonnegative reals to the positive natural power N is order preserving.

  The final $a assertion records only the statement; there is no $p proof.
$)

hundred-theorems-038-arithmetic-geometric-mean $a
  |- ( F : NN --> RR ->
       A. N e. NN
         ( ( A. k e. ( 1 ... N ) 0 <_ ( F ` k ) ) ->
           ( prod_ k e. ( 1 ... N ) ( F ` k ) ) <_
             ( ( ( sum_ k e. ( 1 ... N ) ( F ` k ) ) / N ) ^ N ) ) )
$.

title: 038_arithmetic_mean___geometric_mean
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean" from Hundred Theorems item
% 038. This file contains no proof.

% Hundred Theorems item 038, "Arithmetic Mean / Geometric Mean": for every nonempty finite
% sequence of nonnegative real numbers, its product is at most the corresponding power of its
% arithmetic mean. This is a statement-only formalization and contains no proof.

arithmetic_mean_geometric_mean_038: THEORY
BEGIN
  prefix_sum(values: [nat -> real], count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      prefix_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  prefix_product(values: [nat -> real], count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      prefix_product(values, count - 1) * values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  arithmetic_mean_geometric_mean: bool =
    FORALL (values: [nat -> real]):
      FORALL (n: posnat):
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n IMPLIES 0 <= values(i))
        IMPLIES
          prefix_product(values, n)
            <= (prefix_sum(values, n) / (n :: real)) ^ n
END arithmetic_mean_geometric_mean_038

title: 039_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
