hide_const (open) supp


subsection \<open>Algebraic closedness\<close>

text \<open>
  We will now show that the field of formal Puiseux series over an algebraically closed field of
  characteristic 0 is again algebraically closed.

  The typeclass constraint \<^class>\<open>field_gcd\<close> is a technical constraint that mandates that
  the field has a (trivial) GCD operation defined on it. It comes from some peculiarities of
  Isabelle's typeclass system and can be considered unimportant, since any concrete type of
  class \<^class>\<open>field\<close> can easily be made an instance of \<^class>\<open>field_gcd\<close>.

  It would be possible to get rid of this constraint entirely here, but it is not worth
  the effort.

  The proof is a fairly standard one that uses Hensel's lemma. Some preliminary tricks are
  required to be able to use it, however, namely a number of non-obvious changes of variables
  to turn the polynomial with Puiseux coefficients into one with formal power series coefficients.
  The overall approach was taken from an article by Nowak~\<^cite>\<open>"nowak2000"\<close>.

  Basically, what we need to show is this: Let 
  \[p(X,Z) = a_n(Z) X^n + a_{n-1}(Z) X^{n-1} + \ldots + a_0(Z)\]
  be a polynomial in \<open>X\<close> of degree at least 2
  with coefficients that are formal Puiseux series in \<open>Z\<close>. Then \<open>p\<close> is reducible, i.e. it splits
  into two non-constant factors.

  Due to work we have already done elsewhere, we may assume here that $a_n = 1$, $a_{n-1} = 0$, and
  $a_0 \neq 0$, all of which will come in very useful.
\<close>

instance fpxs :: ("{alg_closed_field, field_char_0, field_gcd}") alg_closed_field
proof (rule alg_closedI_reducible_coeff_deg_minus_one_eq_0)
  fix p :: "'a fpxs poly"
  assume deg_p: "degree p > 1"  and lc_p: "lead_coeff p = 1"
  assume coeff_deg_minus_1: "coeff p (degree p - 1) = 0"
  assume "coeff p 0 \<noteq> 0"
  define N where "N = degree p"

  text \<open>
    Let $a_0, \ldots, a_n$ be the coefficients of \<open>p\<close> with $a_n = 1$. Now let \<open>r\<close> be the maximum of
    $-\frac{\text{val}(a_i)}{n-i}$ ranging over all $i < n$ such that $a_i \neq 0$.
  \<close>
  define r :: rat
    where "r = (MAX i\<in>{i\<in>{..<N}. coeff p i \<noteq> 0}.
                  -fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) / (rat_of_nat N - rat_of_nat i))"

  text \<open>
    We write $r = a / b$ such that all the $a_i$ can be written as Laurent series in
    $X^{1/b}$, i.e. the root orders of all the $a_i$ divide $b$:
  \<close>
  obtain a b where ab: "b > 0" "r = of_int a / of_nat b" "\<forall>i\<le>N. fpxs_root_order (coeff p i) dvd b"
  proof -
    define b where "b = lcm (nat (snd (quotient_of r))) (LCM i\<in>{..N}. fpxs_root_order (coeff p i))"
    define x where "x = b div nat (snd (quotient_of r))"
    define a where "a = fst (quotient_of r) * int x"

    show ?thesis
    proof (rule that)
      show "b > 0"
        using quotient_of_denom_pos'[of r] by (auto simp: b_def intro!: Nat.gr0I)
      have b_eq: "b = nat (snd (quotient_of r)) * x"
        by (simp add: x_def b_def)
      have "x > 0"
        using b_eq \<open>b > 0\<close> by (auto intro!: Nat.gr0I)
      have "r = rat_of_int (fst (quotient_of r)) / rat_of_int (int (nat (snd (quotient_of r))))"
        using quotient_of_denom_pos'[of r] quotient_of_div[of r] by simp
      also have "\<dots> = rat_of_int a / rat_of_nat b"
        using \<open>x > 0\<close> by (simp add: a_def b_eq)
      finally show "r = rat_of_int a / rat_of_nat b" .
      show "\<forall>i\<le>N. fpxs_root_order (poly.coeff p i) dvd b"
        by (auto simp: b_def)
    qed
  qed

  text \<open>
    We write all the coefficients of \<open>p\<close> as Laurent series in $X^{1/b}$:
  \<close>
  have "\<exists>c. coeff p i = fpxs_compose_power (fpxs_of_fls c) (1 / rat_of_nat b)" if i: "i \<le> N" for i
  proof -
    have "fpxs_root_order (coeff p i) dvd b"
      using ab(3) i by auto
    from fpxs_as_fls'[OF this \<open>b > 0\<close>] show ?thesis by metis
  qed
  then obtain c_aux where c_aux:
    "coeff p i = fpxs_compose_power (fpxs_of_fls (c_aux i)) (1 / rat_of_nat b)" if "i \<le> N" for i
    by metis
  define c where "c = (\<lambda>i. if i \<le> N then c_aux i else 0)"
  have c: "coeff p i = fpxs_compose_power (fpxs_of_fls (c i)) (1 / rat_of_nat b)" for i
    using c_aux[of i] by (auto simp: c_def N_def coeff_eq_0)
  have c_eq_0 [simp]: "c i = 0" if "i > N" for i
    using that by (auto simp: c_def)
  have c_eq: "fpxs_of_fls (c i) = fpxs_compose_power (coeff p i) (rat_of_nat b)" for i
    using c[of i] \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: fpxs_compose_power_distrib)

  text \<open>
    We perform another change of variables and multiply with a suitable power of \<open>X\<close> to turn our
    Laurent coefficients into FPS coefficients:
  \<close>
  define c' where "c' = (\<lambda>i. fls_X_intpow ((int N - int i) * a) * c i)"
  have "c' N = 1"
    using c[of N] \<open>lead_coeff p = 1\<close> \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: c'_def N_def)

  have subdegree_c: "of_int (fls_subdegree (c i)) = fpxs_val (coeff p i) * rat_of_nat b"
    if i: "i \<le> N" for i
  proof -
    have "rat_of_int (fls_subdegree (c i)) = fpxs_val (fpxs_of_fls (c i))"
      by simp
    also have "fpxs_of_fls (c i) = fpxs_compose_power (poly.coeff p i) (rat_of_nat b)"
      by (subst c_eq) auto
    also have "fpxs_val \<dots> = fpxs_val (coeff p i) * rat_of_nat b"
      using \<open>b > 0\<close> by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed

  text \<open>
    We now write all the coefficients as FPSs:
  \<close>
  have "\<exists>c''. c' i = fps_to_fls c''" if "i \<le> N" for i
  proof (cases "i = N")
    case True
    hence "c' i = fps_to_fls 1"
      using \<open>c' N = 1\<close> by simp
    thus ?thesis by metis
  next
    case i: False
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "c i = 0")
      case True
      hence "c' i = 0" by (auto simp: c'_def)
      thus ?thesis
        by (metis fps_zero_to_fls)
    next
      case False
      hence "coeff p i \<noteq> 0"
        using c_eq[of i] by auto
      hence r_ge: "r \<ge> -fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) / (rat_of_nat N - rat_of_nat i)"
        unfolding r_def using i that False by (intro Max.coboundedI) auto

      have "fls_subdegree (c' i) = fls_subdegree (c i) + (int N - int i) * a"
        using i that False by (simp add: c'_def fls_X_intpow_times_conv_shift subdegree_c)
      also have "rat_of_int \<dots> =
                   fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) * of_nat b + (of_nat N - of_nat i) * of_int a"
        using i that False by (simp add: subdegree_c)
      also have "\<dots> = of_nat b * (of_nat N - of_nat i) *
                        (fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) / (of_nat N - of_nat i) + r)"
        using \<open>b > 0\<close> i by (auto simp: field_simps ab(2))
      also have "\<dots> \<ge> 0"
        using r_ge that by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) auto
      finally have "fls_subdegree (c' i) \<ge> 0" by simp
      hence "\<exists>c''. c' i = fls_shift 0 (fps_to_fls c'')"
        by (intro fls_as_fps') (auto simp: algebra_simps)
      thus ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
  then obtain c''_aux where c''_aux: "c' i = fps_to_fls (c''_aux i)" if "i \<le> N" for i
    by metis
  define c'' where "c'' = (\<lambda>i. if i \<le> N then c''_aux i else 0)"
  have c': "c' i = fps_to_fls (c'' i)" for i
  proof (cases "i \<le> N")
    case False
    thus ?thesis by (auto simp: c'_def c''_def)
  qed (auto simp: c''_def c''_aux)
  have c''_eq: "fps_to_fls (c'' i) = c' i" for i
    using c'[of i] by simp

  define p' where "p' = Abs_poly c''"
  have coeff_p': "coeff p' = c''"
    unfolding p'_def
  proof (rule coeff_Abs_poly)
    fix i assume "i > N"
    hence "coeff p i = 0"
      by (simp add: N_def coeff_eq_0)
    thus "c'' i = 0" using c'[of i] c[of i] \<open>b > 0\<close> \<open>N < i\<close> c''_def by auto
  qed

  text \<open>
    We set up some homomorphisms to convert between the two polynomials:
  \<close>
  interpret comppow: map_poly_inj_idom_hom "(\<lambda>x::'a fpxs. fpxs_compose_power x (1/rat_of_nat b))"
    by unfold_locales (use \<open>b > 0\<close> in simp_all)
  define lift_poly :: "'a fps poly \<Rightarrow> 'a fpxs poly" where
    "lift_poly = (\<lambda>p. pcompose p [:0, fpxs_X_power r:]) \<circ>
                  (map_poly ((\<lambda>x. fpxs_compose_power x (1/rat_of_nat b)) \<circ> fpxs_of_fls \<circ> fps_to_fls))"
  have [simp]: "degree (lift_poly q) = degree q" for q
    unfolding lift_poly_def by (simp add: degree_map_poly)
  
  interpret fps_to_fls: map_poly_inj_idom_hom fps_to_fls
    by unfold_locales (simp_all add: fls_times_fps_to_fls)
  interpret fpxs_of_fls: map_poly_inj_idom_hom fpxs_of_fls
    by unfold_locales simp_all
  interpret lift_poly: inj_idom_hom lift_poly
    unfolding lift_poly_def
    by (intro inj_idom_hom_compose inj_idom_hom_pcompose inj_idom_hom.inj_idom_hom_map_poly
              fps_to_fls.base.inj_idom_hom_axioms fpxs_of_fls.base.inj_idom_hom_axioms
              comppow.base.inj_idom_hom_axioms) simp_all
  interpret lift_poly: map_poly_inj_idom_hom lift_poly
    by unfold_locales

  define C :: "'a fpxs" where "C = fpxs_X_power (- (rat_of_nat N * r))"
  have [simp]: "C \<noteq> 0"
    by (auto simp: C_def)

  text \<open>
    Now, finally: the original polynomial and the new polynomial are related through the
    \<^term>\<open>lift_poly\<close> homomorphism:
  \<close>
  have p_eq: "p = smult C (lift_poly p')"
    using \<open>b > 0\<close>
    by (intro poly_eqI)
       (simp_all add: coeff_map_poly coeff_pcompose_linear coeff_p' c c''_eq c'_def C_def
                      ring_distribs fpxs_X_power_conv_shift fpxs_shift_mult lift_poly_def ab(2)
                 flip: fpxs_X_power_add fpxs_X_power_mult fpxs_shift_add_left)
  have [simp]: "degree p' = N"
    unfolding N_def using \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: p_eq)
  have lc_p': "lead_coeff p' = 1"
    using c''_eq[of N] by (simp add: coeff_p' \<open>c' N = 1\<close>)
  have "coeff p' (N - 1) = 0"
    using coeff_deg_minus_1 \<open>b > 0\<close> unfolding N_def [symmetric]
    by (simp add: p_eq lift_poly_def coeff_map_poly coeff_pcompose_linear)

  text \<open>
    We reduce $p'(X,Z)$ to $p'(X,0)$:
  \<close>
  define p'_proj where "p'_proj = reduce_fps_poly p'"
  have [simp]: "degree p'_proj = N"
    unfolding p'_proj_def using lc_p' by (subst degree_reduce_fps_poly_monic) simp_all
  have lc_p'_proj: "lead_coeff p'_proj = 1"
    unfolding p'_proj_def using lc_p' by (subst reduce_fps_poly_monic) simp_all
  hence [simp]: "p'_proj \<noteq> 0"
    by auto
  have "coeff p'_proj (N - 1) = 0"
    using \<open>coeff p' (N - 1) = 0\<close> by (simp add: p'_proj_def reduce_fps_poly_def)

  text \<open>
    We now show that \<^term>\<open>p'_proj\<close> splits into non-trivial coprime factors. To do this, we
    have to show that it has two distinct roots, i.e. that it is not of the form $(X - c)^n$.
  \<close>
  obtain g h where gh: "degree g > 0" "degree h > 0" "coprime g h" "p'_proj = g * h"
  proof -
    have "degree p'_proj > 1"
      using deg_p by (auto simp: N_def)
    text \<open>Let \<open>x\<close> be an arbitrary root of \<^term>\<open>p'_proj\<close>:\<close>
    then obtain x where x: "poly p'_proj x = 0"
      using alg_closed_imp_poly_has_root[of p'_proj] by force

    text \<open>Assume for the sake of contradiction that \<^term>\<open>p'_proj\<close> were equal to $(1-x)^n$:\<close>
    have not_only_one_root: "p'_proj \<noteq> [:-x, 1:] ^ N"
    proof safe
      assume *: "p'_proj = [:-x, 1:] ^ N"

      text \<open>
        If \<open>x\<close> were non-zero, all the coefficients of \<open>p'_proj\<close> would also be non-zero by the
        Binomial Theorem. Since we know that the coefficient of \<open>n - 1\<close> \<^emph>\<open>is\<close> zero, this means
        that \<open>x\<close> must be zero:
      \<close>
      have "coeff p'_proj (N - 1) = 0" by fact
      hence "x = 0"
        by (subst (asm) *, subst (asm) coeff_linear_poly_power) auto

      text \<open>
        However, by our choice of \<open>r\<close>, we know that there is an index \<open>i\<close> such that \<open>c' i\<close> has
        is non-zero and has valuation (i.e. subdegree) 0, which means that the \<open>i\<close>-th coefficient
        of \<^term>\<open>p'_proj\<close> must also be non-zero.
      \<close>
      have "0 < N \<and> coeff p 0 \<noteq> 0"
        using deg_p \<open>coeff p 0 \<noteq> 0\<close> by (auto simp: N_def)
      hence "{i\<in>{..<N}. coeff p i \<noteq> 0} \<noteq> {}"
        by blast
      hence "r \<in> (\<lambda>i. -fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) / (rat_of_nat N - rat_of_nat i)) `
              {i\<in>{..<N}. coeff p i \<noteq> 0}"
        unfolding r_def using deg_p by (intro Max_in) (auto simp: N_def)
      then obtain i where i: "i < N" "coeff p i \<noteq> 0"
                             "-fpxs_val (coeff p i) / (rat_of_nat N - rat_of_nat i) = r"
        by blast
      hence [simp]: "c' i \<noteq> 0"
        using i c[of i] by (auto simp: c'_def)
      have "fpxs_val (poly.coeff p i) = rat_of_int (fls_subdegree (c i)) / rat_of_nat b"
        using subdegree_c[of i] i \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: field_simps)
      also have "fpxs_val (coeff p i) = -r * (rat_of_nat N - rat_of_nat i)"
        using i by (simp add: field_simps)
      finally have "rat_of_int (fls_subdegree (c i)) = - r * (of_nat N - of_nat i) * of_nat b"
        using \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: field_simps)
      also have "c i = fls_shift ((int N - int i) * a) (c' i)"
        using i by (simp add: c'_def ring_distribs fls_X_intpow_times_conv_shift
                         flip: fls_shifted_times_simps(2))
      also have "fls_subdegree \<dots> = fls_subdegree (c' i) - (int N - int i) * a"
        by (subst fls_shift_subdegree) auto
      finally have "fls_subdegree (c' i) = 0"
        using \<open>b > 0\<close> by (simp add: ab(2))
      hence "subdegree (coeff p' i) = 0"
        by (simp flip: c''_eq add: fls_subdegree_fls_to_fps coeff_p')
      moreover have "coeff p' i \<noteq> 0"
        using \<open>c' i \<noteq> 0\<close> c' coeff_p' by auto
      ultimately have "coeff p' i $ 0 \<noteq> 0"
        using subdegree_eq_0_iff by blast

      also have "coeff p' i $ 0 = coeff p'_proj i"
        by (simp add: p'_proj_def reduce_fps_poly_def)
      also have "\<dots> = 0"
        by (subst *, subst coeff_linear_poly_power) (use i \<open>x = 0\<close> in auto)
      finally show False by simp
    qed

    text \<open>
      We can thus obtain our second root \<open>y\<close> from the factorisation:
    \<close>
    have "\<exists>y. x \<noteq> y \<and> poly p'_proj y = 0"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume *: "\<not>(\<exists>y. x \<noteq> y \<and> poly p'_proj y = 0)"
      have "p'_proj \<noteq> 0" by simp
      then obtain A where A: "size A = degree p'_proj"
                             "p'_proj = smult (lead_coeff p'_proj) (\<Prod>x\<in>#A. [:-x, 1:])"
        using alg_closed_imp_factorization[of p'_proj] by blast
      have "set_mset A = {x. poly p'_proj x = 0}"
        using lc_p'_proj by (subst A) (auto simp: poly_prod_mset)
      also have "\<dots> = {x}"
        using x * by auto
      finally have "A = replicate_mset N x"
        using set_mset_subset_singletonD[of A x] A(1) by simp
      with A(2) have "p'_proj = [:- x, 1:] ^ N"
        using lc_p'_proj by simp
      with not_only_one_root show False 
        by contradiction
    qed
    then obtain y where "x \<noteq> y" "poly p'_proj y = 0"
      by blast

    text \<open>
      It now follows easily that \<^term>\<open>p'_proj\<close> splits into non-trivial and coprime factors:
    \<close>
    show ?thesis
    proof (rule alg_closed_imp_poly_splits_coprime)
      show "degree p'_proj > 1"
        using deg_p by (simp add: N_def)
      show "x \<noteq> y" "poly p'_proj x = 0" "poly p'_proj y = 0"
        by fact+
    qed (use that in metis)
  qed

  text \<open>
    By Hensel's lemma, these factors give rise to corresponding factors of \<open>p'\<close>:
  \<close>
  interpret hensel: fps_hensel p' p'_proj g h
  proof unfold_locales
    show "lead_coeff p' = 1"
      using lc_p' by simp
  qed (use gh \<open>coprime g h\<close> in \<open>simp_all add: p'_proj_def\<close>) 

  text \<open>All that remains now is to undo the variable substitutions we did above:\<close>
  have "p = [:C:] * lift_poly hensel.G * lift_poly hensel.H"
    unfolding p_eq by (subst hensel.F_splits) (simp add: hom_distribs)
  thus "\<not>irreducible p"
    by (rule reducible_polyI) (use hensel.deg_G hensel.deg_H gh in simp_all)
qed

text \<open>
  We do not actually show that this is the algebraic closure since this cannot be stated
  idiomatically in the typeclass setting and is probably not very useful either, but it can
  be motivated like this:

  Suppose we have an algebraically closed extension $L$ of the field of Laurent series. Clearly,
  $X^{a/b}\in L$ for any integer \<open>a\<close> and any positive integer \<open>b\<close> since
  $(X^{a/b})^b - X^a = 0$. But any Puiseux series $F(X)$ with root order \<open>b\<close> can
  be written as
  \[F(X) = \sum_{k=0}^{b-1} X^{k/b} F_k(X)\]
  where the Laurent series $F_k(X)$ are defined as follows:
  \[F_k(X) := \sum_{n = n_{0,k}}^\infty [X^{n + k/b}] F(X) X^n\]
  Thus, $F(X)$ can be written as a finite sum of products of elements in $L$ and must therefore
  also be in $L$. Thus, the Puiseux series are all contained in $L$.
\<close>


subsection \<open>Metric and topology\<close>

text \<open>
  Formal Puiseux series form a metric space with the usual metric for formal series:
  Two series are ``close'' to one another if they have many initial coefficients in common.
\<close>

instantiation fpxs :: (zero) norm
begin

definition norm_fpxs :: "'a fpxs \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "norm f = (if f = 0 then 0 else 2 powr (-of_rat (fpxs_val f)))"

instance ..

end


instantiation fpxs :: (group_add) dist
begin

definition dist_fpxs :: "'a fpxs \<Rightarrow> 'a fpxs \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "dist f g = (if f = g then 0 else 2 powr (-of_rat (fpxs_val (f - g))))"

instance ..

end


instantiation fpxs :: (group_add) metric_space
begin

definition uniformity_fpxs_def:
  "(uniformity :: ('a fpxs \<times> 'a fpxs) filter) = (INF e\<in>{0 <..}. principal {(x, y). dist x y < e})"

definition open_fpxs_def:
  "open (U :: 'a fpxs set) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>U. eventually (\<lambda>(x', y). x' = x \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U) uniformity)"

instance proof
  fix f g h :: "'a fpxs"
  show "dist f g \<le> dist f h + dist g h"
  proof (cases "f \<noteq> g \<and> f \<noteq> h \<and> g \<noteq> h")
    case True
    have "dist f g \<le> 2 powr -real_of_rat (min (fpxs_val (f - h)) (fpxs_val (g - h)))"
      using fpxs_val_add_ge[of "f - h" "h - g"] True
      by (auto simp: algebra_simps fpxs_val_minus_commute dist_fpxs_def of_rat_less_eq)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> dist f h + dist g h"
      using True by (simp add: dist_fpxs_def min_def)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed (auto simp: dist_fpxs_def fpxs_val_minus_commute)
qed (simp_all add: uniformity_fpxs_def open_fpxs_def dist_fpxs_def)

end


instance fpxs :: (group_add) dist_norm
  by standard (auto simp: dist_fpxs_def norm_fpxs_def)

lemma fpxs_const_eq_0_iff [simp]: "fpxs_const x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0"
  by sorry

lemma semiring_char_fpxs [simp]: "CHAR('a :: comm_semiring_1 fpxs) = CHAR('a)"
  by sorry

instance fpxs :: ("{semiring_prime_char,comm_semiring_1}") semiring_prime_char
  by (rule semiring_prime_charI) auto
instance fpxs :: ("{comm_semiring_prime_char,comm_semiring_1}") comm_semiring_prime_char
  by standard
instance fpxs :: ("{comm_ring_prime_char,comm_semiring_1}") comm_ring_prime_char
  by standard
instance fpxs :: ("{idom_prime_char,comm_semiring_1}") idom_prime_char
  by standard
instance fpxs :: ("field_prime_char") field_prime_char
  by standard auto

end

title: 041_puiseux_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Puiseux's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems
  artifact 041 (hundred-theorems__hol-light__041). Over an arbitrary
  algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, every nonconstant
  polynomial with formal Puiseux-series coefficients has a Puiseux-series
  root. This file contains no proof.
*)

let PUISEUXS_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
       \(z0:A) (z1:A) (fld_add:A->A->A) (fld_mul:A->A->A)
        (fld_neg:A->A) (fld_inv:A->A).
          ~(z1 = z0) /\
          (!x y. fld_add x y = fld_add y x) /\
          (!x y z. fld_add (fld_add x y) z =
                   fld_add x (fld_add y z)) /\
          (!x. fld_add x z0 = x) /\
          (!x. fld_add x (fld_neg x) = z0) /\
          (!x y. fld_mul x y = fld_mul y x) /\
          (!x y z. fld_mul (fld_mul x y) z =
                   fld_mul x (fld_mul y z)) /\
          (!x. fld_mul x z1 = x) /\
          (!x y z. fld_mul x (fld_add y z) =
                   fld_add (fld_mul x y) (fld_mul x z)) /\
          (!x. ~(x = z0) ==> fld_mul x (fld_inv x) = z1) in
   let has_characteristic_zero =
       \(z0:A) (z1:A) (fld_add:A->A->A).
          !n:num. ~(n = 0)
                  ==> ~(ITLIST fld_add (REPLICATE n z1) z0 = z0) in
   let is_algebraically_closed =
       \(z0:A) (fld_add:A->A->A) (fld_mul:A->A->A).
          !p:A list.
             (?n:num. 0 < n /\ n < LENGTH p /\ ~(EL n p = z0))
             ==> ?x:A.
                    ITLIST
                      (\a acc. fld_add a (fld_mul x acc)) p z0 = z0 in
   !z0 z1:A.
   !fld_add fld_mul:A->A->A.
   !fld_neg fld_inv:A->A.
      is_field z0 z1 fld_add fld_mul fld_neg fld_inv /\
      has_characteristic_zero z0 z1 fld_add /\
      is_algebraically_closed z0 fld_add fld_mul
      ==>
      let is_puiseux =
          \(f:real->A).
             (?b:real. !q:real. q < b ==> f q = z0) /\
             (?d:num. ~(d = 0) /\
                      !q:real. ~(f q = z0)
                               ==> ?n:int. q = real_of_int n / &d) in
      let ps_zero = \q:real. z0 in
      let ps_add =
          \(f:real->A) (g:real->A) q. fld_add (f q) (g q) in
      let ps_mul =
          \(f:real->A) (g:real->A) q.
             iterate fld_add
                     {r:real | ~(f r = z0) /\
                               ~(g(q - r) = z0)}
                     (\r. fld_mul (f r) (g(q - r))) in
      !p:(real->A)list.
         (!a. MEM a p ==> is_puiseux a) /\
         (?n:num. 0 < n /\ n < LENGTH p /\ ~(EL n p = ps_zero))
         ==> ?s:real->A.
                is_puiseux s /\
                ITLIST (\a acc. ps_add a (ps_mul s acc))
                       p ps_zero =
                ps_zero`;;

title: 041_puiseux_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__041, "Puiseux's Theorem": over an algebraically
;; closed field of characteristic zero, every positive-degree polynomial with
;; coefficients in the full field of lower-bounded, bounded-denominator
;; rational-exponent formal Puiseux series has a Puiseux-series root. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The following conservative interfaces represent an arbitrary coefficient
;; field and rational-indexed series. All typing, field laws, support
;; conditions, extensionality, and coefficient laws are hypotheses of the
;; final statement; the stubs themselves assert no mathematical facts.

(defstub ht041-base-member-p (field value) t)
(defstub ht041-base-zero (field) t)
(defstub ht041-base-one (field) t)
(defstub ht041-base-add (field left right) t)
(defstub ht041-base-mul (field left right) t)
(defstub ht041-base-neg (field value) t)
(defstub ht041-base-inv (field value) t)

(defstub ht041-series-coeff (field series exponent) t)
(defstub ht041-series-zero (field) t)
(defstub ht041-series-one (field) t)
(defstub ht041-series-monomial (field coefficient exponent) t)
(defstub ht041-series-add (field left right) t)
(defstub ht041-series-mul (field left right) t)
(defstub ht041-series-from-coefficients
  (field coefficient-function) t)

;; Coefficient-field structure.

(defun-sk ht041-base-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (ht041-base-member-p field x)
      (and
       (ht041-base-member-p field (ht041-base-neg field x))
       (ht041-base-member-p field (ht041-base-inv field x))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-add field x (ht041-base-zero field))
        x)
       (equal
        (ht041-base-add field x (ht041-base-neg field x))
        (ht041-base-zero field))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-mul field x (ht041-base-one field))
        x)
       (implies
        (not (equal x (ht041-base-zero field)))
        (equal
         (ht041-base-mul field x (ht041-base-inv field x))
         (ht041-base-one field)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht041-base-member-p field x)
       (ht041-base-member-p field y))
      (and
       (ht041-base-member-p
        field (ht041-base-add field x y))
       (ht041-base-member-p
        field (ht041-base-mul field x y))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-add field x y)
        (ht041-base-add field y x))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-mul field x y)
        (ht041-base-mul field y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ht041-base-member-p field x)
       (ht041-base-member-p field y)
       (ht041-base-member-p field z))
      (and
       (equal
        (ht041-base-add
         field (ht041-base-add field x y) z)
        (ht041-base-add
         field x (ht041-base-add field y z)))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-mul
         field (ht041-base-mul field x y) z)
        (ht041-base-mul
         field x (ht041-base-mul field y z)))
       (equal
        (ht041-base-mul
         field x (ht041-base-add field y z))
        (ht041-base-add
         field
         (ht041-base-mul field x y)
         (ht041-base-mul field x z))))))))

(defun ht041-base-field-structure-p (field)
  (and
   (ht041-base-member-p field (ht041-base-zero field))
   (ht041-base-member-p field (ht041-base-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht041-base-zero field)
     (ht041-base-one field)))
   (ht041-base-field-laws-p field)))

(defun ht041-base-nat-scalar (field n)
  (if (zp n)
      (ht041-base-zero field)
    (ht041-base-add
     field
     (ht041-base-one field)
     (ht041-base-nat-scalar field (1- n)))))

(defun-sk ht041-base-characteristic-zero-p (field)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (< 0 n))
     (not
      (equal
       (ht041-base-nat-scalar field n)
       (ht041-base-zero field))))))

;; Finite coefficient lists, in ascending degree order, are the canonical
;; representation of ordinary univariate polynomials over the base field.

(defun ht041-base-polynomial-p (field coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (ht041-base-member-p field (car coefficients))
       (ht041-base-polynomial-p field (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun ht041-leading-coefficient (coefficients)
  (if (consp (cdr coefficients))
      (ht041-leading-coefficient (cdr coefficients))
    (car coefficients)))

(defun ht041-base-positive-degree-polynomial-p
    (field coefficients)
  (and
   (ht041-base-polynomial-p field coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht041-leading-coefficient coefficients)
     (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun ht041-base-polynomial-eval
    (field coefficients argument)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht041-base-add
       field
       (car coefficients)
       (ht041-base-mul
        field
        argument
        (ht041-base-polynomial-eval
         field (cdr coefficients) argument)))
    (ht041-base-zero field)))

(defun-sk ht041-base-polynomial-has-root-p
    (field coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht041-base-member-p field root)
     (equal
      (ht041-base-polynomial-eval
       field coefficients root)
      (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun-sk ht041-base-algebraically-closed-p (field)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (ht041-base-positive-degree-polynomial-p
      field coefficients)
     (ht041-base-polynomial-has-root-p
      field coefficients))))

(defun ht041-algebraically-closed-char-zero-field-p (field)
  (and
   (ht041-base-field-structure-p field)
   (ht041-base-characteristic-zero-p field)
   (ht041-base-algebraically-closed-p field)))

;; A formal Puiseux series is a genuine coefficient function on all rational
;; exponents. Its support is bounded below and all supported exponents have a
;; common positive denominator. The condition INTEGERP(D*Q) is equivalent to
;; the reduced denominator of rational Q dividing the positive integer D.

(defun-sk ht041-series-coefficients-typed-p (field series)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (ht041-base-member-p
      field (ht041-series-coeff field series q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-support-above-p
    (field series lower-bound)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (< q lower-bound))
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff field series q)
      (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-denominator-bounded-p
    (field series common-denominator)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (not
       (equal
        (ht041-series-coeff field series q)
        (ht041-base-zero field))))
     (integerp (* common-denominator q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-support-condition-p (field series)
  (exists (lower-bound common-denominator)
    (and
     (rationalp lower-bound)
     (natp common-denominator)
     (< 0 common-denominator)
     (ht041-series-support-above-p
      field series lower-bound)
     (ht041-series-denominator-bounded-p
      field series common-denominator))))

(defun ht041-puiseux-series-p (field series)
  (and
   (ht041-series-coefficients-typed-p field series)
   (ht041-series-support-condition-p field series)))

;; APPLY$ function objects provide ACL2's native representation of function
;; arguments. The realization clauses below ensure that the series carrier
;; contains every tame coefficient function satisfying the Puiseux support
;; conditions, rather than only the finitely supported functions generated by
;; zero, one, monomials, addition, and multiplication.

(defun ht041-coefficient-function-value
    (coefficient-function exponent)
  (apply$ coefficient-function (list exponent)))

(defun-sk ht041-coefficient-function-typed-p
    (field coefficient-function)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (ht041-base-member-p
      field
      (ht041-coefficient-function-value
       coefficient-function q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-coefficient-function-support-above-p
    (field coefficient-function lower-bound)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (< q lower-bound))
     (equal
      (ht041-coefficient-function-value
       coefficient-function q)
      (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun-sk ht041-coefficient-function-denominator-bounded-p
    (field coefficient-function common-denominator)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (not
       (equal
        (ht041-coefficient-function-value
         coefficient-function q)
        (ht041-base-zero field))))
     (integerp (* common-denominator q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-coefficient-function-support-condition-p
    (field coefficient-function)
  (exists (lower-bound common-denominator)
    (and
     (rationalp lower-bound)
     (natp common-denominator)
     (< 0 common-denominator)
     (ht041-coefficient-function-support-above-p
      field coefficient-function lower-bound)
     (ht041-coefficient-function-denominator-bounded-p
      field coefficient-function common-denominator))))

(defun ht041-admissible-coefficient-function-p
    (field coefficient-function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp coefficient-function)
   (ht041-coefficient-function-typed-p
    field coefficient-function)
   (ht041-coefficient-function-support-condition-p
    field coefficient-function)))

(defun-sk ht041-series-realizes-coefficient-function-p
    (field coefficient-function series)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff field series q)
      (ht041-coefficient-function-value
       coefficient-function q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-carrier-complete-p (field)
  (forall (coefficient-function)
    (implies
     (ht041-admissible-coefficient-function-p
      field coefficient-function)
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p
       field
       (ht041-series-from-coefficients
        field coefficient-function))
      (ht041-series-realizes-coefficient-function-p
       field
       coefficient-function
       (ht041-series-from-coefficients
        field coefficient-function))))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-coefficients-equal-p
    (field left right)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff field left q)
      (ht041-series-coeff field right q)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-extensionality-p (field)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field left)
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field right)
      (ht041-series-coefficients-equal-p
       field left right))
     (equal left right))))

;; Zero, one, and every rational monomial are represented with their exact
;; coefficient functions. These clauses guarantee a nontrivial, unbounded
;; Puiseux carrier rather than a finite or tag-only surrogate.

(defun-sk ht041-series-zero-coeff-law-p (field)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff
       field (ht041-series-zero field) q)
      (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-one-coeff-law-p (field)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff
       field (ht041-series-one field) q)
      (if (equal q 0)
          (ht041-base-one field)
        (ht041-base-zero field))))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-monomial-closure-p (field)
  (forall (coefficient exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-base-member-p field coefficient)
      (rationalp exponent))
     (ht041-puiseux-series-p
      field
      (ht041-series-monomial
       field coefficient exponent)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-monomial-coeff-law-p (field)
  (forall (coefficient exponent q)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-base-member-p field coefficient)
      (rationalp exponent)
      (rationalp q))
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff
       field
       (ht041-series-monomial
        field coefficient exponent)
       q)
      (if (equal q exponent)
          coefficient
        (ht041-base-zero field))))))

;; Addition is pointwise.

(defun-sk ht041-series-add-closure-p (field)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field left)
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field right))
     (ht041-puiseux-series-p
      field (ht041-series-add field left right)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-add-coeff-law-p (field)
  (forall (left right q)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field left)
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field right)
      (rationalp q))
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff
       field (ht041-series-add field left right) q)
      (ht041-base-add
       field
       (ht041-series-coeff field left q)
       (ht041-series-coeff field right q))))))

;; Multiplication is the exact Cauchy product. For fixed Q, bounded support and
;; a common denominator make the set of nonzero contributing exponents finite.
;; INDICES is only a local witness enumerating that mathematically finite set;
;; completeness below quantifies over every rational exponent, so it is not a
;; finite-table replacement for either a series or its multiplication.

(defun ht041-contributing-exponent-p
    (field left right target exponent)
  (and
   (rationalp exponent)
   (not
    (equal
     (ht041-series-coeff field left exponent)
     (ht041-base-zero field)))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht041-series-coeff
      field right (- target exponent))
     (ht041-base-zero field)))))

(defun ht041-convolution-index-list-p
    (field left right target indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (ht041-contributing-exponent-p
        field left right target (car indices))
       (not (member-equal (car indices) (cdr indices)))
       (ht041-convolution-index-list-p
        field left right target (cdr indices)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun-sk ht041-convolution-index-complete-p
    (field left right target indices)
  (forall (exponent)
    (implies
     (ht041-contributing-exponent-p
      field left right target exponent)
     (member-equal exponent indices))))

(defun ht041-convolution-sum
    (field left right target indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (ht041-base-add
       field
       (ht041-base-mul
        field
        (ht041-series-coeff
         field left (car indices))
        (ht041-series-coeff
         field right (- target (car indices))))
       (ht041-convolution-sum
        field left right target (cdr indices)))
    (ht041-base-zero field)))

(defun-sk ht041-product-coefficient-correct-p
    (field left right target)
  (exists (indices)
    (and
     (ht041-convolution-index-list-p
      field left right target indices)
     (ht041-convolution-index-complete-p
      field left right target indices)
     (equal
      (ht041-series-coeff
       field (ht041-series-mul field left right) target)
      (ht041-convolution-sum
       field left right target indices)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-mul-closure-p (field)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field left)
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field right))
     (ht041-puiseux-series-p
      field (ht041-series-mul field left right)))))

(defun-sk ht041-series-mul-coeff-law-p (field)
  (forall (left right q)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field left)
      (ht041-puiseux-series-p field right)
      (rationalp q))
     (ht041-product-coefficient-correct-p
      field left right q))))

(defun ht041-puiseux-interface-p (field)
  (and
   (ht041-puiseux-series-p
    field (ht041-series-zero field))
   (ht041-puiseux-series-p
    field (ht041-series-one field))
   (ht041-series-zero-coeff-law-p field)
   (ht041-series-one-coeff-law-p field)
   (ht041-series-monomial-closure-p field)
   (ht041-series-monomial-coeff-law-p field)
   (ht041-series-add-closure-p field)
   (ht041-series-add-coeff-law-p field)
   (ht041-series-mul-closure-p field)
   (ht041-series-mul-coeff-law-p field)
   (ht041-series-carrier-complete-p field)
   (ht041-series-extensionality-p field)))

;; Polynomials over Puiseux series are again canonical finite coefficient
;; lists in ascending degree order. Horner evaluation uses the exact series
;; addition and Cauchy multiplication specified above.

(defun ht041-puiseux-polynomial-p (field coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (ht041-puiseux-series-p field (car coefficients))
       (ht041-puiseux-polynomial-p
        field (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun ht041-positive-degree-puiseux-polynomial-p
    (field coefficients)
  (and
   (ht041-puiseux-polynomial-p field coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht041-leading-coefficient coefficients)
     (ht041-series-zero field)))))

(defun ht041-puiseux-polynomial-eval
    (field coefficients argument)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht041-series-add
       field
       (car coefficients)
       (ht041-series-mul
        field
        argument
        (ht041-puiseux-polynomial-eval
         field (cdr coefficients) argument)))
    (ht041-series-zero field)))

(defun-sk ht041-puiseux-polynomial-has-root-p
    (field coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht041-puiseux-series-p field root)
     (equal
      (ht041-puiseux-polynomial-eval
       field coefficients root)
      (ht041-series-zero field)))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-041-puiseux-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (field coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht041-algebraically-closed-char-zero-field-p field)
      (ht041-puiseux-interface-p field)
      (ht041-positive-degree-puiseux-polynomial-p
       field coefficients))
     (ht041-puiseux-polynomial-has-root-p
      field coefficients))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 041_puiseux_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Puiseux's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems
-- item 041: formal Puiseux series over an algebraically closed field of
-- characteristic zero are algebraically closed. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data ⊥ : Set where

data ⊤ : Set where
  trivial : ⊤

¬_ : Set → Set
¬ A = A → ⊥

record Field (F : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    Equivalent : F → F → Set
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F → F → F
    negate inverse : F → F
    fromNat : Nat → F

    equivalent-reflexive :
      (x : F) → Equivalent x x
    equivalent-symmetric :
      (x y : F) → Equivalent x y → Equivalent y x
    equivalent-transitive :
      (x y z : F) →
      Equivalent x y →
      Equivalent y z →
      Equivalent x z
    add-respects-equivalence :
      (w x y z : F) →
      Equivalent w x →
      Equivalent y z →
      Equivalent (add w y) (add x z)
    multiply-respects-equivalence :
      (w x y z : F) →
      Equivalent w x →
      Equivalent y z →
      Equivalent (multiply w y) (multiply x z)
    negate-respects-equivalence :
      (x y : F) →
      Equivalent x y →
      Equivalent (negate x) (negate y)

    one-not-zero :
      ¬ Equivalent oneF zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) → Equivalent (add x y) (add y x)
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) →
      Equivalent (add (add x y) z) (add x (add y z))
    add-zero :
      (x : F) → Equivalent (add x zeroF) x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) → Equivalent (add x (negate x)) zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) → Equivalent (multiply x y) (multiply y x)
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) →
      Equivalent (multiply (multiply x y) z)
        (multiply x (multiply y z))
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) → Equivalent (multiply x oneF) x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) → Equivalent (multiply x zeroF) zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) →
      Equivalent (multiply x (add y z))
        (add (multiply x y) (multiply x z))
    inverse-zero :
      Equivalent (inverse zeroF) zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) →
      ¬ Equivalent x zeroF →
      Equivalent (multiply x (inverse x)) oneF

    fromNat-zero :
      Equivalent (fromNat zero) zeroF
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) →
      Equivalent (fromNat (suc n)) (add (fromNat n) oneF)
    characteristic-zero :
      (m n : Nat) →
      Equivalent (fromNat m) (fromNat n) →
      m ≡ n

NotEquivalent :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  Set
NotEquivalent algebra x y =
  ¬ Field.Equivalent algebra x y

evaluate :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  List F →
  F →
  F
evaluate algebra [] x =
  Field.zeroF algebra
evaluate algebra (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  Field.add algebra coefficient
    (Field.multiply algebra x (evaluate algebra coefficients x))

data HasNonzeroCoefficient
  {F : Set}
  (algebra : Field F) :
  List F → Set where

  here :
    {coefficient : F} {coefficients : List F} →
    NotEquivalent algebra coefficient (Field.zeroF algebra) →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient algebra (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

  there :
    {coefficient : F} {coefficients : List F} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient algebra coefficients →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient algebra (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

Nonconstant :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  List F →
  Set
Nonconstant algebra [] = ⊥
Nonconstant algebra (coefficient ∷ coefficients) =
  HasNonzeroCoefficient algebra coefficients

AlgebraicallyClosed :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  Set
AlgebraicallyClosed algebra =
  (coefficients : List _) →
  Nonconstant algebra coefficients →
  Σ _
    (λ root →
      Field.Equivalent algebra
        (evaluate algebra coefficients root)
        (Field.zeroF algebra))

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

scale : Int → Nat → Int
scale (pos m) n = pos (m * n)
scale (negsuc m) n = negative (suc m * n)

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

addInt : Int → Int → Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

data NatLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} →
    NatLessOrEqual zero n
  successor-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} →
    NatLessOrEqual m n →
    NatLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set
IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n) = NatLessOrEqual m n
IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (negsuc n) = ⊥
IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (pos n) = ⊤
IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = NatLessOrEqual n m

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

denominator : Rational → Nat
denominator q = suc (Rational.denominator-minus-one q)

RationalEquivalent : Rational → Rational → Set
RationalEquivalent x y =
  scale (Rational.numerator x) (denominator y) ≡
  scale (Rational.numerator y) (denominator x)

RationalLessOrEqual : Rational → Rational → Set
RationalLessOrEqual x y =
  IntLessOrEqual
    (scale (Rational.numerator x) (denominator y))
    (scale (Rational.numerator y) (denominator x))

RationalSum : Rational → Rational → Rational → Set
RationalSum x y z =
  scale
    (addInt
      (scale (Rational.numerator x) (denominator y))
      (scale (Rational.numerator y) (denominator x)))
    (denominator z)
  ≡
  scale (Rational.numerator z)
    (denominator x * denominator y)

SupportBoundedBelow :
  {F : Set} →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (Rational → F) →
  Set
SupportBoundedBelow algebra coefficient =
  Σ Rational
    (λ lower →
      (q : Rational) →
      NotEquivalent algebra
        (coefficient q)
        (Field.zeroF algebra) →
      RationalLessOrEqual lower q)

SupportHasCommonDenominator :
  {F : Set} →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (Rational → F) →
  Set
SupportHasCommonDenominator algebra coefficient =
  Σ Nat
    (λ common-denominator-minus-one →
      (q : Rational) →
      NotEquivalent algebra
        (coefficient q)
        (Field.zeroF algebra) →
      Σ Int
        (λ numerator →
          RationalEquivalent q
            (fraction numerator
              common-denominator-minus-one)))

record PuiseuxSeries
  (F : Set)
  (algebra : Field F) :
  Set where

  field
    coefficient : Rational → F
    respects-rational-equivalence :
      (p q : Rational) →
      RationalEquivalent p q →
      Field.Equivalent algebra (coefficient p) (coefficient q)
    support-bounded-below :
      SupportBoundedBelow algebra coefficient
    support-common-denominator :
      SupportHasCommonDenominator algebra coefficient

SeriesEquivalent :
  {F : Set} →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  PuiseuxSeries F algebra →
  PuiseuxSeries F algebra →
  Set
SeriesEquivalent algebra left right =
  (q : Rational) →
  Field.Equivalent algebra
    (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient left q)
    (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient right q)

record ExponentPair : Set where
  constructor exponent-pair
  field
    left-exponent right-exponent : Rational

data ContainsEquivalentPair
  (x y : Rational) :
  List ExponentPair →
  Set where

  pair-here :
    {pair : ExponentPair} {pairs : List ExponentPair} →
    RationalEquivalent x (ExponentPair.left-exponent pair) →
    RationalEquivalent y (ExponentPair.right-exponent pair) →
    ContainsEquivalentPair x y (pair ∷ pairs)

  pair-there :
    {pair : ExponentPair} {pairs : List ExponentPair} →
    ContainsEquivalentPair x y pairs →
    ContainsEquivalentPair x y (pair ∷ pairs)

data AllSumTo
  (q : Rational) :
  List ExponentPair →
  Set where

  sums-empty :
    AllSumTo q []

  sums-cons :
    {pair : ExponentPair} {pairs : List ExponentPair} →
    RationalSum
      (ExponentPair.left-exponent pair)
      (ExponentPair.right-exponent pair)
      q →
    AllSumTo q pairs →
    AllSumTo q (pair ∷ pairs)

data DistinctPairs : List ExponentPair → Set where
  distinct-empty :
    DistinctPairs []

  distinct-cons :
    {pair : ExponentPair} {pairs : List ExponentPair} →
    ¬ ContainsEquivalentPair
      (ExponentPair.left-exponent pair)
      (ExponentPair.right-exponent pair)
      pairs →
    DistinctPairs pairs →
    DistinctPairs (pair ∷ pairs)

CoversNonzeroPairs :
  {F : Set} →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (left right : PuiseuxSeries F algebra) →
  Rational →
  List ExponentPair →
  Set
CoversNonzeroPairs algebra left right q pairs =
  (x y : Rational) →
  NotEquivalent algebra
    (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient left x)
    (Field.zeroF algebra) →
  NotEquivalent algebra
    (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient right y)
    (Field.zeroF algebra) →
  RationalSum x y q →
  ContainsEquivalentPair x y pairs

sumProducts :
  {F : Set} →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  PuiseuxSeries F algebra →
  PuiseuxSeries F algebra →
  List ExponentPair →
  F
sumProducts algebra left right [] =
  Field.zeroF algebra
sumProducts algebra left right (pair ∷ pairs) =
  Field.add algebra
    (Field.multiply algebra
      (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient left
        (ExponentPair.left-exponent pair))
      (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient right
        (ExponentPair.right-exponent pair)))
    (sumProducts algebra left right pairs)

record ConvolutionAt
  {F : Set}
  (algebra : Field F)
  (left right : PuiseuxSeries F algebra)
  (q : Rational)
  (value : F) :
  Set where

  field
    pairs : List ExponentPair
    every-pair-sums-to-q :
      AllSumTo q pairs
    pairs-are-distinct :
      DistinctPairs pairs
    pairs-cover-support :
      CoversNonzeroPairs algebra left right q pairs
    value-is-coefficient-sum :
      Field.Equivalent algebra value
        (sumProducts algebra left right pairs)

zeroExponent : Rational
zeroExponent = fraction (pos zero) zero

record IsConstantSeries
  {F : Set}
  (algebra : Field F)
  (constant : F)
  (series : PuiseuxSeries F algebra) :
  Set where

  field
    coefficient-at-zero :
      (q : Rational) →
      RationalEquivalent q zeroExponent →
      Field.Equivalent algebra
        (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient series q)
        constant
    coefficient-away-from-zero :
      (q : Rational) →
      ¬ RationalEquivalent q zeroExponent →
      Field.Equivalent algebra
        (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient series q)
        (Field.zeroF algebra)

record FormalPuiseuxField
  {F : Set}
  (coefficient-field : Field F) :
  Set₁ where

  field
    series-field :
      Field (PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field)

    equality-gives-equal-coefficients :
      (left right : PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field) →
      Field.Equivalent series-field left right →
      SeriesEquivalent coefficient-field left right

    equal-coefficients-give-equality :
      (left right : PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field) →
      SeriesEquivalent coefficient-field left right →
      Field.Equivalent series-field left right

    zero-is-constant :
      IsConstantSeries coefficient-field
        (Field.zeroF coefficient-field)
        (Field.zeroF series-field)

    one-is-constant :
      IsConstantSeries coefficient-field
        (Field.oneF coefficient-field)
        (Field.oneF series-field)

    add-coefficient :
      (left right : PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field) →
      (q : Rational) →
      Field.Equivalent coefficient-field
        (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient
          (Field.add series-field left right)
          q)
        (Field.add coefficient-field
          (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient left q)
          (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient right q))

    negate-coefficient :
      (series : PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field) →
      (q : Rational) →
      Field.Equivalent coefficient-field
        (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient
          (Field.negate series-field series)
          q)
        (Field.negate coefficient-field
          (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient series q))

    multiply-coefficient :
      (left right : PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field) →
      (q : Rational) →
      ConvolutionAt coefficient-field left right q
        (PuiseuxSeries.coefficient
          (Field.multiply series-field left right)
          q)

puiseux-theorem : Set₁
puiseux-theorem =
  (F : Set) →
  (coefficient-field : Field F) →
  AlgebraicallyClosed coefficient-field →
  (formal-series :
    FormalPuiseuxField coefficient-field) →
  let series-field =
        FormalPuiseuxField.series-field formal-series
  in
  (polynomial :
    List (PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field)) →
  Nonconstant series-field polynomial →
  Σ (PuiseuxSeries F coefficient-field)
    (λ root →
      Field.Equivalent series-field
        (evaluate series-field polynomial root)
        (Field.zeroF series-field))

title: 041_puiseux_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Puiseux's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 041. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory ratTheory;

val puiseuxs_theorem =
  ``!(z0 : 'a) (z1 : 'a)
      (plus : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (times : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negate : 'a -> 'a)
      (reciprocal : 'a -> 'a).
      let field_axioms =
        (z0 <> z1 /\
         (!x. plus z0 x = x) /\
         (!x. plus (negate x) x = z0) /\
         (!x y. plus x y = plus y x) /\
         (!x y z. plus (plus x y) z = plus x (plus y z)) /\
         (!x. times z1 x = x) /\
         (!x y. times x y = times y x) /\
         (!x y z. times (times x y) z = times x (times y z)) /\
         (!x y z.
            times x (plus y z) = plus (times x y) (times x z)) /\
         (!x. x <> z0 ==> times (reciprocal x) x = z1))
      in
      let characteristic_zero =
        !n. 0 < n ==> FOLDL plus z0 (REPLICATE n z1) <> z0
      in
      let base_eval =
        \coeffs x.
          FOLDR (\c acc. plus c (times x acc)) z0 coeffs
      in
      let algebraically_closed =
        !coeffs : 'a list.
          1 < LENGTH coeffs /\ LAST coeffs <> z0 ==>
          ?x : 'a. base_eval coeffs x = z0
      in
      let is_puiseux =
        \(f : rat -> 'a).
          (?lower : rat.
             !q. q < lower ==> f q = z0) /\
          (?denom : num.
             0 < denom /\
             !q. f q <> z0 ==>
                 ?numer : int.
                   q = rat_of_int numer / &denom)
      in
      let coefficient_pairs =
        \(f : rat -> 'a) g q.
          {p |
             f (FST p) <> z0 /\
             g (SND p) <> z0 /\
             q = FST p + SND p}
      in
      let series_zero =
        \q : rat. z0
      in
      let series_add =
        \(f : rat -> 'a) g q. plus (f q) (g q)
      in
      let series_mul =
        \(f : rat -> 'a) g q.
          ITSET
            (\p acc.
               plus (times (f (FST p)) (g (SND p))) acc)
            (coefficient_pairs f g q) z0
      in
      let series_eval =
        \coeffs x.
          FOLDR
            (\c acc. series_add c (series_mul x acc))
            series_zero coeffs
      in
        field_axioms /\
        characteristic_zero /\
        algebraically_closed ==>
        !coeffs : (rat -> 'a) list.
          1 < LENGTH coeffs /\
          EVERY is_puiseux coeffs /\
          LAST coeffs <> series_zero ==>
          ?root : rat -> 'a.
            is_puiseux root /\
            series_eval coeffs root = series_zero``;

title: 041_puiseux_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Puiseux's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems
  item 041: formal Puiseux series over an algebraically closed field of
  characteristic zero are algebraically closed. This file contains no proof.
$)

$(
  The coefficient field is explicitly quantified.  Second-order graph
  comprehension represents every rational-indexed F-valued function, and
  PuiseuxOver selects exactly those whose support is bounded below and lies
  in (1 / d) Z for one positive natural d.  The standard series operations
