title: 042_sum_of_the_reciprocals_of_the_triangular_numbers
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Sum of the Reciprocals of the Triangular Numbers" from
% Hundred Theorems item 042. The reciprocal partial sums converge to 2; this file contains
% no proof.

sum_of_the_reciprocals_of_the_triangular_numbers_042: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  triangular_number(index: nat): real =
    ((index :: real) * ((index + 1) :: real)) / 2

  reciprocal_triangular_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      reciprocal_triangular_partial_sum(count - 1)
        + safe_div(1, triangular_number(count))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < eps

  sum_of_the_reciprocals_of_the_triangular_numbers: bool =
    (FORALL (count: nat):
      reciprocal_triangular_partial_sum(count)
        = 2 - safe_div(2, (count + 1) :: real))
      AND converges_to(
        (LAMBDA (count: nat):
          reciprocal_triangular_partial_sum(count)),
        2)
END sum_of_the_reciprocals_of_the_triangular_numbers_042

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 043.
-- It states the sharp area bound for rectifiable simple closed plane curves and characterizes
-- equality by circular images. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped BigOperators

@[expose] public section

namespace Theorems100.IsoperimetricTheorem

abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ

def euclideanDist (z w : Plane) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt ((z.1 - w.1) ^ 2 + (z.2 - w.2) ^ 2)

def euclideanSphere (center : Plane) (radius : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {z | euclideanDist z center = radius}

def circlePi : ℝ :=
  4 * ∑' n : ℕ,
    (1 / (4 * (n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (4 * (n : ℝ) + 3))

def pathImage (g : ℝ → Plane) : Set Plane :=
  g '' Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

def IsSimplePath (g : ℝ → Plane) : Prop :=
  ContinuousOn g (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → g s = g t →
      s = t ∨ (s = 0 ∧ t = 1) ∨ (s = 1 ∧ t = 0)

structure UnitIntervalPartition where
  segments : ℕ
  segments_pos : 0 < segments
  point : Fin (segments + 1) → ℝ
  point_strictMono : StrictMono point
  left_endpoint : point 0 = 0
  right_endpoint : point (Fin.last segments) = 1

def polygonalLength (g : ℝ → Plane) (p : UnitIntervalPartition) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin p.segments,
    euclideanDist (g (p.point i.castSucc)) (g (p.point i.succ))

def IsRectifiable (g : ℝ → Plane) : Prop :=
  BddAbove (Set.range (polygonalLength g))

noncomputable def pathLength (g : ℝ → Plane) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (polygonalLength g))

def IsBoundedPlaneSet (s : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ s, ‖z‖ ≤ R

def curveInside (g : ℝ → Plane) : Set Plane :=
  {z | z ∈ (pathImage g)ᶜ ∧
    IsBoundedPlaneSet (connectedComponentIn (pathImage g)ᶜ z)}

structure RectangleCover (s : Set Plane) where
  lower : ℕ → Plane
  upper : ℕ → Plane
  covers :
    ∀ z ∈ s, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (lower n).1 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ (upper n).1 ∧
      (lower n).2 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ (upper n).2

def rectangleArea (lower upper : Plane) : ENNReal :=
  ENNReal.ofReal ((upper.1 - lower.1) * (upper.2 - lower.2))

noncomputable def coverArea {s : Set Plane} (cover : RectangleCover s) : ENNReal :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, rectangleArea (cover.lower n) (cover.upper n)

noncomputable def planarOuterArea (s : Set Plane) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ cover : RectangleCover s, coverArea cover

noncomputable def enclosedArea (g : ℝ → Plane) : ℝ :=
  (planarOuterArea (curveInside g)).toReal

theorem isoperimetric_theorem
    (L : ℝ) (g : ℝ → Plane)
    (hg_rectifiable : IsRectifiable g)
    (hg_simple : IsSimplePath g)
    (hg_closed : g 1 = g 0)
    (h_length : pathLength g = L) :
    enclosedArea g ≤ L ^ 2 / (4 * circlePi) ∧
      (enclosedArea g = L ^ 2 / (4 * circlePi) →
        ∃ center : Plane, ∃ radius : ℝ,
          pathImage g = euclideanSphere center radius) := sorry

end Theorems100.IsoperimetricTheorem

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 043.
  It states the sharp area bound for rectifiable simple closed plane curves and characterizes
  equality by a circular image. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * R)%type.
Definition region := point -> Prop.
Definition plane_path := R -> point.

Definition unit_interval (t : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= t <= 1.

Definition path_image (gamma : plane_path) : region :=
  fun z => exists t : R, unit_interval t /\ gamma t = z.

Definition path_start (gamma : plane_path) : point :=
  gamma 0.

Definition path_finish (gamma : plane_path) : point :=
  gamma 1.

Definition point_distance (p q : point) : R :=
  sqrt ((fst p - fst q) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd q) ^ 2).

Definition sphere (center : point) (radius : R) : region :=
  fun p => point_distance p center = radius.

Definition same_region (s t : region) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, s p <-> t p.

Definition continuous_on_unit (gamma : plane_path) : Prop :=
  forall t : R, unit_interval t ->
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
  exists delta : R, 0 < delta /\
    forall u : R, unit_interval u ->
      Rabs (u - t) < delta ->
      point_distance (gamma u) (gamma t) < epsilon.

Definition simple_path (gamma : plane_path) : Prop :=
  continuous_on_unit gamma /\
  forall s t : R, unit_interval s -> unit_interval t ->
    gamma s = gamma t ->
    s = t \/ (s = 0 /\ t = 1) \/ (s = 1 /\ t = 0).

Definition unit_partition (partition : nat -> R) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  partition O = 0 /\
  partition n = 1 /\
  forall i : nat, (i < n)%nat ->
    partition i <= partition (S i).

Fixpoint polygonal_length
    (gamma : plane_path) (partition : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k =>
      polygonal_length gamma partition k +
      point_distance (gamma (partition k)) (gamma (partition (S k)))
  end.

Definition variation_upper_bound (gamma : plane_path) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  forall (n : nat) (partition : nat -> R),
    unit_partition partition n ->
    polygonal_length gamma partition n <= bound.

Definition rectifiable_path (gamma : plane_path) : Prop :=
  continuous_on_unit gamma /\
  exists bound : R, variation_upper_bound gamma bound.

Definition is_path_length (gamma : plane_path) (length : R) : Prop :=
  variation_upper_bound gamma length /\
  forall bound : R, variation_upper_bound gamma bound -> length <= bound.

Definition path_length (gamma : plane_path) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0%R) (is_path_length gamma).

Definition open_region (s : region) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, s p ->
  exists epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon /\
    forall q : point, point_distance q p < epsilon -> s q.

Definition relatively_open (carrier subset : region) : Prop :=
  exists ambient : region, open_region ambient /\
    forall p : point, subset p <-> carrier p /\ ambient p.

Definition connected_region (carrier : region) : Prop :=
  forall left right : region,
    relatively_open carrier left ->
    relatively_open carrier right ->
    (forall p : point, carrier p <-> left p \/ right p) ->
    (forall p : point, ~ (left p /\ right p)) ->
    (forall p : point, ~ left p) \/ (forall p : point, ~ right p).

Definition complement_component
    (boundary : region) (base : point) : region :=
  fun p =>
    exists carrier : region,
      connected_region carrier /\
      carrier base /\
      carrier p /\
      forall q : point, carrier q -> ~ boundary q.

Definition bounded_region (s : region) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R, forall p : point, s p ->
    point_distance p (0, 0) <= bound.

Definition inside (boundary : region) : region :=
  fun p =>
    ~ boundary p /\
    bounded_region (complement_component boundary p).

Record open_rectangle := {
  x_lower : R;
  x_upper : R;
  y_lower : R;
  y_upper : R
}.

Definition in_open_rectangle
    (rectangle : open_rectangle) (p : point) : Prop :=
  x_lower rectangle < fst p < x_upper rectangle /\
  y_lower rectangle < snd p < y_upper rectangle.

Definition rectangle_area (rectangle : open_rectangle) : R :=
  Rmax 0 (x_upper rectangle - x_lower rectangle) *
  Rmax 0 (y_upper rectangle - y_lower rectangle).

Definition rectangles_cover
    (s : region) (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) : Prop :=
  forall p : point, s p ->
    exists n : nat, in_open_rectangle (rectangles n) p.

Fixpoint partial_area
    (rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => partial_area rectangles k + rectangle_area (rectangles k)
  end.

Definition converges_to (sequence : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
  exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
    Rabs (sequence n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition cover_cost (s : region) (cost : R) : Prop :=
  exists rectangles : nat -> open_rectangle,
    rectangles_cover s rectangles /\
    converges_to (partial_area rectangles) cost.

(* The infimum of countable open-rectangle cover costs is planar outer area. *)
Definition is_outer_area (s : region) (area : R) : Prop :=
  (forall cost : R, cover_cost s cost -> area <= cost) /\
  (forall lower_bound : R,
      (forall cost : R, cover_cost s cost -> lower_bound <= cost) ->
      lower_bound <= area).

Definition area_measure (s : region) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0%R) (is_outer_area s).

Theorem isoperimetric_theorem :
  forall (L : R) (gamma : plane_path),
    rectifiable_path gamma ->
    simple_path gamma ->
    path_finish gamma = path_start gamma ->
    path_length gamma = L ->
    area_measure (inside (path_image gamma)) <= L ^ 2 / (4 * PI) /\
    (area_measure (inside (path_image gamma)) = L ^ 2 / (4 * PI) ->
     exists (center : point) (radius : R),
       same_region (path_image gamma) (sphere center radius)).
Admitted.

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 043.
  The statement uses Isabelle/HOL's native path, planar-inside, sphere, path-length, and
  Lebesgue-measure notions, with complex numbers representing the Euclidean plane.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Isoperimetric_Theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Analysis"
begin

theorem isoperimetric_theorem:
  fixes L :: real
    and g :: "real \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes "rectifiable_path g"
    and "simple_path g"
    and "pathfinish g = pathstart g"
    and "path_length g = L"
  shows "measure lebesgue (inside (path_image g)) \<le> L ^ 2 / (4 * pi) \<and>
    (measure lebesgue (inside (path_image g)) = L ^ 2 / (4 * pi)
      \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>a r. path_image g = sphere a r))"
  sorry

end

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
(* ========================================================================= *)
(* The isoperimetric inequality.                                             *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

needs "Multivariate/cauchy.ml";;
needs "Multivariate/lpspaces.ml";;
needs "100/green.ml";;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A few lemmas to switch between views of a convex curve.                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let lemma1 = `!g:real^1->real^2.
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        convex(inside(path_image g))
        ==> convex hull (path_image g) = closure(inside(path_image g))`;;

let lemma2 = `!g:real^1->real^2.
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        convex(inside(path_image g))
        ==> frontier(convex hull (path_image g)) = path_image g`;;

let lemma3 = `!g:real^1->real^2.
        simple_path g /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        path_image g SUBSET frontier (convex hull path_image g)
        ==> frontier (convex hull path_image g) = path_image g`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Part 1: The Wirtinger inequality.                                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let REAL_HOELDER_BOUND_2 = `!f s. real_measurable s /\
         f real_measurable_on s /\
         (\x. f x pow 2) real_integrable_on s
         ==> (real_integral s f) pow 2
             <= real_measure s * real_integral s (\x. f x pow 2)`;;

let WIRTINGER_INEQUALITY = `!f f'.
        (!x. x IN real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]
             ==> (f' has_real_integral (f x - f(&0))) (real_interval[&0,x])) /\
        f(&2 * pi) = f(&0) /\
        (f has_real_integral &0) (real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]) /\
        (\x. f'(x) pow 2) real_integrable_on real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]
        ==> (\x. f(x) pow 2) real_integrable_on real_interval[&0,&2 * pi] /\
            real_integral (real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]) (\x. f(x) pow 2) <=
            real_integral (real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]) (\x. f'(x) pow 2) /\
            (real_integral (real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]) (\x. f(x) pow 2) =
             real_integral (real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]) (\x. f'(x) pow 2)
             ==> ?c a. !x. x IN real_interval[&0,&2 * pi]
                           ==> f x = c * sin(x - a))`;;

let SCALED_WIRTINGER_INEQUALITY = `!f f'.
      (!x. x IN real_interval[&0,&1]
           ==> (f' has_real_integral (f x - f(&0))) (real_interval[&0,x])) /\
      f(&1) = f(&0) /\
      (f has_real_integral &0) (real_interval[&0,&1]) /\
      (\x. f'(x) pow 2) real_integrable_on real_interval[&0,&1]
      ==> (\x. f(x) pow 2) real_integrable_on real_interval[&0,&1] /\
          real_integral (real_interval[&0,&1]) (\x. (&2 * pi * f(x)) pow 2) <=
          real_integral (real_interval[&0,&1]) (\x. f'(x) pow 2) /\
          (real_integral (real_interval[&0,&1]) (\x. (&2 * pi * f(x)) pow 2) =
           real_integral (real_interval[&0,&1]) (\x. f'(x) pow 2)
           ==> ?c a. !x. x IN real_interval[&0,&1]
                         ==> f x = c * sin(&2 * pi * x - a))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Part 2: a very special case of Green's theorem for a convex area.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let GREEN_AREA_THEOREM = `!(g:real^1->real^2) g' u a.
        simple_path g /\ pathstart g = a /\ pathfinish g = a /\
        g absolutely_continuous_on interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        negligible u /\
        (!t. t IN interval[vec 0,vec 1] DIFF u
             ==> (g has_vector_derivative g'(t)) (at t))
        ==> (\t. lift(g'(t)$1 * g(t)$2)) integrable_on
            interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
            norm(integral (interval[vec 0,vec 1])
                          (\t. lift(g'(t)$1 * g(t)$2))) =
            measure(inside(path_image g))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Part 3: Isoperimetric theorem for a convex curve.                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ISOPERIMETRIC_THEOREM_CONVEX = `!L g:real^1->real^2.
        rectifiable_path g /\
        simple_path g /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        convex(inside(path_image g)) /\
        path_length g = L
        ==> measure(inside(path_image g)) <= L pow 2 / (&4 * pi) /\
            (measure(inside(path_image g)) =  L pow 2 / (&4 * pi)
             ==> ?a r. path_image g = sphere(a,r))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Part 4: Convexification of an arbitrary rectifiable simple curve.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let STEP_LEMMA = `!g:real^1->real^2 a b L.
        simple_path g /\ pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        (!x y. x IN interval [vec 0,vec 1] /\
               y IN interval [vec 0,vec 1]
               ==> dist(g x,g y) <= L * dist(x,y)) /\
        drop a < drop b /\
        a IN interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\ b IN interval[vec 0,vec 1] /\
        g(a) IN frontier(convex hull (path_image g)) /\
        g(b) IN frontier(convex hull (path_image g)) /\
        IMAGE g (interval(a,b)) INTER frontier(convex hull (path_image g)) = {}
        ==> ?h. simple_path h /\
                pathstart h = pathstart g /\ pathfinish h = pathstart g /\
                (!x y. x IN interval [vec 0,vec 1] /\
                       y IN interval [vec 0,vec 1]
                       ==> dist(h x,h y) <= L * dist(x,y)) /\
                path_length h < path_length g /\
                convex hull (path_image h) = convex hull (path_image g) /\
                (!x. ~(x IN interval(a,b)) ==> h x = g x) /\
                IMAGE h (interval[a,b]) SUBSET
                frontier(convex hull (path_image g))`;;

let ISOPERIMETRIC_CONVEXIFICATION = `!g:real^1->real^2.
        rectifiable_path g /\
        simple_path g /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g
        ==> ?h:real^1->real^2.
                rectifiable_path h /\
                simple_path h /\
                pathfinish h = pathstart h /\
                path_length h <= path_length g /\
                convex hull (path_image h) = convex hull (path_image g) /\
                path_image h = frontier(convex hull (path_image g))`;;

let ISOPERIMETRIC_CONVEXIFICATION_1 = `!g:real^1->real^2.
        rectifiable_path g /\
        simple_path g /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        ~convex(inside(path_image g))
        ==> ?h:real^1->real^2.
                rectifiable_path h /\
                simple_path h /\
                pathfinish h = pathstart h /\
                path_length h <= path_length g /\
                convex hull path_image h = convex hull path_image g /\
                path_image h = frontier (convex hull path_image g) /\
                measure(inside(path_image g)) < measure(inside(path_image h))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The grand finale.                                                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ISOPERIMETRIC_THEOREM = `!L g:real^1->real^2.
        rectifiable_path g /\
        simple_path g /\
        pathfinish g = pathstart g /\
        path_length g = L
        ==> measure(inside(path_image g)) <= L pow 2 / (&4 * pi) /\
            (measure(inside(path_image g)) =  L pow 2 / (&4 * pi)
             ==> ?a r. path_image g = sphere(a,r))`;;

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__043, "The Isoperimetric Theorem": every rectifiable
;; simple closed planar path of length L encloses area at most L^2/(4*pi), and
;; equality implies that its path image is a Euclidean circle. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar arguments present the real numbers as a Dedekind-complete
;; ordered field. Paths and auxiliary functions are arbitrary tame APPLY$
;; functions on the full represented real unit interval, not finite tables.

(defun ht043-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun ht043-unary (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun ht043-binary (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun-sk ht043-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
          (ht043-member-p carrier y)
          (ht043-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier (ht043-binary add x y))
      (ht043-member-p carrier (ht043-binary multiply x y))
      (ht043-member-p carrier (ht043-unary negate x))
      (ht043-member-p carrier (ht043-unary inverse x))
      (equal (ht043-binary add (ht043-binary add x y) z)
             (ht043-binary add x (ht043-binary add y z)))
      (equal (ht043-binary add x y) (ht043-binary add y x))
      (equal (ht043-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht043-binary add x (ht043-unary negate x)) zero)
      (equal
       (ht043-binary multiply (ht043-binary multiply x y) z)
       (ht043-binary multiply x (ht043-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal (ht043-binary multiply x y)
             (ht043-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (ht043-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies (equal x zero)
               (equal (ht043-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (ht043-binary multiply x (ht043-unary inverse x)) one))
      (equal
       (ht043-binary multiply x (ht043-binary add y z))
       (ht043-binary
        add
        (ht043-binary multiply x y)
        (ht043-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk ht043-order-laws-p (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
          (ht043-member-p carrier y)
          (ht043-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (ht043-binary less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (ht043-binary less x y)
          (ht043-binary less y x))
      (implies
       (and (ht043-binary less x y)
            (ht043-binary less y z))
       (ht043-binary less x z))
      (implies
       (ht043-binary less x y)
       (ht043-binary
        less (ht043-binary add x z) (ht043-binary add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (ht043-binary less zero x)
            (ht043-binary less zero y))
       (ht043-binary less zero (ht043-binary multiply x y)))))))

(defun ht043-less-p (less x y)
  (if (ht043-binary less x y) t nil))

(defun ht043-leq-p (less x y)
  (not (ht043-less-p less y x)))

(defun-sk ht043-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk ht043-upper-bound-p (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (ht043-leq-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk ht043-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and (ht043-member-p carrier bound)
         (ht043-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk ht043-is-supremum-p (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (ht043-member-p carrier supremum)
     (ht043-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and (ht043-member-p carrier bound)
           (ht043-upper-bound-p carrier less set bound))
      (ht043-leq-p less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk ht043-has-supremum-p (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (ht043-is-supremum-p carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk ht043-dedekind-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and (tamep-functionp set)
          (ht043-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
          (ht043-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (ht043-has-supremum-p carrier less set))))

(defun ht043-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (ht043-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht043-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht043-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (ht043-order-laws-p carrier add multiply zero less)
   (ht043-less-p less zero one)
   (ht043-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun ht043-add (add x y)
  (ht043-binary add x y))

(defun ht043-neg (negate x)
  (ht043-unary negate x))

(defun ht043-sub (add negate x y)
  (ht043-add add x (ht043-neg negate y)))

(defun ht043-mul (multiply x y)
  (ht043-binary multiply x y))

(defun ht043-inv (inverse x)
  (ht043-unary inverse x))

(defun ht043-div (multiply inverse x y)
  (ht043-mul multiply x (ht043-inv inverse y)))

(defun ht043-square (multiply x)
  (ht043-mul multiply x x))

(defun ht043-abs (less negate zero x)
  (if (ht043-less-p less x zero)
      (ht043-neg negate x)
    x))

(defun ht043-max (less x y)
  (if (ht043-less-p less x y) y x))

(defun ht043-positive-p (carrier less zero x)
  (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
       (ht043-less-p less zero x)))

(defun ht043-nat (add zero one n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (ht043-add add one (ht043-nat add zero one (1- n)))))

(defun ht043-four (add zero one)
  (ht043-nat add zero one 4))

(defun-sk ht043-unary-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ht043-member-p carrier x)
     (ht043-member-p carrier (ht043-unary function x)))))

(defun ht043-valid-unary-function-p (carrier function)
  (and (tamep-functionp function)
       (ht043-unary-real-function-p carrier function)))

;; SQRT is fixed by the nonnegative square-root characterization.

(defun-sk ht043-square-root-laws-p
    (carrier multiply zero less square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (ht043-member-p carrier x)
          (ht043-leq-p less zero x))
     (let ((root (ht043-unary square-root x)))
       (and
        (ht043-member-p carrier root)
        (ht043-leq-p less zero root)
        (equal (ht043-square multiply root) x))))))

(defun ht043-square-root-p
    (carrier multiply zero less square-root)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp square-root)
   (ht043-square-root-laws-p
    carrier multiply zero less square-root)))

(defun ht043-plane-distance
    (add multiply negate square-root x1 y1 x2 y2)
  (let ((dx (ht043-sub add negate x1 x2))
        (dy (ht043-sub add negate y1 y2)))
    (ht043-unary
     square-root
     (ht043-add
      add
      (ht043-square multiply dx)
      (ht043-square multiply dy)))))

;; Pi is fixed as the limit of Machin's arctangent series.

(defun ht043-power (multiply one base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (ht043-mul
     multiply base
     (ht043-power multiply one base (1- exponent)))))

(defun ht043-arctan-prefix
    (add multiply negate inverse zero one z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      zero
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (denominator (ht043-nat add zero one exponent))
           (unsigned
            (ht043-div
             multiply inverse
             (ht043-power multiply one z exponent)
             denominator))
           (term
            (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                unsigned
              (ht043-neg negate unsigned))))
      (ht043-add
       add
       (ht043-arctan-prefix
        add multiply negate inverse zero one z index)
       term))))

(defun ht043-pi-prefix
    (add multiply negate inverse zero one terms)
  (let* ((five (ht043-nat add zero one 5))
         (two-thirty-nine (ht043-nat add zero one 239))
         (sixteen (ht043-nat add zero one 16))
         (four (ht043-four add zero one)))
    (ht043-sub
     add negate
     (ht043-mul
      multiply sixteen
      (ht043-arctan-prefix
       add multiply negate inverse zero one
       (ht043-div multiply inverse one five)
       terms))
     (ht043-mul
      multiply four
      (ht043-arctan-prefix
       add multiply negate inverse zero one
       (ht043-div multiply inverse one two-thirty-nine)
       terms)))))

(defun-sk ht043-pi-tail-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             pi-value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (natp cutoff)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (ht043-less-p
      less
      (ht043-abs
       less negate zero
       (ht043-sub
        add negate
        (ht043-pi-prefix
         add multiply negate inverse zero one terms)
        pi-value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht043-pi-cutoff-exists-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
             pi-value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (ht043-pi-tail-p
      carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      pi-value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk ht043-pi-limit-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht043-pi-cutoff-exists-p
      carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less
      pi-value epsilon))))

(defun ht043-pi-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
  (and
   (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero pi-value)
   (ht043-pi-limit-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)))

;; Continuity and the standard simple-closed-path condition on [0,1].

(defun ht043-in-unit-interval-p (less zero one x)
  (and (ht043-leq-p less zero x)
       (ht043-leq-p less x one)))

(defun-sk ht043-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less parameter epsilon delta)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier other)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one other)
      (ht043-less-p
       less
       (ht043-abs
        less negate zero
        (ht043-sub add negate other parameter))
       delta))
     (ht043-less-p
      less
      (ht043-plane-distance
       add multiply negate square-root
       (ht043-unary gx other)
       (ht043-unary gy other)
       (ht043-unary gx parameter)
       (ht043-unary gy parameter))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht043-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less parameter epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero delta)
     (ht043-continuity-neighborhood-p
      carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
      zero one less parameter epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk ht043-continuous-path-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
  (forall (parameter epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one parameter)
      (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon))
     (ht043-continuity-radius-exists-p
      carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
      zero one less parameter epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht043-simple-path-p (carrier gx gy zero one less)
  (forall (s time)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier s)
      (ht043-member-p carrier time)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one s)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one time)
      (equal (ht043-unary gx s) (ht043-unary gx time))
      (equal (ht043-unary gy s) (ht043-unary gy time)))
     (or
      (equal s time)
      (and (equal s zero) (equal time one))
      (and (equal s one) (equal time zero))))))

(defun ht043-closed-path-p (gx gy zero one)
  (and
   (equal (ht043-unary gx zero) (ht043-unary gx one))
   (equal (ht043-unary gy zero) (ht043-unary gy one))))

(defun-sk ht043-path-hits-point-p (carrier gx gy zero one less x y)
  (exists (parameter)
    (and
     (ht043-member-p carrier parameter)
     (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one parameter)
     (equal (ht043-unary gx parameter) x)
     (equal (ht043-unary gy parameter) y))))

;; Rectifiability and path_length(g)=L are expressed together by saying that
;; L is the least upper bound of all Euclidean polygonal variation sums over
;; arbitrary finite partitions of the full unit interval.

(defun ht043-partition-from-p
    (carrier less current finish points)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((next (car points)))
        (and
         (ht043-member-p carrier next)
         (ht043-less-p less current next)
         (ht043-partition-from-p
          carrier less next finish (cdr points))))
    (and (equal points nil)
         (equal current finish))))

(defun ht043-partition-p (carrier less zero one points)
  (and
   (true-listp points)
   (ht043-partition-from-p carrier less zero one points)))

(defun ht043-path-variation-sum
    (gx gy add multiply negate square-root start points)
  (if (consp points)
      (let ((next (car points)))
        (ht043-add
         add
         (ht043-plane-distance
          add multiply negate square-root
          (ht043-unary gx start)
          (ht043-unary gy start)
          (ht043-unary gx next)
          (ht043-unary gy next))
         (ht043-path-variation-sum
          gx gy add multiply negate square-root next (cdr points))))
    (ht043-sub add negate start start)))

(defun-sk ht043-path-length-upper-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less bound)
  (forall (points)
    (implies
     (ht043-partition-p carrier less zero one points)
     (ht043-leq-p
      less
      (ht043-path-variation-sum
       gx gy add multiply negate square-root zero points)
      bound))))

(defun-sk ht043-path-length-least-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less length)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier bound)
      (ht043-path-length-upper-bound-p
       carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
       zero one less bound))
     (ht043-leq-p less length bound))))

(defun ht043-has-path-length-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less length)
  (and
   (ht043-member-p carrier length)
   (ht043-path-length-upper-bound-p
    carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
    zero one less length)
   (ht043-path-length-least-p
    carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
    zero one less length)))

;; A complement point is outside when it can be joined, through the
;; complement of the path image, to a point beyond a square containing the
;; image. Its negation is exactly membership in the union of bounded
;; complement components, i.e. inside(path_image g).

(defun-sk ht043-path-image-in-square-p
    (carrier gx gy zero one less negate bound)
  (forall (parameter)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one parameter))
     (and
      (ht043-leq-p
       less
       (ht043-abs
        less negate zero (ht043-unary gx parameter))
       bound)
      (ht043-leq-p
       less
       (ht043-abs
        less negate zero (ht043-unary gy parameter))
       bound)))))

(defun-sk ht043-connector-avoids-image-p
    (carrier gx gy hx hy zero one less)
  (forall (parameter)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier parameter)
      (ht043-in-unit-interval-p less zero one parameter))
     (not
      (ht043-path-hits-point-p
       carrier gx gy zero one less
       (ht043-unary hx parameter)
       (ht043-unary hy parameter))))))

(defun ht043-outside-connector-p
    (carrier gx gy hx hy x y bound
             add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
  (and
   (ht043-valid-unary-function-p carrier hx)
   (ht043-valid-unary-function-p carrier hy)
   (ht043-continuous-path-p
    carrier hx hy add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
   (equal (ht043-unary hx zero) x)
   (equal (ht043-unary hy zero) y)
   (or
    (ht043-less-p
     less bound
     (ht043-abs less negate zero (ht043-unary hx one)))
    (ht043-less-p
     less bound
     (ht043-abs less negate zero (ht043-unary hy one))))
   (ht043-connector-avoids-image-p
    carrier gx gy hx hy zero one less)))

(defun-sk ht043-outside-connector-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy x y bound
             add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
  (exists (hx hy)
    (ht043-outside-connector-p
     carrier gx gy hx hy x y bound
     add multiply negate square-root zero one less)))

(defun ht043-inside-at-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy x y bound
             add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
  (and
   (ht043-member-p carrier x)
   (ht043-member-p carrier y)
   (not
    (ht043-path-hits-point-p
     carrier gx gy zero one less x y))
   (not
    (ht043-outside-connector-exists-p
     carrier gx gy x y bound
     add multiply negate square-root zero one less))))

;; The enclosed area is planar outer area: the infimum of the costs of
;; countable rectangle covers of the bounded complement components. A
;; rectangle is (lower-x upper-x lower-y upper-y); reversed or degenerate
;; intervals have zero area, as in ENNReal.ofReal in the Lean statement.

(defun ht043-rectangle-p (carrier rectangle)
  (and
   (true-listp rectangle)
   (equal (len rectangle) 4)
   (ht043-member-p carrier (car rectangle))
   (ht043-member-p carrier (cadr rectangle))
   (ht043-member-p carrier (caddr rectangle))
   (ht043-member-p carrier (cadddr rectangle))))

(defun ht043-point-in-rectangle-p (less x y rectangle)
  (and
   (ht043-leq-p less (car rectangle) x)
   (ht043-leq-p less x (cadr rectangle))
   (ht043-leq-p less (caddr rectangle) y)
   (ht043-leq-p less y (cadddr rectangle))))

(defun ht043-rectangle-area
    (add multiply negate zero less rectangle)
  (let ((width
         (ht043-max
          less zero
          (ht043-sub add negate
                     (cadr rectangle) (car rectangle))))
        (height
         (ht043-max
          less zero
          (ht043-sub add negate
                     (cadddr rectangle) (caddr rectangle)))))
    (ht043-mul multiply width height)))

(defun-sk ht043-rectangle-sequence-values-p (carrier rectangles)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (ht043-rectangle-p
      carrier (ht043-unary rectangles index)))))

(defun ht043-rectangle-sequence-p (carrier rectangles)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp rectangles)
   (ht043-rectangle-sequence-values-p carrier rectangles)))

(defun-sk ht043-point-covered-p (rectangles less x y)
  (exists (index)
    (and
     (natp index)
     (ht043-point-in-rectangle-p
      less x y (ht043-unary rectangles index)))))

(defun-sk ht043-rectangles-cover-inside-p
    (carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less rectangles)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (ht043-inside-at-bound-p
      carrier gx gy x y bound
      add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
     (ht043-point-covered-p rectangles less x y))))

(defun ht043-countable-inside-cover-p
    (carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less rectangles)
  (and
   (ht043-rectangle-sequence-p carrier rectangles)
   (ht043-rectangles-cover-inside-p
    carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
    zero one less rectangles)))

(defun ht043-cover-area-prefix
    (rectangles add multiply negate zero less count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (ht043-add
       add
       (ht043-cover-area-prefix
        rectangles add multiply negate zero less index)
       (ht043-rectangle-area
        add multiply negate zero less
        (ht043-unary rectangles index))))))

;; This says threshold is at most the supremum of the nondecreasing partial
;; area sums. It also covers divergent series, whose cost is +infinity.
(defun-sk ht043-cover-prefix-witness-p
    (rectangles add multiply negate zero less threshold epsilon)
  (exists (count)
    (and
     (natp count)
     (ht043-less-p
      less
      (ht043-sub add negate threshold epsilon)
      (ht043-cover-area-prefix
       rectangles add multiply negate zero less count)))))

(defun-sk ht043-cover-series-at-least-p
    (carrier rectangles add multiply negate zero less threshold)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero epsilon)
     (ht043-cover-prefix-witness-p
      rectangles add multiply negate zero less threshold epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht043-inside-area-lower-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less candidate)
  (forall (rectangles)
    (implies
     (ht043-countable-inside-cover-p
      carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
      zero one less rectangles)
     (ht043-cover-series-at-least-p
      carrier rectangles add multiply negate zero less candidate))))

;; The lower cut determines the greatest lower bound of all countable-cover
;; costs without choosing a particular convergent series representation.
(defun-sk ht043-is-outer-area-at-bound-p
    (carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
             zero one less area)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (ht043-member-p carrier candidate)
     (iff
      (ht043-leq-p less candidate area)
      (ht043-inside-area-lower-bound-p
       carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
       zero one less candidate)))))

(defun-sk ht043-has-inside-area-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root zero one less area)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ht043-member-p carrier area)
     (ht043-leq-p less zero area)
     (ht043-positive-p carrier less zero bound)
     (ht043-path-image-in-square-p
      carrier gx gy zero one less negate bound)
     (ht043-is-outer-area-at-bound-p
      carrier gx gy bound add multiply negate square-root
      zero one less area))))

;; Equality with sphere(a,r) is extensional equality of the path image and
;; the full Euclidean circle. The center and radius are internal witnesses.

(defun-sk ht043-path-image-is-circle-p
    (carrier gx gy center-x center-y radius
             add multiply negate zero one less)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht043-member-p carrier x)
      (ht043-member-p carrier y))
     (iff
      (ht043-path-hits-point-p
       carrier gx gy zero one less x y)
      (equal
       (ht043-add
        add
        (ht043-square
         multiply (ht043-sub add negate x center-x))
        (ht043-square
         multiply (ht043-sub add negate y center-y)))
       (ht043-square multiply radius))))))

(defun-sk ht043-circle-witness-exists-p
    (carrier gx gy add multiply negate zero one less)
  (exists (center-x center-y radius)
    (and
     (ht043-member-p carrier center-x)
     (ht043-member-p carrier center-y)
     (ht043-member-p carrier radius)
     (ht043-leq-p less zero radius)
     (ht043-path-image-is-circle-p
      carrier gx gy center-x center-y radius
      add multiply negate zero one less))))

(defun-sk ht043-isoperimetric-conclusion-p
    (carrier gx gy length pi-value
             add multiply negate inverse square-root zero one less)
  (exists (area)
    (let* ((four (ht043-four add zero one))
           (denominator (ht043-mul multiply four pi-value))
           (bound
            (ht043-div
             multiply inverse
             (ht043-square multiply length)
             denominator)))
      (and
       (ht043-member-p carrier area)
       (ht043-has-inside-area-p
        carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
        zero one less area)
       (ht043-leq-p less area bound)
       (implies
        (equal area bound)
        (ht043-circle-witness-exists-p
         carrier gx gy add multiply negate zero one less))))))

(defun hundred-theorems-043-isoperimetric-theorem-statement
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse square-root zero one less
             gx gy pi-value length)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht043-real-field-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
    (ht043-square-root-p
     carrier multiply zero less square-root)
    (ht043-pi-p
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less pi-value)
    (ht043-valid-unary-function-p carrier gx)
    (ht043-valid-unary-function-p carrier gy)
    (ht043-continuous-path-p
     carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root zero one less)
    (ht043-simple-path-p carrier gx gy zero one less)
    (ht043-closed-path-p gx gy zero one)
    (ht043-has-path-length-p
     carrier gx gy add multiply negate square-root
     zero one less length))
   (ht043-isoperimetric-conclusion-p
    carrier gx gy length pi-value
    add multiply negate inverse square-root zero one less)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 043.
-- It states the sharp area bound and equality case for rectifiable simple closed plane curves.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

record OrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open OrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals
          (subtract reals limit epsilon)
          (sequence n))
        (StrictLess reals
          (sequence n)
          (add reals limit epsilon)))

oddNatural : Nat -> Nat
oddNatural zero = suc zero
oddNatural (suc n) = suc (suc (oddNatural n))

alternatingUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingUnit reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingUnit reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingUnit reals n)

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  multiply reals
    (alternatingUnit reals n)
    (inverse reals
      (fromNat reals (oddNatural n)))

leibnizPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizPartialSum reals zero =
  leibnizTerm reals zero
leibnizPartialSum reals (suc n) =
  add reals
    (leibnizPartialSum reals n)
    (leibnizTerm reals (suc n))

piApproximation :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
piApproximation reals n =
  multiply reals
    (fromNat reals 4)
    (leibnizPartialSum reals n)

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Curve : Set -> Set
Curve R = R -> Point R

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R = Point R -> Set

UnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitInterval reals t =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t)
    (lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals))

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

pathImage :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Curve R ->
  Region R
pathImage {R} reals g p =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      Both
        (UnitInterval reals t)
        (g t == p))

RegionEquivalent :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
RegionEquivalent {R} leftRegion rightRegion =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff (leftRegion p) (rightRegion p)

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (x-coordinate p)
        (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals
        (y-coordinate p)
        (y-coordinate q)))

parameterSquaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  OrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
parameterSquaredDistance reals x y =
  square reals (subtract reals x y)

record StandardRealPlane (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : OrderedField R
    pi : R
    squareRoot : R -> R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      Nonnegative algebra (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      Nonnegative algebra x ->
      square algebra (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (zeroR algebra) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR algebra

    pi-leibniz-limit :
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (piApproximation algebra)
        pi
    pi-lower-bound :
      StrictLess algebra
        (fromNat algebra 3)
        pi
    pi-upper-bound :
      StrictLess algebra
        pi
        (fromNat algebra 4)

open StandardRealPlane

module PlaneDefinitions
  {R : Set}
  (plane : StandardRealPlane R) where

  reals : OrderedField R
  reals = algebra plane

  origin : Point R
  origin = point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

  PointNear : R -> Point R -> Point R -> Set
  PointNear epsilon p q =
    StrictLess reals
      (squaredDistance reals p q)
      (square reals epsilon)

  ParameterNear : R -> R -> R -> Set
  ParameterNear epsilon x y =
    StrictLess reals
      (parameterSquaredDistance reals x y)
      (square reals epsilon)

  ContinuousCurve : Curve R -> Set
  ContinuousCurve g =
    (t : R) ->
    UnitInterval reals t ->
    (epsilon : R) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
    Exists R
      (\ delta ->
        Both
          (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
          ((s : R) ->
            UnitInterval reals s ->
            ParameterNear delta s t ->
            PointNear epsilon (g s) (g t)))

  Endpoints : R -> R -> Set
  Endpoints s t =
    Either
      (Both
        (s == zeroR reals)
        (t == oneR reals))
      (Both
        (s == oneR reals)
        (t == zeroR reals))

  SimplePath : Curve R -> Set
  SimplePath g =
    Both
      (ContinuousCurve g)
      ((s t : R) ->
        UnitInterval reals s ->
        UnitInterval reals t ->
        g s == g t ->
        Either (s == t) (Endpoints s t))

  record Partition : Set where
    constructor partition
    field
      count : Nat
      parameter : Nat -> R
      begins-at-zero :
        parameter zero == zeroR reals
      ends-at-one :
        parameter count == oneR reals
      increasing :
        (i : Nat) ->
        i <N count ->
        lessOrEqual reals
          (parameter i)
          (parameter (suc i))

  open Partition

  pointDistance : Point R -> Point R -> R
  pointDistance p q =
    squareRoot plane (squaredDistance reals p q)

  distanceSum :
    Curve R ->
    (Nat -> R) ->
    Nat ->
    R
  distanceSum g parameters zero =
    zeroR reals
  distanceSum g parameters (suc n) =
    add reals
      (distanceSum g parameters n)
      (pointDistance
        (g (parameters n))
        (g (parameters (suc n))))

  partitionLength : Curve R -> Partition -> R
  partitionLength g p =
    distanceSum g (parameter p) (count p)

  UpperLengthBound : Curve R -> R -> Set
  UpperLengthBound g bound =
    (p : Partition) ->
    lessOrEqual reals (partitionLength g p) bound

  PathLength : Curve R -> R -> Set
  PathLength g length =
    Both
      (UpperLengthBound g length)
      ((bound : R) ->
        UpperLengthBound g bound ->
        lessOrEqual reals length bound)

  RectifiablePath : Curve R -> Set
  RectifiablePath g =
    Both
      (ContinuousCurve g)
      (Exists R (\ length -> PathLength g length))

  PathConnectedOutside :
    Region R ->
    Point R ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  PathConnectedOutside region p q =
    Exists (Curve R)
      (\ h ->
        Both
          (ContinuousCurve h)
          (Both
            (Both
              (h (zeroR reals) == p)
              (h (oneR reals) == q))
            ((t : R) ->
              UnitInterval reals t ->
              Not (region (h t)))))

  Inside : Region R -> Region R
  Inside region p =
    Both
      (Not (region p))
      (Exists R
        (\ bound ->
          Both
            (Nonnegative reals bound)
            ((q : Point R) ->
              PathConnectedOutside region p q ->
              lessOrEqual reals
                (squaredDistance reals q origin)
                (square reals bound))))

  sphere : Point R -> R -> Region R
  sphere center radius p =
    Both
      (Nonnegative reals radius)
      (squaredDistance reals p center ==
        square reals radius)

  record Rectangle : Set where
    constructor rectangle
    field
      lower-x upper-x : R
      lower-y upper-y : R

  open Rectangle

  ValidRectangle : Rectangle -> Set
  ValidRectangle box =
    Both
      (lessOrEqual reals (lower-x box) (upper-x box))
      (lessOrEqual reals (lower-y box) (upper-y box))

  RectangleContains : Rectangle -> Point R -> Set
  RectangleContains box p =
    Both
      (Both
        (StrictLess reals (lower-x box) (x-coordinate p))
        (StrictLess reals (x-coordinate p) (upper-x box)))
      (Both
        (StrictLess reals (lower-y box) (y-coordinate p))
        (StrictLess reals (y-coordinate p) (upper-y box)))

  rectangleArea : Rectangle -> R
  rectangleArea box =
    multiply reals
      (subtract reals (upper-x box) (lower-x box))
      (subtract reals (upper-y box) (lower-y box))

  RectangleCover : Set
  RectangleCover = Nat -> Rectangle

  ValidCover : RectangleCover -> Set
  ValidCover cover =
    (n : Nat) -> ValidRectangle (cover n)

  Covers : RectangleCover -> Region R -> Set
  Covers cover region =
    (p : Point R) ->
    region p ->
    Exists Nat (\ n -> RectangleContains (cover n) p)

  coverPartialArea : RectangleCover -> Nat -> R
  coverPartialArea cover zero =
    rectangleArea (cover zero)
  coverPartialArea cover (suc n) =
    add reals
      (coverPartialArea cover n)
      (rectangleArea (cover (suc n)))

  CoverTotal : RectangleCover -> R -> Set
  CoverTotal cover total =
    SequentialLimit reals (coverPartialArea cover) total

  CoverCost : Region R -> R -> Set
  CoverCost region total =
    Exists RectangleCover
      (\ cover ->
        Both
          (ValidCover cover)
          (Both
            (Covers cover region)
            (CoverTotal cover total)))

  LowerBound : (R -> Set) -> R -> Set
  LowerBound values bound =
    (value : R) ->
    values value ->
    lessOrEqual reals bound value

  GreatestLowerBound : (R -> Set) -> R -> Set
  GreatestLowerBound values infimum =
    Both
      (LowerBound values infimum)
      ((bound : R) ->
        LowerBound values bound ->
        lessOrEqual reals bound infimum)

  PlanarLebesgueArea : Region R -> R -> Set
  PlanarLebesgueArea region area =
    GreatestLowerBound (CoverCost region) area

  FourPiTimes : R -> R
  FourPiTimes area =
    multiply reals
      (multiply reals (fromNat reals 4) (pi plane))
      area

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (L : R) ->
    (g : Curve R) ->
    RectifiablePath g ->
    SimplePath g ->
    g (oneR reals) == g (zeroR reals) ->
    PathLength g L ->
    Exists R
      (\ area ->
        Both
          (PlanarLebesgueArea
            (Inside (pathImage reals g))
            area)
          (Both
            (lessOrEqual reals
              (FourPiTimes area)
              (square reals L))
            (FourPiTimes area == square reals L ->
              Exists (Point R)
                (\ center ->
                  Exists R
                    (\ radius ->
                      RegionEquivalent
                        (pathImage reals g)
                        (sphere center radius))))))

the-isoperimetric-theorem : Set1
the-isoperimetric-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (plane : StandardRealPlane R) ->
  PlaneDefinitions.proposition plane

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact
  hundred-theorems__hol4__043, cataloged as "The Isoperimetric Theorem":
  a rectifiable simple closed plane curve of length L encloses area at most
  L^2 / (4 * pi), with equality only when its image is a circle. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val isoperimetric_theorem =
  ``!(L : real) (g : real -> real # real).
      let sqdist =
        \x y : real # real.
          (FST y - FST x) pow 2 + (SND y - SND x) pow 2
      in
      let on_unit_interval =
        \t. 0 <= t /\ t <= 1
      in
      let continuous_plane_path =
        \h.
          !t. on_unit_interval t ==>
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?d. 0 < d /\
                      !s. on_unit_interval s /\ abs (s - t) < d ==>
                          sqdist (h s) (h t) < e
      in
      let path_image =
        \z. ?t. on_unit_interval t /\ g t = z
      in
      let partition =
        \n p.
          p 0 = 0 /\
          p n = 1 /\
          !i. i < n ==> p i < p (SUC i)
      in
      let polygonal_length =
        \n p.
          SIGMA
            (\i. sqrt (sqdist (g (p i)) (g (p (SUC i)))))
            (count n)
      in
      let path_length =
        \ell.
          0 <= ell /\
          (!n p.
             partition n p ==> polygonal_length n p <= ell) /\
          (!e. 0 < e ==>
               ?n p.
                 partition n p /\
                 ell - e < polygonal_length n p)
      in
      let rectifiable_path =
        (?ell. path_length ell)
      in
      let simple_path =
        (continuous_plane_path g /\
         !s t.
           on_unit_interval s /\
           on_unit_interval t /\
           g s = g t
           ==>
           s = t \/ (s = 0 /\ t = 1) \/ (s = 1 /\ t = 0))
      in
      let open_plane_set =
        \U : (real # real) -> bool.
          !x. U x ==>
              ?e. 0 < e /\
                  !y. sqdist x y < e ==> U y
      in
      let connected_plane_set =
        \C : (real # real) -> bool.
          ~(?U V : (real # real) -> bool.
              open_plane_set U /\
              open_plane_set V /\
              (?x. C x /\ U x) /\
              (?x. C x /\ V x) /\
              (!x. C x ==> U x \/ V x) /\
              (!x. C x ==> ~(U x /\ V x)))
      in
      let same_component =
        \x y : real # real.
          ?C : (real # real) -> bool.
            connected_plane_set C /\
            C x /\
            C y /\
            !z. C z ==> ~path_image z
      in
      let inside =
        \z : real # real.
          ~path_image z /\
          ?B : real.
            !w. same_component z w ==> sqdist (0, 0) w <= B
      in
      let enclosed_area =
        measure (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue) inside
      in
        rectifiable_path /\
        simple_path /\
        g 1 = g 0 /\
        path_length L
        ==>
        enclosed_area <= Normal (L pow 2 / (4 * pi)) /\
        (enclosed_area = Normal (L pow 2 / (4 * pi))
         ==>
         ?c r.
           path_image =
             {z : real # real | sqdist c z = r pow 2})``;

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred
  Theorems item 043. It states the sharp area bound for a rectifiable simple
  closed plane curve of prescribed length, together with the equality
  characterization by a Euclidean circle. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The source spaces real^1 and real^2 are identified isometrically with RR and
  CC. A source curve g : real^1 -> real^2 is therefore represented by a total
  function G : RR --> CC, while its path image is the image of 0 [,] 1.

  The definitions below are set-theoretic abbreviations over set.mm:

  * HT043Path requires continuity on the closed unit interval in the standard
    real and complex topologies.
  * HT043Simple is injectivity on that interval apart from the two endpoints,
    exactly the simple_path convention for a closed path.
  * HT043Length is the supremum of all polygonal partition sums. Thus
    HT043Rectifiable says that this variation is a real number.
  * HT043Inside is the union of the bounded connected components of the
    complement of the path image in the standard complex topology.
  * HT043Area is the iterated Lebesgue integral of the indicator after the
    identification (x,y) |-> x + i y. For the inside of a rectifiable Jordan
    curve this equals planar Lebesgue measure.
  * HT043Sphere is the Euclidean sphere {z : abs(z-a) = r} in the plane.

  The final $a assertion is the statement itself and is intentionally
  unproved.
$)

$c HT043Image HT043Path HT043Simple HT043Length HT043Rectifiable $.
$c HT043Inside HT043Indicator HT043Row HT043Area HT043Sphere $.

ht043-image-syntax $a class ( HT043Image G ) $.
ht043-path-syntax $a wff ( HT043Path G ) $.
ht043-simple-syntax $a wff ( HT043Simple G ) $.
ht043-length-syntax $a class ( HT043Length G ) $.
ht043-rectifiable-syntax $a wff ( HT043Rectifiable G ) $.
ht043-inside-syntax $a class ( HT043Inside G ) $.
ht043-indicator-syntax $a class ( HT043Indicator S X Y ) $.
ht043-row-syntax $a class ( HT043Row S X ) $.
ht043-area-syntax $a class ( HT043Area S ) $.
ht043-sphere-syntax $a class ( HT043Sphere A R ) $.

${
  ht043-image-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Image G ) = ( G " ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  ht043-path-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Path G )
    <->
    (
      G : RR --> CC
      /\
      ( G |` ( 0 [,] 1 ) ) e.
        (
          ( ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) |`t ( 0 [,] 1 ) )
          Cn
          ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d x y G $.

  ht043-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Simple G )
    <->
    (
      ( HT043Path G )
      /\
      A. x e. ( 0 [,] 1 ) A. y e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        (
          ( G ` x ) = ( G ` y )
          ->
          (
            x = y
            \/
            (
              ( x = 0 /\ y = 1 )
              \/
              ( x = 1 /\ y = 0 )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d j k n p s G $.

  ht043-length-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Length G )
    =
    sup
      (
        { s e. RR |
          E. n e. NN E. p
            (
              (
                p : ( 0 ... n ) --> RR
                /\
                ( ( p ` 0 ) = 0 /\ ( p ` n ) = 1 )
              )
              /\
              (
                A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  ( p ` j ) < ( p ` ( j + 1 ) )
                /\
                s =
                  sum_ k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    (
                      abs `
                        (
                          ( G ` ( p ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
                          -
                          ( G ` ( p ` k ) )
                        )
                    )
              )
            )
        } ,
        RR ,
        <
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  ht043-rectifiable-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Rectifiable G )
    <->
    ( ( HT043Path G ) /\ ( HT043Length G ) e. RR )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c r w z G $.

  ht043-inside-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Inside G )
    =
    { z e. ( CC \ ( HT043Image G ) ) |
      E. r e. RR+
        A. w e.
          U. { c e. ~P ( CC \ ( HT043Image G ) ) |
            (
              z e. c
              /\
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
                    |`t ( CC \ ( HT043Image G ) )
                  )
                  |`t c
                )
                e. Conn
              )
            )
          }
          ( ( abs ` w ) < r )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S X Y $.

  ht043-indicator-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Indicator S X Y )
    =
    if
      (
        ( X + ( _i x. Y ) ) e. S ,
        1 ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y S X $.

  ht043-row-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Row S X )
    =
    S. RR ( HT043Indicator S X y ) _d y
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d x S $.

  ht043-area-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Area S )
    =
    S. RR ( HT043Row S x ) _d x
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d z A R $.

  ht043-sphere-definition $a |- (
    ( HT043Sphere A R )
    =
    { z e. CC | ( abs ` ( z - A ) ) = R }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a G L r $.

  hundred-theorems-043-isoperimetric-theorem $a |- (
    (
        (
          (
            ( HT043Rectifiable G )
            /\
            ( HT043Simple G )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( G ` 1 ) = ( G ` 0 )
            /\
            ( HT043Length G ) = L
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( HT043Area ( HT043Inside G ) )
            <_ ( ( L ^ 2 ) / ( 4 x. _pi ) )
          /\
          (
            ( HT043Area ( HT043Inside G ) )
              = ( ( L ^ 2 ) / ( 4 x. _pi ) )
            ->
            E. a e. CC E. r e. RR
              ( HT043Image G ) = ( HT043Sphere a r )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for L being Real,
      x,y being PartFunc of REAL,REAL,
      A being Subset of REAL,
      C being Simple_closed_curve,
      D being Element of XL-Field 2 st
    A = { t where t is Real : 0 <= t & t <= 1 } &
    dom x = A &
    dom y = A &
    x | A is continuous &
    y | A is continuous &
    x.0 = x.1 & y.0 = y.1 &
    (for s,t being Real st
      s in A & t in A & x.s = x.t & y.s = y.t
      holds s = t or (s = 0 & t = 1) or (s = 1 & t = 0)) &
    (for z being object holds
      z in C iff ex t being Real st
        t in A & z = |[x.t,y.t]|) &
    0 <= L &
    (for n being Nat, p,d being FinSequence of REAL st
      1 <= n &
      len p = n+1 &
      p.1 = 0 & p.(n+1) = 1 &
      (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i <= n holds
        p.i < p.(i+1)) &
      len d = n &
      (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i <= n holds
        d.i = sqrt ((x.(p.(i+1)) - x.(p.i))^2 +
                    (y.(p.(i+1)) - y.(p.i))^2))
      holds Sum d <= L) &
    (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
      ex n being Nat, p,d being FinSequence of REAL st
        1 <= n &
        len p = n+1 &
        p.1 = 0 & p.(n+1) = 1 &
        (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i <= n holds
          p.i < p.(i+1)) &
        len d = n &
        (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i <= n holds
          d.i = sqrt ((x.(p.(i+1)) - x.(p.i))^2 +
                      (y.(p.(i+1)) - y.(p.i))^2)) &
        L-e < Sum d) &
    D = BDD C
  holds
    (XL-Meas 2).D <= L^2 / (4*PI) &
    ((XL-Meas 2).D = L^2 / (4*PI) implies
      ex c being Point of TOP-REAL 2, r being Real st
        C = Sphere(c,r))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 043_the_isoperimetric_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Isoperimetric Theorem" from Hundred
% Theorems item 043: a rectifiable simple closed plane curve of length L
% encloses area at most L^2/(4*pi), with equality only for a circle.
% This file contains no proof.

the_isoperimetric_theorem_043: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  parametrized_curve: TYPE = [real -> point]
  knot_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  squared_norm(p: point): real =
    x_coord(p) ^ 2 + y_coord(p) ^ 2

  euclidean_distance(p, q: point): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (distance: real):
        0 <= distance
          AND distance ^ 2 = squared_distance(p, q))

  in_unit_interval(t: real): bool =
    0 <= t AND t <= 1

  point_close(p, q: point, epsilon: real): bool =
    squared_distance(p, q) < epsilon ^ 2

  continuous_on_unit_interval(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (s: real):
              (in_unit_interval(s) AND abs(s - t) < delta)
                IMPLIES point_close(g(s), g(t), epsilon)

  path_start(g: parametrized_curve): point =
    g(0)

  path_finish(g: parametrized_curve): point =
    g(1)

  closed_path(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    path_finish(g) = path_start(g)

  path_image(g: parametrized_curve): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      EXISTS (t: real):
        in_unit_interval(t) AND p = g(t)

  simple_path(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    continuous_on_unit_interval(g)
      AND FORALL (s, t: real):
        (in_unit_interval(s)
          AND in_unit_interval(t)
          AND g(s) = g(t))
        IMPLIES
          (s = t
            OR (s = 0 AND t = 1)
            OR (s = 1 AND t = 0))

  partition_of_unit_interval(
      knots: knot_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    knots(0) = 0
      AND knots(count) = 1
      AND FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          knots(index) < knots(index + 1)

  polygonal_length(
      g: parametrized_curve,
      knots: knot_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      polygonal_length(g, knots, count - 1)
        + euclidean_distance(
            g(knots(count - 1)),
            g(knots(count)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  variation_upper_bound(g: parametrized_curve, bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND FORALL (knots: knot_sequence), (count: nat):
        partition_of_unit_interval(knots, count)
          IMPLIES polygonal_length(g, knots, count) <= bound

  is_path_length(g: parametrized_curve, length: real): bool =
    variation_upper_bound(g, length)
      AND FORALL (lower: real):
        lower < length IMPLIES
          EXISTS (knots: knot_sequence), (count: nat):
            partition_of_unit_interval(knots, count)
              AND lower < polygonal_length(g, knots, count)

  path_length(g: parametrized_curve): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (length: real):
        is_path_length(g, length))

  rectifiable_path(g: parametrized_curve): bool =
    continuous_on_unit_interval(g)
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        variation_upper_bound(g, bound)

  complement_path(
      h: parametrized_curve,
      region: planar_region,
      start, finish: point): bool =
    continuous_on_unit_interval(h)
      AND path_start(h) = start
      AND path_finish(h) = finish
      AND FORALL (t: real):
        in_unit_interval(t) IMPLIES NOT region(h(t))

  same_complement_component(
      region: planar_region,
      p, q: point): bool =
    EXISTS (h: parametrized_curve):
      complement_path(h, region, p, q)

  bounded_complement_component(
      region: planar_region,
      p: point): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (q: point):
        same_complement_component(region, p, q)
          IMPLIES squared_norm(q) <= bound ^ 2

  inside_region(region: planar_region): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      NOT region(p)
        AND bounded_complement_component(region, p)

  in_open_box(p: point, b: box): bool =
    left(b) < x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) < right(b)
      AND bottom(b) < y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < top(b)

  box_area(b: box): real =
    IF left(b) < right(b) AND bottom(b) < top(b) THEN
      (right(b) - left(b)) * (top(b) - bottom(b))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_area(
      boxes: box_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon

  covers(region: planar_region, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(p, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      region: planar_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  is_lebesgue_outer_area(
      region: planar_region,
      area: real): bool =
    0 <= area
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES area <= total)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
            AND total < area + epsilon)

  lebesgue_area(region: planar_region): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (area: real):
        is_lebesgue_outer_area(region, area))

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_pi(value))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  sphere(center: point, radius: real): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      0 <= radius
        AND squared_distance(p, center) = radius ^ 2

  isoperimetric_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (L: real), (g: parametrized_curve):
      (rectifiable_path(g)
        AND simple_path(g)
        AND closed_path(g)
        AND path_length(g) = L)
      IMPLIES
        (lebesgue_area(inside_region(path_image(g)))
            <= safe_div(L ^ 2, 4 * pi)
          AND (lebesgue_area(inside_region(path_image(g)))
                = safe_div(L ^ 2, 4 * pi)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (center: point), (radius: real):
                path_image(g) = sphere(center, radius)))
END the_isoperimetric_theorem_043

title: 044_the_binomial_theorem
content:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Chris Hughes, Patrick Stevens
