Lemma shiftdeg3 : forall u:C, forall a b c:C, forall z:C, 
Cpow (z+u) 3+a*Cpow (z+u) 2+b*(z+u)+c
=Cpow z 3+(a+3*u)*Cpow z 2+(b+2*u*a+3*Cpow u 2)*z+(c+b*u+a*Cpow u 2+Cpow u 3).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma permprod: forall e f g:C,  g*f*e=e*g*f.
Proof.
Admitted.

Ltac nneq0:=unfold RtoC;
injection;
intro;
lra.

Ltac developall:=
  unfold Cpow;
  repeat (try Csimpl;
          try rewrite Cmult_plus_distr_r;
          try rewrite Cmult_plus_distr_l);
  repeat (
          repeat rewrite (permprod CJ);
          repeat rewrite Cmult_assoc).




Definition Cardan_Tartaglia_formula:=fun (a1:C) (a2:C) (a3:C) (n:nat) =>
let s:=-a1/3 in 
let p:=a2+2*s*a1+3*Cpow s 2 in
let q:=a3+a2*s+a1*Cpow s 2+Cpow s 3 in
let Delta:=(Cpow (q/2) 2)+(Cpow (p/3) 3) in
let alpha : C :=if(Ceq_dec p 0) then (RtoC 0) else (cubicroot (-(q/2)+Csqrt Delta)) in
let beta:=if(Ceq_dec p 0) then -cubicroot q else -(p/3)/alpha in
s+(alpha*Cpow CJ n+beta*Cpow CJ (n+n)).


Theorem Cardan_Tartaglia : forall a1 a2 a3 :C,
let u1:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 0) in
let u2:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 1) in
let u3:=(Cardan_Tartaglia_formula a1 a2 a3 2) in
forall u:C, (u-u1)*(u-u2)*(u-u3)=Cpow u 3+a1*Cpow u 2+a2*u+a3.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma shiftdeg4 : forall u:C, forall a b c d:C, forall z:C, 
Cpow (z+u) 4+a*Cpow (z+u) 3+b*Cpow (z+u) 2+c*(z+u)+d
=Cpow z 4+(a+4*u)*Cpow z 3+(b+3*u*a+6*Cpow u 2)*Cpow z 2
 +(c+2*b*u+3*a*Cpow u 2+4*Cpow u 3)*z+(d+c*u+b*Cpow u 2+a*Cpow u 3+Cpow u 4).
Proof.
Admitted.

Definition binom_solution:= fun (b:C) (c:C) (n:nat) =>
-b/2+(Csqrt (Cpow (b/2) 2-c))*Cpow (-1) n.

Lemma Binom_solution_proof : forall (b:C) (c:C), forall z:C,
Cpow z 2+b*z+c=(z-binom_solution b c 0)*(z-binom_solution b c 1).
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Ferrari_formula: forall (a:C) (b:C) (c:C) (d:C), 
let s:=-a/4 in 
let p:= b+3*s*a+6*Cpow s 2 in
let q:= c+2*b*s+3*a*Cpow s 2+4*Cpow s 3 in
let r:= d+c*s+b*Cpow s 2+a*Cpow s 3+Cpow s 4 in
let lambda:=Cardan_Tartaglia_formula (-p/2) (-r) (r*p/2-/8*Cpow q 2) 0 in
let A:=Csqrt(2*lambda-p) in
let cond:=(Ceq_dec (2*lambda) p) in
let B:=if cond then (RtoC 0) else (-q/(2*A)) in
let z1:=if cond then Csqrt (binom_solution p r 0) 
                else binom_solution A (B+lambda) 0 in
let z2:=if cond then -Csqrt (binom_solution p r 0) 
                else binom_solution A (B+lambda) 1 in
let z3:=if cond then Csqrt (binom_solution p r 1) 
                else binom_solution (-A) (-B+lambda) 0 in
let z4:=if cond then -Csqrt (binom_solution p r 1) 
                else binom_solution (-A) (-B+lambda) 1 in
let u1:=z1+s in
let u2:=z2+s in
let u3:=z3+s in
let u4:=z4+s in
forall u:C, (u-u1)*(u-u2)*(u-u3)*(u-u4)=Cpow u 4+a*Cpow u 3+b*Cpow u 2+c*u+d.
Proof.
Admitted.

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
section \<open>Ferrari's formula for solving quartic equations\<close>

theory Ferraris_Formula
  imports 
    Polynomial_Factorization.Explicit_Roots
    Polynomial_Interpolation.Ring_Hom_Poly
    Complex_Geometry.More_Complex
begin

subsection \<open>Translation to depressed case\<close>

text \<open>Solving an arbitrary quartic equation can easily be turned into the depressed case, i.e., where
  there is no cubic part.\<close>

lemma to_depressed_quartic: fixes a4 :: "'a :: field_char_0"
  assumes a4: "a4 \<noteq> 0" 
  and b: "b = a3 / a4" 
  and c: "c = a2 / a4" 
  and d: "d = a1 / a4" 
  and e: "e = a0 / a4" 
  and p: "p = c - (3/8) * b^2" 
  and q: "q = (b^3 - 4*b*c + 8 * d) / 8" 
  and r: "r = ( -3 * b^4 + 256 * e - 64 * b * d + 16 * b^2 * c) / 256" 
  and x: "x = y - b/4" 
shows "a4 * x^4 + a3 * x^3 + a2 * x^2 + a1 * x + a0 = 0 
  \<longleftrightarrow> y^4 + p * y^2 + q * y + r = 0" 
  by sorry

lemma biquadratic_solution: fixes p q :: "'a :: field_char_0"
  shows "y^4 + p * y^2 + q = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists> z. z^2 + p * z + q = 0 \<and> z = y^2)" 
  by sorry

subsection \<open>Solving the depressed case via Ferrari's formula\<close>

lemma depressed_quartic_Ferrari: fixes p q r :: "'a :: field_char_0" 
  assumes cubic_root: "8*m^3 + (8 * p) * m^2 + (2 * p^2 - 8 * r) * m - q^2 = 0" 
  and q0: "q \<noteq> 0"  \<comment> \<open>otherwise m might be zero, so a is zero and then there is a division by zero in b1 and b2\<close>
  and sqrt: "a * a = 2 * m"  (* a = sqrt(2m), where the square-root might not be defined *)
  and b1: "b1 = p / 2 + m - q / (2 * a)" 
  and b2: "b2 = p / 2 + m + q / (2 * a)" 
  shows "y^4 + p * y^2 + q * y + r = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> poly [:b1,a,1:] y = 0 \<or> poly [:b2,-a,1:] y = 0" 
  by sorry


end

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 046, "The
;; Solution of the General Quartic Equation": Ferrari's formulas characterize
;; the roots of a quartic over an arbitrary field of characteristic not two.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative generic function symbols are ACL2's standard mechanism
;; for stating a theorem uniformly over an arbitrary algebraic structure.
(defstub ht046-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht046-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht046-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht046-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht046-inverse-op (x) t)

(defun ht046-member-p (x)
  (if (ht046-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht046-add (x y)
  (ht046-add-op x y))

(defun ht046-mul (x y)
  (ht046-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht046-neg (x)
  (ht046-negate-op x))

(defun ht046-inv (x)
  (ht046-inverse-op x))

(defun ht046-sub (x y)
  (ht046-add x (ht046-neg y)))

(defun ht046-div (x y)
  (ht046-mul x (ht046-inv y)))

(defun ht046-mul3 (x y z)
  (ht046-mul (ht046-mul x y) z))

(defun ht046-mul4 (x y z w)
  (ht046-mul (ht046-mul3 x y z) w))

(defun ht046-all-members-p (objects)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and
       (ht046-member-p (car objects))
       (ht046-all-members-p (cdr objects)))
    (equal objects nil)))

(defun-sk ht046-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht046-member-p x)
      (ht046-member-p y)
      (ht046-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht046-member-p (ht046-add x y))
      (ht046-member-p (ht046-mul x y))
      (ht046-member-p (ht046-neg x))
      (ht046-member-p (ht046-inv x))
      (equal (ht046-add (ht046-add x y) z)
             (ht046-add x (ht046-add y z)))
      (equal (ht046-add x y) (ht046-add y x))
      (equal (ht046-add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht046-add x (ht046-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (ht046-mul (ht046-mul x y) z)
             (ht046-mul x (ht046-mul y z)))
      (equal (ht046-mul x y) (ht046-mul y x))
      (equal (ht046-mul x one) x)
      (equal (ht046-inv zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (ht046-mul x (ht046-inv x)) one))
      (equal (ht046-mul x (ht046-add y z))
             (ht046-add (ht046-mul x y)
                        (ht046-mul x z)))))))

(defun ht046-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (ht046-member-p zero)
   (ht046-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht046-field-laws-p zero one)))

(defun ht046-natural-value (n zero one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (ht046-add one
               (ht046-natural-value (- n 1) zero one))))

(defun ht046-power (x exponent one)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (ht046-mul x (ht046-power x (- exponent 1) one))))

(defun ht046-ferrari-p (a b c zero one)
  (let* ((three (ht046-natural-value 3 zero one))
         (eight (ht046-natural-value 8 zero one))
         (a2 (ht046-power a 2 one))
         (b2 (ht046-power b 2 one))
         (numerator
          (ht046-sub
           (ht046-mul3 eight a c)
           (ht046-mul three b2)))
         (denominator (ht046-mul eight a2)))
    (ht046-div numerator denominator)))

(defun ht046-ferrari-q (a b c d zero one)
  (let* ((four (ht046-natural-value 4 zero one))
         (eight (ht046-natural-value 8 zero one))
         (a2 (ht046-power a 2 one))
         (a3 (ht046-power a 3 one))
         (b3 (ht046-power b 3 one))
         (numerator
          (ht046-add
           (ht046-sub b3 (ht046-mul4 four a b c))
           (ht046-mul3 eight a2 d)))
         (denominator (ht046-mul eight a3)))
    (ht046-div numerator denominator)))

(defun ht046-ferrari-r (a b c d e zero one)
  (let* ((three (ht046-natural-value 3 zero one))
         (sixteen (ht046-natural-value 16 zero one))
         (sixty-four (ht046-natural-value 64 zero one))
         (two-hundred-fifty-six (ht046-natural-value 256 zero one))
         (a2 (ht046-power a 2 one))
         (a3 (ht046-power a 3 one))
         (a4 (ht046-power a 4 one))
         (b2 (ht046-power b 2 one))
         (b4 (ht046-power b 4 one))
         (positive-part
          (ht046-add
           (ht046-mul4 sixteen a b2 c)
           (ht046-mul3 two-hundred-fifty-six a3 e)))
         (numerator
          (ht046-sub
           (ht046-sub positive-part (ht046-mul three b4))
           (ht046-mul4 sixty-four a2 b d)))
         (denominator (ht046-mul two-hundred-fifty-six a4)))
    (ht046-div numerator denominator)))

(defun ht046-quartic-value (a b c d e x one)
  (ht046-add
   (ht046-add
    (ht046-add
     (ht046-add
      (ht046-mul a (ht046-power x 4 one))
      (ht046-mul b (ht046-power x 3 one)))
     (ht046-mul c (ht046-power x 2 one)))
    (ht046-mul d x))
   e))

(defun ht046-ferrari-base-p
    (zero one a b c d e p q r v w x)
  (let ((two (ht046-natural-value 2 zero one)))
    (and
     (ht046-field-p zero one)
     (ht046-all-members-p (list a b c d e p q r v w x))
     (not (equal two zero))
     (not (equal a zero))
     (equal p (ht046-ferrari-p a b c zero one))
     (equal q (ht046-ferrari-q a b c d zero one))
     (equal r (ht046-ferrari-r a b c d e zero one)))))

(defun ht046-ferrari-radical-data-p
    (zero one p q r u s tau v w)
  (let* ((two (ht046-natural-value 2 zero one))
         (four (ht046-natural-value 4 zero one))
         (eight (ht046-natural-value 8 zero one))
         (p2 (ht046-power p 2 one))
         (q2 (ht046-power q 2 one))
         (u2 (ht046-power u 2 one))
         (u3 (ht046-power u 3 one))
         (s2 (ht046-power s 2 one))
         (tau2 (ht046-power tau 2 one))
         (v2 (ht046-power v 2 one))
         (w2 (ht046-power w 2 one)))
    (if (equal q zero)
        (and
         (ht046-member-p tau)
         (equal tau2 (ht046-sub p2 (ht046-mul four r)))
         (equal v2
                (ht046-div
                 (ht046-add (ht046-neg p) tau)
                 two))
         (equal w2
                (ht046-div
                 (ht046-sub (ht046-neg p) tau)
                 two)))
      (let* ((resolvent
              (ht046-sub
               (ht046-add
                (ht046-sub
                 (ht046-sub u3 (ht046-mul p u2))
                 (ht046-mul3 four r u))
                (ht046-mul3 four p r))
               q2))
             (q-over-s (ht046-div q s))
             (four-s2 (ht046-mul four s2)))
        (and
         (ht046-all-members-p (list u s))
         (equal resolvent zero)
         (equal s2 (ht046-sub u p))
         (equal v2
                (ht046-sub
                 four-s2
                 (ht046-mul eight (ht046-sub u q-over-s))))
         (equal w2
                (ht046-sub
                 four-s2
                 (ht046-mul eight (ht046-add u q-over-s)))))))))

(defun ht046-ferrari-root-characterization-p
    (zero one a b c d e q s v w x)
  (let* ((two (ht046-natural-value 2 zero one))
         (four (ht046-natural-value 4 zero one))
         (shift (ht046-div b (ht046-mul four a)))
         (two-s (ht046-mul two s))
         (minus-two-s (ht046-neg two-s))
         (root-one
          (if (equal q zero)
              (ht046-sub v shift)
            (ht046-sub
             (ht046-div (ht046-sub minus-two-s v) four)
             shift)))
         (root-two
          (if (equal q zero)
              (ht046-sub (ht046-neg v) shift)
            (ht046-sub
             (ht046-div (ht046-add minus-two-s v) four)
             shift)))
         (root-three
          (if (equal q zero)
              (ht046-sub w shift)
            (ht046-sub
             (ht046-div (ht046-sub two-s w) four)
             shift)))
         (root-four
          (if (equal q zero)
              (ht046-sub (ht046-neg w) shift)
            (ht046-sub
             (ht046-div (ht046-add two-s w) four)
             shift))))
    (equal
     (equal (ht046-quartic-value a b c d e x one) zero)
     (or
      (equal x root-one)
      (equal x root-two)
      (equal x root-three)
      (equal x root-four)))))

(defun hundred-theorems-046-solution-of-general-quartic-statement
    (zero one a b c d e p q r u s tau v w x)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht046-ferrari-base-p
     zero one a b c d e p q r v w x)
    (ht046-ferrari-radical-data-p
     zero one p q r u s tau v w))
   (ht046-ferrari-root-characterization-p
    zero one a b c d e q s v w x)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of the General Quartic Equation" from Hundred
-- Theorems item 046. It gives Ferrari's four-root characterizations for the nonzero and zero
-- linear-term cases of the associated depressed quartic over characteristic-zero fields.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 2 _∨_
infix 1 _↔_

data ⊥ : Set where

¬_ : Set → Set
¬ A = A → ⊥

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = ¬ (x ≡ y)

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Field (F : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroF oneF : F
    add multiply : F → F → F
    negate inverse : F → F
    fromNat : Nat → F

    one-not-zero :
      oneF ≠ zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : F) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : F) → add x zeroF ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : F) → add x (negate x) ≡ zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) → multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : F) → multiply x oneF ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : F) → multiply x zeroF ≡ zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroF ≡ zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) →
      x ≠ zeroF →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ oneF

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero ≡ zeroF
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) → fromNat (suc n) ≡ add (fromNat n) oneF
    characteristic-zero :
      (m n : Nat) → fromNat m ≡ fromNat n → m ≡ n

power :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  Nat →
  F
power algebra x zero =
  Field.oneF algebra
power algebra x (suc n) =
  Field.multiply algebra x (power algebra x n)

subtract :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
subtract algebra x y =
  Field.add algebra x (Field.negate algebra y)

divide :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
divide algebra x y =
  Field.multiply algebra x (Field.inverse algebra y)

scale :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  Nat →
  F →
  F
scale algebra n x =
  Field.multiply algebra (Field.fromNat algebra n) x

product3 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
product3 algebra x y z =
  Field.multiply algebra (Field.multiply algebra x y) z

product4 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
product4 algebra x y z w =
  Field.multiply algebra (product3 algebra x y z) w

quarticValue :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
quarticValue algebra a b c d e x =
  Field.add algebra
    (Field.add algebra
      (Field.add algebra
        (Field.add algebra
          (Field.multiply algebra a (power algebra x 4))
          (Field.multiply algebra b (power algebra x 3)))
        (Field.multiply algebra c (power algebra x 2)))
      (Field.multiply algebra d x))
    e

depressedP :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedP algebra a b c =
  divide algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (scale algebra 8 (Field.multiply algebra a c))
      (scale algebra 3 (power algebra b 2)))
    (scale algebra 8 (power algebra a 2))

depressedQNumerator :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedQNumerator algebra a b c d =
  Field.add algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (power algebra b 3)
      (scale algebra 4 (product3 algebra a b c)))
    (scale algebra 8
      (Field.multiply algebra (power algebra a 2) d))

depressedQ :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedQ algebra a b c d =
  divide algebra
    (depressedQNumerator algebra a b c d)
    (scale algebra 8 (power algebra a 3))

depressedR :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
depressedR algebra a b c d e =
  divide algebra
    (subtract algebra
      (subtract algebra
        (Field.add algebra
          (scale algebra 16
            (product3 algebra a (power algebra b 2) c))
          (scale algebra 256
            (Field.multiply algebra (power algebra a 3) e)))
        (scale algebra 3 (power algebra b 4)))
      (scale algebra 64
        (product3 algebra (power algebra a 2) b d)))
    (scale algebra 256 (power algebra a 4))

resolventValue :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
resolventValue algebra p q r u =
  subtract algebra
    (Field.add algebra
      (subtract algebra
        (subtract algebra
          (power algebra u 3)
          (Field.multiply algebra p (power algebra u 2)))
        (scale algebra 4 (Field.multiply algebra r u)))
      (scale algebra 4 (Field.multiply algebra p r)))
    (power algebra q 2)

quarticOffset :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F
quarticOffset algebra a b =
  divide algebra b (scale algebra 4 a)

nonzeroRoot1 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot1 algebra a b s v =
  subtract algebra
    (divide algebra
      (subtract algebra
        (Field.negate algebra (scale algebra 2 s))
        v)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 4))
    (quarticOffset algebra a b)

nonzeroRoot2 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot2 algebra a b s v =
  subtract algebra
    (divide algebra
      (Field.add algebra
        (Field.negate algebra (scale algebra 2 s))
        v)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 4))
    (quarticOffset algebra a b)

nonzeroRoot3 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot3 algebra a b s w =
  subtract algebra
    (divide algebra
      (subtract algebra (scale algebra 2 s) w)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 4))
    (quarticOffset algebra a b)

nonzeroRoot4 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
nonzeroRoot4 algebra a b s w =
  subtract algebra
    (divide algebra
      (Field.add algebra (scale algebra 2 s) w)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 4))
    (quarticOffset algebra a b)

FourRootCases :
  {F : Set} →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  Set
FourRootCases x root1 root2 root3 root4 =
  x ≡ root1 ∨
  x ≡ root2 ∨
  x ≡ root3 ∨
  x ≡ root4

quartic-nonzero-case : Set₁
quartic-nonzero-case =
  (F : Set) →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (a b c d e p q r u s v w x : F) →
  a ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  p ≡ depressedP algebra a b c →
  q ≡ depressedQ algebra a b c d →
  q ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  r ≡ depressedR algebra a b c d e →
  resolventValue algebra p q r u ≡ Field.zeroF algebra →
  power algebra s 2 ≡ subtract algebra u p →
  power algebra v 2 ≡
    subtract algebra
      (scale algebra 4 (power algebra s 2))
      (scale algebra 8
        (subtract algebra u (divide algebra q s))) →
  power algebra w 2 ≡
    subtract algebra
      (scale algebra 4 (power algebra s 2))
      (scale algebra 8
        (Field.add algebra u (divide algebra q s))) →
  quarticValue algebra a b c d e x ≡ Field.zeroF algebra ↔
  FourRootCases x
    (nonzeroRoot1 algebra a b s v)
    (nonzeroRoot2 algebra a b s v)
    (nonzeroRoot3 algebra a b s w)
    (nonzeroRoot4 algebra a b s w)

zeroRoot1 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
zeroRoot1 algebra a b v =
  subtract algebra v (quarticOffset algebra a b)

zeroRoot2 :
  {F : Set} →
  Field F →
  F →
  F →
  F →
  F
zeroRoot2 algebra a b v =
  subtract algebra
    (Field.negate algebra v)
    (quarticOffset algebra a b)

quartic-zero-case : Set₁
quartic-zero-case =
  (F : Set) →
  (algebra : Field F) →
  (a b c d e p r t v w x : F) →
  a ≠ Field.zeroF algebra →
  p ≡ depressedP algebra a b c →
  depressedQNumerator algebra a b c d ≡ Field.zeroF algebra →
  r ≡ depressedR algebra a b c d e →
  power algebra t 2 ≡
    subtract algebra
      (power algebra p 2)
      (scale algebra 4 r) →
  power algebra v 2 ≡
    divide algebra
      (Field.add algebra (Field.negate algebra p) t)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 2) →
  power algebra w 2 ≡
    divide algebra
      (subtract algebra (Field.negate algebra p) t)
      (Field.fromNat algebra 2) →
  quarticValue algebra a b c d e x ≡ Field.zeroF algebra ↔
  FourRootCases x
    (zeroRoot1 algebra a b v)
    (zeroRoot2 algebra a b v)
    (zeroRoot1 algebra a b w)
    (zeroRoot2 algebra a b w)

record GeneralQuarticFormula : Set₁ where
  field
    ferrari-nonzero-case :
      quartic-nonzero-case
    biquadratic-zero-case :
      quartic-zero-case

hundred-theorems-046 : Set₁
hundred-theorems-046 =
  GeneralQuarticFormula

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of the General Quartic Equation" from Hundred
  Theorems item 046. Ferrari's formulas characterize all roots of a complex quartic in the
  biquadratic and cubic-resolvent cases. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open complexTheory;

val solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation =
  ``!a b c d e p q r s t u v w x : complex.
      a <> 0 /\
      p = (8 * a * c - 3 * b pow 2) / (8 * a pow 2) /\
      q =
        (b pow 3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a pow 2 * d) /
        (8 * a pow 3) /\
      r =
        (16 * a * b pow 2 * c + 256 * a pow 3 * e -
         3 * b pow 4 - 64 * a pow 2 * b * d) /
        (256 * a pow 4) /\
      (if q = 0 then
         t pow 2 = p pow 2 - 4 * r /\
         v pow 2 = (0 - p + t) / 2 /\
         w pow 2 = (0 - p - t) / 2
       else
         u pow 3 - p * u pow 2 - 4 * r * u +
           4 * p * r - q pow 2 = 0 /\
         s pow 2 = u - p /\
         v pow 2 = 4 * s pow 2 - 8 * (u - q / s) /\
         w pow 2 = 4 * s pow 2 - 8 * (u + q / s))
      ==>
      (if q = 0 then
         (a * x pow 4 + b * x pow 3 + c * x pow 2 + d * x + e = 0 <=>
          x = v - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = 0 - v - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = w - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = 0 - w - b / (4 * a))
       else
         (a * x pow 4 + b * x pow 3 + c * x pow 2 + d * x + e = 0 <=>
          x = (0 - 2 * s - v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = (0 - 2 * s + v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = (2 * s - w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) \/
          x = (2 * s + w) / 4 - b / (4 * a)))``;

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of the General Quartic Equation" from Hundred
:: Theorems item 046. It states Ferrari's formulas for all complex roots in the nonzero and zero
:: depressed-linear-coefficient cases and contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, SQUARE_1, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_1, NEWTON;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
    COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, COMPLEX1,
    INT_1, XXREAL_0, NEWTON;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

:: Ferrari's formula when the depressed quartic's linear coefficient is nonzero.
::$P-
theorem
  for a, b, c, d, e, p, q, r, s, u, v, w, x being Complex st
    a <> 0 &
    p = (8 * a * c - 3 * (b |^ 2)) / (8 * (a |^ 2)) &
    q = ((b |^ 3) - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * (a |^ 2) * d) /
      (8 * (a |^ 3)) &
    q <> 0 &
    r = (16 * a * (b |^ 2) * c + 256 * (a |^ 3) * e -
      3 * (b |^ 4) - 64 * (a |^ 2) * b * d) / (256 * (a |^ 4)) &
    (u |^ 3) - p * (u |^ 2) - 4 * r * u + 4 * p * r - (q |^ 2) = 0 &
    s |^ 2 = u - p &
    v |^ 2 = 4 * (s |^ 2) - 8 * (u - q / s) &
    w |^ 2 = 4 * (s |^ 2) - 8 * (u + q / s)
  holds
    (a * (x |^ 4) + b * (x |^ 3) + c * (x |^ 2) + d * x + e = 0 iff
      x = (-2 * s - v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) or
      x = (-2 * s + v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) or
      x = (2 * s - w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) or
      x = (2 * s + w) / 4 - b / (4 * a))
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Ferrari's formula when the depressed quartic's linear coefficient is zero.
::$P-
theorem
  for a, b, c, d, e, p, r, t, v, w, x being Complex st
    a <> 0 &
    p = (8 * a * c - 3 * (b |^ 2)) / (8 * (a |^ 2)) &
    (b |^ 3) - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * (a |^ 2) * d = 0 &
    r = (16 * a * (b |^ 2) * c + 256 * (a |^ 3) * e -
      3 * (b |^ 4) - 64 * (a |^ 2) * b * d) / (256 * (a |^ 4)) &
    t |^ 2 = (p |^ 2) - 4 * r &
    v |^ 2 = (-p + t) / 2 &
    w |^ 2 = (-p - t) / 2
  holds
    (a * (x |^ 4) + b * (x |^ 3) + c * (x |^ 2) + d * x + e = 0 iff
      x = v - b / (4 * a) or
      x = -v - b / (4 * a) or
      x = w - b / (4 * a) or
      x = -w - b / (4 * a))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 046_the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Solution of the General Quartic Equation" from Hundred
% Theorems item 046: Ferrari's formulas characterize all complex roots of every quartic with
% nonzero leading coefficient, in both cases for the depressed linear coefficient. This file
% contains no proof.

hundred_theorems_046: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_scale(k: real, x: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(complex_of_real(k), x)

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  complex_inv(x: complex): complex =
    LET denominator: real =
      real_part(x) * real_part(x)
        + imag_part(x) * imag_part(x)
    IN
      (# real_part := safe_div(real_part(x), denominator),
         imag_part := safe_div(-imag_part(x), denominator) #)

  complex_div(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(x, complex_inv(y))

  complex_power(x: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  quartic_value(
      a, b, c, d, e, x: complex): complex =
    complex_add(
      complex_add(
        complex_add(
          complex_add(
            complex_mul(a, complex_power(x, 4)),
            complex_mul(b, complex_power(x, 3))),
          complex_mul(c, complex_power(x, 2))),
        complex_mul(d, x)),
      e)

  ferrari_p(a, b, c: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      complex_sub(
        complex_scale(8, complex_mul(a, c)),
        complex_scale(3, complex_power(b, 2))),
      complex_scale(8, complex_power(a, 2)))

  ferrari_q(a, b, c, d: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      complex_add(
        complex_sub(
          complex_power(b, 3),
          complex_scale(
            4,
            complex_mul(complex_mul(a, b), c))),
        complex_scale(
          8,
          complex_mul(complex_power(a, 2), d))),
      complex_scale(8, complex_power(a, 3)))

  ferrari_r(a, b, c, d, e: complex): complex =
    complex_div(
      complex_sub(
        complex_sub(
          complex_add(
            complex_scale(
              16,
              complex_mul(
                complex_mul(a, complex_power(b, 2)),
                c)),
            complex_scale(
              256,
              complex_mul(complex_power(a, 3), e))),
          complex_scale(3, complex_power(b, 4))),
        complex_scale(
          64,
          complex_mul(
            complex_mul(complex_power(a, 2), b),
            d))),
      complex_scale(256, complex_power(a, 4)))

  depression_shift(a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_div(b, complex_scale(4, a))

  shifted_quartic_root(y, a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_sub(y, depression_shift(a, b))

  cubic_resolvent_value(
      p, q, r, u: complex): complex =
    complex_sub(
      complex_add(
        complex_sub(
          complex_sub(
            complex_power(u, 3),
            complex_mul(p, complex_power(u, 2))),
          complex_scale(4, complex_mul(r, u))),
        complex_scale(4, complex_mul(p, r))),
      complex_power(q, 2))

  ferrari_nonzero_root_1(
      s, v, a, b: complex): complex =
    shifted_quartic_root(
      complex_div(
        complex_sub(complex_neg(complex_scale(2, s)), v),
        complex_of_real(4)),
      a,
      b)

  ferrari_nonzero_root_2(
      s, v, a, b: complex): complex =
    shifted_quartic_root(
      complex_div(
        complex_add(complex_neg(complex_scale(2, s)), v),
        complex_of_real(4)),
      a,
      b)

  ferrari_nonzero_root_3(
      s, w, a, b: complex): complex =
    shifted_quartic_root(
      complex_div(
        complex_sub(complex_scale(2, s), w),
        complex_of_real(4)),
      a,
      b)

  ferrari_nonzero_root_4(
      s, w, a, b: complex): complex =
    shifted_quartic_root(
      complex_div(
        complex_add(complex_scale(2, s), w),
        complex_of_real(4)),
      a,
      b)

  nonzero_q_ferrari_witness(
      p, q, r, u, s, v, w: complex): bool =
    cubic_resolvent_value(p, q, r, u) = complex_zero
      AND complex_power(s, 2) = complex_sub(u, p)
      AND complex_power(v, 2)
        = complex_sub(
            complex_scale(4, complex_power(s, 2)),
            complex_scale(
              8,
              complex_sub(u, complex_div(q, s))))
      AND complex_power(w, 2)
        = complex_sub(
            complex_scale(4, complex_power(s, 2)),
            complex_scale(
              8,
              complex_add(u, complex_div(q, s))))

  nonzero_q_ferrari_roots(
      a, b, c, d, e, s, v, w: complex): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      quartic_value(a, b, c, d, e, x) = complex_zero
        IFF
      x = ferrari_nonzero_root_1(s, v, a, b)
        OR x = ferrari_nonzero_root_2(s, v, a, b)
        OR x = ferrari_nonzero_root_3(s, w, a, b)
        OR x = ferrari_nonzero_root_4(s, w, a, b)

  nonzero_q_ferrari_solution(
      a, b, c, d, e, p, q, r: complex): bool =
    FORALL (u, s, v, w: complex):
      nonzero_q_ferrari_witness(p, q, r, u, s, v, w)
        IMPLIES
      nonzero_q_ferrari_roots(a, b, c, d, e, s, v, w)

  zero_q_ferrari_witness(
      p, r, t, v, w: complex): bool =
    complex_power(t, 2)
      = complex_sub(
          complex_power(p, 2),
          complex_scale(4, r))
      AND complex_power(v, 2)
        = complex_div(
            complex_add(complex_neg(p), t),
            complex_of_real(2))
      AND complex_power(w, 2)
        = complex_div(
            complex_sub(complex_neg(p), t),
            complex_of_real(2))

  zero_q_ferrari_roots(
      a, b, c, d, e, v, w: complex): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      quartic_value(a, b, c, d, e, x) = complex_zero
        IFF
      x = shifted_quartic_root(v, a, b)
        OR x = shifted_quartic_root(complex_neg(v), a, b)
        OR x = shifted_quartic_root(w, a, b)
        OR x = shifted_quartic_root(complex_neg(w), a, b)

  zero_q_ferrari_solution(
      a, b, c, d, e, p, r: complex): bool =
    FORALL (t, v, w: complex):
      zero_q_ferrari_witness(p, r, t, v, w)
        IMPLIES
      zero_q_ferrari_roots(a, b, c, d, e, v, w)

  ferrari_solution(
      a, b, c, d, e: complex): bool =
    LET p: complex = ferrari_p(a, b, c)
    IN
      LET q: complex = ferrari_q(a, b, c, d)
      IN
        LET r: complex = ferrari_r(a, b, c, d, e)
        IN
          (q = complex_zero
            AND zero_q_ferrari_solution(
              a,
              b,
              c,
              d,
              e,
              p,
              r))
          OR
          (NOT (q = complex_zero)
            AND nonzero_q_ferrari_solution(
              a,
              b,
              c,
              d,
              e,
              p,
              q,
              r))

  the_solution_of_the_general_quartic_equation: bool =
    FORALL (a, b, c, d, e: complex):
      NOT (a = complex_zero)
        IMPLIES ferrari_solution(a, b, c, d, e)
END hundred_theorems_046

-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 047, "The Central Limit Theorem": independent identically distributed real random variables with finite variance have normalized partial-sum laws converging weakly to the standard normal distribution. This file contains no proof.
module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Portmanteau
public import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Real
public import Mathlib.Probability.Independence.Basic
public import Mathlib.Probability.Moments.Variance

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

noncomputable section

theorem central_limit_theorem_zero_mean
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hX_measurable : ∀ n, Measurable (X n))
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hX_mean_zero : ∀ n, ∫ ω, X n ω ∂P = 0)
    (hσ_pos : 0 < σ)
    (hX_square_integrable : ∀ n, Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X n ω) ^ 2) P)
    (hX_variance : ∀ n, variance (X n) P = σ ^ 2)
    (hX_distrib : ∀ n, P.map (X n) = μ) :
    ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂P.map (fun ω ↦
          (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) * σ ^ 2)))
        atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
  sorry

theorem central_limit_theorem
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ) (m σ : ℝ)
    (hX_measurable : ∀ n, Measurable (X n))
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hX_mean : ∀ n, ∫ ω, X n ω ∂P = m)
    (hσ_pos : 0 < σ)
    (hX_square_integrable : ∀ n, Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X n ω) ^ 2) P)
    (hX_variance : ∀ n, variance (X n) P = σ ^ 2)
    (hX_distrib : ∀ n, P.map (X n) = μ) :
    ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂P.map (fun ω ↦
          (∑ i ∈ range n, (X i ω - m)) / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) * σ ^ 2)))

title: 047_the_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Central Limit Theorem" from Hundred
  Theorems item 047. It states the measure-theoretic central limit theorem for
  independent identically distributed real random variables, in zero-mean and
  centered forms, with convergence in distribution to the standard normal.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals RiemannInt List.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition set (A : Type) := A -> Prop.

Definition empty_set {A : Type} : set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition full_set {A : Type} : set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition set_complement {A : Type} (E : set A) : set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition set_intersection {A : Type} (E F : set A) : set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition countable_union {A : Type} (E : nat -> set A) : set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition preimage {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) (E : set B) : set A :=
  fun x => E (f x).

Definition same_set {A : Type} (E F : set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition disjoint_sets {A : Type} (E F : set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition pairwise_disjoint {A : Type} (E : nat -> set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> disjoint_sets (E i) (E j).

Fixpoint partial_sum (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => u O
  | S k => partial_sum u k + u (S k)
  end.

Definition sequence_converges (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R,
    0 < eps ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < eps.

Definition series_sum (u : nat -> R) (sum : R) : Prop :=
  sequence_converges (partial_sum u) sum.

Definition sigma_class {A : Type} (C : set (set A)) : Prop :=
  C empty_set /\
  (forall E : set A, C E -> C (set_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> set A,
      (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
      C (countable_union E)).

Definition open_real_set (U : set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists eps : R,
      0 < eps /\
      forall y : R, Rabs (y - x) < eps -> U y.

Definition borel_set (E : set R) : Prop :=
  forall C : set (set R),
    sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : set R, open_real_set U -> C U) ->
    C E.

Record probability_space (A : Type) := {
  ps_measurable : set A -> Prop;
  ps_measurable_empty : ps_measurable empty_set;
  ps_measurable_complement :
    forall E : set A,
      ps_measurable E ->
      ps_measurable (set_complement E);
  ps_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> set A,
      (forall n : nat, ps_measurable (E n)) ->
      ps_measurable (countable_union E);
  ps_measure : set A -> R;
  ps_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : set A,
      same_set E F ->
      ps_measure E = ps_measure F;
  ps_measure_nonnegative :
    forall E : set A,
      ps_measurable E ->
      0 <= ps_measure E;
  ps_measure_empty : ps_measure empty_set = 0;
  ps_measure_total : ps_measure full_set = 1;
  ps_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> set A,
      (forall n : nat, ps_measurable (E n)) ->
      pairwise_disjoint E ->
      series_sum
        (fun n => ps_measure (E n))
        (ps_measure (countable_union E))
}.

Record borel_measure := {
  bm_measure : set R -> R;
  bm_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : set R,
      same_set E F ->
      bm_measure E = bm_measure F;
  bm_measure_nonnegative :
    forall E : set R,
      borel_set E ->
      0 <= bm_measure E;
  bm_measure_empty : bm_measure empty_set = 0;
  bm_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> set R,
      (forall n : nat, borel_set (E n)) ->
      pairwise_disjoint E ->
      series_sum
        (fun n => bm_measure (E n))
        (bm_measure (countable_union E))
}.

Definition measurable_real_function {A : Type}
    (measurable : set A -> Prop) (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall B : set R,
    borel_set B ->
    measurable (preimage f B).

Definition finite_partition {A : Type}
    (measurable : set A -> Prop)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> set A) : Prop :=
  (forall i : nat, (i <= k)%nat -> measurable (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
      (i <= k)%nat ->
      (j <= k)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      disjoint_sets (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
      exists i : nat, (i <= k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Fixpoint finite_sum (k : nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match k with
  | O => f O
  | S n => finite_sum n f + f (S n)
  end.

Definition simple_integral_below {A : Type}
    (measurable : set A -> Prop) (measure : set A -> R)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R) (cells : nat -> set A),
    finite_partition measurable k cells /\
    (forall i : nat, (i <= k)%nat -> 0 <= coefficients i) /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
        (i <= k)%nat ->
        cells i x ->
        coefficients i <= f x) /\
    value =
      finite_sum k
        (fun i => coefficients i * measure (cells i)).

Definition least_upper_bound (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R, values value -> value <= bound) /\
  (forall upper : R,
      (forall value : R, values value -> value <= upper) ->
      bound <= upper).

Definition nonnegative_lebesgue_integral {A : Type}
    (measurable : set A -> Prop) (measure : set A -> R)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  least_upper_bound
    (simple_integral_below measurable measure f)
    value.

Definition positive_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax x 0.

Definition negative_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax (- x) 0.

Definition has_finite_lebesgue_integral {A : Type}
    (measurable : set A -> Prop) (measure : set A -> R)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  measurable_real_function measurable f /\
  exists positive_integral negative_integral : R,
    nonnegative_lebesgue_integral measurable measure
      (fun x => positive_part (f x)) positive_integral /\
    nonnegative_lebesgue_integral measurable measure
      (fun x => negative_part (f x)) negative_integral /\
    value = positive_integral - negative_integral.

Definition random_variable {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R) : Prop :=
  measurable_real_function (ps_measurable P) X.

Definition has_expectation {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R) (mean : R) : Prop :=
  has_finite_lebesgue_integral
    (ps_measurable P) (ps_measure P) X mean.

Definition integrable {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, has_expectation P X value.

Definition square_integrable {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R) : Prop :=
  integrable P (fun x => (X x) ^ 2).

Definition has_variance {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R) (variance : R) : Prop :=
  exists mean : R,
    has_expectation P X mean /\
    has_expectation P (fun x => (X x - mean) ^ 2) variance.

Definition has_distribution {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : A -> R)
    (mu : borel_measure) : Prop :=
  random_variable P X /\
  forall B : set R,
    borel_set B ->
    ps_measure P (preimage X B) = bm_measure mu B.

Fixpoint finite_intersection {A : Type}
    (X : nat -> A -> R) (indices : list nat)
    (events : nat -> set R) : set A :=
  match indices with
  | nil => full_set
  | i :: rest =>
      set_intersection
        (preimage (X i) (events i))
        (finite_intersection X rest events)
  end.

Fixpoint finite_product (indices : list nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match indices with
  | nil => 1
  | i :: rest => f i * finite_product rest f
  end.

Definition independent_random_variables {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (X : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat, random_variable P (X n)) /\
  forall (indices : list nat) (events : nat -> set R),
    NoDup indices ->
    (forall i : nat, In i indices -> borel_set (events i)) ->
    ps_measure P (finite_intersection X indices events) =
    finite_product indices
      (fun i => ps_measure P (preimage (X i) (events i))).

Fixpoint sum_first (n : nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => sum_first k f + f k
  end.

Definition has_riemann_integral
    (f : R -> R) (a b value : R) : Prop :=
  exists pr : Riemann_integrable f a b,
    @RiemannInt f a b pr = value.

Definition tends_to_at_negative_infinity
    (f : R -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R,
    0 < eps ->
    exists cutoff : R,
      forall x : R,
        x <= cutoff ->
        Rabs (f x - limit) < eps.

Definition standard_normal_density (x : R) : R :=
  exp (- (x ^ 2) / 2) / sqrt (2 * PI).

Definition standard_normal_cdf_value (t value : R) : Prop :=
  exists finite_integral : R -> R,
    (forall a : R,
        has_riemann_integral
          standard_normal_density a t (finite_integral a)) /\
    tends_to_at_negative_infinity finite_integral value.

Definition converges_in_distribution_to_standard_normal {A : Type}
    (P : probability_space A) (Y : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat, random_variable P (Y n)) /\
  forall t : R,
    exists cdf_value : R,
      standard_normal_cdf_value t cdf_value /\
      sequence_converges
        (fun n =>
           ps_measure P (fun x => Y n x <= t))
        cdf_value.

Theorem central_limit_theorem_zero_mean :
  forall (A : Type) (P : probability_space A)
         (X : nat -> A -> R) (mu : borel_measure)
         (sigma : R) (S : nat -> A -> R),
    independent_random_variables P X ->
    (forall n : nat, has_expectation P (X n) 0) ->
    0 < sigma ->
    (forall n : nat, square_integrable P (X n)) ->
    (forall n : nat, has_variance P (X n) (sigma ^ 2)) ->
    (forall n : nat, has_distribution P (X n) mu) ->
    (forall (n : nat) (x : A),
        S n x = sum_first n (fun i => X i x)) ->
    converges_in_distribution_to_standard_normal P
      (fun n x =>
         S n x / sqrt (INR n * sigma ^ 2)).
Admitted.

Theorem central_limit_theorem :
  forall (A : Type) (P : probability_space A)
         (X : nat -> A -> R) (mu : borel_measure)
         (sigma : R) (S X_centered : nat -> A -> R) (m : R),
    independent_random_variables P X ->
    (forall n : nat, has_expectation P (X n) m) ->
    0 < sigma ->
    (forall n : nat, square_integrable P (X n)) ->
    (forall n : nat, has_variance P (X n) (sigma ^ 2)) ->
    (forall n : nat, has_distribution P (X n) mu) ->
    (forall (i : nat) (x : A),
        X_centered i x = X i x - m) ->
    converges_in_distribution_to_standard_normal P
      (fun n x =>
         sum_first n (fun i => X_centered i x) /
         sqrt (INR n * sigma ^ 2)).
Admitted.

title: 047_the_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*  Title:     HOL/Probability/Central_Limit_Theorem.thy
    Authors:   Jeremy Avigad (CMU), Luke Serafin (CMU)
*)

section \<open>The Central Limit Theorem\<close>

theory Central_Limit_Theorem
  imports Levy
begin

theorem (in prob_space) central_limit_theorem_zero_mean:
  fixes X :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and \<mu> :: "real measure"
    and \<sigma> :: real
    and S :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes X_indep: "indep_vars (\<lambda>i. borel) X UNIV"
    and X_mean_0: "\<And>n. expectation (X n) = 0"
    and \<sigma>_pos: "\<sigma> > 0"
    and X_square_integrable: "\<And>n. integrable M (\<lambda>x. (X n x)\<^sup>2)"
    and X_variance: "\<And>n. variance (X n) = \<sigma>\<^sup>2"
    and X_distrib: "\<And>n. distr M borel (X n) = \<mu>"
  defines "S n \<equiv> \<lambda>x. \<Sum>i<n. X i x"
  shows "weak_conv_m (\<lambda>n. distr M borel (\<lambda>x. S n x / sqrt (n * \<sigma>\<^sup>2))) std_normal_distribution"
  by sorry

theorem (in prob_space) central_limit_theorem:
  fixes X :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and \<mu> :: "real measure"
    and \<sigma> :: real
    and S :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes X_indep: "indep_vars (\<lambda>i. borel) X UNIV"
    and X_mean: "\<And>n. expectation (X n) = m"
    and \<sigma>_pos: "\<sigma> > 0"
    and X_square_integrable: "\<And>n. integrable M (\<lambda>x. (X n x)\<^sup>2)"
    and X_variance: "\<And>n. variance (X n) = \<sigma>\<^sup>2"
    and X_distrib: "\<And>n. distr M borel (X n) = \<mu>"
  defines "X' i x \<equiv> X i x - m"
  shows "weak_conv_m (\<lambda>n. distr M borel (\<lambda>x. (\<Sum>i<n. X' i x) / sqrt (n*\<sigma>\<^sup>2))) std_normal_distribution"
  by sorry

end

title: 047_the_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Central Limit Theorem" from Hundred
  Theorems artifact 047 (hundred-theorems__hol-light__047). It states the
  zero-mean and centered central limit theorems for identically distributed
  independent real random variables on an arbitrary probability space:
  normalized partial sums converge weakly to the standard normal law. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let HUNDRED_THEOREMS_047_CENTRAL_LIMIT_THEOREM_ZERO_MEAN =
 `let seq_tends =
      \(u:num->real) l.
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let probability_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (p:(A->bool)->real).
        (!s. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s. s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {a:A | ?n. a IN sets n} IN events) /\
        p {} = &0 /\
        p carrier = &1 /\
        (!s. s IN events ==> &0 <= p s) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> seq_tends
                 (\n. sum {k:num | k < n} (\k. p (sets k)))
                 (p {a:A | ?k. a IN sets k})) in
   let random_variable =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool) (Y:A->real).
        !x. {a:A | a IN carrier /\ Y a <= x} IN events in
   let independent_sequence =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (p:(A->bool)->real) (X:num->A->real).
        (!n. random_variable carrier events (X n)) /\
        (!inds:num->bool thresholds:num->real.
           FINITE inds
           ==> p
                 (carrier INTER
                  INTERS
                    (IMAGE
                      (\i. {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                    X i a <= thresholds i})
                      inds)) =
               product inds
                 (\i. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                  X i a <= thresholds i})) in
   let nonnegative_expectation =
      \(p:(A->bool)->real) (carrier:A->bool) (Y:A->real) e.
        (!a. a IN carrier ==> &0 <= Y a) /\
        seq_tends
          (\n. inv(&(2 EXP n)) *
               sum {k:num | 1 <= k /\ k <= n * 2 EXP n}
                 (\k. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                  &k / &(2 EXP n) <= Y a}))
          e in
   let has_expectation =
      \(p:(A->bool)->real) (carrier:A->bool) (Y:A->real) e.
        ?ep en.
          nonnegative_expectation p carrier
            (\a. if &0 <= Y a then Y a else &0) ep /\
          nonnegative_expectation p carrier
            (\a. if Y a < &0 then --(Y a) else &0) en /\
          e = ep - en in
   let derivative_at =
      \(g:real->real) dg x.
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                    !h. &0 < abs h /\ abs h < d
                        ==> abs((g(x + h) - g x) / h - dg) < e in
   let standard_normal_cdf =
      @Phi:real->real.
        ?phi:real->real.
          (!x. &0 < phi x) /\
          (!x. derivative_at phi (--(x * phi x)) x) /\
          (!x. derivative_at Phi (phi x) x) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                       !x. x < --B ==> abs(Phi x) < e) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                       !x. B < x ==> abs(Phi x - &1) < e) in
   !carrier:A->bool
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    p:(A->bool)->real
    X:num->A->real
    mu:real->real
    sigma:real
    S:num->A->real.
      probability_space carrier events p /\
      independent_sequence carrier events p X /\
      (!n. has_expectation p carrier (X n) (&0)) /\
      &0 < sigma /\
      (!n. has_expectation p carrier
             (\a:A. X n a pow 2) (sigma pow 2)) /\
      (!n x. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\ X n a <= x} = mu x) /\
      (!n a. S n a = sum {i:num | i < n} (\i. X i a))
      ==> !x:real.
            seq_tends
              (\n. p
                {a:A |
                  a IN carrier /\
                  S n a /
                    (@r:real.
                       &0 <= r /\ r pow 2 = &n * sigma pow 2) <= x})
              (standard_normal_cdf x)`;;

let HUNDRED_THEOREMS_047_CENTRAL_LIMIT_THEOREM =
 `let seq_tends =
      \(u:num->real) l.
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let probability_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (p:(A->bool)->real).
        (!s. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s. s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {a:A | ?n. a IN sets n} IN events) /\
        p {} = &0 /\
        p carrier = &1 /\
        (!s. s IN events ==> &0 <= p s) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> seq_tends
                 (\n. sum {k:num | k < n} (\k. p (sets k)))
                 (p {a:A | ?k. a IN sets k})) in
   let random_variable =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool) (Y:A->real).
        !x. {a:A | a IN carrier /\ Y a <= x} IN events in
   let independent_sequence =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (p:(A->bool)->real) (X:num->A->real).
        (!n. random_variable carrier events (X n)) /\
        (!inds:num->bool thresholds:num->real.
           FINITE inds
           ==> p
                 (carrier INTER
                  INTERS
                    (IMAGE
                      (\i. {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                    X i a <= thresholds i})
                      inds)) =
               product inds
                 (\i. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                  X i a <= thresholds i})) in
   let nonnegative_expectation =
      \(p:(A->bool)->real) (carrier:A->bool) (Y:A->real) e.
        (!a. a IN carrier ==> &0 <= Y a) /\
        seq_tends
          (\n. inv(&(2 EXP n)) *
               sum {k:num | 1 <= k /\ k <= n * 2 EXP n}
                 (\k. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\
                                  &k / &(2 EXP n) <= Y a}))
          e in
   let has_expectation =
      \(p:(A->bool)->real) (carrier:A->bool) (Y:A->real) e.
        ?ep en.
          nonnegative_expectation p carrier
            (\a. if &0 <= Y a then Y a else &0) ep /\
          nonnegative_expectation p carrier
            (\a. if Y a < &0 then --(Y a) else &0) en /\
          e = ep - en in
   let derivative_at =
      \(g:real->real) dg x.
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                    !h. &0 < abs h /\ abs h < d
                        ==> abs((g(x + h) - g x) / h - dg) < e in
   let standard_normal_cdf =
      @Phi:real->real.
        ?phi:real->real.
          (!x. &0 < phi x) /\
          (!x. derivative_at phi (--(x * phi x)) x) /\
          (!x. derivative_at Phi (phi x) x) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                       !x. x < --B ==> abs(Phi x) < e) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                       !x. B < x ==> abs(Phi x - &1) < e) in
   !carrier:A->bool
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    p:(A->bool)->real
    X:num->A->real
    mu:real->real
    sigma:real
    m:real
    S:num->A->real
    Xc:num->A->real.
      probability_space carrier events p /\
      independent_sequence carrier events p X /\
      (!n. has_expectation p carrier (X n) m) /\
      &0 < sigma /\
      (!n. ?second.
             has_expectation p carrier
               (\a:A. X n a pow 2) second) /\
      (!n. has_expectation p carrier
             (\a:A. (X n a - m) pow 2) (sigma pow 2)) /\
      (!n x. p {a:A | a IN carrier /\ X n a <= x} = mu x) /\
      (!i a. Xc i a = X i a - m)
      ==> !x:real.
            seq_tends
              (\n. p
                {a:A |
                  a IN carrier /\
                  sum {i:num | i < n} (\i. Xc i a) /
                    (@r:real.
                       &0 <= r /\ r pow 2 = &n * sigma pow 2) <= x})
              (standard_normal_cdf x)`;;

title: 047_the_central_limit_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__047, "The Central Limit Theorem": independent,
;; identically distributed real random variables with positive finite
;; variance have normalized zero-mean or centered partial-sum laws converging
;; weakly to the standard normal distribution. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, functions, sigma algebras, and operations are tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, and
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; witnesses. The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence
;; a presentation of the real field. The measure on an arbitrary subset is
;; characterized as the infimum of the measures of its measurable supersets,
;; so null exceptional sets use outer-measure semantics. Measurability is
;; defined through upper-ray preimages, lintegral is the supremum of integrals
;; of measurable finite-range simple functions below the integrand, and the
;; real integral is defined from positive and negative parts. Weak convergence
;; is rendered by its equivalent bounded-continuous-test-function
;; characterization along the sequential filter.

(defun ht047-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun ht047-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (ht047-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (ht047-quoted nil)))

(defun ht047-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (ht047-term-list arguments)))

(defun ht047-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (ht047-apply-term
   (ht047-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun ht047-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht047-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (ht047-quoted nil))
    (ht047-quoted t)))

(defun ht047-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht047-quoted t)
            (ht047-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (ht047-quoted nil)))

(defun ht047-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (ht047-quoted nil)
        (ht047-quoted t)))

(defun ht047-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (ht047-quoted t)))

(defun ht047-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (ht047-quoted t)
              (ht047-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (ht047-quoted nil)
              (ht047-quoted t))))

(defun ht047-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht047-quoted t)))

(defun ht047-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht047-quoted nil)))

(defun ht047-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (ht047-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun ht047-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (ht047-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun ht047-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht047-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun ht047-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun ht047-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-and-terms
     (list
      (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht047-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (ht047-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun ht047-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht047-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht047-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun ht047-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht047-iff-term
     (ht047-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (ht047-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun ht047-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (ht047-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (ht047-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun ht047-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (ht047-quoted nil)))

(defun ht047-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun ht047-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-and-terms
    (list
     (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht047-not-term
      (ht047-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun ht047-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
    (ht047-static-apply-term
     codomain-carrier
     (list (ht047-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun ht047-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-function-values-function
     domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun ht047-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (ht047-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (ht047-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (ht047-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (ht047-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht047-implies-term
      (ht047-and-terms
       (list
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht047-and-terms
       (list
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (ht047-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (ht047-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (ht047-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (ht047-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (ht047-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (ht047-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (ht047-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (ht047-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (ht047-quoted zero)))
        (ht047-implies-term
         (ht047-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (ht047-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (ht047-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (ht047-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht047-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (ht047-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun ht047-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (ht047-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (ht047-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (ht047-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht047-implies-term
      (ht047-and-terms
       (list
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht047-and-terms
       (list
        (ht047-not-term
         (ht047-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (ht047-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (ht047-implies-term
         (ht047-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (ht047-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (ht047-implies-term
         xy
         (ht047-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht047-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (ht047-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (ht047-implies-term
         (ht047-and-terms
          (list
           (ht047-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht047-quoted zero) 'x))
           (ht047-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht047-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (ht047-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht047-quoted zero)
           (ht047-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun ht047-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-and-terms
     (list
      (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht047-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (ht047-not-term
     (ht047-static-apply-term
      less (list (ht047-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun ht047-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (ht047-member-p carrier upper)
   (ht047-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun ht047-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-and-terms
    (list
     (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht047-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun ht047-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (ht047-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht047-exists-p
    (ht047-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun ht047-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'ht047-upper-bound-p
         (ht047-quoted carrier)
         (ht047-quoted less)
         (ht047-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun ht047-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (ht047-exists-p
   (ht047-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun ht047-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'ht047-upper-bound-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          (ht047-quoted less)
          (ht047-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (ht047-not-term
     (ht047-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (ht047-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun ht047-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (ht047-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun ht047-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht047-valid-set-p
            (ht047-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht047-set-nonempty-p
            (ht047-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht047-bounded-above-p
            (ht047-quoted carrier)
            (ht047-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'ht047-least-upper-bound-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          (ht047-quoted less)
          'set
          (ht047-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun ht047-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (ht047-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht047-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (ht047-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun ht047-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (ht047-binary-value less value zero)
      (ht047-unary-value negate value)
    value))
;; Sigma algebras.

(defun ht047-family-extensional-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'ht047-set-equiv-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (ht047-iff-term
     (ht047-static-apply-term family '(left))
     (ht047-static-apply-term family '(right))))))

(defun ht047-family-members-valid-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (list 'ht047-valid-set-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          'set))))

(defun ht047-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-family-extensional-function carrier family)
    '(left right))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-family-members-valid-function carrier family)
    '(set))))

(defun ht047-sequence-union-member-function (sequence x)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht047-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'natp 'n)
     (ht047-apply-term
      (ht047-static-apply-term sequence '(n))
      (list (ht047-quoted x)))))))

(defun ht047-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (ht047-exists-p
   (ht047-sequence-union-member-function sequence x)
   '(n)))

(defun ht047-sequence-union-set (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-and-terms
    (list
     (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (list 'ht047-sequence-union-member-p
           (ht047-quoted sequence)
           'x)))))

(defun ht047-sequence-of-sets-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (list 'ht047-valid-set-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          (ht047-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht047-sequence-of-sets-p (carrier sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-sequence-of-sets-function carrier sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun ht047-sequence-members-family-function (family sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (ht047-static-apply-term
     family
     (list (ht047-static-apply-term sequence '(n)))))))

(defun ht047-sequence-members-family-p
    (carrier family sequence)
  (and
   (ht047-sequence-of-sets-p carrier sequence)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-sequence-members-family-function family sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun ht047-sigma-complement-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (ht047-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'ht047-complement-set
            (ht047-quoted carrier)
            'set))))))

(defun ht047-sigma-union-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(sequence)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'ht047-sequence-members-family-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          (ht047-quoted family)
          'sequence)
    (ht047-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'ht047-sequence-union-set
            (ht047-quoted carrier)
            'sequence))))))

(defun ht047-sigma-algebra-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (ht047-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
   (ht047-member-p family (ht047-empty-set))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-sigma-complement-function carrier family)
    '(set))
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-sigma-union-function carrier family)
    '(sequence))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun ht047-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :ht047-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :ht047-finite)
    (ht047-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (ht047-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun ht047-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :ht047-finite value))

(defun ht047-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (ht047-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun ht047-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :ht047-top) nil)
   ((equal right :ht047-top) t)
   (t
    (ht047-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht047-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (ht047-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun ht047-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :ht047-top)
          (equal right :ht047-top))
      :ht047-top
    (ht047-ennreal-finite
     (ht047-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun ht047-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (ht047-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (ht047-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (ht047-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :ht047-top)
        (equal right :ht047-top))
    :ht047-top)
   (t
    (ht047-ennreal-finite
     (ht047-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun ht047-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (ht047-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (ht047-ennreal-add
     (ht047-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (ht047-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

(defun ht047-sum-upper-bound-function
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'ht047-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'ht047-finite-ennreal-sum
                (ht047-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (ht047-quoted scalar-zero)
                (ht047-quoted scalar-add))
          (ht047-quoted total)
          (ht047-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht047-sum-upper-bound-p
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (ht047-universal-p
   (ht047-sum-upper-bound-function
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   '(count)))

(defun ht047-sum-least-function
    (sequence total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(bound)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht047-ennreal-p
            'bound
            (ht047-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (ht047-quoted scalar-zero)
            (ht047-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'ht047-sum-upper-bound-p
            (ht047-quoted sequence)
            'bound
            (ht047-quoted scalar-zero)
            (ht047-quoted scalar-add)
            (ht047-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'ht047-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (ht047-quoted total)
          'bound
          (ht047-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht047-countable-sum-p
    (sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (ht047-ennreal-p
    total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
   (ht047-sum-upper-bound-p
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   (ht047-universal-p
    (ht047-sum-least-function
     sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
    '(bound))))

;; Countably additive measures, including values on arbitrary subsets.

(defun ht047-measure-extensional-function (carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'ht047-set-equiv-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (list 'equal
          (ht047-static-apply-term measure '(left))
          (ht047-static-apply-term measure '(right))))))

(defun ht047-measure-values-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (list 'ht047-valid-set-p
          (ht047-quoted carrier)
          'set)
    (list 'ht047-ennreal-p
          (ht047-static-apply-term measure '(set))
          (ht047-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (ht047-quoted scalar-zero)
          (ht047-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun ht047-measure-sequence-values (measure sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (ht047-static-apply-term
    measure
    (list (ht047-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun ht047-disjoint-sets-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht047-implies-term
    (ht047-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht047-not-term
     (ht047-and-terms
      (list
       (ht047-static-apply-term left '(x))
       (ht047-static-apply-term right '(x))))))))

(defun ht047-disjoint-sets-p (carrier left right)
  (ht047-universal-p
   (ht047-disjoint-sets-function carrier left right)
   '(x)))
