title: 005_the_prime_number_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Prime Number Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 005.
% This file contains no proof.

the_prime_number_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    divisor > 0
      AND EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  prime_count(bound: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF bound = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      prime_count(bound - 1)
        + IF prime_nat(bound) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE bound

  natural_log_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET j: nat = count - 1,
          ratio: real = safe_div(x - 1, x + 1)
      IN
        natural_log_partial(x, count - 1)
          + 2 * safe_div(
              ratio ^ (2 * j + 1),
              (2 * j + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  natural_log_value(x, value: real): bool =
    x > 0
      AND converges_to(
        (LAMBDA (count: nat): natural_log_partial(x, count)),
        value)

  prime_ratio(index: nat, log_index: real): real =
    safe_div(
      prime_count(index) :: real,
      safe_div(index :: real, log_index))

  the_prime_number_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            EXISTS (log_index: real):
              natural_log_value(index :: real, log_index)
                AND abs(prime_ratio(index, log_index) - 1) < eps
END the_prime_number_theorem

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Number of Platonic Solids" from Hundred Theorems item 050.
-- It classifies the constant face-edge and vertex-edge incidence counts of full-dimensional
-- polytopes in real three-space, with exactly the five Platonic pairs. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Theorems100.NumberOfPlatonicSolids

noncomputable section

abbrev Point := Fin 3 → ℝ

/-- The affine combination of a finite family of points with the given coefficients. -/
def weightedPoint {k : ℕ} (coefficients : Fin k → ℝ) (points : Fin k → Point) : Point :=
  fun coordinate => ∑ i, coefficients i * points i coordinate

/-- The convex hull of a finite indexed family of points. -/
def finiteConvexHull {k : ℕ} (vertices : Fin k → Point) : Set Point :=
  {x |
    ∃ coefficients : Fin k → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ coefficients i) ∧
        (∑ i, coefficients i) = 1 ∧
          x = weightedPoint coefficients vertices}

/-- A polytope is the convex hull of finitely many points. -/
def IsPolytope (p : Set Point) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin k → Point, p = finiteConvexHull vertices

/-- The point at parameter `t` on the segment from `x` to `y`. -/
def segmentPoint (t : ℝ) (x y : Point) : Point :=
  fun coordinate => (1 - t) * x coordinate + t * y coordinate

/-- Convexity stated directly using line segments. -/
def IsConvexSet (s : Set Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ t : ℝ,
    0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → segmentPoint t x y ∈ s

/--
`f` is a face of `p` when it is a convex subset of `p` and any relative-interior
point of a segment in `p` lying in `f` forces both endpoints to lie in `f`.
-/
def IsFace (f p : Set Point) : Prop :=
  f ⊆ p ∧
    IsConvexSet f ∧
      ∀ x ∈ p, ∀ y ∈ p, ∀ t : ℝ,
        0 < t → t < 1 → segmentPoint t x y ∈ f → x ∈ f ∧ y ∈ f

/-- Affine independence via the only affine linear relation being the trivial one. -/
def AffineIndependent {k : ℕ} (points : Fin k → Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ coefficients : Fin k → ℝ,
    (∑ i, coefficients i) = 0 →
      (∀ coordinate : Fin 3, (∑ i, coefficients i * points i coordinate) = 0) →
        ∀ i, coefficients i = 0

/-- The set has affine dimension exactly `d`. -/
def AffineDimensionEq (s : Set Point) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∃ points : Fin (d + 1) → Point,
      (∀ i, points i ∈ s) ∧ AffineIndependent points) ∧
    ¬∃ points : Fin (d + 2) → Point,
      (∀ i, points i ∈ s) ∧ AffineIndependent points

/--
A full-dimensional polytope in real three-space has a constant number `m` of edges
on each two-dimensional face and a constant number `n` of edges at each vertex if
and only if `(m, n)` is one of the five Platonic incidence pairs.
-/
theorem number_of_platonic_solids (m n : ℕ) :
    (∃ p : Set Point,
        IsPolytope p ∧
          AffineDimensionEq p 3 ∧
            (∀ f : Set Point,
              IsFace f p ∧ AffineDimensionEq f 2 →
                {e : Set Point |
                    IsFace e p ∧ AffineDimensionEq e 1 ∧ e ⊆ f}.ncard =
                  m) ∧
              (∀ v : Set Point,
                IsFace v p ∧ AffineDimensionEq v 0 →
                  {e : Set Point |
                      IsFace e p ∧ AffineDimensionEq e 1 ∧ v ⊆ e}.ncard =
                    n)) ↔
      (m = 3 ∧ n = 3) ∨
        (m = 4 ∧ n = 3) ∨
          (m = 3 ∧ n = 4) ∨
            (m = 5 ∧ n = 3) ∨
              (m = 3 ∧ n = 5) := sorry

end

end Theorems100.NumberOfPlatonicSolids

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems__rocq__050,
   "The Number of Platonic Solids": full-dimensional real three-dimensional
   polytopes with constant numbers of edges per facet and at each vertex have
   exactly the five Platonic incidence pairs. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition point := (R * (R * R))%type.

Definition point_zero : point := (0, (0, 0)).

Definition point_add (u v : point) : point :=
  (fst u + fst v,
   (fst (snd u) + fst (snd v), snd (snd u) + snd (snd v))).

Definition point_scale (a : R) (u : point) : point :=
  (a * fst u, (a * fst (snd u), a * snd (snd u))).

Definition point_dot (u v : point) : R :=
  fst u * fst v +
  fst (snd u) * fst (snd v) +
  snd (snd u) * snd (snd v).

Fixpoint sum_reals (xs : list R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: rest => x + sum_reals rest
  end.

Fixpoint linear_combination (weights : list R) (vertices : list point)
    : point :=
  match weights, vertices with
  | w :: ws, v :: vs =>
      point_add (point_scale w v) (linear_combination ws vs)
  | _, _ => point_zero
  end.

Definition convex_hull (vertices : list point) : point -> Prop :=
  fun x =>
    exists weights : list R,
      length weights = length vertices /\
      Forall (fun w => 0 <= w) weights /\
      sum_reals weights = 1 /\
      linear_combination weights vertices = x.

Definition subset (s t : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x, s x -> t x.

Definition same_set (s t : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x, s x <-> t x.

Fixpoint pairwise_distinct_sets (sets : list (point -> Prop)) : Prop :=
  match sets with
  | [] => True
  | s :: rest =>
      (forall t, In t rest -> ~ same_set s t) /\
      pairwise_distinct_sets rest
  end.

Definition has_cardinality
    (collection : (point -> Prop) -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists representatives : list (point -> Prop),
    length representatives = n /\
    (forall s,
      collection s <->
      exists t, In t representatives /\ same_set s t) /\
    pairwise_distinct_sets representatives.

Definition affine_dimension_zero (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists a, s a /\ forall x, s x -> x = a.

Definition affine_dimension_at_most_one (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists a direction,
    (exists x, s x) /\
    forall x, s x ->
      exists parameter : R,
        x = point_add a (point_scale parameter direction).

Definition affine_dimension_one (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  affine_dimension_at_most_one s /\ ~ affine_dimension_zero s.

Definition affine_dimension_at_most_two (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists normal offset,
    normal <> point_zero /\
    (exists x, s x) /\
    forall x, s x -> point_dot normal x = offset.

Definition affine_dimension_two (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  affine_dimension_at_most_two s /\
  ~ affine_dimension_at_most_one s.

Definition full_dimensional_three (s : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  (exists x, s x) /\ ~ affine_dimension_at_most_two s.

Definition face_of (polytope face : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists normal offset,
    (forall x, polytope x -> point_dot normal x <= offset) /\
    (forall x,
      face x <-> polytope x /\ point_dot normal x = offset).

Definition edge_in_facet
    (polytope facet edge : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  face_of polytope edge /\
  affine_dimension_one edge /\
  subset edge facet.

Definition edge_at_vertex
    (polytope vertex edge : point -> Prop) : Prop :=
  face_of polytope edge /\
  affine_dimension_one edge /\
  subset vertex edge.

Theorem number_of_platonic_solids :
  forall m n : nat,
    (exists vertices : list point,
      let polytope := convex_hull vertices in
      full_dimensional_three polytope /\
      (forall facet,
        face_of polytope facet ->
        affine_dimension_two facet ->
        has_cardinality (edge_in_facet polytope facet) m) /\
      (forall vertex,
        face_of polytope vertex ->
        affine_dimension_zero vertex ->
        has_cardinality (edge_at_vertex polytope vertex) n)) <->
    (m = 3%nat /\ n = 3%nat) \/
    (m = 4%nat /\ n = 3%nat) \/
    (m = 3%nat /\ n = 4%nat) \/
    (m = 5%nat /\ n = 3%nat) \/
    (m = 3%nat /\ n = 5%nat).
Admitted.

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 050,
  "The Number of Platonic Solids". It characterizes the possible uniform
  face-edge and vertex-edge incidence counts of full-dimensional polytopes
  in real three-dimensional space. Real three-space is represented by triples
  of real numbers, with the standard point-set definitions of convex hull,
  supporting face, and affine dimension given below. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Number_of_Platonic_Solids
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym point3 = "real \<times> (real \<times> real)"

definition lincomb3 ::
    "(point3 \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> point3 set \<Rightarrow> point3" where
  "lincomb3 a A =
     ((\<Sum>x\<in>A. a x * fst x),
      ((\<Sum>x\<in>A. a x * fst (snd x)),
       (\<Sum>x\<in>A. a x * snd (snd x))))"

definition affine_independent3 :: "point3 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "affine_independent3 A \<longleftrightarrow>
     finite A \<and>
     (\<forall>a :: point3 \<Rightarrow> real.
        (\<Sum>x\<in>A. a x) = 0 \<and>
        lincomb3 a A = (0, (0, 0))
        \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>A. a x = 0))"

definition convex_hull3 :: "point3 set \<Rightarrow> point3 set" where
  "convex_hull3 S =
     {x. \<exists>A :: point3 set. \<exists>a :: point3 \<Rightarrow> real.
        finite A \<and>
        A \<subseteq> S \<and>
        (\<forall>y\<in>A. 0 \<le> a y) \<and>
        (\<Sum>y\<in>A. a y) = 1 \<and>
        x = lincomb3 a A}"

definition polytope3 :: "point3 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "polytope3 p \<longleftrightarrow>
     (\<exists>V :: point3 set. finite V \<and> p = convex_hull3 V)"

definition dot3 :: "point3 \<Rightarrow> point3 \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "dot3 a x =
     fst a * fst x +
     fst (snd a) * fst (snd x) +
     snd (snd a) * snd (snd x)"

definition face_of3 :: "point3 set \<Rightarrow> point3 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "face_of3 f p \<longleftrightarrow>
     (\<exists>a :: point3. \<exists>b :: real.
        f = {x \<in> p. dot3 a x = b} \<and>
        (\<forall>x\<in>p. dot3 a x \<le> b))"

definition has_aff_dim3 :: "point3 set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "has_aff_dim3 S d \<longleftrightarrow>
     (\<exists>A :: point3 set.
        A \<subseteq> S \<and>
        affine_independent3 A \<and>
        card A = d + 1 \<and>
        (\<forall>B :: point3 set.
           B \<subseteq> S \<and> affine_independent3 B
           \<longrightarrow> card B \<le> d + 1))"

theorem platonic_solids:
  fixes m n :: nat
  shows
    "(\<exists>p :: point3 set.
       polytope3 p \<and>
       has_aff_dim3 p 3 \<and>
       (\<forall>f. face_of3 f p \<and> has_aff_dim3 f 2 \<longrightarrow>
          card {e. face_of3 e p \<and> has_aff_dim3 e 1 \<and> e \<subseteq> f} = m) \<and>
       (\<forall>v. face_of3 v p \<and> has_aff_dim3 v 0 \<longrightarrow>
          card {e. face_of3 e p \<and> has_aff_dim3 e 1 \<and> v \<subseteq> e} = n))
     \<longleftrightarrow>
       (m = 3 \<and> n = 3) \<or>
       (m = 4 \<and> n = 3) \<or>
       (m = 3 \<and> n = 4) \<or>
       (m = 5 \<and> n = 3) \<or>
       (m = 3 \<and> n = 5)"
  sorry

end

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
(* ========================================================================= *)
(* The five Platonic solids exist and there are no others.                   *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

needs "100/polyhedron.ml";;
needs "Multivariate/cross.ml";;

prioritize_real();;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some standard regular polyhedra (vertex coordinates from Wikipedia).      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let std_tetrahedron = new_definition
 `std_tetrahedron =
     convex hull
       {vector[&1;&1;&1],vector[-- &1;-- &1;&1],
        vector[-- &1;&1;-- &1],vector[&1;-- &1;-- &1]}:real^3->bool`;;

let std_cube = new_definition
 `std_cube =
     convex hull
       {vector[&1;&1;&1],vector[&1;&1;-- &1],
        vector[&1;-- &1;&1],vector[&1;-- &1;-- &1],
        vector[-- &1;&1;&1],vector[-- &1;&1;-- &1],
        vector[-- &1;-- &1;&1],vector[-- &1;-- &1;-- &1]}:real^3->bool`;;

let std_octahedron = new_definition
 `std_octahedron =
      convex hull
       {vector[&1;&0;&0],vector[-- &1;&0;&0],
        vector[&0;&0;&1],vector[&0;&0;-- &1],
        vector[&0;&1;&0],vector[&0;-- &1;&0]}:real^3->bool`;;

let std_dodecahedron = new_definition
 `std_dodecahedron =

(* must be present.                                                          *)

let REAL_RAT5_OF_RAT_CONV =
  let pth = `p = p + &0 * sqrt(&5)`;;

let REAL_RAT5_SUB_CONV =
  let pth = `(a1 + b1 * sqrt(&5)) - (a2 + b2 * sqrt(&5)) =
      (a1 - a2) + (b1 - b2) * sqrt(&5)`;;

let REAL_RAT5_MUL_CONV =
  let pth = `(a1 + b1 * sqrt(&5)) * (a2 + b2 * sqrt(&5)) =
      (a1 * a2 + &5 * b1 * b2) + (a1 * b2 + a2 * b1) * sqrt(&5)`;;

let REAL_RAT5_INV_CONV =
  let pth = `~(a pow 2 = &5 * b pow 2)
     ==> inv(a + b * sqrt(&5)) =
         a / (a pow 2 - &5 * b pow 2) +
         --b / (a pow 2 - &5 * b pow 2) * sqrt(&5)`;;

  GEN_REWRITE_CONV I [GSYM REAL_LE_ANTISYM] THENC

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Given a coplanar set, return a hyperplane containing it.                  *)
(* Maps term s to theorem |- !x. x IN s ==> n dot x = d                      *)
(* Currently assumes |s| >= 3 but it would be trivial to do other cases.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let COPLANAR_HYPERPLANE_RULE =
  let rec allsets m l =
    if m = 0 then [[]] else
    match l with
      [] -> []
    | h::t -> map (fun g -> h::g) (allsets (m - 1) t) @ allsets m t in
  let mk_sub = mk_binop `(-):real^3->real^3->real^3`
  and mk_cross = mk_binop `cross`
  and mk_dot = mk_binop `(dot):real^3->real^3->real`
  and zerovec_tm = `vector[&0;&0;&0]:real^3`
  and template = `(!x:real^3. x IN s ==> n dot x = d)`
  and s_tm = `s:real^3->bool`
  and n_tm = `n:real^3`
  and d_tm = `d:real` in
  let mk_normal [x;y;z] = mk_cross (mk_sub y x) (mk_sub z x) in
  let eval_normal t =
    (BINOP_CONV VECTOR3_SUB_CONV THENC VECTOR3_CROSS_CONV) (mk_normal t) in
  let check_normal t =
    let th = eval_normal t in
    let n = rand(concl th) in
    if n = zerovec_tm then failwith "check_normal" else n in
  fun tm ->
    let s = dest_setenum tm in
    if length s < 3 then failwith "COPLANAR_HYPERPLANE_RULE: trivial" else
    let n = tryfind check_normal (allsets 3 s) in
    let d = rand(concl(VECTOR3_DOT_CONV(mk_dot n (hd s)))) in
    let ptm = vsubst [tm,s_tm; n,n_tm; d,d_tm] template in
    EQT_ELIM
    ((REWRITE_CONV[FORALL_IN_INSERT; NOT_IN_EMPTY] THENC
      DEPTH_BINOP_CONV `/\`
       (LAND_CONV VECTOR3_DOT_CONV THENC REAL_RAT5_EQ_CONV) THENC
      GEN_REWRITE_CONV DEPTH_CONV [AND_CLAUSES]) ptm);;

let COMPUTE_FACES_1 = `!s:real^3->bool n d.
        (!x. x IN s ==> n dot x = d)
        ==> FINITE s /\ ~(n = vec 0)
            ==> !f. f face_of (convex hull s) /\ aff_dim f = &1 <=>
                    ?x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\
                          let a = n cross (y - x) in
                          ~(a = vec 0) /\
                          let b = a dot x in
                          ((!w. w IN s ==> a dot w <= b) \/
                           (!w. w IN s ==> a dot w >= b)) /\
                          f = convex hull (s INTER {x | a dot x = b})`;;

let COMPUTE_EDGES_CONV =
  let lemma = `(x INSERT s) INTER {x | P x} =
                        if P x then x INSERT (s INTER {x | P x})
                        else s INTER {x | P x}`;;

let EDGES_PER_FACE_TAC th =
  REPEAT STRIP_TAC THEN MATCH_MP_TAC EQ_TRANS THEN
  EXISTS_TAC `CARD  {e:real^3->bool | e face_of f /\ aff_dim(e) = &1}` THEN
  CONJ_TAC THENL
   [AP_TERM_TAC THEN GEN_REWRITE_TAC I [EXTENSION] THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[IN_ELIM_THM] THEN
    ASM_MESON_TAC[FACE_OF_FACE; FACE_OF_TRANS; FACE_OF_IMP_SUBSET];
    ALL_TAC] THEN
  MP_TAC(ISPEC `f:real^3->bool` th) THEN ASM_REWRITE_TAC[] THEN
  DISCH_THEN(REPEAT_TCL DISJ_CASES_THEN SUBST1_TAC) THEN
  W(fun (_,w) -> REWRITE_TAC[COMPUTE_EDGES_CONV(find_term is_setenum w)]) THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[SET_RULE `x = a \/ x = b <=> x IN {a,b}`] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[GSYM IN_INSERT; SET_RULE `{x | x IN s} = s`] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[GSYM SEGMENT_CONVEX_HULL] THEN MATCH_MP_TAC
   (MESON[HAS_SIZE] `s HAS_SIZE n ==> CARD s = n`) THEN
  REPEAT
  (MATCH_MP_TAC CARD_EQ_LEMMA THEN REPEAT CONJ_TAC THENL
    [CONV_TAC NUM_REDUCE_CONV THEN NO_TAC;
     REWRITE_TAC[IN_INSERT; NOT_IN_EMPTY; SEGMENT_EQ; DE_MORGAN_THM] THEN
     REPEAT CONJ_TAC THEN MATCH_MP_TAC(SET_RULE
      `~(a = c /\ b = d) /\ ~(a = d /\ b = c) /\ ~(a = b /\ c = d)
       ==> ~({a,b} = {c,d})`) THEN
     PURE_ONCE_REWRITE_TAC[GSYM VECTOR_SUB_EQ] THEN
     CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_SUB_CONV) THEN
     CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_EQ_0_CONV) THEN
     REWRITE_TAC[] THEN NO_TAC;
     ALL_TAC]) THEN
  CONV_TAC NUM_REDUCE_CONV THEN REWRITE_TAC[CONJUNCT1 HAS_SIZE_CLAUSES];;

let POLYTOPE_3D_LEMMA = `(let a = (z - x) cross (y - x) in
    ~(a = vec 0) /\ ?w. w IN s /\ ~(a dot w = a dot x))
   ==> aff_dim(convex hull (x INSERT y INSERT z INSERT s:real^3->bool)) = &3`;;

let POLYTOPE_FULLDIM_TAC =
  MATCH_MP_TAC POLYTOPE_3D_LEMMA THEN
  CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_SUB_CONV) THEN
  CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_CROSS_CONV) THEN
  CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV let_CONV) THEN CONJ_TAC THENL
   [CONV_TAC(RAND_CONV VECTOR3_EQ_0_CONV) THEN REWRITE_TAC[];
    CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_DOT_CONV) THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[EXISTS_IN_INSERT; NOT_IN_EMPTY] THEN
    CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_DOT_CONV) THEN
    CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV REAL_RAT5_EQ_CONV) THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[]];;

let COMPUTE_EDGES_TAC defn fulldim facets =
  GEN_TAC THEN MATCH_MP_TAC EQ_TRANS THEN
  EXISTS_TAC
   (vsubst[lhs(concl defn),`p:real^3->bool`]
      `?f:real^3->bool. (f face_of p /\ aff_dim f = &2) /\
                        (e face_of f /\ aff_dim e = &1)`) THEN
  CONJ_TAC THENL
   [EQ_TAC THENL [STRIP_TAC; MESON_TAC[FACE_OF_TRANS]] THEN
    MP_TAC(ISPECL [lhs(concl defn); `e:real^3->bool`]
        FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_SUBSET_FACET) THEN
    ANTS_TAC THENL
     [ASM_REWRITE_TAC[] THEN CONJ_TAC THENL
       [REWRITE_TAC[defn] THEN
        MATCH_MP_TAC POLYHEDRON_CONVEX_HULL THEN
        REWRITE_TAC[FINITE_INSERT; FINITE_EMPTY];
        CONJ_TAC THEN
        DISCH_THEN(MP_TAC o AP_TERM `aff_dim:(real^3->bool)->int`) THEN
        ASM_REWRITE_TAC[fulldim; AFF_DIM_EMPTY] THEN
        CONV_TAC INT_REDUCE_CONV];
      MATCH_MP_TAC MONO_EXISTS THEN REWRITE_TAC[facet_of] THEN
      REWRITE_TAC[fulldim] THEN CONV_TAC INT_REDUCE_CONV THEN
      ASM_MESON_TAC[FACE_OF_FACE]];
    REWRITE_TAC[facets] THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[TAUT `(a \/ b) /\ c <=> a /\ c \/ b /\ c`] THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[EXISTS_OR_THM; UNWIND_THM2] THEN
    CONV_TAC(LAND_CONV(DEPTH_BINOP_CONV `\/`
     (fun tm -> REWR_CONV (COMPUTE_EDGES_CONV(rand(rand(lhand tm)))) tm))) THEN
    REWRITE_TAC[INSERT_AC] THEN REWRITE_TAC[DISJ_ACI]];;

  CONJ_TAC THENL
   [EQ_TAC THENL [STRIP_TAC; MESON_TAC[FACE_OF_TRANS]] THEN
    MP_TAC(ISPECL [lhs(concl defn); `v:real^3->bool`]
        FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_SUBSET_FACET) THEN
    ANTS_TAC THENL
     [ASM_REWRITE_TAC[] THEN CONJ_TAC THENL

    ANTS_TAC THENL
     [REPEAT CONJ_TAC THENL
       [MATCH_MP_TAC FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_POLYHEDRON THEN
        FIRST_ASSUM(fun th ->
          EXISTS_TAC (rand(concl th)) THEN
          CONJ_TAC THENL [ALL_TAC; ACCEPT_TAC th]) THEN
        REWRITE_TAC[defn] THEN
        MATCH_MP_TAC POLYHEDRON_CONVEX_HULL THEN
        REWRITE_TAC[FINITE_INSERT; FINITE_EMPTY];

  REPEAT STRIP_TAC THEN MATCH_MP_TAC EQ_TRANS THEN
  EXISTS_TAC
   (vsubst[lhs(concl defn),`p:real^3->bool`]
     `CARD {e | (e face_of p /\ aff_dim(e) = &1) /\
                (v:real^3->bool) face_of e}`) THEN
  CONJ_TAC THENL
   [AP_TERM_TAC THEN REWRITE_TAC[EXTENSION; IN_ELIM_THM] THEN
    ASM_MESON_TAC[FACE_OF_FACE];
    ALL_TAC] THEN
  MP_TAC(ISPEC `v:real^3->bool` verts) THEN
  ASM_REWRITE_TAC[] THEN
  DISCH_THEN(REPEAT_TCL DISJ_CASES_THEN SUBST1_TAC) THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[edges] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[SET_RULE
   `{e | (P e \/ Q e) /\ R e} =
    {e | P e /\ R e} UNION {e | Q e /\ R e}`] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[MESON[FACE_OF_SING]
   `e = a /\ {x} face_of e <=> e = a /\ x extreme_point_of a`] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[GSYM SEGMENT_CONVEX_HULL; EXTREME_POINT_OF_SEGMENT] THEN
  ONCE_REWRITE_TAC[GSYM VECTOR_SUB_EQ] THEN
  CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_SUB_CONV) THEN
  CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_EQ_0_CONV) THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[EMPTY_GSPEC; UNION_EMPTY] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[SET_RULE `{x | x = a} = {a}`] THEN
  REWRITE_TAC[SET_RULE `{x} UNION s = x INSERT s`] THEN MATCH_MP_TAC
   (MESON[HAS_SIZE] `s HAS_SIZE n ==> CARD s = n`) THEN
  REPEAT
  (MATCH_MP_TAC CARD_EQ_LEMMA THEN REPEAT CONJ_TAC THENL
    [CONV_TAC NUM_REDUCE_CONV THEN NO_TAC;
     REWRITE_TAC[IN_INSERT; NOT_IN_EMPTY; DE_MORGAN_THM; SEGMENT_EQ] THEN
     REPEAT CONJ_TAC THEN MATCH_MP_TAC(SET_RULE
      `~(a = c /\ b = d) /\ ~(a = d /\ b = c) /\ ~(a = b /\ c = d)
       ==> ~({a,b} = {c,d})`) THEN
     PURE_ONCE_REWRITE_TAC[GSYM VECTOR_SUB_EQ] THEN

     CONV_TAC(ONCE_DEPTH_CONV VECTOR3_EQ_0_CONV) THEN
     REWRITE_TAC[] THEN NO_TAC;
     ALL_TAC]) THEN
  CONV_TAC NUM_REDUCE_CONV THEN REWRITE_TAC[CONJUNCT1 HAS_SIZE_CLAUSES];;

let MULTIPLE_COUNTING_LEMMA = `!R:A->B->bool s t.
        FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\
        (!x. x IN s ==> CARD {y | y IN t /\ R x y} = m) /\
        (!y. y IN t ==> CARD {x | x IN s /\ R x y} = n)
        ==> m * CARD s = n * CARD t`;;

let SIZE_ZERO_DIMENSIONAL_FACES = `!s:real^N->bool.
        polyhedron s
        ==> CARD {f | f face_of s /\ aff_dim f = &0} =
            CARD {v | v extreme_point_of s} /\
            (FINITE {f | f face_of s /\ aff_dim f = &0} <=>
             FINITE {v | v extreme_point_of s}) /\
            (!n. {f | f face_of s /\ aff_dim f = &0} HAS_SIZE n <=>
                 {v | v extreme_point_of s} HAS_SIZE n)`;;

let PLATONIC_SOLIDS_LIMITS = `!p:real^3->bool m n.
    polytope p /\ aff_dim p = &3 /\
    (!f. f face_of p /\ aff_dim(f) = &2
         ==> CARD {e | e face_of p /\ aff_dim(e) = &1 /\ e SUBSET f} = m) /\
    (!v. v face_of p /\ aff_dim(v) = &0
         ==> CARD {e | e face_of p /\ aff_dim(e) = &1 /\ v SUBSET e} = n)
    ==> m = 3 /\ n = 3 \/       // Tetrahedron
        m = 4 /\ n = 3 \/       // Cube
        m = 3 /\ n = 4 \/       // Octahedron
        m = 5 /\ n = 3 \/       // Dodecahedron
        m = 3 /\ n = 5          // Icosahedron`;;

let PLATONIC_SOLIDS = `!m n.
   (?p:real^3->bool.

     (!f. f face_of p /\ aff_dim(f) = &2
          ==> CARD {e | e face_of p /\ aff_dim(e) = &1 /\ e SUBSET f} = m) /\
     (!v. v face_of p /\ aff_dim(v) = &0

     m = 3 /\ n = 3 \/       // Tetrahedron

let congruent = new_definition
 `(s:real^N->bool) congruent (t:real^N->bool) <=>
        ?c f. orthogonal_transformation f /\ t = IMAGE (\x. c + f x) s`;;

let CONGRUENT_SIMPLE = `(?A:real^3^3. orthogonal_matrix A /\ IMAGE (\x:real^3. A ** x) s = t)
   ==> (convex hull s) congruent (convex hull t)`;;

let CONGRUENT_SEGMENTS = `!a b c d:real^N.
        dist(a,b) = dist(c,d)
        ==> segment[a,b] congruent segment[c,d]`;;

let compute_dist =
  let mk_sub = mk_binop `(-):real^3->real^3->real^3`
  and dot_tm = `(dot):real^3->real^3->real` in
  fun v1 v2 -> let vth = VECTOR3_SUB_CONV(mk_sub v1 v2) in
               let dth = CONV_RULE(RAND_CONV VECTOR3_DOT_CONV)
                          (MK_COMB(AP_TERM dot_tm vth,vth)) in
               rand(concl dth);;

let le_rat5 =
  let mk_le = mk_binop `(<=):real->real->bool` and t_tm = `T` in
  fun r1 r2 -> rand(concl(REAL_RAT5_LE_CONV(mk_le r1 r2))) = t_tm;;

let three_adjacent_points s =
  match s with
  | x::t -> let (y,_)::(z,_)::_ =
              sort (fun (_,r1) (_,r2) -> le_rat5 r1 r2)
                   (map (fun y -> y,compute_dist x y) t) in
            x,y,z
  | _ -> failwith "three_adjacent_points: no points";;

let mk_33matrix =

  and a13_tm = `a13:real`
  and a21_tm = `a21:real`

  and a31_tm = `a31:real`
  and a32_tm = `a32:real`

   `vector[vector[a11; a12; a13];
           vector[a21; a22; a23];
           vector[a31; a32; a33]]:real^3^3` in
  fun [a11;a12;a13;a21;a22;a23;a31;a32;a33] ->

let MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_3 = `(vector[vector[a11;a12;a13];
           vector[a21; a22; a23];
           vector[a31; a32; a33]]:real^3^3) **
   (vector[x1;x2;x3]:real^3) =
   vector[a11 * x1 + a12 * x2 + a13 * x3;
          a21 * x1 + a22 * x2 + a23 * x3;
          a31 * x1 + a32 * x2 + a33 * x3]`;;

let MATRIX_LEMMA = `!A:real^3^3.
   A ** x1 = x2 /\
   A ** y1 = y2 /\
   A ** z1 = z2 <=>
   (vector [x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3) ** (row 1 A:real^3) =
   vector [x2$1; y2$1; z2$1] /\
   (vector [x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3) ** (row 2 A:real^3) =
   vector [x2$2; y2$2; z2$2] /\
   (vector [x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3) ** (row 3 A:real^3) =
   vector [x2$3; y2$3; z2$3]`;;

let MATRIX_BY_CRAMER_LEMMA = `!A:real^3^3.
        ~(det(vector[x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3) = &0)
        ==> (A ** x1 = x2 /\
             A ** y1 = y2 /\
             A ** z1 = z2 <=>
             A = lambda m k. det((lambda i j.
                                  if j = k
                                  then (vector[x2$m; y2$m; z2$m]:real^3)$i
                                  else (vector[x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3)$i$j)
                                 :real^3^3) /
                             det(vector[x1;y1;z1]:real^3^3))`;;

let MATRIX_BY_CRAMER = `!A:real^3^3 x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2.
        let d = det(vector[x1; y1; z1]:real^3^3) in
        ~(d = &0)
        ==> (A ** x1 = x2 /\
             A ** y1 = y2 /\
             A ** z1 = z2 <=>
               A$1$1 =
               (x2$1 * y1$2 * z1$3 +
                x1$2 * y1$3 * z2$1 +
                x1$3 * y2$1 * z1$2 -
                x2$1 * y1$3 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y2$1 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y1$2 * z2$1) / d /\
               A$1$2 =
               (x1$1 * y2$1 * z1$3 +
                x2$1 * y1$3 * z1$1 +
                x1$3 * y1$1 * z2$1 -
                x1$1 * y1$3 * z2$1 -
                x2$1 * y1$1 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y2$1 * z1$1) / d /\
               A$1$3 =
               (x1$1 * y1$2 * z2$1 +
                x1$2 * y2$1 * z1$1 +
                x2$1 * y1$1 * z1$2 -
                x1$1 * y2$1 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y1$1 * z2$1 -
                x2$1 * y1$2 * z1$1) / d /\
               A$2$1 =
               (x2$2 * y1$2 * z1$3 +
                x1$2 * y1$3 * z2$2 +
                x1$3 * y2$2 * z1$2 -
                x2$2 * y1$3 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y2$2 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y1$2 * z2$2) / d /\
               A$2$2 =
               (x1$1 * y2$2 * z1$3 +
                x2$2 * y1$3 * z1$1 +
                x1$3 * y1$1 * z2$2 -
                x1$1 * y1$3 * z2$2 -
                x2$2 * y1$1 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y2$2 * z1$1) / d /\
               A$2$3 =
               (x1$1 * y1$2 * z2$2 +
                x1$2 * y2$2 * z1$1 +
                x2$2 * y1$1 * z1$2 -
                x1$1 * y2$2 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y1$1 * z2$2 -
                x2$2 * y1$2 * z1$1) / d /\
               A$3$1 =
               (x2$3 * y1$2 * z1$3 +
                x1$2 * y1$3 * z2$3 +
                x1$3 * y2$3 * z1$2 -
                x2$3 * y1$3 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y2$3 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y1$2 * z2$3) / d /\
               A$3$2 =
               (x1$1 * y2$3 * z1$3 +
                x2$3 * y1$3 * z1$1 +
                x1$3 * y1$1 * z2$3 -
                x1$1 * y1$3 * z2$3 -
                x2$3 * y1$1 * z1$3 -
                x1$3 * y2$3 * z1$1) / d /\
               A$3$3 =
               (x1$1 * y1$2 * z2$3 +
                x1$2 * y2$3 * z1$1 +
                x2$3 * y1$1 * z1$2 -
                x1$1 * y2$3 * z1$2 -
                x1$2 * y1$1 * z2$3 -
                x2$3 * y1$2 * z1$1) / d)`;;

  REPEAT STRIP_TAC THEN ASM_REWRITE_TAC[] THEN

          REWRITE_TAC[INSERT_AC]]);;

let TETRAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_EDGES = `!e1 e2. e1 face_of std_tetrahedron /\ aff_dim e1 = &1 /\
           e2 face_of std_tetrahedron /\ aff_dim e2 = &1
           ==> e1 congruent e2`;;

let TETRAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_FACETS = `!f1 f2. f1 face_of std_tetrahedron /\ aff_dim f1 = &2 /\
           f2 face_of std_tetrahedron /\ aff_dim f2 = &2
           ==> f1 congruent f2`;;

let CUBE_CONGRUENT_EDGES = `!e1 e2. e1 face_of std_cube /\ aff_dim e1 = &1 /\
           e2 face_of std_cube /\ aff_dim e2 = &1
           ==> e1 congruent e2`;;

let CUBE_CONGRUENT_FACETS = `!f1 f2. f1 face_of std_cube /\ aff_dim f1 = &2 /\
           f2 face_of std_cube /\ aff_dim f2 = &2
           ==> f1 congruent f2`;;

let OCTAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_EDGES = `!e1 e2. e1 face_of std_octahedron /\ aff_dim e1 = &1 /\
           e2 face_of std_octahedron /\ aff_dim e2 = &1
           ==> e1 congruent e2`;;

let OCTAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_FACETS = `!f1 f2. f1 face_of std_octahedron /\ aff_dim f1 = &2 /\
           f2 face_of std_octahedron /\ aff_dim f2 = &2
           ==> f1 congruent f2`;;

let DODECAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_EDGES = `!e1 e2. e1 face_of std_dodecahedron /\ aff_dim e1 = &1 /\
           e2 face_of std_dodecahedron /\ aff_dim e2 = &1
           ==> e1 congruent e2`;;

let DODECAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_FACETS = `!f1 f2. f1 face_of std_dodecahedron /\ aff_dim f1 = &2 /\
           f2 face_of std_dodecahedron /\ aff_dim f2 = &2
           ==> f1 congruent f2`;;

let ICOSAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_EDGES = `!e1 e2. e1 face_of std_icosahedron /\ aff_dim e1 = &1 /\
           e2 face_of std_icosahedron /\ aff_dim e2 = &1
           ==> e1 congruent e2`;;

let ICOSAHEDRON_CONGRUENT_FACETS = `!f1 f2. f1 face_of std_icosahedron /\ aff_dim f1 = &2 /\
           f2 face_of std_icosahedron /\ aff_dim f2 = &2
           ==> f1 congruent f2`;;

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 050,
;; "The Number of Platonic Solids." A full-dimensional convex polytope in
;; three-dimensional real space with m edges on each facet and n incident
;; edges at each vertex exists exactly for the five Platonic pairs. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; ACL2's built-in numbers are not the real numbers, so the scalar structure
;; is an explicit real-closed ordered field. Real closedness is the
;; first-order algebraic theory of the reals needed by this statement.

(defstub ht050-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht050-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht050-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht050-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht050-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub ht050-less-op (x y) t)

(defun ht050-member-p (x)
  (if (ht050-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht050-add (x y)
  (ht050-add-op x y))

(defun ht050-multiply (x y)
  (ht050-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht050-negate (x)
  (ht050-negate-op x))

(defun ht050-inverse (x)
  (ht050-inverse-op x))

(defun ht050-subtract (x y)
  (ht050-add x (ht050-negate y)))

(defun ht050-less (x y)
  (if (ht050-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun ht050-less-or-equal (x y)
  (or (equal x y)
      (ht050-less x y)))

(defun ht050-square (x)
  (ht050-multiply x x))

(defun-sk ht050-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht050-member-p x)
      (ht050-member-p y)
      (ht050-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht050-member-p (ht050-add x y))
      (ht050-member-p (ht050-multiply x y))
      (ht050-member-p (ht050-negate x))
      (ht050-member-p (ht050-inverse x))
      (equal (ht050-add (ht050-add x y) z)
             (ht050-add x (ht050-add y z)))
      (equal (ht050-add x y)
             (ht050-add y x))
      (equal (ht050-add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht050-add x (ht050-negate x)) zero)
      (equal (ht050-multiply (ht050-multiply x y) z)
             (ht050-multiply x (ht050-multiply y z)))
      (equal (ht050-multiply x y)
             (ht050-multiply y x))
      (equal (ht050-multiply x one) x)
      (equal
       (ht050-multiply x (ht050-add y z))
       (ht050-add
        (ht050-multiply x y)
        (ht050-multiply x z)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (ht050-multiply x (ht050-inverse x))
        one))))))

(defun-sk ht050-order-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht050-member-p x)
      (ht050-member-p y)
      (ht050-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (ht050-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (ht050-less x y)
       (ht050-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht050-less x y)
        (ht050-less y z))
       (ht050-less x z))
      (implies
       (ht050-less x y)
       (ht050-less
        (ht050-add x z)
        (ht050-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht050-less zero x)
        (ht050-less zero y))
       (ht050-less zero (ht050-multiply x y)))))))

(defun ht050-field-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (ht050-member-p (car values))
       (ht050-field-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun ht050-polynomial-value (coefficients x zero)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht050-add
       (car coefficients)
       (ht050-multiply
        x
        (ht050-polynomial-value (cdr coefficients) x zero)))
    zero))

(defun ht050-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients zero)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (ht050-field-list-p coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero))))

(defun-sk ht050-has-square-root-p (x zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht050-member-p root)
     (equal (ht050-square root) x))))

(defun-sk ht050-has-polynomial-root-p (coefficients zero)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht050-member-p root)
     (equal
      (ht050-polynomial-value coefficients root zero)
      zero))))

(defun-sk ht050-real-closure-laws-p (zero)
  (forall (x coefficients)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (ht050-member-p x)
       (not (ht050-less x zero)))
      (ht050-has-square-root-p x zero))
     (implies
      (ht050-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients zero)
      (ht050-has-polynomial-root-p coefficients zero)))))

(defun ht050-real-scalar-context-p (zero one)
  (and
   (ht050-member-p zero)
   (ht050-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht050-less zero one)
   (ht050-field-laws-p zero one)
   (ht050-order-laws-p zero)
   (ht050-real-closure-laws-p zero)))

;; A point is the proper list (x y z), and a plane is the proper list
;; (a b c d), denoting a*x + b*y + c*z = d. A polytope is represented by a
;; finite list of planes whose corresponding closed half-spaces are
;; intersected.

(defun ht050-point-p (point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (ht050-member-p (nth 0 point))
   (ht050-member-p (nth 1 point))
   (ht050-member-p (nth 2 point))))

(defun ht050-point-x (point)
  (nth 0 point))

(defun ht050-point-y (point)
  (nth 1 point))

(defun ht050-point-z (point)
  (nth 2 point))

(defun ht050-plane-p (plane zero)
  (and
   (true-listp plane)
   (equal (len plane) 4)
   (ht050-member-p (nth 0 plane))
   (ht050-member-p (nth 1 plane))
   (ht050-member-p (nth 2 plane))
   (ht050-member-p (nth 3 plane))
   (not
    (and
     (equal (nth 0 plane) zero)
     (equal (nth 1 plane) zero)
     (equal (nth 2 plane) zero)))))

(defun ht050-plane-value (plane point)
  (ht050-add
   (ht050-add
    (ht050-multiply (nth 0 plane) (ht050-point-x point))
    (ht050-multiply (nth 1 plane) (ht050-point-y point)))
   (ht050-multiply (nth 2 plane) (ht050-point-z point))))

(defun ht050-plane-bound (plane)
  (nth 3 plane))

(defun ht050-halfspace-list-p (halfspaces zero)
  (if (consp halfspaces)
      (and
       (ht050-plane-p (car halfspaces) zero)
       (ht050-halfspace-list-p (cdr halfspaces) zero))
    (equal halfspaces nil)))

(defun ht050-point-in-polytope-p (point halfspaces)
  (and
   (ht050-point-p point)
   (if (consp halfspaces)
       (and
        (ht050-less-or-equal
         (ht050-plane-value (car halfspaces) point)
         (ht050-plane-bound (car halfspaces)))
        (ht050-point-in-polytope-p point (cdr halfspaces)))
     (equal halfspaces nil))))

(defun ht050-coordinate-bounded-p (coordinate bound)
  (and
   (ht050-less-or-equal (ht050-negate bound) coordinate)
   (ht050-less-or-equal coordinate bound)))

(defun-sk ht050-bound-works-p (halfspaces bound)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
     (and
      (ht050-coordinate-bounded-p (ht050-point-x point) bound)
      (ht050-coordinate-bounded-p (ht050-point-y point) bound)
      (ht050-coordinate-bounded-p (ht050-point-z point) bound)))))

(defun-sk ht050-bounded-p (halfspaces zero)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ht050-member-p bound)
     (ht050-less zero bound)
     (ht050-bound-works-p halfspaces bound))))

(defun ht050-distance-squared (first second)
  (let ((dx (ht050-subtract
             (ht050-point-x first)
             (ht050-point-x second)))
        (dy (ht050-subtract
             (ht050-point-y first)
             (ht050-point-y second)))
        (dz (ht050-subtract
             (ht050-point-z first)
             (ht050-point-z second))))
    (ht050-add
     (ht050-add (ht050-square dx) (ht050-square dy))
     (ht050-square dz))))

(defun-sk ht050-open-ball-contained-p (halfspaces center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht050-point-p point)
      (ht050-less
       (ht050-distance-squared point center)
       (ht050-square radius)))
     (ht050-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces))))

(defun-sk ht050-full-dimensional-p (halfspaces zero)
  (exists (center radius)
    (and
     (ht050-point-p center)
     (ht050-member-p radius)
     (ht050-less zero radius)
     (ht050-open-ball-contained-p halfspaces center radius))))

(defun ht050-polytope3-p (halfspaces zero)
  (and
   (true-listp halfspaces)
   (ht050-halfspace-list-p halfspaces zero)
   (ht050-bounded-p halfspaces zero)
   (ht050-full-dimensional-p halfspaces zero)))

;; Every face of a polytope is exposed. A plane descriptor represents the
;; nonempty face where a supporting inequality is tight.

(defun-sk ht050-supporting-plane-p (halfspaces plane)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
     (ht050-less-or-equal
      (ht050-plane-value plane point)
      (ht050-plane-bound plane)))))

(defun ht050-point-in-face-p (point halfspaces plane)
  (and
   (ht050-point-in-polytope-p point halfspaces)
   (equal
    (ht050-plane-value plane point)
    (ht050-plane-bound plane))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-equivalent-p
    (halfspaces first-plane second-plane)
  (forall (point)
    (equal
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces first-plane)
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces second-plane))))

;; Affine dimensions zero, one, and two are expressed intrinsically. The
;; quantified scalars in on-line and on-plane range over the field carrier.

(defun-sk ht050-on-line-p (point first second)
  (exists (parameter)
    (and
     (ht050-member-p parameter)
     (equal
      (ht050-point-x point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-point-x first)
       (ht050-multiply
        parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-x second)
         (ht050-point-x first)))))
     (equal
      (ht050-point-y point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-point-y first)
       (ht050-multiply
        parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-y second)
         (ht050-point-y first)))))
     (equal
      (ht050-point-z point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-point-z first)
       (ht050-multiply
        parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-z second)
         (ht050-point-z first))))))))

(defun ht050-cross-x (first second third)
  (ht050-subtract
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-y second) (ht050-point-y first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-z third) (ht050-point-z first)))
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-z second) (ht050-point-z first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-y third) (ht050-point-y first)))))

(defun ht050-cross-y (first second third)
  (ht050-subtract
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-z second) (ht050-point-z first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-x third) (ht050-point-x first)))
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-x second) (ht050-point-x first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-z third) (ht050-point-z first)))))

(defun ht050-cross-z (first second third)
  (ht050-subtract
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-x second) (ht050-point-x first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-y third) (ht050-point-y first)))
   (ht050-multiply
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-y second) (ht050-point-y first))
    (ht050-subtract (ht050-point-x third) (ht050-point-x first)))))

(defun ht050-affinely-independent-three-p
    (first second third zero)
  (or
   (not (equal (ht050-cross-x first second third) zero))
   (not (equal (ht050-cross-y first second third) zero))
   (not (equal (ht050-cross-z first second third) zero))))

(defun-sk ht050-on-plane-p (point first second third)
  (exists (first-parameter second-parameter)
    (and
     (ht050-member-p first-parameter)
     (ht050-member-p second-parameter)
     (equal
      (ht050-point-x point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-add
        (ht050-point-x first)
        (ht050-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht050-subtract
          (ht050-point-x second)
          (ht050-point-x first))))
       (ht050-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-x third)
         (ht050-point-x first)))))
     (equal
      (ht050-point-y point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-add
        (ht050-point-y first)
        (ht050-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht050-subtract
          (ht050-point-y second)
          (ht050-point-y first))))
       (ht050-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-y third)
         (ht050-point-y first)))))
     (equal
      (ht050-point-z point)
      (ht050-add
       (ht050-add
        (ht050-point-z first)
        (ht050-multiply
         first-parameter
         (ht050-subtract
          (ht050-point-z second)
          (ht050-point-z first))))
       (ht050-multiply
        second-parameter
        (ht050-subtract
         (ht050-point-z third)
         (ht050-point-z first))))))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-is-singleton-p
    (halfspaces plane point)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-face-p other halfspaces plane)
     (equal other point))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-dimension-zero-p
    (halfspaces plane)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-face-is-singleton-p halfspaces plane point))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-contained-in-line-p
    (halfspaces plane first second)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-on-line-p point first second))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-dimension-one-p
    (halfspaces plane)
  (exists (first second)
    (and
     (ht050-point-in-face-p first halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-point-in-face-p second halfspaces plane)
     (not (equal first second))
     (ht050-face-contained-in-line-p
      halfspaces plane first second))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-contained-in-plane-p
    (halfspaces plane first second third)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-on-plane-p point first second third))))

(defun-sk ht050-face-dimension-two-p
    (halfspaces plane zero)
  (exists (first second third)
    (and
     (ht050-point-in-face-p first halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-point-in-face-p second halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-point-in-face-p third halfspaces plane)
     (ht050-affinely-independent-three-p
      first second third zero)
     (ht050-face-contained-in-plane-p
      halfspaces plane first second third))))

(defun ht050-face-of-dimension-p
    (halfspaces plane dimension zero)
  (and
   (ht050-plane-p plane zero)
   (ht050-supporting-plane-p halfspaces plane)
   (cond
    ((equal dimension 0)
     (ht050-face-dimension-zero-p halfspaces plane))
    ((equal dimension 1)
     (ht050-face-dimension-one-p halfspaces plane))
    ((equal dimension 2)
     (ht050-face-dimension-two-p halfspaces plane zero))
    (t nil))))

;; Face incidence is inclusion between the exposed subsets represented by two
;; supporting-plane descriptors.

(defun-sk ht050-face-subset-p
    (halfspaces lower-plane upper-plane)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces lower-plane)
     (ht050-point-in-face-p point halfspaces upper-plane))))

(defun ht050-edge-incident-to-face-p
    (halfspaces edge-plane face-plane face-dimension zero)
  (and
   (ht050-face-of-dimension-p
    halfspaces edge-plane 1 zero)
   (ht050-face-of-dimension-p
    halfspaces face-plane face-dimension zero)
   (cond
    ((equal face-dimension 2)
     (ht050-face-subset-p
      halfspaces edge-plane face-plane))
    ((equal face-dimension 0)
     (ht050-face-subset-p
      halfspaces face-plane edge-plane))
    (t nil))))

;; A finite list gives the incident edges of one facet or vertex when every
;; descriptor is sound, no two descriptors denote the same edge, and every
;; incident edge is extensionally represented in the list.

(defun ht050-equivalent-face-in-list-p
    (halfspaces plane face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (or
       (ht050-face-equivalent-p
        halfspaces plane (car face-list))
       (ht050-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces plane (cdr face-list)))
    nil))

(defun ht050-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
    (halfspaces plane face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (and
       (not
        (ht050-face-equivalent-p
         halfspaces plane (car face-list)))
       (ht050-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces plane (cdr face-list)))
    t))

(defun ht050-incident-edge-list-sound-p
    (halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)
  (if (consp edge-list)
      (and
       (ht050-edge-incident-to-face-p
        halfspaces
        (car edge-list)
        face-plane
        face-dimension
        zero)
       (ht050-incident-edge-list-sound-p
        halfspaces
        (cdr edge-list)
        face-plane
        face-dimension
        zero))
    (equal edge-list nil)))

(defun ht050-face-list-distinct-p (halfspaces face-list)
  (if (consp face-list)
      (and
       (ht050-no-equivalent-face-in-list-p
        halfspaces (car face-list) (cdr face-list))
       (ht050-face-list-distinct-p
        halfspaces (cdr face-list)))
    (equal face-list nil)))

(defun-sk ht050-incident-edge-list-complete-p
    (halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)
  (forall (edge-plane)
    (implies
     (ht050-edge-incident-to-face-p
      halfspaces
      edge-plane
      face-plane
      face-dimension
      zero)
     (ht050-equivalent-face-in-list-p
      halfspaces edge-plane edge-list))))

(defun ht050-incident-edge-enumeration-p
    (halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)
  (and
   (true-listp edge-list)
   (ht050-incident-edge-list-sound-p
    halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)
   (ht050-face-list-distinct-p halfspaces edge-list)
   (ht050-incident-edge-list-complete-p
    halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)))

(defun-sk ht050-face-has-edge-count-p
    (halfspaces face-plane face-dimension count zero)
  (exists (edge-list)
    (and
     (ht050-incident-edge-enumeration-p
      halfspaces edge-list face-plane face-dimension zero)
     (equal (len edge-list) count))))

(defun-sk ht050-all-faces-have-edge-count-p
    (halfspaces face-dimension count zero)
  (forall (face-plane)
    (implies
     (ht050-face-of-dimension-p
      halfspaces face-plane face-dimension zero)
     (ht050-face-has-edge-count-p
      halfspaces face-plane face-dimension count zero))))

(defun-sk ht050-uniform-polytope-exists-p
    (face-size vertex-degree zero)
  (exists (halfspaces)
    (and
     (ht050-polytope3-p halfspaces zero)
     (ht050-all-faces-have-edge-count-p
      halfspaces 2 face-size zero)
     (ht050-all-faces-have-edge-count-p
      halfspaces 0 vertex-degree zero))))

(defun ht050-platonic-pair-p (face-size vertex-degree)
  (or
   (and (equal face-size 3)
        (equal vertex-degree 3))
   (and (equal face-size 4)
        (equal vertex-degree 3))
   (and (equal face-size 3)
        (equal vertex-degree 4))
   (and (equal face-size 5)
        (equal vertex-degree 3))
   (and (equal face-size 3)
        (equal vertex-degree 5))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-050-the-number-of-platonic-solids-statement
    (zero one)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht050-real-scalar-context-p zero one)
      (natp m)
      (natp n))
     (equal
      (ht050-uniform-polytope-exists-p m n zero)
      (ht050-platonic-pair-p m n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Number of Platonic Solids" from Hundred Theorems
-- artifact hundred-theorems__agda__050: a full-dimensional polytope in real three-space has
-- constant facet-edge and vertex-edge counts exactly for the five Platonic pairs. This file
-- contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {a : Level} -> {A : Set a} -> A -> A -> Set a
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists {a p : Level} (A : Set a) (P : A -> Set p) :
    Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

Region : Set -> Nat -> Set1
Region R n =
  Vector R n -> Set

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

zeroVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n
zeroVector reals i =
  zeroR reals

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

Subset :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Region R n ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
Subset {R} {n} smaller larger =
  (x : Vector R n) ->
  smaller x ->
  larger x

RegionEquivalent :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Region R n ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
RegionEquivalent {R} {n} firstRegion secondRegion =
  (x : Vector R n) ->
  Iff (firstRegion x) (secondRegion x)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {n = zero} values =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {n = suc n} values =
  add reals
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> values (fsuc i)))

weightedSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  {dimension count : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin count -> Vector R dimension) ->
  (Fin count -> R) ->
  Vector R dimension
weightedSum reals points coefficients coordinate =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      multiply reals
        (coefficients i)
        (points i coordinate))

linearCombination :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
linearCombination reals t x y coordinate =
  add reals
    (multiply reals t (x coordinate))
    (multiply reals
      (subtract reals (oneR reals) t)
      (y coordinate))

Convex :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R n ->
  Set
Convex {R} {n} reals body =
  (x y : Vector R n) ->
  body x ->
  body y ->
  (t : R) ->
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals) ->
  body (linearCombination reals t x y)

ConvexHull :
  {R : Set} ->
  {dimension count : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin count -> Vector R dimension) ->
  Region R dimension
ConvexHull {R} {count = count} reals points x =
  Exists (Fin count -> R)
    (\ coefficients ->
      Both
        ((i : Fin count) ->
          lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (coefficients i))
        (Both
          (sumFin reals coefficients == oneR reals)
          (VectorEqual
            (weightedSum reals points coefficients)
            x)))

Polytope :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Set
Polytope {R} reals body =
  Exists Nat
    (\ count ->
      Exists (Fin count -> Vector R 3)
        (\ points ->
          RegionEquivalent body (ConvexHull reals points)))

FaceOf :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Set
FaceOf {R} reals face body =
  Both
    (Subset face body)
    (Both
      (Convex reals face)
      ((x y : Vector R 3) ->
        body x ->
        body y ->
        (t : R) ->
        StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t ->
        StrictLess reals t (oneR reals) ->
        face (linearCombination reals t x y) ->
        Both (face x) (face y)))

AffineIndependent :
  {R : Set} ->
  {count : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Fin count -> Vector R 3) ->
  Set
AffineIndependent {R} {count = count} reals points =
  (coefficients : Fin count -> R) ->
  sumFin reals coefficients == zeroR reals ->
  VectorEqual
    (weightedSum reals points coefficients)
    (zeroVector reals) ->
  (i : Fin count) ->
  coefficients i == zeroR reals

PointsIn :
  {R : Set} ->
  {count : Nat} ->
  Region R 3 ->
  (Fin count -> Vector R 3) ->
  Set
PointsIn {count = count} body points =
  (i : Fin count) ->
  body (points i)

HasAffineDimension :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Set
HasAffineDimension {R} reals dimension body =
  Both
    (Exists (Fin (suc dimension) -> Vector R 3)
      (\ points ->
        Both
          (PointsIn body points)
          (AffineIndependent reals points)))
    ((points : Fin (suc (suc dimension)) -> Vector R 3) ->
      PointsIn body points ->
      Not (AffineIndependent reals points))

record HasRegionCardinality
  {R : Set}
  (P : Region R 3 -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      Region R 3

    enumeration-sound :
      (i : Fin cardinality) ->
      P (enumerate i)

    enumeration-complete :
      (region : Region R 3) ->
      P region ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ i ->
          RegionEquivalent (enumerate i) region)

    enumeration-injective :
      (i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      RegionEquivalent (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

EdgeOf :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Set
EdgeOf reals polytope edge =
  Both
    (FaceOf reals edge polytope)
    (HasAffineDimension reals 1 edge)

FacetEdgeCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
FacetEdgeCount {R} reals polytope count =
  (facet : Region R 3) ->
  Both
    (FaceOf reals facet polytope)
    (HasAffineDimension reals 2 facet) ->
  HasRegionCardinality
    (\ edge ->
      Both
        (EdgeOf reals polytope edge)
        (Subset edge facet))
    count

VertexEdgeCount :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
VertexEdgeCount {R} reals polytope count =
  (vertex : Region R 3) ->
  Both
    (FaceOf reals vertex polytope)
    (HasAffineDimension reals 0 vertex) ->
  HasRegionCardinality
    (\ edge ->
      Both
        (EdgeOf reals polytope edge)
        (Subset vertex edge))
    count

AdmissiblePolytope :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Region R 3 ->
  Set1
AdmissiblePolytope reals facetCount vertexCount polytope =
  Both
    (Polytope reals polytope)
    (Both
      (HasAffineDimension reals 3 polytope)
      (Both
        (FacetEdgeCount reals polytope facetCount)
        (VertexEdgeCount reals polytope vertexCount)))

PlatonicCounts :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
PlatonicCounts facetCount vertexCount =
  Either
    (Both (facetCount == 3) (vertexCount == 3))
    (Either
      (Both (facetCount == 4) (vertexCount == 3))
      (Either
        (Both (facetCount == 3) (vertexCount == 4))
        (Either
          (Both (facetCount == 5) (vertexCount == 3))
          (Both (facetCount == 3) (vertexCount == 5)))))

the-number-of-platonic-solids : Set1
the-number-of-platonic-solids =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (facetCount vertexCount : Nat) ->
  Iff
    (Exists (Region R 3)
      (AdmissiblePolytope reals facetCount vertexCount))
    (PlatonicCounts facetCount vertexCount)

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Number of Platonic Solids" from Hundred
  Theorems artifact 050. A full-dimensional real three-dimensional polytope
  with m edges on every facet and n incident edges at every vertex exists
  exactly for the five Platonic incidence pairs. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory cardinalTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val number_of_platonic_solids =
  ``let xcoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. FST (FST p)
    in
    let ycoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. SND (FST p)
    in
    let zcoord =
      \p : (real # real) # real. SND p
    in
    let plane_value =
      \(h : (real # real) # (real # real))
       (p : (real # real) # real).
        FST (FST h) * xcoord p +
        SND (FST h) * ycoord p +
        FST (SND h) * zcoord p
    in
    let plane_rhs =
      \h : (real # real) # (real # real). SND (SND h)
    in
    let nonzero_normal =
      \h : (real # real) # (real # real).
        ~(FST (FST h) = 0 /\
          SND (FST h) = 0 /\
          FST (SND h) = 0)
    in
    let bounded3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?B : real.
          0 < B /\
          !p.
            p IN P ==>
            abs (xcoord p) <= B /\
            abs (ycoord p) <= B /\
            abs (zcoord p) <= B
    in
    let full_dimensional3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?c r.
          0 < r /\
          !p.
            (xcoord p - xcoord c) * (xcoord p - xcoord c) +
            (ycoord p - ycoord c) * (ycoord p - ycoord c) +
            (zcoord p - zcoord c) * (zcoord p - zcoord c) < r * r
            ==> p IN P
    in
    let polytope3 =
      \P : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?H : (((real # real) # (real # real)) set).
          FINITE H /\
          (!h. h IN H ==> nonzero_normal h) /\
          (!p.
             p IN P <=>
             !h. h IN H ==> plane_value h p <= plane_rhs h) /\
          bounded3 P /\
          full_dimensional3 P
    in
    let face_of =
      \(f : (((real # real) # real) set))
       (P : (((real # real) # real) set)).
        ~(f = EMPTY) /\
        f SUBSET P /\
        ?h : (real # real) # (real # real).
          nonzero_normal h /\
          (!p. p IN P ==> plane_value h p <= plane_rhs h) /\
          f = {p | p IN P /\ plane_value h p = plane_rhs h}
    in
    let on_line =
      \(p : (real # real) # real)
       (q : (real # real) # real)
       (s : (real # real) # real).
        ?t : real.
          xcoord s = xcoord p + t * (xcoord q - xcoord p) /\
          ycoord s = ycoord p + t * (ycoord q - ycoord p) /\
          zcoord s = zcoord p + t * (zcoord q - zcoord p)
    in
    let on_plane =
      \(p : (real # real) # real)
       (q : (real # real) # real)
       (r : (real # real) # real)
       (s : (real # real) # real).
        ?u v : real.
          xcoord s =
            xcoord p +
            u * (xcoord q - xcoord p) +
            v * (xcoord r - xcoord p) /\
          ycoord s =
            ycoord p +
            u * (ycoord q - ycoord p) +
            v * (ycoord r - ycoord p) /\
          zcoord s =
            zcoord p +
            u * (zcoord q - zcoord p) +
            v * (zcoord r - zcoord p)
    in
    let dimension0 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p. f = {p}
    in
    let dimension1 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p q.
          p IN f /\
          q IN f /\
          ~(p = q) /\
          !s. s IN f ==> on_line p q s
    in
    let dimension2 =
      \f : (((real # real) # real) set).
        ?p q r.
          p IN f /\
          q IN f /\
          r IN f /\
          ~(p = q) /\
          ~on_line p q r /\
          !s. s IN f ==> on_plane p q r s
    in
      !(m : num) (n : num).
        (?P : (((real # real) # real) set).
          polytope3 P /\
          (!f.
            face_of f P /\ dimension2 f ==>
            CARD {e | face_of e P /\ dimension1 e /\ e SUBSET f} = m) /\
          (!v.
            face_of v P /\ dimension0 v ==>
            CARD {e | face_of e P /\ dimension1 e /\ v SUBSET e} = n))
        <=>
        (m = 3 /\ n = 3) \/
        (m = 4 /\ n = 3) \/
        (m = 3 /\ n = 4) \/
        (m = 5 /\ n = 3) \/
        (m = 3 /\ n = 5)``;

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "The Number of Platonic Solids" from
  Hundred Theorems item 050: a full-dimensional convex polytope in real
  three-space has uniform facet-edge and vertex-edge incidence counts
  exactly for the five classical Platonic pairs.  This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Real three-space is represented by RR X. ( RR X. RR ).  The following
  symbols are definitional abbreviations only.  They expand convex
  polytopes as convex hulls of internally existentially quantified finite
  sets of real points, faces by the open-segment characterization, and
  affine dimensions by affine independence of two, three, or four points.
$)

$c
  HT050R3 HT050X HT050Y HT050Z HT050Mix HT050Hull HT050Convex
  HT050AI3 HT050Det HT050AI4 HT050Dim0 HT050Dim1 HT050Dim2
  HT050Full3 HT050Polytope HT050Face HT050EdgesInFace
  HT050EdgesAtVertex
$.

ht050-r3-syntax $a class HT050R3 $.
ht050-x-syntax $a class ( HT050X A ) $.
ht050-y-syntax $a class ( HT050Y A ) $.
ht050-z-syntax $a class ( HT050Z A ) $.
ht050-mix-syntax $a class ( A HT050Mix B C ) $.
ht050-hull-syntax $a class ( HT050Hull A ) $.
ht050-convex-syntax $a wff ( HT050Convex A ) $.
ht050-ai3-syntax $a wff ( HT050AI3 A B C ) $.
ht050-det-syntax $a class ( HT050Det A B C D ) $.
ht050-ai4-syntax $a wff ( HT050AI4 A B C D ) $.
ht050-dim0-syntax $a wff ( HT050Dim0 A ) $.
ht050-dim1-syntax $a wff ( HT050Dim1 A ) $.
ht050-dim2-syntax $a wff ( HT050Dim2 A ) $.
ht050-full3-syntax $a wff ( HT050Full3 A ) $.
ht050-polytope-syntax $a wff ( HT050Polytope A ) $.
ht050-face-syntax $a wff ( A HT050Face B ) $.
ht050-edges-in-face-syntax $a class ( HT050EdgesInFace A B ) $.
ht050-edges-at-vertex-syntax $a class ( HT050EdgesAtVertex A B ) $.

ht050-r3-def $a
  |- HT050R3 = ( RR X. ( RR X. RR ) )
$.

ht050-x-def $a
  |- ( HT050X A ) = ( 1st ` A )
$.

ht050-y-def $a
  |- ( HT050Y A ) = ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
$.

ht050-z-def $a
  |- ( HT050Z A ) = ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) )
$.

ht050-mix-def $a
  |- ( A HT050Mix B C ) =
      <. ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT050X B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT050X C ) ) ,
        <. ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT050Y B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT050Y C ) ) ,
           ( ( 1 - A ) x. ( HT050Z B ) ) + ( A x. ( HT050Z C ) ) >. >.
$.

${
  $d w x z A $.
  ht050-hull-def $a
    |- ( HT050Hull A ) =
       { z e. HT050R3 |
         E. w
           ( ( w : A --> RR /\
               A. x e. A ( 0 <_ ( w ` x ) ) ) /\
             ( ( sum_ x e. A ( w ` x ) ) = 1 /\
               z =
               <. sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT050X x ) ) ,
                  <. sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT050Y x ) ) ,
                     sum_ x e. A ( ( w ` x ) x. ( HT050Z x ) ) >. >. ) ) }
  $.
$}

${
  $d t x y A $.
  ht050-convex-def $a
    |- ( HT050Convex A ) <->
       A. x e. A A. y e. A A. t e. RR
         ( ( 0 <_ t /\ t <_ 1 ) -> ( ( t HT050Mix x y ) e. A ) )
  $.
$}

ht050-ai3-def $a
  |- ( HT050AI3 A B C ) <->
     ( ( ( ( HT050X B ) - ( HT050X A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050Y C ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT050Y B ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050X C ) - ( HT050X A ) ) ) \/
       ( ( ( HT050X B ) - ( HT050X A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050Z C ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT050Z B ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050X C ) - ( HT050X A ) ) ) \/
       ( ( ( HT050Y B ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050Z C ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) ) =/=
         ( ( ( HT050Z B ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) x.
           ( ( HT050Y C ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) ) )
$.

ht050-det-def $a
  |- ( HT050Det A B C D ) =
     ( ( ( ( HT050X B ) - ( HT050X A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT050Y C ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050Z D ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT050Z C ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050Y D ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) ) ) ) -
       ( ( ( HT050Y B ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT050X C ) - ( HT050X A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050Z D ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT050Z C ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050X D ) - ( HT050X A ) ) ) ) ) ) +
       ( ( ( HT050Z B ) - ( HT050Z A ) ) x.
         ( ( ( ( HT050X C ) - ( HT050X A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050Y D ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) ) -
           ( ( ( HT050Y C ) - ( HT050Y A ) ) x.
             ( ( HT050X D ) - ( HT050X A ) ) ) ) ) )
$.

ht050-ai4-def $a
  |- ( HT050AI4 A B C D ) <-> ( ( HT050Det A B C D ) =/= 0 )
$.

${
  $d x y A $.
  ht050-dim0-def $a
    |- ( HT050Dim0 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT050R3 /\ A =/= (/) ) /\
         A. x e. A A. y e. A x = y )
  $.
$}

${
  $d x y z A $.
  ht050-dim1-def $a
    |- ( HT050Dim1 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT050R3 /\
           E. x e. A E. y e. A x =/= y ) /\
         A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
           -. ( HT050AI3 x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d w x y z A $.
  ht050-dim2-def $a
    |- ( HT050Dim2 A ) <->
       ( ( A C_ HT050R3 /\
           E. x e. A E. y e. A E. z e. A
             ( HT050AI3 x y z ) ) /\
         A. w e. A A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
           -. ( HT050AI4 w x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d w x y z A $.
  ht050-full3-def $a
    |- ( HT050Full3 A ) <->
       ( A C_ HT050R3 /\
         E. w e. A E. x e. A E. y e. A E. z e. A
           ( HT050AI4 w x y z ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d v A $.
  ht050-polytope-def $a
    |- ( HT050Polytope A ) <->
       E. v
         ( ( v e. Fin /\ v C_ HT050R3 ) /\
           A = ( HT050Hull v ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d t x y A B $.
  ht050-face-def $a
    |- ( A HT050Face B ) <->
       ( ( A C_ B /\ ( HT050Convex A ) ) /\
         A. x e. B A. y e. B A. t e. RR
           ( ( ( 0 < t /\ t < 1 ) /\
               ( ( t HT050Mix x y ) e. A ) ) ->
             ( x e. A /\ y e. A ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d e A B $.
  ht050-edges-in-face-def $a
    |- ( HT050EdgesInFace A B ) =
       { e e. ~P A |
         ( ( e HT050Face A ) /\
           ( ( HT050Dim1 e ) /\ e C_ B ) ) }
  $.

  ht050-edges-at-vertex-def $a
    |- ( HT050EdgesAtVertex A B ) =
       { e e. ~P A |
         ( ( e HT050Face A ) /\
           ( ( HT050Dim1 e ) /\ B C_ e ) ) }
  $.
$}

$(
  This unproved assertion is the translated statement.  The two set
  comprehensions are the one-dimensional faces of p contained in a facet f
  and containing a vertex v, respectively.  Their set.mm cardinalities are
  finite for the finite convex-hull polytopes defined above.
$)
ht050-platonic-solids $a
  |- A. m e. NN0 A. n e. NN0
       ( E. p
           ( ( ( HT050Polytope p ) /\ ( HT050Full3 p ) ) /\
             ( A. f
                 ( ( ( f HT050Face p ) /\ ( HT050Dim2 f ) ) ->
                   ( ( # ` ( HT050EdgesInFace p f ) ) = m ) ) /\
               A. v
                 ( ( ( v HT050Face p ) /\ ( HT050Dim0 v ) ) ->
                   ( ( # ` ( HT050EdgesAtVertex p v ) ) = n ) ) ) )
         <->
         ( ( m = 3 /\ n = 3 ) \/
           ( ( m = 4 /\ n = 3 ) \/
             ( ( m = 3 /\ n = 4 ) \/
               ( ( m = 5 /\ n = 3 ) \/
                 ( m = 3 /\ n = 5 ) ) ) ) ) )
$.

            A c= E & card A = 2 & Affin A = Affin E) &
          E c= F} = m) &
      (for V being Subset of TOP-REAL 3 st
        V c= P & V is convex &
        (for x,y being Point of TOP-REAL 3, r being Real st
          x in P & y in P & 0 < r & r < 1 &
          r*x + (1-r)*y in V

          A c= V & card A = 1 & Affin A = Affin V)
       holds

          E c= P & E is convex &

            x in P & y in P & 0 < r & r < 1 &

          (ex A being finite affinely-independent Subset of TOP-REAL 3 st
            A c= E & card A = 2 & Affin A = Affin E) &
          V c= E} = n))
    iff
      (m = 3 & n = 3) or
      (m = 4 & n = 3) or
      (m = 3 & n = 4) or
      (m = 5 & n = 3) or
      (m = 3 & n = 5)
proof
end;

title: 050_the_number_of_platonic_solids
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Number of Platonic Solids" from Hundred
% Theorems item 050. It characterizes the possible constant numbers of edges
% per facet and per vertex of a full-dimensional real three-dimensional
% polytope. This file contains no proof.

the_number_of_platonic_solids_050: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate: TYPE = below(3)
  point: TYPE = [coordinate -> real]
  point_set: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  point_set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  point_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> point]
  point_set_enumeration: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  subset(S, T: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: point):
      S(x) IMPLIES T(x)

  affine_combination(t: real, a, b: point): point =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate):
      (1 - t) * a(i) + t * b(i)

  convex(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (a, b: point), (t: real):
      S(a) AND S(b) AND 0 <= t AND t <= 1
        IMPLIES S(affine_combination(t, a, b))

  convex_hull(S: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: point):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND subset(S, C) IMPLIES C(x)

  open_segment_member(x, a, b: point): bool =
    NOT a = b
      AND
        EXISTS (t: real):
          0 < t AND t < 1
            AND x = affine_combination(t, a, b)

  injective_points_below(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_points_exactly(
      enumeration: point_enumeration,
      S: point_set,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: point):
      S(x)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = x

  has_point_cardinality(S: point_set, cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_enumeration):
      injective_points_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_points_exactly(enumeration, S, cardinality)

  finite_point_set(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cardinality: nat):
      has_point_cardinality(S, cardinality)

  injective_point_sets_below(
      enumeration: point_set_enumeration,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < bound AND j < bound
        AND enumeration(i) = enumeration(j)
      IMPLIES i = j

  enumerates_point_sets_exactly(
      enumeration: point_set_enumeration,
      family: point_set_family,
      bound: nat): bool =
    FORALL (S: point_set):
      family(S)
        IFF
          EXISTS (i: nat):
            i < bound AND enumeration(i) = S

  has_point_set_cardinality(
      family: point_set_family,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: point_set_enumeration):
      injective_point_sets_below(enumeration, cardinality)
        AND enumerates_point_sets_exactly(
          enumeration,
          family,
          cardinality)

  polytope(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (vertices: point_set):
      finite_point_set(vertices)
        AND S = convex_hull(vertices)

  face_of(F, S: point_set): bool =
    subset(F, S)
      AND convex(F)
      AND
        FORALL (a, b, x: point):
          S(a) AND S(b) AND F(x)
            AND open_segment_member(x, a, b)
          IMPLIES F(a) AND F(b)

  collinear(a, b, c: point): bool =
    (b(0) - a(0)) * (c(1) - a(1))
        = (b(1) - a(1)) * (c(0) - a(0))
      AND
        (b(0) - a(0)) * (c(2) - a(2))
          = (b(2) - a(2)) * (c(0) - a(0))
      AND
        (b(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - a(2))
          = (b(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - a(1))

  oriented_volume(a, b, c, d: point): real =
    (b(0) - a(0))
        * ((c(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))
          - (c(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))
      - (b(1) - a(1))
        * ((c(0) - a(0)) * (d(2) - a(2))
          - (c(2) - a(2)) * (d(0) - a(0)))
      + (b(2) - a(2))
        * ((c(0) - a(0)) * (d(1) - a(1))
          - (c(1) - a(1)) * (d(0) - a(0)))

  coplanar(a, b, c, d: point): bool =
    oriented_volume(a, b, c, d) = 0

  affine_dimension_zero(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (a: point):
      S(a)
        AND
          FORALL (x: point):
            S(x) IMPLIES x = a

  affine_dimension_one(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (a, b: point):
      S(a) AND S(b) AND NOT a = b
        AND
          FORALL (x: point):
            S(x) IMPLIES collinear(a, b, x)

  affine_dimension_two(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (a, b, c: point):
      S(a) AND S(b) AND S(c) AND NOT collinear(a, b, c)
        AND
          FORALL (x: point):
            S(x) IMPLIES coplanar(a, b, c, x)

  affine_dimension_three(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (a, b, c, d: point):
      S(a) AND S(b) AND S(c) AND S(d)
        AND NOT oriented_volume(a, b, c, d) = 0

  edge_of(E, P: point_set): bool =
    face_of(E, P) AND affine_dimension_one(E)

  edges_of_facet(P, F: point_set): point_set_family =
    LAMBDA (E: point_set):
      edge_of(E, P) AND subset(E, F)

  edges_at_vertex(P, V: point_set): point_set_family =
    LAMBDA (E: point_set):
      edge_of(E, P) AND subset(V, E)

  platonic_pair(m, n: nat): bool =
    (m = 3 AND n = 3)
      OR (m = 4 AND n = 3)
      OR (m = 3 AND n = 4)
      OR (m = 5 AND n = 3)
      OR (m = 3 AND n = 5)

  number_of_platonic_solids: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      (EXISTS (P: point_set):
        polytope(P)
          AND affine_dimension_three(P)
          AND
            (FORALL (F: point_set):
              face_of(F, P) AND affine_dimension_two(F)
                IMPLIES
                  has_point_set_cardinality(
                    edges_of_facet(P, F),
                    m))
          AND
            (FORALL (V: point_set):
              face_of(V, P) AND affine_dimension_zero(V)
                IMPLIES
                  has_point_set_cardinality(
                    edges_at_vertex(P, V),
                    n)))
      IFF platonic_pair(m, n)
END the_number_of_platonic_solids_050

title: 051_wilson_s_theorem
content:
/-
