            ex a being FinSequence of REAL st
              len a = n &
              (for j being Nat st j in dom a holds
                a.j = (X.(j-'1)).omega) &
              s.n = Sum a / (n qua Real)) &
          s is convergent &
          lim s = expect(X0,P)} &
      P.A = 1
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 059_the_laws_of_large_numbers
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 059, "The Laws of Large Numbers":
% pairwise independent identically distributed integrable real random variables have sample
% averages converging almost surely to their common expectation; this includes the iid form.
% This file contains no proof.

the_laws_of_large_numbers_059: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  real_event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_event]
  real_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [real_event -> bool]
  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  random_variable: TYPE = [sample_space -> real]
  random_variable_family: TYPE = [nat -> random_variable]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  absolute_value(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN x ELSE -x ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (n: nat): events(n)(omega)

  real_full_event: real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real): TRUE

  real_event_complement(A: real_event): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real): NOT A(value)

  real_countable_union(events: real_event_sequence): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real):
      EXISTS (n: nat): events(n)(value)

  is_real_sigma_algebra(
      BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    BorelSigma(real_full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        BorelSigma(A) IMPLIES
          BorelSigma(real_event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: real_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat): BorelSigma(events(n)))
          IMPLIES BorelSigma(real_countable_union(events)))

  contains_real_lower_rays(
      BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      BorelSigma(
        LAMBDA (value: real): value <= bound)

  borel_event(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra):
      (is_real_sigma_algebra(BorelSigma)
        AND contains_real_lower_rays(BorelSigma))
      IMPLIES BorelSigma(A)

  preimage_event(
      X: random_variable,
      A: real_event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(X(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < count AND j < count AND i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  distinct_below(
      indices: index_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < count AND j < count AND i /= j IMPLIES
        indices(i) /= indices(j)

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            absolute_value(values(n) - limit) < epsilon

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        bound < values(n)

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  one_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 1 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_one(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 1

  measure_value_product(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      (# infinite_flag := FALSE,
         finite_part := finite_part(left) * finite_part(right) #)
    ENDIF

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (n: nat): finite_part(values(n)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(n)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (n: nat): infinite_flag(values(n)))
          OR ((FORALL (n: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(n)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(n)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat): Sigma(events(n)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (n: nat): Sigma(events(n)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (n: nat): M(events(n)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  measure_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)

  probability_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    measure_space(M, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_one(M(full_event))

  sublevel_event(
      X: random_variable,
      bound: real): event =
    preimage_event(
      X,
      LAMBDA (value: real): value <= bound)

  random_variable_on(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      borel_event(A) IMPLIES
        Sigma(preimage_event(X, A))

  random_variable_family_on(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      random_variable_on(Sigma, X(index))

  positive_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) >= 0 THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  negative_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) <= 0 THEN -X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(omega)
            THEN coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (k: nat):
        k < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(k) >= 0 AND Sigma(pieces(k)))
      AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        0 <= simple_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
          AND simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega) <= X(omega))

  has_finite_simple_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (terms: real_sequence):
      (FORALL (k: nat):
        k < count IMPLIES
          ((coefficients(k) = 0 AND terms(k) = 0)
            OR (NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(k)))
              AND terms(k)
                = coefficients(k)
                    * finite_part(M(pieces(k))))))
        AND value = finite_sum(terms, count)

  nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      nonnegative_simple_minorant(
        Sigma, X, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (value: real):
          has_finite_simple_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count, value)
            AND value <= upper

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: sample_space): X(omega) >= 0)
      AND value >= 0
      AND nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, X, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, X, upper)
        IMPLIES value <= upper)

  has_expectation(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    random_variable_on(Sigma, X)
      AND EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: real):
        has_nonnegative_integral(
          M, Sigma, positive_part(X), positive_integral)
          AND has_nonnegative_integral(
            M, Sigma, negative_part(X), negative_integral)
          AND value = positive_integral - negative_integral

  integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, value)

  identically_distributed(
      M: measure_map,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat), (A: real_event):
      borel_event(A) IMPLIES
        M(preimage_event(X(i), A))
          = M(preimage_event(X(j), A))

  pairwise_independent(
      M: measure_map,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat), (A, B: real_event):
      i /= j AND borel_event(A) AND borel_event(B)
      IMPLIES
        M(event_intersection(
          preimage_event(X(i), A),
          preimage_event(X(j), B)))
          = measure_value_product(
              M(preimage_event(X(i), A)),
              M(preimage_event(X(j), B)))

  finite_preimage_intersection(
      X: random_variable_family,
      indices: index_sequence,
      sets: real_event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE event =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      full_event
    ELSE
      event_intersection(
        finite_preimage_intersection(
          X, indices, sets, count - 1),
        preimage_event(
          X(indices(count - 1)),
          sets(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_measure_product(
      M: measure_map,
      X: random_variable_family,
      indices: index_sequence,
      sets: real_event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      one_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_product(
        finite_measure_product(
          M, X, indices, sets, count - 1),
        M(preimage_event(
          X(indices(count - 1)),
          sets(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  mutually_independent(
      M: measure_map,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    FORALL
        (indices: index_sequence),
        (sets: real_event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      (distinct_below(indices, count)
        AND (FORALL (k: nat):
          k < count IMPLIES borel_event(sets(k))))
      IMPLIES
        M(finite_preimage_intersection(
          X, indices, sets, count))
          = finite_measure_product(
              M, X, indices, sets, count)

  iid_family(
      M: measure_map,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    mutually_independent(M, X)
      AND identically_distributed(M, X)

  partial_sum(
      X: random_variable_family,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(X, count - 1, omega)
        + X(count - 1)(omega)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sample_average(
      X: random_variable_family,
      count: nat): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF count = 0 THEN
        0
      ELSE
        partial_sum(X, count, omega) / (count :: real)
      ENDIF

  averages_converge_event(
      X: random_variable_family,
      mean: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      converges_to_real(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          sample_average(X, count)(omega),
        mean)

  almost_surely(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    Sigma(A)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(
        M(event_complement(A)))

  strong_law_context(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    measure_space(M, Sigma)
      AND random_variable_family_on(Sigma, X)
      AND identically_distributed(M, X)
      AND integrable(M, Sigma, X(0))

  strong_law_of_large_numbers: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (X: random_variable_family):
      (strong_law_context(M, Sigma, X)
        AND pairwise_independent(M, X))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (mean: real):
          has_expectation(M, Sigma, X(0), mean)
            AND almost_surely(
              M,
              Sigma,
              averages_converge_event(X, mean))

  iid_strong_law_of_large_numbers: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (X: random_variable_family):
      (strong_law_context(M, Sigma, X)
        AND probability_space(M, Sigma)
        AND iid_family(M, X))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (mean: real):
          has_expectation(M, Sigma, X(0), mean)
            AND almost_surely(
              M,
              Sigma,
              averages_converge_event(X, mean))

  the_laws_of_large_numbers: bool =
    strong_law_of_large_numbers
      AND iid_strong_law_of_large_numbers
END the_laws_of_large_numbers_059

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
-- Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending the fixed
-- first-order arithmetic theory NN, whose axioms are represented in that
-- arithmetic, has a closed formula independent of the theory. This file
-- contains no proof.

namespace GoedelsIncompleteness

/-- Terms in the first-order language of arithmetic. -/
inductive Term where
  | var : Nat → Term
  | zero : Term
  | succ : Term → Term
  | add : Term → Term → Term
  | mul : Term → Term → Term
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Formulas in the first-order language with equality and strict order. -/
inductive Formula where
  | equal : Term → Term → Formula
  | less : Term → Term → Formula
  | imp : Formula → Formula → Formula
  | neg : Formula → Formula
  | all : Nat → Formula → Formula
deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Theory := Formula → Prop

def Formula.disj (left right : Formula) : Formula :=
  Formula.imp (Formula.neg left) right

def Formula.conj (left right : Formula) : Formula :=
  Formula.neg (Formula.imp left (Formula.neg right))

def Formula.iffFormula (left right : Formula) : Formula :=
  Formula.conj (Formula.imp left right) (Formula.imp right left)

def Formula.existsFormula (index : Nat) (body : Formula) : Formula :=
  Formula.neg (Formula.all index (Formula.neg body))

def Term.freeVariable : Term → Nat → Prop
  | .var index, free => index = free
  | .zero, _ => False
  | .succ term, free => term.freeVariable free
  | .add left right, free =>
      left.freeVariable free ∨ right.freeVariable free
  | .mul left right, free =>
      left.freeVariable free ∨ right.freeVariable free

def Term.hasVariable : Term → Nat → Bool
  | .var index, sought => index == sought
  | .zero, _ => false
  | .succ term, sought => term.hasVariable sought
  | .add left right, sought =>
      left.hasVariable sought || right.hasVariable sought
  | .mul left right, sought =>
      left.hasVariable sought || right.hasVariable sought

def Formula.freeVariable : Formula → Nat → Prop
  | .equal left right, free =>
      left.freeVariable free ∨ right.freeVariable free
  | .less left right, free =>
      left.freeVariable free ∨ right.freeVariable free
  | .imp left right, free =>
      left.freeVariable free ∨ right.freeVariable free
  | .neg body, free => body.freeVariable free
  | .all bound body, free =>
      free ≠ bound ∧ body.freeVariable free

def Term.maxVariable : Term → Nat
  | .var index => index
  | .zero => 0
  | .succ term => term.maxVariable
  | .add left right => max left.maxVariable right.maxVariable
  | .mul left right => max left.maxVariable right.maxVariable

def Formula.maxVariable : Formula → Nat
  | .equal left right => max left.maxVariable right.maxVariable
  | .less left right => max left.maxVariable right.maxVariable
  | .imp left right => max left.maxVariable right.maxVariable
  | .neg body => body.maxVariable
  | .all bound body => max bound body.maxVariable

def Term.rename (old fresh : Nat) : Term → Term
  | .var index => .var (if index = old then fresh else index)
  | .zero => .zero
  | .succ term => .succ (term.rename old fresh)
  | .add left right =>
      .add (left.rename old fresh) (right.rename old fresh)
  | .mul left right =>
      .mul (left.rename old fresh) (right.rename old fresh)

def Formula.renameBound (old fresh : Nat) : Formula → Formula
  | .equal left right => .equal (left.rename old fresh) (right.rename old fresh)
  | .less left right => .less (left.rename old fresh) (right.rename old fresh)
  | .imp left right =>
      .imp (left.renameBound old fresh) (right.renameBound old fresh)
  | .neg body => .neg (body.renameBound old fresh)
  | .all bound body =>
      if bound = old then .all bound body
      else .all bound (body.renameBound old fresh)

def Formula.depth : Formula → Nat
  | .equal _ _ => 1
  | .less _ _ => 1
  | .imp left right => max left.depth right.depth + 1
  | .neg body => body.depth + 1
  | .all _ body => body.depth + 1

def Term.substitute (term : Term) (index : Nat) (replacement : Term) : Term :=
  match term with
  | .var termIndex => if termIndex = index then replacement else .var termIndex
  | .zero => .zero
  | .succ argument => .succ (argument.substitute index replacement)
  | .add left right =>
      .add (left.substitute index replacement) (right.substitute index replacement)
  | .mul left right =>
      .mul (left.substitute index replacement) (right.substitute index replacement)

/-- Fuel-bounded capture-avoiding substitution for the fixed arithmetic syntax. -/
def Formula.substituteFuel : Nat → Formula → Nat → Term → Formula
  | 0, formula, _, _ => formula
  | _ + 1, .equal left right, index, replacement =>
      .equal
        (left.substitute index replacement)
        (right.substitute index replacement)
  | _ + 1, .less left right, index, replacement =>
      .less
        (left.substitute index replacement)
        (right.substitute index replacement)
  | fuel + 1, .imp left right, index, replacement =>
      .imp
        (left.substituteFuel fuel index replacement)
        (right.substituteFuel fuel index replacement)
  | fuel + 1, .neg body, index, replacement =>
      .neg (body.substituteFuel fuel index replacement)
  | fuel + 1, .all bound body, index, replacement =>
      if bound = index then
        .all bound body
      else if replacement.hasVariable bound then
        let fresh :=
          max body.maxVariable
            (max replacement.maxVariable (max index bound)) + 1
        .all fresh
          ((body.renameBound bound fresh).substituteFuel fuel index replacement)
      else
        .all bound (body.substituteFuel fuel index replacement)

def Formula.substitute (formula : Formula) (index : Nat) (replacement : Term) : Formula :=
  formula.substituteFuel formula.depth index replacement

def Term.numeral : Nat → Term
  | 0 => .zero
  | n + 1 => .succ (numeral n)

/-- The pairing function used by the fixed Gödel numbering. -/
def pairCode (left right : Nat) : Nat :=
  2 ^ left * (2 * right + 1)

def Term.code : Term → Nat
  | .var index => 5 * index
  | .zero => 1
  | .succ term => 5 * term.code + 2
  | .add left right => 5 * pairCode left.code right.code + 3
  | .mul left right => 5 * pairCode left.code right.code + 4

def Formula.code : Formula → Nat
  | .equal left right => 5 * pairCode left.code right.code
  | .less left right => 5 * pairCode left.code right.code + 1
  | .imp left right => 5 * pairCode left.code right.code + 2
  | .neg body => 5 * body.code + 3
  | .all bound body => 5 * pairCode bound body.code + 4

def Formula.reflect (formula : Formula) : Term :=
  Term.numeral formula.code

/-- Hilbert derivations for the fixed first-order language of arithmetic. -/
inductive Derivation : List Formula → Formula → Prop
  | axiom (formula : Formula) :
      Derivation [formula] formula
  | modusPonens
      (leftHypotheses rightHypotheses : List Formula)
      (antecedent consequent : Formula) :
      Derivation leftHypotheses (.imp antecedent consequent) →
      Derivation rightHypotheses antecedent →
      Derivation (leftHypotheses ++ rightHypotheses) consequent
  | generalize
      (hypotheses : List Formula) (formula : Formula) (index : Nat) :
      (∀ hypothesis, hypothesis ∈ hypotheses →
        ¬hypothesis.freeVariable index) →
      Derivation hypotheses formula →
      Derivation hypotheses (.all index formula)
  | impOne (left right : Formula) :
      Derivation [] (.imp left (.imp right left))
  | impTwo (left middle right : Formula) :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.imp left (.imp middle right))
          (.imp (.imp left middle) (.imp left right)))
  | contraposition (left right : Formula) :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.imp (.neg left) (.neg right))
          (.imp right left))
  | forallElim (formula : Formula) (index : Nat) (term : Term) :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.all index formula)
          (formula.substitute index term))
  | forallIntro (formula : Formula) (index : Nat) :
      ¬formula.freeVariable index →
      Derivation [] (.imp formula (.all index formula))
  | forallImp (left right : Formula) (index : Nat) :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.all index (.imp left right))
          (.imp (.all index left) (.all index right)))
  | equalityRefl :
      Derivation [] (.equal (.var 0) (.var 0))
  | equalitySymm :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.equal (.var 1) (.var 0)))
  | equalityTrans :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.imp
            (.equal (.var 1) (.var 2))
            (.equal (.var 0) (.var 2))))
  | lessCongruence :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.imp
            (.equal (.var 2) (.var 3))
            (Formula.iffFormula
              (.less (.var 0) (.var 2))
              (.less (.var 1) (.var 3)))))
  | zeroCongruence :
      Derivation [] (.equal .zero .zero)
  | succCongruence :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.equal (.succ (.var 0)) (.succ (.var 1))))
  | addCongruence :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.imp
            (.equal (.var 2) (.var 3))
            (.equal
              (.add (.var 0) (.var 2))
              (.add (.var 1) (.var 3)))))
  | mulCongruence :
      Derivation []
        (.imp
          (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
          (.imp
            (.equal (.var 2) (.var 3))
            (.equal
              (.mul (.var 0) (.var 2))
              (.mul (.var 1) (.var 3)))))

def Provable (theory : Theory) (formula : Formula) : Prop :=
  ∃ hypotheses : List Formula,
    Derivation hypotheses formula ∧
    ∀ hypothesis, hypothesis ∈ hypotheses → theory hypothesis

def Independent (theory : Theory) (formula : Formula) : Prop :=
  ¬Provable theory formula ∧ ¬Provable theory (.neg formula)

def Closed (formula : Formula) : Prop :=
  ∀ index, ¬formula.freeVariable index

/--
The source's ω-consistency condition: if the theory proves an existential
counterexample to a one-variable formula, some numeral instance is unprovable.
-/
def WeaklyConsistent (theory : Theory) : Prop :=
  ∀ formula index,
    (∀ free, formula.freeVariable free → index = free) →
    Provable theory (.existsFormula index (.neg formula)) →
    ∃ number : Nat,
      ¬Provable theory (formula.substitute index (Term.numeral number))

def nn1 : Formula :=
  .all 0 (.neg (.equal (.succ (.var 0)) .zero))

def nn2 : Formula :=
  .all 1 <| .all 0 <|
    .imp
      (.equal (.succ (.var 0)) (.succ (.var 1)))
      (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))

def nn3 : Formula :=
  .all 0 (.equal (.add (.var 0) .zero) (.var 0))

def nn4 : Formula :=
  .all 1 <| .all 0 <|
    .equal
      (.add (.var 0) (.succ (.var 1)))
      (.succ (.add (.var 0) (.var 1)))

def nn5 : Formula :=
  .all 0 (.equal (.mul (.var 0) .zero) .zero)

def nn6 : Formula :=
  .all 1 <| .all 0 <|
    .equal
      (.mul (.var 0) (.succ (.var 1)))
      (.add (.mul (.var 0) (.var 1)) (.var 0))

def nn7 : Formula :=
  .all 0 (.neg (.less (.var 0) .zero))

def nn8 : Formula :=
  .all 1 <| .all 0 <|
    .imp
      (.less (.var 0) (.succ (.var 1)))
      (Formula.disj
        (.less (.var 0) (.var 1))
        (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1)))

def nn9 : Formula :=
  .all 1 <| .all 0 <|
    Formula.disj
      (.less (.var 0) (.var 1))
      (Formula.disj
        (.equal (.var 0) (.var 1))
        (.less (.var 1) (.var 0)))

/-- The fixed nine-axiom arithmetic theory `NN` used by the Rocq source. -/
def NN : Theory :=
  fun formula =>
    formula = nn1 ∨ formula = nn2 ∨ formula = nn3 ∨
    formula = nn4 ∨ formula = nn5 ∨ formula = nn6 ∨
    formula = nn7 ∨ formula = nn8 ∨ formula = nn9

/--
Gödel's first incompleteness theorem for the fixed arithmetic syntax,
Gödel numbering, derivability relation, and ω-consistency predicate above.
-/
theorem goedels_first_incompleteness
    (theory : Theory)
    (extendsNN : ∀ formula, NN formula → theory formula)
    (representsTheory : Formula)
    (codeVariable : Nat)
    (onlyFreeVariable :
      ∀ other, representsTheory.freeVariable other → other = codeVariable)
    (expressesMembership :
      ∀ formula, theory formula →
        Provable theory
          (representsTheory.substitute codeVariable formula.reflect))
    (expressesNonmembership :
      ∀ formula, ¬theory formula →
        Provable theory
          (.neg (representsTheory.substitute codeVariable formula.reflect)))
    (consistent : WeaklyConsistent theory) :
    ∃ formula : Formula, Independent theory formula ∧ Closed formula := sorry

end GoedelsIncompleteness

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
From Coq Require Import Ensembles.
From Coq Require Import List.
From Coq Require Import Arith.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import folProp.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import folProof.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import subProp.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import ListExt.
From Goedel Require Import fixPoint codeSysPrf.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import wConsistent.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import NN.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import code.
From hydras.Ackermann Require Import checkPrf.
From hydras Require Import Compat815.

From LibHyps Require Export LibHyps.
From hydras Require Export MoreLibHyps NewNotations.

Import NNnotations codeNatToTerm.


(* TO do: remove this kind of redefinition *)
Definition codeFNN := codeFormula (cl:=LcodeLNN) .

(* cf Gilles' paper ? *)
Notation reflection f := (natToTerm (codeFNN f)).
  
Section Goedel's_1st_Incompleteness.

Variable T : System.

Hypothesis extendsNN : Included _ NN T.

(*
 There exists a formula repT 
  -  with only a free variable v0
  -  which means "v0 is a term which reflects some axiom of T"

   (see also codeSysPrf.v)
*)
Variable repT : Formula.
Variable v0 : nat.
Hypothesis
  freeVarRepT : forall v : nat, In v (freeVarF repT) -> v = v0.

Hypothesis
  expressT1 :
    forall f : Formula, mem _ T f ->
    SysPrf T (substF repT v0 (reflection f)).

Hypothesis
  expressT2 :
    forall f : Formula, ~ mem _ T f ->
    SysPrf T (~ (substF repT v0 (reflection f)))%fol.




Definition codeSysPrf :=
  codeSysPrf LNN LcodeLNN codeArityLNTF codeArityLNNR
    codeArityLNTFIsPR codeArityLNNRIsPR repT v0.

Definition codeSysPf :=
  codeSysPf LNN LcodeLNN codeArityLNTF codeArityLNNR
    codeArityLNTFIsPR codeArityLNNRIsPR repT v0.

Definition G := let (a,_) := FixPointLNN (notH codeSysPf) 0 in a.


Definition codeSysPfCorrect :=
  codeSysPfCorrect LNN LcodeLNN codeArityLNTF
    codeArityLNNR codeArityLNTFIsPR codeArityLNTFIsCorrect1 codeArityLNNRIsPR
    codeArityLNNRIsCorrect1 T extendsNN T repT v0 freeVarRepT expressT1.

Definition codeSysPrfCorrect2 :=
  codeSysPrfCorrect2 LNN LcodeLNN codeArityLNTF
    codeArityLNNR codeArityLNTFIsPR codeArityLNTFIsCorrect1 codeArityLNNRIsPR
    codeArityLNNRIsCorrect1 T extendsNN T repT v0 freeVarRepT expressT2.

Definition codeSysPrfCorrect3 :=
  codeSysPrfCorrect3 LNN LcodeLNN codeArityLNTF
    codeArityLNNR codeArityLNTFIsPR codeArityLNTFIsCorrect1
    codeArityLNTFIsCorrect2 codeArityLNNRIsPR codeArityLNNRIsCorrect1
    codeArityLNNRIsCorrect2  T extendsNN.
 


Lemma freeVarG : closed G.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma FirstIncompletenessA : SysPrf T G -> Inconsistent LNN T.
Proof.
Admitted.

(*I don't believe I can prove

 (SysPrf T (notH G))->(wInconsistent T))
 
 So instead I prove: *)

Lemma FirstIncompletenessB :
  wConsistent T -> ~ SysPrf T (notH G).
Proof.
Admitted.


Theorem Goedel'sIncompleteness1st :
 wConsistent T ->
 exists f : Formula, independent T f /\ closed f.
Proof.
Admitted.

End Goedel's_1st_Incompleteness.

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
  Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending the concrete
  arithmetic theory NN, with representable axiom membership, has a closed
  formula independent of the theory. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Goedel_Incompleteness
  imports Main
begin

datatype arith_term =
    TVar nat
  | TZero
  | TSucc arith_term
  | TAdd arith_term arith_term
  | TMul arith_term arith_term

datatype arith_formula =
    FEq arith_term arith_term
  | FLt arith_term arith_term
  | FImp arith_formula arith_formula
  | FNeg arith_formula
  | FAll nat arith_formula

abbreviation FOr :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "FOr A B \<equiv> FImp (FNeg A) B"

abbreviation FAnd :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "FAnd A B \<equiv> FNeg (FImp A (FNeg B))"

abbreviation FIff :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "FIff A B \<equiv> FAnd (FImp A B) (FImp B A)"

abbreviation FEx :: "nat \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "FEx v A \<equiv> FNeg (FAll v (FNeg A))"

fun free_vars_term :: "arith_term \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "free_vars_term (TVar v) = {v}"
| "free_vars_term TZero = {}"
| "free_vars_term (TSucc t) = free_vars_term t"
| "free_vars_term (TAdd s t) = free_vars_term s \<union> free_vars_term t"
| "free_vars_term (TMul s t) = free_vars_term s \<union> free_vars_term t"

fun all_vars_term :: "arith_term \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "all_vars_term (TVar v) = {v}"
| "all_vars_term TZero = {}"
| "all_vars_term (TSucc t) = all_vars_term t"
| "all_vars_term (TAdd s t) = all_vars_term s \<union> all_vars_term t"
| "all_vars_term (TMul s t) = all_vars_term s \<union> all_vars_term t"

fun free_vars_formula :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "free_vars_formula (FEq s t) = free_vars_term s \<union> free_vars_term t"
| "free_vars_formula (FLt s t) = free_vars_term s \<union> free_vars_term t"
| "free_vars_formula (FImp A B) =
    free_vars_formula A \<union> free_vars_formula B"
| "free_vars_formula (FNeg A) = free_vars_formula A"
| "free_vars_formula (FAll v A) = free_vars_formula A - {v}"

fun all_vars_formula :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "all_vars_formula (FEq s t) = all_vars_term s \<union> all_vars_term t"
| "all_vars_formula (FLt s t) = all_vars_term s \<union> all_vars_term t"
| "all_vars_formula (FImp A B) =
    all_vars_formula A \<union> all_vars_formula B"
| "all_vars_formula (FNeg A) = all_vars_formula A"
| "all_vars_formula (FAll v A) = insert v (all_vars_formula A)"

fun rename_term :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> arith_term \<Rightarrow> arith_term" where
  "rename_term x y (TVar v) = TVar (if v = x then y else v)"
| "rename_term x y TZero = TZero"
| "rename_term x y (TSucc t) = TSucc (rename_term x y t)"
| "rename_term x y (TAdd s t) =
    TAdd (rename_term x y s) (rename_term x y t)"
| "rename_term x y (TMul s t) =
    TMul (rename_term x y s) (rename_term x y t)"

fun rename_bound ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "rename_bound x y (FEq s t) =
    FEq (rename_term x y s) (rename_term x y t)"
| "rename_bound x y (FLt s t) =
    FLt (rename_term x y s) (rename_term x y t)"
| "rename_bound x y (FImp A B) =
    FImp (rename_bound x y A) (rename_bound x y B)"
| "rename_bound x y (FNeg A) = FNeg (rename_bound x y A)"
| "rename_bound x y (FAll v A) =
    (if v = x then FAll v A else FAll v (rename_bound x y A))"

fun formula_depth :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "formula_depth (FEq s t) = 1"
| "formula_depth (FLt s t) = 1"
| "formula_depth (FImp A B) =
    Suc (max (formula_depth A) (formula_depth B))"
| "formula_depth (FNeg A) = Suc (formula_depth A)"
| "formula_depth (FAll v A) = Suc (formula_depth A)"

fun subst_term ::
    "arith_term \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> arith_term \<Rightarrow> arith_term" where
  "subst_term (TVar v) x s = (if v = x then s else TVar v)"
| "subst_term TZero x s = TZero"
| "subst_term (TSucc t) x s = TSucc (subst_term t x s)"
| "subst_term (TAdd t u) x s =
    TAdd (subst_term t x s) (subst_term u x s)"
| "subst_term (TMul t u) x s =
    TMul (subst_term t x s) (subst_term u x s)"

fun subst_formula_fuel ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> arith_term
      \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "subst_formula_fuel 0 A x s = A"
| "subst_formula_fuel (Suc n) (FEq t u) x s =
    FEq (subst_term t x s) (subst_term u x s)"
| "subst_formula_fuel (Suc n) (FLt t u) x s =
    FLt (subst_term t x s) (subst_term u x s)"
| "subst_formula_fuel (Suc n) (FImp A B) x s =
    FImp (subst_formula_fuel n A x s) (subst_formula_fuel n B x s)"
| "subst_formula_fuel (Suc n) (FNeg A) x s =
    FNeg (subst_formula_fuel n A x s)"
| "subst_formula_fuel (Suc n) (FAll v A) x s =
    (if v = x then FAll v A
     else if v \<in> free_vars_term s then
       (let fresh =
          Suc (Max (all_vars_formula A \<union> all_vars_term s \<union> {x, v}))
        in FAll fresh
          (subst_formula_fuel n (rename_bound v fresh A) x s))
     else FAll v (subst_formula_fuel n A x s))"

definition subst_formula ::
    "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> arith_term \<Rightarrow> arith_formula" where
  "subst_formula A x s = subst_formula_fuel (formula_depth A) A x s"

fun numeral :: "nat \<Rightarrow> arith_term" where
  "numeral 0 = TZero"
| "numeral (Suc n) = TSucc (numeral n)"

definition pair_code :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "pair_code a b = 2 ^ a * (2 * b + 1)"

fun code_term :: "arith_term \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "code_term (TVar v) = 5 * v"
| "code_term TZero = 1"
| "code_term (TSucc t) = 5 * code_term t + 2"
| "code_term (TAdd s t) = 5 * pair_code (code_term s) (code_term t) + 3"
| "code_term (TMul s t) = 5 * pair_code (code_term s) (code_term t) + 4"

fun code_formula :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "code_formula (FEq s t) = 5 * pair_code (code_term s) (code_term t)"
| "code_formula (FLt s t) =
    5 * pair_code (code_term s) (code_term t) + 1"
| "code_formula (FImp A B) =
    5 * pair_code (code_formula A) (code_formula B) + 2"
| "code_formula (FNeg A) = 5 * code_formula A + 3"
| "code_formula (FAll v A) =
    5 * pair_code v (code_formula A) + 4"

definition reflect :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> arith_term" where
  "reflect A = numeral (code_formula A)"

fun free_vars_context :: "arith_formula list \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "free_vars_context [] = {}"
| "free_vars_context (A # H) =
    free_vars_formula A \<union> free_vars_context H"

definition less_congruence :: arith_formula where
  "less_congruence =
    FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
      (FImp (FEq (TVar 2) (TVar 3))
        (FIff (FLt (TVar 0) (TVar 2))
          (FLt (TVar 1) (TVar 3))))"

definition succ_congruence :: arith_formula where
  "succ_congruence =
    FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
      (FEq (TSucc (TVar 0)) (TSucc (TVar 1)))"

definition add_congruence :: arith_formula where
  "add_congruence =
    FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
      (FImp (FEq (TVar 2) (TVar 3))
        (FEq (TAdd (TVar 0) (TVar 2))
          (TAdd (TVar 1) (TVar 3))))"

definition mul_congruence :: arith_formula where
  "mul_congruence =
    FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
      (FImp (FEq (TVar 2) (TVar 3))
        (FEq (TMul (TVar 0) (TVar 2))
          (TMul (TVar 1) (TVar 3))))"

inductive derivation :: "arith_formula list \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  D_axiom: "derivation [A] A"
| D_modus_ponens:
    "\<lbrakk>derivation H1 (FImp A B); derivation H2 A\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
      derivation (H1 @ H2) B"
| D_generalization:
    "\<lbrakk>v \<notin> free_vars_context H; derivation H A\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
      derivation H (FAll v A)"
| D_imp1: "derivation [] (FImp A (FImp B A))"
| D_imp2:
    "derivation []
      (FImp (FImp A (FImp B C)) (FImp (FImp A B) (FImp A C)))"
| D_contraposition:
    "derivation [] (FImp (FImp (FNeg A) (FNeg B)) (FImp B A))"
| D_forall_elim:
    "derivation [] (FImp (FAll v A) (subst_formula A v t))"
| D_forall_intro:
    "v \<notin> free_vars_formula A \<Longrightarrow>
      derivation [] (FImp A (FAll v A))"
| D_forall_imp:
    "derivation []
      (FImp (FAll v (FImp A B)) (FImp (FAll v A) (FAll v B)))"
| D_eq_refl: "derivation [] (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 0))"
| D_eq_sym:
    "derivation []
      (FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1)) (FEq (TVar 1) (TVar 0)))"
| D_eq_trans:
    "derivation []
      (FImp (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
        (FImp (FEq (TVar 1) (TVar 2)) (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 2))))"
| D_less_congruence: "derivation [] less_congruence"
| D_zero_congruence: "derivation [] (FEq TZero TZero)"
| D_succ_congruence: "derivation [] succ_congruence"
| D_add_congruence: "derivation [] add_congruence"
| D_mul_congruence: "derivation [] mul_congruence"

definition provable ::
    "arith_formula set \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "provable T A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>H. derivation H A \<and> set H \<subseteq> T)"

definition nn1_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn1_axiom = FAll 0 (FNeg (FEq (TSucc (TVar 0)) TZero))"

definition nn2_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn2_axiom =
    FAll 1 (FAll 0
      (FImp (FEq (TSucc (TVar 0)) (TSucc (TVar 1)))
        (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1))))"

definition nn3_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn3_axiom = FAll 0 (FEq (TAdd (TVar 0) TZero) (TVar 0))"

definition nn4_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn4_axiom =
    FAll 1 (FAll 0
      (FEq (TAdd (TVar 0) (TSucc (TVar 1)))
        (TSucc (TAdd (TVar 0) (TVar 1)))))"

definition nn5_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn5_axiom = FAll 0 (FEq (TMul (TVar 0) TZero) TZero)"

definition nn6_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn6_axiom =
    FAll 1 (FAll 0
      (FEq (TMul (TVar 0) (TSucc (TVar 1)))
        (TAdd (TMul (TVar 0) (TVar 1)) (TVar 0))))"

definition nn7_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn7_axiom = FAll 0 (FNeg (FLt (TVar 0) TZero))"

definition nn8_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn8_axiom =
    FAll 1 (FAll 0
      (FImp (FLt (TVar 0) (TSucc (TVar 1)))
        (FOr (FLt (TVar 0) (TVar 1)) (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1)))))"

definition nn9_axiom :: arith_formula where
  "nn9_axiom =
    FAll 1 (FAll 0
      (FOr (FLt (TVar 0) (TVar 1))
        (FOr (FEq (TVar 0) (TVar 1)) (FLt (TVar 1) (TVar 0)))))"

definition NN :: "arith_formula set" where
  "NN =
    {nn1_axiom, nn2_axiom, nn3_axiom, nn4_axiom, nn5_axiom,
      nn6_axiom, nn7_axiom, nn8_axiom, nn9_axiom}"

definition weakly_consistent :: "arith_formula set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "weakly_consistent T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>A v.
      (\<forall>x \<in> free_vars_formula A. v = x) \<longrightarrow>
      provable T (FEx v (FNeg A)) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>n. \<not> provable T (subst_formula A v (numeral n))))"

definition independent ::
    "arith_formula set \<Rightarrow> arith_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "independent T A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<not> provable T A \<and> \<not> provable T (FNeg A))"

definition closed :: "arith_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "closed A \<longleftrightarrow> free_vars_formula A = {}"

theorem goedel_first_incompleteness:
  fixes T :: "arith_formula set"
    and repT :: arith_formula
    and v0 :: nat
  assumes extends_NN: "NN \<subseteq> T"
    and free_var_repT:
      "\<And>v. v \<in> free_vars_formula repT \<Longrightarrow> v = v0"
    and express_T_positive:
      "\<And>A. A \<in> T \<Longrightarrow>
        provable T (subst_formula repT v0 (reflect A))"
    and express_T_negative:
      "\<And>A. A \<notin> T \<Longrightarrow>
        provable T (FNeg (subst_formula repT v0 (reflect A)))"
    and omega_consistency: "weakly_consistent T"
  shows "\<exists>A. independent T A \<and> closed A"
  sorry

end

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
  Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent arithmetic theory extending NN,
  whose axioms are represented within arithmetic, has a closed formula
  independent of the theory. This file contains no proof.
*)

prioritize_num();;
needs "Library/rstc.ml";;
needs "Library/prime.ml";;
needs "Arithmetic/fol.ml";;
needs "Arithmetic/definability.ml";;
needs "Arithmetic/tarski.ml";;

let GOEDEL_FIRST_INCOMPLETENESS =
  `!thy:form->bool repT:form v0:num.
      {!!0 (Not(Suc(V 0) === Z)),
       !!1 (!!0 (Suc(V 0) === Suc(V 1) --> V 0 === V 1)),
       !!0 (V 0 ++ Z === V 0),
       !!1 (!!0 (V 0 ++ Suc(V 1) === Suc(V 0 ++ V 1))),
       !!0 (V 0 ** Z === Z),
       !!1 (!!0 (V 0 ** Suc(V 1) === V 0 ** V 1 ++ V 0)),
       !!0 (Not(V 0 << Z)),
       !!1 (!!0 (V 0 << Suc(V 1) --> (V 0 << V 1 || V 0 === V 1))),
       !!1 (!!0 (V 0 << V 1 || V 0 === V 1 || V 1 << V 0))}
      SUBSET thy /\
      (!v:num. v IN FV repT ==> v = v0) /\
      (!f:form.
         f IN thy
         ==> thy |-- formsubst (v0 |=> numeral (gform f)) repT) /\
      (!f:form.
         ~(f IN thy)
         ==> thy |-- Not(formsubst (v0 |=> numeral (gform f)) repT)) /\
      (!p:form x:num.
         (!y:num. y IN FV p ==> x = y) /\
         thy |-- ??x (Not p)
         ==> ?n:num. ~(thy |-- formsubst (x |=> numeral n) p))
      ==> ?f:form.
            (~(thy |-- f) /\ ~(thy |-- Not f)) /\
            FV f = EMPTY`;;

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact 006,
;; "Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem": an omega-consistent deductive system
;; extending elementary arithmetic and representing its own axiom predicate
;; has an existentially quantified closed sentence independent of the system.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; The arbitrary system T is an actual (possibly infinite) predicate on
;; formulas, not a finite list or a table of preassigned truth values.

(defstub ht006-system-axiom (system formula) t)

(defun ht006-system-axiom-p (system formula)
  (if (ht006-system-axiom system formula) t nil))

;; Terms and formulas for the source language LNN. Variables are natural
;; numbers; terms use 0, successor, addition, and multiplication, and the
;; sole non-equality relation symbol is less-than.

(mutual-recursion
 (defun ht006-term-p (term)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term) (equal term :zero))
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (and (true-listp term)
          (equal (len term) 2)
          (natp (cadr term))))
    ((equal (car term) :succ)
     (and (true-listp term)
          (equal (len term) 2)
          (ht006-term-p (cadr term))))
    ((or (equal (car term) :plus)
         (equal (car term) :times))
     (and (true-listp term)
          (equal (len term) 3)
          (ht006-term-p (cadr term))
          (ht006-term-p (caddr term))))
    (t nil)))

 (defun ht006-formula-p (formula)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) nil)
    ((equal (car formula) :equal)
     (and (true-listp formula)
          (equal (len formula) 3)
          (ht006-term-p (cadr formula))
          (ht006-term-p (caddr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :less)
     (and (true-listp formula)
          (equal (len formula) 3)
          (ht006-term-p (cadr formula))
          (ht006-term-p (caddr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :not)
     (and (true-listp formula)
          (equal (len formula) 2)
          (ht006-formula-p (cadr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (and (true-listp formula)
          (equal (len formula) 3)
          (ht006-formula-p (cadr formula))
          (ht006-formula-p (caddr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (and (true-listp formula)
          (equal (len formula) 3)
          (natp (cadr formula))
          (ht006-formula-p (caddr formula))))
    (t nil))))

(defun ht006-var (variable)
  (list :var (nfix variable)))

(defun ht006-succ (term)
  (list :succ term))

(defun ht006-plus (left right)
  (list :plus left right))

(defun ht006-times (left right)
  (list :times left right))

(defun ht006-equal (left right)
  (list :equal left right))

(defun ht006-less (left right)
  (list :less left right))

(defun ht006-negate (formula)
  (list :not formula))

(defun ht006-implies (antecedent consequent)
  (list :implies antecedent consequent))

(defun ht006-forall (variable formula)
  (list :forall (nfix variable) formula))

(defun ht006-exists (variable formula)
  (ht006-negate
   (ht006-forall variable (ht006-negate formula))))

(defun ht006-or (left right)
  (ht006-implies (ht006-negate left) right))

(mutual-recursion
 (defun ht006-term-free-variable-p (term variable)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term) nil)
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (equal (cadr term) variable))
    ((equal (car term) :succ)
     (ht006-term-free-variable-p (cadr term) variable))
    ((or (equal (car term) :plus)
         (equal (car term) :times))
     (or
      (ht006-term-free-variable-p (cadr term) variable)
      (ht006-term-free-variable-p (caddr term) variable)))
    (t nil)))

 (defun ht006-formula-free-variable-p (formula variable)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) nil)
    ((or (equal (car formula) :equal)
         (equal (car formula) :less))
     (or
      (ht006-term-free-variable-p (cadr formula) variable)
      (ht006-term-free-variable-p (caddr formula) variable)))
    ((equal (car formula) :not)
     (ht006-formula-free-variable-p (cadr formula) variable))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (or
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p (cadr formula) variable)
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p (caddr formula) variable)))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (and
      (not (equal (cadr formula) variable))
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p (caddr formula) variable)))
    (t nil))))

;; The theorem-specific substitutions insert closed numerals. The proof
;; checker also admits arbitrary terms, guarded below by the standard
;; "free for the variable" side condition.

(mutual-recursion
 (defun ht006-substitute-term (term variable replacement)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term) term)
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (if (equal (cadr term) variable) replacement term))
    ((equal (car term) :succ)
     (ht006-succ
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (cadr term) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car term) :plus)
     (ht006-plus
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (cadr term) variable replacement)
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (caddr term) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car term) :times)
     (ht006-times
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (cadr term) variable replacement)
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (caddr term) variable replacement)))
    (t term)))

 (defun ht006-substitute-formula (formula variable replacement)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) formula)
    ((equal (car formula) :equal)
     (ht006-equal
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :less)
     (ht006-less
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (ht006-substitute-term
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :not)
     (ht006-negate
      (ht006-substitute-formula
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (ht006-implies
      (ht006-substitute-formula
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (ht006-substitute-formula
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (if (equal (cadr formula) variable)
         formula
       (ht006-forall
        (cadr formula)
        (ht006-substitute-formula
         (caddr formula) variable replacement))))
    (t formula))))

(defun ht006-free-for-p (formula variable term)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((atom formula) t)
   ((or (equal (car formula) :equal)
        (equal (car formula) :less))
    t)
   ((equal (car formula) :not)
    (ht006-free-for-p (cadr formula) variable term))
   ((equal (car formula) :implies)
    (and
     (ht006-free-for-p (cadr formula) variable term)
     (ht006-free-for-p (caddr formula) variable term)))
   ((equal (car formula) :forall)
    (let ((binder (cadr formula))
          (body (caddr formula)))
      (or
       (equal binder variable)
       (not
        (ht006-formula-free-variable-p
         body variable))
       (and
        (not
         (ht006-term-free-variable-p term binder))
        (ht006-free-for-p body variable term)))))
   (t nil)))

(defun ht006-numeral (number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      :zero
    (ht006-succ (ht006-numeral (- number 1)))))

;; Cantor pairing supplies an unbounded Gödel numbering. The reflection of a
;; formula is the numeral for its code, matching the source construction.

(defun ht006-pair (left right)
  (let* ((left (nfix left))
         (right (nfix right))
         (sum (+ left right)))
    (+ right (floor (* sum (+ sum 1)) 2))))

(mutual-recursion
 (defun ht006-term-code (term)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term) 0)
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (ht006-pair 1 (nfix (cadr term))))
    ((equal (car term) :succ)
     (ht006-pair 2 (ht006-term-code (cadr term))))
    ((equal (car term) :plus)
     (ht006-pair
      3
      (ht006-pair
       (ht006-term-code (cadr term))
       (ht006-term-code (caddr term)))))
    ((equal (car term) :times)
     (ht006-pair
      4
      (ht006-pair
       (ht006-term-code (cadr term))
       (ht006-term-code (caddr term)))))
    (t 0)))

 (defun ht006-formula-code (formula)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) 0)
    ((equal (car formula) :equal)
     (ht006-pair
      1
      (ht006-pair
       (ht006-term-code (cadr formula))
       (ht006-term-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :less)
     (ht006-pair
      2
      (ht006-pair
       (ht006-term-code (cadr formula))
       (ht006-term-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :not)
     (ht006-pair
      3 (ht006-formula-code (cadr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (ht006-pair
      4
      (ht006-pair
       (ht006-formula-code (cadr formula))
       (ht006-formula-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (ht006-pair
      5
      (ht006-pair
       (nfix (cadr formula))
       (ht006-formula-code (caddr formula)))))
    (t 0))))

(defun ht006-reflection-term (formula)
  (ht006-numeral (ht006-formula-code formula)))

;; A concrete Hilbert derivation tree gives the genuine SysPrf relation.
;; Leaves are system axioms or first-order logical/equality axiom instances;
;; modus ponens and generalization are the inference rules.

(defun ht006-proof-conclusion (proof)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count proof)))
  (cond
   ((atom proof) :invalid-proof-conclusion)
   ((and (equal (car proof) :system)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 2))
    (cadr proof))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :prop-1)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
    (ht006-implies
     (cadr proof)
     (ht006-implies (caddr proof) (cadr proof))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :prop-2)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4))
    (let ((a (cadr proof))
          (b (caddr proof))
          (c (cadddr proof)))
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-implies a (ht006-implies b c))
       (ht006-implies
        (ht006-implies a b)
        (ht006-implies a c)))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :prop-3)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
    (let ((a (cadr proof))
          (b (caddr proof)))
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-implies
        (ht006-negate b) (ht006-negate a))
       (ht006-implies a b))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :forall-elim)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4))
    (let ((variable (cadr proof))
          (formula (caddr proof))
          (term (cadddr proof)))
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-forall variable formula)
       (ht006-substitute-formula
        formula variable term))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :forall-distribute)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4))
    (let ((variable (cadr proof))
          (a (caddr proof))
          (b (cadddr proof)))
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-forall variable (ht006-implies a b))
       (ht006-implies a (ht006-forall variable b)))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :equality-reflexive)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 2))
    (ht006-equal (cadr proof) (cadr proof)))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :equality-substitute)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 5))
    (let ((variable (cadr proof))
          (left (caddr proof))
          (right (cadddr proof))
          (formula (car (cddddr proof))))
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-equal left right)
       (ht006-implies
        (ht006-substitute-formula
         formula variable left)
        (ht006-substitute-formula
         formula variable right)))))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :modus-ponens)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
    (let ((implication
           (ht006-proof-conclusion (cadr proof)))
          (antecedent
           (ht006-proof-conclusion (caddr proof))))
      (if (and
           (consp implication)
           (equal (car implication) :implies)
           (equal (cadr implication) antecedent))
          (caddr implication)
        :invalid-proof-conclusion)))
   ((and (equal (car proof) :generalize)
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
    (ht006-forall
     (cadr proof)
     (ht006-proof-conclusion (caddr proof))))
   (t :invalid-proof-conclusion)))

;; This is the finite hypothesis list carried by the source Prf judgment:
;; AXM contributes one hypothesis, MP concatenates the two finite lists,
;; GEN preserves its premise's list, and logical/equality axioms contribute
;; no hypotheses.

(defun ht006-proof-hypotheses (proof)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count proof)))
  (cond
   ((atom proof) nil)
   ((equal (car proof) :system)
    (if (and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 2))
        (list (cadr proof))
      nil))
   ((equal (car proof) :modus-ponens)
    (if (and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
        (append
         (ht006-proof-hypotheses (cadr proof))
         (ht006-proof-hypotheses (caddr proof)))
      nil))
   ((equal (car proof) :generalize)
    (if (and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3))
        (ht006-proof-hypotheses (caddr proof))
      nil))
   (t nil)))

(defun ht006-variable-absent-from-hypotheses-p
    (hypotheses variable)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count hypotheses)))
  (if (atom hypotheses)
      t
    (and
     (not
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p
       (car hypotheses) variable))
     (ht006-variable-absent-from-hypotheses-p
      (cdr hypotheses) variable))))

(defun ht006-proof-valid-p (system proof)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count proof)))
  (cond
   ((atom proof) nil)
   ((equal (car proof) :system)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 2)
     (ht006-formula-p (cadr proof))
     (ht006-system-axiom-p system (cadr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :prop-1)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 3)
     (ht006-formula-p (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (caddr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :prop-2)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 4)
     (ht006-formula-p (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (caddr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (cadddr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :prop-3)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 3)
     (ht006-formula-p (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (caddr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :forall-elim)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 4)
     (natp (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (caddr proof))
     (ht006-term-p (cadddr proof))
     (ht006-free-for-p
      (caddr proof)
      (cadr proof)
      (cadddr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :forall-distribute)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 4)
     (natp (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (caddr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (cadddr proof))
     (not
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p
       (caddr proof) (cadr proof)))))
   ((equal (car proof) :equality-reflexive)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 2)
     (ht006-term-p (cadr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :equality-substitute)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 5)
     (natp (cadr proof))
     (ht006-term-p (caddr proof))
     (ht006-term-p (cadddr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p (car (cddddr proof)))
     (ht006-free-for-p
      (car (cddddr proof))
      (cadr proof)
      (caddr proof))
     (ht006-free-for-p
      (car (cddddr proof))
      (cadr proof)
      (cadddr proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :modus-ponens)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 3)
     (ht006-proof-valid-p system (cadr proof))
     (ht006-proof-valid-p system (caddr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p
      (ht006-proof-conclusion proof))))
   ((equal (car proof) :generalize)
    (and
     (true-listp proof)
     (equal (len proof) 3)
     (natp (cadr proof))
     (ht006-proof-valid-p system (caddr proof))
     (ht006-variable-absent-from-hypotheses-p
      (ht006-proof-hypotheses (caddr proof))
      (cadr proof))
     (ht006-formula-p
      (ht006-proof-conclusion proof))))
   (t nil)))

(defun-sk ht006-sys-prf-p (system formula)
  (exists (proof)
    (and
     (ht006-formula-p formula)
     (ht006-proof-valid-p system proof)
     (equal
      (ht006-proof-conclusion proof)
      formula))))

;; The fixed elementary arithmetic system NN is exactly the source's
;; nine axioms NN1--NN9 in this concrete LNN language.

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-1 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0)))
    (ht006-forall
     0
     (ht006-negate
      (ht006-equal (ht006-succ x) :zero)))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-2 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0))
        (y (ht006-var 1)))
    (ht006-forall
     1
     (ht006-forall
      0
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-equal (ht006-succ x) (ht006-succ y))
       (ht006-equal x y))))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-3 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0)))
    (ht006-forall
     0
     (ht006-equal (ht006-plus x :zero) x))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-4 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0))
        (y (ht006-var 1)))
    (ht006-forall
     1
     (ht006-forall
      0
      (ht006-equal
       (ht006-plus x (ht006-succ y))
       (ht006-succ (ht006-plus x y)))))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-5 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0)))
    (ht006-forall
     0
     (ht006-equal (ht006-times x :zero) :zero))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-6 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0))
        (y (ht006-var 1)))
    (ht006-forall
     1
     (ht006-forall
      0
      (ht006-equal
       (ht006-times x (ht006-succ y))
       (ht006-plus (ht006-times x y) x))))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-7 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0)))
    (ht006-forall
     0
     (ht006-negate
      (ht006-less x :zero)))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-8 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0))
        (y (ht006-var 1)))
    (ht006-forall
     1
     (ht006-forall
      0
      (ht006-implies
       (ht006-less x (ht006-succ y))
       (ht006-or
        (ht006-less x y)
        (ht006-equal x y)))))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-9 ()
  (let ((x (ht006-var 0))
        (y (ht006-var 1)))
    (ht006-forall
     1
     (ht006-forall
      0
      (ht006-or
       (ht006-less x y)
       (ht006-or
        (ht006-equal x y)
        (ht006-less y x)))))))

(defun ht006-nn-axiom-p (formula)
  (or
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-1))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-2))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-3))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-4))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-5))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-6))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-7))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-8))
   (equal formula (ht006-nn-axiom-9))))

(defun-sk ht006-extends-nn-p (system)
  (forall (formula)
    (implies
     (ht006-nn-axiom-p formula)
     (ht006-system-axiom-p system formula))))

(defun-sk ht006-only-designated-free-variable-p
    (formula variable)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp candidate)
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p
       formula candidate))
     (equal candidate variable))))

(defun-sk ht006-closed-formula-p (formula)
  (forall (variable)
    (implies
     (natp variable)
     (not
      (ht006-formula-free-variable-p
       formula variable)))))

;; These are expressT1 and expressT2 with their source-wide quantification.

(defun-sk ht006-positive-representation-p
    (system representing-formula variable)
  (forall (formula)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht006-formula-p formula)
      (ht006-system-axiom-p system formula))
     (ht006-sys-prf-p
      system
      (ht006-substitute-formula
       representing-formula
       variable
       (ht006-reflection-term formula))))))

(defun-sk ht006-negative-representation-p
    (system representing-formula variable)
  (forall (formula)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht006-formula-p formula)
      (not
       (ht006-system-axiom-p system formula)))
     (ht006-sys-prf-p
      system
      (ht006-negate
       (ht006-substitute-formula
        representing-formula
        variable
        (ht006-reflection-term formula)))))))

;; Omega-consistency excludes a one-variable formula whose every numeral
;; instance is derivable while its existential negation is also derivable.

(defun-sk ht006-all-numeral-instances-provable-p
    (system formula variable)
  (forall (number)
    (implies
     (natp number)
     (ht006-sys-prf-p
      system
      (ht006-substitute-formula
       formula variable (ht006-numeral number))))))

(defun ht006-omega-inconsistency-witness-p
    (system formula variable)
  (and
   (ht006-formula-p formula)
   (natp variable)
   (ht006-only-designated-free-variable-p
    formula variable)
   (ht006-all-numeral-instances-provable-p
    system formula variable)
   (ht006-sys-prf-p
    system
    (ht006-exists
     variable
     (ht006-negate formula)))))

(defun-sk ht006-omega-inconsistent-p (system)
  (exists (formula variable)
    (ht006-omega-inconsistency-witness-p
     system formula variable)))

(defun ht006-omega-consistent-p (system)
  (not (ht006-omega-inconsistent-p system)))

(defun ht006-independent-p (system formula)
  (and
   (ht006-formula-p formula)
   (not (ht006-sys-prf-p system formula))
   (not
    (ht006-sys-prf-p
     system (ht006-negate formula)))))

(defun-sk ht006-closed-independent-formula-exists-p (system)
  (exists (formula)
    (and
     (ht006-formula-p formula)
     (ht006-independent-p system formula)
     (ht006-closed-formula-p formula))))

(defun hundred-theorems-006-goedels-incompleteness-statement
    (system representing-formula variable)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht006-formula-p representing-formula)
    (natp variable)
    (ht006-extends-nn-p system)
    (ht006-only-designated-free-variable-p
     representing-formula variable)
    (ht006-positive-representation-p
     system representing-formula variable)
    (ht006-negative-representation-p
     system representing-formula variable)
    (ht006-omega-consistent-p system))
   (ht006-closed-independent-formula-exists-p
    system)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
-- Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending the fixed
-- first-order arithmetic theory NN, whose axioms are represented in that
-- arithmetic, has a closed formula independent of the theory. This file
-- contains no proof.

module GoedelsIncompleteness where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 4 _or_
infixr 5 _and_
infixr 6 _++_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc _) = false
natEqual (suc _) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

natMaximum : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
natMaximum zero n = n
natMaximum m zero = m
natMaximum (suc m) (suc n) = suc (natMaximum m n)

boolOr : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolOr false value = value
boolOr true _ = true

_++_ : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> List A
[] ++ rightList = rightList
(head ∷ tail) ++ rightList = head ∷ (tail ++ rightList)

data Member {A : Set} (value : A) : List A -> Set where
  here  : {tail : List A} -> Member value (value ∷ tail)
  there : {head : A} {tail : List A} ->
    Member value tail ->
    Member value (head ∷ tail)

-- Terms and formulas in the first-order language of arithmetic.
data Term : Set where
  termVariable : Nat -> Term
  termZero      : Term
  termSuccessor : Term -> Term
  termAdd       : Term -> Term -> Term
  termMultiply  : Term -> Term -> Term

data Formula : Set where
  formulaEqual   : Term -> Term -> Formula
  formulaLess    : Term -> Term -> Formula
  formulaImplies : Formula -> Formula -> Formula
  formulaNegate  : Formula -> Formula
  formulaForall  : Nat -> Formula -> Formula

Theory : Set₁
Theory = Formula -> Set

formulaDisjunction : Formula -> Formula -> Formula
formulaDisjunction leftFormula rightFormula =
  formulaImplies (formulaNegate leftFormula) rightFormula

formulaConjunction : Formula -> Formula -> Formula
formulaConjunction leftFormula rightFormula =
  formulaNegate
    (formulaImplies leftFormula (formulaNegate rightFormula))

formulaBiconditional : Formula -> Formula -> Formula
formulaBiconditional leftFormula rightFormula =
  formulaConjunction
    (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula)
    (formulaImplies rightFormula leftFormula)

formulaExists : Nat -> Formula -> Formula
formulaExists index body =
  formulaNegate (formulaForall index (formulaNegate body))

termFreeVariable : Term -> Nat -> Set
termFreeVariable (termVariable index) free = index == free
termFreeVariable termZero free = Bottom
termFreeVariable (termSuccessor term) free =
  termFreeVariable term free
termFreeVariable (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) free =
  termFreeVariable leftTerm free or termFreeVariable rightTerm free
termFreeVariable (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) free =
  termFreeVariable leftTerm free or termFreeVariable rightTerm free

formulaFreeVariable : Formula -> Nat -> Set
formulaFreeVariable (formulaEqual leftTerm rightTerm) free =
  termFreeVariable leftTerm free or termFreeVariable rightTerm free
formulaFreeVariable (formulaLess leftTerm rightTerm) free =
  termFreeVariable leftTerm free or termFreeVariable rightTerm free
formulaFreeVariable (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) free =
  formulaFreeVariable leftFormula free or
  formulaFreeVariable rightFormula free
formulaFreeVariable (formulaNegate body) free =
  formulaFreeVariable body free
formulaFreeVariable (formulaForall bound body) free =
  Not (free == bound) and formulaFreeVariable body free

termHasVariable : Term -> Nat -> Bool
termHasVariable (termVariable index) sought = natEqual index sought
termHasVariable termZero sought = false
termHasVariable (termSuccessor term) sought =
  termHasVariable term sought
termHasVariable (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) sought =
  boolOr
    (termHasVariable leftTerm sought)
    (termHasVariable rightTerm sought)
termHasVariable (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) sought =
  boolOr
    (termHasVariable leftTerm sought)
    (termHasVariable rightTerm sought)

termMaximumVariable : Term -> Nat
termMaximumVariable (termVariable index) = index
termMaximumVariable termZero = zero
termMaximumVariable (termSuccessor term) = termMaximumVariable term
termMaximumVariable (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) =
  natMaximum
    (termMaximumVariable leftTerm)
    (termMaximumVariable rightTerm)
termMaximumVariable (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) =
  natMaximum
    (termMaximumVariable leftTerm)
    (termMaximumVariable rightTerm)

formulaMaximumVariable : Formula -> Nat
formulaMaximumVariable (formulaEqual leftTerm rightTerm) =
  natMaximum
    (termMaximumVariable leftTerm)
    (termMaximumVariable rightTerm)
formulaMaximumVariable (formulaLess leftTerm rightTerm) =
  natMaximum
    (termMaximumVariable leftTerm)
    (termMaximumVariable rightTerm)
formulaMaximumVariable (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) =
  natMaximum
    (formulaMaximumVariable leftFormula)
    (formulaMaximumVariable rightFormula)
formulaMaximumVariable (formulaNegate body) =
  formulaMaximumVariable body
formulaMaximumVariable (formulaForall bound body) =
  natMaximum bound (formulaMaximumVariable body)

termRename : Nat -> Nat -> Term -> Term
termRename old fresh (termVariable index) with natEqual index old
... | true = termVariable fresh
... | false = termVariable index
termRename old fresh termZero = termZero
termRename old fresh (termSuccessor term) =
  termSuccessor (termRename old fresh term)
termRename old fresh (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) =
  termAdd
    (termRename old fresh leftTerm)
    (termRename old fresh rightTerm)
termRename old fresh (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) =
  termMultiply
    (termRename old fresh leftTerm)
    (termRename old fresh rightTerm)

-- Rename occurrences governed by an outer binder, stopping at shadowing
-- quantifiers with the same variable name.
formulaRenameBound : Nat -> Nat -> Formula -> Formula
formulaRenameBound old fresh (formulaEqual leftTerm rightTerm) =
  formulaEqual
    (termRename old fresh leftTerm)
    (termRename old fresh rightTerm)
formulaRenameBound old fresh (formulaLess leftTerm rightTerm) =
  formulaLess
    (termRename old fresh leftTerm)
    (termRename old fresh rightTerm)
formulaRenameBound old fresh
  (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) =
  formulaImplies
    (formulaRenameBound old fresh leftFormula)
    (formulaRenameBound old fresh rightFormula)
formulaRenameBound old fresh (formulaNegate body) =
  formulaNegate (formulaRenameBound old fresh body)
formulaRenameBound old fresh (formulaForall bound body)
  with natEqual bound old
... | true = formulaForall bound body
... | false =
  formulaForall bound (formulaRenameBound old fresh body)

formulaDepth : Formula -> Nat
formulaDepth (formulaEqual _ _) = suc zero
formulaDepth (formulaLess _ _) = suc zero
formulaDepth (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) =
  suc
    (natMaximum
      (formulaDepth leftFormula)
      (formulaDepth rightFormula))
formulaDepth (formulaNegate body) = suc (formulaDepth body)
formulaDepth (formulaForall _ body) = suc (formulaDepth body)

termSubstitute : Term -> Nat -> Term -> Term
termSubstitute (termVariable termIndex) index replacement
  with natEqual termIndex index
... | true = replacement
... | false = termVariable termIndex
termSubstitute termZero index replacement = termZero
termSubstitute (termSuccessor term) index replacement =
  termSuccessor (termSubstitute term index replacement)
termSubstitute (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) index replacement =
  termAdd
    (termSubstitute leftTerm index replacement)
    (termSubstitute rightTerm index replacement)
termSubstitute (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) index replacement =
  termMultiply
    (termSubstitute leftTerm index replacement)
    (termSubstitute rightTerm index replacement)

-- Fuel-bounded capture-avoiding substitution for the fixed syntax.
formulaSubstituteFuel :
  Nat ->
  Formula ->
  Nat ->
  Term ->
  Formula
formulaSubstituteFuel zero formula index replacement = formula
formulaSubstituteFuel (suc fuel)
  (formulaEqual leftTerm rightTerm) index replacement =
  formulaEqual
    (termSubstitute leftTerm index replacement)
    (termSubstitute rightTerm index replacement)
formulaSubstituteFuel (suc fuel)
  (formulaLess leftTerm rightTerm) index replacement =
  formulaLess
    (termSubstitute leftTerm index replacement)
    (termSubstitute rightTerm index replacement)
formulaSubstituteFuel (suc fuel)
  (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) index replacement =
  formulaImplies
    (formulaSubstituteFuel fuel leftFormula index replacement)
    (formulaSubstituteFuel fuel rightFormula index replacement)
formulaSubstituteFuel (suc fuel)
  (formulaNegate body) index replacement =
  formulaNegate
    (formulaSubstituteFuel fuel body index replacement)
formulaSubstituteFuel (suc fuel)
  (formulaForall bound body) index replacement
  with natEqual bound index
... | true = formulaForall bound body
... | false with termHasVariable replacement bound
...   | true =
  let fresh =
        suc
          (natMaximum
            (formulaMaximumVariable body)
            (natMaximum
              (termMaximumVariable replacement)
              (natMaximum index bound)))
  in formulaForall fresh
       (formulaSubstituteFuel fuel
         (formulaRenameBound bound fresh body)
         index
         replacement)
...   | false =
  formulaForall bound
    (formulaSubstituteFuel fuel body index replacement)

formulaSubstitute : Formula -> Nat -> Term -> Formula
formulaSubstitute formula index replacement =
  formulaSubstituteFuel
    (formulaDepth formula)
    formula
    index
    replacement

termNumeral : Nat -> Term
termNumeral zero = termZero
termNumeral (suc n) = termSuccessor (termNumeral n)

natPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
natPower base zero = suc zero
natPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * natPower base exponent

pairCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pairCode leftCode rightCode =
  natPower (suc (suc zero)) leftCode *
  (suc (suc zero) * rightCode + suc zero)

termCode : Term -> Nat
termCode (termVariable index) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) * index
termCode termZero = suc zero
termCode (termSuccessor term) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) * termCode term +
  suc (suc zero)
termCode (termAdd leftTerm rightTerm) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode (termCode leftTerm) (termCode rightTerm) +
  suc (suc (suc zero))
termCode (termMultiply leftTerm rightTerm) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode (termCode leftTerm) (termCode rightTerm) +
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

formulaCode : Formula -> Nat
formulaCode (formulaEqual leftTerm rightTerm) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode (termCode leftTerm) (termCode rightTerm)
formulaCode (formulaLess leftTerm rightTerm) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode (termCode leftTerm) (termCode rightTerm) +
  suc zero
formulaCode (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode (formulaCode leftFormula) (formulaCode rightFormula) +
  suc (suc zero)
formulaCode (formulaNegate body) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) * formulaCode body +
  suc (suc (suc zero))
formulaCode (formulaForall bound body) =
  suc (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))) *
  pairCode bound (formulaCode body) +
  suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))

formulaReflection : Formula -> Term
formulaReflection formula = termNumeral (formulaCode formula)

-- A concrete Hilbert derivation calculus for first-order arithmetic.
data Derivation : List Formula -> Formula -> Set where
  assumption :
    (formula : Formula) ->
    Derivation (formula ∷ []) formula
  modusPonens :
    {leftHypotheses rightHypotheses : List Formula}
    {antecedent consequent : Formula} ->
    Derivation
      leftHypotheses
      (formulaImplies antecedent consequent) ->
    Derivation rightHypotheses antecedent ->
    Derivation
      (leftHypotheses ++ rightHypotheses)
      consequent
  generalize :
    {hypotheses : List Formula}
    {formula : Formula}
    {index : Nat} ->
    ((hypothesis : Formula) ->
      Member hypothesis hypotheses ->
      Not (formulaFreeVariable hypothesis index)) ->
    Derivation hypotheses formula ->
    Derivation hypotheses (formulaForall index formula)
  implicationOne :
    (leftFormula rightFormula : Formula) ->
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies leftFormula
        (formulaImplies rightFormula leftFormula))
  implicationTwo :
    (leftFormula middleFormula rightFormula : Formula) ->
    Derivation []
