      (formulaImplies
        (formulaImplies leftFormula
          (formulaImplies middleFormula rightFormula))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaImplies leftFormula middleFormula)
          (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula)))
  contraposition :
    (leftFormula rightFormula : Formula) ->
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaNegate leftFormula)
          (formulaNegate rightFormula))
        (formulaImplies rightFormula leftFormula))
  forallElimination :
    (formula : Formula) ->
    (index : Nat) ->
    (term : Term) ->
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaForall index formula)
        (formulaSubstitute formula index term))
  forallIntroduction :
    (formula : Formula) ->
    (index : Nat) ->
    Not (formulaFreeVariable formula index) ->
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies formula (formulaForall index formula))
  forallImplication :
    (leftFormula rightFormula : Formula) ->
    (index : Nat) ->
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaForall index
          (formulaImplies leftFormula rightFormula))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaForall index leftFormula)
          (formulaForall index rightFormula)))
  equalityReflexive :
    Derivation []
      (formulaEqual (termVariable zero) (termVariable zero))
  equalitySymmetric :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable (suc zero))
          (termVariable zero)))
  equalityTransitive :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable (suc zero))
            (termVariable (suc (suc zero))))
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc (suc zero))))))
  lessCongruence :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable (suc (suc zero)))
            (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero)))))
          (formulaBiconditional
            (formulaLess
              (termVariable zero)
              (termVariable (suc (suc zero))))
            (formulaLess
              (termVariable (suc zero))
              (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero))))))))
  successorCongruence :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaEqual
          (termSuccessor (termVariable zero))
          (termSuccessor (termVariable (suc zero)))))
  additionCongruence :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable (suc (suc zero)))
            (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero)))))
          (formulaEqual
            (termAdd
              (termVariable zero)
              (termVariable (suc (suc zero))))
            (termAdd
              (termVariable (suc zero))
              (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero))))))))
  multiplicationCongruence :
    Derivation []
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaImplies
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable (suc (suc zero)))
            (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero)))))
          (formulaEqual
            (termMultiply
              (termVariable zero)
              (termVariable (suc (suc zero))))
            (termMultiply
              (termVariable (suc zero))
              (termVariable (suc (suc (suc zero))))))))

Provable : Theory -> Formula -> Set
Provable theory formula =
  Exists (List Formula)
    (\ hypotheses ->
      Derivation hypotheses formula and
      ((hypothesis : Formula) ->
        Member hypothesis hypotheses ->
        theory hypothesis))

Independent : Theory -> Formula -> Set
Independent theory formula =
  Not (Provable theory formula) and
  Not (Provable theory (formulaNegate formula))

Closed : Formula -> Set
Closed formula =
  (index : Nat) -> Not (formulaFreeVariable formula index)

-- The source's omega-consistency condition: if the theory proves an
-- existential counterexample to a one-variable formula, some numeral
-- instance of that formula is unprovable.
WeaklyConsistent : Theory -> Set
WeaklyConsistent theory =
  (formula : Formula) ->
  (index : Nat) ->
  ((free : Nat) ->
    formulaFreeVariable formula free ->
    index == free) ->
  Provable theory
    (formulaExists index (formulaNegate formula)) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ number ->
      Not
        (Provable theory
          (formulaSubstitute
            formula
            index
            (termNumeral number))))

nn1 : Formula
nn1 =
  formulaForall zero
    (formulaNegate
      (formulaEqual
        (termSuccessor (termVariable zero))
        termZero))

nn2 : Formula
nn2 =
  formulaForall (suc zero)
    (formulaForall zero
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaEqual
          (termSuccessor (termVariable zero))
          (termSuccessor (termVariable (suc zero))))
        (formulaEqual
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))))

nn3 : Formula
nn3 =
  formulaForall zero
    (formulaEqual
      (termAdd (termVariable zero) termZero)
      (termVariable zero))

nn4 : Formula
nn4 =
  formulaForall (suc zero)
    (formulaForall zero
      (formulaEqual
        (termAdd
          (termVariable zero)
          (termSuccessor (termVariable (suc zero))))
        (termSuccessor
          (termAdd
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc zero))))))

nn5 : Formula
nn5 =
  formulaForall zero
    (formulaEqual
      (termMultiply (termVariable zero) termZero)
      termZero)

nn6 : Formula
nn6 =
  formulaForall (suc zero)
    (formulaForall zero
      (formulaEqual
        (termMultiply
          (termVariable zero)
          (termSuccessor (termVariable (suc zero))))
        (termAdd
          (termMultiply
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc zero)))
          (termVariable zero))))

nn7 : Formula
nn7 =
  formulaForall zero
    (formulaNegate
      (formulaLess (termVariable zero) termZero))

nn8 : Formula
nn8 =
  formulaForall (suc zero)
    (formulaForall zero
      (formulaImplies
        (formulaLess
          (termVariable zero)
          (termSuccessor (termVariable (suc zero))))
        (formulaDisjunction
          (formulaLess
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc zero)))
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc zero))))))

nn9 : Formula
nn9 =
  formulaForall (suc zero)
    (formulaForall zero
      (formulaDisjunction
        (formulaLess
          (termVariable zero)
          (termVariable (suc zero)))
        (formulaDisjunction
          (formulaEqual
            (termVariable zero)
            (termVariable (suc zero)))
          (formulaLess
            (termVariable (suc zero))
            (termVariable zero)))))

-- The fixed nine-axiom arithmetic theory NN used by the source.
NN : Theory
NN formula =
  (formula == nn1) or
  ((formula == nn2) or
  ((formula == nn3) or
  ((formula == nn4) or
  ((formula == nn5) or
  ((formula == nn6) or
  ((formula == nn7) or
  ((formula == nn8) or
   (formula == nn9))))))))

Extends : Theory -> Theory -> Set
Extends smaller larger =
  (formula : Formula) -> smaller formula -> larger formula

goedels-first-incompleteness-theorem : Set₁
goedels-first-incompleteness-theorem =
  (theory : Theory) ->
  Extends NN theory ->
  (representsTheory : Formula) ->
  (codeVariable : Nat) ->
  ((other : Nat) ->
    formulaFreeVariable representsTheory other ->
    other == codeVariable) ->
  ((formula : Formula) ->
    theory formula ->
    Provable theory
      (formulaSubstitute
        representsTheory
        codeVariable
        (formulaReflection formula))) ->
  ((formula : Formula) ->
    Not (theory formula) ->
    Provable theory
      (formulaNegate
        (formulaSubstitute
          representsTheory
          codeVariable
          (formulaReflection formula)))) ->
  WeaklyConsistent theory ->
  Exists Formula
    (\ formula ->
      Independent theory formula and Closed formula)

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006,
  "Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending
  the concrete arithmetic theory NN, with axiom membership represented by
  a formula whose only possible free variable is v0, has a closed formula
  independent of the theory. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory listTheory;

val _ = Datatype `
  gterm =
      GVar num
    | GZero
    | GSucc gterm
    | GAdd gterm gterm
    | GMul gterm gterm
`;

val _ = Datatype `
  gformula =
      GEq gterm gterm
    | GLt gterm gterm
    | GImp gformula gformula
    | GNeg gformula
    | GAll num gformula
`;

val g_or_def = Define `
  g_or A B = GImp (GNeg A) B
`;

val g_and_def = Define `
  g_and A B = GNeg (GImp A (GNeg B))
`;

val g_iff_def = Define `
  g_iff A B = g_and (GImp A B) (GImp B A)
`;

val g_ex_def = Define `
  g_ex v A = GNeg (GAll v (GNeg A))
`;

val g_free_vars_term_def = Define `
  (g_free_vars_term (GVar v) = {v}) /\
  (g_free_vars_term GZero = EMPTY) /\
  (g_free_vars_term (GSucc t) = g_free_vars_term t) /\
  (g_free_vars_term (GAdd s t) =
    g_free_vars_term s UNION g_free_vars_term t) /\
  (g_free_vars_term (GMul s t) =
    g_free_vars_term s UNION g_free_vars_term t)
`;

val g_free_vars_formula_def = Define `
  (g_free_vars_formula (GEq s t) =
    g_free_vars_term s UNION g_free_vars_term t) /\
  (g_free_vars_formula (GLt s t) =
    g_free_vars_term s UNION g_free_vars_term t) /\
  (g_free_vars_formula (GImp A B) =
    g_free_vars_formula A UNION g_free_vars_formula B) /\
  (g_free_vars_formula (GNeg A) = g_free_vars_formula A) /\
  (g_free_vars_formula (GAll v A) = g_free_vars_formula A DELETE v)
`;

val g_max_var_term_def = Define `
  (g_max_var_term (GVar v) = v) /\
  (g_max_var_term GZero = 0) /\
  (g_max_var_term (GSucc t) = g_max_var_term t) /\
  (g_max_var_term (GAdd s t) =
    MAX (g_max_var_term s) (g_max_var_term t)) /\
  (g_max_var_term (GMul s t) =
    MAX (g_max_var_term s) (g_max_var_term t))
`;

val g_max_var_formula_def = Define `
  (g_max_var_formula (GEq s t) =
    MAX (g_max_var_term s) (g_max_var_term t)) /\
  (g_max_var_formula (GLt s t) =
    MAX (g_max_var_term s) (g_max_var_term t)) /\
  (g_max_var_formula (GImp A B) =
    MAX (g_max_var_formula A) (g_max_var_formula B)) /\
  (g_max_var_formula (GNeg A) = g_max_var_formula A) /\
  (g_max_var_formula (GAll v A) = MAX v (g_max_var_formula A))
`;

val g_rename_term_def = Define `
  (g_rename_term x y (GVar v) = GVar (if v = x then y else v)) /\
  (g_rename_term x y GZero = GZero) /\
  (g_rename_term x y (GSucc t) = GSucc (g_rename_term x y t)) /\
  (g_rename_term x y (GAdd s t) =
    GAdd (g_rename_term x y s) (g_rename_term x y t)) /\
  (g_rename_term x y (GMul s t) =
    GMul (g_rename_term x y s) (g_rename_term x y t))
`;

val g_rename_bound_def = Define `
  (g_rename_bound x y (GEq s t) =
    GEq (g_rename_term x y s) (g_rename_term x y t)) /\
  (g_rename_bound x y (GLt s t) =
    GLt (g_rename_term x y s) (g_rename_term x y t)) /\
  (g_rename_bound x y (GImp A B) =
    GImp (g_rename_bound x y A) (g_rename_bound x y B)) /\
  (g_rename_bound x y (GNeg A) = GNeg (g_rename_bound x y A)) /\
  (g_rename_bound x y (GAll v A) =
    if v = x then GAll v A else GAll v (g_rename_bound x y A))
`;

val g_formula_depth_def = Define `
  (g_formula_depth (GEq s t) = 1) /\
  (g_formula_depth (GLt s t) = 1) /\
  (g_formula_depth (GImp A B) =
    SUC (MAX (g_formula_depth A) (g_formula_depth B))) /\
  (g_formula_depth (GNeg A) = SUC (g_formula_depth A)) /\
  (g_formula_depth (GAll v A) = SUC (g_formula_depth A))
`;

val g_subst_term_def = Define `
  (g_subst_term (GVar v) x s = if v = x then s else GVar v) /\
  (g_subst_term GZero x s = GZero) /\
  (g_subst_term (GSucc t) x s = GSucc (g_subst_term t x s)) /\
  (g_subst_term (GAdd t u) x s =
    GAdd (g_subst_term t x s) (g_subst_term u x s)) /\
  (g_subst_term (GMul t u) x s =
    GMul (g_subst_term t x s) (g_subst_term u x s))
`;

val g_subst_formula_fuel_def = Define `
  (g_subst_formula_fuel 0 A x s = A) /\
  (g_subst_formula_fuel (SUC n) (GEq t u) x s =
    GEq (g_subst_term t x s) (g_subst_term u x s)) /\
  (g_subst_formula_fuel (SUC n) (GLt t u) x s =
    GLt (g_subst_term t x s) (g_subst_term u x s)) /\
  (g_subst_formula_fuel (SUC n) (GImp A B) x s =
    GImp (g_subst_formula_fuel n A x s)
         (g_subst_formula_fuel n B x s)) /\
  (g_subst_formula_fuel (SUC n) (GNeg A) x s =
    GNeg (g_subst_formula_fuel n A x s)) /\
  (g_subst_formula_fuel (SUC n) (GAll v A) x s =
    if v = x then GAll v A
    else if v IN g_free_vars_term s then
      let fresh =
        SUC (MAX (g_max_var_formula A)
                 (MAX (g_max_var_term s) (MAX x v)))
      in
        GAll fresh
          (g_subst_formula_fuel n (g_rename_bound v fresh A) x s)
    else
      GAll v (g_subst_formula_fuel n A x s))
`;

val g_subst_formula_def = Define `
  g_subst_formula A x s =
    g_subst_formula_fuel (g_formula_depth A) A x s
`;

val g_numeral_def = Define `
  (g_numeral 0 = GZero) /\
  (g_numeral (SUC n) = GSucc (g_numeral n))
`;

val g_pair_code_def = Define `
  g_pair_code a b = 2 ** a * (2 * b + 1)
`;

val g_code_term_def = Define `
  (g_code_term (GVar v) = 5 * v) /\
  (g_code_term GZero = 1) /\
  (g_code_term (GSucc t) = 5 * g_code_term t + 2) /\
  (g_code_term (GAdd s t) =
    5 * g_pair_code (g_code_term s) (g_code_term t) + 3) /\
  (g_code_term (GMul s t) =
    5 * g_pair_code (g_code_term s) (g_code_term t) + 4)
`;

val g_code_formula_def = Define `
  (g_code_formula (GEq s t) =
    5 * g_pair_code (g_code_term s) (g_code_term t)) /\
  (g_code_formula (GLt s t) =
    5 * g_pair_code (g_code_term s) (g_code_term t) + 1) /\
  (g_code_formula (GImp A B) =
    5 * g_pair_code (g_code_formula A) (g_code_formula B) + 2) /\
  (g_code_formula (GNeg A) = 5 * g_code_formula A + 3) /\
  (g_code_formula (GAll v A) =
    5 * g_pair_code v (g_code_formula A) + 4)
`;

val g_reflect_def = Define `
  g_reflect A = g_numeral (g_code_formula A)
`;

val g_free_vars_context_def = Define `
  (g_free_vars_context [] = EMPTY) /\
  (g_free_vars_context (A::H) =
    g_free_vars_formula A UNION g_free_vars_context H)
`;

val g_less_congruence_def = Define `
  g_less_congruence =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
      (GImp (GEq (GVar 2) (GVar 3))
        (g_iff (GLt (GVar 0) (GVar 2))
               (GLt (GVar 1) (GVar 3))))
`;

val g_succ_congruence_def = Define `
  g_succ_congruence =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
      (GEq (GSucc (GVar 0)) (GSucc (GVar 1)))
`;

val g_add_congruence_def = Define `
  g_add_congruence =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
      (GImp (GEq (GVar 2) (GVar 3))
        (GEq (GAdd (GVar 0) (GVar 2))
             (GAdd (GVar 1) (GVar 3))))
`;

val g_mul_congruence_def = Define `
  g_mul_congruence =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
      (GImp (GEq (GVar 2) (GVar 3))
        (GEq (GMul (GVar 0) (GVar 2))
             (GMul (GVar 1) (GVar 3))))
`;

val _ = Datatype `
  gderivation =
      GDAxiom gformula
    | GDModusPonens gformula gformula gderivation gderivation
    | GDGeneralization num gderivation
    | GDImp1 gformula gformula
    | GDImp2 gformula gformula gformula
    | GDContraposition gformula gformula
    | GDForallElim num gformula gterm
    | GDForallIntro num gformula
    | GDForallImp num gformula gformula
    | GDEqRefl
    | GDEqSym
    | GDEqTrans
    | GDLessCongruence
    | GDZeroCongruence
    | GDSuccCongruence
    | GDAddCongruence
    | GDMulCongruence
`;

val g_derivation_context_def = Define `
  (g_derivation_context (GDAxiom A) = [A]) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDModusPonens A B d1 d2) =
    g_derivation_context d1 ++ g_derivation_context d2) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDGeneralization v d) =
    g_derivation_context d) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDImp1 A B) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDImp2 A B C) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDContraposition A B) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDForallElim v A t) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDForallIntro v A) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context (GDForallImp v A B) = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDEqRefl = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDEqSym = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDEqTrans = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDLessCongruence = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDZeroCongruence = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDSuccCongruence = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDAddCongruence = []) /\
  (g_derivation_context GDMulCongruence = [])
`;

val g_derivation_conclusion_def = Define `
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDAxiom A) = A) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDModusPonens A B d1 d2) = B) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDGeneralization v d) =
    GAll v (g_derivation_conclusion d)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDImp1 A B) = GImp A (GImp B A)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDImp2 A B C) =
    GImp (GImp A (GImp B C)) (GImp (GImp A B) (GImp A C))) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDContraposition A B) =
    GImp (GImp (GNeg A) (GNeg B)) (GImp B A)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDForallElim v A t) =
    GImp (GAll v A) (g_subst_formula A v t)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDForallIntro v A) =
    GImp A (GAll v A)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion (GDForallImp v A B) =
    GImp (GAll v (GImp A B)) (GImp (GAll v A) (GAll v B))) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDEqRefl = GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 0)) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDEqSym =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1)) (GEq (GVar 1) (GVar 0))) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDEqTrans =
    GImp (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
      (GImp (GEq (GVar 1) (GVar 2)) (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 2)))) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDLessCongruence = g_less_congruence) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDZeroCongruence = GEq GZero GZero) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDSuccCongruence = g_succ_congruence) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDAddCongruence = g_add_congruence) /\
  (g_derivation_conclusion GDMulCongruence = g_mul_congruence)
`;

val g_valid_derivation_def = Define `
  (g_valid_derivation (GDAxiom A) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDModusPonens A B d1 d2) =
    (g_valid_derivation d1 /\
     g_valid_derivation d2 /\
     (g_derivation_conclusion d1 = GImp A B) /\
     (g_derivation_conclusion d2 = A))) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDGeneralization v d) =
    (g_valid_derivation d /\
     v NOTIN g_free_vars_context (g_derivation_context d))) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDImp1 A B) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDImp2 A B C) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDContraposition A B) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDForallElim v A t) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDForallIntro v A) =
    (v NOTIN g_free_vars_formula A)) /\
  (g_valid_derivation (GDForallImp v A B) = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDEqRefl = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDEqSym = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDEqTrans = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDLessCongruence = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDZeroCongruence = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDSuccCongruence = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDAddCongruence = T) /\
  (g_valid_derivation GDMulCongruence = T)
`;

val g_provable_def = Define `
  g_provable thy A <=>
    ?d. g_valid_derivation d /\
        g_derivation_conclusion d = A /\
        EVERY thy (g_derivation_context d)
`;

val g_nn1_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn1_axiom = GAll 0 (GNeg (GEq (GSucc (GVar 0)) GZero))
`;

val g_nn2_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn2_axiom =
    GAll 1 (GAll 0
      (GImp (GEq (GSucc (GVar 0)) (GSucc (GVar 1)))
            (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))))
`;

val g_nn3_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn3_axiom = GAll 0 (GEq (GAdd (GVar 0) GZero) (GVar 0))
`;

val g_nn4_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn4_axiom =
    GAll 1 (GAll 0
      (GEq (GAdd (GVar 0) (GSucc (GVar 1)))
           (GSucc (GAdd (GVar 0) (GVar 1)))))
`;

val g_nn5_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn5_axiom = GAll 0 (GEq (GMul (GVar 0) GZero) GZero)
`;

val g_nn6_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn6_axiom =
    GAll 1 (GAll 0
      (GEq (GMul (GVar 0) (GSucc (GVar 1)))
           (GAdd (GMul (GVar 0) (GVar 1)) (GVar 0))))
`;

val g_nn7_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn7_axiom = GAll 0 (GNeg (GLt (GVar 0) GZero))
`;

val g_nn8_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn8_axiom =
    GAll 1 (GAll 0
      (GImp (GLt (GVar 0) (GSucc (GVar 1)))
        (g_or (GLt (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
              (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1)))))
`;

val g_nn9_axiom_def = Define `
  g_nn9_axiom =
    GAll 1 (GAll 0
      (g_or (GLt (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
        (g_or (GEq (GVar 0) (GVar 1))
              (GLt (GVar 1) (GVar 0)))))
`;

val g_NN_def = Define `
  g_NN =
    {g_nn1_axiom; g_nn2_axiom; g_nn3_axiom; g_nn4_axiom;
     g_nn5_axiom; g_nn6_axiom; g_nn7_axiom; g_nn8_axiom;
     g_nn9_axiom}
`;

val g_weakly_consistent_def = Define `
  g_weakly_consistent thy <=>
    !A v.
      (!x. x IN g_free_vars_formula A ==> v = x) ==>
      g_provable thy (g_ex v (GNeg A)) ==>
      ?n. ~g_provable thy (g_subst_formula A v (g_numeral n))
`;

val g_independent_def = Define `
  g_independent thy A <=>
    ~g_provable thy A /\ ~g_provable thy (GNeg A)
`;

val g_closed_def = Define `
  g_closed A <=> g_free_vars_formula A = EMPTY
`;

val goedel_first_incompleteness =
  ``!(thy : gformula -> bool) repT v0.
      g_NN SUBSET thy /\
      (!v. v IN g_free_vars_formula repT ==> v = v0) /\
      (!A. A IN thy ==>
        g_provable thy (g_subst_formula repT v0 (g_reflect A))) /\
      (!A. ~(A IN thy) ==>
        g_provable thy (GNeg (g_subst_formula repT v0 (g_reflect A)))) /\
      g_weakly_consistent thy
      ==>
      ?A. g_independent thy A /\ g_closed A``;

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
  Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending the concrete
  nine-axiom arithmetic theory NN, with representable axiom membership, has a
  closed formula independent of the theory. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Arithmetic terms and formulas are concrete tagged finite trees.  The least
  constructor-closed sets below give their syntax.  All subsequent operations
  are defined constructor by constructor.
$)

$c HT006Var HT006Zero HT006Succ HT006Add HT006Mul $.
$c HT006Eq HT006Lt HT006Imp HT006Neg HT006All $.
$c HT006Or HT006And HT006Iff HT006Ex HT006Terms HT006Formulas $.

ht006-var-syn $a class ( HT006Var A ) $.
ht006-zero-syn $a class HT006Zero $.
ht006-succ-syn $a class ( HT006Succ A ) $.
ht006-add-syn $a class ( HT006Add A B ) $.
ht006-mul-syn $a class ( HT006Mul A B ) $.
ht006-eq-syn $a class ( HT006Eq A B ) $.
ht006-lt-syn $a class ( HT006Lt A B ) $.
ht006-imp-syn $a class ( HT006Imp A B ) $.
ht006-neg-syn $a class ( HT006Neg A ) $.
ht006-all-syn $a class ( HT006All A B ) $.
ht006-or-syn $a class ( HT006Or A B ) $.
ht006-and-syn $a class ( HT006And A B ) $.
ht006-iff-syn $a class ( HT006Iff A B ) $.
ht006-ex-syn $a class ( HT006Ex A B ) $.
ht006-terms-syn $a class HT006Terms $.
ht006-formulas-syn $a class HT006Formulas $.

ht006-var-def $a |- ( HT006Var A ) = <. 0 , A >. $.
ht006-zero-def $a |- HT006Zero = <. 1 , 0 >. $.
ht006-succ-def $a |- ( HT006Succ A ) = <. 2 , A >. $.
ht006-add-def $a |- ( HT006Add A B ) = <. 3 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-mul-def $a |- ( HT006Mul A B ) = <. 4 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-eq-def $a |- ( HT006Eq A B ) = <. 5 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-lt-def $a |- ( HT006Lt A B ) = <. 6 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-imp-def $a |- ( HT006Imp A B ) = <. 7 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-neg-def $a |- ( HT006Neg A ) = <. 8 , A >. $.
ht006-all-def $a |- ( HT006All A B ) = <. 9 , <. A , B >. >. $.
ht006-or-def $a
  |- ( HT006Or A B ) = ( HT006Imp ( HT006Neg A ) B ) $.
ht006-and-def $a
  |- ( HT006And A B ) = ( HT006Neg ( HT006Imp A ( HT006Neg B ) ) ) $.
ht006-iff-def $a
  |- ( HT006Iff A B ) =
     ( HT006And ( HT006Imp A B ) ( HT006Imp B A ) ) $.
ht006-ex-def $a
  |- ( HT006Ex A B ) = ( HT006Neg ( HT006All A ( HT006Neg B ) ) ) $.

ht006-terms-def $a |- HT006Terms =
  |^| { x |
    (
      ( A. n e. NN0 ( HT006Var n ) e. x /\ HT006Zero e. x )
      /\
      (
        ( A. s e. x ( HT006Succ s ) e. x
          /\ A. s e. x A. u e. x ( HT006Add s u ) e. x )
        /\
        A. s e. x A. u e. x ( HT006Mul s u ) e. x
      )
    )
  } $.

ht006-formulas-def $a |- HT006Formulas =
  |^| { x |
    (
      A. s e. HT006Terms A. u e. HT006Terms
        ( ( HT006Eq s u ) e. x /\ ( HT006Lt s u ) e. x )
      /\
      (
        ( A. a e. x A. b e. x ( HT006Imp a b ) e. x
          /\ A. a e. x ( HT006Neg a ) e. x )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0 A. a e. x ( HT006All n a ) e. x
      )

      ->
      (
        ( HT006Provable A ( HT006Ex n ( HT006Neg a ) ) )
        ->
        E. k e. NN0
          -. ( HT006Provable
                A ( HT006SubstFormula a n ( HT006Numeral k ) ) )
      )
    )
) $.
ht006-ind-def $a |- (
  HT006Independent A B
  <->
  ( -. ( HT006Provable A B )
    /\ -. ( HT006Provable A ( HT006Neg B ) ) )
) $.
ht006-closed-def $a |- (
  HT006Closed A <-> ( HT006FVFormula A ) = (/)
) $.

$(
  In the final scope t is the arbitrary source system T, r is repT, and v is
  v0.  The existential independent closed formula remains internal.
$)

${
  ht006-system-type $e |- t C_ HT006Formulas $.
  ht006-representer-type $e |- r e. HT006Formulas $.
  ht006-variable-type $e |- v e. NN0 $.
  ht006-extends-nn $e |- HT006NN C_ t $.
  ht006-representer-fv $e
    |- A. n e. ( HT006FVFormula r ) n = v $.
  ht006-rep-positive $e |- (
    A. a e. HT006Formulas
      ( a e. t ->
        ( HT006Provable t
          ( HT006SubstFormula r v ( HT006Reflect a ) ) ) )
  ) $.
  ht006-rep-negative $e |- (
    A. a e. HT006Formulas
      ( -. a e. t ->
        ( HT006Provable t
          ( HT006Neg
            ( HT006SubstFormula r v ( HT006Reflect a ) ) ) ) )
  ) $.
  hundred-theorems-006-goedel-first-incompleteness $a |- (
    ( HT006WeaklyConsistent t )
    ->
    E. a e. HT006Formulas
      ( ( HT006Independent t a ) /\ ( HT006Closed a ) )
  ) $.
$}

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
:: Incompleteness Theorem": every weakly consistent theory extending the fixed
:: Robinson arithmetic theory NN, whose axioms and non-axioms are represented
:: in that theory, has a closed independent sentence. This file contains no
:: proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, MCART_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1,
    FINSUB_1, NEWTON, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, CARD_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, MULTOP_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, MCART_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSET_1, NEWTON, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    MULTOP_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1,
    NEWTON, SUPINF_2, MULTOP_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1, POWER, REAL_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0,
    XXREAL_0;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM, REAL;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Term,Formula being non empty set,
      TVar being Function of NAT,Term,
      TZero being Element of Term,
      TSucc being Function of Term,Term,
      TAdd,TMul being Function of [:Term,Term:],Term,
      FEq,FLt being Function of [:Term,Term:],Formula,
      FImp being Function of [:Formula,Formula:],Formula,
      FNeg being Function of Formula,Formula,
      FAll being Function of [:NAT,Formula:],Formula,
      termRank being Function of Term,NAT,
      formulaRank being Function of Formula,NAT,
      freeVarsTerm,allVarsTerm being Function of Term,bool NAT,
      freeVarsFormula,allVarsFormula being Function of Formula,bool NAT,
      renameTerm being Function of [:NAT,NAT,Term:],Term,
      renameBound being Function of [:NAT,NAT,Formula:],Formula,
      substTerm being Function of [:Term,NAT,Term:],Term,
      substFormula being Function of [:Formula,NAT,Term:],Formula,
      setMax being Function of bool NAT,NAT,
      next being Function of NAT,NAT,
      numeral being Function of NAT,Term,
      pairCode being Function of [:NAT,NAT:],NAT,
      twice,fivefold,addFour being Function of NAT,NAT,
      codeTerm being Function of Term,NAT,
      codeFormula being Function of Formula,NAT,
      reflection being Function of Formula,Term,
      freeVarsContext being Function of Formula*,bool NAT,
      append being Function of [:Formula*,Formula*:],Formula*,
      lessCong,succCong,addCong,mulCong being Element of Formula,
      derivation being Relation of Formula*,Formula,
      provable being Relation of bool Formula,Formula,
      nn1,nn2,nn3,nn4,nn5,nn6,nn7,nn8,nn9 being Element of Formula
  st
    Term = rng TVar \/ {TZero} \/ rng TSucc \/ rng TAdd \/ rng TMul &
    (for v being Nat holds termRank.(TVar.v) = 0) &
    termRank.TZero = 0 &
    (for t being Element of Term holds
      termRank.(TSucc.t) = termRank.t + 1) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      termRank.(TAdd.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1 &
      termRank.(TMul.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1) &
    Formula = rng FEq \/ rng FLt \/ rng FImp \/ rng FNeg \/ rng FAll &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      formulaRank.(FEq.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1 &
      formulaRank.(FLt.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula holds
      formulaRank.(FImp.(A,B)) = formulaRank.A + formulaRank.B + 1) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      formulaRank.(FNeg.A) = formulaRank.A + 1) &
    (for v being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      formulaRank.(FAll.(v,A)) = formulaRank.A + 1) &

    (for v being Nat holds
      freeVarsTerm.(TVar.v) = {v} &
      allVarsTerm.(TVar.v) = {v}) &
    freeVarsTerm.TZero = {} & allVarsTerm.TZero = {} &
    (for t being Element of Term holds
      freeVarsTerm.(TSucc.t) = freeVarsTerm.t &
      allVarsTerm.(TSucc.t) = allVarsTerm.t) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      freeVarsTerm.(TAdd.(s,t)) = freeVarsTerm.s \/ freeVarsTerm.t &
      freeVarsTerm.(TMul.(s,t)) = freeVarsTerm.s \/ freeVarsTerm.t &
      allVarsTerm.(TAdd.(s,t)) = allVarsTerm.s \/ allVarsTerm.t &
      allVarsTerm.(TMul.(s,t)) = allVarsTerm.s \/ allVarsTerm.t) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      freeVarsFormula.(FEq.(s,t)) =
        freeVarsTerm.s \/ freeVarsTerm.t &
      freeVarsFormula.(FLt.(s,t)) =
        freeVarsTerm.s \/ freeVarsTerm.t &
      allVarsFormula.(FEq.(s,t)) =
        allVarsTerm.s \/ allVarsTerm.t &
      allVarsFormula.(FLt.(s,t)) =
        allVarsTerm.s \/ allVarsTerm.t) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula holds
      freeVarsFormula.(FImp.(A,B)) =
        freeVarsFormula.A \/ freeVarsFormula.B &
      allVarsFormula.(FImp.(A,B)) =
        allVarsFormula.A \/ allVarsFormula.B) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      freeVarsFormula.(FNeg.A) = freeVarsFormula.A &
      allVarsFormula.(FNeg.A) = allVarsFormula.A) &
    (for v being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      freeVarsFormula.(FAll.(v,A)) = freeVarsFormula.A \ {v} &
      allVarsFormula.(FAll.(v,A)) = allVarsFormula.A \/ {v}) &

    (for x,y,v being Nat holds
      (v = x implies renameTerm.(x,y,TVar.v) = TVar.y) &
      (v <> x implies renameTerm.(x,y,TVar.v) = TVar.v)) &
    (for x,y being Nat holds renameTerm.(x,y,TZero) = TZero) &
    (for x,y being Nat,t being Element of Term holds
      renameTerm.(x,y,TSucc.t) = TSucc.(renameTerm.(x,y,t))) &
    (for x,y being Nat,s,t being Element of Term holds
      renameTerm.(x,y,TAdd.(s,t)) =
        TAdd.(renameTerm.(x,y,s),renameTerm.(x,y,t)) &
      renameTerm.(x,y,TMul.(s,t)) =
        TMul.(renameTerm.(x,y,s),renameTerm.(x,y,t))) &
    (for x,y being Nat,s,t being Element of Term holds
      renameBound.(x,y,FEq.(s,t)) =
        FEq.(renameTerm.(x,y,s),renameTerm.(x,y,t)) &
      renameBound.(x,y,FLt.(s,t)) =
        FLt.(renameTerm.(x,y,s),renameTerm.(x,y,t))) &
    (for x,y being Nat,A,B being Element of Formula holds
      renameBound.(x,y,FImp.(A,B)) =
        FImp.(renameBound.(x,y,A),renameBound.(x,y,B))) &
    (for x,y being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      renameBound.(x,y,FNeg.A) = FNeg.(renameBound.(x,y,A))) &
    (for x,y,v being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      (v = x implies renameBound.(x,y,FAll.(v,A)) = FAll.(v,A)) &
      (v <> x implies renameBound.(x,y,FAll.(v,A)) =
        FAll.(v,renameBound.(x,y,A)))) &

    (for v,x being Nat,s being Element of Term holds
      (v = x implies substTerm.(TVar.v,x,s) = s) &
      (v <> x implies substTerm.(TVar.v,x,s) = TVar.v)) &
    (for x being Nat,s being Element of Term holds
      substTerm.(TZero,x,s) = TZero) &
    (for x being Nat,s,t being Element of Term holds
      substTerm.(TSucc.t,x,s) = TSucc.(substTerm.(t,x,s))) &
    (for x being Nat,s,t,u being Element of Term holds
      substTerm.(TAdd.(t,u),x,s) =
        TAdd.(substTerm.(t,x,s),substTerm.(u,x,s)) &
      substTerm.(TMul.(t,u),x,s) =
        TMul.(substTerm.(t,x,s),substTerm.(u,x,s))) &
    (for x being Nat,s,t,u being Element of Term holds
      substFormula.(FEq.(t,u),x,s) =
        FEq.(substTerm.(t,x,s),substTerm.(u,x,s)) &
      substFormula.(FLt.(t,u),x,s) =
        FLt.(substTerm.(t,x,s),substTerm.(u,x,s))) &
    (for x being Nat,s being Element of Term,A,B being Element of Formula
      holds substFormula.(FImp.(A,B),x,s) =
        FImp.(substFormula.(A,x,s),substFormula.(B,x,s))) &
    (for x being Nat,s being Element of Term,A being Element of Formula
      holds substFormula.(FNeg.A,x,s) = FNeg.(substFormula.(A,x,s))) &
    (for S being Subset of NAT st S is finite & S <> {} holds
      setMax.S in S &
      (for z being Nat st z in S holds z <= setMax.S)) &
    (for n being Nat holds next.n = n+1) &
    (for x,v being Nat,s being Element of Term,A being Element of Formula
      holds
      (v = x implies substFormula.(FAll.(v,A),x,s) = FAll.(v,A)) &
      (v <> x & v in freeVarsTerm.s implies
        substFormula.(FAll.(v,A),x,s) =
          FAll.(next.(setMax.(
              allVarsFormula.A \/ allVarsTerm.s \/ {x,v})),
            substFormula.(
              renameBound.(
                v,next.(setMax.(
                  allVarsFormula.A \/ allVarsTerm.s \/ {x,v})),A),
              x,s))) &
      (v <> x & not v in freeVarsTerm.s implies
        substFormula.(FAll.(v,A),x,s) =
          FAll.(v,substFormula.(A,x,s)))) &

    numeral.0 = TZero &
    (for n being Nat holds numeral.(n+1) = TSucc.(numeral.n)) &
    (for b being Nat holds pairCode.(0,b) = b+b+1) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      twice.n = n+n & fivefold.n = n+n+n+n+n & addFour.n = n+4) &
    (for a,b being Nat holds
      pairCode.(a+1,b) = twice.(pairCode.(a,b))) &
    (for v being Nat holds codeTerm.(TVar.v) = fivefold.v) &
    codeTerm.TZero = 1 &
    (for t being Element of Term holds
      codeTerm.(TSucc.t) = fivefold.(codeTerm.t)+2) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      codeTerm.(TAdd.(s,t)) =
        fivefold.(pairCode.(codeTerm.s,codeTerm.t))+3 &
      codeTerm.(TMul.(s,t)) =
        fivefold.(pairCode.(codeTerm.s,codeTerm.t))+4) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      codeFormula.(FEq.(s,t)) =
        fivefold.(pairCode.(codeTerm.s,codeTerm.t)) &
      codeFormula.(FLt.(s,t)) =
        fivefold.(pairCode.(codeTerm.s,codeTerm.t))+1) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula holds
      codeFormula.(FImp.(A,B)) =
        fivefold.(pairCode.(codeFormula.A,codeFormula.B))+2) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      codeFormula.(FNeg.A) = fivefold.(codeFormula.A)+3) &
    (for v being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      codeFormula.(FAll.(v,A)) =
        addFour.(fivefold.(pairCode.(v,codeFormula.A)))) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      reflection.A = numeral.(codeFormula.A)) &

    (for H being Element of Formula*,v being Nat holds
      (v in freeVarsContext.H iff
        ex A being Element of Formula st
          A in rng H & v in freeVarsFormula.A)) &
    (for H1,H2 being Element of Formula* holds
      len (append.(H1,H2)) = len H1 + len H2 &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom H1 holds
        (append.(H1,H2)).i = H1.i) &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom H2 holds
        (append.(H1,H2)).(len H1+i) = H2.i)) &

    lessCong =
      FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FImp.(FEq.(TVar.2,TVar.3),
          FNeg.(FImp.(
            FImp.(FLt.(TVar.0,TVar.2),FLt.(TVar.1,TVar.3)),
            FNeg.(FImp.(FLt.(TVar.1,TVar.3),
              FLt.(TVar.0,TVar.2))))))) &
    succCong =
      FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FEq.(TSucc.(TVar.0),TSucc.(TVar.1))) &
    addCong =
      FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FImp.(FEq.(TVar.2,TVar.3),
          FEq.(TAdd.(TVar.0,TVar.2),TAdd.(TVar.1,TVar.3)))) &
    mulCong =
      FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FImp.(FEq.(TVar.2,TVar.3),
          FEq.(TMul.(TVar.0,TVar.2),TMul.(TVar.1,TVar.3)))) &

    (for H being Element of Formula*,A being Element of Formula holds
      ([H,A] in derivation iff
        for R being Relation of Formula*,Formula st
          (for C being Element of Formula holds [<*C*>,C] in R) &
          (for H1,H2 being Element of Formula*,
               C,D being Element of Formula st
            [H1,FImp.(C,D)] in R & [H2,C] in R
            holds [append.(H1,H2),D] in R) &
          (for H1 being Element of Formula*,C being Element of Formula,
               v being Nat st
            not v in freeVarsContext.H1 & [H1,C] in R
            holds [H1,FAll.(v,C)] in R) &
          (for C,D being Element of Formula holds
            [<*>Formula,FImp.(C,FImp.(D,C))] in R) &
          (for C,D,E being Element of Formula holds
            [<*>Formula,
              FImp.(FImp.(C,FImp.(D,E)),
                FImp.(FImp.(C,D),FImp.(C,E)))] in R) &
          (for C,D being Element of Formula holds
            [<*>Formula,
              FImp.(FImp.(FNeg.C,FNeg.D),FImp.(D,C))] in R) &
          (for C being Element of Formula,t being Element of Term,
               v being Nat holds
            [<*>Formula,
              FImp.(FAll.(v,C),substFormula.(C,v,t))] in R) &
          (for C being Element of Formula,v being Nat st
            not v in freeVarsFormula.C
            holds [<*>Formula,FImp.(C,FAll.(v,C))] in R) &
          (for C,D being Element of Formula,v being Nat holds
            [<*>Formula,
              FImp.(FAll.(v,FImp.(C,D)),
                FImp.(FAll.(v,C),FAll.(v,D)))] in R) &
          [<*>Formula,FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.0)] in R &
          [<*>Formula,
            FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.0))] in R &
          [<*>Formula,
            FImp.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
              FImp.(FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.2),FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.2)))] in R &
          [<*>Formula,lessCong] in R &
          [<*>Formula,FEq.(TZero,TZero)] in R &
          [<*>Formula,succCong] in R &
          [<*>Formula,addCong] in R &
          [<*>Formula,mulCong] in R
        holds [H,A] in R)) &
    (for T being Subset of Formula,A being Element of Formula holds
      ([T,A] in provable iff
        ex H being Element of Formula* st
          [H,A] in derivation & rng H c= T)) &

    nn1 = FAll.(0,FNeg.(FEq.(TSucc.(TVar.0),TZero))) &
    nn2 = FAll.(1,FAll.(0,
      FImp.(FEq.(TSucc.(TVar.0),TSucc.(TVar.1)),
        FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1)))) &
    nn3 = FAll.(0,FEq.(TAdd.(TVar.0,TZero),TVar.0)) &
    nn4 = FAll.(1,FAll.(0,
      FEq.(TAdd.(TVar.0,TSucc.(TVar.1)),
        TSucc.(TAdd.(TVar.0,TVar.1))))) &
    nn5 = FAll.(0,FEq.(TMul.(TVar.0,TZero),TZero)) &
    nn6 = FAll.(1,FAll.(0,
      FEq.(TMul.(TVar.0,TSucc.(TVar.1)),
        TAdd.(TMul.(TVar.0,TVar.1),TVar.0)))) &
    nn7 = FAll.(0,FNeg.(FLt.(TVar.0,TZero))) &
    nn8 = FAll.(1,FAll.(0,
      FImp.(FLt.(TVar.0,TSucc.(TVar.1)),
        FImp.(FNeg.(FLt.(TVar.0,TVar.1)),
          FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1))))) &
    nn9 = FAll.(1,FAll.(0,
      FImp.(FNeg.(FLt.(TVar.0,TVar.1)),
        FImp.(FNeg.(FEq.(TVar.0,TVar.1)),FLt.(TVar.1,TVar.0)))))
  holds
    for T being Subset of Formula,
        repT being Element of Formula,v0 being Nat st
      nn1 in T & nn2 in T & nn3 in T & nn4 in T & nn5 in T &
      nn6 in T & nn7 in T & nn8 in T & nn9 in T &
      (for v being Nat st v in freeVarsFormula.repT holds v = v0) &
      (for A being Element of Formula st A in T holds
        [T,substFormula.(repT,v0,reflection.A)] in provable) &
      (for A being Element of Formula st not A in T holds
        [T,FNeg.(substFormula.(repT,v0,reflection.A))] in provable) &
      (for A being Element of Formula,v being Nat st
        (for x being Nat st x in freeVarsFormula.A holds v = x) &
        [T,FNeg.(FAll.(v,FNeg.(FNeg.A)))] in provable
        holds ex n being Nat st
          not [T,substFormula.(A,v,numeral.n)] in provable)
    holds ex A being Element of Formula st
      not [T,A] in provable &
      not [T,FNeg.A] in provable &
      freeVarsFormula.A = {}
proof
end;

title: 006_gödel_s_incompleteness_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 006, "Gödel's
% Incompleteness Theorem": a weakly consistent theory extending the fixed
% arithmetic theory NN, with its axiom membership represented in arithmetic,
% has a closed formula for which neither it nor its negation is provable. This
% file contains no proof.

lnn_term: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  tm_var(variable_index: nat): tm_var?
  tm_zero: tm_zero?
  tm_succ(succ_arg: lnn_term): tm_succ?
  tm_plus(plus_left, plus_right: lnn_term): tm_plus?
  tm_times(times_left, times_right: lnn_term): tm_times?
END lnn_term

lnn_formula: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  IMPORTING lnn_term
  fm_equal(equal_left, equal_right: lnn_term): fm_equal?
  fm_less(less_left, less_right: lnn_term): fm_less?
  fm_implies(implies_left, implies_right: lnn_formula): fm_implies?
  fm_not(not_body: lnn_formula): fm_not?
  fm_forall(forall_variable: nat, forall_body: lnn_formula): fm_forall?
END lnn_formula

goedel_first_incompleteness_006: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING lnn_term, lnn_formula, list_props[lnn_formula],
    list_props[nat]

  formula_set: TYPE = [lnn_formula -> bool]

  free_in_term(variable: nat, t: lnn_term): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES t OF
      tm_var(i): variable = i,
      tm_zero: FALSE,
      tm_succ(arg): free_in_term(variable, arg),
      tm_plus(left, right):
        free_in_term(variable, left)
          OR free_in_term(variable, right),
      tm_times(left, right):
        free_in_term(variable, left)
          OR free_in_term(variable, right)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  free_in_formula(variable: nat, f: lnn_formula): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES f OF
      fm_equal(left, right):
        free_in_term(variable, left)
          OR free_in_term(variable, right),
      fm_less(left, right):
        free_in_term(variable, left)
          OR free_in_term(variable, right),
      fm_implies(left, right):
        free_in_formula(variable, left)
          OR free_in_formula(variable, right),
      fm_not(body): free_in_formula(variable, body),
      fm_forall(binder, body):
        variable /= binder
          AND free_in_formula(variable, body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE f BY <<

  substitute_term(
      t: lnn_term,
      variable: nat,
      replacement: lnn_term): RECURSIVE lnn_term =
    CASES t OF
      tm_var(i):
        IF i = variable THEN replacement ELSE tm_var(i) ENDIF,
      tm_zero: tm_zero,
      tm_succ(arg):
        tm_succ(substitute_term(arg, variable, replacement)),
      tm_plus(left, right):
        tm_plus(
          substitute_term(left, variable, replacement),
          substitute_term(right, variable, replacement)),
      tm_times(left, right):
        tm_times(
          substitute_term(left, variable, replacement),
          substitute_term(right, variable, replacement))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  nat_max(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN right ELSE left ENDIF

  free_bound_term(
      t: lnn_term,
      bound: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES t OF
      tm_var(i):
        IF member(i, bound) THEN 0 ELSE i + 1 ENDIF,
      tm_zero: 0,
      tm_succ(arg): free_bound_term(arg, bound),
      tm_plus(left, right):
        nat_max(
          free_bound_term(left, bound),
          free_bound_term(right, bound)),
      tm_times(left, right):
        nat_max(
          free_bound_term(left, bound),
          free_bound_term(right, bound))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  free_bound_formula(
      f: lnn_formula,
      bound: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES f OF
      fm_equal(left, right):
        nat_max(
          free_bound_term(left, bound),
          free_bound_term(right, bound)),
      fm_less(left, right):
        nat_max(
          free_bound_term(left, bound),
          free_bound_term(right, bound)),
      fm_implies(left, right):
        nat_max(
          free_bound_formula(left, bound),
          free_bound_formula(right, bound)),
      fm_not(body): free_bound_formula(body, bound),
      fm_forall(binder, body):
        free_bound_formula(body, cons(binder, bound))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE f BY <<

  formula_depth(f: lnn_formula): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES f OF
      fm_equal(left, right): 0,
      fm_less(left, right): 0,
      fm_implies(left, right):
        1 + nat_max(formula_depth(left), formula_depth(right)),
      fm_not(body): 1 + formula_depth(body),
      fm_forall(binder, body): 1 + formula_depth(body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE f BY <<

  fresh_variable(
      variable: nat,
      replacement: lnn_term,
      body: lnn_formula): nat =
    nat_max(
      variable + 1,
      nat_max(
        free_bound_term(replacement, null),
        free_bound_formula(body, null)))

  substitute_formula_at(
      f: lnn_formula,
      variable: nat,
      replacement: lnn_term,
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE lnn_formula =
    IF fuel = 0
    THEN f
    ELSE
      CASES f OF
        fm_equal(left, right):
          fm_equal(
            substitute_term(left, variable, replacement),
            substitute_term(right, variable, replacement)),
        fm_less(left, right):
          fm_less(
            substitute_term(left, variable, replacement),
            substitute_term(right, variable, replacement)),
        fm_implies(left, right):
          fm_implies(
            substitute_formula_at(
              left, variable, replacement, fuel - 1),
            substitute_formula_at(
              right, variable, replacement, fuel - 1)),
        fm_not(body):
          fm_not(
            substitute_formula_at(
              body, variable, replacement, fuel - 1)),
        fm_forall(binder, body):
          IF binder = variable
          THEN fm_forall(binder, body)
          ELSIF free_in_term(binder, replacement)
          THEN
            LET fresh =
                  fresh_variable(variable, replacement, body),
                renamed =
                  substitute_formula_at(
                    body,
                    binder,
                    tm_var(fresh),
                    fuel - 1)
            IN
              fm_forall(
                fresh,
                substitute_formula_at(
                  renamed,
                  variable,
                  replacement,
                  fuel - 1))
          ELSE
            fm_forall(
              binder,
              substitute_formula_at(
                body, variable, replacement, fuel - 1))
          ENDIF
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  substitute_formula(
      f: lnn_formula,
      variable: nat,
      replacement: lnn_term): lnn_formula =
    substitute_formula_at(
      f, variable, replacement, formula_depth(f) + 1)

  disjoin(left, right: lnn_formula): lnn_formula =
    fm_implies(fm_not(left), right)

  conjoin(left, right: lnn_formula): lnn_formula =
    fm_not(disjoin(fm_not(left), fm_not(right)))

  biconditional(left, right: lnn_formula): lnn_formula =
    conjoin(
      fm_implies(left, right),
      fm_implies(right, left))

  existential(variable: nat, f: lnn_formula): lnn_formula =
    fm_not(fm_forall(variable, fm_not(f)))

  numeral(value: nat): RECURSIVE lnn_term =
    IF value = 0
      THEN tm_zero
      ELSE tm_succ(numeral(value - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  sum_to_n(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE value + sum_to_n(value - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  pair_nat(left, right: nat): nat =
    left + sum_to_n(left + right)

  code_term(t: lnn_term): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES t OF
      tm_var(i): pair_nat(0, i),
      tm_zero: pair_nat(4, 0),
      tm_succ(arg):
        pair_nat(
          3,
          1 + pair_nat(code_term(arg), 0)),
      tm_plus(left, right):
        pair_nat(
          1,
          1 + pair_nat(
            code_term(left),
            1 + pair_nat(code_term(right), 0))),
      tm_times(left, right):
        pair_nat(
          2,
          1 + pair_nat(
            code_term(left),
            1 + pair_nat(code_term(right), 0)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  code_formula(f: lnn_formula): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES f OF
      fm_equal(left, right):
        pair_nat(
          0,
          pair_nat(code_term(left), code_term(right))),
      fm_less(left, right):
        pair_nat(
          4,
          1 + pair_nat(
            code_term(left),
            1 + pair_nat(code_term(right), 0))),
      fm_implies(left, right):
        pair_nat(
          1,
          pair_nat(code_formula(left), code_formula(right))),
      fm_not(body): pair_nat(2, code_formula(body)),
      fm_forall(variable, body):
        pair_nat(
          3,
          pair_nat(variable, code_formula(body)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE f BY <<

  reflection(f: lnn_formula): lnn_term =
    numeral(code_formula(f))

  free_in_hypotheses(
      variable: nat,
      hypotheses: list[lnn_formula]): bool =
    EXISTS (f: lnn_formula):
      member(f, hypotheses)
        AND free_in_formula(variable, f)

  logical_axiom(f: lnn_formula): bool =
    (EXISTS (A, B: lnn_formula):
      f = fm_implies(A, fm_implies(B, A)))
    OR
    (EXISTS (A, B, C: lnn_formula):
      f =
        fm_implies(
          fm_implies(A, fm_implies(B, C)),
          fm_implies(
            fm_implies(A, B),
            fm_implies(A, C))))
    OR
    (EXISTS (A, B: lnn_formula):
      f =
        fm_implies(
          fm_implies(fm_not(A), fm_not(B)),
          fm_implies(B, A)))
    OR
    (EXISTS (A: lnn_formula), (variable: nat), (t: lnn_term):
      f =
        fm_implies(
          fm_forall(variable, A),
          substitute_formula(A, variable, t)))
    OR
    (EXISTS (A: lnn_formula), (variable: nat):
      NOT free_in_formula(variable, A)
        AND f =
          fm_implies(A, fm_forall(variable, A)))
    OR
    (EXISTS (A, B: lnn_formula), (variable: nat):
      f =
        fm_implies(
          fm_forall(variable, fm_implies(A, B)),
          fm_implies(
            fm_forall(variable, A),
            fm_forall(variable, B))))
    OR f = fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(0))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
        fm_equal(tm_var(1), tm_var(0)))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
        fm_implies(
          fm_equal(tm_var(1), tm_var(2)),
          fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(2))))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(2), tm_var(3)),
        fm_implies(
          fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
          biconditional(
            fm_less(tm_var(2), tm_var(0)),
            fm_less(tm_var(3), tm_var(1)))))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(2), tm_var(3)),
        fm_implies(
          fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
          fm_equal(
            tm_plus(tm_var(2), tm_var(0)),
            tm_plus(tm_var(3), tm_var(1)))))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(2), tm_var(3)),
        fm_implies(
          fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
          fm_equal(
            tm_times(tm_var(2), tm_var(0)),
            tm_times(tm_var(3), tm_var(1)))))
    OR f =
      fm_implies(
        fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
        fm_equal(
          tm_succ(tm_var(0)),
          tm_succ(tm_var(1))))
    OR f = fm_equal(tm_zero, tm_zero)

  derivation(
      hypotheses: list[lnn_formula],
      f: lnn_formula): INDUCTIVE bool =
    (hypotheses = cons(f, null))
      OR
      (hypotheses = null AND logical_axiom(f))
      OR
      (EXISTS
          (left_hypotheses, right_hypotheses:
            list[lnn_formula]),
          (A: lnn_formula):
        hypotheses = append(left_hypotheses, right_hypotheses)
          AND derivation(
            left_hypotheses,
            fm_implies(A, f))
          AND derivation(right_hypotheses, A))
      OR
      (EXISTS (A: lnn_formula), (variable: nat):
        f = fm_forall(variable, A)
          AND NOT free_in_hypotheses(variable, hypotheses)
          AND derivation(hypotheses, A))

  provable: [formula_set, lnn_formula -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (sys: formula_set), (f: lnn_formula):
      EXISTS (hypotheses: list[lnn_formula]):
        derivation(hypotheses, f)
          AND
          (FORALL (g: lnn_formula):
            member(g, hypotheses) IMPLIES sys(g))

  nn1: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      0,
      fm_not(
        fm_equal(
          tm_succ(tm_var(0)),
          tm_zero)))

  nn2: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      1,
      fm_forall(
        0,
        fm_implies(
          fm_equal(
            tm_succ(tm_var(0)),
            tm_succ(tm_var(1))),
          fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)))))

  nn3: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      0,
      fm_equal(
        tm_plus(tm_var(0), tm_zero),
        tm_var(0)))

  nn4: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      1,
      fm_forall(
        0,
        fm_equal(
          tm_plus(
            tm_var(0),
            tm_succ(tm_var(1))),
          tm_succ(
            tm_plus(tm_var(0), tm_var(1))))))

  nn5: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      0,
      fm_equal(
        tm_times(tm_var(0), tm_zero),
        tm_zero))

  nn6: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      1,
      fm_forall(
        0,
        fm_equal(
          tm_times(
            tm_var(0),
            tm_succ(tm_var(1))),
          tm_plus(
            tm_times(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
            tm_var(0)))))

  nn7: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      0,
      fm_not(
        fm_less(tm_var(0), tm_zero)))

  nn8: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      1,
      fm_forall(
        0,
        fm_implies(
          fm_less(
            tm_var(0),
            tm_succ(tm_var(1))),
          disjoin(
            fm_less(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
            fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1))))))

  nn9: lnn_formula =
    fm_forall(
      1,
      fm_forall(
        0,
        disjoin(
          fm_less(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
          disjoin(
            fm_equal(tm_var(0), tm_var(1)),
            fm_less(tm_var(1), tm_var(0))))))

  nn(f: lnn_formula): bool =
    f = nn1
      OR f = nn2
      OR f = nn3
      OR f = nn4
      OR f = nn5
      OR f = nn6
      OR f = nn7
      OR f = nn8
      OR f = nn9

  extends_nn(sys: formula_set): bool =
    FORALL (f: lnn_formula):
      nn(f) IMPLIES sys(f)

  closed_formula(f: lnn_formula): bool =
    FORALL (variable: nat):
      NOT free_in_formula(variable, f)

  independent_in(sys: formula_set, f: lnn_formula): bool =
    NOT provable(sys, f)
      AND NOT provable(sys, fm_not(f))

  weakly_consistent(sys: formula_set): bool =
    FORALL (f: lnn_formula), (variable: nat):
      ((FORALL (x: nat):
          free_in_formula(x, f) IMPLIES variable = x)
        AND provable(
          sys,
          existential(variable, fm_not(f))))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (value: nat):
          NOT provable(
            sys,
            substitute_formula(
              f,
              variable,
              numeral(value)))

  rep_has_only_variable(
      rep_t: lnn_formula,
      variable: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: nat):
      free_in_formula(x, rep_t) IMPLIES x = variable

  positively_represents_membership(
      sys: formula_set,
      rep_t: lnn_formula,
      variable: nat): bool =
    FORALL (f: lnn_formula):
      sys(f)
      IMPLIES
        provable(
          sys,
          substitute_formula(
            rep_t,
            variable,
            reflection(f)))

  negatively_represents_membership(
      sys: formula_set,
      rep_t: lnn_formula,
      variable: nat): bool =
    FORALL (f: lnn_formula):
      NOT sys(f)
      IMPLIES
        provable(
          sys,
          fm_not(
            substitute_formula(
              rep_t,
              variable,
              reflection(f))))

  goedel_first_incompleteness: bool =
    FORALL
        (sys: formula_set),
        (rep_t: lnn_formula),
        (variable: nat):
      (extends_nn(sys)
        AND rep_has_only_variable(rep_t, variable)
        AND positively_represents_membership(
          sys, rep_t, variable)
        AND negatively_represents_membership(
          sys, rep_t, variable)
        AND weakly_consistent(sys))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: lnn_formula):
          independent_in(sys, f)
            AND closed_formula(f)
END goedel_first_incompleteness_006

title: 060_bézout_s_theorem
content:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Sangwoo Jo (aka Jason), Guy Leroy, Johannes Hölzl, Mario Carneiro
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.GroupWithZero.Semiconj
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Commute.Units
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Operations
public import Mathlib.Order.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Int.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Divisibility.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Nat.Defs

/-!
# Extended GCD and divisibility over ℤ

## Main definitions

* Given `x y : ℕ`, `xgcd x y` computes the pair of integers `(a, b)` such that
  `gcd x y = x * a + y * b`. `gcdA x y` and `gcdB x y` are defined to be `a` and `b`,
  respectively.

## Main statements

* `gcd_eq_gcd_ab`: Bézout's lemma, given `x y : ℕ`, `gcd x y = x * gcdA x y + y * gcdB x y`.

## Tags

Bézout's lemma, Bezout's lemma
-/

@[expose] public section

/-! ### Extended Euclidean algorithm -/


namespace Nat

/-- Helper function for the extended GCD algorithm (`Nat.xgcd`). -/
def xgcdAux : ℕ → ℤ → ℤ → ℕ → ℤ → ℤ → ℕ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  Nat.strongRec' fun n ih s t r' s' t' ↦ match n with
  | 0 => (r', s', t')
  | succ k =>
    let q := r' / succ k
    ih (r' % succ k) (mod_lt _ <| (succ_pos _).gt) (s' - q * s) (t' - q * t) (succ k) s t

@[simp]
theorem xgcd_zero_left {s t r' s' t'} : xgcdAux 0 s t r' s' t' = (r', s', t') := rfl

theorem xgcdAux_rec {r s t r' s' t'} (h : 0 < r) :
    xgcdAux r s t r' s' t' = xgcdAux (r' % r) (s' - r' / r * s) (t' - r' / r * t) r s t := by sorry
def xgcd (x y : ℕ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (xgcdAux x 1 0 y 0 1).2

/-- The extended GCD `a` value in the equation `gcd x y = x * a + y * b`. -/
def gcdA (x y : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (xgcd x y).1

/-- The extended GCD `b` value in the equation `gcd x y = x * a + y * b`. -/
def gcdB (x y : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (xgcd x y).2

@[simp]
theorem gcdA_zero_left {s : ℕ} : gcdA 0 s = 0 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem gcdB_zero_left {s : ℕ} : gcdB 0 s = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem gcdA_zero_right {s : ℕ} (h : s ≠ 0) : gcdA s 0 = 1 := by sorry
theorem gcdB_zero_right {s : ℕ} (h : s ≠ 0) : gcdB s 0 = 0 := by sorry
theorem xgcdAux_fst (x y) : ∀ s t s' t', (xgcdAux x s t y s' t').1 = gcd x y :=
  gcd.induction x y (by simp) fun x y h IH s t s' t' => by
    simp only [h, xgcdAux_rec, IH]
    rw [← gcd_rec]

theorem xgcdAux_val (x y) : xgcdAux x 1 0 y 0 1 = (gcd x y, xgcd x y) := by sorry
theorem xgcd_val (x y) : xgcd x y = (gcdA x y, gcdB x y) := by sorry
variable (x y : ℕ)

private def P : ℕ × ℤ × ℤ → Prop
  | (r, s, t) => (r : ℤ) = x * s + y * t

private theorem xgcdAux_P {r r'} :
    ∀ {s t s' t'}, P x y (r, s, t) → P x y (r', s', t') → P x y (xgcdAux r s t r' s' t') := by sorry
theorem gcd_eq_gcd_ab : (gcd x y : ℤ) = x * gcdA x y + y * gcdB x y := by sorry
end

theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_gcd {k n : ℕ} (hk : gcd n k < k) : ∃ m < k, n * m % k = gcd n k := by sorry
theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime {k n : ℕ} (hkn : Coprime n k) (hk : 1 < k) :
    ∃ m < k, n * m % k = 1 := by sorry
theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_of_coprime {k n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (hkn : Coprime n k) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m < k, n * m % k = r % k := by sorry
end Nat

/-! ### Divisibility over ℤ -/


namespace Int

theorem gcd_def (i j : ℤ) : gcd i j = Nat.gcd i.natAbs j.natAbs := rfl

/-- The extended GCD `a` value in the equation `gcd x y = x * a + y * b`. -/
def gcdA : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ
  | ofNat m, n => m.gcdA n.natAbs
  | -[m+1], n => -m.succ.gcdA n.natAbs

/-- The extended GCD `b` value in the equation `gcd x y = x * a + y * b`. -/
def gcdB : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ
  | m, ofNat n => m.natAbs.gcdB n
  | m, -[n+1] => -m.natAbs.gcdB n.succ

/-- **Bézout's lemma** -/
theorem gcd_eq_gcd_ab : ∀ x y : ℤ, (gcd x y : ℤ) = x * gcdA x y + y * gcdB x y := by sorry
theorem lcm_def (i j : ℤ) : lcm i j = Nat.lcm (natAbs i) (natAbs j) :=
  rfl

alias gcd_div := gcd_ediv
alias gcd_div_gcd_div_gcd := gcd_ediv_gcd_ediv_gcd

/-- If `gcd a (m * n) = 1`, then `gcd a m = 1`. -/
theorem gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_left {a : ℤ} {m n : ℕ} (h : a.gcd (m * n) = 1) :
    a.gcd m = 1 :=
  Nat.dvd_one.mp <| h ▸ gcd_dvd_gcd_mul_right_right a m n

/-- If `gcd a (m * n) = 1`, then `gcd a n = 1`. -/
theorem gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_right {a : ℤ} {m n : ℕ} (h : a.gcd (m * n) = 1) :
    a.gcd n = 1 :=
  Nat.dvd_one.mp <| h ▸ gcd_dvd_gcd_mul_left_right a n m

theorem ne_zero_of_gcd {x y : ℤ} (hc : gcd x y ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 := by sorry
theorem exists_gcd_one {m n : ℤ} (H : 0 < gcd m n) :
    ∃ m' n' : ℤ, gcd m' n' = 1 ∧ m = m' * gcd m n ∧ n = n' * gcd m n :=
  ⟨_, _, gcd_div_gcd_div_gcd H, (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_left ..)).symm,
    (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_right ..)).symm⟩

theorem exists_gcd_one' {m n : ℤ} (H : 0 < gcd m n) :
    ∃ (g : ℕ) (m' n' : ℤ), 0 < g ∧ gcd m' n' = 1 ∧ m = m' * g ∧ n = n' * g :=
  let ⟨m', n', h⟩ := exists_gcd_one H
  ⟨_, m', n', H, h⟩

theorem gcd_dvd_iff {a b : ℤ} {n : ℕ} : gcd a b ∣ n ↔ ∃ x y : ℤ, ↑n = a * x + b * y := by sorry
theorem gcd_greatest {a b d : ℤ} (hd_pos : 0 ≤ d) (hda : d ∣ a) (hdb : d ∣ b)
    (hd : ∀ e : ℤ, e ∣ a → e ∣ b → e ∣ d) : d = gcd a b :=
  dvd_antisymm hd_pos (natCast_nonneg (gcd a b)) (dvd_coe_gcd hda hdb)
    (hd _ (gcd_dvd_left ..) (gcd_dvd_right ..))

/-- Euclid's lemma: if `a ∣ b * c` and `gcd a c = 1` then `a ∣ b`.
Compare with `IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left` and
`UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_no_prime_factors` -/
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_gcd_one {a b c : ℤ} (habc : a ∣ b * c) (hab : gcd a c = 1) :
    a ∣ b := by sorry
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_gcd_one {a b c : ℤ} (habc : a ∣ b * c) (hab : gcd a b = 1) :
    a ∣ c := by sorry
theorem gcd_least_linear {a b : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    IsLeast { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃ x y : ℤ, ↑n = a * x + b * y } (a.gcd b) := by sorry
end Int

section Monoid
variable {M : Type*} [Monoid M] {a : M} {m n : ℕ}

@[to_additive (attr := simp) gcd_nsmul_eq_zero]
lemma pow_gcd_eq_one : a ^ m.gcd n = 1 ↔ a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1 where
  mp hmn := by sorry
lemma pow_eq_one_iff_of_coprime (hmn : m.Coprime n) : a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1 ↔ a = 1 := by sorry
end Monoid

section Group
variable {M : Type*} [Group M] {a : M} {m n : ℤ}

@[to_additive (attr := simp) intGCD_nsmul_eq_zero]
lemma pow_intGCD_eq_one : a ^ m.gcd n = 1 ↔ a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1 := by sorry
end Group

variable {α : Type*}

section GroupWithZero
variable [GroupWithZero α] {a b : α} {m n : ℕ}

protected lemma Commute.pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime (hab : Commute a b) (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    a ^ m = b ^ n ↔ ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m := by sorry
end GroupWithZero

section CommGroupWithZero
variable [CommGroupWithZero α] {a b : α} {m n : ℕ}

lemma pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime (hmn : m.Coprime n) : a ^ m = b ^ n ↔ ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m :=
  (Commute.all _ _).pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime hmn

lemma pow_mem_range_pow_of_coprime (hmn : m.Coprime n) (a : α) :
    a ^ m ∈ Set.range (· ^ n : α → α) ↔ a ∈ Set.range (· ^ n : α → α) := by sorry
end CommGroupWithZero

title: 060_bézout_s_theorem
content:
From Stdlib Require Import ZArith.

Open Scope Z_scope.

(**
  Bézout's identity over the integers, with the standard nonnegative gcd
  chosen by [Z.gcd].
*)
Theorem Bezout_gcd (a b : Z) :
  exists u v : Z, u * a + v * b = Z.gcd a b.
Proof.
  destruct (Z.extgcd a b) as [[u v] d] eqn:Hextgcd.
  pose proof (Z.extgcd_correct a b Hextgcd) as [Hlinear Hgcd].
  exists u, v.
  now rewrite Hlinear, Hgcd.
Qed.

title: 060_bézout_s_theorem
content:
(*  Title:      HOL/GCD.thy
    Author:     Christophe Tabacznyj
    Author:     Lawrence C. Paulson
    Author:     Amine Chaieb
    Author:     Thomas M. Rasmussen
    Author:     Jeremy Avigad
    Author:     Tobias Nipkow

This file deals with the functions gcd and lcm.  Definitions and
lemmas are proved uniformly for the natural numbers and integers.

This file combines and revises a number of prior developments.

The original theories "GCD" and "Primes" were by Christophe Tabacznyj
and Lawrence C. Paulson, based on @{cite davenport92}. They introduced
gcd, lcm, and prime for the natural numbers.

The original theory "IntPrimes" was by Thomas M. Rasmussen, and
extended gcd, lcm, primes to the integers. Amine Chaieb provided
another extension of the notions to the integers, and added a number
of results to "Primes" and "GCD". IntPrimes also defined and developed
the congruence relations on the integers. The notion was extended to
the natural numbers by Chaieb.

Jeremy Avigad combined all of these, made everything uniform for the
natural numbers and the integers, and added a number of new theorems.

Tobias Nipkow cleaned up a lot.
*)

section \<open>Greatest common divisor and least common multiple\<close>

theory GCD
  imports Groups_List Code_Numeral
begin

subsection \<open>Abstract bounded quasi semilattices as common foundation\<close>

locale bounded_quasi_semilattice = abel_semigroup +
  fixes top :: 'a  (\<open>\<^bold>\<top>\<close>) and bot :: 'a  (\<open>\<^bold>\<bottom>\<close>)
    and normalize :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes idem_normalize [simp]: "a \<^bold>* a = normalize a"
    and normalize_left_idem [simp]: "normalize a \<^bold>* b = a \<^bold>* b"
    and normalize_idem [simp]: "normalize (a \<^bold>* b) = a \<^bold>* b"
    and normalize_top [simp]: "normalize \<^bold>\<top> = \<^bold>\<top>"
    and normalize_bottom [simp]: "normalize \<^bold>\<bottom> = \<^bold>\<bottom>"
    and top_left_normalize [simp]: "\<^bold>\<top> \<^bold>* a = normalize a"
    and bottom_left_bottom [simp]: "\<^bold>\<bottom> \<^bold>* a = \<^bold>\<bottom>"
begin

lemma left_idem [simp]:
  "a \<^bold>* (a \<^bold>* b) = a \<^bold>* b"
  by sorry

lemma right_idem [simp]:
  "(a \<^bold>* b) \<^bold>* b = a \<^bold>* b"
  by sorry

lemma comp_fun_idem: "comp_fun_idem f"
  by sorry

interpretation comp_fun_idem f
  by (fact comp_fun_idem)

lemma top_right_normalize [simp]:
  "a \<^bold>* \<^bold>\<top> = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma bottom_right_bottom [simp]:
  "a \<^bold>* \<^bold>\<bottom> = \<^bold>\<bottom>"
  by sorry

lemma normalize_right_idem [simp]:
  "a \<^bold>* normalize b = a \<^bold>* b"
  by sorry

end

locale bounded_quasi_semilattice_set = bounded_quasi_semilattice
begin

interpretation comp_fun_idem f
  by (fact comp_fun_idem)

definition F :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a"
where
  eq_fold: "F A = (if finite A then Finite_Set.fold f \<^bold>\<top> A else \<^bold>\<bottom>)"

lemma infinite [simp]:
  "infinite A \<Longrightarrow> F A = \<^bold>\<bottom>"
  by sorry

lemma set_eq_fold [code]:
  "F (set xs) = fold f xs \<^bold>\<top>"
  by sorry

lemma empty [simp]:
  "F {} = \<^bold>\<top>"
  by sorry

lemma insert [simp]:
  "F (insert a A) = a \<^bold>* F A"
  by sorry

lemma normalize [simp]:
  "normalize (F A) = F A"
  by sorry

lemma in_idem:
  assumes "a \<in> A"
  shows "a \<^bold>* F A = F A"
  by sorry

lemma union:
  "F (A \<union> B) = F A \<^bold>* F B"
  by sorry

lemma remove:
  assumes "a \<in> A"
  shows "F A = a \<^bold>* F (A - {a})"
  by sorry

lemma insert_remove:
  "F (insert a A) = a \<^bold>* F (A - {a})"
  by sorry

lemma subset:
  assumes "B \<subseteq> A"
  shows "F B \<^bold>* F A = F A"
  by sorry

end

subsection \<open>Abstract GCD and LCM\<close>

class gcd = zero + one + dvd +
  fixes gcd :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and lcm :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"

class Gcd = gcd +
  fixes Gcd :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and Lcm :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a"

syntax
  "_GCD1"     :: "pttrns \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b"           (\<open>(\<open>indent=3 notation=\<open>binder GCD\<close>\<close>GCD _./ _)\<close> [0, 10] 10)
  "_GCD"      :: "pttrn \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b"  (\<open>(\<open>indent=3 notation=\<open>binder GCD\<close>\<close>GCD _\<in>_./ _)\<close> [0, 0, 10] 10)
  "_LCM1"     :: "pttrns \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b"           (\<open>(\<open>indent=3 notation=\<open>binder LCM\<close>\<close>LCM _./ _)\<close> [0, 10] 10)
  "_LCM"      :: "pttrn \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'b"  (\<open>(\<open>indent=3 notation=\<open>binder LCM\<close>\<close>LCM _\<in>_./ _)\<close> [0, 0, 10] 10)

syntax_consts
  "_GCD1" "_GCD" \<rightleftharpoons> Gcd and
  "_LCM1" "_LCM" \<rightleftharpoons> Lcm

translations
  "GCD x y. f"   \<rightleftharpoons> "GCD x. GCD y. f"
  "GCD x. f"     \<rightleftharpoons> "CONST Gcd (CONST range (\<lambda>x. f))"
  "GCD x\<in>A. f"   \<rightleftharpoons> "CONST Gcd ((\<lambda>x. f) ` A)"
  "LCM x y. f"   \<rightleftharpoons> "LCM x. LCM y. f"
  "LCM x. f"     \<rightleftharpoons> "CONST Lcm (CONST range (\<lambda>x. f))"
  "LCM x\<in>A. f"   \<rightleftharpoons> "CONST Lcm ((\<lambda>x. f) ` A)"

class semiring_gcd = normalization_semidom + gcd +
  assumes gcd_dvd1 [iff]: "gcd a b dvd a"
    and gcd_dvd2 [iff]: "gcd a b dvd b"
    and gcd_greatest: "c dvd a \<Longrightarrow> c dvd b \<Longrightarrow> c dvd gcd a b"
    and normalize_gcd [simp]: "normalize (gcd a b) = gcd a b"
    and lcm_gcd: "lcm a b = normalize (a * b div gcd a b)"
begin

lemma gcd_greatest_iff [simp]: "a dvd gcd b c \<longleftrightarrow> a dvd b \<and> a dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_dvdI1: "a dvd c \<Longrightarrow> gcd a b dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_dvdI2: "b dvd c \<Longrightarrow> gcd a b dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_gcdD1: "a dvd gcd b c \<Longrightarrow> a dvd b"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_gcdD2: "a dvd gcd b c \<Longrightarrow> a dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_0_left [simp]: "gcd 0 a = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_0_right [simp]: "gcd a 0 = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_eq_0_iff [simp]: "gcd a b = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0 \<and> b = 0"
  (is "?P \<longleftrightarrow> ?Q")
  by sorry

lemma unit_factor_gcd: "unit_factor (gcd a b) = (if a = 0 \<and> b = 0 then 0 else 1)"
  by sorry

lemma is_unit_gcd_iff [simp]:
  "is_unit (gcd a b) \<longleftrightarrow> gcd a b = 1"
  by sorry

sublocale gcd: abel_semigroup gcd
proof
  fix a b c
  show "gcd a b = gcd b a"
    by (rule associated_eqI) simp_all
  from gcd_dvd1 have "gcd (gcd a b) c dvd a"
    by (rule dvd_trans) simp
  moreover from gcd_dvd1 have "gcd (gcd a b) c dvd b"
    by (rule dvd_trans) simp
  ultimately have P1: "gcd (gcd a b) c dvd gcd a (gcd b c)"
    by (auto intro!: gcd_greatest)
  from gcd_dvd2 have "gcd a (gcd b c) dvd b"
    by (rule dvd_trans) simp
  moreover from gcd_dvd2 have "gcd a (gcd b c) dvd c"
    by (rule dvd_trans) simp
  ultimately have P2: "gcd a (gcd b c) dvd gcd (gcd a b) c"
    by (auto intro!: gcd_greatest)
  from P1 P2 show "gcd (gcd a b) c = gcd a (gcd b c)"
    by (rule associated_eqI) simp_all
qed

sublocale gcd: bounded_quasi_semilattice gcd 0 1 normalize
proof
  show "gcd a a = normalize a" for a
  proof -
    have "a dvd gcd a a"
      by (rule gcd_greatest) simp_all
    then show ?thesis
      by (auto intro: associated_eqI)
  qed
  show "gcd (normalize a) b = gcd a b" for a b
    using gcd_dvd1 [of "normalize a" b]
    by (auto intro: associated_eqI)
  show "gcd 1 a = 1" for a
    by (rule associated_eqI) simp_all
qed simp_all

lemma gcd_self: "gcd a a = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_left_idem: "gcd a (gcd a b) = gcd a b"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_right_idem: "gcd (gcd a b) b = gcd a b"
  by sorry

lemma gcdI:
  assumes "c dvd a" and "c dvd b"
    and greatest: "\<And>d. d dvd a \<Longrightarrow> d dvd b \<Longrightarrow> d dvd c"
    and "normalize c = c"
  shows "c = gcd a b"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_unique:
  "d dvd a \<and> d dvd b \<and> normalize d = d \<and> (\<forall>e. e dvd a \<and> e dvd b \<longrightarrow> e dvd d) \<longleftrightarrow> d = gcd a b"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_dvd_prod: "gcd a b dvd k * b"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_proj2_if_dvd: "b dvd a \<Longrightarrow> gcd a b = normalize b"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_proj1_if_dvd: "a dvd b \<Longrightarrow> gcd a b = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_proj1_iff: "gcd m n = normalize m \<longleftrightarrow> m dvd n"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_proj2_iff: "gcd m n = normalize n \<longleftrightarrow> n dvd m"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_mult_left: "gcd (c * a) (c * b) = normalize (c * gcd a b)"
  by sorry

lemma gcd_mult_right: "gcd (a * c) (b * c) = normalize (gcd b a * c)"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_lcm1 [iff]: "a dvd lcm a b"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_lcm2 [iff]: "b dvd lcm a b"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_lcmI1: "a dvd b \<Longrightarrow> a dvd lcm b c"
  by sorry

lemma dvd_lcmI2: "a dvd c \<Longrightarrow> a dvd lcm b c"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_dvdD1: "lcm a b dvd c \<Longrightarrow> a dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_dvdD2: "lcm a b dvd c \<Longrightarrow> b dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_least:
  assumes "a dvd c" and "b dvd c"
  shows "lcm a b dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_least_iff [simp]: "lcm a b dvd c \<longleftrightarrow> a dvd c \<and> b dvd c"
  by sorry

lemma normalize_lcm [simp]: "normalize (lcm a b) = lcm a b"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_0_left [simp]: "lcm 0 a = 0"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_0_right [simp]: "lcm a 0 = 0"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_eq_0_iff: "lcm a b = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0 \<or> b = 0"
  (is "?P \<longleftrightarrow> ?Q")
  by sorry

lemma zero_eq_lcm_iff: "0 = lcm a b \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0 \<or> b = 0"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_eq_1_iff [simp]: "lcm a b = 1 \<longleftrightarrow> is_unit a \<and> is_unit b"
  by sorry

lemma unit_factor_lcm: "unit_factor (lcm a b) = (if a = 0 \<or> b = 0 then 0 else 1)"
  by sorry

sublocale lcm: abel_semigroup lcm
proof
  fix a b c
  show "lcm a b = lcm b a"
    by (simp add: lcm_gcd ac_simps normalize_mult dvd_normalize_div)
  have "lcm (lcm a b) c dvd lcm a (lcm b c)"
    and "lcm a (lcm b c) dvd lcm (lcm a b) c"
    by (auto intro: lcm_least
      dvd_trans [of b "lcm b c" "lcm a (lcm b c)"]
      dvd_trans [of c "lcm b c" "lcm a (lcm b c)"]
      dvd_trans [of a "lcm a b" "lcm (lcm a b) c"]
      dvd_trans [of b "lcm a b" "lcm (lcm a b) c"])
  then show "lcm (lcm a b) c = lcm a (lcm b c)"
    by (rule associated_eqI) simp_all
qed

sublocale lcm: bounded_quasi_semilattice lcm 1 0 normalize
proof
  show "lcm a a = normalize a" for a
  proof -
    have "lcm a a dvd a"
      by (rule lcm_least) simp_all
    then show ?thesis
      by (auto intro: associated_eqI)
  qed
  show "lcm (normalize a) b = lcm a b" for a b
    using dvd_lcm1 [of "normalize a" b] unfolding normalize_dvd_iff
    by (auto intro: associated_eqI)
  show "lcm 1 a = normalize a" for a
    by (rule associated_eqI) simp_all
qed simp_all

lemma lcm_self: "lcm a a = normalize a"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_left_idem: "lcm a (lcm a b) = lcm a b"
  by sorry

lemma lcm_right_idem: "lcm (lcm a b) b = lcm a b"

lemma gcd_lcm:
  assumes "a \<noteq> 0" and "b \<noteq> 0"

lemma lcm_1_left: "lcm 1 a = normalize a"

lemma comp_fun_idem_gcd: "comp_fun_idem gcd"
  by sorry

lemma comp_fun_idem_lcm: "comp_fun_idem lcm"

declare unit_factor_lcm [simp]

  assumes "a dvd c" and "b dvd c" and "\<And>d. a dvd d \<Longrightarrow> b dvd d \<Longrightarrow> c dvd d"

lemma gcd_dvd_lcm [simp]: "gcd a b dvd lcm a b"

lemmas lcm_0 = lcm_0_right

lemma lcm_unique:
  "a dvd d \<and> b dvd d \<and> normalize d = d \<and> (\<forall>e. a dvd e \<and> b dvd e \<longrightarrow> d dvd e) \<longleftrightarrow> d = lcm a b"

class semiring_Gcd = semiring_gcd + Gcd +
  assumes Gcd_dvd: "a \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> Gcd A dvd a"
    and Gcd_greatest: "(\<And>b. b \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> a dvd b) \<Longrightarrow> a dvd Gcd A"

    and Lcm_least: "(\<And>b. b \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> b dvd a) \<Longrightarrow> Lcm A dvd a"

text \<open>
  \<^medskip> \<^term>\<open>gcd m n\<close> divides \<open>m\<close> and \<open>n\<close>.
  The conjunctions don't seem provable separately.
\<close>

instance nat :: semiring_gcd
proof
  fix m n :: nat
  show "gcd m n dvd m" and "gcd m n dvd n"
  proof (induct m n rule: gcd_nat_induct)
    case (step m n)
    then have "gcd n (m mod n) dvd m"
      by (metis dvd_mod_imp_dvd)
    with step show "gcd m n dvd m"
      by (simp add: gcd_non_0_nat)
  qed (simp_all add: gcd_0_nat gcd_non_0_nat)
next
  fix m n k :: nat
  assume "k dvd m" and "k dvd n"
  then show "k dvd gcd m n"
    by (induct m n rule: gcd_nat_induct) (simp_all add: gcd_non_0_nat dvd_mod gcd_0_nat)
qed (simp_all add: lcm_nat_def)

instance int :: ring_gcd
proof
  fix k l r :: int
  show [simp]: "gcd k l dvd k" "gcd k l dvd l"
    using gcd_dvd1 [of "nat \<bar>k\<bar>" "nat \<bar>l\<bar>"]
      gcd_dvd2 [of "nat \<bar>k\<bar>" "nat \<bar>l\<bar>"]
    by simp_all
  show "lcm k l = normalize (k * l div gcd k l)"
    using lcm_gcd [of "nat \<bar>k\<bar>" "nat \<bar>l\<bar>"]
    by (simp add: nat_eq_iff of_nat_div abs_mult abs_div)
  assume "r dvd k" "r dvd l"
  then show "r dvd gcd k l"
    using gcd_greatest [of "nat \<bar>r\<bar>" "nat \<bar>k\<bar>" "nat \<bar>l\<bar>"]
    by simp
qed simp
