title: 062_fair_games_theorem__optional_stopping
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 062,
-- "Fair Games Theorem (Optional Stopping)": the characterization of real-valued
-- discrete-time submartingales by monotonicity of expectations between ordered
-- bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.

module FairGamesOptionalStopping where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<=T_

data Bottom {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

Not : {ℓ : Level} -> Set ℓ -> Set ℓ
Not {ℓ} A = A -> Bottom {ℓ}

_!=_ : {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ} -> A -> A -> Set ℓ
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where
  constructor top

record Both {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (P : A -> Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate reciprocal absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocal zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (reciprocal x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement E x =
  Not (E x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable (complement E)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable F

open SigmaAlgebra

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    borel : SigmaAlgebra R

    borel-open-ray :
      (a : R) ->
      measurable borel (\ x -> StrictLess algebra a x)
    borel-minimal :
      (candidate : SigmaAlgebra R) ->
      ((a : R) ->
        measurable candidate (\ x -> StrictLess algebra a x)) ->
      (E : Predicate R) ->
      measurable borel E ->
      measurable candidate E

open StandardRealAnalysis

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteValue reals
          (subtract reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

data ExtendedNonnegative (R : Set) : Set where
  finiteValue   : R -> ExtendedNonnegative R
  infiniteValue : ExtendedNonnegative R

addExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
addExtended reals (finiteValue x) (finiteValue y) =
  finiteValue (add reals x y)
addExtended reals infiniteValue _ =
  infiniteValue
addExtended reals _ infiniteValue =
  infiniteValue

partialExtendedSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  Nat ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R
partialExtendedSum reals sequence zero =
  finiteValue (zeroR reals)
partialExtendedSum reals sequence (suc n) =
  addExtended reals
    (partialExtendedSum reals sequence n)
    (sequence n)

StrictBelowExtended :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
StrictBelowExtended reals bound (finiteValue value) =
  StrictLess reals bound value
StrictBelowExtended reals bound infiniteValue =
  Top

ExtendedLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> ExtendedNonnegative R) ->
  ExtendedNonnegative R ->
  Set
ExtendedLimit reals sequence (finiteValue limit) =
  Exists (Nat -> _)
    (\ values ->
      Both
        ((n : Nat) -> sequence n == finiteValue (values n))
        (SequentialLimit reals values limit))
ExtendedLimit reals sequence infiniteValue =
  (bound : _) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> StrictBelowExtended reals bound (sequence n))

Disjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Disjoint E F =
  (x : _) -> Not (Both (E x) (F x))

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint sets =
  (m n : Nat) -> m != n -> Disjoint (sets m) (sets n)

record CountablyAdditiveMeasure
  {R A : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    measureValue : Predicate A -> ExtendedNonnegative R

    measure-nonnegative :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      (value : R) ->
      measureValue E == finiteValue value ->
      lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
        (zeroR (algebra analysis))
        value
    measure-empty :
      measureValue emptySet ==
      finiteValue (zeroR (algebra analysis))
    measure-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      measureValue E == measureValue F
    measure-countably-additive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      ExtendedLimit
        (algebra analysis)
        (\ n ->
          partialExtendedSum
            (algebra analysis)
            (\ k -> measureValue (sets k))
            n)
        (measureValue (countableUnion sets))

open CountablyAdditiveMeasure

preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
preimage f E x =
  E (f x)

MeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
MeasurableFunction source target f =
  (E : Predicate _) ->
  measurable target E ->
  measurable source (preimage f E)

record MeasureIntegration
  {R A : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    measure-structure : CountablyAdditiveMeasure analysis events
    integrable : (A -> R) -> Set
    integral : (A -> R) -> R
    indicator : Predicate A -> A -> R

    integrable-measurable :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      MeasurableFunction events (borel analysis) f
    integrable-congruent :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      ((x : A) -> f x == g x) ->
      Iff (integrable f) (integrable g)
    integral-congruent :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable g ->
      ((x : A) -> f x == g x) ->
      integral f == integral g

    integrable-zero :
      integrable (\ _ -> zeroR (algebra analysis))
    integral-zero :
      integral (\ _ -> zeroR (algebra analysis)) ==
      zeroR (algebra analysis)
    integrable-add :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable g ->
      integrable
        (\ x -> add (algebra analysis) (f x) (g x))
    integral-add :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable g ->
      integral
        (\ x -> add (algebra analysis) (f x) (g x)) ==
      add (algebra analysis) (integral f) (integral g)
    integrable-negate :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable (\ x -> negate (algebra analysis) (f x))
    integral-negate :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integral (\ x -> negate (algebra analysis) (f x)) ==
      negate (algebra analysis) (integral f)
    integrable-absolute :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable
        (\ x -> absoluteValue (algebra analysis) (f x))
    integrable-of-dominated :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      MeasurableFunction events (borel analysis) f ->
      integrable g ->
      ((x : A) ->
        lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
          (absoluteValue (algebra analysis) (f x))
          (g x)) ->
      integrable f
    integral-monotone :
      (f g : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      integrable g ->
      ((x : A) ->
        lessOrEqual (algebra analysis) (f x) (g x)) ->
      lessOrEqual (algebra analysis) (integral f) (integral g)

    indicator-on :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      (x : A) ->
      E x ->
      indicator E x == oneR (algebra analysis)
    indicator-off :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Not (E x) ->
      indicator E x == zeroR (algebra analysis)
    indicator-integrable-iff-finite :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      Iff
        (integrable (indicator E))
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            measureValue measure-structure E ==
            finiteValue value))
    integral-indicator :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      (value : R) ->
      measureValue measure-structure E == finiteValue value ->
      integral (indicator E) == value
    integrable-restrict :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      integrable f ->
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      integrable
        (\ x ->
          multiply (algebra analysis)
            (indicator E x)
            (f x))

    -- Countable order-continuity distinguishes this Daniell-Lebesgue
    -- integral from a merely finitely additive positive functional.
    monotone-convergence :
      (sequence : Nat -> A -> R) ->
      (limit : A -> R) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> integrable (sequence n)) ->
      integrable limit ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        (x : A) ->
        lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
          (zeroR (algebra analysis))
          (sequence n x)) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        (x : A) ->
        lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
          (sequence n x)
          (sequence (suc n) x)) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        SequentialLimit
          (algebra analysis)
          (\ n -> sequence n x)
          (limit x)) ->
      SequentialLimit
        (algebra analysis)
        (\ n -> integral (sequence n))
        (integral limit)

open MeasureIntegration

setIntegral :
  {R A : Set}
  {analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  MeasureIntegration analysis events ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Predicate A ->
  R
setIntegral {analysis = analysis} integration f E =
  integral integration
    (\ x ->
      multiply (algebra analysis)
        (indicator integration E x)
        (f x))

IsSubalgebra :
  {A : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  Set1
IsSubalgebra smaller larger =
  (E : Predicate _) ->
  measurable smaller E ->
  measurable larger E

record IsFiltration
  {A : Set}
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (filtration : Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    contained-in-base :
      (n : Nat) ->
      IsSubalgebra (filtration n) base
    increasing :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      m <=N n ->
      IsSubalgebra (filtration m) (filtration n)

record SigmaFinite
  {R A : Set}
  {analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (integration : MeasureIntegration analysis base)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    events-contained-in-base :
      IsSubalgebra events base
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate A
    pieces-measurable :
      (n : Nat) -> measurable events (pieces n)
    pieces-finite-measure :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          measureValue
            (measure-structure integration)
            (pieces n) ==
          finiteValue value)
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> pieces n x)

SigmaFiniteFiltration :
  {R A : Set}
  {analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  MeasureIntegration analysis base ->
  (Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  Set1
SigmaFiniteFiltration integration filtration =
  (n : Nat) -> SigmaFinite integration (filtration n)

data ExtendedNat : Set where
  finite   : Nat -> ExtendedNat
  infinity : ExtendedNat

_<=T_ : ExtendedNat -> ExtendedNat -> Set
finite m <=T finite n = m <=N n
finite m <=T infinity = Top
infinity <=T finite n = Bottom
infinity <=T infinity = Top

IsStoppingTime :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  Set
IsStoppingTime filtration stoppingTime =
  (n : Nat) ->
  measurable (filtration n)
    (\ x -> stoppingTime x <=T finite n)

StoppingTimeOrder :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  (A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  Set
StoppingTimeOrder firstTime secondTime =
  (x : _) -> firstTime x <=T secondTime x

BoundedStoppingTime :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  Set
BoundedStoppingTime stoppingTime =
  Exists Nat
    (\ bound ->
      (x : _) -> stoppingTime x <=T finite bound)

stoppedValue :
  {R A : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  (A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  A ->
  R
stoppedValue analysis process stoppingTime x with stoppingTime x
... | finite n = process n x
... | infinity = zeroR (algebra analysis)

StronglyAdapted :
  {R A : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  (Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Set1
StronglyAdapted analysis filtration process =
  (n : Nat) ->
  MeasurableFunction
    (filtration n)
    (borel analysis)
    (process n)

ProcessIntegrable :
  {R A : Set}
  {analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  MeasureIntegration analysis base ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Set
ProcessIntegrable integration process =
  (n : Nat) -> integrable integration (process n)

record Submartingale
  {R A : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (integration : MeasureIntegration analysis base)
  (filtration : Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A)
  (process : Nat -> A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-adapted :
      StronglyAdapted analysis filtration process
    integrable-process :
      ProcessIntegrable integration process
    conditional-monotonicity :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      m <=N n ->
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable (filtration m) E ->
      lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
        (setIntegral integration (process m) E)
        (setIntegral integration (process n) E)

OptionalStoppingMonotonicity :
  {R A : Set} ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (integration : MeasureIntegration analysis base) ->
  (filtration : Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (process : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Set
OptionalStoppingMonotonicity {A = A}
  analysis base integration filtration process =
  (firstTime secondTime : A -> ExtendedNat) ->
  IsStoppingTime filtration firstTime ->
  IsStoppingTime filtration secondTime ->
  StoppingTimeOrder firstTime secondTime ->
  BoundedStoppingTime secondTime ->
  lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
    (integral integration
      (stoppedValue analysis process firstTime))
    (integral integration
      (stoppedValue analysis process secondTime))

fair-games-theorem-optional-stopping : Set1
fair-games-theorem-optional-stopping =
  (R A : Set) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (integration : MeasureIntegration analysis base) ->
  (filtration : Nat -> SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  IsFiltration base filtration ->
  SigmaFiniteFiltration integration filtration ->
  (process : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  StronglyAdapted analysis filtration process ->
  ProcessIntegrable integration process ->
  Iff
    (Submartingale analysis base integration filtration process)
    (OptionalStoppingMonotonicity
      analysis base integration filtration process)

title: 062_fair_games_theorem__optional_stopping
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Fair Games Theorem (Optional Stopping)"
  from Hundred Theorems item 062. It characterizes strongly adapted,
  integrable real-valued submartingales by monotonicity of expected stopped
  values at ordered bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;
open lebesgueTheory martingaleTheory probabilityTheory;

val fair_games_theorem_optional_stopping =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (a : num -> 'a algebra)
      (f : num -> 'a -> real).
      let strongly_adapted =
        \g : num -> 'a -> real.
          !n. g n IN measurable (a n) borel
      in
      let is_stopping_time =
        \tau : 'a -> num option.
          !n.
            ({x | ?k. tau x = SOME k /\ k <= n} INTER m_space m)
              IN subsets (a n)
      in
      let stopping_time_le =
        \tau pi : 'a -> num option.
          !x. x IN m_space m ==>
              case pi x of
                NONE => T
              | SOME j =>
                  case tau x of
                    NONE => F
                  | SOME i => i <= j
      in
      let bounded_stopping_time =
        \pi : 'a -> num option.
          ?N. !x. x IN m_space m ==>
                case pi x of
                  NONE => F
                | SOME n => n <= N
      in
      let stopped_value =
        \g : num -> 'a -> real.
        \tau : 'a -> num option.
        \x.
          case tau x of
            NONE => 0
          | SOME n => g n x
      in
        sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\
        strongly_adapted f /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o f n))
        ==>
        (sub_martingale m a (\n x. Normal (f n x)) <=>
         !tau pi.
           is_stopping_time tau /\
           is_stopping_time pi /\
           stopping_time_le tau pi /\
           bounded_stopping_time pi
           ==>
           expectation m (Normal o stopped_value f tau) <=
           expectation m (Normal o stopped_value f pi))``;

title: 062_fair_games_theorem__optional_stopping
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Fair Games Theorem (Optional Stopping)" from Hundred Theorems
  item 062. It includes the bounded-stopping-time characterization of submartingales and the
  martingale, submartingale, and supermartingale optional-stopping conclusions under each of
  the three standard sufficient conditions. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The definitions below are conservative abbreviations over set.mm objects.
  A probability space is P e. Prob, with event sigma-algebra dom P and sample
  space U. dom P. Real random variables use the set.mm construction rRndVar.

  HT062SimpleIntegral integrates a nonnegative finite-range measurable real
  function by summing its values times the P-measures of their fibers.
  HT062NnIntegral is the supremum, in the extended reals, of those simple
  integrals over all nonnegative simple functions bounded by its argument.
  HT062L1 P is exactly the real random variables whose absolute-value
  nonnegative integral is finite. HT062Integral P is the genuine signed real
  integral on that L1 domain, defined as the difference of the integrals of
  the positive and negative parts. Thus all expectations below are taken with
  respect to the arbitrary probability measure P; set.mm's itgm is not used.

  HT062Filtration says that F is an increasing sequence of sub-sigma-algebras
  of dom P, all on the same sample space. HT062Integrable says that every X_n
  belongs to HT062L1 P, and HT062Adapted says that X_n is measurable with
  respect to F_n.

  HT062Martingale expresses the usual conditional-expectation martingale law
  without taking conditional expectation as a primitive: for n <= m, X_n and
  X_m have equal integrals on every event of F_n. For integrable adapted real
  processes this is equivalent to E[X_m | F_n] = X_n almost surely.

  A stopping time T maps the sample space to NN0* = NN0 u. { +oo }, and
  { w | T(w) <= n } belongs to F_n for every n. HT062EverywhereBounded is the
  pointwise boundedness used by the Lean characterization. HT062Bounded allows
  a measurable null exceptional set and is the almost-sure boundedness used by
  condition (a) of the Rocq theorem. HT062Stopped evaluates X_(T(w))(w) at
  finite stopping values and uses zero at +oo, as in the Rocq source.

  The final $a assertions are the translated statements. There are no $p
  proof statements in this file.
$)

$c HT062Simple HT062SimpleIntegral HT062NnIntegral $.
$c HT062L1 HT062Integral $.
$c HT062Filtration HT062SigmaFinite HT062Integrable HT062Adapted $.
$c HT062Stopping HT062TimeLe HT062EverywhereBounded HT062Bounded HT062Finite $.
$c HT062UniformlyBounded HT062StoppingIntegrable $.
$c HT062BoundedIncrements HT062Conditions $.
$c HT062Martingale HT062Submartingale HT062Supermartingale HT062Stopped $.

ht062-simple-syntax $a wff ( HT062Simple P G ) $.
ht062-simple-integral-syntax $a class ( HT062SimpleIntegral P G ) $.
ht062-nn-integral-syntax $a class ( HT062NnIntegral P H ) $.
ht062-l1-syntax $a class ( HT062L1 P ) $.
ht062-integral-syntax $a class ( HT062Integral P ) $.
ht062-filtration-syntax $a wff ( HT062Filtration P F ) $.
ht062-sigma-finite-syntax $a wff ( HT062SigmaFinite P F ) $.
ht062-integrable-syntax $a wff ( HT062Integrable P X ) $.
ht062-adapted-syntax $a wff ( HT062Adapted F X ) $.
ht062-stopping-syntax $a wff ( HT062Stopping P F T ) $.
ht062-time-le-syntax $a wff ( HT062TimeLe P T U ) $.
ht062-everywhere-bounded-syntax $a wff ( HT062EverywhereBounded P T ) $.
ht062-bounded-syntax $a wff ( HT062Bounded P T ) $.
ht062-finite-syntax $a wff ( HT062Finite P T ) $.
ht062-uniformly-bounded-syntax $a wff ( HT062UniformlyBounded P X ) $.
ht062-stopping-integrable-syntax $a wff ( HT062StoppingIntegrable P T ) $.
ht062-bounded-increments-syntax $a wff ( HT062BoundedIncrements P X ) $.
ht062-conditions-syntax $a wff ( HT062Conditions P X T ) $.
ht062-martingale-syntax $a wff ( HT062Martingale P F X ) $.
ht062-submartingale-syntax $a wff ( HT062Submartingale P F X ) $.
ht062-supermartingale-syntax $a wff ( HT062Supermartingale P F X ) $.
ht062-stopped-syntax $a class ( HT062Stopped P X T ) $.

${
  $d G P x $.

  ht062-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Simple P G )
    <->
    (
      G e. ( dom P MblFnM BrSiga )
      /\
      (
        G : U. dom P --> RR
        /\
        (
          ran G e. Fin
          /\
          A. x e. U. dom P 0 <_ ( G ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G P y $.

  ht062-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    HT062SimpleIntegral P G
    =
    sum_ y e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( y x. ( P ` ( `' G " { y } ) ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H P g r x $.

  ht062-nn-integral-definition $a |- (
    HT062NnIntegral P H
    =
    sup
    (
      { r e. RR |
        E. g
          (
            ( HT062Simple P g )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom P ( g ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              r = ( HT062SimpleIntegral P g )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P h x $.

  ht062-l1-definition $a |- (
    HT062L1 P
    =
    { h e. ( rRndVar ` P ) |
      ( HT062NnIntegral P
        ( x e. U. dom P |-> ( abs ` ( h ` x ) ) )
      ) e. RR
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H P x $.

  ht062-integral-definition $a |- (
    HT062Integral P
    =
    ( H e. ( HT062L1 P ) |->
      (
        ( HT062NnIntegral P
          ( x e. U. dom P |->
            if ( 0 <_ ( H ` x ) , ( H ` x ) , 0 ) )
        )
        -
        ( HT062NnIntegral P
          ( x e. U. dom P |->
            if ( ( H ` x ) < 0 , -u ( H ` x ) , 0 ) )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P m n $.

  ht062-filtration-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Filtration P F )
    <->
    (
      F : NN0 --> ( sigAlgebra ` U. dom P )
      /\
      (
        A. n e. NN0 ( F ` n ) C_ dom P
        /\
        A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
          ( n <_ m -> ( F ` n ) C_ ( F ` m ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P f k n $.

  ht062-sigma-finite-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062SigmaFinite P F )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0 E. f
      (
        f : NN0 --> ( F ` n )
        /\
        (
          U. ran f = U. dom P
          /\
          A. k e. NN0 ( P ` ( f ` k ) ) e. RR
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P X n $.

  ht062-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Integrable P X )
    <->
    (
      X : NN0 --> ( rRndVar ` P )
      /\
      A. n e. NN0 ( X ` n ) e. ( HT062L1 P )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F X n $.

  ht062-adapted-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Adapted F X )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0
      ( X ` n ) e. ( ( F ` n ) MblFnM BrSiga )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P T n x $.

  ht062-stopping-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Stopping P F T )
    <->
    (
      T : U. dom P --> NN0*
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        { x e. U. dom P | ( T ` x ) <_ n } e. ( F ` n )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T U x $.

  ht062-time-le-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062TimeLe P T U )
    <->
    A. x e. U. dom P ( T ` x ) <_ ( U ` x )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T n x $.

  ht062-everywhere-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062EverywhereBounded P T )
    <->
    E. n e. NN0 A. x e. U. dom P ( T ` x ) <_ n
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T n x z $.

  ht062-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Bounded P T )
    <->
    E. n e. NN0 E. z e. dom P
      (
        ( P ` z ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom P \ z ) ( T ` x ) <_ n
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T x z $.

  ht062-finite-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Finite P T )
    <->
    E. z e. dom P
      (
        ( P ` z ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom P \ z ) ( T ` x ) e. NN0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P X k n x z $.

  ht062-uniformly-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062UniformlyBounded P X )
    <->
    E. k e. RR A. n e. NN0 E. z e. dom P
      (
        ( P ` z ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom P \ z )
          ( abs ` ( ( X ` n ) ` x ) ) < k
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T x $.

  ht062-stopping-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062StoppingIntegrable P T )
    <->
    (
      ( HT062Finite P T )
      /\
      ( x e. U. dom P |->
          if ( ( T ` x ) e. NN0 , ( T ` x ) , 0 )
      ) e. ( HT062L1 P )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P X k n x z $.

  ht062-bounded-increments-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062BoundedIncrements P X )
    <->
    E. k e. RR
      (
        0 <_ k
        /\
        A. n e. NN0 E. z e. dom P
          (
            ( P ` z ) = 0
            /\
            A. x e. ( U. dom P \ z )
              ( abs `
                (
                  ( ( X ` ( n + 1 ) ) ` x )
                  -
                  ( ( X ` n ) ` x )
                )
              ) <_ k
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T X $.

  ht062-conditions-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Conditions P X T )
    <->
    (
      ( HT062Bounded P T )
      \/
      (
        (
          ( HT062Finite P T )
          /\
          ( HT062UniformlyBounded P X )
        )
        \/
        (
          ( HT062StoppingIntegrable P T )
          /\
          ( HT062BoundedIncrements P X )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P X a m n x $.

  ht062-martingale-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Martingale P F X )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
      (
        n <_ m
        ->
        A. a e. ( F ` n )
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` m ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
          =
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` n ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P X a m n x $.

  ht062-submartingale-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Submartingale P F X )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
      (
        n <_ m
        ->
        A. a e. ( F ` n )
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` n ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
          <_
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` m ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P X a m n x $.

  ht062-supermartingale-definition $a |- (
    ( HT062Supermartingale P F X )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
      (
        n <_ m
        ->
        A. a e. ( F ` n )
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` m ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
          <_
          (
            ( HT062Integral P )
            `
            ( x e. U. dom P |->
              if ( x e. a , ( ( X ` n ) ` x ) , 0 ) )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T X x $.

  ht062-stopped-definition $a |- (
    HT062Stopped P X T
    =
    ( x e. U. dom P |->
      if
      (
        ( T ` x ) e. NN0 ,
        ( ( X ` ( T ` x ) ) ` x ) ,
        0
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P X t u $.

  hundred-theorems-062-submartingale-characterization $a |- (
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        ( HT062Filtration P F )
        /\
        (
          ( HT062SigmaFinite P F )
          /\
          (
            ( HT062Integrable P X )
            /\
            ( HT062Adapted F X )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    (
      ( HT062Submartingale P F X )
      <->
      A. t A. u
        (
          (
            ( HT062Stopping P F t )
            /\
            (
              ( HT062Stopping P F u )
              /\
              (
                ( HT062TimeLe P t u )
                /\
                ( HT062EverywhereBounded P u )
              )
            )
          )
          ->
          (
            ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( HT062Stopped P X t ) )
            <_
            ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( HT062Stopped P X u ) )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F P T X $.

  hundred-theorems-062-stopped-integrable $a |- (
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        ( HT062Filtration P F )
        /\
        (
          ( HT062Integrable P X )
          /\
          (
            ( HT062Adapted F X )
            /\
            (
              ( HT062Stopping P F T )
              /\
              ( HT062Conditions P X T )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    ( HT062Stopped P X T ) e. ( HT062L1 P )
  ) $.

  hundred-theorems-062-optional-stopping $a |- (
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        ( HT062Filtration P F )
        /\
        (
          ( HT062Integrable P X )
          /\
          (
            ( HT062Adapted F X )
            /\
            (
              ( HT062Martingale P F X )
              /\
              (
                ( HT062Stopping P F T )
                /\
                ( HT062Conditions P X T )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    (
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( HT062Stopped P X T ) )
      =
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( X ` 0 ) )
    )
  ) $.

  hundred-theorems-062-optional-stopping-sub $a |- (
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        ( HT062Filtration P F )
        /\
        (
          ( HT062Integrable P X )
          /\
          (
            ( HT062Adapted F X )
            /\
            (
              ( HT062Submartingale P F X )
              /\
              (
                ( HT062Stopping P F T )
                /\
                ( HT062Conditions P X T )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    (
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( X ` 0 ) )
      <_
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( HT062Stopped P X T ) )
    )
  ) $.

  hundred-theorems-062-optional-stopping-super $a |- (
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        ( HT062Filtration P F )
        /\
        (
          ( HT062Integrable P X )
          /\
          (
            ( HT062Adapted F X )
            /\
            (
              ( HT062Supermartingale P F X )
              /\
              (
                ( HT062Stopping P F T )
                /\
                ( HT062Conditions P X T )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    (
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( HT062Stopped P X T ) )
      <_
      ( ( HT062Integral P ) ` ( X ` 0 ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

title: 062_fair_games_theorem__optional_stopping
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact 062, "Fair Games
:: Theorem (Optional Stopping)": the set-integral characterization of
:: discrete-time submartingales over arbitrary measures with sigma-finite
:: filtrations, together with stopped-value integrability and fair-game
:: expectation conclusions under the standard hypotheses. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, PARTFUN1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ARYTM_3, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1,
      FUNCT_2, VALUED_0, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_2, NAT_1,
      CARD_3, CARD_1, ZFMISC_1, PROB_3, PROB_4, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3,
      FUNCOP_1, FINANCE1, FINANCE3, REAL_1, SETFAM_1, XCMPLX_0, ARYTM_1,
      VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, INTEGRA5, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, CARD_1,
      NUMBERS, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0,
      VALUED_0, SUPINF_2, PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_3, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, MESFUNC1,
      PROB_4, MESFUNC6, MESFUNC5, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FINANCE1,
      FINANCE3, REAL_1, VALUED_1, EXTREAL1, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 constructors REAL_1, MESFUNC6, MEASURE6, PROB_3, PROB_4, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC5, RELSET_1, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FINANCE1, FINANCE3,
      SETFAM_1, EXTREAL1, XXREAL_3, FUNCOP_1, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3,
      ORDINAL1, MEASURE1, FUNCOP_1, FINANCE1, FINANCE3, VALUED_0, FUNCT_2,
      RELAT_1, NUMBERS, PROB_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, CARD_1, MEMBERED,
      RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, XCMPLX_0;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, ARITHM, REAL;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, VALUED_0;
 equalities PROB_1, RANDOM_2, PROB_4, RELAT_1, FINANCE3;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1;

begin

:: Optional stopping characterization of real-valued submartingales.
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      M being sigma_Measure of Sigma,
      F being Filtration of NAT,Sigma,
      X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL)
  st
    (for n being Element of NAT holds
       ex E being Set_Sequence of El_Filtration(n,F) st
         (for k being Nat holds M.(E.k) < +infty) &
         Union E = Omega) &
    X is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
    (for n being Element of NAT,
         Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
      st Xn = X.n
      holds
        Xn is_integrable_on M &
        Xn is
          (El_Filtration(n,F),Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like)
  holds
    ((for n,m being Element of NAT,
          A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F),
          Xn,Xm being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
        st n <= m & Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
        holds
          Integral(M,Xn|A) <= Integral(M,Xm|A))
    iff
    (for tau,rho being Function of Omega,ExtREAL st
       (for w being Element of Omega holds
          tau.w = +infty or
            ex k being Nat st tau.w = k) &
       (for w being Element of Omega holds
          rho.w = +infty or
            ex k being Nat st rho.w = k) &
       (for n being Element of NAT holds
          ex A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F) st
            A = {w where w is Element of Omega : tau.w <= n}) &
       (for n being Element of NAT holds
          ex A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F) st
            A = {w where w is Element of Omega : rho.w <= n}) &
       (for w being Element of Omega holds tau.w <= rho.w) &
       (ex N being Nat st
          for w being Element of Omega holds rho.w <= N)
     holds
       ex Ztau,Zpi being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st
         Ztau is_integrable_on M &
         Zpi is_integrable_on M &
         (for w being Element of Omega holds
            (tau.w = +infty implies Ztau.w = 0) &
            (for k being Nat st tau.w = k holds
              Ztau.w = X.k.w)) &
         (for w being Element of Omega holds
            (rho.w = +infty implies Zpi.w = 0) &
            (for k being Nat st rho.w = k holds
              Zpi.w = X.k.w)) &
         Integral(M,Ztau) <= Integral(M,Zpi)))
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Fair-game, submartingale, and supermartingale stopped expectations under
:: the three sufficient hypotheses used in the Rocq formulation.
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      F being Filtration of NAT,Sigma,
      tau being Function of Omega,ExtREAL,
      X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL)
  st
    X is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
    (for n being Element of NAT,
         Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
      st Xn = X.n
      holds
        Xn is_integrable_on P &
        Xn is
          (El_Filtration(n,F),Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like) &
    (for w being Element of Omega holds
       tau.w = +infty or
         ex k being Nat st tau.w = k) &
    (for n being Element of NAT holds
       ex A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F) st
         A = {w where w is Element of Omega : tau.w <= n}) &
    ((ex N being Nat, A being Element of Sigma st
        P.A = 1 &
        (for w being Element of Omega st w in A holds
          ex k being Nat st tau.w = k & k <= N))
     or
     ((ex A being Element of Sigma st
         P.A = 1 &
         (for w being Element of Omega st w in A holds
           ex k being Nat st tau.w = k)) &
      (ex K being Real st
         for n being Element of NAT,
             Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
           st Xn = X.n holds
           ex A being Element of Sigma st
             P.A = 1 &
             (for w being Element of Omega st w in A holds
               |.Xn.w.| < K)))
     or
     (tau is_integrable_on P2M(P) &
      ex K being Real st
        for n being Element of NAT,
            Xn,Xs being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
          st Xn = X.n & Xs = X.(n+1) holds
          ex A being Element of Sigma st
            P.A = 1 &
            (for w being Element of Omega st w in A holds
              |.Xs.w - Xn.w.| <= K)))
  holds
    ex Z being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st
      Z is_integrable_on P &
      (for w being Element of Omega holds
        (tau.w = +infty implies Z.w = 0) &
        (for k being Nat st tau.w = k holds
          Z.w = X.k.w)) &
      (((for n,m being Element of NAT,
             A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F),
             Xn,Xm being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
           st n <= m & Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
           holds
             Integral(P2M(P),Xn|A) = Integral(P2M(P),Xm|A))
        implies
        (for X0 being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st X0 = X.0
          holds expect(Z,P) = expect(X0,P))) &
       ((for n,m being Element of NAT,
             A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F),
             Xn,Xm being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
           st n <= m & Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
           holds
             Integral(P2M(P),Xn|A) <= Integral(P2M(P),Xm|A))
        implies
        (for X0 being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st X0 = X.0
          holds expect(X0,P) <= expect(Z,P))) &
       ((for n,m being Element of NAT,
             A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F),
             Xn,Xm being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
           st n <= m & Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
           holds
             Integral(P2M(P),Xm|A) <= Integral(P2M(P),Xn|A))
        implies
        (for X0 being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st X0 = X.0
          holds expect(Z,P) <= expect(X0,P))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 062_fair_games_theorem__optional_stopping
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Fair Games Theorem (Optional Stopping)" from Hundred Theorems
% item 062: submartingales are characterized by monotone expected stopped values at ordered
% bounded stopping times, with the standard stopped-expectation conclusions. This file contains
% no proof.

fair_games_theorem_062: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  random_variable: TYPE = [sample_space -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  process: TYPE = [nat -> random_variable]
  filtration: TYPE = [nat -> sigma_algebra]

  stopping_instant: TYPE =
    [# time_is_finite: bool, time_index: nat #]
  stopping_time: TYPE = [sample_space -> stopping_instant]

  absolute_value(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN x ELSE -x ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (n: nat): events(n)(omega)

  event_subset(A, B: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space):
      A(omega) IMPLIES B(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < count AND j < count AND i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            absolute_value(values(n) - limit) < epsilon

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat): Sigma(events(n)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  sub_sigma_algebra(
      smaller, larger: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (A: event):
      smaller(A) IMPLIES larger(A)

  is_probability_measure(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(empty_event) = 0
      AND M(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          0 <= M(A) AND M(A) <= 1)
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (n: nat): Sigma(events(n)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (n: nat): M(events(n)),
                count),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  probability_space(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_probability_measure(M, Sigma)

  sigma_finite(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (n: nat):
        Sigma(cover(n)) AND 0 <= M(cover(n)) AND M(cover(n)) <= 1)
        AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          EXISTS (n: nat): cover(n)(omega))

  filtration_on(
      F: filtration,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        is_sigma_algebra(F(n))
          AND sub_sigma_algebra(F(n), Sigma))
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        i <= j IMPLIES sub_sigma_algebra(F(i), F(j)))

  sigma_finite_filtration(
      M: probability_measure,
      F: filtration): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      sigma_finite(M, F(n))

  sublevel_event(
      X: random_variable,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      X(omega) <= bound

  random_variable_on(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      Sigma(sublevel_event(X, bound))

  measurable_process(
      X: process,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      random_variable_on(Sigma, X(n))

  adapted(
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      random_variable_on(F(n), X(n))

  strongly_adapted(
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    adapted(X, F)

  positive_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) >= 0 THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  negative_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) <= 0 THEN -X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  restricted_variable(
      X: random_variable,
      A: event): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF A(omega) THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(omega)
            THEN coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  simple_integral(
      M: probability_measure,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_integral(M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1)
        + coefficients(count - 1) * M(pieces(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (k: nat):
        k < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(k) >= 0 AND Sigma(pieces(k)))
      AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        0 <= simple_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
          AND simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega) <= X(omega))

  nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      nonnegative_simple_minorant(
        Sigma, X, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        simple_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count) <= upper

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: sample_space): X(omega) >= 0)
      AND value >= 0
      AND nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, X, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, X, upper)
        IMPLIES value <= upper)

  has_expectation(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    random_variable_on(Sigma, X)
      AND EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: real):
        has_nonnegative_integral(
          M, Sigma, positive_part(X), positive_integral)
          AND has_nonnegative_integral(
            M, Sigma, negative_part(X), negative_integral)
          AND value = positive_integral - negative_integral

  integrable(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, value)

  integrable_process(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      integrable(M, Sigma, X(n))

  expectation_le(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (x_value, y_value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, x_value)
        AND has_expectation(M, Sigma, Y, y_value)
        AND x_value <= y_value

  expectation_equal(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (x_value, y_value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, x_value)
        AND has_expectation(M, Sigma, Y, y_value)
        AND x_value = y_value

  canonical_stopping_time(tau: stopping_time): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space):
      NOT time_is_finite(tau(omega))
        IMPLIES time_index(tau(omega)) = 0

  extended_time_le(s, t: stopping_instant): bool =
    IF time_is_finite(s) THEN
      NOT time_is_finite(t)
        OR time_index(s) <= time_index(t)
    ELSE
      NOT time_is_finite(t)
    ENDIF

  stopping_time_le(tau, pi: stopping_time): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space):
      extended_time_le(tau(omega), pi(omega))

  stopped_by_event(
      tau: stopping_time,
      n: nat): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      time_is_finite(tau(omega))
        AND time_index(tau(omega)) <= n

  stopping_time_wrt(
      tau: stopping_time,
      F: filtration): bool =
    canonical_stopping_time(tau)
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        F(n)(stopped_by_event(tau, n)))

  bounded_stopping_time(tau: stopping_time): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        time_is_finite(tau(omega))
          AND time_index(tau(omega)) <= bound

  almost_surely(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    Sigma(A) AND M(A) = 1

  almost_surely_bounded(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      tau: stopping_time): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      almost_surely(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
          time_is_finite(tau(omega))
            AND time_index(tau(omega)) <= bound)

  almost_surely_finite(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      tau: stopping_time): bool =
    almost_surely(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
        time_is_finite(tau(omega)))

  stopping_time_value(
      tau: stopping_time): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF time_is_finite(tau(omega))
        THEN time_index(tau(omega)) :: real
      ELSE 0
      ENDIF

  finite_expected_stopping_time(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      tau: stopping_time): bool =
    almost_surely_finite(M, Sigma, tau)
      AND integrable(M, Sigma, stopping_time_value(tau))

  stopped_value(
      X: process,
      tau: stopping_time): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF time_is_finite(tau(omega)) THEN
        X(time_index(tau(omega)))(omega)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  stopped_process(
      X: process,
      tau: stopping_time): process =
    LAMBDA (n: nat):
      LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
        IF time_is_finite(tau(omega))
             AND time_index(tau(omega)) <= n THEN
          X(time_index(tau(omega)))(omega)
        ELSE
          X(n)(omega)
        ENDIF

  submartingale(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat), (A: event):
        (i <= j AND F(i)(A))
        IMPLIES
          expectation_le(
            M,
            Sigma,
            restricted_variable(X(i), A),
            restricted_variable(X(j), A)))

  martingale(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat), (A: event):
        (i <= j AND F(i)(A))
        IMPLIES
          expectation_equal(
            M,
            Sigma,
            restricted_variable(X(i), A),
            restricted_variable(X(j), A)))

  supermartingale(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat), (A: event):
        (i <= j AND F(i)(A))
        IMPLIES
          expectation_le(
            M,
            Sigma,
            restricted_variable(X(j), A),
            restricted_variable(X(i), A)))

  uniformly_bounded_process(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        almost_surely(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
            absolute_value(X(n)(omega)) < bound)

  bounded_process_increments(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        almost_surely(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
            absolute_value(
              X(n + 1)(omega) - X(n)(omega)) <= bound)

  optional_stopping_conditions(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process,
      tau: stopping_time): bool =
    almost_surely_bounded(M, Sigma, tau)
      OR (almost_surely_finite(M, Sigma, tau)
        AND uniformly_bounded_process(M, Sigma, X))
      OR (finite_expected_stopping_time(M, Sigma, tau)
        AND bounded_process_increments(M, Sigma, X))

  characterization_context(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      F: filtration,
      X: process): bool =
    probability_space(M, Sigma)
      AND filtration_on(F, Sigma)
      AND sigma_finite_filtration(M, F)
      AND measurable_process(X, Sigma)
      AND strongly_adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)

  single_stop_context(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      F: filtration,
      X: process,
      tau: stopping_time): bool =
    probability_space(M, Sigma)
      AND filtration_on(F, Sigma)
      AND measurable_process(X, Sigma)
      AND adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)
      AND stopping_time_wrt(tau, F)
      AND optional_stopping_conditions(M, Sigma, X, tau)

  expected_stopped_value_mono: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau, pi: stopping_time):
      (characterization_context(M, Sigma, F, X)
        AND submartingale(M, Sigma, X, F)
        AND stopping_time_wrt(tau, F)
        AND stopping_time_wrt(pi, F)
        AND stopping_time_le(tau, pi)
        AND bounded_stopping_time(pi))
      IMPLIES
        expectation_le(
          M,
          Sigma,
          stopped_value(X, tau),
          stopped_value(X, pi))

  submartingale_optional_stopping_characterization: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process):
      characterization_context(M, Sigma, F, X)
      IMPLIES
        (submartingale(M, Sigma, X, F)
          IFF
            (FORALL (tau, pi: stopping_time):
              (stopping_time_wrt(tau, F)
                AND stopping_time_wrt(pi, F)
                AND stopping_time_le(tau, pi)
                AND bounded_stopping_time(pi))
              IMPLIES
                expectation_le(
                  M,
                  Sigma,
                  stopped_value(X, tau),
                  stopped_value(X, pi))))

  stopped_process_is_submartingale: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau: stopping_time):
      (characterization_context(M, Sigma, F, X)
        AND submartingale(M, Sigma, X, F)
        AND stopping_time_wrt(tau, F))
      IMPLIES
        submartingale(
          M, Sigma, stopped_process(X, tau), F)

  stopped_value_is_integrable: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau: stopping_time):
      single_stop_context(M, Sigma, F, X, tau)
      IMPLIES
        integrable(M, Sigma, stopped_value(X, tau))

  optional_stopping_martingale: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau: stopping_time):
      (single_stop_context(M, Sigma, F, X, tau)
        AND martingale(M, Sigma, X, F))
      IMPLIES
        expectation_equal(
          M, Sigma, stopped_value(X, tau), X(0))

  optional_stopping_submartingale: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau: stopping_time):
      (single_stop_context(M, Sigma, F, X, tau)
        AND submartingale(M, Sigma, X, F))
      IMPLIES
        expectation_le(
          M, Sigma, X(0), stopped_value(X, tau))

  optional_stopping_supermartingale: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process),
        (tau: stopping_time):
      (single_stop_context(M, Sigma, F, X, tau)
        AND supermartingale(M, Sigma, X, F))
      IMPLIES
        expectation_le(
          M, Sigma, stopped_value(X, tau), X(0))

  fair_games_theorem: bool =
    expected_stopped_value_mono
      AND submartingale_optional_stopping_characterization
      AND stopped_process_is_submartingale
      AND stopped_value_is_integrable
      AND optional_stopping_martingale
      AND optional_stopping_submartingale
      AND optional_stopping_supermartingale
END fair_games_theorem_062

title: 063_cantor_s_theorem
content:
/-
