title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule
content:
(*
  L'Hopital's rule for finite endpoints.

  The source development exposes 18 variants: approach from the right or
  left; denominator limit 0, +infinity, or -infinity; and derivative-ratio
  limit finite, +infinity, or -infinity.  This file states all 18 variants
  with their differentiability, continuity, and nonvanishing hypotheses.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition limit_div_pos
    (f : R -> R) (domain : R -> Prop) (point : R) : Prop :=
  forall bound,
    bound > 0 ->
    exists delta,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x,
        domain x ->
        R_dist x point < delta ->
        bound < f x.

Definition limit_div_neg
    (f : R -> R) (domain : R -> Prop) (point : R) : Prop :=
  forall bound,
    bound > 0 ->
    exists delta,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x,
        domain x ->
        R_dist x point < delta ->
        - bound > f x.

Record hopital_context
    (f g : R -> R) (a b : R) : Type := {
  hopital_interval_nonempty : a < b;
  hopital_num_derivable :
    forall x, open_interval a b x -> derivable_pt f x;
  hopital_den_derivable :
    forall x, open_interval a b x -> derivable_pt g x;
  hopital_num_continuous :
    forall x, a <= x <= b -> continuity_pt f x;
  hopital_den_continuous :
    forall x, a <= x <= b -> continuity_pt g x
}.

Arguments hopital_num_derivable {f g a b} _ _ _.
Arguments hopital_den_derivable {f g a b} _ _ _.

Definition derivative_ratio
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (x : R) (inside : open_interval a b x) : R :=
  derive_pt f x (hopital_num_derivable context x inside) /
  derive_pt g x (hopital_den_derivable context x inside).

Definition denominator_and_derivative_nonzero
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b) : Prop :=
  forall x (inside : open_interval a b x),
    derive_pt g x (hopital_den_derivable context x inside) <> 0 /\
    g x <> 0.

Definition denominator_derivative_nonzero
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b) : Prop :=
  forall x (inside : open_interval a b x),
    derive_pt g x (hopital_den_derivable context x inside) <> 0.

Definition derivative_ratio_finite_limit
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (point limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps,
    eps > 0 ->
    exists delta,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x (inside : open_interval a b x),
        R_dist x point < delta ->
        R_dist (derivative_ratio context x inside) limit < eps.

Definition derivative_ratio_pos_infinite
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (point : R) : Prop :=
  forall bound,
    bound > 0 ->
    exists delta,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x (inside : open_interval a b x),
        R_dist x point < delta ->
        bound < derivative_ratio context x inside.

Definition derivative_ratio_neg_infinite
    {f g a b} (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (point : R) : Prop :=
  forall bound,
    bound > 0 ->
    exists delta,
      delta > 0 /\
      forall x (inside : open_interval a b x),
        R_dist x point < delta ->
        - bound > derivative_ratio context x inside.

Section HopitalStatements.

Variables (f g : R -> R) (a b : R).

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lfin_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio_L : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context a L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lfin_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context b L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lfin_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context a L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lfin_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context b L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lfin_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context a L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lfin_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (L : R)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_finite_limit context b L) :
  limit1_in (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) L b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lpinf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lpinf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context b) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lninf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_neg_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_neg (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_g0_Lninf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zf : limit1_in f (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (Zg : limit1_in g (open_interval a b) 0 b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_and_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_neg_infinite context b) :
  limit_div_neg (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lpinf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lpinf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context b) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lninf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_neg_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_neg (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gpinf_Lninf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_pos g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_neg_infinite context b) :
  limit_div_neg (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lpinf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lpinf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_pos_infinite context b) :
  limit_div_pos (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lninf_right
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) a)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)
    (Hratio : derivative_ratio_neg_infinite context a) :
  limit_div_neg (fun x => f x / g x) (open_interval a b) a.
Proof.
Admitted.

Theorem Hopital_gninf_Lninf_left
    (context : hopital_context f g a b)
    (Zg : limit_div_neg g (open_interval a b) b)
    (g_nonzero : denominator_derivative_nonzero context)

title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule

(*
  Statement-only formalization of L'Hopital's rule from Hundred Theorems
  item 064. This is Isabelle/HOL's punctured-neighborhood zero-over-zero
  formulation. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory LHopitals_Rule
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem hundred_theorems_lhopital:
  fixes f g f' g' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and x :: real
  assumes f_zero: "(f \<longlongrightarrow> 0) (at x)"
    and g_zero: "(g \<longlongrightarrow> 0) (at x)"
    and g'_nonzero: "eventually (\<lambda>y. g' y \<noteq> 0) (at x)"
    and f_deriv: "eventually (\<lambda>y. DERIV f y :> f' y) (at x)"
    and g_deriv: "eventually (\<lambda>y. DERIV g y :> g' y) (at x)"
    and derivative_ratio:
      "filterlim (\<lambda>y. f' y / g' y) F (at x)"
  shows "filterlim (\<lambda>y. f y / g y) F (at x)"
  sorry

end

title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems corpus artifact 064,
;; "L'Hôpital's Rule": the two-sided real 0/0 rule at a finite point, with
;; supplied derivatives on a punctured neighborhood and convergence of the
;; derivative quotient. This file contains no proof.
;; Manual semantic audit (2026-09-06): retained as a historical candidate,
;; but not counted as a faithful standard-ACL2 translation. See
;; corpus-extension/semantic_canonical_resolutions.json for the blocker.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary sets and functions are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL
;; supplies unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a
;; constant-false function supplies internal existential quantification.
;; The scalar context is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a
;; presentation of the real field. Derivatives and limits are expanded below
;; by their epsilon-delta definitions; no analytic predicate is left
;; uninterpreted.

(defun ht064-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun ht064-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (ht064-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (ht064-quoted nil)))

(defun ht064-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (ht064-term-list arguments)))

(defun ht064-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (ht064-apply-term
   (ht064-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun ht064-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht064-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (ht064-quoted nil))
    (ht064-quoted t)))

(defun ht064-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (ht064-quoted t)
            (ht064-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (ht064-quoted nil)))

(defun ht064-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (ht064-quoted nil)
        (ht064-quoted t)))

(defun ht064-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (ht064-quoted t)))

(defun ht064-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht064-quoted t)))

(defun ht064-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (ht064-quoted nil)))

(defun ht064-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (ht064-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun ht064-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (ht064-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun ht064-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun ht064-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun ht064-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and arbitrary subsets of the real carrier.

(defun ht064-function-values-function (carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (ht064-static-apply-term
     carrier
     (list (ht064-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun ht064-real-function-p (carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-function-values-function carrier function)
    '(x))))

(defun ht064-set-subset-carrier-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-static-apply-term set '(x))
    (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x)))))

(defun ht064-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-set-subset-carrier-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun ht064-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (ht064-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (ht064-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (ht064-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (ht064-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht064-implies-term
      (ht064-and-terms
       (list
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht064-and-terms
       (list
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (ht064-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (ht064-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (ht064-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (ht064-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (ht064-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (ht064-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (ht064-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (ht064-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (ht064-quoted zero)))
        (ht064-implies-term
         (ht064-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (ht064-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (ht064-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (ht064-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (ht064-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (ht064-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun ht064-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (ht064-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (ht064-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (ht064-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (ht064-implies-term
      (ht064-and-terms
       (list
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (ht064-and-terms
       (list
        (ht064-not-term
         (ht064-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (ht064-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (ht064-implies-term
         (ht064-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (ht064-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (ht064-implies-term
         xy
         (ht064-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht064-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (ht064-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (ht064-implies-term
         (ht064-and-terms
          (list
           (ht064-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht064-quoted zero) 'x))
           (ht064-static-apply-term
            less (list (ht064-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (ht064-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (ht064-quoted zero)
           (ht064-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun ht064-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (ht064-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (ht064-not-term
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      less (list (ht064-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun ht064-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (ht064-member-p carrier upper)
   (ht064-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun ht064-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (ht064-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (ht064-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun ht064-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (ht064-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (ht064-exists-p
    (ht064-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun ht064-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'ht064-upper-bound-p
         (ht064-quoted carrier)
         (ht064-quoted less)
         (ht064-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun ht064-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (ht064-exists-p
   (ht064-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun ht064-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (list 'ht064-upper-bound-p
          (ht064-quoted carrier)
          (ht064-quoted less)
          (ht064-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (ht064-not-term
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (ht064-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun ht064-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (ht064-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun ht064-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht064-valid-set-p
            (ht064-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht064-set-nonempty-p
            (ht064-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'ht064-bounded-above-p
            (ht064-quoted carrier)
            (ht064-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'ht064-least-upper-bound-p
          (ht064-quoted carrier)
          (ht064-quoted less)
          'set
          (ht064-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun ht064-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (ht064-member-p carrier zero)
   (ht064-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (ht064-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Real-field context and arithmetic.

(defun ht064-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))
(defun ht064-r-sup (ctx) (nth 8 ctx))

(defun ht064-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 9)
   (ht064-real-field-p
    (ht064-r-carrier ctx)
    (ht064-r-zero ctx)
    (ht064-r-one ctx)
    (ht064-r-add ctx)
    (ht064-r-mul ctx)
    (ht064-r-neg ctx)
    (ht064-r-inv ctx)
    (ht064-r-lt ctx)
    (ht064-r-sup ctx))))

(defun ht064-r-add-value (ctx left right)
  (ht064-binary-value (ht064-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun ht064-r-neg-value (ctx value)
  (ht064-unary-value (ht064-r-neg ctx) value))

(defun ht064-r-sub-value (ctx left right)
  (ht064-r-add-value
   ctx left (ht064-r-neg-value ctx right)))

(defun ht064-r-mul-value (ctx left right)
  (ht064-binary-value (ht064-r-mul ctx) left right))

(defun ht064-r-inv-value (ctx value)
  (ht064-unary-value (ht064-r-inv ctx) value))

(defun ht064-r-div-value (ctx numerator denominator)
  (ht064-r-mul-value
   ctx numerator (ht064-r-inv-value ctx denominator)))

(defun ht064-r-lt-p (ctx left right)
  (if (ht064-binary-value
       (ht064-r-lt ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun ht064-r-le-p (ctx left right)
  (not (ht064-r-lt-p ctx right left)))

(defun ht064-r-abs-value (ctx value)
  (if (ht064-r-lt-p ctx value (ht064-r-zero ctx))
      (ht064-r-neg-value ctx value)
    value))

(defun ht064-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) value)
   (ht064-r-lt-p ctx (ht064-r-zero ctx) value)))

;; Closed and open intervals.

(defun ht064-ioo-set (ctx a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      (ht064-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      (ht064-r-lt ctx)
      (list (ht064-quoted a) 'x))
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      (ht064-r-lt ctx)
      (list 'x (ht064-quoted b)))))))

(defun ht064-icc-set (ctx a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (ht064-static-apply-term
      (ht064-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
     (ht064-not-term
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-r-lt ctx)
       (list 'x (ht064-quoted a))))
     (ht064-not-term
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-r-lt ctx)
       (list (ht064-quoted b) 'x)))))))

;; Continuity within the closed interval [a,b].

(defun ht064-continuity-point-function
    (ctx function a b x epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-icc-set ctx a b) '(y))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'y
                        (ht064-quoted x)))
            (ht064-quoted radius))))
    (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx)
          (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                      (ht064-quoted ctx)
                      (ht064-static-apply-term function '(y))
                      (ht064-static-apply-term
                       function
                       (list (ht064-quoted x)))))
          (ht064-quoted epsilon)))))

(defun ht064-continuity-radius-function
    (ctx function a b x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
           (ht064-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'ht064-universal-p
           (list 'ht064-continuity-point-function
                 (ht064-quoted ctx)
                 (ht064-quoted function)
                 (ht064-quoted a)
                 (ht064-quoted b)
                 (ht064-quoted x)
                 (ht064-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (ht064-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun ht064-continuity-epsilon-function
    (ctx function a b x)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'ht064-exists-p
          (list 'ht064-continuity-radius-function
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (ht064-quoted function)
                (ht064-quoted a)
                (ht064-quoted b)
                (ht064-quoted x)
                'epsilon)
          (ht064-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun ht064-continuous-on-row-function
    (ctx function a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-static-apply-term
     (ht064-icc-set ctx a b) '(x))
    (list 'ht064-universal-p
          (list 'ht064-continuity-epsilon-function
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (ht064-quoted function)
                (ht064-quoted a)
                (ht064-quoted b)
                'x)
          (ht064-quoted '(epsilon))))))

(defun ht064-continuous-on-icc-p
    (ctx function a b)
  (ht064-universal-p
   (ht064-continuous-on-row-function
    ctx function a b)
   '(x)))

;; HasDerivAt in epsilon-delta form:
;; |f(y)-f(x)-d*(y-x)| <= epsilon*|y-x| near x.

(defun ht064-derivative-point-function
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-r-carrier ctx) '(y))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'y
                        (ht064-quoted x)))
            (ht064-quoted radius))))
    (list 'ht064-r-le-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx)
          (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                      (ht064-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                            (ht064-quoted ctx)
                            (ht064-static-apply-term function '(y))
                            (ht064-static-apply-term
                             function
                             (list (ht064-quoted x))))
                      (list 'ht064-r-mul-value
                            (ht064-quoted ctx)
                            (ht064-quoted derivative)
                            (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                                  'y
                                  (ht064-quoted x)))))
          (list 'ht064-r-mul-value
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (ht064-quoted epsilon)
                (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                      (ht064-quoted ctx)
                      (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                            (ht064-quoted ctx)
                            'y
                            (ht064-quoted x))))))))

(defun ht064-derivative-radius-function
    (ctx function derivative x epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
           (ht064-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'ht064-universal-p
           (list 'ht064-derivative-point-function
                 (ht064-quoted ctx)
                 (ht064-quoted function)
                 (ht064-quoted derivative)
                 (ht064-quoted x)
                 (ht064-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (ht064-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun ht064-derivative-epsilon-function
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'ht064-exists-p
          (list 'ht064-derivative-radius-function
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (ht064-quoted function)
                (ht064-quoted derivative)
                (ht064-quoted x)
                'epsilon)
          (ht064-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun ht064-has-derivative-at-p
    (ctx function derivative x)
  (and
   (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) derivative)
   (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) x)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-derivative-epsilon-function
     ctx function derivative x)
    '(epsilon))))

(defun ht064-derivative-witness-function
    (ctx function x)
  (list
   'lambda '(derivative)
   (list 'ht064-has-derivative-at-p
         (ht064-quoted ctx)
         (ht064-quoted function)
         'derivative
         (ht064-quoted x))))

(defun ht064-differentiable-at-p
    (ctx function x)
  (ht064-exists-p
   (ht064-derivative-witness-function
    ctx function x)
   '(derivative)))

(defun ht064-differentiable-on-row-function
    (ctx function a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-static-apply-term
     (ht064-ioo-set ctx a b) '(x))
    (list 'ht064-differentiable-at-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx)
          (ht064-quoted function)
          'x))))

(defun ht064-differentiable-on-ioo-p
    (ctx function a b)
  (ht064-universal-p
   (ht064-differentiable-on-row-function
    ctx function a b)
   '(x)))

;; Two-sided punctured limits at a finite point.

(defun ht064-limit-point-function
    (ctx function c limit epsilon radius)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (ht064-quoted (ht064-r-zero ctx))
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'x
                        (ht064-quoted c))))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'x
                        (ht064-quoted c)))
            (ht064-quoted radius))))
    (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx)
          (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                      (ht064-quoted ctx)
                      (ht064-static-apply-term function '(x))
                      (ht064-quoted limit)))
          (ht064-quoted epsilon)))))

(defun ht064-limit-radius-function
    (ctx function c limit epsilon)
  (list
   'lambda '(radius)
   (ht064-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
           (ht064-quoted ctx) 'radius)
     (list 'ht064-universal-p
           (list 'ht064-limit-point-function
                 (ht064-quoted ctx)
                 (ht064-quoted function)
                 (ht064-quoted c)
                 (ht064-quoted limit)
                 (ht064-quoted epsilon)
                 'radius)
           (ht064-quoted '(x)))))))

(defun ht064-limit-epsilon-function
    (ctx function c limit)
  (list
   'lambda '(epsilon)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (list 'ht064-positive-real-p
          (ht064-quoted ctx) 'epsilon)
    (list 'ht064-exists-p
          (list 'ht064-limit-radius-function
                (ht064-quoted ctx)
                (ht064-quoted function)
                (ht064-quoted c)
                (ht064-quoted limit)
                'epsilon)
          (ht064-quoted '(radius))))))

(defun ht064-tends-to-at-p
    (ctx function c limit)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) c)
   (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) limit)
   (ht064-universal-p
    (ht064-limit-epsilon-function
     ctx function c limit)
    '(epsilon))))

;; The supplied derivative functions agree with the derivatives of f and g
;; throughout a fixed punctured neighborhood, and g' is nonzero there.

(defun ht064-derivative-neighborhood-row-function
    (ctx f g f-prime g-prime c d)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht064-implies-term
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (ht064-static-apply-term
       (ht064-r-carrier ctx) '(x))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (ht064-quoted (ht064-r-zero ctx))
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'x
                        (ht064-quoted c))))
      (list 'ht064-r-lt-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (list 'ht064-r-abs-value
                  (ht064-quoted ctx)
                  (list 'ht064-r-sub-value
                        (ht064-quoted ctx)
                        'x
                        (ht064-quoted c)))
            (ht064-quoted d))))
    (ht064-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'ht064-has-derivative-at-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (ht064-quoted f)
            (ht064-static-apply-term f-prime '(x))
            'x)
      (list 'ht064-has-derivative-at-p
            (ht064-quoted ctx)
            (ht064-quoted g)
            (ht064-static-apply-term g-prime '(x))
            'x)
      (ht064-not-term
       (list 'equal
             (ht064-static-apply-term g-prime '(x))
             (ht064-quoted (ht064-r-zero ctx)))))))))

(defun ht064-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (ctx f g f-prime g-prime c d)
  (ht064-universal-p
   (ht064-derivative-neighborhood-row-function
    ctx f g f-prime g-prime c d)
   '(x)))

(defun ht064-quotient-function
    (ctx numerator denominator)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (list 'ht064-r-div-value
         (ht064-quoted ctx)
         (ht064-static-apply-term numerator '(x))
         (ht064-static-apply-term denominator '(x)))))

;; HOL Light's LHOPITAL theorem: the full two-sided 0/0 form.
(defun hundred-theorems-064-lhopitals-rule-statement
    (ctx f g f-prime g-prime c limit d)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht064-context-p ctx)
    (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) c)
    (ht064-member-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) limit)
    (ht064-positive-real-p ctx d)
    (ht064-real-function-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) f)
    (ht064-real-function-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) g)
    (ht064-real-function-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) f-prime)
    (ht064-real-function-p (ht064-r-carrier ctx) g-prime)
    (ht064-derivative-neighborhood-p
     ctx f g f-prime g-prime c d)
    (ht064-tends-to-at-p
     ctx f c (ht064-r-zero ctx))
    (ht064-tends-to-at-p
     ctx g c (ht064-r-zero ctx))
    (ht064-tends-to-at-p
     ctx
     (ht064-quotient-function ctx f-prime g-prime)
     c
     limit))
   (ht064-tends-to-at-p
    ctx
    (ht064-quotient-function ctx f g)
    c
    limit)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact
-- hundred-theorems__agda__064, "L'Hôpital's Rule": in the zero-over-zero case,
-- a finite two-sided limit of the derivative quotient gives the same limit for
-- the original quotient.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtract reals center radius) x)
    (StrictLess reals x (add reals center radius))

LimitAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LimitAt {R} reals function limit point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((x : R) ->
          CloseTo reals point delta x ->
          x != point ->
          CloseTo reals limit epsilon (function x)))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point x =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (function x) (function point))
    (subtract reals x point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function derivative point =
  LimitAt reals
    (differenceQuotient reals function point)
    derivative
    point

l-hopitals-rule : Set1
l-hopitals-rule =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (f g f' g' : R -> R) ->
  (c L d : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) d ->
  ((x : R) ->
    CloseTo reals c d x ->
    x != c ->
    Both
      (DerivativeAt reals f (f' x) x)
      (Both
        (DerivativeAt reals g (g' x) x)
        (g' x != zeroR reals))) ->
  LimitAt reals f (zeroR reals) c ->
  LimitAt reals g (zeroR reals) c ->
  LimitAt reals
    (\ x -> divide reals (f' x) (g' x))
    L
    c ->
  LimitAt reals
    (\ x -> divide reals (f x) (g x))
    L
    c

title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "L'Hôpital's Rule" from Hundred Theorems
  artifact 064. For real functions tending to zero at a point, differentiable
  throughout a punctured neighborhood there with nonzero denominator
  derivative, convergence of the quotient of derivatives implies convergence
  of the quotient of the functions to the same finite limit. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory limTheory;

val lhopitals_rule =
  ``!f g f' g' c L d.
      0 < d /\
      (!x.
         0 < abs (x - c) /\ abs (x - c) < d
         ==>
         (f diffl (f' x)) x /\
         (g diffl (g' x)) x /\
         g' x <> 0) /\
      (f -> 0) c /\
      (g -> 0) c /\
      ((\x. f' x / g' x) -> L) c
      ==>
      ((\x. f x / g x) -> L) c``;

title: 064_l_hôpital_s_rule
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems item 064, "L'Hôpital's Rule":
% the two-sided real 0/0 limit rule relating a quotient to the quotient of
% specified nonvanishing denominator derivatives. This file contains no proof.

l_hopital_s_rule_064: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  tends_to_at(f: real_function, limit, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      epsilon > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (x: real):
              (0 < abs(x - point) AND abs(x - point) < delta)
                IMPLIES abs(f(x) - limit) < epsilon

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      epsilon > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (delta: real):
          delta > 0
            AND FORALL (h: real):
              (NOT (h = 0) AND abs(h) < delta)
                IMPLIES
                  abs(
                    safe_div(f(point + h) - f(point), h)
                      - derivative)
                    < epsilon

  l_hopital_s_rule: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, g, f_prime, g_prime: real_function),
        (point, limit, radius: real):
      (radius > 0
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          (0 < abs(x - point) AND abs(x - point) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              (has_derivative_at(f, f_prime(x), x)
                AND has_derivative_at(g, g_prime(x), x)
                AND NOT (g_prime(x) = 0)))
        AND tends_to_at(f, 0, point)
        AND tends_to_at(g, 0, point)
        AND tends_to_at(
          (LAMBDA (x: real): safe_div(f_prime(x), g_prime(x))),
          limit,
          point))
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_at(
          (LAMBDA (x: real): safe_div(f(x), g(x))),
          limit,
          point)
END l_hopital_s_rule_064

title: 065_isosceles_triangle_theorem
content:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Joseph Myers, Manuel Candales

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Affine.AddTorsor
public import Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Angle.Oriented.Affine
public import Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Angle.Unoriented.Affine
public import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

/-!
# Triangles

This file proves basic geometrical results about distances and angles
in (possibly degenerate) triangles in real inner product spaces and
Euclidean affine spaces. More specialized results, and results
developed for simplices in general rather than just for triangles, are
in separate files. Definitions and results that make sense in more
general affine spaces rather than just in the Euclidean case go under
`LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace`.

## Implementation notes

Results in this file are generally given in a form with only those
non-degeneracy conditions needed for the particular result, rather
than requiring affine independence of the points of a triangle
unnecessarily.

## References

* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law_of_cosines
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pons_asinorum
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sum_of_angles_of_a_triangle
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law_of_sines

-/

public section

noncomputable section

open scoped CharZero Real RealInnerProductSpace

namespace InnerProductGeometry

/-!
### Geometrical results on triangles in real inner product spaces

This section develops some results on (possibly degenerate) triangles
in real inner product spaces, where those definitions and results can
most conveniently be developed in terms of vectors and then used to
deduce corresponding results for Euclidean affine spaces.
-/

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]

/-- **Law of cosines** (cosine rule), vector angle form. -/
theorem norm_sub_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_sub_two_mul_norm_mul_norm_mul_cos_angle (x y : V) :
    ‖x - y‖ * ‖x - y‖ = ‖x‖ * ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ * ‖y‖ - 2 * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * Real.cos (angle x y) := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_mul_norm_eq_sin_angle_mul_norm (x y : V) :
    Real.sin (angle x y) * ‖x‖ = Real.sin (angle y (x - y)) * ‖x - y‖ := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_div_norm_eq_sin_angle_div_norm (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxy : x - y ≠ 0) :
    Real.sin (angle x y) / ‖x - y‖ = Real.sin (angle y (x - y)) / ‖x‖ := by sorry
theorem angle_sub_eq_angle_sub_rev_of_norm_eq {x y : V} (h : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖) :
    angle x (x - y) = angle y (y - x) := by sorry
theorem norm_eq_of_angle_sub_eq_angle_sub_rev_of_angle_ne_pi {x y : V}
    (h : angle x (x - y) = angle y (y - x)) (hpi : angle x y ≠ π) : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ := by sorry
theorem angle_eq_angle_add_add_angle_add (x : V) {y : V} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    angle x y = angle x (x + y) + angle y (x + y) := by sorry
theorem angle_add_angle_sub_add_angle_sub_eq_pi (x : V) {y : V} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    angle x y + angle x (x - y) + angle y (y - x) = π := by sorry
end InnerProductGeometry

namespace Orientation

open Module InnerProductGeometry

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (finrank ℝ V = 2)]
variable (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2))

/-- **Converse of pons asinorum**, oriented vector angle form (given equality of angles mod `π`). -/
theorem norm_eq_of_two_zsmul_oangle_sub_eq {x y : V}
    (h : (2 : ℤ) • o.oangle x (x - y) = (2 : ℤ) • o.oangle (y - x) y) (h0 : o.oangle x y ≠ 0)
    (hpi : o.oangle x y ≠ π) : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ := by sorry
end Orientation

namespace EuclideanGeometry

/-!
### Geometrical results on triangles in Euclidean affine spaces

This section develops some geometrical definitions and results on
(possibly degenerate) triangles in Euclidean affine spaces.
-/

open InnerProductGeometry
open scoped EuclideanGeometry

variable {V : Type*} {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P]
  [NormedAddTorsor V P]

/-- **Law of cosines** (cosine rule), angle-at-point form. -/
theorem dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_sub_two_mul_dist_mul_dist_mul_cos_angle (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) :
    dist p₁ p₃ * dist p₁ p₃ = dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₁ p₂ + dist p₃ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ -
      2 * dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ * Real.cos (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) :
    Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) * dist p₂ p₃ = Real.sin (∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) * dist p₃ p₁ := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_div_dist_eq_sin_angle_div_dist {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h23 : p₂ ≠ p₃) (h31 : p₃ ≠ p₁) :
    Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) / dist p₃ p₁ = Real.sin (∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) / dist p₂ p₃ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_dist_mul_sin_angle_div_sin_angle {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P}
    (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({p₁, p₂, p₃} : Set P)) :
    dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₃ p₁ * Real.sin (∠ p₂ p₃ p₁) / Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) := by sorry
theorem angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_of_angle_eq_angle_of_angle_ne_pi {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂)
    (hpi : ∠ p₂ p₁ p₃ ≠ π) : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_of_two_zsmul_oangle_eq [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)]
    [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : (2 : ℤ) • ∡ p₁ p₂ p₃ = (2 : ℤ) • ∡ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h0 : ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≠ 0) (hpi : ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≠ π) : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃ := by sorry
theorem angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi {p₁ p₂ : P} (p₃ : P) (h : p₂ ≠ p₁) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ + ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ + ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ = π := by sorry
theorem exterior_angle_eq_angle_add_angle {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (p : P) (h : Sbtw ℝ p p₁ p₂) :
    ∠ p₃ p₁ p = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂ + ∠ p₃ p₂ p₁ := by sorry
theorem oangle_add_oangle_add_oangle_eq_pi [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)]
    [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h21 : p₂ ≠ p₁) (h32 : p₃ ≠ p₂)
    (h13 : p₁ ≠ p₃) : ∡ p₁ p₂ p₃ + ∡ p₂ p₃ p₁ + ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ = π := by sorry
lemma angle_add_of_ne_of_ne {a b c p : P} (hb : a ≠ b) (hc : a ≠ c) (hp : Wbtw ℝ b p c) :
    ∠ b a p + ∠ p a c = ∠ b a c := by sorry
theorem dist_sq_mul_dist_add_dist_sq_mul_dist (a b c p : P) (h : ∠ b p c = π) :
    dist a b ^ 2 * dist c p + dist a c ^ 2 * dist b p =
    dist b c * (dist a p ^ 2 + dist b p * dist c p) := by sorry
theorem dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq (a b c : P) :
    dist a b ^ 2 + dist a c ^ 2 = 2 * (dist a (midpoint ℝ b c) ^ 2 + (dist b c / 2) ^ 2) := by sorry
theorem dist_mul_of_eq_angle_of_dist_mul (a b c a' b' c' : P) (r : ℝ) (h : ∠ a' b' c' = ∠ a b c)
    (hab : dist a' b' = r * dist a b) (hcb : dist c' b' = r * dist c b) :
    dist a' c' = r * dist a c := by sorry
theorem dist_lt_of_angle_lt {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b < ∠ a b c → dist a b < dist a c := by sorry
theorem angle_lt_iff_dist_lt {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b < ∠ a b c ↔ dist a b < dist a c := by sorry
theorem angle_le_iff_dist_le {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b ≤ ∠ a b c ↔ dist a b ≤ dist a c := by sorry
lemma pi_div_three_le_angle_of_le_of_le {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) : π / 3 ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ := by sorry
lemma pi_div_three_lt_angle_of_le_of_le_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (hne : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ∨ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ∨ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) :
    π / 3 < ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ := by sorry
lemma angle_le_pi_div_three_of_le_of_le {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) (hnd : p₁ ≠ p₂ ∨ p₁ ≠ p₃ ∨ p₂ ≠ p₃) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ π / 3 := by sorry
lemma angle_lt_pi_div_three_of_le_of_le_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂)
    (hne : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ∨ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ∨ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ < π / 3 := by sorry
end EuclideanGeometry

From HighSchoolGeometry Require Export mediatrice.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
 
Definition isocele (A B C : PO) : Prop := distance A B = distance A C.
 
Lemma isocele_permute : forall A B C : PO, isocele A B C -> isocele A C B.
Proof.
Admitted.
#[export] Hint Immediate isocele_permute: geo.
 
Lemma isocele_mediatrice :
 forall A B C : PO, isocele A B C -> mediatrice B C A.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma mediatrice_isocele :
 forall A B C : PO, mediatrice B C A -> isocele A B C.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma mediane_hauteur_isocele :
 forall A B C I : PO,
 I = milieu B C -> orthogonal (vec B C) (vec I A) -> isocele A B C.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma mediane_isocele_hauteur :
 forall A B C I : PO,
 I = milieu B C -> isocele A B C -> orthogonal (vec I A) (vec B C).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma hauteur_isocele_mediane :
 forall A B C I : PO,
 B <> C ->
 orthogonal (vec B C) (vec I A) ->
 isocele A B C -> alignes B C I -> I = milieu B C.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma isocele_mediane_bissectrice :
 forall A B C I : PO,
 A <> I ->
 B <> C ->
 I = milieu B C ->
 isocele A B C -> cons_AV (vec A B) (vec A I) = cons_AV (vec A I) (vec A C).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma isocele_angles_base :
 forall A B C : PO,
 A <> B ->
 A <> C ->
 B <> C ->
 isocele A B C -> cons_AV (vec B C) (vec B A) = cons_AV (vec C A) (vec C B).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma diametre_rectangle :
 forall A B C C' : PO,
 A <> B ->
 C' = milieu A B ->
 distance C' C = distance C' A -> orthogonal (vec C A) (vec C B).
Proof.
Admitted.

title: 065_isosceles_triangle_theorem
content:
(*
  File:    Triangle.thy
  Author:  Manuel Eberl <manuel@pruvisto.org>

  Sine and cosine laws, angle sum in a triangle, congruence theorems,
  Isosceles Triangle Theorem
*)

section \<open>Basic Properties of Triangles\<close>
theory Triangle
imports
  Angles
begin

text \<open>
  We prove a number of basic geometric properties of triangles. All theorems hold
  in any real inner product space.
\<close>
subsection \<open>Thales' theorem\<close>

theorem thales:
  fixes A B C :: "'a :: real_inner"
  assumes "dist B (midpoint A C) = dist A C / 2"
  shows   "orthogonal (A - B) (C - B)"
  by sorry

subsection \<open>Sine and cosine laws\<close>

text \<open>
  The proof of the Law of Cosines follows trivially from the definition of the angle,
  the definition of the norm in vector spaces with an inner product and the bilinearity
  of the inner product.
\<close>

lemma cosine_law_vector:
  "norm (u - v) ^ 2 = norm u ^ 2 + norm v ^ 2 - 2 * norm u * norm v * cos (vangle u v)"
  by sorry

lemma cosine_law_triangle:
  "dist b c ^ 2 = dist a b ^ 2 + dist a c ^ 2 - 2 * dist a b * dist a c * cos (angle b a c)"
  by sorry


text \<open>
  According to our definition, angles are always between $0$ and $\pi$ and therefore,
  the sign of an angle is always non-negative. We can therefore look at
  $\sin(\alpha)^2$, which we can express in terms of $\cos(\alpha)$ using the
  identity $\sin(\alpha)^2 + \cos(\alpha)^2 = 1$. The remaining proof is then a
  trivial consequence of the definitions.
\<close>
lemma sine_law_triangle:
  "sin (angle a b c) * dist b c = sin (angle b a c) * dist a c" (is "?A = ?B")
  by sorry


text \<open>
  The following forms of the Law of Sines/Cosines are more convenient for eliminating
  sines/cosines from a goal completely.
\<close>

lemma cosine_law_triangle':
  "2 * dist a b * dist a c * cos (angle b a c) = (dist a b ^ 2 + dist a c ^ 2 - dist b c ^ 2)"
  by sorry

lemma cosine_law_triangle'':
  "cos (angle b a c) = (dist a b ^ 2 + dist a c ^ 2 - dist b c ^ 2) / (2 * dist a b * dist a c)"
  by sorry

lemma sine_law_triangle':
  "b \<noteq> c \<Longrightarrow> sin (angle a b c) = sin (angle b a c) * dist a c / dist b c"
  by sorry

lemma sine_law_triangle'':
  "b \<noteq> c \<Longrightarrow> sin (angle c b a) = sin (angle b a c) * dist a c / dist b c"
  by sorry


subsection \<open>Sum of angles\<close>

context
begin

private lemma gather_squares: "a * (a * b) = a^2 * (b :: real)"
  by (simp_all add: power2_eq_square)

private lemma eval_power: "x ^ numeral n = x * x ^ pred_numeral n"
  by (subst numeral_eq_Suc, subst power_Suc) simp

text \<open>
  The proof that the sum of the angles in a triangle is $\pi$ is somewhat more
  involved. Following the HOL Light proof by John Harrison, we first prove
  that $\cos(\alpha + \beta + \gamma) = -1$ and $\alpha + \beta + \gamma \in [0;3\pi)$,
  which then implies the theorem.

  The main work is proving $\cos(\alpha + \beta + \gamma)$. This is done using the
  addition theorems for the sine and cosine, then using the Laws of Sines to eliminate
  all $\sin$ terms save $\sin(\gamma)^2$, which only appears squared in the remaining goal.
  We then use $\sin(\gamma)^2 = 1 - \cos(\gamma)^2$ to eliminate this term and apply
  the law of cosines to eliminate this term as well.

  The remaining goal is a non-linear equation containing only the length of the sides
  of the triangle. It can be shown by simple algebraic rewriting.
\<close>
lemma angle_sum_triangle:
  assumes "a \<noteq> b \<or> b \<noteq> c \<or> a \<noteq> c"
  shows   "angle c a b + angle a b c + angle b c a = pi"
  by sorry

end


subsection \<open>Congruence Theorems\<close>

text \<open>
  If two triangles agree on two angles at a non-degenerate side, the third angle
  must also be equal.
\<close>
lemma similar_triangle_aa:
  assumes "b1 \<noteq> c1" "b2 \<noteq> c2"
  assumes "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2"
  assumes "angle b1 c1 a1 = angle b2 c2 a2"
  shows   "angle b1 a1 c1 = angle b2 a2 c2"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  A triangle is defined by its three angles and the lengths of three sides up to congruence.
  Two triangles are congruent if they have their angles are the same and their sides have
  the same length.
\<close>

locale congruent_triangle =
  fixes a1 b1 c1 :: "'a :: real_inner" and a2 b2 c2 :: "'b :: real_inner"
  assumes sides':  "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2" "dist a1 c1 = dist a2 c2" "dist b1 c1 = dist b2 c2"
      and angles': "angle b1 a1 c1 = angle b2 a2 c2" "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2"
                   "angle a1 c1 b1 = angle a2 c2 b2"
begin

lemma sides:
  "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2" "dist a1 c1 = dist a2 c2" "dist b1 c1 = dist b2 c2"
  "dist b1 a1 = dist a2 b2" "dist c1 a1 = dist a2 c2" "dist c1 b1 = dist b2 c2"
  "dist a1 b1 = dist b2 a2" "dist a1 c1 = dist c2 a2" "dist b1 c1 = dist c2 b2"
  "dist b1 a1 = dist b2 a2" "dist c1 a1 = dist c2 a2" "dist c1 b1 = dist c2 b2"
  by sorry

lemma angles:
  "angle b1 a1 c1 = angle b2 a2 c2" "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2" "angle a1 c1 b1 = angle a2 c2 b2"
  "angle c1 a1 b1 = angle b2 a2 c2" "angle c1 b1 a1 = angle a2 b2 c2" "angle b1 c1 a1 = angle a2 c2 b2"
  "angle b1 a1 c1 = angle c2 a2 b2" "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle c2 b2 a2" "angle a1 c1 b1 = angle b2 c2 a2"
  "angle c1 a1 b1 = angle c2 a2 b2" "angle c1 b1 a1 = angle c2 b2 a2" "angle b1 c1 a1 = angle b2 c2 a2"
  by sorry

end

lemmas congruent_triangleD = congruent_triangle.sides congruent_triangle.angles



text \<open>
  Given two triangles that agree on a subset of its side lengths and angles that are
  sufficient to define a triangle uniquely up to congruence, one can conclude that they
  must also agree on all remaining quantities, i.e. that they are congruent.

  The following four congruence theorems state what constitutes such a uniquely-defining
  subset of quantities. Each theorem states in its name which quantities are required and
  in which order (clockwise or counter-clockwise): an ``s'' stands for a side,
  an ``a'' stands for an angle.

  The lemma ``congruent-triangleI-sas, for example, requires that two adjacent sides and the
  angle inbetween are the same in both triangles.
\<close>

lemma congruent_triangleI_sss:
  fixes a1 b1 c1 :: "'a :: real_inner" and a2 b2 c2 :: "'b :: real_inner"
  assumes "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2"
  assumes "dist b1 c1 = dist b2 c2"
  assumes "dist a1 c1 = dist a2 c2"
  shows   "congruent_triangle a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2"
  by sorry

lemmas congruent_triangle_sss = congruent_triangleD[OF congruent_triangleI_sss]

lemma congruent_triangleI_sas:
  assumes "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2"
  assumes "dist b1 c1 = dist b2 c2"
  assumes "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2"
  shows   "congruent_triangle a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2"
  by sorry

lemmas congruent_triangle_sas = congruent_triangleD[OF congruent_triangleI_sas]

lemma congruent_triangleI_aas:
  assumes "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2"
  assumes "angle b1 c1 a1 = angle b2 c2 a2"
  assumes "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2"
  assumes "\<not>collinear {a1,b1,c1}"
  shows   "congruent_triangle a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2"
  by sorry

lemmas congruent_triangle_aas = congruent_triangleD[OF congruent_triangleI_aas]

lemma congruent_triangleI_asa:
  assumes "angle a1 b1 c1 = angle a2 b2 c2"
  assumes "dist a1 b1 = dist a2 b2"
  assumes "angle b1 a1 c1 = angle b2 a2 c2"
  assumes "\<not>collinear {a1, b1, c1}"
  shows   "congruent_triangle a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2"
  by sorry

lemmas congruent_triangle_asa = congruent_triangleD[OF congruent_triangleI_asa]


subsection \<open>Isosceles Triangle Theorem\<close>

text \<open>
  We now prove the Isosceles Triangle Theorem: in a triangle where two sides have
  the same length, the two angles that are adjacent to only one of the two sides
  must be equal.
\<close>
lemma isosceles_triangle:
  assumes "dist a c = dist b c"
  shows   "angle b a c = angle a b c"
  by sorry


text \<open>
  For the non-degenerate case (i.e. the three points are not collinear), We also
  prove the converse.
\<close>
lemma isosceles_triangle_converse:
  assumes "angle a b c = angle b a c" "\<not>collinear {a,b,c}"
  shows   "dist a c = dist b c"
  by sorry


subsection\<open>Contributions by Lukas Bulwahn\<close>
  
lemma Pythagoras:
  fixes A B C :: "'a :: real_inner"
  assumes "orthogonal (A - C) (B - C)"
  shows "(dist B C) ^ 2 + (dist C A) ^ 2 = (dist A B) ^ 2"
  by sorry

lemma isosceles_triangle_orthogonal_on_midpoint:
  fixes A B C :: "'a :: euclidean_space"
  assumes "dist C A = dist C B"
  shows "orthogonal (C - midpoint A B) (A - midpoint A B)"
  by sorry

end

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Isosceles triangle theorem.                                               *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

needs "Multivariate/geom.ml";;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The theorem, according to Wikipedia.                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_THEOREM = `!A B C:real^N. dist(A,C) = dist(B,C) ==> angle(C,A,B) = angle(A,B,C)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The obvious converse.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_CONVERSE = `!A B C:real^N. angle(C,A,B) = angle(A,B,C) /\ ~(collinear {A,B,C})
                  ==> dist(A,C) = dist(B,C)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Some other equivalents sometimes called the ITT (see the Web page         *)
(* http://www.sonoma.edu/users/w/wilsonst/Courses/Math_150/Theorems/itt.html *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let lemma = `!A B C D:real^N.
        between D (A,B)
        ==> (orthogonal (A - B) (C - D) <=>
                angle(A,D,C) = pi / &2 /\ angle(B,D,C) = pi / &2)`;;

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_1 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        dist(A,C) = dist(B,C) /\ D = midpoint(A,B)
        ==> angle(A,C,D) = angle(B,C,D)`;;

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_2 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        between D (A,B) /\
        dist(A,C) = dist(B,C) /\ angle(A,C,D) = angle(B,C,D)
        ==> orthogonal (A - B) (C - D)`;;

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_3 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        between D (A,B) /\
        dist(A,C) = dist(B,C) /\ orthogonal (A - B) (C - D)
        ==> D = midpoint(A,B)`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Now the converses to those as well.                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_4 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        D = midpoint(A,B) /\ orthogonal (A - B) (C - D)
        ==> dist(A,C) = dist(B,C)`;;

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_5 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        ~collinear{D,C,A} /\ between D (A,B) /\
        angle(A,C,D) = angle(B,C,D) /\ orthogonal (A - B) (C - D)
        ==> dist(A,C) = dist(B,C)`;;

let ISOSCELES_TRIANGLE_6 = `!A B C D:real^N.
        ~collinear{D,C,A} /\ D = midpoint(A,B) /\ angle(A,C,D) = angle(B,C,D)
        ==> dist(A,C) = dist(B,C)`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of the hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__065, "Isosceles Triangle Theorem": in an arbitrary
;; real inner-product affine space, equal apex-side lengths imply equal base
;; angles, including degenerate point configurations. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent arbitrary scalar, vector, and affine
;; point carriers.  The predicates below state all typing and structural laws
;; used to interpret them as a real ordered field, an inner-product vector
;; space, and an affine torsor; no carrier is enumerated or finite-coded.

(defstub ht065-scalar-member-p (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ht065-vector-member-p (vector-type x) t)
(defstub ht065-point-member-p (point-type x) t)

(defstub ht065-zero-r (scalar-type) t)
(defstub ht065-one-r (scalar-type) t)
(defstub ht065-add-r (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub ht065-mul-r (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub ht065-opp-r (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ht065-inv-r (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ht065-le-r (scalar-type x y) t)

(defstub ht065-zero-v (scalar-type vector-type) t)
(defstub ht065-add-v (scalar-type vector-type x y) t)
(defstub ht065-opp-v (scalar-type vector-type x) t)
(defstub ht065-smul (scalar-type vector-type a x) t)
(defstub ht065-inner (scalar-type vector-type x y) t)

(defstub ht065-vadd
  (scalar-type vector-type point-type vector point)
  t)
(defstub ht065-vsub
  (scalar-type vector-type point-type left-point right-point)
  t)

(defun-sk ht065-point-carrier-nonempty-p (point-type)
  (exists (point)
    (ht065-point-member-p point-type point)))

(defun-sk ht065-ordered-field-laws-p (scalar-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type y)
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type z))
     (let ((zero (ht065-zero-r scalar-type))
           (one (ht065-one-r scalar-type)))
       (and
        (ht065-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (ht065-add-r scalar-type x y))
        (ht065-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x y))
        (ht065-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (ht065-opp-r scalar-type x))
        (ht065-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (ht065-inv-r scalar-type x))

        (equal
         (ht065-add-r scalar-type x y)
         (ht065-add-r scalar-type y x))
        (equal
         (ht065-add-r
          scalar-type (ht065-add-r scalar-type x y) z)
         (ht065-add-r
          scalar-type x (ht065-add-r scalar-type y z)))
        (equal (ht065-add-r scalar-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (ht065-add-r
          scalar-type x (ht065-opp-r scalar-type x))
         zero)

        (equal
         (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x y)
         (ht065-mul-r scalar-type y x))
        (equal
         (ht065-mul-r
          scalar-type (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x y) z)
         (ht065-mul-r
          scalar-type x (ht065-mul-r scalar-type y z)))
        (equal (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x one) x)
        (equal (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x zero) zero)
        (equal
         (ht065-mul-r
          scalar-type x (ht065-add-r scalar-type y z))
         (ht065-add-r
          scalar-type
          (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x y)
          (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x z)))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x
                       (ht065-inv-r scalar-type x))
          one))

        (ht065-le-r scalar-type x x)
        (implies
         (and
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type x y)
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type y x))
         (equal x y))
        (implies
         (and
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type x y)
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type y z))
         (ht065-le-r scalar-type x z))
        (or
         (ht065-le-r scalar-type x y)
         (ht065-le-r scalar-type y x))
        (implies
         (ht065-le-r scalar-type x y)
         (ht065-le-r
          scalar-type
          (ht065-add-r scalar-type x z)
          (ht065-add-r scalar-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type zero x)
          (ht065-le-r scalar-type zero y))
         (ht065-le-r
          scalar-type zero (ht065-mul-r scalar-type x y))))))))

(defun ht065-ordered-field-p (scalar-type)
  (and
   (ht065-scalar-member-p
    scalar-type (ht065-zero-r scalar-type))
   (ht065-scalar-member-p
    scalar-type (ht065-one-r scalar-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (ht065-zero-r scalar-type)
     (ht065-one-r scalar-type)))
   (ht065-ordered-field-laws-p scalar-type)))

(defun-sk ht065-vector-space-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type b)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type u)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type v)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type w))
     (let ((one (ht065-one-r scalar-type))
           (zero-v (ht065-zero-v scalar-type vector-type)))
       (and
        (ht065-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v))
        (ht065-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (ht065-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u))
        (ht065-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type a u))

        (equal
         (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
         (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type v u))
        (equal
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
          w)
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          u
          (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type v w)))
        (equal
         (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u zero-v)
         u)
        (equal
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          u
          (ht065-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u))
         zero-v)

        (equal
         (ht065-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          a
          (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v))
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type a v)))
        (equal
         (ht065-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-add-r scalar-type a b)
          u)
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type b u)))
        (equal
         (ht065-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-mul-r scalar-type a b)
          u)
         (ht065-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          a
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type b u)))
        (equal
         (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type one u)
         u))))))

(defun ht065-vector-space-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (ht065-vector-member-p
    vector-type (ht065-zero-v scalar-type vector-type))
   (ht065-vector-space-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

(defun-sk ht065-inner-product-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht065-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type u)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type v)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type w))
     (let ((zero-r (ht065-zero-r scalar-type))
           (zero-v (ht065-zero-v scalar-type vector-type)))
       (and
        (ht065-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type
         (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u v))
        (equal
         (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)
         (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type v u))
        (equal
         (ht065-inner
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
          w)
         (ht065-add-r
          scalar-type
          (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u w)
          (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type v w)))
        (equal
         (ht065-inner
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
          v)
         (ht065-mul-r
          scalar-type a
          (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)))
        (ht065-le-r
         scalar-type zero-r
         (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u u))
        (equal
         (equal
          (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u u)
          zero-r)
         (equal u zero-v)))))))

(defun ht065-inner-product-space-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (ht065-ordered-field-p scalar-type)
   (ht065-vector-space-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (ht065-inner-product-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

(defun-sk ht065-affine-torsor-laws-p
    (scalar-type vector-type point-type)
  (forall (u v p q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type u)
      (ht065-vector-member-p vector-type v)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type p)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type q)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type r))
     (let ((zero-v (ht065-zero-v scalar-type vector-type)))
       (and
        (ht065-point-member-p
         point-type
         (ht065-vadd
          scalar-type vector-type point-type u p))
        (ht065-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (ht065-vsub
          scalar-type vector-type point-type p q))

        (equal
         (ht065-vadd
          scalar-type vector-type point-type zero-v p)
         p)
        (equal
         (ht065-vadd
          scalar-type vector-type point-type
          (ht065-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
          p)
         (ht065-vadd
          scalar-type vector-type point-type
          u
          (ht065-vadd
           scalar-type vector-type point-type v p)))
        (equal
         (ht065-vadd
          scalar-type vector-type point-type
          (ht065-vsub
           scalar-type vector-type point-type p q)
          q)
         p)
        (equal
         (ht065-vsub
          scalar-type vector-type point-type
          (ht065-vadd
           scalar-type vector-type point-type u p)
          p)
         u)
        (equal
         (ht065-vsub
          scalar-type vector-type point-type p r)
         (ht065-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (ht065-vsub
           scalar-type vector-type point-type p q)
          (ht065-vsub
           scalar-type vector-type point-type q r))))))))

(defun ht065-affine-context-p
    (scalar-type vector-type point-type)
  (and
   (ht065-inner-product-space-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (ht065-point-carrier-nonempty-p point-type)
   (ht065-affine-torsor-laws-p
    scalar-type vector-type point-type)))

(defun ht065-norm-squared
    (scalar-type vector-type vector)
  (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type vector vector))

(defun ht065-distance-equal-p
    (scalar-type vector-type point-type p q r s)
  (equal
   (ht065-norm-squared
    scalar-type vector-type
    (ht065-vsub
     scalar-type vector-type point-type p q))
   (ht065-norm-squared
    scalar-type vector-type
    (ht065-vsub
     scalar-type vector-type point-type r s))))

;; In a real inner-product space an unoriented angle lies in [0, pi], so two
;; angles are equal exactly when their cosines are equal.  The cases below
;; compare
;;
;;   <u,v> / sqrt(<u,u><v,v>)
;;
;; without introducing square roots.  A zero ray has cosine zero, matching
;; the source libraries' pi/2 convention.  For nonzero denominators, equality
;; is equivalent to equal cross-multiplied squares together with equal signs.

(defun ht065-same-sign-p (scalar-type x y)
  (let ((zero (ht065-zero-r scalar-type)))
    (or
     (and
      (ht065-le-r scalar-type zero x)
      (ht065-le-r scalar-type zero y))
     (and
      (ht065-le-r scalar-type x zero)
      (ht065-le-r scalar-type y zero)))))

(defun ht065-vector-angle-equal-p
    (scalar-type vector-type u v x y)
  (let* ((zero (ht065-zero-r scalar-type))
         (dot-uv (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type u v))
         (dot-xy (ht065-inner scalar-type vector-type x y))
         (denom-uv-squared
          (ht065-mul-r
           scalar-type
           (ht065-norm-squared scalar-type vector-type u)
           (ht065-norm-squared scalar-type vector-type v)))
         (denom-xy-squared
          (ht065-mul-r
           scalar-type
           (ht065-norm-squared scalar-type vector-type x)
           (ht065-norm-squared scalar-type vector-type y))))
    (cond
     ((equal denom-uv-squared zero)
      (equal dot-xy zero))
     ((equal denom-xy-squared zero)
      (equal dot-uv zero))
     (t
      (and
       (ht065-same-sign-p scalar-type dot-uv dot-xy)
       (equal
        (ht065-mul-r
         scalar-type
         (ht065-mul-r scalar-type dot-uv dot-uv)
         denom-xy-squared)
        (ht065-mul-r
         scalar-type
         (ht065-mul-r scalar-type dot-xy dot-xy)
         denom-uv-squared)))))))

(defun ht065-angle-equal-p
    (scalar-type vector-type point-type
                 first-a vertex-a third-a
                 first-b vertex-b third-b)
  (ht065-vector-angle-equal-p
   scalar-type
   vector-type
   (ht065-vsub
    scalar-type vector-type point-type first-a vertex-a)
   (ht065-vsub
    scalar-type vector-type point-type third-a vertex-a)
   (ht065-vsub
    scalar-type vector-type point-type first-b vertex-b)
   (ht065-vsub
    scalar-type vector-type point-type third-b vertex-b)))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-065-isosceles-triangle-theorem-statement
    (scalar-type vector-type point-type)
  (forall (apex base-left base-right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht065-affine-context-p
       scalar-type vector-type point-type)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type apex)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type base-left)
      (ht065-point-member-p point-type base-right)
      (ht065-distance-equal-p
       scalar-type vector-type point-type
       apex base-left apex base-right))
     (ht065-angle-equal-p
      scalar-type vector-type point-type
      apex base-left base-right
      apex base-right base-left))))
