title: 086_lebesgue_measure_and_integration
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of corpus artifact hundred-theorems__agda__086,
-- "Lebesgue Measure and Integration": lower Lebesgue integration of ENNReal-valued
-- functions, outer-null almost-everywhere semantics, and set integrals defined by
-- canonical measure restriction on arbitrary measurable spaces. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Iff1 (A B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Exists1 (A : Set) (P : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor witness1
  field
    value1    : A
    property1 : P value1

record Exists2 (A : Set1) (P : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor witness2
  field
    value2    : A
    property2 : P value2

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
preimage f S x =
  S (f x)

MeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
MeasurableFunction source target f =
  (S : Predicate _) ->
  measurable target S ->
  measurable source (preimage f S)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    add-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (addR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == addR (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == addR (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record NNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nnreal
  field
    realValue : R
    nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NNReal

zeroNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NNReal reals
zeroNN reals =
  nnreal
    (zeroR reals)
    (order-reflexive reals (zeroR reals))

oneNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NNReal reals
oneNN reals =
  nnreal
    (oneR reals)
    (Both.first (zero-less-than-one reals))

addNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NNReal reals ->
  NNReal reals ->
  NNReal reals
addNN reals x y =
  nnreal
    (addR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))
    (add-nonnegative reals
      (realValue x)
      (realValue y)
      (nonnegative x)
      (nonnegative y))

multiplyNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NNReal reals ->
  NNReal reals ->
  NNReal reals
multiplyNN reals x y =
  nnreal
    (multiplyR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))
    (multiply-nonnegative reals
      (realValue x)
      (realValue y)
      (nonnegative x)
      (nonnegative y))

data ENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finite   : NNReal reals -> ENNReal reals
  infinity : ENNReal reals

zeroE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ENNReal reals
zeroE reals =
  finite (zeroNN reals)

oneE :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ENNReal reals
oneE reals =
  finite (oneNN reals)

record ENNRealStructure
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    lessOrEqualE : ENNReal reals -> ENNReal reals -> Set
    addE multiplyE : ENNReal reals -> ENNReal reals -> ENNReal reals

    finite-order :
      (x y : NNReal reals) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualE (finite x) (finite y))
        (lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))
    finite-le-infinity :
      (x : NNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE (finite x) infinity
    infinity-not-le-finite :
      (x : NNReal reals) ->
      Not (lessOrEqualE infinity (finite x))
    infinity-le-infinity :
      lessOrEqualE infinity infinity

    add-finite :
      (x y : NNReal reals) ->
      addE (finite x) (finite y) == finite (addNN reals x y)
    add-infinity-left :
      (x : ENNReal reals) ->
      addE infinity x == infinity
    add-infinity-right :
      (x : ENNReal reals) ->
      addE x infinity == infinity

    multiply-finite :
      (x y : NNReal reals) ->
      multiplyE (finite x) (finite y) ==
      finite (multiplyNN reals x y)
    multiply-infinity-zero-left :
      multiplyE infinity (zeroE reals) == zeroE reals
    multiply-infinity-zero-right :
      multiplyE (zeroE reals) infinity == zeroE reals
    multiply-infinity-positive-left :
      (x : NNReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      multiplyE infinity (finite x) == infinity
    multiply-infinity-positive-right :
      (x : NNReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      multiplyE (finite x) infinity == infinity
    multiply-infinity-infinity :
      multiplyE infinity infinity == infinity

    add-commutative :
      (x y : ENNReal reals) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : ENNReal reals) -> addE x (zeroE reals) == x
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : ENNReal reals) -> multiplyE x y == multiplyE y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      multiplyE (multiplyE x y) z == multiplyE x (multiplyE y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : ENNReal reals) -> multiplyE x (oneE reals) == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : ENNReal reals) -> multiplyE x (zeroE reals) == zeroE reals
    distribute :
      (x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      multiplyE x (addE y z) ==
      addE (multiplyE x y) (multiplyE x z)

    order-reflexive :
      (x : ENNReal reals) -> lessOrEqualE x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE x y ->
      lessOrEqualE y z ->
      lessOrEqualE x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE x y ->
      lessOrEqualE y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : ENNReal reals) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualE x y) (lessOrEqualE y x)
    zero-least :
      (x : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE (zeroE reals) x
    infinity-greatest :
      (x : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE x infinity
    add-monotone :
      (w x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE w x ->
      lessOrEqualE y z ->
      lessOrEqualE (addE w y) (addE x z)
    multiply-monotone :
      (w x y z : ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE w x ->
      lessOrEqualE y z ->
      lessOrEqualE (multiplyE w y) (multiplyE x z)

    supremum : Predicate (ENNReal reals) -> ENNReal reals
    supremum-upper :
      (P : Predicate (ENNReal reals)) ->
      (x : ENNReal reals) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualE x (supremum P)
    supremum-least :
      (P : Predicate (ENNReal reals)) ->
      (upper : ENNReal reals) ->
      ((x : ENNReal reals) -> P x -> lessOrEqualE x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualE (supremum P) upper

    borelE : SigmaAlgebra (ENNReal reals)
    borel-open-ray :
      (a : ENNReal reals) ->
      measurable borelE
        (\ x -> Both (lessOrEqualE a x) (a != x))
    borel-minimal :
      (candidate : SigmaAlgebra (ENNReal reals)) ->
      ((a : ENNReal reals) ->
        measurable candidate
          (\ x -> Both (lessOrEqualE a x) (a != x))) ->
      (S : Predicate (ENNReal reals)) ->
      measurable borelE S ->
      measurable candidate S
    nonzero-borel :
      measurable borelE (\ x -> x != zeroE reals)

open ENNRealStructure

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ENNRealStructure reals ->
  (Nat -> ENNReal reals) ->
  Nat ->
  ENNReal reals
sumFirst {reals = reals} extended terms zero =
  zeroE reals
sumFirst extended terms (suc n) =
  addE extended (sumFirst extended terms n) (terms n)

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ENNRealStructure reals ->
  (Nat -> ENNReal reals) ->
  Nat ->
  ENNReal reals
sumThrough extended terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThrough extended terms (suc n) =
  addE extended (sumThrough extended terms n) (terms (suc n))

record CountableSumValue
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (terms : Nat -> ENNReal reals)
  (value : ENNReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    partial-sum-upper :
      (n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended (sumFirst extended terms n) value
    least-upper-bound :
      (upper : ENNReal reals) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualE extended (sumFirst extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended value upper

record Measure
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass : Predicate A -> ENNReal reals

    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroE reals
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualE extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : ENNReal reals) ->
      CountableSumValue extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue

    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addE extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSumValue extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

MeasureLess :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ENNRealStructure reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set1
MeasureLess {extended = extended} {events = events} measure1 measure2 =
  (S : Predicate _) ->
  measurable events S ->
  lessOrEqualE extended
    (outerMass measure1 S)
    (outerMass measure2 S)

record MeasureRestriction
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    restrict :
      Measure extended events ->
      Predicate A ->
      Measure extended events
    restrict-outer-mass :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (restrict measure S) T ==
      outerMass measure (intersection T S)
    restrict-monotone :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      MeasureLess (restrict measure S) (restrict measure T)
    restrict-le-self :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      MeasureLess (restrict measure S) measure

open MeasureRestriction

OuterNull :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ENNRealStructure reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
OuterNull {reals = reals} measure S =
  outerMass measure S == zeroE reals

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ENNRealStructure reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere measure P =
  OuterNull measure (\ x -> Not (P x))

AlmostEqual :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ENNRealStructure reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
  (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
  Set
AlmostEqual measure f g =
  AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == g x)

PointwiseBelow :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ENNRealStructure reals ->
  (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
  (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
  Set
PointwiseBelow {A} extended f g =
  (x : A) -> lessOrEqualE extended (f x) (g x)

SequenceSupremum :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ENNRealStructure reals ->
  (Nat -> ENNReal reals) ->
  ENNReal reals ->
  Set
SequenceSupremum extended sequence limit =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) -> lessOrEqualE extended (sequence n) limit)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> lessOrEqualE extended (sequence n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended limit upper)

record SimpleFunction
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    function : A -> ENNReal reals
    cutoff : Nat
    values : Nat -> ENNReal reals
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate A

    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          Both
            (i <=N cutoff)
            (pieces i x))
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

record SimpleIntegralValue
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (simple : SimpleFunction {R = R} {reals = reals} events)
  (value : ENNReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    integral-equation :
      value ==
      sumThrough extended
        (\ i ->
          multiplyE extended
            (values simple i)
            (outerMass measure (pieces simple i)))
        (cutoff simple)

record LowerIntegralValue
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> ENNReal reals)
  (value : ENNReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple : SimpleFunction {R = R} {reals = reals} events) ->
      PointwiseBelow extended (function simple) f ->
      (simpleValue : ENNReal reals) ->
      SimpleIntegralValue extended events measure simple simpleValue ->
      lessOrEqualE extended simpleValue value
    least-upper-bound :
      (upper : ENNReal reals) ->
      ((simple : SimpleFunction {R = R} {reals = reals} events) ->
        PointwiseBelow extended (function simple) f ->
        (simpleValue : ENNReal reals) ->
        SimpleIntegralValue extended events measure simple simpleValue ->
        lessOrEqualE extended simpleValue upper) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended value upper

record MeasurableLowerEnvelope
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (lowerIntegral :
    Measure extended events ->
    (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
    ENNReal reals)
  (f g : A -> ENNReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    envelope-measurable :
      MeasurableFunction events (borelE extended) g
    envelope-below :
      PointwiseBelow extended g f
    same-lower-integral :
      lowerIntegral measure f == lowerIntegral measure g

SetLowerIntegral :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ENNRealStructure reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  MeasureRestriction extended events ->
  (Measure extended events ->
    (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
    ENNReal reals) ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
  ENNReal reals
SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure S f =
  lowerIntegral (restrict restrictions measure S) f

record LebesgueIntegration
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (restrictions : MeasureRestriction extended events)
  (lowerIntegral :
    Measure extended events ->
    (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
    ENNReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    lower-integral-definition :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure f
        (lowerIntegral measure f)

    measurable-lower-envelope :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      Exists1 (A -> ENNReal reals)
        (\ g ->
          MeasurableLowerEnvelope
            extended events measure lowerIntegral f g)

    indicator :
      Predicate A ->
      (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      A ->
      ENNReal reals
    indicator-on :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      indicator S f x == f x
    indicator-off :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Not (S x) ->
      indicator S f x == zeroE reals

    lower-integral-congruent :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f g : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      ((x : A) -> f x == g x) ->
      lowerIntegral measure f == lowerIntegral measure g
    lower-integral-congruent-ae :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f g : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      AlmostEqual measure f g ->
      lowerIntegral measure f == lowerIntegral measure g
    lower-integral-monotone :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f g : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      PointwiseBelow extended f g ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (lowerIntegral measure f)
        (lowerIntegral measure g)
    lower-integral-monotone-ae :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f g : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      AlmostEverywhere measure
        (\ x -> lessOrEqualE extended (f x) (g x)) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (lowerIntegral measure f)
        (lowerIntegral measure g)
    lower-integral-monotone-measure :
      (measure1 measure2 : Measure extended events) ->
      MeasureLess measure1 measure2 ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (lowerIntegral measure1 f)
        (lowerIntegral measure2 f)

    lower-integral-zero :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      lowerIntegral measure (\ _ -> zeroE reals) == zeroE reals
    lower-integral-constant :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (c : ENNReal reals) ->
      lowerIntegral measure (\ _ -> c) ==
      multiplyE extended c (outerMass measure wholeSet)
    set-lower-integral-constant :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (c : ENNReal reals) ->
      SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure S (\ _ -> c) ==
      multiplyE extended c (outerMass measure S)

    indicator-equals-restricted-integral :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      lowerIntegral measure (indicator S f) ==
      SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure S f
    set-integral-monotone :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure S f)
        (SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure T f)
    set-integral-le-total :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualE extended
        (SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure S f)
        (lowerIntegral measure f)
    set-integral-countable-additivity :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      CountableSumValue extended
        (\ n ->
          SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure (sets n) f)
        (SetLowerIntegral restrictions lowerIntegral measure
          (countableUnion sets) f)

    lower-integral-monotone-convergence :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (functions : Nat -> A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      (limitFunction : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        MeasurableFunction events (borelE extended) (functions n)) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        PointwiseBelow extended (functions n) (functions (suc n))) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        SequenceSupremum extended
          (\ n -> functions n x)
          (limitFunction x)) ->
      SequenceSupremum extended
        (\ n -> lowerIntegral measure (functions n))
        (lowerIntegral measure limitFunction)

    lower-integral-zero-iff-ae-zero :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      MeasurableFunction events (borelE extended) f ->
      Iff
        (lowerIntegral measure f == zeroE reals)
        (AlmostEqual measure f (\ _ -> zeroE reals))
    lower-integral-positive-iff-support-positive :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
      MeasurableFunction events (borelE extended) f ->
      Iff
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualE extended
            (zeroE reals)
            (lowerIntegral measure f))
          (lowerIntegral measure f != zeroE reals))
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualE extended
            (zeroE reals)
            (outerMass measure (\ x -> f x != zeroE reals)))
          (outerMass measure (\ x -> f x != zeroE reals) != zeroE reals))

    integrals-determine-measurable-mass :
      (measure1 measure2 : Measure extended events) ->
      Iff1
        ((f : A -> ENNReal reals) ->
          MeasurableFunction events (borelE extended) f ->
          lowerIntegral measure1 f == lowerIntegral measure2 f)
        ((S : Predicate A) ->
          measurable events S ->
          outerMass measure1 S == outerMass measure2 S)

lebesgue-measure-and-integration : Set1
lebesgue-measure-and-integration =
  (A R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (extended : ENNRealStructure reals) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  Exists2
    (MeasureRestriction extended events)
    (\ restrictions ->
      Exists2
        (Measure extended events ->
          (A -> ENNReal reals) ->
          ENNReal reals)
        (\ lowerIntegral ->
          LebesgueIntegration
            extended events restrictions lowerIntegral))

title: 086_lebesgue_measure_and_integration
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Lebesgue Measure and Integration" from Hundred Theorems
  item 086. It states the construction and fundamental normalization, monotonicity, indicator,
  linearity, and monotone-convergence laws for Lebesgue measure and integration. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;
open lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;

val lebesgue_measure_normalization =
  ``measure_space lebesgue /\
    (!a b.
       a <= b ==>
       measure lebesgue (interval [a,b]) = Normal (b - a)) /\
    (!s.
       s IN subsets borel ==>
       measure lebesgue s = lambda s)``;

val lower_lebesgue_integral_characterization =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> extreal).
      pos_fn_integral m f =
        sup
          {r |
             ?g.
               r IN psfis m g /\
               !x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x}``;

val lower_lebesgue_integral_indicator_and_monotonicity =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set)
      (f : 'a -> extreal) (g : 'a -> extreal).
      measure_space m /\
      s IN measurable_sets m /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <= g x)
      ==>
      pos_fn_integral m (indicator_fn s) = measure m s /\
      pos_fn_integral m f <= pos_fn_integral m g``;

val lower_lebesgue_monotone_convergence =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> extreal)
      (fi : num -> 'a -> extreal).
      measure_space m /\
      (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
      (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_increasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
      (!x.
         x IN m_space m ==>
         sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x)
      ==>
      pos_fn_integral m f =
        sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i)) UNIV)``;

val lebesgue_integral_linearity_and_monotonicity =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f g : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      integrable m (Normal o f) /\
      integrable m (Normal o g)
      ==>
      integrable m (\x. Normal (f x + g x)) /\
      integral m (\x. Normal (f x + g x)) =
        integral m (Normal o f) + integral m (Normal o g) /\
      ((!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <= g x) ==>
       integral m (Normal o f) <= integral m (Normal o g))``;

title: 086_lebesgue_measure_and_integration
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 086, "Lebesgue
  Measure and Integration". It states existence and uniqueness on measurable
  functions of the lower Lebesgue integral over every measure space, together
  with indicator normalization, monotonicity, additivity, almost-everywhere
  congruence, and monotone convergence. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  Measures and their sigma-algebras use the native set.mm representation:
  M e. U. ran measures, with measurable sets dom M and sample space
  U. dom M. Extended nonnegative values use the set.mm class
  ( 0 [,] +oo ), and +e and *e are the extended-real operations.

  HT086Measurable uses inverse images of finite lower rays, which generate the
  Borel sigma-algebra of ( 0 [,] +oo ). HT086AE is equality outside an
  internally quantified measurable null set. HT086PointwiseSup states that G
  is the pointwise supremum of a sequence H.

  HT086Laws characterizes a lower-integral functional on all
  ( 0 [,] +oo )-valued functions. The final assertion quantifies the integral
  witness internally and states uniqueness on measurable functions. Every
  declaration is an unproved $a statement; this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c HT086Measurable HT086AE HT086Indicator HT086PointwiseSup HT086Laws $.

ht086-measurable-syntax $a wff ( HT086Measurable M F ) $.
ht086-ae-syntax $a wff ( HT086AE M F G ) $.
ht086-indicator-syntax $a class ( HT086Indicator M S F ) $.
ht086-pointwise-sup-syntax $a wff ( HT086PointwiseSup M H G ) $.
ht086-laws-syntax $a wff ( HT086Laws M I ) $.

${
  $d F M r x $.

  ht086-measurable-definition $a |- (
    ( HT086Measurable M F )
    <->
    (
      F : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      A. r e. RR
        { x e. U. dom M | ( F ` x ) <_ r } e. dom M
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G M N x $.

  ht086-ae-definition $a |- (
    ( HT086AE M F G )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N ) ( F ` x ) = ( G ` x )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M S x $.

  ht086-indicator-definition $a |- (
    HT086Indicator M S F
    =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      if ( x e. S , ( F ` x ) , 0 ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H M n x y $.

  ht086-pointwise-sup-definition $a |- (
    ( HT086PointwiseSup M H G )
    <->
    (
      H : NN0 --> ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      (
        G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
        /\
        A. x e. U. dom M
          ( G ` x )
          =
          sup
          (
            { y e. ( 0 [,] +oo ) |
              E. n e. NN0 y = ( ( H ` n ) ` x )
            } ,
            RR* ,
            <
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G H I M N S c n x $.
  $d F G H I M S c n x $.
  $d F G H I M n x $.
  $d F G I M S c x $.
  $d F G I M x $.
  $d F I M N x $.
  $d F I M x $.
  $d I M S c x $.
  $d I M x $.

  ht086-laws-definition $a |- (
    ( HT086Laws M I )
    <->
    (
      I : ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M ) --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        ( I ` ( x e. U. dom M |-> 0 ) ) = 0
        /\
        (
          A. S e. dom M A. c e. ( 0 [,] +oo )
            ( I `
              ( HT086Indicator M S
                ( x e. U. dom M |-> c ) )
            )
            =
            ( c *e ( M ` S ) )
          /\
          (
            A. F A. G
              (
                (
                  F e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
                  /\
                  (
                    G e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
                    /\
                    A. x e. U. dom M
                      ( F ` x ) <_ ( G ` x )
                  )
                )
                ->
                ( I ` F ) <_ ( I ` G )
              )
            /\
            (
              A. F A. G
                (
                  (
                    ( HT086Measurable M F )
                    /\
                    ( HT086Measurable M G )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    I `
                    ( x e. U. dom M |->
                      ( ( F ` x ) +e ( G ` x ) ) )
                  )
                  =
                  ( ( I ` F ) +e ( I ` G ) )
                )
              /\
              (
                A. F A. G
                  (
                    (
                      F e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
                      /\
                      (
                        G e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
                        /\
                        ( HT086AE M F G )
                      )
                    )
                    ->
                    ( I ` F ) = ( I ` G )
                  )
                /\
                (
                  A. H A. G
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          A. n e. NN0
                            ( HT086Measurable M ( H ` n ) )
                          /\
                          A. n e. NN0 A. x e. U. dom M
                            ( ( H ` n ) ` x )
                            <_
                            ( ( H ` ( n + 1 ) ) ` x )
                        )
                        /\
                        ( HT086PointwiseSup M H G )
                      )
                      ->
                      ( I ` G )
                      =
                      sup
                      (
                        { y e. ( 0 [,] +oo ) |

title: 086_lebesgue_measure_and_integration
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 086, "Lebesgue Measure and Integration":
% extended-nonnegative measures on arbitrary measurable spaces, lower Lebesgue integration by
% measurable simple minorants, monotone convergence, and measurable-set measure restriction.
% This file contains no proof.

lebesgue_measure_and_integration_086: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [sample_space -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function_sequence: TYPE =
    [nat -> nonnegative_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: sample_space):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      (# infinite_flag := FALSE,
         finite_part := finite_part(left) + finite_part(right) #)
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      (# infinite_flag := FALSE,
         finite_part := finite_part(left) * finite_part(right) #)
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (n: nat): events(n)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < count AND j < count AND i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  measure_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)

  restricted_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      A: event): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (B: event):
      M(event_intersection(B, A))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      NOT infinite_flag(function_value(omega))
        AND finite_part(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  finite_simple_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_function(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
          function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    measure_space(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  pointwise_le(
      left, right: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(left)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(right)
      AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        measure_value_le(left(omega), right(omega)))

  increasing_function_sequence(
      functions: nonnegative_function_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index <= right_index IMPLIES
        pointwise_le(
          functions(left_index),
          functions(right_index))

  is_pointwise_supremum(
      functions: nonnegative_function_sequence,
      supremum_function: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(supremum_function)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        pointwise_le(functions(index), supremum_function))
      AND (FORALL (upper: nonnegative_function):
        (canonical_nonnegative_function(upper)
          AND (FORALL (index: nat):
            pointwise_le(functions(index), upper)))
        IMPLIES pointwise_le(supremum_function, upper))

  is_sequence_supremum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      supremum_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(supremum_value)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index))
          AND measure_value_le(
            values(index), supremum_value))
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        (canonical_measure_value(upper)
          AND (FORALL (index: nat):
            measure_value_le(values(index), upper)))
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(supremum_value, upper))

  restricted_function(
      A: event,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF A(omega) THEN
        function_value(omega)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_set_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    Sigma(A)
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M, Sigma,
        restricted_function(A, function_value),
        integral_value)

  lower_integral_exists_uniquely: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (function_value: nonnegative_function):
      (measure_space(M, Sigma)
        AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value))
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
          has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
        AND (FORALL (left_value, right_value: measure_value):
          (has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, function_value, left_value)
            AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, function_value, right_value))
          IMPLIES left_value = right_value)

  restricted_measure_is_measure: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (A: event):
      (measure_space(M, Sigma) AND Sigma(A))
      IMPLIES
        measure_space(
          restricted_measure(M, A), Sigma)

  lower_monotone_convergence: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (functions: nonnegative_function_sequence),
        (supremum_function: nonnegative_function):
      (measure_space(M, Sigma)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          measurable_nonnegative_function(
            Sigma, functions(index)))
        AND increasing_function_sequence(functions)
        AND is_pointwise_supremum(
          functions, supremum_function))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (integral_values: measure_value_sequence),
            (supremum_integral: measure_value):
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, functions(index),
              integral_values(index)))
            AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, supremum_function,
              supremum_integral)
            AND is_sequence_supremum(
              integral_values, supremum_integral)

  set_integral_restriction_identity: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (A: event),
        (function_value: nonnegative_function):
      (measure_space(M, Sigma)
        AND Sigma(A)
        AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (indicator_integral,
             restricted_measure_integral: measure_value):
          has_set_lower_lebesgue_integral(
            M, Sigma, A, function_value,
            indicator_integral)
            AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              restricted_measure(M, A), Sigma,
              function_value,
              restricted_measure_integral)
            AND indicator_integral
              = restricted_measure_integral

  lebesgue_measure_and_integration: bool =
    lower_integral_exists_uniquely
      AND restricted_measure_is_measure
      AND lower_monotone_convergence
      AND set_integral_restriction_identity
END lebesgue_measure_and_integration_086

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Desargues's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 087.
-- In the real projective plane, corresponding sides of two perspective triangles meet in
-- three collinear points, under the source's explicit nondegeneracy conditions.
-- This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

namespace Theorems100.Desargues

/-- A projective-plane point represented by nonzero homogeneous coordinates in `Real ^ 3`. -/
abbrev ProjectivePoint := {v : Fin 3 → ℝ // v ≠ 0}

/--
Three projective points are collinear exactly when their homogeneous coordinate vectors
are linearly dependent.
-/
def Collinear (a b c : ProjectivePoint) : Prop :=
  ∃ x y z : ℝ,
    (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, x * a.1 i + y * b.1 i + z * c.1 i = 0

/--
Desargues's theorem in the explicit incidence configuration used by the HOL Light source.
The triangles `A A'`, `B B'`, and `C C'` are perspective from `P`; `Q`, `R`, and `S`
are the intersections of corresponding sides.
-/
theorem desargues
    (A A' B B' C C' P Q R S : ProjectivePoint)
    (h_nondegenerate :
      ¬Collinear A' B S ∧
      ¬Collinear A P C ∧
      ¬Collinear A P R ∧
      ¬Collinear A C B ∧
      ¬Collinear A B R ∧
      ¬Collinear C' P A' ∧
      ¬Collinear C' P B ∧
      ¬Collinear C' P B' ∧
      ¬Collinear C' A' S ∧
      ¬Collinear C' A' B' ∧
      ¬Collinear P C A' ∧
      ¬Collinear P C B ∧
      ¬Collinear P A' R ∧
      ¬Collinear P B Q ∧
      ¬Collinear P Q B' ∧
      ¬Collinear C B S ∧
      ¬Collinear A' Q B')
    (h_incidence :
      Collinear P A' A ∧
      Collinear P B B' ∧
      Collinear P C' C ∧
      Collinear B C Q ∧
      Collinear B' C' Q ∧
      Collinear A R C ∧
      Collinear A' C' R ∧
      Collinear B S A ∧
      Collinear A' S B') :
    Collinear Q S R := sorry

end Theorems100.Desargues

From HighSchoolGeometry Require Export parallelisme_concours.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
 
Lemma triangle_droite_milieu_paralleles :
 forall A B C A' B' : PO,
 triangle A B C ->
 A' = milieu B C :>PO ->
 B' = milieu A C :>PO -> paralleles (droite A B) (droite A' B').
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma milieu_parallelogrammme :
 forall A B C D I : PO, vec A B = vec D C -> I = milieu A C -> I = milieu B D.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma milieu_parallelogrammme_rec:
 forall (A B C D I : PO), I = milieu A C -> I = milieu B D ->  vec A B = vec D C.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma caract_milieu_parallelogramme:
 forall (A B C D : PO),  (milieu A C = milieu B D <-> parallelogramme A B C D).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Thales_PP :
 forall A B C D : PO,
 A <> C ->
 B <> D ->
 paralleles (droite A C) (droite B D) ->
 exists k : R,
   add_PP (cons 1 A) (cons k B) = add_PP (cons 1 C) (cons k D) :>PP.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma reciproque_Thales_PP :
 forall (A B C D : PO) (k : R),
 A <> C :>PO ->
 B <> D :>PO ->
 add_PP (cons 1 A) (cons k B) = add_PP (cons 1 C) (cons k D) ->
 paralleles (droite A C) (droite B D).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Theorem Thales_expl :
 forall A B C D : PO,
 A <> C :>PO ->
 B <> D :>PO ->
 paralleles (droite A C) (droite B D) ->
 vec B A = vec D C \/
 (exists k : R,
    (exists I : PO,
       vec I A = mult_PP k (vec I B) /\ vec I C = mult_PP k (vec I D))).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Theorem reciproque_Thales_expl :
 forall (A B C D I : PO) (k : R),
 A <> C :>PO ->
 B <> D :>PO ->
 vec I A = mult_PP k (vec I B) :>PP ->
 vec I C = mult_PP k (vec I D) :>PP -> paralleles (droite A C) (droite B D).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma trapeze_complet_PP :
 forall A B C D I J : PO,
 A <> B :>PO ->
 C <> D :>PO ->
 paralleles (droite A B) (droite C D) ->
 I = milieu C D ->
 J = milieu A B ->
 ex
   (fun k : R =>
    add_PP (cons 1 A) (cons k C) = add_PP (cons 1 B) (cons k D) :>PP /\
    add_PP (cons 1 A) (cons k C) = add_PP (cons 1 J) (cons k I) :>PP).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma trapeze_complet_expl :
 forall A B C D I J : PO,
 A <> B :>PO ->
 C <> D :>PO ->
 paralleles (droite A B) (droite C D) ->
 I = milieu C D ->
 J = milieu A B ->
 vec C A = vec D B /\ vec C A = vec I J \/ concours_3 A C B D J I.
Proof.
Admitted.
#[export] Hint Immediate paralleles_ABBA paralleles_sym: geo.
 
Lemma trapeze_complet_expl2 :
 forall A B C D I J : PO,
 A <> B :>PO ->
 C <> D :>PO ->
 paralleles (droite A B) (droite C D) ->
 I = milieu C D ->
 J = milieu A B ->
 vec D A = vec C B /\ vec D A = vec I J \/ concours_3 A D B C J I.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Theorem Desargues :
 forall A B C A1 B1 C1 S : PO,
 C <> C1 ->
 B <> B1 ->
 C <> S ->
 B <> S ->
 C1 <> S ->
 B1 <> S ->
 A1 <> B1 ->
 A1 <> C1 ->
 B <> C ->
 B1 <> C1 ->
 triangle A A1 B ->
 triangle A A1 C ->
 alignes A A1 S ->
 alignes B B1 S ->
 alignes C C1 S ->
 paralleles (droite A B) (droite A1 B1) ->
 paralleles (droite A C) (droite A1 C1) ->
 paralleles (droite B C) (droite B1 C1).
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma Thales_concours :
 forall (k : R) (A B C I J : PO),
 triangle A B C ->
 k <> 0 :>R ->
 vec A I = mult_PP k (vec A B) :>PP ->
 paralleles (droite B C) (droite I J) ->
 alignes A C J -> vec A J = mult_PP k (vec A C) :>PP.
Proof.
Admitted.
 
Lemma reciproque_droite_milieu :
 forall A B C I J : PO,
 triangle A B C ->
 I = milieu A B :>PO ->
 paralleles (droite B C) (droite I J) -> alignes A C J -> J = milieu A C :>PO.
Proof.
Admitted.

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Desargues's theorem from Hundred Theorems
  item 087. Points use homogeneous coordinates, and collinearity is the
  vanishing of the corresponding 3-by-3 determinant. The nondegeneracy and
  incidence hypotheses match the HOL Light benchmark. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Desargues_Theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

datatype projective_point = Projective_Point real real real

fun bracket ::
    "projective_point \<Rightarrow> projective_point \<Rightarrow>
      projective_point \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "bracket (Projective_Point x1 x2 x3)
        (Projective_Point y1 y2 y3)
        (Projective_Point z1 z2 z3) =
      x1 * (y2 * z3 - y3 * z2)
        - x2 * (y1 * z3 - y3 * z1)
        + x3 * (y1 * z2 - y2 * z1)"

definition collinear ::
    "projective_point \<Rightarrow> projective_point \<Rightarrow>
      projective_point \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "collinear A B C \<longleftrightarrow> bracket A B C = 0"

theorem desargues_direct:
  fixes A A' B B' C C' P Q R S :: projective_point
  assumes "\<not> collinear A' B S"
    and "\<not> collinear A P C"
    and "\<not> collinear A P R"
    and "\<not> collinear A C B"
    and "\<not> collinear A B R"
    and "\<not> collinear C' P A'"
    and "\<not> collinear C' P B"
    and "\<not> collinear C' P B'"
    and "\<not> collinear C' A' S"
    and "\<not> collinear C' A' B'"
    and "\<not> collinear P C A'"
    and "\<not> collinear P C B"
    and "\<not> collinear P A' R"
    and "\<not> collinear P B Q"
    and "\<not> collinear P Q B'"
    and "\<not> collinear C B S"
    and "\<not> collinear A' Q B'"
    and "collinear P A' A"
    and "collinear P B B'"
    and "collinear P C' C"
    and "collinear B C Q"
    and "collinear B' C' Q"
    and "collinear A R C"
    and "collinear A' C' R"
    and "collinear B S A"
    and "collinear A' S B'"
  shows "collinear Q S R"
  sorry

end

087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 087,
;; "Desargues's Theorem": in a projective plane over an arbitrary
;; commutative field, corresponding intersections of two perspective
;; triangles are collinear.  Points use nonzero homogeneous coordinates.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defstub ht087-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht087-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht087-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht087-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht087-inverse-op (x) t)

(defun ht087-member-p (x)
  (if (ht087-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht087-add (x y)
  (ht087-add-op x y))

(defun ht087-mul (x y)
  (ht087-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht087-neg (x)
  (ht087-negate-op x))

(defun ht087-inv (x)
  (ht087-inverse-op x))

(defun ht087-sub (x y)
  (ht087-add x (ht087-neg y)))

(defun-sk ht087-field-laws-p (zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht087-member-p x)
      (ht087-member-p y)
      (ht087-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht087-member-p (ht087-add x y))
      (ht087-member-p (ht087-mul x y))
      (ht087-member-p (ht087-neg x))
      (ht087-member-p (ht087-inv x))
      (equal (ht087-add (ht087-add x y) z)
             (ht087-add x (ht087-add y z)))
      (equal (ht087-add x y) (ht087-add y x))
      (equal (ht087-add x zero) x)
      (equal (ht087-add x (ht087-neg x)) zero)
      (equal (ht087-mul (ht087-mul x y) z)
             (ht087-mul x (ht087-mul y z)))
      (equal (ht087-mul x y) (ht087-mul y x))
      (equal (ht087-mul x one) x)
      (equal (ht087-inv zero) zero)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal (ht087-mul x (ht087-inv x)) one))
      (equal
       (ht087-mul x (ht087-add y z))
       (ht087-add (ht087-mul x y)
                  (ht087-mul x z)))))))

(defun ht087-field-p (zero one)
  (and
   (ht087-member-p zero)
   (ht087-member-p one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (ht087-field-laws-p zero one)))

(defun ht087-point-p (zero point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 3)
   (ht087-member-p (nth 0 point))
   (ht087-member-p (nth 1 point))
   (ht087-member-p (nth 2 point))
   (or
    (not (equal (nth 0 point) zero))
    (not (equal (nth 1 point) zero))
    (not (equal (nth 2 point) zero)))))

(defun ht087-all-points-p (zero points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and
       (ht087-point-p zero (car points))
       (ht087-all-points-p zero (cdr points)))
    (equal points nil)))

(defun ht087-determinant (p q r)
  (ht087-add
   (ht087-sub
    (ht087-mul
     (nth 0 p)
     (ht087-sub
      (ht087-mul (nth 1 q) (nth 2 r))
      (ht087-mul (nth 2 q) (nth 1 r))))
    (ht087-mul
     (nth 1 p)
     (ht087-sub
      (ht087-mul (nth 0 q) (nth 2 r))
      (ht087-mul (nth 2 q) (nth 0 r)))))
   (ht087-mul
    (nth 2 p)
    (ht087-sub
     (ht087-mul (nth 0 q) (nth 1 r))
     (ht087-mul (nth 1 q) (nth 0 r))))))

(defun ht087-collinear-p (zero p q r)
  (equal (ht087-determinant p q r) zero))

(defun hundred-theorems-087-desargues-statement
    (zero one a a1 b b1 c c1 p q r s)
  (implies
   (and
    (ht087-field-p zero one)
    (ht087-all-points-p
     zero (list a a1 b b1 c c1 p q r s))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a1 b s))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a p c))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a p r))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a c b))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a b r))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c1 p a1))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c1 p b))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c1 p b1))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c1 a1 s))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c1 a1 b1))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero p c a1))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero p c b))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero p a1 r))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero p b q))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero p q b1))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero c b s))
    (not (ht087-collinear-p zero a1 q b1))
    (ht087-collinear-p zero p a1 a)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero p b b1)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero p c1 c)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero b c q)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero b1 c1 q)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero a r c)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero a1 c1 r)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero b s a)
    (ht087-collinear-p zero a1 s b1))
   (ht087-collinear-p zero q s r)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "Desargues's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems
-- artifact hundred-theorems__agda__087: the projective ten-point collinearity
-- formulation and the affine parallel-side formulation. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Natural : Set where
  natZero : Natural
  natSuc  : Natural -> Natural

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zero one : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Natural -> R

    one-not-zero :
      one != zero

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zero == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zero

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x one == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zero == zero
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zero ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == one

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y or lessOrEqual y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zero x ->
      lessOrEqual zero y ->
      lessOrEqual zero (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zero one and zero != one

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat natZero == zero
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Natural) -> fromNat (natSuc n) == add (fromNat n) one
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Natural (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

record ProjectivePoint
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set where

  constructor projective
  field
    x3 : R
    y3 : R
    z3 : R
    nonzero :
      Not
        (x3 == zero reals
         and y3 == zero reals
         and z3 == zero reals)

open ProjectivePoint

determinant3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  R
determinant3 reals a b c =
  add reals
    (subtract reals
      (multiply reals
        (x3 a)
        (subtract reals
          (multiply reals (y3 b) (z3 c))
          (multiply reals (z3 b) (y3 c))))
      (multiply reals
        (y3 a)
        (subtract reals
          (multiply reals (x3 b) (z3 c))
          (multiply reals (z3 b) (x3 c)))))
    (multiply reals
      (z3 a)
      (subtract reals
        (multiply reals (x3 b) (y3 c))
        (multiply reals (y3 b) (x3 c))))

ProjectiveCollinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  ProjectivePoint reals ->
  Set
ProjectiveCollinear reals a b c =
  determinant3 reals a b c == zero reals

record AffinePoint (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor affine
  field
    x2 : R
    y2 : R

open AffinePoint

AffineCollinear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  Set
AffineCollinear reals a b c =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (x2 b) (x2 a))
    (subtract reals (y2 c) (y2 a))
  ==
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (y2 b) (y2 a))
    (subtract reals (x2 c) (x2 a))

ParallelLines :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  AffinePoint R ->
  Set
ParallelLines reals a b c d =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (x2 b) (x2 a))
    (subtract reals (y2 d) (y2 c))
  ==
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (y2 b) (y2 a))
    (subtract reals (x2 d) (x2 c))

module HolLightDirectStatement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a aPrime b bPrime c cPrime p q r s :
      ProjectivePoint reals) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals aPrime b s) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals a p c) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals a p r) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals a c b) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals a b r) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals cPrime p aPrime) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals cPrime p b) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals cPrime p bPrime) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals cPrime aPrime s) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals cPrime aPrime bPrime) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals p c aPrime) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals p c b) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals p aPrime r) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals p b q) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals p q bPrime) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals c b s) ->
    Not (ProjectiveCollinear reals aPrime q bPrime) ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals p aPrime a ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals p b bPrime ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals p cPrime c ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals b c q ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals bPrime cPrime q ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals a r c ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals aPrime cPrime r ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals b s a ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals aPrime s bPrime ->
    ProjectiveCollinear reals q s r

module RocqAffineStatement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (a b c a1 b1 c1 s : AffinePoint R) ->
    c != c1 ->
    b != b1 ->
    c != s ->
    b != s ->
    c1 != s ->
    b1 != s ->
    a1 != b1 ->
    a1 != c1 ->
    b != c ->
    b1 != c1 ->
    Not (AffineCollinear reals a a1 b) ->
    Not (AffineCollinear reals a a1 c) ->
    AffineCollinear reals a a1 s ->
    AffineCollinear reals b b1 s ->
    AffineCollinear reals c c1 s ->
    ParallelLines reals a b a1 b1 ->
    ParallelLines reals a c a1 c1 ->
    ParallelLines reals b c b1 c1

hol-light-desargues-direct : Set1
hol-light-desargues-direct =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  HolLightDirectStatement.proposition reals

rocq-affine-desargues : Set1
rocq-affine-desargues =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RocqAffineStatement.proposition reals

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact
  hundred-theorems__hol4__087, cataloged as "Desargues's Theorem": two
  projective triangles perspective from a point have collinear intersections
  of corresponding sides, under the source nondegeneracy conditions. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory realTheory;

val desargues_s_theorem =
  ``let x = \P : (real # real) # real. FST (FST P) in
    let y = \P : (real # real) # real. SND (FST P) in
    let z = \P : (real # real) # real. SND P in
    let nonzero =
      \P : (real # real) # real.
        ~(x P = 0 /\ y P = 0 /\ z P = 0)
    in
    let collinear =
      \P Q R : (real # real) # real.
        x P * (y Q * z R - z Q * y R) -
        y P * (x Q * z R - z Q * x R) +
        z P * (x Q * y R - y Q * x R) = 0
    in
      !A B C A1 B1 C1 P Q R S : (real # real) # real.
        nonzero A /\ nonzero B /\ nonzero C /\
        nonzero A1 /\ nonzero B1 /\ nonzero C1 /\
        nonzero P /\ nonzero Q /\ nonzero R /\ nonzero S /\
        ~collinear A1 B S /\
        ~collinear A P C /\
        ~collinear A P R /\
        ~collinear A C B /\
        ~collinear A B R /\
        ~collinear C1 P A1 /\
        ~collinear C1 P B /\
        ~collinear C1 P B1 /\
        ~collinear C1 A1 S /\
        ~collinear C1 A1 B1 /\
        ~collinear P C A1 /\
        ~collinear P C B /\
        ~collinear P A1 R /\
        ~collinear P B Q /\
        ~collinear P Q B1 /\
        ~collinear C B S /\
        ~collinear A1 Q B1
        ==>
        collinear P A1 A /\
        collinear P B B1 /\
        collinear P C1 C /\
        collinear B C Q /\
        collinear B1 C1 Q /\
        collinear A R C /\
        collinear A1 C1 R /\
        collinear B S A /\
        collinear A1 S B1
        ==>
        collinear Q S R``;

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Desargues's Theorem" from Hundred
  Theorems artifact 087: the projective incidence theorem for two
  perspective triangles and its affine parallel-line specialization over
  the real plane. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  HT087PPlane is the real projective plane: its points are equivalence
  classes of nonzero triples of reals under multiplication by a nonzero real
  scalar. HT087PCol is projective collinearity, expressed by a zero
  determinant of representatives.

  HT087R2 is the real affine plane. HT087ACol is affine collinearity,
  HT087Triangle is noncollinearity, and HT087Parallel says that the direction
  vectors of two affine lines are linearly dependent.

  In the projective assertion D, E, and F denote the source points A', B',
  and C'. In the affine assertion they denote A1, B1, and C1. The first
  assertion preserves the HOL Light nondegeneracy and incidence hypotheses;
  the second preserves the Rocq inequalities, triangle hypotheses,
  perspectivity center, and parallel-side hypotheses. The supplied Isabelle
  source contains affine-space infrastructure but no Desargues proposition.
  Every declaration below is an unproved $a statement.
$)

$c
  HT087R2 HT087R3 HT087X HT087Y HT087PY HT087Z HT087Scale HT087HClass
  HT087PPlane HT087Det HT087PCol HT087ACol HT087Triangle HT087Parallel
  HT087PND HT087PConfig HT087AffineHyp
$.

ht087-r2-syntax $a class HT087R2 $.
ht087-r3-syntax $a class HT087R3 $.
ht087-x-syntax $a class ( HT087X A ) $.
ht087-y-syntax $a class ( HT087Y A ) $.
ht087-py-syntax $a class ( HT087PY A ) $.
ht087-z-syntax $a class ( HT087Z A ) $.
ht087-scale-syntax $a class ( HT087Scale A B ) $.
ht087-hclass-syntax $a class ( HT087HClass A ) $.
ht087-pplane-syntax $a class HT087PPlane $.
ht087-det-syntax $a class ( HT087Det A B C ) $.
ht087-pcol-syntax $a wff ( HT087PCol A B C ) $.
ht087-acol-syntax $a wff ( HT087ACol A B C ) $.
ht087-triangle-syntax $a wff ( HT087Triangle A B C ) $.
ht087-parallel-syntax $a wff ( HT087Parallel A B C D ) $.
ht087-pnd-syntax
  $a wff ( HT087PND A B C D E F P Q R S ) $.
ht087-pconfig-syntax
  $a wff ( HT087PConfig A B C D E F P Q R S ) $.
ht087-affine-hyp-syntax
  $a wff ( HT087AffineHyp A B C D E F S ) $.

ht087-r2-definition $a |- HT087R2 = ( RR X. RR ) $.

ht087-r3-definition $a |- HT087R3 = ( RR X. ( RR X. RR ) ) $.

ht087-x-definition $a |- ( HT087X A ) = ( 1st ` A ) $.

ht087-y-definition $a |- ( HT087Y A ) = ( 2nd ` A ) $.

ht087-py-definition $a |- ( HT087PY A ) = ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) $.

ht087-z-definition $a |- ( HT087Z A ) = ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` A ) ) $.

ht087-scale-definition $a |- ( HT087Scale A B ) =
  <.
    ( A x. ( HT087X B ) )
    ,
    <.
      ( A x. ( HT087PY B ) )
      ,
      ( A x. ( HT087Z B ) )
    >.
  >.
$.

${
  $d A B k $.

  ht087-hclass-definition $a |- ( HT087HClass A ) =
    { B e. HT087R3 |
      E. k e. ( RR \ { 0 } )
        B = ( HT087Scale k A )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B $.

  ht087-pplane-definition $a |- HT087PPlane =

title: 087_desargues_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "Desargues's Theorem" from Hundred Theorems item 087.
% In the real projective plane, corresponding sides of two perspective triangles meet
% in three collinear points under the source's explicit nondegeneracy conditions.
% This file contains no proof.

desargues_s_theorem_087: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real, z_coord: real #]

  projective_point(P: point): bool =
    NOT (x_coord(P) = 0 AND y_coord(P) = 0 AND z_coord(P) = 0)

  collinear(P, Q, R: point): bool =
    x_coord(P) *
        (y_coord(Q) * z_coord(R) - z_coord(Q) * y_coord(R))
      - y_coord(P) *
        (x_coord(Q) * z_coord(R) - z_coord(Q) * x_coord(R))
      + z_coord(P) *
        (x_coord(Q) * y_coord(R) - y_coord(Q) * x_coord(R))
      = 0

  all_projective_points(
      A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S: point): bool =
    projective_point(A)
      AND projective_point(A1)
      AND projective_point(B)
      AND projective_point(B1)
      AND projective_point(C)
      AND projective_point(C1)
      AND projective_point(P)
      AND projective_point(Q)
      AND projective_point(R)
      AND projective_point(S)

  nondegenerate(
      A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S: point): bool =
    NOT collinear(A1, B, S)
      AND NOT collinear(A, P, C)
      AND NOT collinear(A, P, R)
      AND NOT collinear(A, C, B)
      AND NOT collinear(A, B, R)
      AND NOT collinear(C1, P, A1)
      AND NOT collinear(C1, P, B)
      AND NOT collinear(C1, P, B1)
      AND NOT collinear(C1, A1, S)
      AND NOT collinear(C1, A1, B1)
      AND NOT collinear(P, C, A1)
      AND NOT collinear(P, C, B)
      AND NOT collinear(P, A1, R)
      AND NOT collinear(P, B, Q)
      AND NOT collinear(P, Q, B1)
      AND NOT collinear(C, B, S)
      AND NOT collinear(A1, Q, B1)

  incidence_configuration(
      A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S: point): bool =
    collinear(P, A1, A)
      AND collinear(P, B, B1)
      AND collinear(P, C1, C)
      AND collinear(B, C, Q)
      AND collinear(B1, C1, Q)
      AND collinear(A, R, C)
      AND collinear(A1, C1, R)
      AND collinear(B, S, A)
      AND collinear(A1, S, B1)

  desargues_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S: point):
      (all_projective_points(A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S)
        AND nondegenerate(A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S)
        AND incidence_configuration(A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, P, Q, R, S))
      IMPLIES collinear(Q, S, R)
END desargues_s_theorem_087
