From Stdlib Require Import Reals RiemannInt.

#[local] Open Scope R_scope.

Definition open_disc
    (center : (R * R)%type) (radius : R) : (R * R)%type -> Prop :=
  fun p =>
    (fst p - fst center) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd center) ^ 2 < radius ^ 2.

Definition disc_indicator
    (center : (R * R)%type) (radius : R) (p : (R * R)%type) : R :=
  if Rlt_dec
       ((fst p - fst center) ^ 2 + (snd p - snd center) ^ 2)
       (radius ^ 2)
  then 1
  else 0.

Definition iterated_Riemann_integral
    (f : R -> R -> R) (x0 x1 y0 y1 value : R) : Prop :=
  exists inner_integrable :
      forall x : R, Riemann_integrable (fun y => f x y) y0 y1,
    exists outer_integrable :
      Riemann_integrable
        (fun x => RiemannInt (inner_integrable x)) x0 x1,
      RiemannInt outer_integrable = value.

Theorem area_disc :
  forall (center : (R * R)%type) (radius : R),
    0 <= radius ->
    iterated_Riemann_integral
      (fun x y => disc_indicator center radius (x, y))
      (fst center - radius) (fst center + radius)
      (snd center - radius) (snd center + radius)
      (PI * radius ^ 2).
Admitted.

title: 009_the_area_of_a_circle
content:
(*
   File:     HOL/Analysis/Ball_Volume.thy
   Author:   Manuel Eberl, TU München
*)

section \<open>The Volume of an \<open>n\<close>-Dimensional Ball\<close>

theory Ball_Volume
  imports Gamma_Function Lebesgue_Integral_Substitution
begin

text \<open>
  We define the volume of the unit ball in terms of the Gamma function. Note that the
  dimension need not be an integer; we also allow fractional dimensions, although we do
  not use this case or prove anything about it for now.
\<close>
definition\<^marker>\<open>tag important\<close> unit_ball_vol :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "unit_ball_vol n = pi powr (n / 2) / Gamma (n / 2 + 1)"

lemma unit_ball_vol_pos [simp]: "n \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> unit_ball_vol n > 0"
  by sorry

lemma unit_ball_vol_nonneg [simp]: "n \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> unit_ball_vol n \<ge> 0"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  We first need the value of the following integral, which is at the core of
  computing the measure of an \<open>n + 1\<close>-dimensional ball in terms of the measure of an
  \<open>n\<close>-dimensional one.
\<close>
lemma emeasure_cball_aux_integral:
  "(\<integral>\<^sup>+x. indicator {-1..1} x * sqrt (1 - x\<^sup>2) ^ n \<partial>lborel) =
      ennreal (Beta (1 / 2) (real n / 2 + 1))"
  by sorry

lemma real_sqrt_le_iff': "x \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> y \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> sqrt x \<le> y \<longleftrightarrow> x \<le> y ^ 2"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  Isabelle's type system makes it very difficult to do an induction over the dimension
  of a Euclidean space type, because the type would change in the inductive step. To avoid
  this problem, we instead formulate the problem in a more concrete way by unfolding the
  definition of the Euclidean norm.
\<close>
lemma emeasure_cball_aux:
  assumes "finite A" "r > 0"
  shows   "emeasure (Pi\<^sub>M A (\<lambda>_. lborel))
             ({f. sqrt (\<Sum>i\<in>A. (f i)\<^sup>2) \<le> r} \<inter> space (Pi\<^sub>M A (\<lambda>_. lborel))) =
             ennreal (unit_ball_vol (real (card A)) * r ^ card A)"
  by sorry


text \<open>
  We now get the main theorem very easily by just applying the above lemma.
\<close>
context
  fixes c :: "'a :: euclidean_space" and r :: real
  assumes r: "r \<ge> 0"
begin

theorem\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> emeasure_cball:
  "emeasure lborel (cball c r) = ennreal (unit_ball_vol (DIM('a)) * r ^ DIM('a))"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> content_cball:
  "content (cball c r) = unit_ball_vol (DIM('a)) * r ^ DIM('a)"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> emeasure_ball:
  "emeasure lborel (ball c r) = ennreal (unit_ball_vol (DIM('a)) * r ^ DIM('a))"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag important\<close> content_ball:
  "content (ball c r) = unit_ball_vol (DIM('a)) * r ^ DIM('a)"
  by sorry

end


text \<open>
  Lastly, we now prove some nicer explicit formulas for the volume of the unit balls in
  the cases of even and odd integer dimensions.
\<close>
lemma unit_ball_vol_even:
  "unit_ball_vol (real (2 * n)) = pi ^ n / fact n"
  by sorry

lemma unit_ball_vol_odd':
        "unit_ball_vol (real (2 * n + 1)) = pi ^ n / pochhammer (1 / 2) (Suc n)"
  and unit_ball_vol_odd:
        "unit_ball_vol (real (2 * n + 1)) =
           (2 ^ (2 * Suc n) * fact (Suc n)) / fact (2 * Suc n) * pi ^ n"
  by sorry

lemma unit_ball_vol_numeral:
  "unit_ball_vol (numeral (Num.Bit0 n)) = pi ^ numeral n / fact (numeral n)" (is ?th1)
  "unit_ball_vol (numeral (Num.Bit1 n)) = 2 ^ (2 * Suc (numeral n)) * fact (Suc (numeral n)) /
    fact (2 * Suc (numeral n)) * pi ^ numeral n" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

lemmas eval_unit_ball_vol = unit_ball_vol_numeral fact_numeral


text \<open>
  Just for fun, we compute the volume of unit balls for a few dimensions.
\<close>
lemma unit_ball_vol_0 [simp]: "unit_ball_vol 0 = 1"
  by sorry

lemma unit_ball_vol_1 [simp]: "unit_ball_vol 1 = 2"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close>
          unit_ball_vol_2: "unit_ball_vol 2 = pi"
      and unit_ball_vol_3: "unit_ball_vol 3 = 4 / 3 * pi"
      and unit_ball_vol_4: "unit_ball_vol 4 = pi\<^sup>2 / 2"
      and unit_ball_vol_5: "unit_ball_vol 5 = 8 / 15 * pi\<^sup>2"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> circle_area:
  "r \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> content (ball c r :: (real ^ 2) set) = r ^ 2 * pi"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> sphere_volume:
  "r \<ge> 0 \<Longrightarrow> content (ball c r :: (real ^ 3) set) = 4 / 3 * r ^ 3 * pi"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  Useful equivalent forms
\<close>
corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> content_ball_eq_0_iff [simp]: "content (ball c r) = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> r \<le> 0"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> content_ball_gt_0_iff [simp]: "0 < content (ball z r) \<longleftrightarrow> 0 < r"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> content_cball_eq_0_iff [simp]: "content (cball c r) = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> r \<le> 0"
  by sorry

corollary\<^marker>\<open>tag unimportant\<close> content_cball_gt_0_iff [simp]: "0 < content (cball z r) \<longleftrightarrow> 0 < r"
  by sorry

end

title: 009_the_area_of_a_circle
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 009,
;; "The Area of a Circle." The outer area of every open Euclidean disc of
;; nonnegative real radius is pi times the square of the radius. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; ACL2's built-in numbers are rational, so the reals are represented by an
;; explicit Archimedean real-closed ordered field. Pi is independently fixed
;; as the limit of the Leibniz series.

(defstub ht009-carrier (x) t)
(defstub ht009-add-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht009-multiply-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht009-negate-op (x) t)
(defstub ht009-inverse-op (x) t)
(defstub ht009-less-op (x y) t)
(defstub ht009-zero () t)
(defstub ht009-one () t)
(defstub ht009-pi () t)

(defun ht009-member-p (x)
  (if (ht009-carrier x) t nil))

(defun ht009-add (x y)
  (ht009-add-op x y))

(defun ht009-multiply (x y)
  (ht009-multiply-op x y))

(defun ht009-negate (x)
  (ht009-negate-op x))

(defun ht009-inverse (x)
  (ht009-inverse-op x))

(defun ht009-subtract (x y)
  (ht009-add x (ht009-negate y)))

(defun ht009-divide (x y)
  (ht009-multiply x (ht009-inverse y)))

(defun ht009-less (x y)
  (if (ht009-less-op x y) t nil))

(defun ht009-less-or-equal (x y)
  (or
   (equal x y)
   (ht009-less x y)))

(defun ht009-positive-p (x)
  (and
   (ht009-member-p x)
   (ht009-less (ht009-zero) x)))

(defun ht009-nonnegative-p (x)
  (and
   (ht009-member-p x)
   (not (ht009-less x (ht009-zero)))))

(defun ht009-square (x)
  (ht009-multiply x x))

(defun ht009-absolute (x)
  (if (ht009-less x (ht009-zero))
      (ht009-negate x)
    x))

(defun ht009-natural (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (ht009-zero)
    (ht009-add
     (ht009-one)
     (ht009-natural (1- n)))))

(defun-sk ht009-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht009-member-p x)
      (ht009-member-p y)
      (ht009-member-p z))
     (and
      (ht009-member-p (ht009-add x y))
      (ht009-member-p (ht009-multiply x y))
      (ht009-member-p (ht009-negate x))
      (ht009-member-p (ht009-inverse x))
      (equal (ht009-add (ht009-add x y) z)
             (ht009-add x (ht009-add y z)))
      (equal (ht009-add x y)
             (ht009-add y x))
      (equal (ht009-add x (ht009-zero)) x)
      (equal
       (ht009-add x (ht009-negate x))
       (ht009-zero))
      (equal
       (ht009-multiply (ht009-multiply x y) z)
       (ht009-multiply x (ht009-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (ht009-multiply x y)
       (ht009-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (ht009-multiply x (ht009-one))
       x)
      (equal
       (ht009-multiply x (ht009-add y z))
       (ht009-add
        (ht009-multiply x y)
        (ht009-multiply x z)))
      (implies
       (equal x (ht009-zero))
       (equal (ht009-inverse x) (ht009-zero)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (ht009-zero)))
       (equal
        (ht009-multiply x (ht009-inverse x))
        (ht009-one)))))))

(defun-sk ht009-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht009-member-p x)
      (ht009-member-p y)
      (ht009-member-p z))
     (and
      (not (ht009-less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (ht009-less x y)
       (ht009-less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht009-less x y)
        (ht009-less y z))
       (ht009-less x z))
      (implies
       (ht009-less x y)
       (ht009-less
        (ht009-add x z)
        (ht009-add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ht009-less (ht009-zero) x)
        (ht009-less (ht009-zero) y))
       (ht009-less
        (ht009-zero)
        (ht009-multiply x y)))))))

(defun ht009-field-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (ht009-member-p (car values))
       (ht009-field-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun ht009-polynomial-value (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (ht009-add
       (car coefficients)
       (ht009-multiply
        x
        (ht009-polynomial-value (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (ht009-zero)))

(defun ht009-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (consp coefficients)
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (ht009-field-list-p coefficients)
   (evenp (len coefficients))
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (ht009-zero)))))

(defun-sk ht009-square-root-exists-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht009-member-p root)
     (equal (ht009-square root) x))))

(defun-sk ht009-polynomial-root-exists-p (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (ht009-member-p root)
     (equal
      (ht009-polynomial-value coefficients root)
      (ht009-zero)))))

(defun-sk ht009-real-closure-laws-p ()
  (forall (x coefficients)
    (and
     (implies
      (ht009-nonnegative-p x)
      (ht009-square-root-exists-p x))
     (implies
      (ht009-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients)
      (ht009-polynomial-root-exists-p coefficients)))))

(defun-sk ht009-natural-bound-exists-p (x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (ht009-less x (ht009-natural n)))))

(defun-sk ht009-archimedean-law-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ht009-member-p x)
     (ht009-natural-bound-exists-p x))))

(defun ht009-real-scalar-context-p ()
  (and
   (ht009-member-p (ht009-zero))
   (ht009-member-p (ht009-one))
   (not (equal (ht009-zero) (ht009-one)))
   (ht009-less (ht009-zero) (ht009-one))
   (ht009-field-laws-p)
   (ht009-order-laws-p)
   (ht009-real-closure-laws-p)
   (ht009-archimedean-law-p)))

;; The nth prefix is four times
;;   1 - 1/3 + 1/5 - ... + (-1)^(n-1)/(2n-1).

(defun ht009-leibniz-term (index)
  (let* ((denominator
          (ht009-natural (+ (* 2 index) 1)))
         (unsigned
          (ht009-divide (ht009-one) denominator)))
    (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
        unsigned
      (ht009-negate unsigned))))

(defun ht009-leibniz-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (ht009-zero)
    (ht009-add
     (ht009-leibniz-prefix (1- terms))
     (ht009-leibniz-term (1- terms)))))

(defun ht009-pi-prefix (terms)
  (ht009-multiply
   (ht009-natural 4)
   (ht009-leibniz-prefix terms)))

(defun-sk ht009-pi-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (ht009-less
      (ht009-absolute
       (ht009-subtract
        (ht009-pi-prefix terms)
        (ht009-pi)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht009-pi-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (ht009-pi-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk ht009-pi-value-p ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht009-positive-p epsilon)
     (ht009-pi-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(defun ht009-exact-pi-p ()
  (and
   (ht009-member-p (ht009-pi))
   (ht009-positive-p (ht009-pi))
   (ht009-pi-value-p)))

;; A box is the proper list (left right bottom top). Area is characterized as
;; outer Jordan area: a value is below every finite open-box cover and can be
;; approached arbitrarily closely by such covers. For a disc this equals its
;; Lebesgue measure, while avoiding an under-specified abstract sigma-algebra.

(defun ht009-open-disc-member-p
    (center-x center-y radius x y)
  (ht009-less
   (ht009-add
    (ht009-square (ht009-subtract x center-x))
    (ht009-square (ht009-subtract y center-y)))
   (ht009-square radius)))

(defun ht009-box-p (box)
  (and
   (true-listp box)
   (equal (len box) 4)
   (ht009-member-p (nth 0 box))
   (ht009-member-p (nth 1 box))
   (ht009-member-p (nth 2 box))
   (ht009-member-p (nth 3 box))
   (ht009-less (nth 0 box) (nth 1 box))
   (ht009-less (nth 2 box) (nth 3 box))))

(defun ht009-point-in-open-box-p (x y box)
  (and
   (ht009-less (nth 0 box) x)
   (ht009-less x (nth 1 box))
   (ht009-less (nth 2 box) y)
   (ht009-less y (nth 3 box))))

(defun ht009-box-area (box)
  (ht009-multiply
   (ht009-subtract (nth 1 box) (nth 0 box))
   (ht009-subtract (nth 3 box) (nth 2 box))))

(defun ht009-box-list-p (boxes)
  (if (consp boxes)
      (and
       (ht009-box-p (car boxes))
       (ht009-box-list-p (cdr boxes)))
    (equal boxes nil)))

(defun ht009-point-covered-p (x y boxes)
  (if (consp boxes)
      (or
       (ht009-point-in-open-box-p x y (car boxes))
       (ht009-point-covered-p x y (cdr boxes)))
    nil))

(defun ht009-cover-total-area (boxes)
  (if (consp boxes)
      (ht009-add
       (ht009-box-area (car boxes))
       (ht009-cover-total-area (cdr boxes)))
    (ht009-zero)))

(defun-sk ht009-boxes-cover-disc-p
    (center-x center-y radius boxes)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht009-member-p x)
      (ht009-member-p y)
      (ht009-open-disc-member-p
       center-x center-y radius x y))
     (ht009-point-covered-p x y boxes))))

(defun ht009-valid-disc-cover-p
    (center-x center-y radius boxes)
  (and
   (true-listp boxes)
   (ht009-box-list-p boxes)
   (ht009-boxes-cover-disc-p
    center-x center-y radius boxes)))

(defun-sk ht009-area-below-every-cover-p
    (center-x center-y radius area)
  (forall (boxes)
    (implies
     (ht009-valid-disc-cover-p
      center-x center-y radius boxes)
     (ht009-less-or-equal
      area
      (ht009-cover-total-area boxes)))))

(defun-sk ht009-close-cover-exists-p
    (center-x center-y radius area epsilon)
  (exists (boxes)
    (and
     (ht009-valid-disc-cover-p
      center-x center-y radius boxes)
     (ht009-less
      (ht009-cover-total-area boxes)
      (ht009-add area epsilon)))))

(defun-sk ht009-arbitrarily-close-covers-p
    (center-x center-y radius area)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (ht009-positive-p epsilon)
     (ht009-close-cover-exists-p
      center-x center-y radius area epsilon))))

(defun ht009-is-disc-area-p
    (center-x center-y radius area)
  (and
   (ht009-nonnegative-p area)
   (ht009-area-below-every-cover-p
    center-x center-y radius area)
   (ht009-arbitrarily-close-covers-p
    center-x center-y radius area)))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-009-area-of-a-circle-statement ()
  (forall (center-x center-y radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (ht009-real-scalar-context-p)
      (ht009-exact-pi-p)
      (ht009-member-p center-x)
      (ht009-member-p center-y)
      (ht009-nonnegative-p radius))
     (ht009-is-disc-area-p
      center-x
      center-y
      radius
      (ht009-multiply
       (ht009-pi)
       (ht009-square radius))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 009_the_area_of_a_circle
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of "The Area of a Circle" from Hundred Theorems item 009:
-- every open disc of nonnegative real radius has Lebesgue area pi times radius squared.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _≠_ _≤ₙ_
infixr 3 _∧_
infix 2 _↔_

data ⊥ : Set where

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = x ≡ y → ⊥

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A → Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _≤ₙ_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ₙ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ₙ n → suc m ≤ₙ suc n

pred : Nat → Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

negative : Nat → Int
negative zero = pos zero
negative (suc n) = negsuc n

negateInt : Int → Int
negateInt (pos n) = negative n
negateInt (negsuc n) = pos (suc n)

difference : Nat → Nat → Int
difference zero zero = pos zero
difference (suc m) zero = pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) = negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) = difference m n

addInt : Int → Int → Int
addInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m + n)
addInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = difference m (suc n)
addInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = difference n (suc m)
addInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = negsuc (suc (m + n))

multiplyInt : Int → Int → Int
multiplyInt (pos m) (pos n) = pos (m * n)
multiplyInt (pos m) (negsuc n) = negative (m * suc n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (pos n) = negative (suc m * n)
multiplyInt (negsuc m) (negsuc n) = pos (suc m * suc n)

scaleInt : Int → Nat → Int
scaleInt z n = multiplyInt z (pos n)

absoluteInt : Int → Nat
absoluteInt (pos n) = n
absoluteInt (negsuc n) = suc n

data IntLessOrEqual : Int → Int → Set where
  positive≤positive :
    {m n : Nat} →
    m ≤ₙ n →
    IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n)
  negative≤positive :
    {m n : Nat} →
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (pos n)
  negative≤negative :
    {m n : Nat} →
    n ≤ₙ m →
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational public

denominator : Rational → Nat
denominator q = suc (denominator-minus-one q)

ratZero : Rational
ratZero = fraction (pos zero) zero

ratOne : Rational
ratOne = fraction (pos 1) zero

ratFour : Rational
ratFour = fraction (pos 4) zero

unitFraction : Nat → Rational
unitFraction n = fraction (pos 1) n

ratNegate : Rational → Rational
ratNegate q =
  fraction (negateInt (numerator q)) (denominator-minus-one q)

ratAdd : Rational → Rational → Rational
ratAdd x y =
  fraction
    (addInt
      (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
      (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

ratSubtract : Rational → Rational → Rational
ratSubtract x y = ratAdd x (ratNegate y)

ratMultiply : Rational → Rational → Rational
ratMultiply x y =
  fraction
    (multiplyInt (numerator x) (numerator y))
    (pred (denominator x * denominator y))

ratAbsolute : Rational → Rational
ratAbsolute q =
  fraction
    (pos (absoluteInt (numerator q)))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

RationalEquivalent : Rational → Rational → Set
RationalEquivalent x y =
  scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y) ≡
  scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x)

RationalLessOrEqual : Rational → Rational → Set
RationalLessOrEqual x y =
  IntLessOrEqual
    (scaleInt (numerator x) (denominator y))
    (scaleInt (numerator y) (denominator x))

RationalDistanceWithin : Rational → Rational → Rational → Set
RationalDistanceWithin x y epsilon =
  RationalLessOrEqual
    (ratAbsolute (ratSubtract x y))
    epsilon

Sequence : Set
Sequence = Nat → Rational

Cauchy : Sequence → Set
Cauchy sequence =
  (precision : Nat) →
  Exists Nat
    (λ cutoff →
      (m n : Nat) →
      cutoff ≤ₙ m →
      cutoff ≤ₙ n →
      RationalDistanceWithin
        (sequence m)
        (sequence n)
        (unitFraction precision))

record Real : Set where
  constructor cauchyReal
  field
    approximation : Sequence
    cauchy         : Cauchy approximation

open Real public

SequenceEquivalent : Sequence → Sequence → Set
SequenceEquivalent left right =
  (precision : Nat) →
  Exists Nat
    (λ cutoff →
      (n : Nat) →
      cutoff ≤ₙ n →
      RationalDistanceWithin
        (left n)
        (right n)
        (unitFraction precision))

SequenceLessOrEqual : Sequence → Sequence → Set
SequenceLessOrEqual left right =
  (precision : Nat) →
  Exists Nat
    (λ cutoff →
      (n : Nat) →
      cutoff ≤ₙ n →
      RationalLessOrEqual
        (left n)
        (ratAdd (right n) (unitFraction precision)))

SequenceStrictLess : Sequence → Sequence → Set
SequenceStrictLess left right =
  Exists Nat
    (λ margin →
      Exists Nat
        (λ cutoff →
          (n : Nat) →
          cutoff ≤ₙ n →
          RationalLessOrEqual
            (ratAdd (left n) (unitFraction margin))
            (right n)))

RealEquivalent : Real → Real → Set
RealEquivalent x y =
  SequenceEquivalent (approximation x) (approximation y)

RealLessOrEqual : Real → Real → Set
RealLessOrEqual x y =
  SequenceLessOrEqual (approximation x) (approximation y)

constantSequence : Rational → Sequence
constantSequence q n = q

Nonnegative : Real → Set
Nonnegative x =
  SequenceLessOrEqual
    (constantSequence ratZero)
    (approximation x)

record Point : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : Real
    y-coordinate : Real

open Point public

Region : Set₁
Region = Point → Set

squaredDistanceSequence : Point → Point → Sequence
squaredDistanceSequence p q n =
  ratAdd
    (ratMultiply
      (ratSubtract
        (approximation (x-coordinate p) n)
        (approximation (x-coordinate q) n))
      (ratSubtract
        (approximation (x-coordinate p) n)
        (approximation (x-coordinate q) n)))
    (ratMultiply
      (ratSubtract
        (approximation (y-coordinate p) n)
        (approximation (y-coordinate q) n))
      (ratSubtract
        (approximation (y-coordinate p) n)
        (approximation (y-coordinate q) n)))

squareSequence : Real → Sequence
squareSequence x n =
  ratMultiply
    (approximation x n)
    (approximation x n)

openDisc : Point → Real → Region
openDisc center radius p =
  SequenceStrictLess
    (squaredDistanceSequence p center)
    (squareSequence radius)

alternatingSign : Nat → Int
alternatingSign zero = pos 1
alternatingSign (suc n) = negateInt (alternatingSign n)

oddNatural : Nat → Nat
oddNatural n = suc (n + n)

leibnizTerm : Nat → Rational
leibnizTerm n =
  fraction
    (alternatingSign n)
    (pred (oddNatural n))

leibnizPartialSum : Nat → Rational
leibnizPartialSum zero = leibnizTerm zero
leibnizPartialSum (suc n) =
  ratAdd (leibnizPartialSum n) (leibnizTerm (suc n))

piSequence : Sequence
piSequence n =
  ratMultiply ratFour (leibnizPartialSum n)

PiTimesRadiusSquared : Real → Real → Set
PiTimesRadiusSquared radius value =
  SequenceEquivalent
    (approximation value)
    (λ n →
      ratMultiply
        (piSequence n)
        (ratMultiply
          (approximation radius n)
          (approximation radius n)))

record RationalRectangle : Set where
  constructor rationalRectangle
  field
    lower-x : Rational
    upper-x : Rational
    lower-y : Rational
    upper-y : Rational

open RationalRectangle public

ValidRectangle : RationalRectangle → Set
ValidRectangle rectangle =
  RationalLessOrEqual
    (lower-x rectangle)
    (upper-x rectangle) ∧
  RationalLessOrEqual
    (lower-y rectangle)
    (upper-y rectangle)

RectangleContains : RationalRectangle → Point → Set
RectangleContains rectangle p =
  (SequenceStrictLess
    (constantSequence (lower-x rectangle))
    (approximation (x-coordinate p)) ∧
   SequenceStrictLess
    (approximation (x-coordinate p))
    (constantSequence (upper-x rectangle))) ∧
  (SequenceStrictLess
    (constantSequence (lower-y rectangle))
    (approximation (y-coordinate p)) ∧
   SequenceStrictLess
    (approximation (y-coordinate p))
    (constantSequence (upper-y rectangle)))

rectangleArea : RationalRectangle → Rational
rectangleArea rectangle =
  ratMultiply
    (ratSubtract
      (upper-x rectangle)
      (lower-x rectangle))
    (ratSubtract
      (upper-y rectangle)
      (lower-y rectangle))

RectangleCover : Set
RectangleCover = Nat → RationalRectangle

ValidCover : RectangleCover → Set
ValidCover cover =
  (n : Nat) → ValidRectangle (cover n)

Covers : RectangleCover → Region → Set
Covers cover region =
  (p : Point) →
  region p →
  Exists Nat (λ n → RectangleContains (cover n) p)

coverPartialArea : RectangleCover → Sequence
coverPartialArea cover zero = rectangleArea (cover zero)
coverPartialArea cover (suc n) =
  ratAdd
    (coverPartialArea cover n)
    (rectangleArea (cover (suc n)))

CoverTotal : RectangleCover → Real → Set
CoverTotal cover total =
  SequenceEquivalent
    (approximation total)
    (coverPartialArea cover)

CoverCost : Region → Real → Set
CoverCost region total =
  Exists RectangleCover
    (λ cover →
      ValidCover cover ∧
      (Covers cover region ∧ CoverTotal cover total))

LowerBound : (Real → Set) → Real → Set
LowerBound values bound =
  (value : Real) →
  values value →
  RealLessOrEqual bound value

GreatestLowerBound : (Real → Set) → Real → Set
GreatestLowerBound values infimum =
  LowerBound values infimum ∧
  ((bound : Real) →
    LowerBound values bound →
    RealLessOrEqual bound infimum)

LebesgueArea : Region → Real → Set
LebesgueArea region value =
  GreatestLowerBound (CoverCost region) value

the-area-of-a-circle : Set
the-area-of-a-circle =
  (center : Point) →
  (radius : Real) →
  Nonnegative radius →
  Exists Real
    (λ area →
      LebesgueArea (openDisc center radius) area ∧
      PiTimesRadiusSquared radius area)

        {p : real # real |

title: 009_the_area_of_a_circle
content:
% Statement-only formalization of "The Area of a Circle" from Hundred Theorems item 009:
% every open Euclidean disc of nonnegative radius has Lebesgue area pi times the square of
% its radius. This file contains no proof.

area_of_a_circle_009: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  planar_region: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  box: TYPE =
    [# left: real, right: real, bottom: real, top: real #]
  box_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> box]

  squared_distance(p, q: point): real =
    (x_coord(p) - x_coord(q)) ^ 2
      + (y_coord(p) - y_coord(q)) ^ 2

  open_disc(center: point, radius: real): planar_region =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      squared_distance(p, center) < radius ^ 2

  in_open_box(p: point, b: box): bool =
    left(b) < x_coord(p)
      AND x_coord(p) < right(b)
      AND bottom(b) < y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < top(b)

  box_area(b: box): real =
    IF left(b) < right(b) AND bottom(b) < top(b) THEN
      (right(b) - left(b)) * (top(b) - bottom(b))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  partial_box_area(boxes: box_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_box_area(boxes, count - 1)
        + box_area(boxes(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < eps

  covers(region: planar_region, boxes: box_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      region(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          in_open_box(p, boxes(index))

  cover_has_total_area(
      region: planar_region,
      boxes: box_sequence,
      total: real): bool =
    covers(region, boxes)
      AND converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat):
          partial_box_area(boxes, count),
        total)

  is_lebesgue_outer_area(
      region: planar_region,
      value: real): bool =
    0 <= value
      AND (FORALL (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
        cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
          IMPLIES value <= total)
      AND (FORALL (eps: posreal):
        EXISTS (boxes: box_sequence), (total: real):
          cover_has_total_area(region, boxes, total)
            AND total < value + eps)

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  area_of_a_circle: bool =
    FORALL
        (center: point),
        (radius, circle_constant: real):
      (0 <= radius AND is_pi(circle_constant))
        IMPLIES
          is_lebesgue_outer_area(
            open_disc(center, radius),
            circle_constant * radius ^ 2)
END area_of_a_circle_009

title: 090_stirling_s_formula
content:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Moritz Firsching, Fabian Kruse, Nikolas Kuhn
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.PSeries
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Pi.Wallis
public import Mathlib.Tactic.AdaptationNote

/-!
# Stirling's formula

This file proves Stirling's formula for the factorial.
It states that $n!$ grows asymptotically like $\sqrt{2\pi n}(\frac{n}{e})^n$.

Also some _global_ bounds on the factorial function and the Stirling sequence are proved.

## Proof outline

The proof follows: <https://proofwiki.org/wiki/Stirling%27s_Formula>.

We proceed in two parts.

**Part 1**: We consider the sequence $a_n$ of fractions $\frac{n!}{\sqrt{2n}(\frac{n}{e})^n}$
and prove that this sequence converges to a real, positive number $a$. For this the two main
ingredients are
- taking the logarithm of the sequence and
- using the series expansion of $\log(1 + x)$.

**Part 2**: We use the fact that the series defined in part 1 converges against a real number $a$
and prove that $a = \sqrt{\pi}$. Here the main ingredient is the convergence of Wallis' product
formula for `π`.
-/

@[expose] public section


open scoped Topology Real Nat Asymptotics

open Nat hiding log log_pow
open Finset Filter Real

namespace Stirling

/-!
### Part 1
https://proofwiki.org/wiki/Stirling%27s_Formula#Part_1
-/


/-- Define `stirlingSeq n` as $\frac{n!}{\sqrt{2n}(\frac{n}{e})^n}$.
Stirling's formula states that this sequence has limit $\sqrt(π)$.
-/
noncomputable def stirlingSeq (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  n ! / (√(2 * n : ℝ) * (n / exp 1) ^ n)

@[simp]
theorem stirlingSeq_zero : stirlingSeq 0 = 0 := by sorry
theorem stirlingSeq_one : stirlingSeq 1 = exp 1 / √2 := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_formula (n : ℕ) :
    log (stirlingSeq n) = Real.log n ! - 1 / 2 * Real.log (2 * n) - n * log (n / exp 1) := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_diff_hasSum (m : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ↑(k + 1) + 1) * ((1 / (2 * ↑(m + 1) + 1)) ^ 2) ^ ↑(k + 1))
      (log (stirlingSeq (m + 1)) - log (stirlingSeq (m + 2))) := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq'_antitone : Antitone (Real.log ∘ stirlingSeq ∘ succ) :=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun n =>
    sub_nonneg.mp <| (log_stirlingSeq_diff_hasSum n).nonneg fun m => by positivity

/-- We have a bound for successive elements in the sequence `log (stirlingSeq k)`. -/
@[deprecated "Use `log_stirlingSeq_diff_le` instead." (since := "2026-03-16")]
theorem log_stirlingSeq_diff_le_geo_sum (n : ℕ) :
    log (stirlingSeq (n + 1)) - log (stirlingSeq (n + 2)) ≤
      ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * ↑(n + 1) + 1)) ^ 2 / (1 - ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * ↑(n + 1) + 1)) ^ 2) := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_diff_le (n : ℕ) :
    log (stirlingSeq n) - log (stirlingSeq (n + 1)) ≤ 1 / (12 * n * (n + 1)) := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_sub_log_stirlingSeq_succ (n : ℕ) :
    log (stirlingSeq n) - log (stirlingSeq (n + 1)) ≤ 1 / (4 * n ^ 2) := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_bounded_aux (n : ℕ) :
    log (stirlingSeq 1) - log (stirlingSeq (n + 1)) ≤ 12⁻¹ := by sorry
theorem log_stirlingSeq_bounded_by_constant (n : ℕ) :
    1 - 12⁻¹ - log 2 / 2 ≤ log (stirlingSeq (n + 1)) := by sorry
theorem stirlingSeq'_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < stirlingSeq (n + 1) := by unfold stirlingSeq; positivity

/-- The sequence `stirlingSeq` has a positive lower bound. -/
theorem stirlingSeq'_bounded_by_pos_constant : ∃ a, 0 < a ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, a ≤ stirlingSeq (n + 1) := by sorry
theorem stirlingSeq'_antitone : Antitone (stirlingSeq ∘ succ) := fun n m h =>
  (log_le_log_iff (stirlingSeq'_pos m) (stirlingSeq'_pos n)).mp (log_stirlingSeq'_antitone h)

/-- The limit `a` of the sequence `stirlingSeq` satisfies `0 < a` -/
theorem stirlingSeq_has_pos_limit_a : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Tendsto stirlingSeq atTop (𝓝 a) := by sorry
theorem tendsto_self_div_two_mul_self_add_one :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) / (2 * n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) := by sorry
theorem stirlingSeq_pow_four_div_stirlingSeq_pow_two_eq (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    stirlingSeq n ^ 4 / stirlingSeq (2 * n) ^ 2 * (n / (2 * n + 1)) = Wallis.W n := by sorry
theorem second_wallis_limit (a : ℝ) (hane : a ≠ 0) (ha : Tendsto stirlingSeq atTop (𝓝 a)) :
    Tendsto Wallis.W atTop (𝓝 (a ^ 2 / 2)) := by sorry
theorem tendsto_stirlingSeq_sqrt_pi : Tendsto stirlingSeq atTop (𝓝 (√π)) := by sorry
lemma factorial_isEquivalent_stirling :
    (fun n ↦ n ! : ℕ → ℝ) ~[atTop] fun n ↦ Real.sqrt (2 * n * π) * (n / exp 1) ^ n := by sorry
theorem sqrt_pi_le_stirlingSeq {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : √π ≤ stirlingSeq n :=
  match n, hn with := by sorry
theorem le_factorial_stirling (n : ℕ) : √(2 * π * n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n ≤ n ! := by sorry
theorem le_log_factorial_stirling {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n * log n - n + log n / 2 + log (2 * π) / 2 ≤ log n ! := by sorry
end Stirling

(** Proof of Stirling equivalence of factorial. *)

Require Import Reals.
Require Import Rsequence_facts.
Require Import Rseries_def.
Require Import Rseries_facts.
Require Import Rseries_usual.
Require Import Rpser.
Require Import Rintegral.
Require Import RTaylor.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Lra.
Require Import Wallis.
Open Scope R_scope.

(** printing ~	~ *)
(** Partial result : De Moivre approximation. *)

Section De_Moivre.
(* begin hide *)

Let Un n := (INR n) ^ n * exp (- (INR n)) * sqrt (INR n) / Rseq_fact n.

Let Vn n :=
match n with
| 0 => 0
| _ => ln (Un (S n) / Un n)
end.

Hint Resolve lt_0_INR : stirling.
Hint Resolve sqrt_lt_R0 : stirling.
Hint Resolve exp_pos : stirling.
Hint Resolve lt_O_fact : stirling.
Hint Resolve pow_lt : stirling.
Hint Resolve Rmult_lt_0_compat : stirling.
Hint Resolve Rinv_0_lt_compat : stirling.
Hint Resolve Rgt_not_eq : stirling.

Lemma Vn_O : Vn 0 = 0.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Vn_S : forall n, (0 < n)%nat -> Vn n = ln (Un (S n) / Un n).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ln_pow : forall r n, 0 < r -> ln (r ^ n) = INR n * ln r.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma ln_sqrt : forall r, 0 < r -> ln (sqrt r) = ln r / 2.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Un_pos : forall n, (0 < n)%nat -> 0 < Un n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Vn_simpl :
  forall n, (0 < n)%nat -> Vn n = (INR n + / 2) * ln (1 + / INR n) - 1.
Proof.
Admitted.

Let Tn n :=
match n with
| 0 => 0 
| _ => (- 1) ^ (S n) / (INR n)
end.

Let Rn n := (/ INR n + - / 2 * (/ INR n) ^ 2 + / 3 * (/ INR n) ^ 3).

Let Sn n := ln (1 + / INR n) - Rn n.

Let Qn d n := Rseq_inv_poly d n.

Lemma Qn_S : forall d n, (0 < n)%nat -> Qn d n = (/ INR n) ^ d.
Proof.
Admitted.
Lemma ln_taylor_3 : Sn = O(Qn 4).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Vn_maj : Vn = O(Qn 2).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rser_cv_Riemann : {l | Rser_abs_cv (Qn 2) l}.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Rser_cv_Vn : {l | Rser_cv Vn l}.
Proof.
Admitted.


Lemma Vn_ser_eq : forall n, sum_f_R0 Vn n = ln (Un (S n)) - ln (Un 1).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Un_cv : {l | Rseq_cv Un l & 0 < l}.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* end hide *)

Lemma De_Moivre_equiv : {C | Rseq_fact ~ (fun n => C * (INR n) ^ n * exp (- (INR n)) * sqrt (INR n)) & 0 < C}.
Proof.
Admitted.

End De_Moivre.
(* begin hide *)

Lemma exp_pow x n : (exp x) ^ n = exp (x* (INR n)).
Proof.
Admitted.
(* end hide *)

(** Final result : Stirling approximation. *)

Section Stirling.

Local Coercion INR : nat >-> R.

Lemma Stirling_equiv : Rseq_fact ~ (fun n => sqrt (2 * PI) * (INR n) ^ n * exp (- (INR n)) * sqrt (INR n)).
Proof.
Admitted.

End Stirling.

title: 090_stirling_s_formula
content:
(*
  File:    Stirling_Formula.thy
  Author:  Manuel Eberl

  A proof of Stirling's formula, i.e. an asymptotic approximation of
  the Gamma function and the factorial.
*)
section \<open>Stirling's Formula\<close>
theory Stirling_Formula
imports
  "HOL-Analysis.Analysis"
  "Landau_Symbols.Landau_More"
  "HOL-Real_Asymp.Real_Asymp"
begin

context
begin

text \<open>
  First, we define the $S_n^*$ from Jameson's article:
\<close>
qualified definition S' :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "S' n x = 1/(2*x) + (\<Sum>r=1..<n. 1/(of_nat r+x)) + 1 /(2*(n + x))"

text \<open>
  Next, the trapezium (also called $T$ in Jameson's article):
\<close>
qualified definition T :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "T x = 1/(2*x) + 1/(2*(x+1))"

text \<open>
  Now we define The difference $\Delta(x)$:
\<close>
qualified definition D :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "D x = T x - ln (x + 1) + ln x"

qualified lemma S'_telescope_trapezium:
  assumes "n > 0"
  shows   "S' n x = (\<Sum>r<n. T (of_nat r + x))"
proof (cases n)
  case (Suc m)
  hence m: "Suc m = n" by simp
  have "(\<Sum>r<n. T (of_nat r + x)) = 
          (\<Sum>r<Suc m. 1 / (2 * real r + 2 * x)) + (\<Sum>r<n. 1 / (2 * real (Suc r) + 2 * x))"
    unfolding m by (simp add: T_def sum.distrib algebra_simps)
  also have "(\<Sum>r<Suc m. 1 / (2 * real r + 2 * x)) = 
               1/(2*x) + (\<Sum>r<m. 1 / (2 * real (Suc r) + 2 * x))" (is "_ = ?a + ?S")
    by (subst sum.lessThan_Suc_shift) simp
  also have "(\<Sum>r<n. 1 / (2 * real (Suc r) + 2 * x)) = 
               ?S + 1 / (2*(real m + x + 1))" (is "_ = _ + ?b") by (simp add: Suc)
  also have "?a + ?S + (?S + ?b) = 2*?S + ?a + ?b" by (simp add: add_ac)
  also have "2 * ?S = (\<Sum>r=0..<m. 1 / (real (Suc r) + x))" 
    unfolding sum_distrib_left by (intro sum.cong) (auto simp add: divide_simps)
  also have "(\<Sum>r=0..<m. 1 / (real (Suc r) + x)) = (\<Sum>r=Suc 0..<Suc m. 1 / (real r + x))"
    by (subst sum.atLeast_Suc_lessThan_Suc_shift) simp_all
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>r=1..<n. 1 / (real r + x))" unfolding m by simp
  also have "\<dots> + ?a + ?b = S' n x" by (simp add: S'_def Suc)
  finally show ?thesis ..
qed (insert assms, simp_all)

qualified lemma stirling_trapezium:
  assumes x: "(x::real) > 0"
  shows   "D x \<in> {0 .. 1/(12*x^2) - 1/(12 * (x+1)^2)}"
proof -
  define y where "y = 1 / (2*x + 1)"
  from x have y: "y > 0" "y < 1" by (simp_all add: divide_simps y_def)

  from x have "D x = T x - ln ((x + 1) / x)" by (subst ln_div) (simp_all add: D_def)
  also from x have "(x + 1) / x = 1 + 1 / x" by (simp add: field_simps)
  finally have D: "D x = T x - ln (1 + 1/x)" .

  from y have "(\<lambda>n. y * y^n) sums (y * (1 / (1 - y)))" 
    by (intro geometric_sums sums_mult) simp_all
  hence "(\<lambda>n. y ^ Suc n) sums (y / (1 - y))" by simp
  also from x have "y / (1 - y) = 1 / (2*x)" by (simp add: y_def divide_simps)
  finally have *: "(\<lambda>n. y ^ Suc n) sums (1 / (2*x))" .

  from y have "(\<lambda>n. (-y) * (-y)^n) sums ((-y) * (1 / (1 - (-y))))" 
    by (intro geometric_sums sums_mult) simp_all
  hence "(\<lambda>n. (-y) ^ Suc n) sums (-(y / (1 + y)))" by simp
  also from x have "y / (1 + y) = 1 / (2*(x+1))" by (simp add: y_def divide_simps)
  finally have **: "(\<lambda>n. (-y) ^ Suc n) sums (-(1 / (2*(x+1))))" .

  from sums_diff[OF * **] have sum1: "(\<lambda>n. y ^ Suc n - (-y) ^ Suc n) sums T x"
    by (simp add: T_def)
  
  from y have "abs y < 1" "abs (-y) < 1" by simp_all
  from sums_diff[OF this[THEN ln_series']]
    have "(\<lambda>n. y ^ n / real n - (-y) ^ n / real n) sums (ln (1 + y) - ln (1 - y))" by simp
  also from y have "ln (1 + y) - ln (1 - y) = ln ((1 + y) / (1 - y))" by (simp add: ln_div)
  also from x have "(1 + y) / (1 - y) = 1 + 1/x" by (simp add: divide_simps y_def)
  finally have "(\<lambda>n. y^n / real n - (-y)^n / real n) sums ln (1 + 1/x)" .
  hence sum2: "(\<lambda>n. y^Suc n / real (Suc n) - (-y)^Suc n / real (Suc n)) sums ln (1 + 1/x)"
    by (subst sums_Suc_iff) simp

  have "ln (1 + 1/x) \<le> T x"
  proof (rule sums_le [OF _ sum2 sum1])
    fix n :: nat
    show "y ^ Suc n / real (Suc n) - (-y) ^ Suc n / real (Suc n) \<le> y^Suc n - (-y) ^ Suc n"
    proof (cases "even n")
      case True
      hence eq: "A - (-y) ^ Suc n / B = A + y ^ Suc n / B" "A - (-y) ^ Suc n = A + y ^ Suc n"
        for A B by simp_all
      from y show ?thesis unfolding eq
        by (intro add_mono) (auto simp: divide_simps)
    qed simp_all
  qed
  hence "D x \<ge> 0" by (simp add: D)

  define c where "c = (\<lambda>n. if even n then 2 * (1 - 1 / real (Suc n)) else 0)"
  note sums_diff[OF sum1 sum2]
  also have "(\<lambda>n. y ^ Suc n - (-y) ^ Suc n - (y ^ Suc n / real (Suc n) - 
                   (-y) ^ Suc n / real (Suc n))) = (\<lambda>n. c n * y ^ Suc n)"
    by (intro ext) (simp add: c_def algebra_simps)
  finally have sum3: "(\<lambda>n. c n * y ^ Suc n) sums D x" by (simp add: D)
  
  from y have "(\<lambda>n. y^2 * (of_nat (Suc n) * y^n)) sums (y^2 * (1 / (1 - y)^2))"
    by (intro sums_mult geometric_deriv_sums) simp_all
  hence "(\<lambda>n. of_nat (Suc n) * y^(n+2)) sums (y^2 / (1 - y)^2)" 
    by (simp add: algebra_simps power2_eq_square)
  also from x have "y^2 / (1 - y)^2 = 1 / (4*x^2)" by (simp add: y_def divide_simps)
  finally have *: "(\<lambda>n. real (Suc n) * y ^ (Suc (Suc n))) sums (1 / (4 * x\<^sup>2))" by simp

  from y have "(\<lambda>n. y^2 * (of_nat (Suc n) * (-y)^n)) sums (y^2 * (1 / (1 - -y)^2))"
    by (intro sums_mult geometric_deriv_sums) simp_all
  hence "(\<lambda>n. of_nat (Suc n) * (-y)^(n+2)) sums (y^2 / (1 + y)^2)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps power2_eq_square)
  also from x have "y^2 / (1 + y)^2 = 1 / (2^2*(x+1)^2)" 
    unfolding power_mult_distrib [symmetric] by (simp add: y_def divide_simps add_ac)
  finally have **: "(\<lambda>n. real (Suc n) * (- y) ^ (Suc (Suc n))) sums (1 / (4 * (x + 1)\<^sup>2))" by simp
  
  define d where "d = (\<lambda>n. if even n then 2 * real n else 0)"
  note sums_diff[OF * **]
  also have "(\<lambda>n. real (Suc n) * y^(Suc (Suc n)) - real (Suc n) * (-y)^(Suc (Suc n))) = 
                 (\<lambda>n. d (Suc n) * y ^ Suc (Suc n))"
    by (intro ext) (simp_all add: d_def)
  finally have "(\<lambda>n. d n * y ^ Suc n) sums (1 / (4 * x\<^sup>2) - 1 / (4 * (x + 1)\<^sup>2))" 
    by (subst (asm) sums_Suc_iff) (simp add: d_def)
  from sums_mult[OF this, of "1/3"] x
    have sum4: "(\<lambda>n. d n / 3 * y ^ Suc n) sums (1 / (12 * x^2) - 1 / (12 * (x + 1)^2))"
    by (simp add: field_simps)
  
  have "D x \<le> (1 / (12 * x^2) - 1 / (12 * (x + 1)^2))"
  proof (intro sums_le [OF _ sum3 sum4] allI)
    fix n :: nat
    define c' :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real" 
      where "c' = (\<lambda>n. if odd n \<or> n = 0 then 0 else if n = 2 then 4/3 else 2)"
    show "c n * y ^ Suc n \<le> d n / 3 * y ^ Suc n"
    proof (intro mult_right_mono)
      have "c n \<le> c' n" by (simp add: c_def c'_def)
      also consider "n = 0" | "n = 1" | "n = 2" | "n \<ge> 3" by force
      hence "c' n \<le> d n / 3" by cases (simp_all add: c'_def d_def)
      finally show "c n \<le> d n / 3" .
    qed (insert y, simp)
  qed

  with \<open>D x \<ge> 0\<close> show ?thesis by simp
qed  

text \<open>
  The following functions correspond to the $p_n(x)$ from the article.
  The special case $n = 0$ would not, strictly speaking, be necessary, but 
  it allows some theorems to work even without the precondition $n \neq 0$:
\<close>
qualified definition p :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "p n x = (if n = 0 then 1/x else (\<Sum>r<n. D (real r + x)))"

text \<open>
  We can write the Digamma function in terms of @{term S'}:
\<close>
qualified lemma S'_LIMSEQ_Digamma:
  assumes x: "x \<noteq> 0"
  shows   "(\<lambda>n. ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> Digamma x"
proof -
  define c where "c = (\<lambda>n. ln (real n) - (\<Sum>r<n. inverse (x + real r)))"
  have "eventually (\<lambda>n. 1 / (2 * (x + real n)) = c n - (ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x))) at_top"
    using eventually_gt_at_top[of "0::nat"]
  proof eventually_elim
    fix n :: nat
    assume n: "n > 0"
    have "c n - (ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x)) = 
            -(\<Sum>r<n. inverse (real r + x)) + (1/x + (\<Sum>r=1..<n. inverse (real r + x))) + 1/(2*(real n + x))"
      using x by (simp add: S'_def c_def field_simps)
    also have "1/x + (\<Sum>r=1..<n. inverse (real r + x)) = (\<Sum>r<n. inverse (real r + x))"
      unfolding lessThan_atLeast0 using n 
      by (subst (2) sum.atLeast_Suc_lessThan) (simp_all add: field_simps)
    finally show "1 / (2 * (x + real n)) = c n - (ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x))" by simp
  qed
  moreover have "(\<lambda>n. 1 / (2 * (x + real n))) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
    by real_asymp
  ultimately have "(\<lambda>n. c n - (ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x))) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
    by (blast intro: Lim_transform_eventually)
  from tendsto_minus[OF this] have "(\<lambda>n. (ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x)) - c n) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0" by simp
  moreover from Digamma_LIMSEQ[OF x] have "c \<longlonglongrightarrow> Digamma x" by (simp add: c_def) 
  ultimately show "(\<lambda>n. ln (real n) - S' n x - 1/(2*x)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> Digamma x"
    by (rule Lim_transform [rotated])
qed

text \<open>
  Moreover, we can give an expansion of @{term S'} with the @{term p} as variation terms.
\<close>
qualified lemma S'_approx: 
  "S' n x = ln (real n + x) - ln x + p n x"
proof (cases "n = 0")
  case True
  thus ?thesis by (simp add: p_def S'_def)
next
  case False
  hence "S' n x = (\<Sum>r<n. T (real r + x))"
    by (subst S'_telescope_trapezium) simp_all
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>r<n. ln (real r + x + 1) - ln (real r + x) + D (real r + x))"
    by (simp add: D_def)
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>r<n. ln (real (Suc r) + x) - ln (real r + x)) + p n x"
    using False by (simp add: sum.distrib add_ac p_def)
  also have "(\<Sum>r<n. ln (real (Suc r) + x) - ln (real r + x)) = ln (real n + x) - ln x"
    by (subst sum_lessThan_telescope) simp_all
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

text \<open>
  We define the limit of the @{term p} (simply called $p(x)$ in Jameson's article):
\<close>
qualified definition P :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "P x = (\<Sum>n. D (real n + x))"

qualified lemma D_summable:
  assumes x: "x > 0"
  shows   "summable (\<lambda>n. D (real n + x))"
proof -
  have *: "summable (\<lambda>n. 1 / (12 * (x + real n)\<^sup>2) - 1 / (12 * (x + real (Suc n))\<^sup>2))"
    by (rule telescope_summable') real_asymp
  show "summable (\<lambda>n. D (real n + x))" 
  proof (rule summable_comparison_test[OF _ *], rule exI[of _ 2], safe)
    fix n :: nat assume "n \<ge> 2"
    show "norm (D (real n + x)) \<le> 1 / (12 * (x + real n)^2) - 1 / (12 * (x + real (Suc n))^2)"
      using stirling_trapezium[of "real n + x"] x by (auto simp: algebra_simps)
  qed
qed

qualified lemma p_LIMSEQ:
  assumes x: "x > 0"
  shows   "(\<lambda>n. p n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> P x"
proof (rule Lim_transform_eventually)
  from D_summable[OF x] have "(\<lambda>n. D (real n + x)) sums P x" unfolding P_def
    by (simp add: sums_iff)
  then show "(\<lambda>n. \<Sum>r<n. D (real r + x)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> P x" by (simp add: sums_def)
  moreover from eventually_gt_at_top[of 1]
  show "eventually (\<lambda>n. (\<Sum>r<n. D (real r + x)) = p n x) at_top"
    by eventually_elim (auto simp: p_def)
qed

text \<open>
  This gives us an expansion of the Digamma function:
\<close>
lemma Digamma_approx:
  assumes x: "(x :: real) > 0"
  shows   "Digamma x = ln x - 1 / (2 * x) - P x"
  by sorry
           
text \<open>
  Next, we derive some bounds on @{term "P"}:
\<close>
qualified lemma p_ge_0: "x > 0 \<Longrightarrow> p n x \<ge> 0"
  using stirling_trapezium[of "real n + x" for n]
  by (auto simp add: p_def intro!: sum_nonneg)

qualified lemma P_ge_0: "x > 0 \<Longrightarrow> P x \<ge> 0"
  by (rule tendsto_lowerbound[OF p_LIMSEQ]) 
     (insert p_ge_0[of x], simp_all)

qualified lemma p_upper_bound:
  assumes "x > 0" "n > 0"
  shows "p n x \<le> 1/(12*x^2)"
proof -
  from assms have "p n x = (\<Sum>r<n. D (real r + x))"
    by (simp add: p_def)
  also have "\<dots> \<le> (\<Sum>r<n. 1/(12*(real r + x)^2) - 1/(12 * (real (Suc r) + x)^2))"
    using stirling_trapezium[of "real r + x" for r] assms 
    by (intro sum_mono) (simp add: add_ac)
  also have "\<dots> = 1 / (12 * x\<^sup>2) - 1 / (12 * (real n + x)\<^sup>2)"
    by (subst sum_lessThan_telescope') simp
  also have "\<dots> \<le> 1 / (12 * x^2)" by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

qualified lemma P_upper_bound:
  assumes "x > 0"
  shows   "P x \<le> 1/(12*x^2)"
proof (rule tendsto_upperbound)
  show "eventually (\<lambda>n. p n x \<le> 1 / (12 * x^2)) at_top"
    using eventually_gt_at_top[of 0] 
    by eventually_elim (use p_upper_bound[of x] assms in auto)
  show "(\<lambda>n. p n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> P x"
    by (simp add: assms p_LIMSEQ)
qed auto


text \<open>
  We can now use this approximation of the Digamma function to approximate
  @{term ln_Gamma} (since the former is the derivative of the latter). 
  We therefore define the function $g$ from Jameson's article, which measures 
  the difference between @{term ln_Gamma} and its approximation:
\<close>

qualified definition g :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "g x = ln_Gamma x - (x - 1/2) * ln x + x"

qualified lemma DERIV_g: "x > 0 \<Longrightarrow> (g has_field_derivative -P x) (at x)"
  unfolding g_def [abs_def] using Digamma_approx[of x]
  by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)

qualified lemma isCont_P: 
  assumes "x > 0"
  shows   "isCont P x"
proof -
  define D' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    where "D' = (\<lambda>x. - 1 / (2 * x^2 * (x+1)^2))"
  have DERIV_D: "(D has_field_derivative D' x) (at x)" if "x > 0" for x
    unfolding D_def [abs_def] D'_def T_def
    by (insert that, (rule derivative_eq_intros refl | simp)+)
       (simp add: power2_eq_square divide_simps,  (simp add: algebra_simps)?)
  note this [THEN DERIV_chain2, derivative_intros]
  
  have "(P has_field_derivative (\<Sum>n. D' (real n + x))) (at x)"
    unfolding P_def [abs_def]
  proof (rule has_field_derivative_series')
    show "convex {x/2<..}" by simp
  next
    fix n :: nat and y :: real assume y: "y \<in> {x/2<..}"
    with assms have "y > 0" by simp
    thus "((\<lambda>a. D (real n + a)) has_real_derivative D' (real n + y)) (at y within {x/2<..})"
      by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros)
  next
    from assms D_summable[of x] show "summable (\<lambda>n. D (real n + x))" by simp
  next
    show "uniformly_convergent_on {x/2<..} (\<lambda>n x. \<Sum>i<n. D' (real i + x))"
    proof (rule Weierstrass_m_test')
      fix n :: nat and y :: real
      assume y: "y \<in> {x/2<..}"
      with assms have "y > 0" by auto
      have "norm (D' (real n + y)) = (1 / (2 * (y + real n)^2)) * (1 / (y + real (Suc n))^2)"
        by (simp add: D'_def add_ac)
      also from y assms have "\<dots> \<le> (1 / (2 * (x/2)^2)) * (1 / (real (Suc n))^2)"
        by (intro mult_mono divide_left_mono power_mono) simp_all
      also have "1 / (real (Suc n))^2 = inverse ((real (Suc n))^2)" by (simp add: field_simps)
      finally show "norm (D' (real n + y)) \<le> (1 / (2 * (x/2)^2)) * inverse ((real (Suc n))^2)" .
    next
      show "summable (\<lambda>n. (1 / (2 * (x/2)^2)) * inverse ((real (Suc n))^2))"
        by (subst summable_Suc_iff, intro summable_mult inverse_power_summable) simp_all
    qed
  qed (insert assms, simp_all add: interior_open)
  thus ?thesis by (rule DERIV_isCont)
qed

qualified lemma P_continuous_on [THEN continuous_on_subset]: "continuous_on {0<..} P"
  by (intro continuous_at_imp_continuous_on ballI isCont_P) auto

qualified lemma P_integrable:
  assumes a: "a > 0"
  shows   "P integrable_on {a..}"
proof -
  define f where "f = (\<lambda>n x. if x \<in> {a..real n} then P x else 0)"
  show "P integrable_on {a..}"
  proof (rule dominated_convergence)
    fix n :: nat
    from a have "P integrable_on {a..real n}"
      by (intro integrable_continuous_real P_continuous_on) auto
    hence "f n integrable_on {a..real n}"
      by (rule integrable_eq) (simp add: f_def)
    thus "f n integrable_on {a..}"
      by (rule integrable_on_superset) (auto simp: f_def)
  next
    fix n :: nat
    show "norm (f n x) \<le> of_real (1/12) * (1 / x^2)" if "x \<in> {a..}" for x
      using a P_ge_0 P_upper_bound by (auto simp: f_def)
  next
    show "(\<lambda>x::real. of_real (1/12) * (1 / x^2)) integrable_on {a..}"
      using has_integral_inverse_power_to_inf[of 2 a] a
      by (intro integrable_on_cmult_left) auto
  next
    show "(\<lambda>n. f n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> P x" if "x\<in>{a..}" for x
    proof -
      have "eventually (\<lambda>n. real n \<ge> x) at_top"
        using filterlim_real_sequentially by (simp add: filterlim_at_top)
      with that not_frequently have "eventually (\<lambda>n. f n x = P x) at_top"
        by (force simp: f_def)
      thus "(\<lambda>n. f n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> P x" by (simp add: tendsto_eventually)
    qed
  qed
qed

qualified definition c :: real where "c = integral {1..} (\<lambda>x. -P x) + g 1"

text \<open>
  We can now give bounds on @{term g}:
\<close>
qualified lemma g_bounds:
  assumes x: "x \<ge> 1"
  shows   "g x \<in> {c..c + 1/(12*x)}"
proof -
  from assms have int_nonneg: "integral {x..} P \<ge> 0"
    by (intro Henstock_Kurzweil_Integration.integral_nonneg P_integrable)
       (auto simp: P_ge_0)
  have int_upper_bound: "integral {x..} P \<le> 1/(12*x)"
  proof (rule has_integral_le)
    from x show "(P has_integral integral {x..} P) {x..}"
      by (intro integrable_integral P_integrable) simp_all
    from x has_integral_mult_right[OF has_integral_inverse_power_to_inf[of 2 x], of "1/12"]
      show "((\<lambda>x. 1/(12*x^2)) has_integral (1/(12*x))) {x..}" by (simp add: field_simps)
  qed (insert P_upper_bound x, simp_all)

  note DERIV_g [THEN DERIV_chain2, derivative_intros]
  from assms have int1: "((\<lambda>x. -P x) has_integral (g x - g 1)) {1..x}"
    by (intro fundamental_theorem_of_calculus)
       (auto simp: has_real_derivative_iff_has_vector_derivative [symmetric]
             intro!: derivative_eq_intros)
  from x have int2: "((\<lambda>x. -P x) has_integral integral {x..} (\<lambda>x. -P x)) {x..}"
    by (intro integrable_integral integrable_neg P_integrable) simp_all
  from has_integral_Un[OF int1 int2] x
    have "((\<lambda>x. - P x) has_integral g x - g 1 - integral {x..} P) ({1..x} \<union> {x..})"
    by (simp add: max_def)
  also from x have "{1..x} \<union> {x..} = {1..}" by auto
  finally have "((\<lambda>x. -P x) has_integral g x - g 1 - integral {x..} P) {1..}" .
  moreover have "((\<lambda>x. -P x) has_integral integral {1..} (\<lambda>x. -P x)) {1..}"
    by (intro integrable_integral integrable_neg P_integrable) simp_all
  ultimately have "g x - g 1 - integral {x..} P = integral {1..} (\<lambda>x. -P x)"
    by (simp add: has_integral_unique)
  hence "g x = c + integral {x..} P" by (simp add: c_def algebra_simps)
  with int_upper_bound int_nonneg show "g x \<in> {c..c + 1/(12*x)}" by simp
qed


text \<open>
  Finally, we have bounds on @{term ln_Gamma}, @{term Gamma}, and @{term fact}.
\<close>
qualified lemma ln_Gamma_bounds_aux:
  "x \<ge> 1 \<Longrightarrow> ln_Gamma x \<ge> c + (x - 1/2) * ln x - x"
  "x \<ge> 1 \<Longrightarrow> ln_Gamma x \<le> c + (x - 1/2) * ln x - x + 1/(12*x)"
  using g_bounds[of x] by (simp_all add: g_def)

qualified lemma Gamma_bounds_aux:
  assumes x: "x \<ge> 1"
  shows   "Gamma x \<ge> exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x"
          "Gamma x \<le> exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x * exp (1/(12*x))"
proof -
  have "exp (ln_Gamma x) \<ge> exp (c + (x - 1/2) * ln x - x)"
    by (subst exp_le_cancel_iff, rule ln_Gamma_bounds_aux) (simp add: x)
  with x show "Gamma x \<ge> exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x"
    by (simp add: Gamma_real_pos_exp exp_add exp_diff powr_def del: exp_le_cancel_iff)
next
  have "exp (ln_Gamma x) \<le> exp (c + (x - 1/2) * ln x - x + 1/(12*x))"
    by (subst exp_le_cancel_iff, rule ln_Gamma_bounds_aux) (simp add: x)
  with x show "Gamma x \<le> exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x * exp (1/(12*x))"
    by (simp add: Gamma_real_pos_exp exp_add exp_diff powr_def del: exp_le_cancel_iff)
qed

qualified lemma Gamma_asymp_equiv_aux: 
  "Gamma \<sim>[at_top] (\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x)"
proof (rule asymp_equiv_sandwich)
  include asymp_equiv_syntax
  show "eventually (\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x \<le> Gamma x) at_top"
       "eventually (\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1/2) / exp x * exp (1/(12*x)) \<ge> Gamma x) at_top"
    using eventually_ge_at_top[of "1::real"]
    by (eventually_elim; use Gamma_bounds_aux in force)+
  have "((\<lambda>x::real. exp (1 / (12 * x))) \<longlongrightarrow> exp 0) at_top"
    by real_asymp
  hence "(\<lambda>x. exp (1 / (12 * x))) \<sim> (\<lambda>x. 1 :: real)"
    by (intro asymp_equivI') simp_all
  hence "(\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1 / 2) / exp x * 1) \<sim>
          (\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1 / 2) / exp x * exp (1 / (12 * x)))"
    by (intro asymp_equiv_mult asymp_equiv_refl) (simp add: asymp_equiv_sym)
  thus "(\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1 / 2) / exp x) \<sim>
          (\<lambda>x. exp c * x powr (x - 1 / 2) / exp x * exp (1 / (12 * x)))" by simp
qed simp_all

qualified lemma exp_1_powr_real [simp]: "exp (1::real) powr x = exp x"
  by (simp add: powr_def)

qualified lemma fact_asymp_equiv_aux:
  "fact \<sim>[at_top] (\<lambda>x. exp c * sqrt (real x) * (real x / exp 1) powr real x)"
proof -
  include asymp_equiv_syntax
  have "fact \<sim> (\<lambda>n. Gamma (real (Suc n)))" by (simp add: Gamma_fact)
  also have "eventually (\<lambda>n. Gamma (real (Suc n)) = real n * Gamma (real n)) at_top"
    using eventually_gt_at_top[of "0::nat"]
    by eventually_elim (insert Gamma_plus1[of "real n" for n], 
                        auto simp: add_ac of_nat_in_nonpos_Ints_iff)
  also have "(\<lambda>n. Gamma (real n)) \<sim> (\<lambda>n. exp c * real n powr (real n - 1/2) / exp (real n))"
    by (rule asymp_equiv_compose'[OF Gamma_asymp_equiv_aux] filterlim_real_sequentially)+
  also have "eventually (\<lambda>n. real n * (exp c * real n powr (real n - 1 / 2) / exp (real n)) =
               exp c * sqrt (real n) * (real n / exp 1) powr real n) at_top"
    using eventually_gt_at_top[of "0::nat"]
  proof eventually_elim
    fix n :: nat assume n: "n > 0"
    thus "real n * (exp c * real n powr (real n - 1 / 2) / exp (real n)) =
            exp c * sqrt (real n) * (real n / exp 1) powr real n"
      by (subst powr_diff) (simp_all add: powr_divide powr_half_sqrt field_simps)
  qed
  finally show ?thesis by - (simp_all add: asymp_equiv_mult)
qed

text \<open>
  We cal also bound @{term Digamma} above and below.
\<close>
  
lemma Digamma_plus_1_gt_ln:
  assumes x: "x > (0 :: real)"
  shows   "Digamma (x + 1) > ln x"
  by sorry

lemma Digamma_less_ln:
  assumes x: "x > (0 :: real)"
  shows   "Digamma x < ln x"
  by sorry

text \<open>
  We still need to determine the constant term @{term c}, which we do using Wallis' 
  product formula: $$\prod_{n=1}^\infty \frac{4n^2}{4n^2-1} = \frac{\pi}{2}$$
\<close>
qualified lemma powr_mult_2: "(x::real) > 0 \<Longrightarrow> x powr (y * 2) = (x^2) powr y"
  by (subst mult.commute, subst powr_powr [symmetric]) (simp add: powr_numeral)

qualified lemma exp_mult_2: "exp (y * 2 :: real) = exp y * exp y"
  by (subst exp_add [symmetric]) simp

qualified lemma exp_c: "exp c = sqrt (2*pi)"
proof -
  include asymp_equiv_syntax
  define p where "p = (\<lambda>n. \<Prod>k=1..n. (4*real k^2) / (4*real k^2 - 1))"

  have p_0 [simp]: "p 0 = 1" by (simp add: p_def)
  have p_Suc: "p (Suc n) = p n * (4 * real (Suc n)^2) / (4 * real (Suc n)^2 - 1)"
    for n unfolding p_def by (subst prod.nat_ivl_Suc') simp_all
  have p: "p = (\<lambda>n. 16 ^ n * fact n ^ 4 / (fact (2 * n))\<^sup>2 / (2 * real n + 1))"
  proof
    fix n :: nat
    have "p n = (\<Prod>k=1..n. (2*real k)^2 / (2*real k - 1) / (2 * real k + 1))"
      unfolding p_def by (intro prod.cong refl) (simp add: field_simps power2_eq_square)
    also have "\<dots> = (\<Prod>k=1..n. (2*real k)^2 / (2*real k - 1)) / (\<Prod>k=1..n. (2 * real (Suc k) - 1))"
      by (simp add: prod_dividef prod.distrib add_ac)
    also have "(\<Prod>k=1..n. (2 * real (Suc k) - 1)) = (\<Prod>k=Suc 1..Suc n. (2 * real k - 1))"
      by (subst prod.atLeast_Suc_atMost_Suc_shift) simp_all
    also have "\<dots> = (\<Prod>k=1..n. (2 * real k - 1)) * (2 * real n + 1)"
      by (induction n) (simp_all add: prod.nat_ivl_Suc')
    also have "(\<Prod>k = 1..n. (2 * real k)\<^sup>2 / (2 * real k - 1)) / \<dots> =
                 (\<Prod>k = 1..n. (2 * real k)^2 / (2 * real k - 1)^2) / (2 * real n + 1)"
      unfolding power2_eq_square by (simp add: prod.distrib prod_dividef)
    also have "(\<Prod>k = 1..n. (2 * real k)^2 / (2 * real k - 1)^2) =
                 (\<Prod>k = 1..n. (2 * real k)^4 / ((2*real k)*(2 * real k - 1))^2)"
      by (rule prod.cong) (simp_all add: power2_eq_square eval_nat_numeral)
    also have "\<dots> = 16^n * fact n^4 / (\<Prod>k=1..n. (2*real k) * (2*real k - 1))^2"
      by (simp add: prod.distrib prod_dividef fact_prod
            prod_power_distrib [symmetric] prod_constant)
    also have "(\<Prod>k=1..n. (2*real k) * (2*real k - 1)) = fact (2*n)"
      by (induction n) (simp_all add: algebra_simps prod.nat_ivl_Suc')
    finally show "p n = 16 ^ n * fact n ^ 4 / (fact (2 * n))\<^sup>2 / (2 * real n + 1)" .
  qed

  have "p \<sim> (\<lambda>n. 16 ^ n * fact n ^ 4 / (fact (2 * n))\<^sup>2 / (2 * real n + 1))"
    by (simp add: p)
  also have "\<dots> \<sim> (\<lambda>n. 16^n * (exp c * sqrt (real n) * (real n / exp 1) powr real n)^4 /
                       (exp c * sqrt (real (2*n)) * (real (2*n) / exp 1) powr real (2*n))^2 /
                       (2 * real n + 1))" (is "_ \<sim> ?f")
    by (intro asymp_equiv_mult asymp_equiv_divide asymp_equiv_refl mult_nat_left_at_top
              fact_asymp_equiv_aux asymp_equiv_power asymp_equiv_compose'[OF fact_asymp_equiv_aux]) 
       simp_all
  also have "eventually (\<lambda>n. \<dots> n = exp c ^ 2 / (4 + 2/n)) at_top"
    using eventually_gt_at_top[of "0::nat"]
  proof eventually_elim
    fix n :: nat assume n: "n > 0"
    have [simp]: "16^n = 4^n * (4^n :: real)" by (simp add: power_mult_distrib [symmetric])
    from n have "?f n = exp c ^ 2 * (n / (2*(2*n+1)))"
      by (simp add: power_mult_distrib divide_simps powr_mult real_sqrt_power_even)
         (simp add: field_simps power2_eq_square eval_nat_numeral powr_mult_2 
                    exp_mult_2 powr_realpow)
    also from n have "\<dots> = exp c ^ 2 / (4 + 2/n)" by (simp add: field_simps)
    finally show "?f n = \<dots>" .
  qed
  also have "(\<lambda>x. 4 + 2 / real x) \<sim> (\<lambda>x. 4)"
    by (subst asymp_equiv_add_right) auto
  finally have "p \<longlonglongrightarrow> exp c ^ 2 / 4" 
    by (rule asymp_equivD_const) (simp_all add: asymp_equiv_divide)
  moreover have "p \<longlonglongrightarrow> pi / 2" unfolding p_def by (rule wallis)
  ultimately have "exp c ^ 2 / 4 = pi / 2" by (rule LIMSEQ_unique)
  hence "2 * pi = exp c ^ 2" by simp
  also have "sqrt (exp c ^ 2) = exp c" by simp
  finally show "exp c = sqrt (2 * pi)" ..
qed

qualified lemma c: "c = ln (2*pi) / 2"
proof -
  note exp_c [symmetric]
  also have "ln (exp c) = c" by simp
  finally show ?thesis by (simp add: ln_sqrt)
qed


text \<open>
  This gives us the final bounds:
\<close>
theorem Gamma_bounds:
  assumes "x \<ge> 1"
  shows   "Gamma x \<ge> sqrt (2*pi/x) * (x / exp 1) powr x" (is ?th1)
          "Gamma x \<le> sqrt (2*pi/x) * (x / exp 1) powr x * exp (1 / (12 * x))" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

theorem ln_Gamma_bounds:
  assumes "x \<ge> 1"
  shows   "ln_Gamma x \<ge> ln (2*pi/x) / 2 + x * ln x - x" (is ?th1)
          "ln_Gamma x \<le> ln (2*pi/x) / 2 + x * ln x - x + 1/(12*x)" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

theorem fact_bounds:
  assumes "n > 0"
  shows   "(fact n :: real) \<ge> sqrt (2*pi*n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n" (is ?th1)
          "(fact n :: real) \<le> sqrt (2*pi*n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n * exp (1 / (12 * n))" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

theorem ln_fact_bounds:
  assumes "n > 0"
  shows   "ln (fact n :: real) \<ge> ln (2*pi*n)/2 + n * ln n - n" (is ?th1)
          "ln (fact n :: real) \<le> ln (2*pi*n)/2 + n * ln n - n + 1/(12*real n)" (is ?th2)
  by sorry

theorem Gamma_asymp_equiv: 
  "Gamma \<sim>[at_top] (\<lambda>x. sqrt (2*pi/x) * (x / exp 1) powr x :: real)"
  by sorry

theorem fact_asymp_equiv: 
  "fact \<sim>[at_top] (\<lambda>n. sqrt (2*pi*n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n :: real)"
  by sorry

corollary stirling_tendsto_sqrt_pi:
  "(\<lambda>n. fact n / (sqrt (2 * n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> sqrt pi"
  by sorry

end

end

title: 090_stirling_s_formula
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__090, "Stirling's Formula": using exact Cauchy-real
;; representatives by rational sequences, the squared positive normalized
;; factorial ratio tends to 1 with an existential epsilon-N cutoff.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Ordinary ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive real numbers.
;; Here a real is represented exactly by a rational Cauchy sequence.  The
;; factorial series represents e, Machin's arctangent series represents pi,
;; and, for each n, HT090-STIRLING-SQUARED-RATIO-APPROX is the full Cauchy
;; representative of
;;
;;   (n!)^2 * e^(2*n) / (2*pi*n^(2*n+1)).
;;
;; No n-dependent finite prefix is treated as the real value.  Strict
;; Cauchy-real inequalities below contain an internal rational bound and an
;; existential approximation cutoff.

(defun ht090-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (ht090-factorial (1- n)))))

(defun ht090-exp-one-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (+ (ht090-exp-one-prefix index)
         (/ 1 (ht090-factorial index))))))

(defun ht090-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned (/ (expt z exponent) exponent))
           (term (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                     unsigned
                   (- unsigned))))
      (+ (ht090-arctan-prefix z index)
         term))))

(defun ht090-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16 (ht090-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4 (ht090-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

(defun ht090-stirling-squared-ratio-approx (n terms)
  (let* ((fact-n (ht090-factorial n))
         (e-approx (ht090-exp-one-prefix terms))
         (pi-approx (ht090-pi-prefix terms))
         (twice-n (* 2 n)))
    (/ (* fact-n
          fact-n
          (expt e-approx twice-n))
       (* 2
          pi-approx
          (expt n (+ twice-n 1))))))

;; Eventually every rational approximation lies below BOUND.  Together with
;; 0 < BOUND < EPSILON, this is exactly the strict Cauchy-real inequality
;; |ratio(n) - 1| < EPSILON, including the boundary distinction.
(defun-sk ht090-cauchy-close-tail-p
    (n bound approximation-cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp approximation-cutoff)
      (<= approximation-cutoff terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (ht090-stirling-squared-ratio-approx n terms)
            1))
        bound))))

(defun-sk ht090-cauchy-real-close-p (n epsilon)
  (exists (bound approximation-cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (< 0 bound)
     (< bound epsilon)
     (natp approximation-cutoff)
     (ht090-cauchy-close-tail-p
      n bound approximation-cutoff))))

(defun-sk ht090-stirling-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (ht090-cauchy-real-close-p n epsilon))))

(defun-sk ht090-stirling-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (ht090-stirling-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk hundred-theorems-090-stirling-formula-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (ht090-stirling-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 090_stirling_s_formula
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact
-- hundred-theorems__agda__090, "Stirling's Formula": the factorial sequence
-- is asymptotically equivalent to sqrt(2*pi*n) * (n/e)^n over natural indices.
-- This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infix 4 _≤N_

data Bottom : Set where

NotEqual :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
NotEqual x y = x ≡ y → Bottom

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A → Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

data _≤N_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤N : {n : Nat} → zero ≤N n
  suc≤N : {m n : Nat} → m ≤N n → suc m ≤N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR inverseR absoluteValueR : R → R
    lessOrEqualR : R → R → Set r
    fromNatR : Nat → R

    oneR-not-zeroR :
      NotEqual oneR zeroR

    addR-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    addR-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    addR-zero :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    addR-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiplyR-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiplyR-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiplyR-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    multiplyR-zero :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    multiplyR-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      NotEqual x zeroR →
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) ≡ oneR
    inverseR-zero :
      inverseR zeroR ≡ zeroR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    addR-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiplyR-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zeroR-less-than-oneR :
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR)
        (NotEqual zeroR oneR)

    absoluteR-nonnegative :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteValueR x)
    absoluteR-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      absoluteValueR x ≡ x
    absoluteR-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR →
      absoluteValueR x ≡ negateR x

    fromNatR-zero :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNatR-successor :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNatR-injective :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n →
      m ≡ n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Exists Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set r) →
      Exists R P →
      Exists R
        (λ upper →
          (x : R) →
          P x →
          lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Exists R
        (λ supremum →
          Both
            ((x : R) →
              P x →
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) →
              ((x : R) →
                P x →
                lessOrEqualR x upper) →
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

subtractR :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  CompleteOrderedField.addR reals
    x
    (CompleteOrderedField.negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  R
divideR reals x y =
  CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
    x
    (CompleteOrderedField.inverseR reals y)

powerR :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  CompleteOrderedField.oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
    (powerR reals x n)
    x

factorial : Nat → Nat
factorial zero = suc zero
factorial (suc n) = suc n * factorial n

partialSumR :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  (Nat → R) →
  Nat →
  R
partialSumR reals term zero =
  CompleteOrderedField.zeroR reals
partialSumR reals term (suc n) =
  CompleteOrderedField.addR reals
    (partialSumR reals term n)
    (term n)

StrictLess :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  Set r
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both
    (CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    (NotEqual x y)

Positive :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Set r
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals
    (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR reals)
    x

SequentialLimit :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  (Nat → R) →
  R →
  Set r
SequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) →
  Positive reals epsilon →
  Exists Nat
    (λ cutoff →
      (n : Nat) →
      cutoff ≤N n →
      StrictLess reals
        (CompleteOrderedField.absoluteValueR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x n =
  partialSumR reals
    (λ k →
      divideR reals
        (powerR reals x k)
        (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals (factorial k)))
    n

alternatingSign :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Nat →
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  CompleteOrderedField.oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  CompleteOrderedField.negateR reals (alternatingSign reals n)

double : Nat → Nat
double zero = zero
double (suc n) = suc (suc (double n))

oddIndex : Nat → Nat
oddIndex n = suc (double n)

sinePartialSum :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
sinePartialSum reals x n =
  partialSumR reals
    (λ k →
      divideR reals
        (CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
          (alternatingSign reals k)
          (powerR reals x (oddIndex k)))
        (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals
          (factorial (oddIndex k))))
    n

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    squareRoot exponential sine : R → R
    pi : R

    squareRoot-nonnegative :
      (x : R) →
      CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR algebra
        (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR algebra)
        (squareRoot x)
    squareRoot-square :
      (x : R) →
      CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR algebra
        (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR algebra)
        x →
      CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR algebra
        (squareRoot x)
        (squareRoot x) ≡ x
    squareRoot-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) →
      CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR algebra
        x
        (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR algebra) →
      squareRoot x ≡ CompleteOrderedField.zeroR algebra

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) →
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (exponentialPartialSum algebra x)
        (exponential x)

    sine-series :
      (x : R) →
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (sinePartialSum algebra x)
        (sine x)
    pi-positive :
      Positive algebra pi
    sine-pi :
      sine pi ≡ CompleteOrderedField.zeroR algebra
    sine-positive-before-pi :
      (x : R) →
      Positive algebra x →
      StrictLess algebra x pi →
      Positive algebra (sine x)

two : Nat
two = suc (suc zero)

factorialValue :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Nat →
  R
factorialValue reals n =
  CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals (factorial n)

stirlingApproximation :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  StandardRealAnalysis R →
  Nat →
  R
stirlingApproximation analysis n =
  CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
    (StandardRealAnalysis.squareRoot analysis
      (CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
        (CompleteOrderedField.multiplyR reals
          (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals two)
          (StandardRealAnalysis.pi analysis))
        (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals n)))
    (powerR reals
      (divideR reals
        (CompleteOrderedField.fromNatR reals n)
        (StandardRealAnalysis.exponential analysis
          (CompleteOrderedField.oneR reals)))
      n)
  where
    reals = StandardRealAnalysis.algebra analysis

AsymptoticallyEquivalent :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  (Nat → R) →
  (Nat → R) →
  Set r
AsymptoticallyEquivalent reals sequence comparison =
  SequentialLimit reals
    (λ n → divideR reals (sequence n) (comparison n))
    (CompleteOrderedField.oneR reals)

stirlings-formula :
  {r : Level} →
  Set (lsuc r)
stirlings-formula {r} =
  (R : Set r) →
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) →
  AsymptoticallyEquivalent
    (StandardRealAnalysis.algebra analysis)
    (factorialValue (StandardRealAnalysis.algebra analysis))
    (stirlingApproximation analysis)
