lemma simple_path_linear_image:
  assumes "simple_path p"
  assumes "inj f \<and> bounded_linear f"
  shows "simple_path (f \<circ> p)" 
  by sorry

lemma vts_interior:
  fixes vts
  defines "p \<equiv> make_polygonal_path vts"
  assumes "convex H"
  assumes "\<forall>j \<in> {0<..<length vts - 1}. vts!j \<notin> frontier H"
  assumes "loop_free p"
  assumes "path_image p \<subseteq> H"
  assumes "length vts \<ge> 3"
  shows "p`{0<..<1} \<subseteq> interior H"
  by sorry

lemma pocket_fill_line_int_0:
  assumes "polygon_of r vts"
  defines "H \<equiv> convex hull (set vts)"
  assumes "2 \<le> i \<and> i < length vts - 1"
  defines "a \<equiv> hd vts"
  defines "b \<equiv> vts!i"
  assumes "{a, b} \<subseteq> frontier H"
  assumes "\<forall>j \<in> {0<..<i}. vts!j \<notin> frontier H"
  assumes "a = 0"
  shows "path_image (linepath a b) \<inter> path_image r = {a, b}"
        "path_image (linepath a b) \<subseteq> frontier H"
  by sorry

lemma linepath_translation: "(\<lambda>v. v - a) \<circ> (linepath x y) = linepath ((\<lambda>v. v - a) x) ((\<lambda>v. v - a) y)"
  by sorry

lemma linepath_image_translation:
    "path_image ((\<lambda>v. v - a) \<circ> (linepath x y)) = path_image (linepath ((\<lambda>v. v - a) x) ((\<lambda>v. v - a) y))"
  by sorry

lemma make_polygonal_path_translate:
  assumes "length vts \<ge> 1"
  shows "(\<lambda>v. v - a) \<circ> (make_polygonal_path vts) = make_polygonal_path (map (\<lambda>v. v - a) vts)"
  by sorry

lemma pocket_fill_line_int:
  assumes "polygon_of r vts"
  defines "H \<equiv> convex hull (set vts)"
  assumes "2 \<le> i \<and> i < length vts - 1"
  defines "a \<equiv> hd vts"
  defines "b \<equiv> vts!i"
  assumes "{a, b} \<subseteq> frontier H"
  assumes "\<forall>j \<in> {0<..<i}. vts!j \<notin> frontier H"
  shows "path_image (linepath a b) \<inter> path_image r = {a, b}"
        "path_image (linepath a b) \<subseteq> frontier H"
  by sorry

(* not in libraries; would be nice? *)
lemma path_connected_simple_path_endless:
  assumes "simple_path p"
  shows "path_connected (path_image p - {pathstart p, pathfinish p})" (is "path_connected ?S")
  by sorry

lemma simple_loop_split:
  assumes "simple_path p \<and> closed_path p"
  assumes "simple_path q"
  assumes "path_image q \<inter> path_image p = {q 0, q 1}"
  assumes "path_image q \<inter> path_inside p \<noteq> {}"
  shows "q`{0<..<1} \<subseteq> path_inside p"
  by sorry

lemma pocket_path_interior_aux:
  assumes "simple_path p \<and> simple_path q"
  assumes "arc p \<and> arc q"
  assumes "q 0 = p 1 \<and> q 1 = p 0"
  assumes "path_image p \<inter> path_image q = {p 0, q 0}"
  defines "A \<equiv> convex hull (path_image p \<union> path_image q)"
  defines "l \<equiv> linepath (p 0) (p 1)"
  assumes "p`{0<..<1} \<subseteq> interior A"
  assumes "path_image l \<subseteq> frontier A"
  assumes "path_image q \<inter> path_image l = {l 0, q 0}"
  shows "p`{0<..<1} \<inter> path_inside (l +++ q) \<noteq> {}"
        "simple_path (l +++ q) \<and> closed_path (l +++ q)"
        "path_image p \<inter> path_image (l +++ q) = {p 0, p 1}"
  by sorry

lemma pocket_path_interior:
  assumes "simple_path p \<and> simple_path q"
  assumes "arc p \<and> arc q"
  assumes "q 0 = p 1 \<and> q 1 = p 0"
  assumes "path_image p \<inter> path_image q = {p 0, q 0}"
  defines "A \<equiv> convex hull (path_image p \<union> path_image q)"
  defines "l \<equiv> linepath (p 0) (p 1)"
  assumes "p`{0<..<1} \<subseteq> interior A"
  assumes "path_image l \<subseteq> frontier A"
  assumes "path_image q \<inter> path_image l = {l 0, q 0}"
  shows "p`{0<..<1} \<subseteq> path_inside (l +++ q)"
  by sorry

lemma pocket_path_good:
  assumes "polygon (make_polygonal_path vts)"
  assumes "vts!0 \<in> frontier (convex hull (set vts))"
  assumes "vts!1 \<notin> frontier (convex hull (set vts))"
  assumes "\<not> convex (path_image (make_polygonal_path vts) \<union> path_inside (make_polygonal_path vts))"
  defines "pocket_path_vts \<equiv> construct_pocket_0 vts (set vts \<inter> frontier (convex hull (set vts)))"
  defines "pocket \<equiv> make_polygonal_path (pocket_path_vts @ [pocket_path_vts!0])"
  defines "filled_vts \<equiv> fill_pocket_0 vts (length pocket_path_vts)"
  defines "filled_p \<equiv> make_polygonal_path filled_vts"
  defines "a \<equiv> hd pocket_path_vts"
  defines "b \<equiv> last pocket_path_vts"
  defines "good_pocket_path_vts \<equiv> tl (butlast pocket_path_vts)"
  shows "polygon filled_p"
        "is_polygon_split_path (butlast filled_vts) 0 1 good_pocket_path_vts"
        "polygon pocket"
        "card (set pocket_path_vts) < card (set vts)"
        "card (set filled_vts) < card (set vts)"
  by sorry

subsection "Arbitrary Polygon Case"

lemma pick_rotate:
  assumes "polygon_of p vts"
  assumes "all_integral vts"
  obtains p' vts' where "polygon_of p' vts'
    \<and> vts'!0 \<in> frontier (convex hull (set vts'))
    \<and> path_image p' = path_image p
    \<and> all_integral vts'
    \<and> set vts' = set vts"
  by sorry

lemma pick_unrotated:
  fixes p :: "R_to_R2"
  assumes polygon: "polygon p"
  assumes polygonal_path: "p = make_polygonal_path vts"
  assumes int_vertices: "all_integral vts"
  assumes I_is: "I = card {x. integral_vec x \<and> x \<in> path_inside p}" 
  assumes B_is: "B = card {x. integral_vec x \<and> x \<in> path_image p}"
  assumes "vts!0 \<in> frontier (convex hull (set vts))"
  shows "measure lebesgue (path_inside p) = I + B/2 - 1"
  by sorry

theorem pick:
  fixes p :: "R_to_R2"
  assumes "polygon p"
  assumes "p = make_polygonal_path vts"
  assumes "all_integral vts"
  assumes "I = card {x. integral_vec x \<and> x \<in> path_inside p}" 
  assumes "B = card {x. integral_vec x \<and> x \<in> path_image p}"
  shows "measure lebesgue (path_inside p) = I + B/2 - 1"
  by sorry

end

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Pick's theorem.                                                           *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

needs "Multivariate/polytope.ml";;
needs "Multivariate/measure.ml";;
needs "Multivariate/moretop.ml";;

prioritize_real();;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Misc lemmas.                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let COLLINEAR_IMP_NEGLIGIBLE = `!s:real^2->bool. collinear s ==> negligible s`;;

let CONVEX_HULL_3_0 = `!a b:real^N.
        convex hull {vec 0,a,b} =
        {x % a + y % b | &0 <= x /\ &0 <= y /\ x + y <= &1}`;;

let INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_3_0 = `!a b:real^2.
        ~(collinear {vec 0,a,b})
        ==> interior(convex hull {vec 0,a,b}) =
              {x % a + y % b | &0 < x /\ &0 < y /\ x + y < &1}`;;

let MEASURE_CONVEX_HULL_2_TRIVIAL = `(!a:real^2. measure(convex hull {a}) = &0) /\
   (!a b:real^2. measure(convex hull {a,b}) = &0)`;;

let NEGLIGIBLE_SEGMENT_2 = `!a b:real^2. negligible(segment[a,b])`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Decomposing an additive function on a triangle.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let TRIANGLE_DECOMPOSITION = `!a b c d:real^2.
        d IN convex hull {a,b,c}
        ==> (convex hull {a,b,c} =
             convex hull {d,b,c} UNION
             convex hull {d,a,c} UNION
             convex hull {d,a,b})`;;

let TRIANGLE_ADDITIVE_DECOMPOSITION = `!f:(real^2->bool)->real a b c d.
        (!s t. compact s /\ compact t
               ==> f(s UNION t) = f(s) + f(t) - f(s INTER t)) /\
        ~(a = b) /\ ~(a = c) /\ ~(b = c) /\
        ~affine_dependent {a,b,c} /\ d IN convex hull {a,b,c}
        ==> f(convex hull {a,b,c}) =
            (f(convex hull {a,b,d}) +
             f(convex hull {a,c,d}) +
             f(convex hull {b,c,d})) -
            (f(convex hull {a,d}) +
             f(convex hull {b,d}) +
             f(convex hull {c,d})) +
            f(convex hull {d})`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Vectors all of whose coordinates are integers.                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let integral_vector = define
 `integral_vector(x:real^N) <=>
        !i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) ==> integer(x$i)`;;

let INTEGRAL_VECTOR_VEC = `!n. integral_vector(vec n)`;;

let INTEGRAL_VECTOR_STDBASIS = `!i. integral_vector(basis i:real^N)`;;

let INTEGRAL_VECTOR_ADD = `!x y:real^N.
        integral_vector x /\ integral_vector y ==> integral_vector(x + y)`;;

let INTEGRAL_VECTOR_SUB = `!x y:real^N.
        integral_vector x /\ integral_vector y ==> integral_vector(x - y)`;;

let INTEGRAL_VECTOR_ADD_LCANCEL = `!x y:real^N.
        integral_vector x ==> (integral_vector(x + y) <=> integral_vector y)`;;

let FINITE_BOUNDED_INTEGER_POINTS = `!s:real^N->bool. bounded s ==> FINITE {x | x IN s /\ integral_vector x}`;;

let FINITE_TRIANGLE_INTEGER_POINTS = `!a b c:real^N. FINITE {x | x IN convex hull {a,b,c} /\ integral_vector x}`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Properties of a basis for the integer lattice.                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let LINEAR_INTEGRAL_VECTOR = `!f:real^N->real^N.
        linear f
        ==> ((!x. integral_vector x ==> integral_vector(f x)) <=>
             (!i j. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex(:N) /\
                    1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex(:N)
                    ==> integer(matrix f$i$j)))`;;

let INTEGRAL_BASIS_UNIMODULAR = `!f:real^N->real^N.
        linear f /\ IMAGE f integral_vector = integral_vector
        ==> abs(det(matrix f)) = &1`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Pick's theorem for an elementary triangle.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PICK_ELEMENTARY_TRIANGLE_0 = `!a b:real^2.
        {x | x IN convex hull {vec 0,a,b} /\ integral_vector x} = {vec 0,a,b}
        ==> measure(convex hull {vec 0,a,b}) =
               if collinear {vec 0,a,b} then &0 else &1 / &2`;;

let PICK_ELEMENTARY_TRIANGLE = `!a b c:real^2.
        {x | x IN convex hull {a,b,c} /\ integral_vector x} = {a,b,c}
        ==> measure(convex hull {a,b,c}) =
               if collinear {a,b,c} then &0 else &1 / &2`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Our form of Pick's theorem holds degenerately for a flat triangle.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PICK_TRIANGLE_FLAT = `!a b c:real^2.
        integral_vector a /\ integral_vector b /\ integral_vector c /\
        c IN segment[a,b]
        ==> measure(convex hull {a,b,c}) =
             &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,b,c} /\ integral_vector x}) -
             (&(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {b,c} /\ integral_vector x}) +
              &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,c} /\ integral_vector x}) +
              &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,b} /\ integral_vector x})) / &2 +
             &1 / &2`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Pick's theorem for a triangle.                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PICK_TRIANGLE_ALT = `!a b c:real^2.
        integral_vector a /\ integral_vector b /\ integral_vector c
        ==> measure(convex hull {a,b,c}) =
             &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,b,c} /\ integral_vector x}) -
             (&(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {b,c} /\ integral_vector x}) +
              &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,c} /\ integral_vector x}) +
              &(CARD {x | x IN convex hull {a,b} /\ integral_vector x})) / &2 +
             &1 / &2`;;

let PICK_TRIANGLE = `!a b c:real^2.
        integral_vector a /\ integral_vector b /\ integral_vector c
        ==> measure(convex hull {a,b,c}) =
                if collinear {a,b,c} then &0
                else &(CARD {x | x IN interior(convex hull {a,b,c}) /\
                                 integral_vector x}) +
                     &(CARD {x | x IN frontier(convex hull {a,b,c}) /\
                                 integral_vector x}) / &2 - &1`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Parity lemma for segment crossing a polygon.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PARITY_LEMMA = `!a b c d p x:real^2.
        simple_path(p ++ linepath(a,b)) /\
        pathstart p = b /\ pathfinish p = a /\
        segment(a,b) INTER segment(c,d) = {x} /\
        segment[c,d] INTER path_image p = {}
        ==> (c IN inside(path_image(p ++ linepath(a,b))) <=>
             d IN outside(path_image(p ++ linepath(a,b))))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Polygonal path; 0 in the empty case is just for linear invariance.        *)
(* Note that we *are* forced to assume non-emptiness for translation.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let polygonal_path = define
 `polygonal_path[] = linepath(vec 0,vec 0) /\
  polygonal_path[a] = linepath(a,a) /\
  polygonal_path [a;b] = linepath(a,b) /\
  polygonal_path (CONS a (CONS b (CONS c l))) =
       linepath(a,b) ++ polygonal_path(CONS b (CONS c l))`;;

let POLYGONAL_PATH_CONS_CONS = `!a b p. ~(p = [])
           ==> polygonal_path(CONS a (CONS b p)) =
               linepath(a,b) ++ polygonal_path(CONS b p)`;;

let POLYGONAL_PATH_TRANSLATION = `!a b p. polygonal_path (MAP (\x. a + x) (CONS b p)) =
         (\x. a + x) o (polygonal_path (CONS b p))`;;

add_translation_invariants [POLYGONAL_PATH_TRANSLATION];;

let POLYGONAL_PATH_LINEAR_IMAGE = `!f p. linear f ==> polygonal_path (MAP f p) = f o polygonal_path p`;;

add_linear_invariants [POLYGONAL_PATH_LINEAR_IMAGE];;

let PATHSTART_POLYGONAL_PATH = `!p. pathstart(polygonal_path p) = if p = [] then vec 0 else HD p`;;

let PATHFINISH_POLYGONAL_PATH = `!p. pathfinish(polygonal_path p) = if p = [] then vec 0 else LAST p`;;

let VERTICES_IN_PATH_IMAGE_POLYGONAL_PATH = `!p:(real^N)list. set_of_list p SUBSET path_image (polygonal_path p)`;;

let ARC_POLYGONAL_PATH_IMP_DISTINCT = `!p:(real^N)list. arc(polygonal_path p) ==> PAIRWISE (\x y. ~(x = y)) p`;;

let PATH_POLYGONAL_PATH = `!p:(real^N)list. path(polygonal_path p)`;;

let PATH_IMAGE_POLYGONAL_PATH_SUBSET_CONVEX_HULL = `!p. ~(p = [])
       ==> path_image(polygonal_path p) SUBSET convex hull (set_of_list p)`;;

let PATH_IMAGE_POLYGONAL_PATH_SUBSET_SEGMENTS = `!p x:real^N.
        arc(polygonal_path p) /\ 3 <= LENGTH p /\
        x IN path_image(polygonal_path p)
        ==> ?a b. MEM a p /\ MEM b p /\ x IN segment[a,b] /\
                  segment[a,b] SUBSET path_image(polygonal_path p) /\
                  ~(pathstart(polygonal_path p) IN segment[a,b] /\
                    pathfinish(polygonal_path p) IN segment[a,b])`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Rotating the starting point to move a preferred vertex forward.           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let SET_OF_LIST_POLYGONAL_PATH_ROTATE = `!p. ~(p = []) ==> set_of_list(CONS (LAST p) (BUTLAST p)) = set_of_list p`;;

let PROPERTIES_POLYGONAL_PATH_SNOC = `!p d:real^N.
        2 <= LENGTH p
        ==> path_image(polygonal_path(APPEND p [d])) =
            path_image(polygonal_path p ++ linepath(LAST p,d)) /\
            (arc(polygonal_path(APPEND p [d])) <=>
             arc(polygonal_path p ++ linepath(LAST p,d))) /\
            (simple_path(polygonal_path(APPEND p [d])) <=>
             simple_path(polygonal_path p ++ linepath(LAST p,d)))`;;

let PATH_IMAGE_POLYGONAL_PATH_ROTATE = `!p:(real^N)list.
        2 <= LENGTH p /\ LAST p = HD p
        ==> path_image(polygonal_path(APPEND (TL p) [HD(TL p)])) =
            path_image(polygonal_path p)`;;

let SIMPLE_PATH_POLYGONAL_PATH_ROTATE = `!p:(real^N)list.
        2 <= LENGTH p /\ LAST p = HD p
        ==> (simple_path(polygonal_path(APPEND (TL p) [HD(TL p)])) =
             simple_path(polygonal_path p))`;;

let ROTATE_LIST_TO_FRONT_1 = `!P l a:A.
      (!l. P(l) ==> 3 <= LENGTH l /\ LAST l = HD l) /\
      (!l. P(l) ==> P(APPEND (TL l) [HD(TL l)])) /\
      P l /\ MEM a l
      ==> ?l'. EL 1 l' = a /\ P l'`;;

let ROTATE_LIST_TO_FRONT_0 = `!P l a:A.
      (!l. P(l) ==> 3 <= LENGTH l /\ LAST l = HD l) /\
      (!l. P(l) ==> P(APPEND (TL l) [HD(TL l)])) /\
      P l /\ MEM a l
      ==> ?l'. HD l' = a /\ P l'`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* We can pick a transformation to make all y coordinates distinct.          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let DISTINGUISHING_ROTATION_EXISTS_PAIR = `!x y. ~(x = y)
         ==> FINITE {t | &0 <= t /\ t < &2 * pi /\
                         (rotate2d t x)$2 = (rotate2d t y)$2}`;;

let DISTINGUISHING_ROTATION_EXISTS = `!s. FINITE s ==> ?t. pairwise (\x y. ~(x$2 = y$2)) (IMAGE (rotate2d t) s)`;;

let DISTINGUISHING_ROTATION_EXISTS_POLYGON = `!p:(real^2)list.
        ?f q. (?g. orthogonal_transformation g /\ f = MAP g) /\
              (!x y. MEM x q /\ MEM y q /\ ~(x = y) ==> ~(x$2 = y$2)) /\
              f q = p`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Proof that we can chop a polygon's inside in two.                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let POLYGON_CHOP_IN_TWO = `!p:(real^2)list.
        simple_path(polygonal_path p) /\
        pathfinish(polygonal_path p) = pathstart(polygonal_path p) /\
        5 <= LENGTH p
        ==> ?a b. ~(a = b) /\ MEM a p /\ MEM b p /\
                  segment(a,b) SUBSET inside(path_image(polygonal_path p))`;;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Hence the final Pick theorem by induction on number of polygon segments.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

let PICK = `!p:(real^2)list.
        (!x. MEM x p ==> integral_vector x) /\
        simple_path (polygonal_path p) /\
        pathfinish (polygonal_path p) = pathstart (polygonal_path p)
        ==> measure(inside(path_image(polygonal_path p))) =
                &(CARD {x | x IN inside(path_image(polygonal_path p)) /\
                            integral_vector x}) +
                &(CARD {x | x IN path_image(polygonal_path p) /\
                            integral_vector x}) / &2 - &1`;;

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of the hundred-theorems corpus artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__092, "Pick's Theorem": the area of a simple closed
;; polygonal path with integer-coordinate vertices equals its number of
;; interior lattice points plus half its number of boundary lattice points
;; minus one. This file contains no proof.

(defun ht092-lattice-point-p (point)
  (and (true-listp point)
       (equal (len point) 2)
       (integerp (car point))
       (integerp (cadr point))))

(defun ht092-all-lattice-points-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (ht092-lattice-point-p (car points))
           (ht092-all-lattice-points-p (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun ht092-point-member-p (point points)
  (if (consp points)
      (or (equal point (car points))
          (ht092-point-member-p point (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun ht092-distinct-points-p (points)
  (if (consp points)
      (and (not (ht092-point-member-p (car points) (cdr points)))
           (ht092-distinct-points-p (cdr points)))
    t))

(defun ht092-butlast-points (points)
  (if (or (not (consp points))
          (not (consp (cdr points))))
      nil
    (cons (car points)
          (ht092-butlast-points (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-last-point (points)
  (if (not (consp points))
      nil
    (if (not (consp (cdr points)))
        (car points)
      (ht092-last-point (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-x (point)
  (car point))

(defun ht092-y (point)
  (cadr point))

(defun ht092-min2 (x y)
  (if (< x y) x y))

(defun ht092-max2 (x y)
  (if (< x y) y x))

(defun ht092-orientation (a b c)
  (- (* (- (ht092-x b) (ht092-x a))
        (- (ht092-y c) (ht092-y a)))
     (* (- (ht092-y b) (ht092-y a))
        (- (ht092-x c) (ht092-x a)))))

(defun ht092-dot-from (origin a b)
  (+ (* (- (ht092-x a) (ht092-x origin))
        (- (ht092-x b) (ht092-x origin)))
     (* (- (ht092-y a) (ht092-y origin))
        (- (ht092-y b) (ht092-y origin)))))

(defun ht092-point-on-segment-p (point a b)
  (and (equal (ht092-orientation a b point) 0)
       (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-x a) (ht092-x b))
           (ht092-x point))
       (<= (ht092-x point)
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-x a) (ht092-x b)))
       (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-y a) (ht092-y b))
           (ht092-y point))
       (<= (ht092-y point)
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-y a) (ht092-y b)))))

(defun ht092-segments-intersect-p (a b c d)
  (and (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-x a) (ht092-x b))
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-x c) (ht092-x d)))
       (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-x c) (ht092-x d))
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-x a) (ht092-x b)))
       (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-y a) (ht092-y b))
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-y c) (ht092-y d)))
       (<= (ht092-min2 (ht092-y c) (ht092-y d))
           (ht092-max2 (ht092-y a) (ht092-y b)))
       (<= (* (ht092-orientation a b c)
              (ht092-orientation a b d))
           0)
       (<= (* (ht092-orientation c d a)
              (ht092-orientation c d b))
           0)))

(defun ht092-common-endpoint-count (a b c d)
  (+ (if (equal a c) 1 0)
     (if (equal a d) 1 0)
     (if (equal b c) 1 0)
     (if (equal b d) 1 0)))

(defun ht092-shared-endpoint-is-only-meeting-p (shared a b)
  (or (not (equal (ht092-orientation shared a b) 0))
      (< (ht092-dot-from shared a b) 0)))

(defun ht092-edge-pair-simple-p (edge1 edge2)
  (let* ((a (car edge1))
         (b (cadr edge1))
         (c (car edge2))
         (d (cadr edge2))
         (common (ht092-common-endpoint-count a b c d)))
    (cond ((equal common 0)
           (not (ht092-segments-intersect-p a b c d)))
          ((not (equal common 1))
           nil)
          ((equal a c)
           (ht092-shared-endpoint-is-only-meeting-p a b d))
          ((equal a d)
           (ht092-shared-endpoint-is-only-meeting-p a b c))
          ((equal b c)
           (ht092-shared-endpoint-is-only-meeting-p b a d))
          (t
           (ht092-shared-endpoint-is-only-meeting-p b a c)))))

(defun ht092-edges (vertices)
  (if (and (consp vertices)
           (consp (cdr vertices)))
      (cons (list (car vertices) (cadr vertices))
            (ht092-edges (cdr vertices)))
    nil))

(defun ht092-edge-compatible-with-all-p (edge edges)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and (ht092-edge-pair-simple-p edge (car edges))
           (ht092-edge-compatible-with-all-p edge (cdr edges)))
    t))

(defun ht092-all-edge-pairs-simple-p (edges)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and (ht092-edge-compatible-with-all-p (car edges) (cdr edges))
           (ht092-all-edge-pairs-simple-p (cdr edges)))
    t))

(defun ht092-simple-closed-lattice-polygon-p (vertices)
  (and (true-listp vertices)
       (<= 4 (len vertices))
       (ht092-all-lattice-points-p vertices)
       (equal (car vertices) (ht092-last-point vertices))
       (ht092-distinct-points-p (ht092-butlast-points vertices))
       (ht092-all-edge-pairs-simple-p (ht092-edges vertices))))

(defun ht092-point-on-any-edge-p (point edges)
  (if (consp edges)
      (or (ht092-point-on-segment-p point
                                    (car (car edges))
                                    (cadr (car edges)))
          (ht092-point-on-any-edge-p point (cdr edges)))
    nil))

(defun ht092-edge-crosses-right-ray-p (point edge)
  (let* ((a (car edge))
         (b (cadr edge))
         (py (ht092-y point))
         (ay (ht092-y a))
         (by (ht092-y b))
         (side (ht092-orientation a b point)))
    (or (and (<= ay py)
             (< py by)
             (< 0 side))
        (and (<= by py)
             (< py ay)
             (< side 0)))))

(defun ht092-odd-ray-crossing-p (point edges)
  (if (consp edges)
      (let ((rest-is-odd
             (ht092-odd-ray-crossing-p point (cdr edges))))
        (if (ht092-edge-crosses-right-ray-p point (car edges))
            (not rest-is-odd)
          rest-is-odd))
    nil))

(defun ht092-interior-point-p (point edges)
  (and (not (ht092-point-on-any-edge-p point edges))
       (ht092-odd-ray-crossing-p point edges)))

(defun ht092-shoelace-sum (vertices)
  (if (and (consp vertices)
           (consp (cdr vertices)))
      (+ (- (* (ht092-x (car vertices))
               (ht092-y (cadr vertices)))
            (* (ht092-y (car vertices))
               (ht092-x (cadr vertices))))
         (ht092-shoelace-sum (cdr vertices)))
    0))

(defun ht092-abs (x)
  (if (< x 0) (- x) x))

(defun ht092-polygon-area (vertices)
  (/ (ht092-abs (ht092-shoelace-sum vertices)) 2))

(defun ht092-min-x (points)
  (if (not (consp (cdr points)))
      (ht092-x (car points))
    (ht092-min2 (ht092-x (car points))
                (ht092-min-x (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-max-x (points)
  (if (not (consp (cdr points)))
      (ht092-x (car points))
    (ht092-max2 (ht092-x (car points))
                (ht092-max-x (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-min-y (points)
  (if (not (consp (cdr points)))
      (ht092-y (car points))
    (ht092-min2 (ht092-y (car points))
                (ht092-min-y (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-max-y (points)
  (if (not (consp (cdr points)))
      (ht092-y (car points))
    (ht092-max2 (ht092-y (car points))
                (ht092-max-y (cdr points)))))

(defun ht092-count-row (x y remaining-y edges boundaryp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-y)))
  (if (zp remaining-y)
      0
    (+ (if (if boundaryp
               (ht092-point-on-any-edge-p (list x y) edges)
             (ht092-interior-point-p (list x y) edges))
           1
         0)
       (ht092-count-row x
                        (+ y 1)
                        (- remaining-y 1)
                        edges
                        boundaryp))))

(defun ht092-count-grid (x remaining-x min-y height edges boundaryp)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-x)))
  (if (zp remaining-x)
      0
    (+ (ht092-count-row x min-y height edges boundaryp)
       (ht092-count-grid (+ x 1)
                         (- remaining-x 1)
                         min-y
                         height
                         edges
                         boundaryp))))

(defun ht092-lattice-count (vertices boundaryp)
  (let* ((min-x (ht092-min-x vertices))
         (max-x (ht092-max-x vertices))
         (min-y (ht092-min-y vertices))
         (max-y (ht092-max-y vertices))
         (width (+ 1 (- max-x min-x)))
         (height (+ 1 (- max-y min-y)))
         (edges (ht092-edges vertices)))
    (ht092-count-grid min-x width min-y height edges boundaryp)))

(defun ht092-interior-lattice-count (vertices)
  (ht092-lattice-count vertices nil))

(defun ht092-boundary-lattice-count (vertices)
  (ht092-lattice-count vertices t))

(defun hundred-theorems-acl2-092-pick-s-theorem (vertices)
  (implies
   (ht092-simple-closed-lattice-polygon-p vertices)
   (equal
    (ht092-polygon-area vertices)
    (- (+ (ht092-interior-lattice-count vertices)
          (/ (ht092-boundary-lattice-count vertices) 2))
       1))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)

:q

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact
-- hundred-theorems__agda__092, "Pick's Theorem": the area of a simple closed
-- lattice polygon is its number of interior lattice points plus half its
-- number of boundary lattice points minus one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data All {A : Set} (P : A -> Set) : List A -> Set where
  all[] : All P []
  all∷  : {x : A} {xs : List A} -> P x -> All P xs -> All P (x ∷ xs)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

fromInt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromInt reals (pos n) =
  fromNat reals n
fromInt reals (negsuc n) =
  negate reals (fromNat reals (suc n))

record Point (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor point
  field
    x-coordinate : R
    y-coordinate : R

open Point

Region : Set -> Set1
Region R = Point R -> Set

Curve : Set -> Set
Curve R = R -> Point R

UnitInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
UnitInterval reals t =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t)
    (lessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals))

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x

addPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
addPoint reals p q =
  point
    (add reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q))
    (add reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q))

scalePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R
scalePoint reals scalar p =
  point
    (multiply reals scalar (x-coordinate p))
    (multiply reals scalar (y-coordinate p))

affinePoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R ->
  Point R
affinePoint reals p q t =
  addPoint reals
    (scalePoint reals (subtract reals (oneR reals) t) p)
    (scalePoint reals t q)

Segment :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
Segment {R} reals p q x =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      Both
        (UnitInterval reals t)
        (affinePoint reals p q t == x))

BoundaryFrom :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  List (Point R) ->
  Region R
BoundaryFrom reals firstPoint previous [] x =
  Segment reals previous firstPoint x
BoundaryFrom reals firstPoint previous (next ∷ rest) x =
  Either
    (Segment reals previous next x)
    (BoundaryFrom reals firstPoint next rest x)

polygonBoundary :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  List (Point R) ->
  Region R
polygonBoundary reals [] _ =
  Bottom
polygonBoundary reals (firstPoint ∷ rest) =
  BoundaryFrom reals firstPoint firstPoint rest

IntegerCoordinate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
IntegerCoordinate reals x =
  Exists Int (\ z -> x == fromInt reals z)

IntegerPoint :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
IntegerPoint reals p =
  Both
    (IntegerCoordinate reals (x-coordinate p))
    (IntegerCoordinate reals (y-coordinate p))

squaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  R
squaredDistance reals p q =
  add reals
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (x-coordinate p) (x-coordinate q)))
    (square reals
      (subtract reals (y-coordinate p) (y-coordinate q)))

parameterSquaredDistance :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
parameterSquaredDistance reals s t =
  square reals (subtract reals s t)

PointNear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PointNear reals epsilon p q =
  StrictLess reals
    (squaredDistance reals p q)
    (square reals epsilon)

ParameterNear :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ParameterNear reals epsilon s t =
  StrictLess reals
    (parameterSquaredDistance reals s t)
    (square reals epsilon)

ContinuousCurve :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Curve R ->
  Set
ContinuousCurve {R} reals g =
  (t : R) ->
  UnitInterval reals t ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((s : R) ->
          UnitInterval reals s ->
          ParameterNear reals delta s t ->
          PointNear reals epsilon (g s) (g t)))

Endpoints :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Endpoints reals s t =
  Either
    (Both (s == zeroR reals) (t == oneR reals))
    (Both (s == oneR reals) (t == zeroR reals))

SimplePath :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Curve R ->
  Set
SimplePath {R} reals g =
  Both
    (ContinuousCurve reals g)
    ((s t : R) ->
      UnitInterval reals s ->
      UnitInterval reals t ->
      g s == g t ->
      Either (s == t) (Endpoints reals s t))

pathImage :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Curve R ->
  Region R
pathImage {R} reals g p =
  Exists R
    (\ t ->
      Both
        (UnitInterval reals t)
        (g t == p))

RegionEquivalent :
  {R : Set} ->
  Region R ->
  Region R ->
  Set
RegionEquivalent {R} leftRegion rightRegion =
  (p : Point R) ->
  Iff (leftRegion p) (rightRegion p)

SimpleClosedPolygon :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  List (Point R) ->
  Set
SimpleClosedPolygon reals vertices =
  Exists (Curve _)
    (\ g ->
      Both
        (SimplePath reals g)
        (Both
          (g (zeroR reals) == g (oneR reals))
          (RegionEquivalent
            (pathImage reals g)
            (polygonBoundary reals vertices))))

origin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Point R
origin reals =
  point (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

PathConnectedOutside :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R ->
  Point R ->
  Point R ->
  Set
PathConnectedOutside {R} reals region p q =
  Exists (Curve R)
    (\ h ->
      Both
        (ContinuousCurve reals h)
        (Both
          (Both
            (h (zeroR reals) == p)
            (h (oneR reals) == q))
          ((t : R) ->
            UnitInterval reals t ->
            Not (region (h t)))))

Inside :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R ->
  Region R
Inside {R} reals region p =
  Both
    (Not (region p))
    (Exists R
      (\ bound ->
        Both
          (Nonnegative reals bound)
          ((q : Point R) ->
            PathConnectedOutside reals region p q ->
            lessOrEqual reals
              (squaredDistance reals q (origin reals))
              (square reals bound))))

data HasCardinality
  {R : Set}
  (P : Point R -> Set)
  (cardinality : Nat) : Set where
  cardinality-witness :
    (enumerate : Fin cardinality -> Point R) ->
    ((i : Fin cardinality) -> P (enumerate i)) ->
    ((p : Point R) ->
      P p ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality) (\ i -> p == enumerate i)) ->
    ((i j : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j) ->
    HasCardinality P cardinality

data Rectangle {R : Set} : Set where
  rectangle : R -> R -> R -> R -> Rectangle

lower-x :
  {R : Set} ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  R
lower-x (rectangle lx ux ly uy) = lx

upper-x :
  {R : Set} ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  R
upper-x (rectangle lx ux ly uy) = ux

lower-y :
  {R : Set} ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  R
lower-y (rectangle lx ux ly uy) = ly

upper-y :
  {R : Set} ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  R
upper-y (rectangle lx ux ly uy) = uy

ValidRectangle :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  Set
ValidRectangle reals box =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual reals (lower-x box) (upper-x box))
    (lessOrEqual reals (lower-y box) (upper-y box))

RectangleContains :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  Point R ->
  Set
RectangleContains reals box p =
  Both
    (Both
      (StrictLess reals (lower-x box) (x-coordinate p))
      (StrictLess reals (x-coordinate p) (upper-x box)))
    (Both
      (StrictLess reals (lower-y box) (y-coordinate p))
      (StrictLess reals (y-coordinate p) (upper-y box)))

rectangleArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Rectangle {R} ->
  R
rectangleArea reals box =
  multiply reals
    (subtract reals (upper-x box) (lower-x box))
    (subtract reals (upper-y box) (lower-y box))

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals
          (subtract reals limit epsilon)
          (sequence n))
        (StrictLess reals
          (sequence n)
          (add reals limit epsilon)))

RectangleCover :
  {R : Set} ->
  Set
RectangleCover {R} =
  Nat -> Rectangle {R}

ValidCover :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  RectangleCover {R} ->
  Set
ValidCover reals cover =
  (n : Nat) -> ValidRectangle reals (cover n)

Covers :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  RectangleCover {R} ->
  Region R ->
  Set
Covers {R} reals cover region =
  (p : Point R) ->
  region p ->
  Exists Nat (\ n -> RectangleContains reals (cover n) p)

coverPartialArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  RectangleCover {R} ->
  Nat ->
  R
coverPartialArea reals cover zero =
  rectangleArea reals (cover zero)
coverPartialArea reals cover (suc n) =
  add reals
    (coverPartialArea reals cover n)
    (rectangleArea reals (cover (suc n)))

CoverTotal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  RectangleCover {R} ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverTotal reals cover total =
  SequentialLimit reals (coverPartialArea reals cover) total

CoverCost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
CoverCost {R} reals region total =
  Exists (RectangleCover {R})
    (\ cover ->
      Both
        (ValidCover reals cover)
        (Both
          (Covers reals cover region)
          (CoverTotal reals cover total)))

LowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
LowerBound {R} reals values bound =
  (value : R) ->
  values value ->
  lessOrEqual reals bound value

GreatestLowerBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
GreatestLowerBound {R} reals values infimum =
  Both
    (LowerBound reals values infimum)
    ((bound : R) ->
      LowerBound reals values bound ->
      lessOrEqual reals bound infimum)

PlanarLebesgueArea :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Region R ->
  R ->
  Set
PlanarLebesgueArea reals region area =
  GreatestLowerBound reals (CoverCost reals region) area

module PickStatement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) where

  boundaryLatticePoints :
    List (Point R) ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  boundaryLatticePoints vertices p =
    Both
      (polygonBoundary reals vertices p)
      (IntegerPoint reals p)

  interiorLatticePoints :
    List (Point R) ->
    Point R ->
    Set
  interiorLatticePoints vertices p =
    Both
      (Inside reals (polygonBoundary reals vertices) p)
      (IntegerPoint reals p)

  pickFormula :
    Nat ->
    Nat ->
    R
  pickFormula interiorCount boundaryCount =
    subtract reals
      (add reals
        (fromNat reals interiorCount)
        (divide reals
          (fromNat reals boundaryCount)
          (fromNat reals (suc (suc zero)))))
      (oneR reals)

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (vertices : List (Point R)) ->
    All (IntegerPoint reals) vertices ->
    SimpleClosedPolygon reals vertices ->
    (interiorCount boundaryCount : Nat) ->
    HasCardinality
      (interiorLatticePoints vertices)
      interiorCount ->
    HasCardinality
      (boundaryLatticePoints vertices)
      boundaryCount ->
    Exists R
      (\ area ->
        Both
          (PlanarLebesgueArea reals
            (Inside reals (polygonBoundary reals vertices))
            area)
          (area == pickFormula interiorCount boundaryCount))

pick-s-theorem : Set1
pick-s-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  PickStatement.proposition reals

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact
  hundred-theorems__hol4__092, cataloged as "Pick's Theorem": the area
  enclosed by a simple closed lattice polygon equals its number of interior
  lattice points plus half its boundary lattice points minus one. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory intrealTheory listTheory pairTheory;
open pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory lebesgue_measureTheory martingaleTheory;

val pick_s_theorem =
  ``!(g : real -> real # real) (vertices : (real # real) list).
      let sqdist =
        \x y : real # real.
          (FST y - FST x) pow 2 + (SND y - SND x) pow 2
      in
      let on_unit_interval =
        \t. 0 <= t /\ t <= 1
      in
      let edge_parameter =
        \i t. &(PRE (LENGTH vertices)) * t - &i
      in
      let polygonal_from_vertices =
        \h.
          2 <= LENGTH vertices /\
          !i t.
            SUC i < LENGTH vertices /\
            &i / &(PRE (LENGTH vertices)) <= t /\
            t <= &(SUC i) / &(PRE (LENGTH vertices))
            ==>
            FST (h t) =
              (1 - edge_parameter i t) * FST (EL i vertices) +
              edge_parameter i t * FST (EL (SUC i) vertices) /\
            SND (h t) =
              (1 - edge_parameter i t) * SND (EL i vertices) +
              edge_parameter i t * SND (EL (SUC i) vertices)
      in
      let continuous_plane_path =
        \h.
          !t. on_unit_interval t ==>
              !e. 0 < e ==>
                  ?d. 0 < d /\
                      !s. on_unit_interval s /\ abs (s - t) < d ==>
                          sqdist (h s) (h t) < e
      in
      let simple_path =
        \h.
          continuous_plane_path h /\
          !s t.
            on_unit_interval s /\
            on_unit_interval t /\
            h s = h t
            ==>
            s = t \/ (s = 0 /\ t = 1) \/ (s = 1 /\ t = 0)
      in
      let path_image =
        \z. ?t. on_unit_interval t /\ g t = z
      in
      let same_component =
        \x y.
          ?h.
            continuous_plane_path h /\
            h 0 = x /\
            h 1 = y /\
            !t. on_unit_interval t ==> ~path_image (h t)
      in
      let unbounded_component =
        \z.
          ~path_image z /\
          !R. ?w.
            same_component z w /\
            R < sqrt (sqdist (0, 0) w)
      in
      let inside =
        \z. ~path_image z /\ ~unbounded_component z
      in
      let integral_point =
        \z : real # real.
          (?m : int. FST z = real_of_int m) /\
          (?n : int. SND z = real_of_int n)
      in
        (!z. MEM z vertices ==> integral_point z) /\
        polygonal_from_vertices g /\
        simple_path g /\
        g 1 = g 0
        ==>
        measure (prod_measure_space lebesgue lebesgue) inside =
          Normal
            (&(CARD {z : real # real | inside z /\ integral_point z}) +
             &(CARD {z : real # real | path_image z /\ integral_point z}) /
               2 -
             1)``;

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of "Pick's Theorem" from the Hundred
  Theorems corpus artifact 092 (hundred-theorems__metamath__092): the area
  enclosed by a simple closed lattice polygon equals its number of interior
  lattice points plus half its number of boundary lattice points minus one.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  The Euclidean plane is identified isometrically with CC. A polygon is
  represented by a vertex function V on 0 ... N, with V(0) = V(N). Its
  boundary is the union of the closed segments between successive vertices.

  HT092Simple requires at least three edges, distinct non-closing vertices,
  and exactly the intersections permitted between equal or adjacent edges.
  This is equivalent to the simple closed polygonal-path hypotheses in the
  HOL Light and Isabelle sources. HT092Inside is the bounded connected
  component of the boundary complement. HT092Area is planar Lebesgue area,
  expressed as an iterated integral of an indicator. HT092Integral says that
  both coordinates are integers.

  The final declaration is the unproved statement itself.
$)

$c HT092Segment HT092Image HT092Simple HT092Inside $.
$c HT092Integral HT092InteriorLattice HT092BoundaryLattice $.
$c HT092Indicator HT092Row HT092Area $.

ht092-segment-syntax $a class ( HT092Segment A B ) $.
ht092-image-syntax $a class ( HT092Image V N ) $.
ht092-simple-syntax $a wff ( HT092Simple V N ) $.
ht092-inside-syntax $a class ( HT092Inside V N ) $.
ht092-integral-syntax $a wff ( HT092Integral Z ) $.
ht092-interior-lattice-syntax $a class ( HT092InteriorLattice V N ) $.
ht092-boundary-lattice-syntax $a class ( HT092BoundaryLattice V N ) $.
ht092-indicator-syntax $a class ( HT092Indicator S X Y ) $.
ht092-row-syntax $a class ( HT092Row S X ) $.
ht092-area-syntax $a class ( HT092Area S ) $.

${
  $d t z A B $.

  ht092-segment-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Segment A B )
    =
    { z e. CC |
      E. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        z = ( ( ( 1 - t ) x. A ) + ( t x. B ) )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k n v $.

  ht092-image-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Image V N )
    =
    U_ k e. ( 0 ..^ N )
      ( HT092Segment ( V ` k ) ( V ` ( k + 1 ) ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d i j z V N $.

  ht092-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Simple V N )
    <->
    (
      (
        3 <_ N
        /\
        V : ( 0 ... N ) --> CC
      )
      /\
      (
        ( V ` 0 ) = ( V ` N )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N ) A. j e. ( 0 ..^ N )
            ( ( V ` i ) = ( V ` j ) -> i = j )
          /\
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N ) A. j e. ( 0 ..^ N ) A. z e. CC
            (
              (
                z e. ( HT092Segment ( V ` i ) ( V ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                /\
                z e. ( HT092Segment ( V ` j ) ( V ` ( j + 1 ) ) )
              )
              <->
              (
                (
                  i = j
                  /\
                  z e. ( HT092Segment ( V ` i ) ( V ` ( i + 1 ) ) )
                )
                \/
                (
                  (
                    j = ( i + 1 )
                    /\
                    z = ( V ` j )
                  )
                  \/
                  (
                    (
                      i = ( j + 1 )
                      /\
                      z = ( V ` i )
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      (
                        ( i = 0 /\ j = ( N - 1 ) )
                        /\
                        z = ( V ` 0 )
                      )
                      \/
                      (
                        ( j = 0 /\ i = ( N - 1 ) )
                        /\
                        z = ( V ` 0 )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d c r w z V N $.

  ht092-inside-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Inside V N )
    =
    { z e. ( CC \ ( HT092Image V N ) ) |
      E. r e. RR+
        A. w e.
          U. { c e. ~P ( CC \ ( HT092Image V N ) ) |
            (
              z e. c
              /\
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
                    |`t ( CC \ ( HT092Image V N ) )
                  )
                  |`t c
                )
                e. Conn
              )
            )
          }
          ( ( abs ` w ) < r )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  ht092-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Integral Z )
    <->
    (
      ( Re ` Z ) e. ZZ
      /\
      ( Im ` Z ) e. ZZ
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d z V N $.

  ht092-interior-lattice-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092InteriorLattice V N )
    =
    { z e. ( HT092Inside V N ) | ( HT092Integral z ) }
  ) $.

  ht092-boundary-lattice-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092BoundaryLattice V N )
    =
    { z e. ( HT092Image V N ) | ( HT092Integral z ) }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S X Y $.

  ht092-indicator-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Indicator S X Y )
    =
    if
      (
        ( X + ( _i x. Y ) ) e. S ,
        1 ,
        0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d y S X $.

  ht092-row-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Row S X )
    =
    S. RR ( HT092Indicator S X y ) _d y
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d x S $.

  ht092-area-definition $a |- (
    ( HT092Area S )
    =
    S. RR ( HT092Row S x ) _d x
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k V N $.

  hundred-theorems-092-pick $a |- (
    A. n e. NN A. v
      (
        (
          ( HT092Simple v n )
          /\
          A. k e. ( 0 ... n )
            ( HT092Integral ( v ` k ) )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( HT092Area ( HT092Inside v n ) )
          =
          (
            ( # ` ( HT092InteriorLattice v n ) )
            +
            (
              ( # ` ( HT092BoundaryLattice v n ) )
              /
              2
            )
          )
          -
          1
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: 092_pick_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 092, "Pick's Theorem":
% the area enclosed by a simple lattice polygon is its number of interior lattice
% points plus half its number of boundary lattice points minus one. This file contains no proof.

pick_s_theorem_092: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# x_coord: real, y_coord: real #]
  vertices: TYPE = [nat -> point]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point], finite_sets[nat]

  lattice_point(p: point): bool =
    EXISTS (m, k: int):
      x_coord(p) = (m :: real)
        AND y_coord(p) = (k :: real)

  cross(a, b, p: point): real =
    (x_coord(b) - x_coord(a)) * (y_coord(p) - y_coord(a))
      - (y_coord(b) - y_coord(a)) * (x_coord(p) - x_coord(a))

  affine_point(t: real, a, b: point): point =
    (# x_coord := (1 - t) * x_coord(a) + t * x_coord(b),
       y_coord := (1 - t) * y_coord(a) + t * y_coord(b) #)

  next_index(i, n: nat): nat =
    IF i + 1 = n THEN 0 ELSE i + 1 ENDIF

  on_edge(p, a, b: point): bool =
    EXISTS (t: real):
      0 <= t AND t <= 1 AND p = affine_point(t, a, b)

  on_polygon_boundary(n: nat, v: vertices, p: point): bool =
    EXISTS (i: nat):
      i < n AND on_edge(p, v(i), v(next_index(i, n)))

  simple_lattice_polygon(n: nat, v: vertices): bool =
    n >= 3
      AND
        (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n IMPLIES lattice_point(v(i)))
      AND
        (FORALL (i, j: nat):
          i < n AND j < n AND v(i) = v(j) IMPLIES i = j)
      AND
        (FORALL (i, j: nat), (p: point):
          i < n
            AND j < n
            AND on_edge(p, v(i), v(next_index(i, n)))
            AND on_edge(p, v(j), v(next_index(j, n)))
          IMPLIES
            i = j
              OR (next_index(i, n) = j AND p = v(j))
              OR (next_index(j, n) = i AND p = v(i)))

  ray_crosses_edge(p, a, b: point): bool =
    (y_coord(a) <= y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < y_coord(b)
      AND cross(a, b, p) > 0)
    OR
    (y_coord(b) <= y_coord(p)
      AND y_coord(p) < y_coord(a)
      AND cross(a, b, p) < 0)

  inside_polygon(n: nat, v: vertices, p: point): bool =
    NOT on_polygon_boundary(n, v, p)
      AND
        EXISTS (crossed_edges: finite_set[nat]), (half_count: nat):
          (FORALL (i: nat):
            crossed_edges(i) IFF
              i < n
                AND ray_crosses_edge(
                  p, v(i), v(next_index(i, n))))
            AND card(crossed_edges) = 2 * half_count + 1

  edge_cross_sum(n: nat, v: vertices, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      edge_cross_sum(n, v, count - 1)
        + x_coord(v(count - 1))
            * y_coord(v(next_index(count - 1, n)))
        - y_coord(v(count - 1))
            * x_coord(v(next_index(count - 1, n)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polygon_area(n: nat, v: vertices): real =
    abs(edge_cross_sum(n, v, n)) / 2

  pick_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (v: vertices):
      simple_lattice_polygon(n, v)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (interior_points, boundary_points: finite_set[point]):
          (FORALL (p: point):
            interior_points(p) IFF
              lattice_point(p) AND inside_polygon(n, v, p))
          AND
            (FORALL (p: point):
              boundary_points(p) IFF
                lattice_point(p) AND on_polygon_boundary(n, v, p))
          AND polygon_area(n, v)
            = (card(interior_points) :: real)
              + (card(boundary_points) :: real) / 2
              - 1
END pick_s_theorem_092

content:

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.CardEmbedding
import Mathlib.Probability.UniformOn
import Mathlib.Probability.Notation

/-!
# Birthday Problem

This file proves Theorem 93 from the [100 Theorems List](https://www.cs.ru.nl/~freek/100/).

As opposed to the standard probabilistic statement, we instead state the birthday problem
in terms of injective functions. The general result about `Fintype.card (α ↪ β)` which this proof
uses is `Fintype.card_embedding_eq`.
-/


namespace Theorems100

local notation "|" x "|" => Finset.card x

local notation "‖" x "‖" => Fintype.card x

/-- **Birthday Problem**: set cardinality interpretation. -/
theorem birthday :
    2 * ‖Fin 23 ↪ Fin 365‖ < ‖Fin 23 → Fin 365‖ ∧ 2 * ‖Fin 22 ↪ Fin 365‖ > ‖Fin 22 → Fin 365‖ := by sorry
section MeasureTheory

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

open scoped ProbabilityTheory ENNReal

variable {n m : ℕ}

/- In order for Lean to understand that we can take probabilities in `Fin 23 → Fin 365`, we must
tell Lean that there is a `MeasurableSpace` structure on the space. Note that this instance
is only for `Fin m` - Lean automatically figures out that the function space `Fin n → Fin m`
is _also_ measurable, by using `MeasurableSpace.pi`, and furthermore that all sets are measurable,
from `MeasurableSingletonClass.pi`. -/
instance : MeasurableSpace (Fin m) :=
  ⊤

instance : MeasurableSingletonClass (Fin m) :=
  ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/- We then endow the space with a canonical measure, which is called ℙ.
We define this to be the conditional counting measure. -/
noncomputable instance measureSpace : MeasureSpace (Fin n → Fin m) :=
  ⟨uniformOn Set.univ⟩

theorem FinFin.measure_apply {s : Set <| Fin n → Fin m} :
    ℙ s = |s.toFinite.toFinset| / ‖Fin n → Fin m‖ := by sorry
theorem birthday_measure :
    ℙ ({f | (Function.Injective f)} : Set ((Fin 23) → (Fin 365))) < 1 / 2 := by sorry
end MeasureTheory

end Theorems100

(*
  Statement-only formalization of "The Birthday Problem" from Hundred Theorems item 093.
  It states the sharp half-cardinality collision thresholds for assignments of 23 and 22
  people to 365 possible birthdays. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Birthday_Problem
  imports Main
begin

definition birthday_functions :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "birthday_functions people days =
    {f. (\<forall>i<people. f i < days) \<and> (\<forall>i. people \<le> i \<longrightarrow> f i = 0)}"

definition birthday_collisions :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "birthday_collisions people days =
    {f \<in> birthday_functions people days. \<not> inj_on f {..<people}}"

theorem birthday_problem:
  "2 * card (birthday_collisions 23 365) > card (birthday_functions 23 365)
    \<and> 2 * card (birthday_collisions 22 365) < card (birthday_functions 22 365)"
  sorry

end

title: 093_the_birthday_problem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact
;; hundred-theorems__acl2__093, "The Birthday Problem": among all functions
;; assigning 365 possible birthdays to 23 people, more than half have a
;; collision, while for 22 people fewer than half have a collision. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A function on a finite person carrier is represented by its image list in
;; carrier order. For duplicate-free carriers, HT093-FUNCTION-IMAGES enumerates
;; every function to the birthday carrier exactly once, so this representation
;; is bijective with the finite function spaces in the source statements.
(defun ht093-prepend-to-each (value image-lists)
  (if (consp image-lists)
      (cons (cons value (car image-lists))
            (ht093-prepend-to-each value (cdr image-lists)))
    nil))

(defun ht093-extend-by-each-image (birthday-carrier image-lists)
  (if (consp birthday-carrier)
      (append
       (ht093-prepend-to-each (car birthday-carrier) image-lists)
       (ht093-extend-by-each-image
        (cdr birthday-carrier) image-lists))
    nil))

(defun ht093-function-images (person-carrier birthday-carrier)
  (if (consp person-carrier)
      (ht093-extend-by-each-image
       birthday-carrier
       (ht093-function-images
        (cdr person-carrier) birthday-carrier))
    (list nil)))

(defun ht093-contains-equal-p (value values)
  (if (consp values)
      (or (equal value (car values))
          (ht093-contains-equal-p value (cdr values)))
    nil))

(defun ht093-collision-p (image-list)
  (if (consp image-list)
      (or (ht093-contains-equal-p (car image-list) (cdr image-list))
          (ht093-collision-p (cdr image-list)))
    nil))

(defun ht093-count-collisions (image-lists)
  (if (consp image-lists)
      (+ (if (ht093-collision-p (car image-lists)) 1 0)
         (ht093-count-collisions (cdr image-lists)))
    0))

(defun hundred-theorems-093-the-birthday-problem-statement
    (people-23 people-22 birthdays)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp people-23)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal people-23)
    (equal (len people-23) 23)
    (true-listp people-22)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal people-22)
    (equal (len people-22) 22)
    (true-listp birthdays)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal birthdays)
    (equal (len birthdays) 365))
   (let* ((functions-23
           (ht093-function-images people-23 birthdays))
          (functions-22
           (ht093-function-images people-22 birthdays)))
     (and
      (> (* 2 (ht093-count-collisions functions-23))
         (len functions-23))
      (< (* 2 (ht093-count-collisions functions-22))
         (len functions-22))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 093_the_birthday_problem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact
-- hundred-theorems__agda__093, "The Birthday Problem": collision assignments
-- are a strict majority for 23 people and a strict minority for 22 people
-- when birthdays range over 365 days. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<N-suc : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  suc<N-suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero = suc zero
power base (suc exponent) = base * power base exponent

subtract : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
subtract n zero = n
subtract zero (suc m) = zero
subtract (suc n) (suc m) = subtract n m

assignmentCount : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
assignmentCount people days = power days people

injectiveAssignmentCount : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
injectiveAssignmentCount zero days = suc zero
injectiveAssignmentCount (suc people) zero = zero
injectiveAssignmentCount (suc people) (suc days) =
  suc days * injectiveAssignmentCount people days

collisionAssignmentCount : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
collisionAssignmentCount people days =
  subtract
    (assignmentCount people days)
    (injectiveAssignmentCount people days)

birthday-problem : Set
birthday-problem =
  Both
    (assignmentCount 23 365 <N
      2 * collisionAssignmentCount 23 365)
    (2 * collisionAssignmentCount 22 365 <N
      assignmentCount 22 365)

  hundred-theorems__hol4__093, cataloged as "The Birthday Problem": more than
  half of all birthday assignments for 23 people have a collision, whereas
  fewer than half do for 22 people. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val the_birthday_problem =
  ``2 *
      CARD
        {birthdays |
           LENGTH birthdays = 23 /\
           EVERY (\day. day < 365) birthdays /\
           ~ALL_DISTINCT birthdays} >
      CARD
        {birthdays |
           LENGTH birthdays = 23 /\
           EVERY (\day. day < 365) birthdays} /\
    2 *
      CARD
        {birthdays |
           LENGTH birthdays = 22 /\
           EVERY (\day. day < 365) birthdays /\
           ~ALL_DISTINCT birthdays} <
      CARD
        {birthdays |
           LENGTH birthdays = 22 /\
           EVERY (\day. day < 365) birthdays}``;

title: 093_the_birthday_problem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 093, "The Birthday
% Problem": among all assignments of 23 people to 365 birthdays, collisions
% occur in more than half, while for 22 people they occur in less than half.
% This file contains no proof.

the_birthday_problem_093: THEORY
BEGIN
  % The base-365 digits of a code enumerate a birthday assignment,
  % with digit zero assigned to the first person.
  birthday_at(code, person: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF person = 0 THEN
      mod(code, 365)
    ELSE
      birthday_at(ndiv(code, 365), person - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE person

  assignment_code(code, people: nat): bool =
    code < 365 ^ people

  collision_code(code, people: nat): bool =
    assignment_code(code, people)
      AND
        EXISTS (first, second: nat):
          first < people
            AND second < people
            AND first /= second
            AND birthday_at(code, first) = birthday_at(code, second)

  count_below(limit: nat, property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  all_assignment_count(people: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      365 ^ people,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): assignment_code(code, people)))

  collision_count(people: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      365 ^ people,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): collision_code(code, people)))

  birthday_problem: bool =
    2 * collision_count(23) > all_assignment_count(23)
      AND
    2 * collision_count(22) < all_assignment_count(22)
END the_birthday_problem_093

title: 094_the_law_of_cosines
content:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Joseph Myers, Manuel Candales

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Affine.AddTorsor
public import Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Angle.Oriented.Affine
public import Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Angle.Unoriented.Affine
public import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

/-!
# Triangles

This file proves basic geometrical results about distances and angles
in (possibly degenerate) triangles in real inner product spaces and
Euclidean affine spaces. More specialized results, and results
developed for simplices in general rather than just for triangles, are
in separate files. Definitions and results that make sense in more
general affine spaces rather than just in the Euclidean case go under
`LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace`.

## Implementation notes

Results in this file are generally given in a form with only those
non-degeneracy conditions needed for the particular result, rather
than requiring affine independence of the points of a triangle
unnecessarily.

## References

* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law_of_cosines
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pons_asinorum
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sum_of_angles_of_a_triangle
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law_of_sines

-/

public section

noncomputable section

open scoped CharZero Real RealInnerProductSpace

namespace InnerProductGeometry

/-!
### Geometrical results on triangles in real inner product spaces

This section develops some results on (possibly degenerate) triangles
in real inner product spaces, where those definitions and results can
most conveniently be developed in terms of vectors and then used to
deduce corresponding results for Euclidean affine spaces.
-/

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]

/-- **Law of cosines** (cosine rule), vector angle form. -/
theorem norm_sub_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_sub_two_mul_norm_mul_norm_mul_cos_angle (x y : V) :
    ‖x - y‖ * ‖x - y‖ = ‖x‖ * ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ * ‖y‖ - 2 * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * Real.cos (angle x y) := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_mul_norm_eq_sin_angle_mul_norm (x y : V) :
    Real.sin (angle x y) * ‖x‖ = Real.sin (angle y (x - y)) * ‖x - y‖ := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_div_norm_eq_sin_angle_div_norm (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxy : x - y ≠ 0) :
    Real.sin (angle x y) / ‖x - y‖ = Real.sin (angle y (x - y)) / ‖x‖ := by sorry
theorem angle_sub_eq_angle_sub_rev_of_norm_eq {x y : V} (h : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖) :
    angle x (x - y) = angle y (y - x) := by sorry
theorem norm_eq_of_angle_sub_eq_angle_sub_rev_of_angle_ne_pi {x y : V}
    (h : angle x (x - y) = angle y (y - x)) (hpi : angle x y ≠ π) : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ := by sorry
theorem angle_eq_angle_add_add_angle_add (x : V) {y : V} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    angle x y = angle x (x + y) + angle y (x + y) := by sorry
theorem angle_add_angle_sub_add_angle_sub_eq_pi (x : V) {y : V} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    angle x y + angle x (x - y) + angle y (y - x) = π := by sorry
end InnerProductGeometry

namespace Orientation

open Module InnerProductGeometry

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [Fact (finrank ℝ V = 2)]
variable (o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2))

/-- **Converse of pons asinorum**, oriented vector angle form (given equality of angles mod `π`). -/
theorem norm_eq_of_two_zsmul_oangle_sub_eq {x y : V}
    (h : (2 : ℤ) • o.oangle x (x - y) = (2 : ℤ) • o.oangle (y - x) y) (h0 : o.oangle x y ≠ 0)
    (hpi : o.oangle x y ≠ π) : ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ := by sorry
end Orientation

namespace EuclideanGeometry

/-!
### Geometrical results on triangles in Euclidean affine spaces

This section develops some geometrical definitions and results on
(possibly degenerate) triangles in Euclidean affine spaces.
-/

open InnerProductGeometry
open scoped EuclideanGeometry

variable {V : Type*} {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P]
  [NormedAddTorsor V P]

/-- **Law of cosines** (cosine rule), angle-at-point form. -/
theorem dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_sub_two_mul_dist_mul_dist_mul_cos_angle (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) :
    dist p₁ p₃ * dist p₁ p₃ = dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₁ p₂ + dist p₃ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ -
      2 * dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ * Real.cos (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) :
    Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) * dist p₂ p₃ = Real.sin (∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) * dist p₃ p₁ := by sorry
theorem sin_angle_div_dist_eq_sin_angle_div_dist {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h23 : p₂ ≠ p₃) (h31 : p₃ ≠ p₁) :
    Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) / dist p₃ p₁ = Real.sin (∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) / dist p₂ p₃ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_dist_mul_sin_angle_div_sin_angle {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P}
    (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({p₁, p₂, p₃} : Set P)) :
    dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₃ p₁ * Real.sin (∠ p₂ p₃ p₁) / Real.sin (∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) := by sorry
theorem angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_of_angle_eq_angle_of_angle_ne_pi {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂)
    (hpi : ∠ p₂ p₁ p₃ ≠ π) : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃ := by sorry
theorem dist_eq_of_two_zsmul_oangle_eq [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)]
    [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : (2 : ℤ) • ∡ p₁ p₂ p₃ = (2 : ℤ) • ∡ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h0 : ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≠ 0) (hpi : ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≠ π) : dist p₁ p₂ = dist p₁ p₃ := by sorry
theorem angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi {p₁ p₂ : P} (p₃ : P) (h : p₂ ≠ p₁) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ + ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ + ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ = π := by sorry
theorem exterior_angle_eq_angle_add_angle {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (p : P) (h : Sbtw ℝ p p₁ p₂) :
    ∠ p₃ p₁ p = ∠ p₁ p₃ p₂ + ∠ p₃ p₂ p₁ := by sorry
theorem oangle_add_oangle_add_oangle_eq_pi [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)]
    [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h21 : p₂ ≠ p₁) (h32 : p₃ ≠ p₂)
    (h13 : p₁ ≠ p₃) : ∡ p₁ p₂ p₃ + ∡ p₂ p₃ p₁ + ∡ p₃ p₁ p₂ = π := by sorry
lemma angle_add_of_ne_of_ne {a b c p : P} (hb : a ≠ b) (hc : a ≠ c) (hp : Wbtw ℝ b p c) :
    ∠ b a p + ∠ p a c = ∠ b a c := by sorry
theorem dist_sq_mul_dist_add_dist_sq_mul_dist (a b c p : P) (h : ∠ b p c = π) :
    dist a b ^ 2 * dist c p + dist a c ^ 2 * dist b p =
    dist b c * (dist a p ^ 2 + dist b p * dist c p) := by sorry
theorem dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq (a b c : P) :
    dist a b ^ 2 + dist a c ^ 2 = 2 * (dist a (midpoint ℝ b c) ^ 2 + (dist b c / 2) ^ 2) := by sorry
theorem dist_mul_of_eq_angle_of_dist_mul (a b c a' b' c' : P) (r : ℝ) (h : ∠ a' b' c' = ∠ a b c)
    (hab : dist a' b' = r * dist a b) (hcb : dist c' b' = r * dist c b) :
    dist a' c' = r * dist a c := by sorry
theorem dist_lt_of_angle_lt {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b < ∠ a b c → dist a b < dist a c := by sorry
theorem angle_lt_iff_dist_lt {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b < ∠ a b c ↔ dist a b < dist a c := by sorry
theorem angle_le_iff_dist_le {a b c : P} (h : ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P)) :
    ∠ a c b ≤ ∠ a b c ↔ dist a b ≤ dist a c := by sorry
lemma pi_div_three_le_angle_of_le_of_le {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃) : π / 3 ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ := by sorry
lemma pi_div_three_lt_angle_of_le_of_le_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ≤ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃)
    (hne : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ∨ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ∨ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) :
    π / 3 < ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ := by sorry
lemma angle_le_pi_div_three_of_le_of_le {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) (hnd : p₁ ≠ p₂ ∨ p₁ ≠ p₃ ∨ p₂ ≠ p₃) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ π / 3 := by sorry
lemma angle_lt_pi_div_three_of_le_of_le_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h₂₃₁ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁)
    (h₃₁₂ : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≤ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂)
    (hne : ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ∨ ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂ ∨ ∠ p₂ p₃ p₁ ≠ ∠ p₃ p₁ p₂) :
    ∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ < π / 3 := by sorry
end EuclideanGeometry
