   (tamep-functionp set)
   (ht099-exists-p
    (list
     'lambda '(start)
     (ht099-and-terms
      (list
       (list 'natp 'start)
       (list 'ht099-universal-p
             (list 'ht099-eventually-from-function
                   (ht099-quoted set) 'start)
             (ht099-quoted '(n))))))
    '(start))))

(defun ht099-sequential-filter ()
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (list 'ht099-eventually-at-top-p 'set)))

;; Exact real powers, factorials, and Taylor partial sums.

(defun ht099-real-nat-value (n real-zero real-one real-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      real-zero
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-add
     (ht099-real-nat-value
      (- n 1) real-zero real-one real-add)
     real-one)))

(defun ht099-real-power
    (value exponent real-one real-multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      real-one
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-multiply
     value
     (ht099-real-power
      value (- exponent 1) real-one real-multiply))))

(defun ht099-real-factorial
    (n real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      real-one
    (ht099-binary-value
     real-multiply
     (ht099-real-nat-value n real-zero real-one real-add)
     (ht099-real-factorial
      (- n 1)
      real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply))))

(defun ht099-real-divide
    (numerator denominator real-multiply real-inverse)
  (ht099-binary-value
   real-multiply
   numerator
   (ht099-unary-value real-inverse denominator)))

(defun ht099-alternating-value (k value real-negate)
  (if (equal (mod (nfix k) 2) 0)
      value
    (ht099-unary-value real-negate value)))

(defun ht099-exp-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (term
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power x k real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              k real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-exp-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-cos-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (exponent (* 2 k))
           (unsigned
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power
              x exponent real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              exponent real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (term
            (ht099-alternating-value k unsigned real-negate)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-cos-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-sin-partial-sum
    (count x
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      real-zero
    (let* ((k (- count 1))
           (exponent (+ 1 (* 2 k)))
           (unsigned
            (ht099-real-divide
             (ht099-real-power
              x exponent real-one real-multiply)
             (ht099-real-factorial
              exponent real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply)
             real-multiply real-inverse))
           (term
            (ht099-alternating-value k unsigned real-negate)))
      (ht099-binary-value
       real-add
       (ht099-sin-partial-sum
        k x
        real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse)
       term))))

(defun ht099-exp-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-exp-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-cos-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-cos-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-negate)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-sin-partial-sum-sequence
    (x real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (list
    'ht099-sin-partial-sum
    'n
    (ht099-quoted x)
    (ht099-quoted real-zero)
    (ht099-quoted real-one)
    (ht099-quoted real-add)
    (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
    (ht099-quoted real-negate)
    (ht099-quoted real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-exp-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-exp-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term exp '(x))))))

(defun ht099-cos-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-cos-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term cos '(x))))))

(defun ht099-sin-values-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (list
     'ht099-real-tendsto-filter-p
     (list 'ht099-natural-carrier)
     (list 'ht099-sequential-filter)
     (ht099-quoted real-carrier)
     (ht099-quoted real-zero)
     (ht099-quoted real-add)
     (ht099-quoted real-negate)
     (ht099-quoted real-less)
     (list
      'ht099-sin-partial-sum-sequence
      'x
      (ht099-quoted real-zero)
      (ht099-quoted real-one)
      (ht099-quoted real-add)
      (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
      (ht099-quoted real-negate)
      (ht099-quoted real-inverse))
     (ht099-static-apply-term sin '(x))))))

(defun ht099-analytic-functions-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp sin cos)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier exp)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier sin)
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier cos)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-exp-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less exp)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-sin-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less sin)
    '(x))
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-cos-values-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less cos)
    '(x))))

;; The total square-root operation agrees with the nonnegative root on
;; nonnegative inputs and is zero on negative inputs.

(defun ht099-square-root-laws-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less square-root)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
    (let ((root (ht099-static-apply-term square-root '(x))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          real-less
          (list 'x (ht099-quoted real-zero)))
         (list 'equal root (ht099-quoted real-zero)))
        (ht099-implies-term
         (ht099-not-term
          (ht099-static-apply-term
           real-less
           (list 'x (ht099-quoted real-zero))))
         (ht099-and-terms
          (list
           (ht099-not-term
            (ht099-static-apply-term
             real-less
             (list root (ht099-quoted real-zero))))
           (list 'equal
                 (ht099-static-apply-term
                  real-multiply (list root root))
                 'x))))))))))

(defun ht099-square-root-operation-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less square-root)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier square-root)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-square-root-laws-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less square-root)
    '(x))))

;; Buffon's experiment uses two independent uniform real random variables:
;; the needle-center distance X in [0,d/2] and its unoriented angle Theta in
;; [0,pi]. The following definitions state those laws by their exact CDFs.

(defun ht099-real-subtract (left right real-add real-negate)
  (ht099-binary-value
   real-add left (ht099-unary-value real-negate right)))

(defun ht099-real-less-equal-p (left right real-less)
  (not (ht099-binary-value real-less right left)))

(defun ht099-real-uniform-cdf-value
    (threshold lower upper
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less)
  (cond
   ((ht099-binary-value real-less threshold lower)
    real-zero)
   ((ht099-real-less-equal-p upper threshold real-less)
    real-one)
   (t
    (ht099-real-divide
     (ht099-real-subtract
      threshold lower real-add real-negate)
     (ht099-real-subtract
      upper lower real-add real-negate)
     real-multiply real-inverse))))

(defun ht099-cdf-event
    (sample-carrier random-variable real-less threshold)
  (list
   'lambda '(omega)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term sample-carrier '(omega))
     (ht099-not-term
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less
       (list
        (ht099-quoted threshold)
        (ht099-static-apply-term random-variable '(omega)))))))))

(defun ht099-uniform-cdf-laws-function
    (sample-carrier measure random-variable real-carrier
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less lower upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(threshold)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(threshold))
    (list
     'equal
     (ht099-static-apply-term
      measure
      (list
       (list 'ht099-cdf-event
             (ht099-quoted sample-carrier)
             (ht099-quoted random-variable)
             (ht099-quoted real-less)
             'threshold)))
     (list
      'ht099-ennreal-finite
      (list
       'ht099-real-uniform-cdf-value
       'threshold
       (ht099-quoted lower)
       (ht099-quoted upper)
       (ht099-quoted real-zero)
       (ht099-quoted real-one)
       (ht099-quoted real-add)
       (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
       (ht099-quoted real-negate)
       (ht099-quoted real-inverse)
       (ht099-quoted real-less)))))))

(defun ht099-uniform-random-variable-p
    (sample-carrier sample-measurable measure random-variable
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less lower upper)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p real-carrier lower)
   (ht099-member-p real-carrier upper)
   (ht099-binary-value real-less lower upper)
   (ht099-measurable-function-p
    sample-carrier sample-measurable
    real-carrier real-less random-variable)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-uniform-cdf-laws-function
     sample-carrier measure random-variable real-carrier
     real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less lower upper)
    '(threshold))))

(defun ht099-event-intersection
    (sample-carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(omega)
   (ht099-and-terms
    (list
     (ht099-static-apply-term sample-carrier '(omega))
     (ht099-static-apply-term left '(omega))
     (ht099-static-apply-term right '(omega))))))

(defun ht099-independent-cdf-laws-function
    (sample-carrier measure left right real-carrier real-less
     real-zero real-multiply)
  (list
   'lambda '(a b)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(a))
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(b))))
    (let ((left-event
           (list 'ht099-cdf-event
                 (ht099-quoted sample-carrier)
                 (ht099-quoted left)
                 (ht099-quoted real-less)
                 'a))
          (right-event
           (list 'ht099-cdf-event
                 (ht099-quoted sample-carrier)
                 (ht099-quoted right)
                 (ht099-quoted real-less)
                 'b)))
      (list
       'equal
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        measure
        (list
         (list 'ht099-event-intersection
               (ht099-quoted sample-carrier)
               left-event right-event)))
       (list
        'ht099-ennreal-multiply
        (ht099-static-apply-term measure (list left-event))
        (ht099-static-apply-term measure (list right-event))
        (ht099-quoted real-zero)
        (ht099-quoted real-multiply)))))))

(defun ht099-independent-real-random-variables-p
    (sample-carrier measure left right
     real-carrier real-less real-zero real-multiply)
  (ht099-universal-p
   (ht099-independent-cdf-laws-function
    sample-carrier measure left right real-carrier real-less
    real-zero real-multiply)
   '(a b)))

;; Pi is the least positive zero of the characterized sine operation.

(defun ht099-no-positive-sine-zero-below-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less sine pi-value)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list (ht099-quoted real-zero) 'x))
      (ht099-static-apply-term
       real-less (list 'x (ht099-quoted pi-value)))))
    (ht099-not-term
     (list
      'equal
      (ht099-static-apply-term sine '(x))
      (ht099-quoted real-zero))))))

(defun ht099-pi-value-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less sine pi-value)
  (and
   (ht099-member-p real-carrier pi-value)
   (ht099-binary-value real-less real-zero pi-value)
   (equal (ht099-unary-value sine pi-value) real-zero)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-no-positive-sine-zero-below-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-less sine pi-value)
    '(x))))

;; Arccos is fixed as the unique angle in [0,pi] having the requested cosine.

(defun ht099-arccos-laws-function
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-negate real-less
     cosine pi-value arccosine)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (ht099-implies-term
    (ht099-and-terms
     (list
      (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier '(x))
      (ht099-not-term
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        real-less
        (list 'x
              (ht099-static-apply-term
               real-negate (list (ht099-quoted real-one))))))
      (ht099-not-term
       (ht099-static-apply-term
        real-less
        (list (ht099-quoted real-one) 'x)))))
    (let ((angle
           (ht099-static-apply-term arccosine '(x))))
      (ht099-and-terms
       (list
        (ht099-static-apply-term real-carrier (list angle))
        (ht099-not-term
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          real-less (list angle (ht099-quoted real-zero))))
        (ht099-not-term
         (ht099-static-apply-term
          real-less (list (ht099-quoted pi-value) angle)))
        (list
         'equal
         (ht099-static-apply-term cosine (list angle))
         'x)))))))

(defun ht099-arccos-operation-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-negate real-less
     cosine pi-value arccosine)
  (and
   (ht099-function-p real-carrier real-carrier arccosine)
   (ht099-universal-p
    (ht099-arccos-laws-function
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-negate real-less
     cosine pi-value arccosine)
    '(x))))

(defun ht099-crossing-event
    (sample-carrier position angle
     real-add real-multiply real-inverse real-less sine
     needle-length real-one)
  (let ((two (ht099-binary-value real-add real-one real-one)))
    (list
     'lambda '(omega)
     (ht099-and-terms
      (list
       (ht099-static-apply-term sample-carrier '(omega))
       (ht099-not-term
        (ht099-static-apply-term
         real-less
         (list
          (list
           'ht099-binary-value
           (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
           (ht099-quoted needle-length)
           (list
            'ht099-binary-value
            (ht099-quoted real-multiply)
            (ht099-quoted
             (ht099-unary-value real-inverse two))
            (ht099-static-apply-term
             sine
             (list
              (ht099-static-apply-term angle '(omega))))))
          (ht099-static-apply-term position '(omega))))))))))

(defun ht099-short-needle-probability
    (needle-length line-spacing pi-value
     real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse)
  (let ((two (ht099-binary-value real-add real-one real-one)))
    (ht099-real-divide
     (ht099-binary-value real-multiply two needle-length)
     (ht099-binary-value real-multiply pi-value line-spacing)
     real-multiply real-inverse)))

(defun ht099-long-needle-probability
    (needle-length line-spacing pi-value
     real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     square-root arccosine)
  (let* ((two (ht099-binary-value real-add real-one real-one))
         (length-square
          (ht099-binary-value
           real-multiply needle-length needle-length))
         (spacing-square
          (ht099-binary-value
           real-multiply line-spacing line-spacing))
         (root
          (ht099-unary-value
           square-root
           (ht099-real-subtract
            length-square spacing-square
            real-add real-negate)))
         (ratio
          (ht099-real-divide
           line-spacing needle-length
           real-multiply real-inverse))
         (angle (ht099-unary-value arccosine ratio))
         (inside
          (ht099-binary-value
           real-add
           (ht099-real-subtract
            needle-length root real-add real-negate)
           (ht099-binary-value
            real-multiply line-spacing angle))))
    (ht099-real-divide
     (ht099-binary-value real-multiply two inside)
     (ht099-binary-value real-multiply pi-value line-spacing)
     real-multiply real-inverse)))

(defun hundred-theorems-099-buffon-needle-problem-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
     exponential sine cosine square-root arccosine pi-value
     sample-carrier sample-measurable probability
     position angle needle-length line-spacing)
  (let* ((two
          (ht099-binary-value real-add real-one real-one))
         (half-spacing
          (ht099-binary-value
           real-multiply line-spacing
           (ht099-unary-value real-inverse two)))
         (crossing
          (ht099-crossing-event
           sample-carrier position angle
           real-add real-multiply real-inverse real-less sine
           needle-length real-one))
         (crossing-probability
          (ht099-unary-value probability crossing)))
    (implies
     (and
      (ht099-real-field-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum)
      (ht099-analytic-functions-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less exponential sine cosine)
      (ht099-square-root-operation-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less square-root)
      (ht099-pi-value-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less sine pi-value)
      (ht099-arccos-operation-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-negate real-less
       cosine pi-value arccosine)
      (ht099-probability-measure-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-less
       sample-carrier sample-measurable probability)
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier needle-length)
      (ht099-member-p real-carrier line-spacing)
      (ht099-binary-value real-less real-zero needle-length)
      (ht099-binary-value real-less real-zero line-spacing)
      (ht099-uniform-random-variable-p
       sample-carrier sample-measurable probability position
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less
       real-zero half-spacing)
      (ht099-uniform-random-variable-p
       sample-carrier sample-measurable probability angle
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less
       real-zero pi-value)
      (ht099-independent-real-random-variables-p
       sample-carrier probability position angle
       real-carrier real-less real-zero real-multiply))
     (and
      (implies
       (ht099-real-less-equal-p
        needle-length line-spacing real-less)
       (equal
        crossing-probability
        (ht099-ennreal-finite
         (ht099-short-needle-probability
          needle-length line-spacing pi-value
          real-one real-add real-multiply real-inverse))))
      (implies
       (ht099-real-less-equal-p
        line-spacing needle-length real-less)
       (equal
        crossing-probability
        (ht099-ennreal-finite
         (ht099-long-needle-probability
          needle-length line-spacing pi-value
          real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
          square-root arccosine))))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: 099_buffon_needle_problem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact
-- hundred-theorems__agda__099, "Buffon Needle Problem": the crossing probability
-- for a uniformly dropped needle in the short- and long-needle cases. This file
-- contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate reciprocal absoluteValue : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z == multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocal zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (reciprocal x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNat m == fromNat n -> m == n

    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      absoluteValue x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x zeroR ->
      absoluteValue x == negate x

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (reciprocal reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

power :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power reals x zero =
  oneR reals
power reals x (suc n) =
  multiply reals (power reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

alternatingSign :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
alternatingSign reals zero =
  oneR reals
alternatingSign reals (suc n) =
  negate reals (alternatingSign reals n)

evenIndex : Nat -> Nat
evenIndex n =
  n + n

oddIndex : Nat -> Nat
oddIndex n =
  suc (evenIndex n)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

cosinePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosinePartialSum reals x n =
  sumFirst reals
    (\ k ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals k)
        (divide reals
          (power reals x (evenIndex k))
          (fromNat reals (factorial (evenIndex k)))))
    n

sinePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sinePartialSum reals x n =
  sumFirst reals
    (\ k ->
      multiply reals
        (alternatingSign reals k)
        (divide reals
          (power reals x (oddIndex k))
          (fromNat reals (factorial (oddIndex k)))))
    n

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteValue reals (subtract reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    pi : R
    sine cosine squareRoot arccosine : R -> R

    sine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (sinePartialSum algebra x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SequentialLimit algebra
        (cosinePartialSum algebra x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess algebra (zeroR algebra) pi
    sine-pi :
      sine pi == zeroR algebra
    cosine-pi :
      cosine pi == negate algebra (oneR algebra)
    pi-least-positive-cosine-minus-one :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      cosine x == negate algebra (oneR algebra) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra pi x

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) (squareRoot x)
    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      square algebra (squareRoot x) == x
    square-root-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (zeroR algebra) ->
      squareRoot x == zeroR algebra

    cosine-arccosine :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (negate algebra (oneR algebra)) x ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (oneR algebra) ->
      cosine (arccosine x) == x
    arccosine-range :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (negate algebra (oneR algebra)) x ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x (oneR algebra) ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) (arccosine x))
        (lessOrEqual algebra (arccosine x) pi)
    arccosine-cosine :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      lessOrEqual algebra x pi ->
      arccosine (cosine x) == x

open StandardRealAnalysis

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement E x =
  Not (E x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection E F x =
  Both (E x) (F x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable (complement E)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      measurable E ->
      measurable F

open SigmaAlgebra

preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
preimage f E x =
  E (f x)

MeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
MeasurableFunction source target f =
  (E : Predicate _) ->
  measurable target E ->
  measurable source (preimage f E)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record ProbabilitySpace
  {A R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    probability : Predicate A -> R

    probability-congruent :
      (E F : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (E x) (F x)) ->
      probability E == probability F
    probability-empty :
      probability emptySet == zeroR (algebra analysis)
    probability-whole :
      probability wholeSet == oneR (algebra analysis)
    probability-nonnegative :
      (E : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events E ->
      lessOrEqual (algebra analysis)
        (zeroR (algebra analysis))
        (probability E)
    countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit (algebra analysis)
        (\ count ->
          sumFirst (algebra analysis)
            (\ n -> probability (sets n))
            count)
        (probability (countableUnion sets))

open ProbabilitySpace

record StandardProbabilityTheory (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R
    borel : SigmaAlgebra R
    borel-lower-ray :
      (t : R) ->
      measurable borel
        (\ x -> lessOrEqual (algebra analysis) x t)

open StandardProbabilityTheory

realAlgebra :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardProbabilityTheory R ->
  CompleteOrderedField R
realAlgebra theory =
  algebra (analysis theory)

distributionFunction :
  {R A : Set}
  {theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  ProbabilitySpace (analysis theory) events ->
  (A -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
distributionFunction {theory = theory} space X t =
  probability space
    (\ x -> lessOrEqual (realAlgebra theory) (X x) t)

record UniformVariable
  {R A : Set}
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (space : ProbabilitySpace (analysis theory) events)
  (X : A -> R)
  (a b : R) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable-variable :
      MeasurableFunction events (borel theory) X
    proper-interval :
      StrictLess (realAlgebra theory) a b
    cdf-below :
      (t : R) ->
      StrictLess (realAlgebra theory) t a ->
      distributionFunction {theory = theory} {events = events} space X t ==
      zeroR (realAlgebra theory)
    cdf-middle :
      (t : R) ->
      lessOrEqual (realAlgebra theory) a t ->
      StrictLess (realAlgebra theory) t b ->
      distributionFunction {theory = theory} {events = events} space X t ==
      divide (realAlgebra theory)
        (subtract (realAlgebra theory) t a)
        (subtract (realAlgebra theory) b a)
    cdf-above :
      (t : R) ->
      lessOrEqual (realAlgebra theory) b t ->
      distributionFunction {theory = theory} {events = events} space X t ==
      oneR (realAlgebra theory)

record IndependentVariables
  {R A : Set}
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (space : ProbabilitySpace (analysis theory) events)
  (X Y : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    independent-events :
      (E F : Predicate R) ->
      measurable (borel theory) E ->
      measurable (borel theory) F ->
      probability space
        (intersection (preimage X E) (preimage Y F)) ==
      multiply (realAlgebra theory)
        (probability space (preimage X E))
        (probability space (preimage Y F))

crossingEvent :
  {R A : Set} ->
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R) ->
  (X theta : A -> R) ->
  R ->
  Predicate A
crossingEvent theory X theta length outcome =
  lessOrEqual reals
    (X outcome)
    (multiply reals
      (divide reals length (fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))))
      (sine (analysis theory) (theta outcome)))
  where
    reals = realAlgebra theory

shortFormula :
  {R : Set} ->
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
shortFormula theory length spacing =
  divide reals
    (multiply reals two length)
    (multiply reals piR spacing)
  where
    reals = realAlgebra theory
    two = fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))
    piR = pi (analysis theory)

longFormula :
  {R : Set} ->
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
longFormula theory length spacing =
  multiply reals
    (divide reals two (multiply reals piR spacing))
    (add reals
      (subtract reals
        length
        (squareRoot (analysis theory)
          (subtract reals
            (square reals length)
            (square reals spacing))))
      (multiply reals
        spacing
        (arccosine (analysis theory)
          (divide reals spacing length))))
  where
    reals = realAlgebra theory
    two = fromNat reals (suc (suc zero))
    piR = pi (analysis theory)

record BuffonNeedleConclusion
  {R A : Set}
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (space : ProbabilitySpace (analysis theory) events)
  (X theta : A -> R)
  (length spacing : R) : Set where
  field
    short-needle :
      lessOrEqual (realAlgebra theory) length spacing ->
      probability space (crossingEvent theory X theta length) ==
      shortFormula theory length spacing
    long-needle :
      lessOrEqual (realAlgebra theory) spacing length ->
      probability space (crossingEvent theory X theta length) ==
      longFormula theory length spacing

buffon-needle-problem : Set1
buffon-needle-problem =
  (R A : Set) ->
  (theory : StandardProbabilityTheory R) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (space : ProbabilitySpace (analysis theory) events) ->
  (X theta : A -> R) ->
  (length spacing : R) ->
  StrictLess (realAlgebra theory)
    (zeroR (realAlgebra theory))
    length ->
  StrictLess (realAlgebra theory)
    (zeroR (realAlgebra theory))
    spacing ->
  UniformVariable theory events space X
    (zeroR (realAlgebra theory))
    (divide (realAlgebra theory)
      spacing
      (fromNat (realAlgebra theory) (suc (suc zero)))) ->
  UniformVariable theory events space theta
    (zeroR (realAlgebra theory))
    (pi (analysis theory)) ->
  IndependentVariables theory events space X theta ->
  BuffonNeedleConclusion
    theory events space X theta length spacing

title: 099_buffon_needle_problem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of "Buffon Needle Problem" from Hundred Theorems
  artifact hundred-theorems__hol4__099. For a needle of positive length dropped
  with independent uniform distance and angle, it states the short- and
  long-needle crossing probabilities. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory probabilityTheory;

val buffon_needle_problem =
  ``let uniform_on =
      \(p : 'a p_space) (Z : 'a -> real) (a : real) (b : real).
        random_variable Z p borel /\
        a < b /\
        !t.
          distribution_function p Z t =
          if t < a then 0
          else if b <= t then 1
          else Normal ((t - a) / (b - a))
    in
      !(p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) (Theta : 'a -> real)
       (l : real) (d : real).
        prob_space p /\
        0 < l /\
        0 < d /\
        uniform_on p X 0 (d / 2) /\
        uniform_on p Theta 0 pi /\
        indep_rv p X Theta borel borel
        ==>
        prob p
          {w |
             w IN p_space p /\
             X w <= (l / 2) * sin (Theta w)} =
        Normal
          (if l <= d then
             (2 * l) / (pi * d)
           else
             (2 / (pi * d)) *
             (l - sqrt (l pow 2 - d pow 2) + d * acs (d / l)))``;

title: 099_buffon_needle_problem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems corpus artifact 099,
  "Buffon Needle Problem". It states Buffon's needle crossing probability for
  positive needle length and line spacing, using independent uniform real
  random variables for the distance from the needle center to the nearest
  line and for its angle. The general integral identity and the short- and
  long-needle closed forms are included. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ library/set.mm $]

$(
  HT099Uniform gives the exact cumulative-distribution characterization of a
  uniform real random variable on [ A , B ]. HT099Independent expands
  independence as the product identity for every pair of Borel preimages.
  HT099Crossing is the event

    X <= ( L / 2 ) sin T.

  Thus X is uniform on [ 0 , D / 2 ] and T is uniform on [ 0 , pi ], exactly
  the distance-and-angle model used by the HOL Light source and equivalent to
  the signed-center product-space models in the Isabelle and Lean sources.
  The integral below uses ( 0 , pi ); this equals the sources' integral over
  [ 0 , pi ] because the two endpoints have Lebesgue measure zero.

  Every declaration is an unproved $a statement. There is no $p proof
  statement in this file.
$)

$c HT099Uniform HT099Independent HT099Crossing $.

ht099-uniform-syntax $a wff ( HT099Uniform P X A B ) $.
ht099-independent-syntax $a wff ( HT099Independent P X T ) $.
ht099-crossing-syntax $a class ( HT099Crossing P X T L ) $.

${
  $d A B P X t x $.

  ht099-uniform-definition $a |- (
    ( HT099Uniform P X A B )
    <->
    (
      P e. Prob
      /\
      (
        X e. ( dom P MblFnM BrSiga )
        /\
        (
          A e. RR
          /\
          (
            B e. RR
            /\
            (
              A < B
              /\
              A. t e. RR
                (
                  P `
                  { x e. U. dom P | ( X ` x ) <_ t }
                )
                =
                if (
                  t < A ,
                  0 ,
                  if (
                    B < t ,
                    1 ,
                    ( t - A ) / ( B - A )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P T X a b $.

  ht099-independent-definition $a |- (
    ( HT099Independent P X T )
    <->
    A. a e. BrSiga A. b e. BrSiga
      (
        P ` (
          ( `' X " a )
          i^i
          ( `' T " b )
        )
      )
      =
      (
        ( P ` ( `' X " a ) )
        *e
        ( P ` ( `' T " b ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L P T X x $.

  ht099-crossing-definition $a |- (
    HT099Crossing P X T L
    =
    { x e. U. dom P |
      ( X ` x )
      <_
      (
        ( L / 2 )
        x.
        ( sin ` ( T ` x ) )
      )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D L P T X t $.

  ht099-buffon-needle $a |- (
    (
      0 < L
      /\
      (
        0 < D
        /\
        (
          ( HT099Uniform P X 0 ( D / 2 ) )
          /\
          (
            ( HT099Uniform P T 0 _pi )
            /\
            ( HT099Independent P X T )
          )
        )
      )
    )
    ->
    (
      (
        P ` ( HT099Crossing P X T L )
      )
      =
      (
        ( 2 / ( _pi x. D ) )
        x.
        S. ( 0 (,) _pi )
          if (
            ( D / 2 )
            <_
            (
              ( L / 2 )
              x.
              ( sin ` t )
            )
            ,
            ( D / 2 )
            ,
            (
              ( L / 2 )
              x.
              ( sin ` t )
            )
          )
          _d t
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          L <_ D
          ->
          (
            P ` ( HT099Crossing P X T L )
          )
          =
          (
            ( 2 x. L )
            /
            ( _pi x. D )
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          D <_ L
          ->
          (
            P ` ( HT099Crossing P X T L )
          )
          =
          (
            ( 2 / ( _pi x. D ) )
            x.
            (
              (
                L
                -
                (
                  sqrt
                  `
                  (
                    ( L ^ 2 )
                    -
                    ( D ^ 2 )
                  )
                )
              )
              +
              (
                D
                x.
                (
                  arccos
                  `
                  ( D / L )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

title: 099_buffon_needle_problem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of hundred-theorems artifact 099,
:: "Buffon Needle Problem": the probability that a uniformly positioned and
:: oriented needle crosses a parallel line, in both the short- and long-needle
:: cases. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, PARTFUN1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ARYTM_3, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, FUNCT_2,
      VALUED_0, MESFUNC1, SUPINF_2, FINSEQ_1, NAT_1, CARD_3, CARD_1,
      ZFMISC_1, FINSET_1, PROB_4, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FUNCOP_1,
      FINANCE1, REAL_1, SETFAM_1, SEQ_2, SQUARE_1, POWER, MEASUR12,
      SIN_COS, SIN_COS6, COMPLEX1, RVSUM_1, MESFUNC5, INTEGRA5, XCMPLX_0,
      ARYTM_1, VALUED_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, FINSET_1,
      CARD_1, NUMBERS, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, NAT_1,

      MEASURE6, MESFUNC1, PROB_4, MESFUNC6, MESFUNC5, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2,
      RANDOM_3, FINANCE1, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, POWER, RVSUM_1, MEASUR12,
      SIN_COS, SIN_COS6, COMPLEX1, VALUED_1, MESFUN6C;
 constructors REAL_1, MESFUNC6, MEASURE6, PROB_3, PROB_4, MESFUNC1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      X,Theta being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
      FX,FTheta being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets,
      muX,muTheta being Probability of Borel_Sets,
      C being Element of Sigma,
      l,d being Real
  st
    0 < l & 0 < d &
    FX = X & FTheta = Theta &
    probability(FX,P) = muX &
    probability(FTheta,P) = muTheta &
    (for t being Real,
         A being Element of Borel_Sets
      st A = ].-infty,t.]
      holds
        (t < 0 implies (muX.A qua Real) = 0) &
        (0 <= t & t < d/2 implies (muX.A qua Real) = t/(d/2)) &
        (d/2 <= t implies (muX.A qua Real) = 1)) &
    (for t being Real,
         A being Element of Borel_Sets
      st A = ].-infty,t.]
      holds
        (t < 0 implies (muTheta.A qua Real) = 0) &
        (0 <= t & t < PI implies (muTheta.A qua Real) = t/PI) &
        (PI <= t implies (muTheta.A qua Real) = 1)) &
    (for A,B being Element of Borel_Sets,
         EA,EB being Element of Sigma
      st EA = FX"A & EB = FTheta"B
      holds
        (P.(EA /\ EB) qua Real) =
          (P.EA qua Real) * (P.EB qua Real)) &
    C = {omega where omega is Element of Omega :
      X.omega <= (l/2) * sin.(Theta.omega)}
  holds
    (l <= d implies (P.C qua Real) = (2*l)/(PI*d)) &
    (d <= l implies
      (P.C qua Real) =
        (2/(PI*d)) *
          (l - sqrt(l^2-d^2) + d*arccos(d/l)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: 099_buffon_needle_problem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Hundred Theorems artifact 099, "Buffon Needle Problem":
% for a uniformly positioned and oriented needle dropped across parallel lines, the crossing
% probability has the standard short-needle and long-needle formulas. This file contains no proof.

buffon_needle_problem_099: THEORY
BEGIN
  sample_space: TYPE+

  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  random_variable: TYPE = [sample_space -> real]
  real_event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_event]
  real_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [real_event -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(values(count) - limit) < epsilon_value

  sine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    2 < value
      AND value < 4
      AND cosine(value / 2) = 0

  pi: real =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: real): is_pi(value))

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(i)(omega) AND events(j)(omega))

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_probability_measure(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(empty_event) = 0
      AND M(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          0 <= M(A) AND M(A) <= 1)
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
                count),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  real_full_event: real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real): TRUE

  real_event_complement(A: real_event): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real):
      NOT A(value)

  real_countable_union(events: real_event_sequence): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  is_real_sigma_algebra(
      BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    BorelSigma(real_full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        BorelSigma(A) IMPLIES
          BorelSigma(real_event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: real_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): BorelSigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES BorelSigma(real_countable_union(events)))

  contains_real_lower_rays(
      BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      BorelSigma(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          value <= bound)

  borel_event(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (BorelSigma: real_sigma_algebra):
      (is_real_sigma_algebra(BorelSigma)
        AND contains_real_lower_rays(BorelSigma))
      IMPLIES BorelSigma(A)

  preimage_event(
      X: random_variable,
      A: real_event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      A(X(omega))

  sublevel_event(
      X: random_variable,
      bound: real): event =
    preimage_event(
      X,
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        value <= bound)

  random_variable_on(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      borel_event(A) IMPLIES
        Sigma(preimage_event(X, A))

  uniform_random_variable(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      left_endpoint, right_endpoint: real): bool =
    random_variable_on(Sigma, X)
      AND left_endpoint < right_endpoint
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        M(sublevel_event(X, bound))
          = IF bound < left_endpoint THEN
              0
            ELSIF right_endpoint <= bound THEN
              1
            ELSE
              (bound - left_endpoint)
                / (right_endpoint - left_endpoint)
            ENDIF)

  independent_random_variables(
      M: probability_measure,
      X, Y: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: real_event):
      borel_event(A) AND borel_event(B)
      IMPLIES
        M(event_intersection(
          preimage_event(X, A),
          preimage_event(Y, B)))
          = M(preimage_event(X, A))
              * M(preimage_event(Y, B))

  crossing_event(
      distance, angle: random_variable,
      needle_length: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      distance(omega)
        <= (needle_length / 2) * sine(angle(omega))

  nonnegative_square_root(
      radicand, root: real): bool =
    root >= 0
      AND root * root = radicand

  principal_arccos(
      value, angle: real): bool =
    0 <= angle
      AND angle <= pi
      AND cosine(angle) = value

  long_needle_probability(
      probability_value, needle_length, line_distance: real): bool =
    EXISTS (root, angle: real):
      nonnegative_square_root(
        needle_length * needle_length
          - line_distance * line_distance,
        root)
        AND principal_arccos(
          safe_div(line_distance, needle_length),
          angle)
        AND probability_value
          = safe_div(2, pi * line_distance)
              * (needle_length - root
                  + line_distance * angle)

  buffon_needle_problem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (distance, angle: random_variable),
        (needle_length, line_distance: real):
      (is_probability_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND 0 < needle_length
        AND 0 < line_distance
        AND uniform_random_variable(
          M, Sigma, distance, 0, line_distance / 2)
        AND uniform_random_variable(
          M, Sigma, angle, 0, pi)
        AND independent_random_variables(
          M, distance, angle))
      IMPLIES
        ((needle_length <= line_distance IMPLIES
          M(crossing_event(
            distance, angle, needle_length))
            = safe_div(
                2 * needle_length,
                pi * line_distance))
          AND
          (line_distance <= needle_length IMPLIES
            long_needle_probability(
              M(crossing_event(
                distance, angle, needle_length)),
              needle_length,
              line_distance)))
END buffon_needle_problem_099
